title: Top PUA
description: This is an LVG, a GALGAME, a visual novel, a super hilarious game. This story happend in Mainland China. In this game, our protagonist Willie dated a top pick-up artist Lilie. Although she is pretty young, but she know everything about dating with a man.

title: Doppa
description: Guide the lost Doppas to the spirit world by controlling their path in this endless journey.

title: Flora Domina
description: In this unique take on turn-based 4X strategy, play as a nature goddess that defends her island by playing cards to use nature as your ally.

title: Eternal Survivor
description: A fast paced twin stick shooter with roguelite elements. Trapped inside a dungeon room you must endure and survive.

title: Ink Neko Maid
description: A relaxing puzzle game with cat-girls.

title: Digital Exorcist Case_(0);
description: Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-Agency operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.

title: Nox Archaist: Lord of Storms
description: An expansion pack for Nox Archaist, containing the original story plus a new scenario and new features. Puzzles and powerful magic items await, along with dangerous traps and monsters. Those foolhardy enough to brave these perils will come face to face with the Lord of Storms! 15+ hours gameplay.

title: Piano at 5 am
description: "Piano at 5 am." is a short text adventure game. A girl who is the main character wanders in a fog forest while adjusting the four factors of "drowsiness," "thirst," "madness," and "recharge," which increase or decrease depending on the choices she makes.

title: Unalive 010
description: Welcome to the captivating world of Unalive - a game where the hero must battle fierce monsters using their shooting skills. You will navigate randomly generated room labyrinths and face challenging bosses, while mysterious events unfold throughout the game. Be prepared for unpredictable challenges and tests at every turn, creating an immersive atmosphere that draws the player deeper into the world's mysteries and enigmas. Will you be able to unravel all the secrets of Unalive? Only time will tell...

title: Xenon Runner
description: Xenon Runner is a fast paced speedrunning parkour FPS where you compete against yourself, your friends, and the world. Utilize grappling, power sliding, recoil knockback, and wallrunning to complete the levels as fast as possible.

title: Paws of Coal
description:
Paws of Coal is a cozy, slow-paced detective adventure with gameplay influenced by the scientific method – quests are solved by connecting evidence. If you get it right, the mystery is solved. If you get it wrong, everyone could be in danger. So, tread carefully.

In the game, you play as Charles, a scholar on a mission sent by His Majesty (the lion king Lav) to help the critters of The Burrows where the outbreak is on the rise. Is it dangerous, or just a mere nuisance? It is up to Charles to find out what is going on.

But there would be problems on his path, both scientific and social.

The Burrows is a mining town, and miners are on a strike
There is no cure for the outbreak, and productivity is suffering. The miners won't tolerate the current scenario and are on strike. The problem? The foreman of The Burrows isn't having any of it and wants to shut down the strike. Unless Charles finds a creative solution.

Paws of Coal is a short, stand-alone game set in the larger Trip the Ark Fantastic universe that is currently in development in Gamechuck. Paws of Coal offers around 3 to 4 hours of gameplay (depending on your play style), and even multiple endings.

The investigation is solved by talking to each resident of The Burrows, finding the clues in the environment, making a lot of notes, and connecting the dots (literally) using the interface in Charles' journal.

When you're sure you got it right - submit the report, and... hope for the best. Good luck!

title: Sol: Last Light
description: Sol: Last Light is a third-person, action-adventure RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world. Learn to control your newly discovered power to harness energy from the sun and battle against robots on your journey up the mountain to find your captured sister.

title: I Read a Post Online about Monarch Butterflies
description:
Made with bitsy for the pollinators bitsy jam,
very, very, very last minute

title: Cafe Venus Flytrap
description: You're a fly. A fly whose hobbies consist of writing novels and eating sweets. One day you decide to check out a new cute cafe that promises an abundance of pastries, sweets and drinks. A cafe that is run by adorable froggos.

title: Yuka: Scattered Shards of the Yokai
description:
Due to a kappa's careless mistake, Yuuka's common sense and sexual reasoning broke out of her mind into fragments and were scattered all around the world... but by strange coincidence, a mortal from the nearby village just happened to be there and as consequence, he was forced to explain what happened...
The pieces could not be seen with the naked eye and yet the mortal could... so he was forced by Yuuka to help collect the pieces in order to regain the fragments of her mental mind but there was one slight problem...
The fragments were very delicate and easy to break, and if they did then Yuuka's common sense and sexual reasoning will be lost meaning her plump body will be for anyones taking...​

title: Fossil Sweeper
description: Fossil Sweeper is a game about excavating fossils and building skeletons of prehistoric animals.

title: Raimodula
description: Raimodula is a dynamic arcade platformer, featuring customizable characters and randomized progression. Unlock habilities, fight modular enemies and navigate surreal environments with polished controls and intense gameplay!

title: Coffee Dates
description: Coffee Dates is a fun and lighthearted visual novel about hanging out with your crazy co-workers and the comedic shenanigans that unfold. There's even a few bits of game play that aren't just reading. Isn't that cool!

title: Neptunia GameMaker R:Evolution
description: Hyperdimension Neptunia GameMaker R:Evolution is set during an era where game makers are competing with each other. There were three goddesses of game makers who were defeated in the race to win "market share" of game sales and perished. Will they be branded as "goddesses of failure" and disappear? However, Adult Neptune who travels many dimensions suddenly appears in their world, asked by the three goddesses to become their president in order to revive the fallen game maker.

title: I Spy School Days
description: I Spy is the fourth game in an educational game series based on the series of children's hidden object books. It is the same as the first game, I Spy, with the addition of Craft Project levels.

title: Ducklyte
description: Ducklyte is a top-down shooter with roguelite elements where you play as a constipated little duck trying to stay alive as long as possible in a randomly generated farm with progressively stronger enemies.

title: The Stoevi Curse
description: Unravel the mystery of The Stoevi Curse, a first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria. Protect your farm, save your family.

title: Wandering Skies
description: Navigate through the Sky Lands and uncover its secrets to restore their lost harmony. In this first person platformer, use your abilities to reach the end of each level. Observation and skill are the keys to success !

title: Magic Toenail
description: Magic Toenail is a strategic wizarding roguelite where every step you take is a tactical maneuver! You shoot when you move and move when you shoot, so even the simplest enemy encounters will quickly become high-stakes puzzles!

title: Hatsune no Naisho!!
description: Hatsune no Naishou is a collection of Leaf's mini games that any Leaf's fan should not miss. The CD contains several cute mini software including some mini games, screen saver, wallpaper, and CD player. The mini games packed in the CD include a mini action game called Heart By Heart with characters from To Heart, a mini RPG game called Leaf Fighting 97, To Heart Omake, and of course the adventure game Hastune no Naishou.

title: Love on Leave
description: You have some paid time off and decide to use it to return to your roots in the countryside.

title: Criminal Archives: Alphabetic Murders - Collector's Edition
description: Are the murders of three different people connected? Or are we dealing with three different incidents? Cunning and logic are your best weapons in solving this case!

title: Monster Memory
description: A stylized card matching memory game based on icons of horror with atmospheric music Relive your childhood with this simple yet fun puzzle game by matching the cards as fast as you can

title: Catch The Fox
description: It's a massive game of tag, who will win?

title: Two Portals: A Gemstone Puzzle Game
description: Open locks, activate gemstones, join passages to the grid and advance to the next level! Two Portals - A Gemstone Puzzle Game is a grid-based movement minimalist puzzle game.

title: Looking for Aliens: Collector's Edition
description:
Aliens are among us! Can you find traces of them on Earth, the moon, and the edges of the galaxy? Find all the clues to prove the existence of alien civilizations and discover how making fried eggs can end up in a monster attack!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
• Blast-off with five exciting bonus levels!
• Explore the galaxy with a downloadable soundtrack and wallpapers!
• Tons of hidden cards to collect!

title: Into the Breach: Advanced Edition
description:
Nearly every aspect of the game will be expanded with new content, including:

New Mechs and Weapons: Five new mech squads and nearly forty new weapons.

New Challenges: More enemies, more bosses, and more mission objectives that add additional challenge and variety to any run.

New Pilot Abilities: The expanded roster includes four new pilots and triple the amount of skills any pilot can earn through promotions.We’ll be elaborating on all of this new content over the coming weeks before launch and can’t wait for everyone to check it out.

title: Voltorometer Recharged+
description:
A remake of the game Voltorometer, released in 2009, with improved graphics, sound, controller support and more than 3 times the amount of content.

A simple platformer, run and jump to reach the end of each stage and progress through all the worlds to destroy the factories that trapped you and tried to harvest your electrical energy, unlock new modes and challenges by collecting all the power orbs in each level.

title: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows
description:
Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms. The game is based on the popular internet creepypasta about a mysterious place that exists between the walls and floors of buildings, a place where people can become trapped and lost for days, weeks, or even years.

In the game, you play as a person who has become trapped in the Backrooms, and your goal is to find a way out before the endless maze drives you insane. The Backrooms are a surreal and unsettling place, filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and mysterious creatures that seem to be watching you from the shadows.

As you explore the Backrooms, you'll need to find keys, solve puzzles, and avoid dangerous traps and obstacles. You'll also encounter other lost souls who are trying to escape, but not all of them can be trusted. The deeper you go, the more unsettling the Backrooms become, and the harder it is to tell what's real and what's just a figment of your imagination.

Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is designed to be a tense and atmospheric horror experience, with a focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival. It's a game that will keep you on edge from start to finish, as you try to find your way out of this terrifying and otherworldly place.

title: Erobos Heaven
description:
This is a short, very uncanny horror game, focusing on darkness..
Answering to your prayers, you get teleported into Salvation's land.

But, what answered your prayers?

title: Dig2China
description:
Dig through the center of the Earth in your backyard!
Upgrade your digger and plunge through 13 layers of the Earth to prove that if you dig deep enough, you really will make it to the other side. And make it back in time for dinner!

title: Sketch Doom
description: A mod which turns a classic Doom game into a pencil sketches on paper list.

title: Paper Angel
description:
Paper Angel is a short visual novel made in RPG Maker VX Ace. You have become conscious and find yourself taking care of “Spinwhim”. Why? Who know! It is just great that you are here!

Content Warning: Eyestrain, Clusters, Reality Distortion…

title: Student Council Leader Auriel
description: A simulation-management type eroge game where the protagonist, student council president Adam, kidnaps his classmate Auriel to make her his personal sexual slave.

title: Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer
description: Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer is a mystery visual novel where you enter the remote and sparsely populated island of Shikinejima and attempt to solve the strangely recurring mystery found there.

title: Town of Salem 2
description:
Town of Salem 2 is the sequel to BlankMediaGames' hit Murder Mystery game, Town of Salem. With a revitalized 3d world, new and reworked roles, improved chat features and much more you can't help but join the Witch Hunt!

Town of Salem 2 pits the Town vs the Coven, Serial Killers, Arsonist, Werewolves, and even the Horsemen of the Apocalypse themselves. Can you survive the Town of Salem again? Use your wits, abilities of deduction, and your role's special abilities to help, or hurt, the Town and lead your side to victory!

title: Octavio Camacho
description:
Based on the online graphic novel. This story takes place in a world filled with science gone mad, old society class revived, and a secret contest to possess
the chalice of Exon. To set the world right Octavio Camacho and his covert task- force named W.A.R.C.O.M are ready to take on the mission.

title: Not Meow Purroblem
description: Iris is tired of studying and working and just wants to be a cat. Her wish comes true. While she's discovering the joy and downsides of her new form, her girlfriend Maggie is bothered by absence of her partner.

title: Reflectile
description: Reflectile is a minimal precision-puzzle game that yearns for the early 2000's era of video games. It will test your ability to cut corners, squeeze through tight corridors, and make split-second inputs to reach the goal of each stage. You’ll encounter stages of varying difficulty, all with unique challenges and stylish designs to boot.

title: Sex, Drugs, and Beer Can
description: A Coop Based team mod based around the story of Beercan the Jamaican beer can! The mod sees you completing objectives and slaughter all the monsters in sight.

title: Half-Life: Shift-Two
description: You are Otis, a security guard at the Black Mesa facility. After surviving the Resonance Cascade you attempt to escape the facility with your colleagues.

title: Bootleg Squadrog
description:
“Bootleg Squadrog, sir. It is not about individualism. It is not about cowboy heroism. It is about being one cohesive unit. The only identity I have is that of a group identity.”

Bootleg Squadrog is a singler player map pack for Half-Life: Opposing Force, with squad-based and teamwork tactical scenarios.

title: Bleach: Zanpakutou Senshi
description: The mod features a technical hack 'n' slash combat style, where you can fight in a team deathmatch as Ichigo or Grimmjow.

title: Half-Life: Case Closed
description:
You are Bob Dewey, Black Mesa janitor. You arrive at the research facility for another day at work: cleaning up the mess those smart ass scientists leave behind, refilling the soapboxes in the toilets, listening to Barney's stupid jokes and reading Penthouse Magazine. It's not the most exciting job in the world, but it pays good and you get lot's off free donuts. As usual, those scientists create black holes and open gates to other alien worlds filled with creatures who eat human flesh for lunch.

Nothing special, but this time, they really messed it up and those aliens found a way to our planet. And guess what, you are in the middle of all this. While Gorden Freeman kicks alien arse, Corporal Adrian Shephard fights Freeman and Barney Calhoun tries to save some scientists, you just try to save you own butt and get the hell out of Black Mesa.

It's a bigger mess you have to clean up this time...

title: Apico 2.0: I Can’t Beelieve it’s Not Butter(flies)!
description:
The new update is buzzing with an un-bee-lievable amount of new content, including new pollinators, new characters to meet, and more:

New NPCs: New friends from the mainland, Cody and Sto, have come to the APICO Islands to further their research.
Butterflies: Discover, collect and breed a variety of brand-new pollinators.
Solitary Bees: These new pollinators prefer to do things on their own – build new solitary bee hotels and help them along!
New Flowers: Now, there are more ways to keep the pollinator population happy – each new flower has its own new effect on the environment.
Incense: Through the magic of alchemy, make your own incense and candles!
Bee-Sides: New tracks have been added to the chill soundtrack
And More: New books, decorations, and a host of quality-of-life improvements have been added.

title: Half-Life: Crossfire
description:
Return and relive the Black Mesa incident through the eyes of Sgt. Jordan Foster, a security guard battling for survivfal through the Xen invasion in search of Dr. Cross.

Find Dr. Cross, protect her at all cost, and maybe you'll have a chance to get out of this whole mess alive.

title: Land of Legends: Heroes of Loria
description: Land of Legends: Heroes of Loria takes place in the fantasy world of Loria, a Human kingdom besieged by conflict with the Orcs. A group of heroes, which includes you, is being cast down by the All-Seeing-Eye to save humanity once again. Travel alone or with your friends in co-operative mode through the rich and colourful world of Loria and end the Orcs' evil reign.

title: Deep Hunters
description: Deep Hunters is a 2 player multiplayer game that focuses on hacking and deep web. You and your friend signed up for a deep web game, but you didn't expect that the you'll end up fighting with each other for your life. Will you win the game or will you sacrifice your life to save your friend?

title: Outer Colony
description: Outer Colony is an open ended, real time strategy game with a focus on artificial intelligence and simulation-derived mechanics. Set in a sci-fi universe, players command expeditions of spacefaring colonists in an effort to establish settlements on remote worlds. Much of the core gameplay revolves around providing for your expedition’s NPCs, managing its fledgling society, freeform building, and tactical combat. Whatever you do in OC affects the persistent game world, so everything from driving species to extinction to terraforming whole regions is possible.

title: Funko Fusion
description: Funko Fusion is a third-person action game that’s all about celebrating fandom. Play with some of your favorite characters from across TV, movies, games, and comics, and explore handcrafted worlds inspired by Jurassic World, Back to the Future, JAWS, The Thing, Chucky, Battlestar Galactica, Hot Fuzz, The Umbrella Academy, Five Nights at Freddy’s, Masters of the Universe, Invincible, and many more!

title: Crystal Colors
description:
Created for Winter VN Jam 2020.

Crystal Colors is a game about two girls trying to live normally in a world that is slowly fading away into pure nothingness.

Will you be brave enough to saved your loved one, or will you be erased too?

As a young chief of the shop, a hero will experience various tales with a regular customer etc. Since girls are the players of a network game, respectively, after closing can also meet them on on-line. And the tale which becomes entangled in both of the worlds, the tale which is not involved. Is a hero how to make it put the body on which world?

title: Kao the Kangaroo: Bend the Roo'les
description: “Bend the Roo'les” features 5 new levels, each with their own unique twist on the formula of Kao the Kangaroo: new perspectives, a retro-inspired design, and the continuation of Kao versus the Eternal World!

title: The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood
description: Immerse yourself in an enchanting narrative experience as Fortuna, a fortune-teller Witch condemned to exile on her asteroid home. Craft your own Tarot deck, regain your freedom, and shape the fate of the cosmic Witch society.

title: True Disc Golf
description: Realistic disc golf simulation with authentic flight physics. Build your bag from 300+ real discs and play challenging courses locally, or online with cross-platform online multiplayer. Train, compete, and improve your rating in ranked matches or play against your friends.

title: Dessert DIY
description:
Make sweet ice cream, popsicles, and waffles using your creativity in one of the best dessert decorating games!

Experience the satisfaction of preparing your customers' orders with your own hands, meeting their expectations, and witnessing their delightful reactions! Explore a variety of delicious molds, creams, syrups, and sweet ingredients to create mouthwatering works of art!

Does your customer want to take revenge on someone? Prepare yucky desserts with surprise bugs or chili peppers! Such a taste is definitely something no one will ever forget!

Every dessert sold brings you coins, a delightful reward that you can invest in enhancing the appearance of your store. Change the colors of your walls or floor, and add new furniture. Transform your store into a cozy and professional haven, all while having fun!

Ready to get your hands dirty and make unique, colorful desserts?

Wait for the right moment, push the sausage homies in the fire and watch them cook well. Just don't get roasted!
With this DLC you will get access to a new Burning stage in each local multiplayer mode.

title: Hazard Hill Idle

title: The Pellar
description: The Pellar is an action-adventure game in which you play the role of a lonely quack doctor. Your task is to prepare medicines, potions and bandages that will be used to help those in need. Struggle with healing various ailments in this magical world inspired by Slavic mythology.

title: BananaGuy
description: BananGuy returns for a new epic adventure! Collect "Power Coins" and explore goofy worlds in the ultimate search for the legendary golden banana!

title: Illum
description: Embark on a heartwarming journey with your little light friend to solve puzzles and bring light to the mystical realm of Illum.

title: Biscuitts 5
description: Biscuitts 5 is a First Person Shooter game.

title: Sex Simulator: The Beach House
description: An interactive sex simulation game with visual novel elements, featuring HD graphics and videos, with realistic looking characters set in a beautiful decor. You play the role of a hot man who has sex with three lucky women inside his luxurious beach house.

title: Nomad Station
description: Become a master MI6 saboteur, and earn your name as the ministry's most important asset on the Moon in this 1st-person shooter VR sci-fi epic! Follow the orders of your handler, or explore and find new weapons and defenses! Do whatever it takes to complete your mission!

title: Death In Abyss
description: Death In Abyss is an intense flight shooter that challenges you to utilize your maneuverability and explosive firepower to survive against the deep sea hostilities.

1984 is a first-person survival adventure set in Orwell's timeless dystopia. As Winston Smith you must carefully plot your secret rebellion against Big Brother, while avoiding the suspicions of the Thought Police. Adaptation by the Narrative Designer of Subnautica, Talos Principle and FTL.

description: Step into an exhilarating fantasy world adventure where you'll confront a series of spine-chilling monsters. In this astonishing VR game, you'll need to maintain unwavering focus, utilizing your unique and powerful skills to defeat these formidable adversaries one by one!

title: Poetry of Blood: Eclipse
description: Poetry of Blood: Eclipse is a 2D rogue-lite platformer action game. Heroine "Yue", codenamed Ishtar, fight against various enemies using different weapons, equipment and mechs. Explore the futuristic world and uncover the astonishing secrets hidden behind!

title: Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories
description: 'Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories' is a humorous co-operative escape room game where you are a henchman who has to make his way through variety of puzzles to make it to a job interview on time. Can you solve all of the puzzles that stand in the way of your employment?

title: Myth Landers
description: Myth Landers is a tactical role-playing game about the ruthless confrontation between heroes and terrifying monsters. It all takes place in a dark fantasy cyber world, where ancient cultures' wisdom and futuristic technological power combine. Manage a party of warriors from bygone times. Use reliable armor and advanced weapons. Choose and develop unique skills to strengthen your heroes. And start a campaign in one of the distinctive locations, where mutated offspring of the disgusting Aspid, cyber-jianshi, mummy-troopers, and other dangerous enemies.

title: Sven: Completely Screwed

description: Silica is a crossover of FPS and RTS where up to 3 factions battle for control over the planet of Baltarus. Lead from above as commander, or experience the action first-hand, either alone, or with friends. Join one of two human armies, or hunt them down as the territorial aliens.

description: Play as Domino, a stray cat in love with food, in this heartwarming adventure where you help an old man overcome his grief after his wife passed away. description: You and your friends were the sidekicks of the world’s greatest heroes. But now that they are gone, will you pick up their mantle or tarnish their legacy?

description: Season 2 Episode 2: Food Feuds! Failing to transform Cody and Peter into Losers on her own, Kitty enlists Juvie's help in pranking the two.

title: Jump, challenge 100 floors
description: This Is a simple, casual, relax and fluency action game. You can jump and challenge 100 floors to arrive the top. Each floor's postion generates randomly. You can collect the coin on each floor. The length of floors will change to add difficulty.

title: Hazy Mind
description: You can't remember anything, and all you can see is HER. Delve into your story and uncover the truth behind what happened to you and your parents.

title: Alchemist's Fantasy R: A Girl's Alchemic Furnace
description: The young alchemist Meti from the village, along with her boyfriend Nero, begins a quest to find their missing master. Meti's ability to synthesize magical creatures helps the couple overcome various challenges they encounter on the way, and they discover a secret that changes their lives.

title: Tinker Tanks
description: "Tinker Tanks" is an action-packed 1v1 multiplayer tank game on Steam that offers fast-paced, strategic gameplay with power-ups to supercharge your tank. Experience thrilling, high-octane tank warfare in 2-3 minute skirmishes and defeat your opponents with quick reflexes and strategic gameplay.

description: "Summon a Vengeance Demon," they said. "What could go wrong?" they said. Our main character is in over his head! Fortunately, the demon Balasque has taken a liking to him. Wait...is that actually fortunate? A NSFW Visual Novel Dating Sim with a Truly Monstrous Monster!

description: The indie-casual game of Last Day of Zombies comes to confirm this principle once again.

description: Play as a lowly triangle in this fast-paced top-down shooter on a dystopian polygon-based universe. Defeat your oppressors, claim glory!

Never stop, collect as much XP and Boosters to get stronger by choosing your upgrades.

title: Bridgebourn
description: Explore a hand-painted dynamic open world in this immersive ARPG. Create custom spells and trigger countless reactions. Plunder treasure and secrets with your party of adventurers. Upgrade your party with magic loot. Fight what lurks in the depths of dungeons. Discover mysteries of the Fadelands.

description: As One We Survive is a top down survival game set in a post-apocalyptic America. Step into the shoes of a father as he tries to find help for his sick daughter during a grid down post-pandemic event. Fight, scavenge, craft, and gather resources for your family's survival.

title: Costly Adventure
description: Costly Adventure is a Match-3 game with RPG elements. Exciting talent trees and itemization will quickly change the way you play. Will your party withstand the ever increasing tolls of the bridge troll?

description: When a souvenir shop dealing in oddities is ransacked, you’re shocked when you’re the prime suspect! Your double has come from another reality to disrupt the flow of magic, taking your abilities in the process. Can you save the sources of magic and clear your name in time?

Cultivate anywhere you choose and gather resources to build and defend your civilization from the dangers outside.

description: Complete the puzzle challenges to win the hearts of 15 different girls with various professions. Apply the patch and dive deeper into their lives!

description: Crab Raid Tactics is an Action Strategy Roguelike game where you command a squad of crabs to overcome swarms of monsters and challenging bosses by collecting upgrades, triggering powerful elemental reactions and avoiding threats of a constantly changing environment.

description: Welcome to the frozen wasteland of our post-apocalyptic world! In this multiplayer game, you and your friends will have to work together to brave the harsh winter conditions and fight off dangerous enemies to survive.

description:
Three new sausages: Fly, Cockroach and Plucked Chicken
and 15,000 coins to unlock your favorites sausages with powerups.

description: Unravel the mystery of a cryptic box in this 2-player co-op puzzle game. Join forces as two detectives, solve cooperative puzzles, communicate effectively, crack the codes and outsmart the killer.

Now, aided by an octopus named Tony the Tickler, he must hunt down the Mafioso who orchestrated the accident and bring him to justice.

title: Winter Stealth
description: Winter Stealth - You have to play as a hired agent who is able to get where the rest can not. Take orders and go on an adventure! Dodge enemies, complete missions and find secret items. Risk everything and go with the hero on a wonderful journey!

description: A terrible disease has struck Queen Guinevere! The only thing that can save her is the Holy Grail. But the ancient artefact has long been lost somewhere in the expanses of Avalon. Can you manage to overcome all obstacles, find the Grail, and save the queen?

description: Nia accidentally goes into her best friend—Alice's past, the only way to escape and go back to the real world is to help Alice to solve all her problems. When you can go back to the past, do you want to do everything you can to save what you've lost?

description: Interrogate suspects, search for clues, & uncover a dastardly plot, as you solve a string of mystifying murders to help reluctant detective Ilmarinen escape the foreboding Fafnir Hotel. From the maker of The Donnerwald Experiment comes a detective adventure with a twist.

description: Puzzles of toys!

title: Shroom Siege
description:
Welcome to Shroom Siege, a fast-paced multiplayer game that balances strategy and fun. In a 4 vs 4 setting, you'll embody a shroom character, coordinating with your teammates and using quick thinking to outsmart your opponents.

Shroom Siege brings together the best aspects of local and online multiplayer games, making it a versatile choice for any gaming session. Whether you're sharing a couch with friends or playing with others from around the globe, this game ensures a dynamic experience tailored to your setup.
What's more, Shroom Siege supports cross-play across Steam and Nintendo Switch platforms, bringing together an even larger community of players. This means you can compete with friends and others regardless of their chosen platform. And don't worry if you're short of human players - AI steps in to balance the 4v4 gameplay.

title: Crying Booth
description: Sacrifice, survive, trick or treat, and go home. Experience four first-person scenarios with stealth, survival, and puzzle elements along with one side scroller platformer.

Get ready to experience a thrilling top-down arcade racing game that's inspired by the classic 90s racing games you know and love.

Super Power Racing League is the prestigious racing competition where ruthless competitors from around the world come together to tear up the track and power their way to victory.

Get ready to feel the adrenaline rush of Super Power Racing League, where the competition is fierce and the stakes are high. Start your engines and let the race begin!

description: Harvest crop, pick fruit, collect bales, chop down trees, plant seeds all while investigating and exploring a series of tiny islands along the way. Discover the secrets hidden in the lands while relaxing and solving mysterious puzzle of the land.

description: Live in the town of Ancient Tea and enjoy a Tang Dynasty-style country life—live off the land, handcraft teas, make delicacies like Mapo Tofu. Enjoy fast-paced, high-score chasing action, challenging puzzles, and casual games. Each game is brought to life with stunning hand-drawn graphics. Addictive, retro-style gaming fun!

Dolven is a fantasy turn-based strategy RPG with a deep card-based battle system. Following the events of The Necromancer’s scourge upon the northern townsfolk, guide a band of mercenaries through the Decaying Isles in order to rid the land of evil. description: Sometimes it's better to prevent something that might happen...

title: Gaia Trek
description: In "Gaia Trek", you will play as Gaia, the shattered will of a planet, and command your spaceship to explore new worlds, collect and refine various resources, build a home on the damaged spacecraft, summon a wide range of monsters, and ultimately, devour other shattered wills to repair yourself.

title: Lunar Legacy
description: Romantic Visual Novel. Unjustly accused of a terrible crime, Soyeon finds herself in the Kingdom of Spirits. How will she survive in a strange and incomprehensible world? How much can one trust the suspiciously friendly spirits?

title: Spriters, Hopes Blooming Dawn
description: Spriters: Hopes Blooming Dawn is an RPG-style game that takes you on an epic adventure through a world filled with magic, mystery, and danger. Battle dangerous creatures, collect Gems with unique powers, and uncover the mysteries of your past in this engaging and innovative game.

title: Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors
description: Youkai have overrun Gensokyo! There's no resolving this incident, just try to survive! Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors is the latest take on the survivor genre, this time with the unique twist of a grid-based inventory system. Hoard as many items as possible if you want to survive!

title: Time Limit Harvest
description: This is a farming game where you compete to see how much money you can make within a time limit. You can get seeds and videos for each level.

title: Year 500
description: Year 500 is a third-person, hack-n-slash adventure game featuring swordplay, magic casting, and an engaging story set in a fantasy world. Reclaim your memory, oppose and defeat evil, and save the kingdom by any means necessary.

title: Medieval Simulators: Baker
description: A relaxing simulator for lovers of the Middle Ages and nature. You take on the role of a medieval baker who has to earn coins, improve his own farm, harvest wheat, grind grain, chop wood and bake...

title: Our Life: Beginnings & Always - Baxter's Story
description: Enjoy exciting summer days in the company of Baxter Ward during Steps 3 and 4! This is an optional DLC for the free game Our Life: Beginnings & Always.

title: Wayward Rose
description: An indie thriller that will test your navigational skills as you find your way out of darkness and into light.

title: Nifa's First Mission
description: Nifa is a young elven knight. While out patrolling, her village is attacked by orcs, leaving her the only knight still in fighting shape. To make matters worse, the brutish orcs took a great number of prisoners, including the elven princess! Fight and platform your way through a variety of stages filled with dangerous foes of all kinds. Use your sword to challenge them directly or your bow to snipe them from afar.

title: Sausage Wars: Trapdoor Hell
description:
Battle other sausages on a new, unstable ground. Trigger the trapdoors and watch the suckers fall into the toxic soup!
With this DLC you will get access to a new Trapdoor stage in each local multiplayer mode.

title: Sausage Wars: Laser Massacre
description:
This is no place to make friends. Escape from imminent death, find the safe spot and push other sausages into the deadly beam!
With this DLC you will get access to a new Laser stage in each local multiplayer mode.

title: Mines of Moria
description: Choose one of six playable classes with a randomly selected race. New players are recommended to play as a Warrior.

title: I Commissioned Some Mice
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many mice and cheese as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Savage Turret
description: Tactical turret placing game with gore, gardening and massive battles. You build the routes for the enemies to facilitate that sweet killzone. And take a break to do some gardening afterwards. Plant on!

title: Fortress of the Undead
description: "Fortress of the Undead" is an intense zombie survival game. Scavenge for weapons and ammo, fight off hundreds or thousands of zombies with up to 4 players, and try to survive as long as possible.

title: Highland Panic
description: Highland Panic is a fast-paced, Scottish/Highland-themed card game with solitaire mechanics for 2-4 players. Race to be the first player to play all the cards from you "panic" pile to the common "clan" piles. It's a thrilling game of strategy and skill, perfect for game nights and parties.

title: Therapy Simulator 2023
description: Top-down fast paced game. Find the right person, make the therapist happy

title: The Hero's Way
description: Get ready for battle, hero! Your bravery and strength will be a bulwark in this world of the risen dead, and you will defeat them all!

title: Enemies Defender
description: Attention, attention! Enemies are approaching.

title: Mai and the Legendary Treasure
description: Mai finds a hidden map that brings her to another world. With some newfound friends, Mai sets off to hunt for the legendary treasure! But with rivals in her way, will she finally get her hands on the legendary treasure...?

title: Nightmare: Worlds Collide
description: Nightmare: Worlds Collide is a unique horror experience that follows Jessica Redford as she recalls her memories after a horrific event causes her to lose touch with reality. Throughout the experience you will be unravelling the mystery as she tries to escape her dark inner secrets.

title: Munchy Mammals
description: A puzzle game where you move herbivores and carnivores on a grid to fulfill multiple animal requirements using moving, biting, eating and more.

title: Highrise Guardian
description: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is an Arena FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, dominate your enemies with map control, and make an art-like battle style to become the Anime gunslinger.

title: Castle of Blackwater
description: Castle of Blackwater is a multiplayer social deduction game where 10 players navigate a magical 2D castle while completing tasks and uncovering hidden allegiances. Players are assigned to three different factions, each equipped with unique abilities that support their role in the game. While alive, participants use various tools to gather information and identify threats, while eliminated players can influence the outcome by collecting souls to purchase power-ups for their team. Through alliance-building, deception, and strategic ability usage, players work to ensure their faction's survival and ultimate control of the castle.

title: Save King
description: Carefully adjust the force so that the princess does not fall down from the maze to reach the 11th floor. Traps installed throughout the maze interfere with the princess, so it is easy to go to the beginning floor if you do something wrong.

title: Eclectic Expansion Enterprise
description: Expand among the stars! It is 72k years in the future, and a new wave of Human expansion abounds. Join the ranks of the Ecxos, prep star systems for habitation, and develop your tools and ships to enterprise ever faster and further.

title: Aphelion Headhunters
description: Aphelion Headhunters is a Third-Person PVE Hero Shooter featuring two unique player characters, each with their own distinct playstyle, abilities and suite of selectable upgrades.

title: Pigblue
description: A stranger arrives at a quiet and isolated town... Pigblue.

title: Disco Elysium: The Final Cut - Collage Mode
description: Collage Mode is a creative screenshot and scene-building mode for Disco Elysium. It allows players to place characters in locations from Martinaise, adjust their poses, add custom dialogue, apply visual filters and weather effects, and decorate scenes with items, clothing stickers, and frames. The mode also includes hidden scenes related to Martinaise’s history and additional narration from the game’s narrator.

title: Meet Your Maker: Scorched Necropolis
description: Meet Your Maker's Scorched Necropolis Collection invites players to build and raid Outposts worthy of the Pharaohs themselves. Use ancient-Egyptian-inspired blocks, props, weapons, and Custodian Suits to create and infiltrate monumental tombs unlike any in the wasteland.

title: Infernax: Deux or Die
description:
The update will bring a new playable character into the fray: Cervul the Squire, a well-rounded lad who sports deadly talents in both axe throwing and tool-assisted combat.

It also incorporates co-op play in Infernax‘s fan-favorite gun mode, perfect for players keen on wielding maximum firepower against the game’s monstrous beasts.

title: Arrow War
description:
Collect, Upgrade, Dominate
Defend your castle from endless enemies

title: VT Harmony
description: Play as VT a lonely TV-boy that want to be alone until the unexpected message from an stranger bunny named IV. Discover the different endings of this visual novel game.

title: The Witch of Sherdorne Forest
description: The Lord's son has vanished and you decide to venture out in search of the boy.

title: Mushroom Mountain
description: Mushroom Mountain is a puzzle game for the PICO-8 console where players plant, destroy, grow, and spread mushrooms to control doors along a branching mountain trail.

title: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Song for Prism
description: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Song for Prism is a free-to-play rhythm game based on The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors.

title: Cube Experimental
description: Cube Experimental is a single player modification for Fallout 3, set in a long deserted, underground scientific facility right below the post-nuclear Washington D.C.

title: Chef Ramsay
description:
Gordon Ramsay likes you very much. You are his top chef and you never disappoint.

But do you have what it takes to be a master chef? I certainly doubt it! Complete objectives to try and impress him. Who knows? You may even make it out alive.

title: Across The Void
description: Across The Void is an exciting new roguelike video game that will take you on a journey through a universe of endless possibilities. Featuring randomly generated maps and side maps, the game offers a new adventure every time you play. With a unique skill system, players can create their own playstyle by investing in three different trees, each with its own set of skills tailored to different playstyles. With over 50 skills to unlock, you can customize your character to your liking and take on the universe on your own terms.

title: Salthe
description:
“Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.”

At the end of a journey of blood, despair, regret, and madness— a stage perched on the razor's edge dividing life and death. With no audience to cheer, at a jester's direction, Salthe performs her past. To learn the reason for her death. To return to the world of life.

Each scene is full of scorn and mockery, she writhes and struggles, through to the end
of the tale of Salthe's life—a comedy——

title: Shooting Survival
description: This is the 2d shooting game with building and crafting that features extremely easy play styles. Its super cool and enjoyable gameplay, mixed with rogue-like, crafting, and farming elements will get you hooked from the very first shooting run!

title: Cards, Universe & Everything
description: Cards, the Universe and Everything (CUE) is the ultimate CCG where you collect and trade thousands of cards and battle them in epic games.

title: Miner Gun Builder
description: You are the captain of a space ship and fly through missions to earn money. With the money you can buy parts to build your weapon in your space ship. You can also buy bigger and better ships which can fit more parts. Building a small weapon is straight forward, but later you can build extremely strong weapons if you use the available space wisely.

title: Idle Dice 2
description:
The sequel for Idle Dice is here!
Idle Dice 2 expands on the gameplay of its predecessor and adds more things

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.1 Onikakushi-hen
description: On a certain day in June, someone dies, and someone else goes missing. The series of deaths is connected to the upheaval surrounding the dam construction project. A murder case that was covered up is being reenacted. Is it a conspiracy? A coincidence? Or perhaps a curse?

title: Kemono Friends: Kingdom
description: Welcome to "Kingdom", an abandoned large-scale theme park where you will meet a diverse cast of animal friends and embark on a miraculous adventure with them. But beware of the azure monsters scattered throughout the Kingdom! With the help of your animal friends' unique characteristics and the landform organs' mechanisms, you can overcome these mysterious enemies and save the Kingdom together.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.2 Watanagashi-hen
description: Keiichi wins a game tournament and gives his prize, a doll, to Rena stating that Mion will not be interested in such girly things, though Mion is actually rather hurt that Keiichi thinks about her that way, though she pretends not to mind.

title: The Jungle Book
description:
IBM produced FMV game starring uncredited chimpanzee and Gary Schwartz.

Deep within India's Black Jungle, a scandalous crime has taken place. Someone has stolen the jeweled crown of King Louie, the orangutan who rules Monkey City. Now he's hoppin' mad and there will be no peace until his crown is returned. Mowgli and his friends are counting on you to help recover this sacred treasure and restore calm to the jungle world.

title: F1 23: Champions Edition
description: F1 23 Champions Edition and receive 3 days Early Access, Max Verstappen designed racing in-game items, 4 New My Team Racing Icons, 4 Braking Point 2 My Team Icons and much more!

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.3 Tatarigoroshi-hen
description: Satoko's uncle Teppei returns to Hinamizawa to take custody of Satoko and resume an abusive relationship with her, where he treats her like a slave while demanding money from her. Keiichi cannot accept this stalemate, and he makes it his personal mission to rescue Satoko.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.4 Himatsubushi-hen
description: Akasaka Mamoru, a detective is sent to Hinamizawa to rescue Inukai Toshiki, the grandson of a government official, who is taken hostage. While waiting for Makino, he meets a younger Furude Rika at the bus stop.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.5 Meakashi-hen
description: Sonozaki Shion escapes from her private school to return to Hinamizawa. During her time there, she meets Satoshi, who protected her from a group of thugs.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.6 Tsumihoroboshi-hen
description: Is the curse really real? This chapter presents the events from another view, which reveals additional information about Rena's past and Keiichi's reasons for moving to Hinamizawa from Tokyo.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.7 Minagoroshi-hen
description: Furude Rika is in an altered state of reality. Around her, various prisms float and circulate her. As she examines them, she mentions that they are "fragments" from the various Junes of 1983.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.8 Matsuribayashi-hen
description: The final arc in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kai series. It is mostly told from the viewpoint of Rika Furude, as well as her other friends.

title: Randal's Tuesday
description: Everything begins on a Wednesday, early in the morning. Our three protagonists are testifying in front of the Student Council leaded by no other than the Dean himself. They have been accused of committing a horrendous act (players don’t know about it just yet) and this is the only chance they have to try and clean their names.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei
description: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei is a collection of short stories that features the characters of the previous chapters.

title: D.W.'s Nightmare
description: D.W. 's Nightmare is a short horror game in which you are playing as D.W. Read. Your doll has been cursed. It's up to you to survive 3 minutes by constantly finding where the doll spawns. Don't get too comfortable. If you take too long, the doll will kill you. Will you step up to the challenge or be the doll's first victim?

title: Soak 'Em Out
description: Soak ‘Em Out is an endless score attack game that takes heavy influence from the Game & Watch Gallery series. You play as Tina, a cat trying to catch a bus that unfortunately is taking an unusually long time to arrive. To make matters worse, a big storm is brewing! With no true shelter nearby and only an umbrella to take cover with, how long are you able to delay the inevitable before getting soaked out?

title: Nazi Zombies: Portable
description:
A Call of Duty: Zombies "de-make" made in the 1996 Quake engine, in development since 2009.

The game itself is feature-equivalent with Call of Duty: World at War on a generic level. Gameplay components are implemented with minor parity differences. Most World at War maps and their unique features are not yet represented. Various small additions and changes from Call of Duty: Black Ops are present as a means of gameplay smoothing, but not on a wide scale. NZ:P is, first and foremost, a Call of Duty: World at War remake.

title: The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness
description:
Deep underground, nestled in the remains of a post-apocalyptic American South, rests a cryogenic facility called Intermine Laboratories. In this miniscule piece of frost-stricken hell rests a collective of eclectic individuals who are inexplicably awoken from their restless dreams long before their assigned time.

But, the facility has changed in the time since they've gone to sleep. It's become a fascistic nightmare in the wake of a gruesome civil war, and everywhere they go ... it feels like they're being watched. To add insult to injury, some of them have started acting ... funny ...

title: Teacher Certification Hell
description: This producer wants you to study on Steam again!! This is a game about Teacher Certification Knowledge. Depending on your strategy (ability), choose the right item at the beginning, and then use the answer to break through each Layers! After 100 layers, waiting for you may be......

title: Eddie's Arcade
description: Uniquely satisfying puzzle game spread out over different graphical themes. The puzzles get harder as you advance, giving you the pleasing sense of accomplishment. Collect arcade tokens to unlock new machines. Over 125 levels for hours of play.

title: Not In My Cave
description: Defend Yourself! Not in my cave is the last line of defense to protect your magical spells from unrelenting attacks from the undead and goblin hordes. In this action based tower defense style game protect your spell books from being looted and leaving yourself defenseless!

title: Eliminator: The Encapsuled Nemesis
description: Eliminator: The Encapsuled Nemesis is an tactical single-player shooter for everyone. Sneak to hostile fortifications, destroy your foes, capture flags, collect new weapons and fight your way through enemy lines to crush their evil plans.

title: Neon Fantasy: Animals
description: Neon Fantasy: Animals is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Borefest
description: "Why would you waste your time making this? Couldn't you have made something fun instead? Games are supposed to be fun..." - The Game Developer's Dad

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Space Spectacular
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Space themed tables that will take you on a journey through time!

title: Spooky Men
description: Spooky Men is a online 2-4 player cooperative survival-horror game. Retrieve forgotten items and complete tasks while avoiding a ghost. Use your wits to distract the ghost and survive its attacks as you explore the spooky house. Can you and your friends make it out alive?

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 15
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 20 art pieces to choose from, and 2000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Ash of Gods: The Way - Deluxe Edition
description: Get the turn-based story-driven tactical card game with hand crafted battles, plus digital extras including soundtrack and art book!

title: Damn Zombies
description: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus

title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
description: Welcome to Japan, the drift capital of the world! Compete, drift, and race on miles of varied roads and winding mountain trails. Drive through towns nestled at the scenic Haikama Lake. Spend your savings on new cars and get a taste of Japanese tuning style.

title: Tuk Tuk Race
description: "Tuk Tuk Race" is a game in which you race in a tuk-tuk. Ride a tuk-tuk and try to win the race! Let's drive in the nature of beautiful graphics in a tuk-tuk. Now, please enjoy this funny racing game.

title: Everholm
description: Lilly was spirited away to a mysterious island. As her memories fade, everyone seems to know about her quest for her missing sister. It's time to establish a homestead, meet the islanders, learn their secrets and solve the mystery of Everholm in this open-ended minimalist RPG!

title: Railway Empire 2: Deluxe Edition
description: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the full Railway Empire 2 game, the original soundtrack, exclusive skins for each of the three sizes of your railway stations, an exclusive skin for your company HQ, and an exclusive skin for two locomotives.

title: Sphere 3
description: Some roads lead to salvation, others - to eternal damnation. What will you choose?

title: I Swear this Hentai Game was a Gift
description: A relaxing puzzle game with cute anime girls. You didn't buy this game; it was a gift. We believe you.

title: Married Woman Cosplay Life
description: Masataka and Misuzu are newlyweds. Masataka proposes costume play sex for Misuzu, who is new to sex, and Misuzu gradually learns to enjoy it.

title: The Voyager
description: After working all your life you have finally managed to build a device that allows you to travel between parallel worlds. will you be able to return home?

title: Xenosis
description: Xenosis is a thrilling metroidvania where you traverse an ancient temple that has been overrun by alien creatures. Armed with your blaster, you must combat a variety of challenging enemies and upgrade your weapon to escape

title: He@rtstrings
description: When your red string of fate connects to three guys, what will you do?

title: Bomber-Mario
description:
The classic Nintendo game meets bombs and castles in this fun Mario adventure.

This is a strategy game compared to the original Mario versions that you have likely played or seen. The goal of the game is to blow up the enemies that you see in each level. As Mario, you have access to several types of bombs. You can upgrade your bombs in the game as you gain experience. You'll start with smaller bombs that are used for the mediocre enemies before seeing the larger bombs that are meant to do significant damage to the larger enemies, especially those that come toward the end of the game.

title: Criminal Archives: Alphabetic Murders DLC
description: Are the murders of three different people connected? Or are we dealing with three different incidents? Cunning and logic are your best weapons in solving this case!

title: Blobi Sprint
description: One button fast tapping game for 2-4 players. Tap the button as fast as you can to stay on screen and win!

title: Half-Life: Pulse
description:
Pulse is a MOD for Half-Life 1. Pulse takes place in Black Mesa after the incident. You are famous scientist Gordon Freeman. In the beginning of Pulse, you are in Surface Lab A Security Complex, a lab and security station on the absolute surface of the Black Mesa Research Facility. You are working with your scientist pals when one scientist working with a hazardous radiation meter detects high radiation amounts coming from all over. They radio into the Administrator's office, the office of Dr. Wallace Breen. Instead of Breen answering, they pick up a remote conversation between Breen and an unknown voice. "It's done," Breen said. "The Xenian crystal triggered a dimensional rift between Earth and the boarderworld Xen. Now let's get to the surface!" "I'm sure my employers will be pleased," says the unknown voice, and then silence fills the room followed by an explosion. The other scientists are amazed that the Administrator of Black Mesa himself would work with someone to trigger such a disaster and are trying to turn Breen in to the Special Projects Executive, the overseers of the Black Mesa Research Facility. The only way to get the S.P.E. to believe them is to get Dr. Breen's special operations profile from his office and hand it over to the S.P.E. as evidence. The scientists, however, are terrified of entering Black Mesa after a resonance cascade saying it is too dangerous. Gordon Freeman volunteers to go into Black Mesa, retrieve Breen's Administrative profile and bring him to justice.

This MOD suggests that Gina Cross was the one to push the xenian crystal into the anti-mass spectrometer and Gordon was not near Sector C at the time. Surface Lab A Security Complex is located on the surface of Sector D.

The scientists detect that Breen's Administrative profile is located in the Lambda Complex so your goal as Gordon Freeman is to get the Lambda Complex and retrieve Breen's profile and make it back to Surface Lab A alive.

title: Public Enemy: The Dark Future
description:
Public Enemy: The Dark Future is a story-focused sci-fi multiplayer Half-Life modification.

Two teams (The Security Corps and the Syndicate) play the basic role in this game and they will fight against each other in front of this futuristic scenery.

The visual aspects, gameplay features and the design offer you new and interesting possibilities to explore the whole world of Public-Enemy.

title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon - Launch Edition
description: In Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon, players will assemble their mech from a wide variety of parts and weaponry to soar freely through mission locales that redefine three-dimensional mobility. Face down overwhelming opposition by outgunning and overrunning your enemies with dynamic movement that makes full use of ranged and melee combat. Players can experience frenetic and fast-paced action that can only be truly achieved with mechs.

title: Mon-Yu: Defeat Monsters And Gain Strong Weapons And Armor. You May Be Defeated, But Don’t Give Up. Become Stronger. I Believe There Will Be A Day When The Heroes Defeat The Devil King.
description: A first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler from Experience Inc. in the tradition of the original Wizardry. Create your own characters to defeat the seven demon kings. Form your team, clear the dungeons, defeat the monsters, and claim victory.

title: Scientist Hunt
description: Scientist Hunt is a Half-Life modification which makes murdering scientists the objective of the game. There are two teams, and each team must compete to murder more scientists than the other team in one of three separate modes of play. SH also features two non-team-based modes of play with entirely different player scenarios, named Live In Fear and Madness. New features include enhanced scientist physics, completely new scientist AI, and much more.

title: Half-Life: Mission of Mercy
description: It seems the G-Man and his government forces cannot keep Xen under their control. We all know how the government responds to something it can't be in charge of....blow it up ! Here's where you come in. The aliens, recognizing your impressive abilities, turn to you for help. If anyone can beat the G-Man at his own game it's you, and the aliens know this to be true. So begins your mission of mercy to save the alien world...... Hiding in the back of a big-rig, you slip into the compound. The science team has prepared the way for you, and Barney will help you when necessary. Not all areas are under heavy guard, but watch your back! Prepare to take on the G-Man's best troops.

title: Citizen Conflict
description: Citizen Conflict is a free-to-play hero shooter designed to merge the best of both worlds - to deliver the competitive heat symptomatic of the esports game modes as well as the Battle Royale frenzy to the masses. The game doesn’t fall short on an immersive storyline, which finds three antagonistic syndicates and captivating heroes waging an endless war for dominance. To scale its futuristic dystopian design to the top, Citizen Conflict will brim over with tons of futuristic maps, guns, and uncanny equipment. Citizen Conflict is now available on Epic Store.

title: Grace Online
description: Grace Online is a captivating 3D fantasy MMORPG (massively-multiplayer online role-playing game) that offers players an immersive experience, allowing them to explore a rich, expansive world filled with secrets and unique creatures. In Grace Online, we believe in player autonomy, which means we guide you through the basics, but there's no hand-holding beyond that. As a result, countless hidden treasures and mysteries await your discovery.

title: Senran Kagura Burst Re:Newal - Yumi Character and Campaign
description:
This Downloadable Content Senran Kagura Burst Re:Newal contains:

Yumi as a new playable character, a mission pack (Exclusive “Ice Queen” Prequel Campaign - 10 Missions), 2 new costumes, multiple accessories and lingerie, 3D diorama scenery, pics, BGMs, new visuals and voices + 2 secret files.

title: Morbid Catastrophe
description: A game based on a recurring nightmare.

title: EvoGene
description: EvoGene is a 3D Hack and Slash game where you need to survive against powerful creatures.

title: Senran Kagura Burst Re:Newal - Miyabi Character and Campaign
description:
This Downloadable Content Contains:
A new playable character (Miyabi), A mission pack (Exclusive “Abyssal” Prequel Campaign - 10 Missions), New hairstyles & outfits, 2D + 3D diorama scenery, pics, BGMs, visuals, voices + 2 new top secret files.

title: Times & Galaxy
description: Embark on an interplanetary adventure as the first robo reporter for the Times & Galaxy, the solar system's most trusted holopaper. You're just an intern, but if you can get the scoop, write great stories, and impress your colleagues, maybe you'll get to keep your job!

title: Dying Light: Enhanced Edition
description: Dying Light: Enhanced Edition is all you need to start your adventure in the post-apocalyptic world ruled by zombies. Featuring an expansion with the buggy—your new ride, an additional game mode, two extra quarantine zones, and two bundles.

title: 1B Spells
description: 1000000000 Spells is an Arena Survival game where you fight off hordes of enemies by making your own spells on the go, using a complex and intricate programming-adjacent system. No more leveling up fireball from level 7 to level 8! Magic should be expressive, free, intense and chaotic.

title: Talents
description: Write your way to success with your talented yet rowdy co-founders in this game development-themed romance visual novel! Do you have what it takes?

title: Bat Blitz
description: Bat Blitz is a top down arcade shooter where you shoot bats to get gold to buy upgrades to kill more bats.

title: Goldheart
description:
A small bullet-hell type game.

The greedy mage Lavka steals a mythical golden sphere from the village and it's up to the villager Skully to retrieve it by directing a wandering spirit's powers.

title: Just Keep Running
description: Just Keep Running is a parkour puzzle-platformer that combines freerunning with quick puzzles and problem-solving. Gameplay is said to be inspired by Mirror's Edge, Portal and Ultrakill, with voxel graphics inspired by Teardown, The Touryst, and Cloudpunk.

title: Hexa Puzzle Saga
description: Help your kingdom survive crises, and grow your wealth through managing your ruler's powers and solving hex puzzles.

title: Deadblast
description: Arrange the warriors correctly to defeat the enemy!

title: Absurdika
description: It's time for you to overcome the fear of conflicts. Every time someone blamed you you stood quiet and kept your anger inside. The demon you are about to face impersonates this fear.

title: Mercury
description: Mercury is postmodern sci-fi first-person shooter set in the year 2052 where you take the role of Mercury agent of the Special Operations Command Center undergoing tremendous missions in an effort to stop the development of a super weapon by the Soviets.

title: Welcome To... Chichester OVN: Omnibus Edition
description: Welcome To... Chichester OVN: Omnibus Edition contains OVN 1, 2 and 3 in one program, with updated in-game GUI, full stops added and slight story enhancements.

title: Slyme Breaker
description: Slyme Breaker is the RPG that hates the genre. SLYME BREAKER has a focus on proactive combat, involved exploration, and meaningful deconstruction of RPG standards. Play as the bandit Gryme after his attack on a lowly Slime monster for some XP goes wrong and he is devoured by the Slime!

He can jump to avoid obstacles and he can also turn into a Tornado when jumping to attack enemies. Players will need to time their attacks carefully to take down enemies without getting hit themselves.

The ultimate goal of Galeão's Dreams is to defeat Galeão's evil brother, Peter, and his henchmen, Galebot, the Slippers, and TokTok. Peter's motivation for attacking DreamsLand is simple: he wants to take over the world and plunge it into darkness. Galeão is the only one who can stop him, and he'll need to use all his skills and abilities to save the day.

title: UFO: The Ranch
description: Somewhere in South America, aliens have made contact. Visitors have not come in peace to Planet Earth... Open world third person shooter (TPS) game. Single player video game, compatible with Windows 8 / 8.1 / 10 / 11 The game locations are inspired by real places in South America.

title: James is Bananas
description: A double game mechanic, classic platformer and runner, free the banana village from the evil king gorilla by punching and breaking stuff but halfway each level, gear up, it's time to shoot some gummy bears!

title: Blindsight: War of the Wardens
description: Blindsight: War of the Wardens, a story-driven action-adventure game where you play as Iggy, a martial arts master with echolocation abilities, as he retrieves a stolen family heirloom that may bring unintended consequences to the universe.

title: Toilet Paper Simulator
description: Try to survive in the role of toilet paper and try to escape from the house of a crazy old man with diarrhea.

title: Get Out Joey!
description: In a dark and stunning world, swing from platform to platform and try to rise to the surface. Thanks to his spear and your agility, make Joey a free man...

title: Arobynn: Below The Surface
description: Finally, the multiplayer VR dungeon crawler we've all been waiting for! Complete with floor bosses, traps, and a glowing immersive environment. Dive into the depths, upgrade your gear, and work your way farther into the unknown dark below the surface!

title: My Klutzy Cupid
description: In the midst of leading an ordinary life, I began to feel the urge to find myself a girlfriend. Yet somehow, I couldn't bring myself to take the first step. But one day... "What's this...?" A single notebook had fallen right in front of me. "Hey, you! Yes, you! Why aren't you picking it up?"

title: Panzer Corps 2: Axis Operations - 1945
description: Panzer Corps 2’s Axis Operations at long last approaches the end of the Second World War in Europe... one way or another.

title: Machine Heart
description: Delve into the captivating cross-timeline puzzles of Machine Heart, and unravel the conspiracy behind a mass mind-uploading scheme.

title: Cassette Boy
description: All you see is all there is - Cassette Boy: an RPG where what exists depends on you.

title: Bomb Bomb Bomb
description: In this game, you control the Kitty to operate a cannon to fire various pellets to eliminate bricks that keep appearing. Sometimes, a big boss will spawn in the map, and it will spit out a lot of bricks, please try to defeat it. Gain new abilities by leveling up against enemies.

title: Uprising: Humanum
description: Uprising: Humanum is a knowledge based metroidvania. Follow Aurora in her quest to save the last bastion of Humanity.

title: Forest of Deceit
description: Forest of Deceit is a 4-8 player social deduction game where you use your phones to play!

title: Flavor Favor
description: Flavor Favor is a slice-of-life click-through mini-game where you'll interact with customers recommending snacks. Satisfy the customers' taste buds while getting to know the locals and becoming their trusted friend.

title: Pet Shop Simulator
description: Run your own pet shop in Pet Shop Simulator! Find new homes for pets, thus fulfilling the dreams of your customers. Take care of the needs of animals by selling the right items and get involved in matters related to the pets' home life!

title: First Christmas
description: Christmas Eve 1987 and Betty travels up to the family cabin to prepare the original perfect Christmas for Frankie. Discover the events leading up to Last Christmas.

title: Cy: Cyberpunk Survivors
description: Cy is a psionic superheroine battling to save humanity against hordes of zombies, mutants, and killer robots with only her ever-evolving mental powers to protect her. Will she survive the sinister onslaught or is she destined to become just another victim of an evil, unfathomable intelligence?

title: Future Racer 2000
description: Only You Can Be The Future Racer 2000

title: Pandash
description: Pandash is a rogue-lite platformer with different perks to discover and balance their powers. On your search for peace for your world, you wander through different areas, which will change every run. You need to get strong enough and unlock everything to survive and reach your destination.

title: VISK
description: Face your fears in VISK, an open-world online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. Escape from a strange village, uncover the dark secrets of this place and solve puzzles to discover new areas. But beware, deadly creatures are after you and your friend!

title: Survival EXtreme
description: Enter a world devastated by the 2050 apocalypse. Fifty years later, humanity has returned… The war to reclaim Earth has begun, and only the bravest will be able to face the demons that now rule it. The world has fallen. Now it's your turn to rise.

title: Weyrdlets
description: Weyrdlets is a relaxing desktop pet game where you can collect cute items, decorate your home and bring a virtual pet onto your desktop when you need a loving companion!

title: Gaslamp Cases 5: The Dreadful City
description: Play the 5th part of the Match3 saga! Morgan, Jack, and Eleanor have solved numerous mystical casesin and out London, but their return to London greets them with terror. London is quarantined, caught in the grip of a mysterious illness, with no cure in sight - can they save thousands of lifes?

title: Carrot: The First Seed
description: A tiny visual novel about a tiny coastal town.

title: You Are Peter Shorts
description: You are Peter Shorts! You have been captured and taken to a secret cloning facility. Can you escape with your newly-cloned brethren?

title: Hangman II
description: A grim sequel to the puzzle of guessing words. The rules are the same - you need to guess the word, and you have the right to make a mistake 6 times, otherwise the man will be in the noose. And be careful - the game contains many secrets...

title: Easy puzzle: Bridges
description: Easy puzzle: Bridges is a logic game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture.

title: Game Of Puzzles: Dragons
description: A puzzle game in which you have to assemble a single image from individual pieces.

title: Asura Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Who Wants to Strip this Babe? Streamer Girl
description: The combination of the well-known TV show with the best genre of games on earth.

title: My Strange Girlfriends
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Easy puzzle: Landscape
description: This is a logic game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture.

title: Wizard Lady
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Glasses and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Bikes and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Cars and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Car Dealer Simulator
description: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

title: Heliborne Collection
description: Heliborne Collection offers two games through a launcher. Choose to play Heliborne or Heliborne Enhanced Edition.

title: Chris: The Element Runner
description: In Chris: The Element Runner, race through an endless 2D stage filled with elemental particles as you dodge stones, flames, water, and air. Simple graphics and gameplay make it easy to pick up and play for quick sessions. Test your skills and see how far you can survive in this thrilling adventure.

title: Drunken FC
description: Ever wanted to get drunk, play football (soccer), and not worry about the medical bill later? Do you hate animation and love physics? Then here's some physics-based sports action for you and your friends. Play locally or remotely. Move your feet, but don't break the sticks on your controller.

title: Temple of Revi
description: Travel through devastated lands solving color-matching sokoban puzzles to bring Nature back to life.

title: Orb Flight
description: Fly and collect all of the glowing orbs. Meditative Flight & exploration game with relaxing music.

title: Sinking Simulator: Legacy
description: The original Sinking Simulator from 2013 A fun lightweight Sandbox game focused on creating ships and wrecking them using soft body physics!

title: Tokyo Psychodemic
description: Through forensic investigation, confront paranormal phenomenas! 2D × Cinematic・Realistic forensics investigation simulation game.

title: Spectra Echo VR
description: Immerse yourself in this surreal world of Spectra Echo VR, and embark on a unique music visualization journey. Play your own music within the game and watch as the environment and particles dance to the rhythm of your tunes. Unwind and revel in this captivating audiovisual extravaganza!

title: Pillars
description: Pillars is a 3D platformer where the environments are put first and foremost to provide a fun, relaxing experience climbing all six levels.

title: Hex Strikers
description: High Striker, the classic funfair strongman game, is now a roguelike deckbuilder. Strategically place hex tiles with strikers, gain tokens and unlock upgrades from the shop to rack up the highest possible score from 1000 strikes.

title: Shale
description: Discover the abandoned world of Shale in this 1-3 player action adventure. Shoot, craft and loot through cities of possessed creatures, industrial parks of corrupted bodies and fields of forgotten souls.

title: Witch's House Beginning
description: Alexei will have to choose several ways to escape from the witch's house. You will have to look for: batteries to keep the flashlight on, keys to open the doors, fuel to fill up the car, etc.

title: Spellfield
description: Spellfield is a relaxing farming RPG set in an idyllic town. You can build up your farm, hone your skills, and explore a vibrant, mysterious world.

title: Chess Graphy
description: Aren't you tired of looking at only one board, while reviewing your opening lines? Chess Graphy will graph out your openings and allow you to easily glider over the endless possibilities of a chess game.

title: Knight Trail
description: A silly little micro RPG. You are Sir Knight, trying to save the kingdom without dying from general incompetence. You're free to explore the expansive world any way you'd like, but beware of what you might encounter.

title: Goblin Conqueror
