description: Surrounded by bright neons, filthy streets and even filthier techno beats, it is you who guard the entrance to the rave. Sharpen your wits and deliver lyrical smackdowns to those not worthy of partying. But beware - the stakes may or may not involve blowing up the city.

title: Manitas Kitchen
description: Welcome to Manitas Kitchen, a casual cooking game with a dressing of arcade and mini-games, where you'll meet Trexito, a T-Rex with short arms that has one dream: to become the best pizza maker!

title: Astebros
description:
Choose your hero among three different characters and go through procedural dungeons to eliminate your formidable opponents!

Astebros is a roguelite game about the beginnings of the kingdom of Asteborg!
Choose your hero among three different characters and go through procedural dungeons to eliminate your formidable opponents!

Defeat bosses to obtain valuable power orbs!
Collect coins and materials to buy and upgrade your equipment!
Discover mysterious secrets within the dungeons...
All this alone or in pairs!

title: Infinite Dungeon Crawler: The Swampy Isles
description: DLC adds an additional world to travel to when you go through the Gate. Prepare yourself for a lush jungle and palm-lined beaches, filled with ancient ruins, sunken ships, and fierce monsters.

title: Fishing Adventure: Finland Reserve
description: Embark on a new fishing adventure in "Fishing Adventure: Finland Reserve"! Explore a stunning Finnish lake, catch perch, zander, pike, salmon, and brown trout as you enjoy the crystal-clear waters and breathtaking scenery. Get ready for an unforgettable experience!

title: Bonfire and Tail
description: Bonfire and Tail is a multiplayer action party game developed by avidya studio. Through the gameplay, we want to bring players back to childhood and have simple fun together. Draw a torch from the bonfire and ignite other players' tails! If your tail is on fire, wiggle it to put the fire out!

title: Pechka
description: This game portrays the tragic history of war in a 2D adventure format, set against real events. It provides a realistic experience, encompassing themes of betrayal, death, and love, while also offering multiple endings driven by player choices. Discover the impact of this era's tragedy firsthand

title: Cabernet
description: Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in 19th century Eastern Europe. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Beware, the taste of Cabernet is not for the faint of heart - prepare to explore themes of social conflict, alcoholism, and corruption.

title: The Soul Box: Don Quixotes of Tomorrow
description: An (in)side story that sheds some light on El Capitan's past and the others' present.

title: Corpse Master
description: In Corpse Master, Raven must face endless hordes of demons and monsters to find and destroy the 3 fragments of the Corpse Master, with the help of special weapons, random and specific items and a lot of skill.

title: Alan Wake II: Deluxe Edition
description:
The physical edition of Alan Wake II: Deluxe Edition is a special edition of Alan Wake II.

It includes:
- Alan Wake 2 physical game
- Alan Wake Remastered: A digital edition of the remastered of the original game
- The Night Springs and Lake House expansions
-The Deluxe Edition cosmetics and items: Nordic Shotgun Skin for Saga, Crimson Windbreaker for Saga, Celebrity Suit for Alan, Parliament Shotgun Skin for Alan, and Lantern Charm for Saga
- A reversible cover sleeve with exclusive artwork

title: Astra Noctis
description: Astra Noctis is a Metroidvania more focused on combat than exploration. It contains some RPG touches, such as the inventory and equipment system. These systems encourage experimentation and the creation of different builds and playstyles.

title: Bore Blasters
description: Blast through rocks with your machine gun drill. Collect rare gems, ores and ancient artifacts, upgrade your ship and unlock new abilities. Uncover the mysteries of the deep and the dangers that lurk below.

title: Primal Rift
description: Turn-based, solo character roleplaying adventure set in a prehistoric world!

title: GoKaDu
description: GoKaDu is a retro simulator of a role-playing card game of the 80s - "Govno". Play cards with the ghosts of GoKaDu castle, use the game chat and enjoy the mystical atmosphere of this amazing game. The game has rude profanity and a lot of joy and fun.

title: Spiral Up
description: An extremely challenging 2D Platformer made by a bunch of Jump King lovers: breach the sky, or torture yourself, with spring and gravity. Can also be played with your friends, either for a race or for co-op.

title: Palladium
description: A classical FPS based on movement filled with metroidvania elements and power ups to find by exploring the interconnected levels.

title: HexBat
description: Challenge your Friends in this Free turn-based, chess-like strategy game with Healers, Rogues, Archers, and more! Create your own Hexagon Grids for near endless variation.

title: Casting Whispers
description: Sound is your only hope for survival in this first-person psychological horror game. Investigate the mysteries of an apartment block in 1960s America terrorized by a cosmic horror, as you try to save your lost mentor… and yourself.

title: Lost In The Shadows
description: Become the hero who will be the first to defeat the toughest enemies of the dungeon. Develop your character to become indestructible. You can gain levels, distribute points and upgrade your abilities.

title: A Thug's Ascension
description: A Thug's Ascension is a low-poly action-adventure / FPS story set in the dying city of Maratha, circa 2023. Become Chief, a feared mercenary, and experience a dark, slow-paced, character-driven crime drama marrying cinematic dialogue-driven storytelling with intense shooting and driving gameplay.

title: The RPG
description: Minimalistic Skyrim + West of Loathing + Supraland. An RPG-lite adventure with intentionally twisted traditional role-playing games aspects, where your choices do matter.

title: Schrott
description: SCHROTT - the roguelite driving game: Pull off insane stunts, collect valuable loot, and customize your absurd vehicle.

title: Rebirth Evolution
description: 2D pixel style simulation business strategy game Build and operate your own survivor base, recruit and cultivate various professional combatants. Clear zombie strongholds, reduce regional infections, survive in the apocalypse, and establish your own power.

title: Snowboard League
description: Snowboard League is an exciting snowboarding game where you customize your character and compete in thrilling races with power-ups. Earn coins to unlock more customization options and enjoy endless hours of fun.

title: Liminal Space
description: Welcome to Liminal Space. We have been expecting you. Choose your map and try to escape. It's up to you if you want monsters chasing you or if you want a peaceful experience with no threats. With an unsettling soundtrack and fun graphic options, you'll have a good time for a cheap price.

title: Pixel Cafe
description: Join a small-town girl on this coming-of-age story about family, relationships, coffee and life in the big city. Immerse yourself in the perfect blend of an arcade-style time manager and visual novel, exploring dual storylines and a beautifully crafted pixel art world in Pixel Cafe.

title: The Mystery of the Moon
description: The game of survival and construction on the surface of the moon. Learn to build a base on the surface of the moon, maintain survival, explore and discover the secrets inside the moon, and solve abnormal problems.

title: Reus 2
description: Shape humanity with the power of the gods in Reus 2. Choose your giants, combine natural elements, and manipulate fate to guide the path of civilization. The choices are yours, and so are the consequences.

title: Isop0dyssey
description: trash-infested power fantasy sandbox with puzzle, racing & crustacean elements set in the gritty, segregated world of ocean floor society

title: Super Sean 008: Xelar's Revenge
description: I'm not bald!!! Wait what? The evil bald wizard Xelar has abducted Super Sean himself this time to take revenge for all the goody goody two shoes stuff he did in Super Sean 007. Fast paced 2D platform action!

title: Dice World
description: Dice World is a turn-based roguelike game. Create your own party by combining skills with character. You need dice to use skills, but you also need strategic dice choices depending on the situation. Collect relics and enhance your skills to defeat your enemies!

title: Magehunter: Phoenix Flame
description: Stalk the city streets with ancient technology! Will your sword clash with mages, or will you betray your order in exchange for power? Magehunter: Phoenix Flame is a dark fantasy text-based rpg.

title: NightHover
description: The NightCity at night is a hoverbike racing arena. Have fun in 43 levels, gaining speed upgrades, shock powerups to slow other racers, repairing powerups and rockets to shoot kamikaze drones. Switch to the first person view for more immersive gameplay. Plays best with a controller!

title: Section Gamma
description: Section Gamma is a post-apocalyptic, turn-based strategy game for up to 4 players. Fight for dominance in the post-apocalyptic world of Section Gamma. Upgrade your troops, unlock new technologies, and use tactical cunning to defeat your enemies.

title: The Battle for Vega
description: Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.

title: Tarnished Blood
description: Battle huge bosses, create epic frame-perfect combos, and master the innovative time manipulation system. Craft powerful weapons, make sure your civilization survives, and discover the dark secrets of the Dome.

title: Banbard
description: An RPG focused on character customization for combat, and having characters break there own fate to grow and build upon themselves. Customize your play style as you see fit, build relationships with your party and grow to overcome any personal or interpersonal challenge that comes your way.

title: Cloudburst
description: CLOUDBURST is the ultimate test of survival in a post-apocalyptic world. Survive the swarms and machines or battle it out battle-royale style. Scavenge, build, make friends, or kill them all. Don't get killed because there's no coming back. Will you be the last one standing on Problesk Island?

title: Void Funk
description: Void Funk is a puzzle platformer that explores the intricacies of human emotion and artificial intelligence through environmental challenges and puzzles.

title: Java Saga
description: Order up! Join Mornin’ Jo and D’Caff, the mischievous mixologist duo, on their daily grind as baristas in Suburb City! Keep a healthy work/fight balance as you serve customers and take down the dastardly cronies of T.E.A. Inc in Turn-Based combat in this zany Action RPG!

title: ShapeHero Factory
description: ShapeHero Factory is a game that fuses the factory simulation, roguelite, and tower defense genres. Use different shape combinations to mass-produce a variety of heroes, who will then fight all on their own. All you need to worry about is building the optimal factory to manufacture them.

title: Crescent Quest
description: Crescent Quest is a mostly medieval turn based open world RPG that is inspired by old 2000s MMO designs while being a single player experience. Increase your skills, go on unique quests, grind for and collect rare items, be a part of the constantly changing world of Reltionus!

title: In the Footage
description: "In the footage" is a horror exploration game. You awaken in an empty room with nothing to do but play a videotape lying on the floor and contemplate the meaning of the footage. That's all you can do at this point.

title: Treasure Chest Clicker
description: Click chests, collect loot. Buy new chests and keep clicking! You will be rewarded gold, XP, rare loot and ultra rare loot each time you open a chest.

title: Burger Cooking Simulator
description: Become the burger chef in the physical-based Burger Cooking Simulator. Skillfully use your hand to interact with ingredients and utensils to complete orders. Grill, fry, make burgers, watch your time, and keep your customers in a good mood.

title: Castaway Station
description: An anomaly has destroyed your cruiser, stranding you alone on a hostile planet. Castaway Station is a roguelike deck-builder game with limited-use cards and permanent death. Complete dangerous missions to locate other survivors and gather the resources you need to live another day.

title: Convolution of Fear
description: Get ready for a challenging journey through a dark labyrinth filled with danger at every turn. Navigate treacherous paths and overcome the horrors lurking within to escape the endless terrors.

title: RuneLight
description: RuneLight is a Horde Survival Action Roguelite where you choose your equipment, craft your weapon to fit your build, and discover powerful fusions in order to take down hordes of powerful elementals

title: Dungeon Tycoon
description: Build your own dungeon and attract heroes from all across the realm! Grow your business by capitalizing on every aspect of your visitor's dungeon-crawling experience. Will you be able to keep your evil business afloat?

title: Midnight Pufferfish Show
description: Get ready for a heart-stopping adventure in the Midnight Pufferfish Show, the multiplayer game that brings the excitement of high-stakes! Outwit and outlast your opponents in a cutthroat contest where every step could be your last. Do you have what it takes to win the "Show"?

title: Total War: Pharaoh - Dynasty Edition
description: The Dynasty Edition is the ultimate Total War: PHARAOH experience. Containing four future DLC releases and the Digital Soundtrack, witness the collapse of the Bronze Age at its most dramatic.

title: Movie Actor Trivia
description: How well do you know your Movie Stars? Choose from the most popular Stars in Hollywood, including Bill Murray, Brad Pitt, Denzel Washington, Julia Roberts, Sandra Bullock, Steve Martin, Tom Cruise, Tom Hanks and Will Smith. Challenge your friends and family in Party Mode.

title: Secret Backrooms 2
description: Secret Backrooms 2, A Sequel that you play as a facility worker that has noclipped through reality. uncover the secrets behind Delta's Experimental Facility and how the backrooms was discovered.

title: Death Rabbit Arena
description: Death Rabbit Arena is a realistic first person and third person shooter that takes place in real world locations. Play with friends online or offline against the computer or by yourself and explore big open world maps.

title: Power Champions
description: Explore the universe and protect Zarion from evil invaders led by the fearsome KillDeath. Join the Champions of Power, the most powerful heroes of the universe, to combat destruction and madness in an epic adventure and action game !

title: Realms of Wilorth
description: Guide sacrificed warriors through elemental realms in 'Realms of Wilorth', a retro-styled action roguelike. Choose the Knight, Mage, or Rogue and defeat guardians to retrieve power seeds. Gain game-changing perks to level up in procedurally generated maps and become unstoppable!

title: Dungeon Merchant
description: Buy and sell weapons, armour, potions and more to grow your humble shop. Hire adventurers and send them into the dungeon to collect loot for you. You've got a debt to pay to the king and in order to pay it, you're going to have to buy low, sell high and hope your hired heroes make it out alive.

title: Posthaste Emporium
description: Posthaste Emporium is a chaotic first-person shop management game where you must run your master's magical goods shop while he's off on vacation. You're responsible for stocking the shelves after the morning delivery arrives and sending all the customers' orders out on time before the shop closes.

title: Brothers in Hell
description: After you die, Death gives you the chance to come back to the world of the living to fulfill your deepest desire. Take the chance. Get back on your feet, and claim your revenge in this stealth action-adventure game

title: Trow's Space
description: Immerse yourself in a 2D pixel style game where you control a spaceship against enemy motherships. Your mission: destroy their towers with accurate shots. Face constant attacks and dodge asteroids, satellites and black holes. Beat levels to face more challenging enemies.

title: Roboden
description: Roboden is an asymmetrical indirect control real-time strategy game about robot colonies.

title: Meteor Down!
description: Meteor Down is set on a dystopian Earth ravaged by a trio of evil fantasy races. Start unlocking your inner tactical genius by diving into this narrative-driven rogue-lite deck builder.

title: Golf with the Lads
description: A short project aimed at bringing a fun minigolf experience to VR for free!

title: Quadrium 2
description: Quadrium is back with a new and exciting mash-up of marble popper and match-3 challenge! Discover new bonuses and antibonuses and develop new strategies. Use mines to clear the field with explosive chain reactions and encounter fun boss battles that pit you against exciting challengers.

title: The Soul Labyrinth
description: The Soul Labyrinth is a thrilling game where you must collect souls and escape a monster in an intricate, stylized maze. With each level, the monster's presence grows, creating a sense of dread.

title: Hoppy Hop
description: Join Hoppy in this classic action platformer as you collect candies, dodge enemies and jump. After all, you are a rabbit!

title: Hero of Fate
description: "Hero of Fate" is a rogue game combining the elements of "survivors" and "role-playing". In the midst of monsters, you will encounter various tasks or sudden events. You can recruit partners or become a lone wolf and experience an exciting and unpredictable adventure in this fantastic world!

title: Ghost Maze
description: Embark on this small adventure to conquer a treasure guarded by an iconic character from old games. Find keys to unlock secret passages, face enemies, and explore a labyrinth to discover the game's secrets. Get ready for an epic journey to become the hero who claims the wealth.

title: Bubble Ghost Remake
description: Guide a small ghost and its bubble through an enchanted castle full of dangers and challenges in this incredible remake of the popular classic "Bubble Ghost". With over 40 levels of skill that include ingenious puzzles and challenging obstacles, get ready for hours of addictive gameplay.

title: Dwarfender
description: Dwarfender is an action-strategy fantasy game in third person, set traps to repel waves of angry golems ! Take control of Rigolain, a dwarf-engineer, ready for anything in the heat of battle !

title: Cryptis
description:
Reawakened In Desolation...

Awaken amidst a desolate realm, your last memory being a life far removed from this nightmare. Embark on a journey of relentless violence, navigating through hordes of bloodthirsty undead. What sinister force has brought you to this place? Plunge into a tale shrouded in shadows and unveil the chilling truth.
Next-Gen Visuals Meet a Retro Aesthetic
Built in the mesmerizing Unreal Engine 5 and harnessing the cutting-edge capabilities of Nanite and Lumen, Cryptis immerses you in a haunting world where retro-inspired designs meet breathtakingly realistic lighting.
Dynamic and Diverse Gameplay
No two encounters are the same. Your journey will see you wielding an array of weapons, tools, and abilities that allow for varied approaches to confrontations, ensuring a fresh and thrilling experience with every battle.

Embrace the chaos, slaughter your bloodthirsty adversaries, and overcome the darkness. The very fabric of this realm quivers at your presence. Leave nothing left standing.

Welcome to Cryptis. Your nightmare has just begun...

title: Chasm Bound
description: Chasm Bound is a challenging 3D platformer where the player tries to escape from a deep pit in the ground.

title: War For Galaxy
description: Become the ruler of the entire Galaxy: colonize planets, extract resources, build defenses and fight in planetary battles!

title: Newcomer: A Language Learning RPG
description: Newcomer is a language learning videogame where you play and learn a second language through natural conversation.

title: Farewell Avalon
description:
Farewell Avalon is a top-down combat game with a unique twist to "death" and a deep storyline in a world unlike before.
Explore the ruins of Outpost 7 as you uncover the mysterious past of Archie and the Avalonian people. And alongside your journey, The Skribble will protect you through, no matter what.

title: 5 Minutes
description: 5 Minutes grants no comfort. Grants no rest. Grants no forgiveness. It is a game for those unafraid to fall a thousand times, for those who see defeat not as failure, but as an invitation. For those who seek the glory of challenging the impossible, even if they never reach it.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
description:
Blaze into the high-Orktane mayhem of clashing Speedmobs, in adrenaline-fueled combat racing through the brutal Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive scrappy vehicles loaded with bombastic weapons and powerful abilities to krump the opposing team!

Assemble your mob of dakka-spitting wagons, pushing their team to victory across multiple maps in this explosively unique take on the combat racing and shooter genres. Obliterate your Ork foes with kunnin’ strategies and brute force as your team speeds towards ultimate glory.

Are you looking for more speed and more dakka in your life? Look no further YA GITS!

title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realms of Ruin
description: Wage a campaign of brutal conquest in this realm-shattering real-time strategy game set in the Warhammer Age of Sigmar universe. Command four unique factions in dynamic battles as part of a story-driven campaign and test your mettle against warlords afar in online multiplayer.

title: Dangeresque: The Roomisode Triungulate
description: Join Dangeresque, (Strong Bad from Homestar Runner) the world's greatest private eye/crooked cop, as he puzzles his way through 3 bite-sized roomisodes in this classic-style point n' click adventure.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Orks
description: The most warlike race in the Galaxy, Orks live for the joy of battle and are always chasing their next big Waaagh! They arrive in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector with fifteen super-killy units that are all armed to da teef and overflowing with Dakka!

title: Blood Bowl III: Season 1
description:
This season includes:
- A new faction
- A new blood pass
- Brand new customisation
- New Competitive Season
And much more!

title: Lighthouse of the Dead
description: Disable your enemies by ripping off their limbs, or explode their heads and swim in the fountains of blood. You’ve got an infinite amount of ammo to fight and three doses of drugs in case your heart fails. Kill four enemies in a row without a single miss and you´ll be healed as a reward for your awesomeness. The only way to survive is to light the beacon, board the ship and leave the damn place. Good luck!

title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Karak Azgaraz
description: Karak Azgaraz is a free new content update for Warhammer: Vermintide 2. It contains three newly remastered adventure maps from the fan-favorite DLC of the first Vermintide game.

title: Underground Above
description:
"What you do above
I have seen below."

A narrative driven adventure-horror game about 3 friends who find the entrance to a cave and the decisions they make.

title: Farmagia
description: Command an army of monsters in this all-new action game featuring character designs by famed manga artist Hiro Mashima. Take a stand to free the people of Felicidad as a Farmagia named Ten when monster farming, adventure, and hectic battles come together in an epic tale of rebellion and friendship.

title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma
description: The classic action-RPG and life-simulation gameplay, beloved by Rune Factory fans across the globe, is taken in a bold new direction in Guardians of Azuma. This all-new adventure takes place in the never-before-seen eastern country of Azuma where you will assume the Earth Dancer powers and fight against the spreading Blight to bring hope back to this once-prosperous land.

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion
description:
From Marvelous First Studio comes an action-packed new entry in the Daemon X Machina series. Fly into battle in your customized Arsenal, unleashing a variety of attacks tailored to your playstyle. Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous open world on land or in the air. After taking down your foes, collect their weapons and equipment, and upgrade your skills to expand your options on the battlefield. Suit up for a dark sci-fi story where you can face the titanic boss battles alone or with up to two other players online. New and veteran Daemon X Machina players alike will find a worthy adventure here.

Created and produced by Kenichiro Tsukuda and featuring stunning mechanical designs from Shoji Kawamori, Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion takes the franchise in a dramatic new direction.

Humanity’s fight for liberation begins now!

title: Alone in the Dark Prologue: Grace in the Dark
description: Grace in the Dark is a free-to-play prelude to Alone in the Dark, a reboot of a horror classic. It gives players their first glimpse into the story of Alone in the Dark and helps set the atmosphere, which is expected to be a more linear experience with some exploration and basic puzzles. Grace in the Dark will provide about 15-20 minutes of gameplay but will not feature any combat.

title: Destroy the Wall
description: A 2D metroidvaina action game with a unique control scheme. Guide a snake constantly chasing your cursor--but be sure not to let them touch. Explore the decaying landscape of a condemned world and fight its monsters so you can grow strong enough to destroy the wall that always holds you back

title: Detective Agency Gray Tie 2: Collector's Edition
description: AviGames presents the second game from the Detective Agency "Gray Tie" series. In this hidden objecft game you have to investigate the theft of a famous painting and solve loads of mindchallenging mini games and riddles!

title: Crossing Damaged Bridge
description: Crossing Damaged Bridge is an exciting game designed for those who love extreme adventures. The game takes you on a thrilling journey, where the roads are full of potholes and obstacles.

title: Fusionist
description: Fusionist is a mech-themed game with diverse gameplays and detailed graphics, and it is free! Combining simulation management, turn-based combat, and 4X (explore, expand, exploit, exterminate) gameplays. Manage, build, and forge mechs to engage in intense battles!

title: An Ankou
description: Recently deceased and chosen as the Ankou, help lost souls to leave the world of the living with the tools of your old trade. Roam haunted lands to find resources, craft equipment and slay hordes of demons in this action-exploration roguelike.

title: 9 Lives to Defend
description: Face a pest infestation and survive until Loki's parents return from their trip! Defend the house with your 9 lives. Choose upgrades, and play with different versions of Loki, with unique weapons and abilities to fight this war ^.^

title: Soak & Splash
description: The game is an ultimate sauna experience where players can enjoy socializing with friends and strangers that easily can become friends. It's all about having fun, relaxing, and experiencing the unique benefits of sauna culture.

title: Nobody's Left
description: In a post-war apocalyptic city, ordinary men can no longer remain ordinary, adaptation is a survival must to protect your loved ones. take responsibility and lead this change in a game with emotional storytelling. remember! always expect the unexpected when nobody’s left to back you up!

title: Insanias
description: In Insanias you must explore what happened to find a truth that only you can find. To do so, you must be able to control your sanity to avoid falling into the madness that lurks around every corner. Are you ready to face your fears and discover the truth?

title: Steel Racer
description:
Steel Racer is a 2D pixelated old school racing game, inspired by classics from the 80s and 90s era, featuring great chiptune music, arcade gameplay style and high speed cars! Are you ready to become the "Steel Racer"!?

Speed through 50 different circuits in any order across 5 different terrain zones. Win races and money to upgrade and customize your car. Choose between 3 difficulty settings and 3 levels of traction assist, making your car easier or harder to control on curves.

title: Dungeons & Keyboards
description: Ready your typing skills and defeat the quirky enemies of the Tower of Verbum. Collect coins, relics, and experience to buy items, assign stats and unlock permanent upgrades. How far will your typing skills take you?

title: Mystery Society 2: Hidden Puzzles
description: Dive into a hidden object adventure with unique tasks, puzzles, and a riveting story. Join elite detectives in a secret organization, uncover hidden treasures, and solve crimes across the globe.

title: One-Eyed Likho
description:
One-Eyed Likho is a grim first-person horror adventure set in a world inspired by a dark, Slavic fairy tale “The One-eyed Likho”. Likho, is an embodiment of evil fate and misfortune in Slavic mythology, a creature with one eye, often depicted as an old, skinny woman in black.

Embark on an exhilarating journey through a haunting realm brought to life from a forgotten Slavic fairy tale of the 19th century. Immerse yourself in a captivating world rendered in mesmerizing greyscale, presented in an immersive 4:3 aspect ratio that adds depth to your adventure.

title: FightBit
description: FightBit is a side-scrolling beat-em-up with pseudo 8-bit graphics and rudimentary gameplay influenced by contemporary melee focused combat games.

title: Beta Decay
description: The development of positronic propulsion technology has granted the ability for mankind to travel beyond the Sol system, to its neighboring star system, Alpha Centauri. Survive in the new frontier amongst an exponential uprising of mega-corporations, factions, and syndicates.

title: Kind Nature
description: Kind Nature is a post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilding game. As one of the last survivors in a harsh world, you'll embark on dangerous missions to gather resources, fight enemies, and expand your camp. In this shattered world, will you find a place to call home?

title: Old Town Bus Simulator
description: Old Town Bus Simulator is a unique and immersive game that lets you experience the thrill of being a bus driver in the heart of a city's historic district.

title: Hunter: The Reckoning - The Beast of Glenkildove
description: Full moon. Cold night. Dark shadow. Warm gun. The Beast of Glenkildove has stalked Ireland for centuries. Now, you must hunt it. A text-based interactive novel set in the World of Darkness.

title: Shell of a King
description: Test your strength in Shell of a King! A precision bullet-hell adventure that will push your dodging skills to the limit. Challenge tough bosses, uncover secrets, and explore a world left to ruin in this top-down RPG.

title: Space Industrial Empire
description: This is a idle game modeled on industrial building gameplay. It will be three-dimensional, complex industrial assembly line, easy, simple plane conveyor belt. At the same time to join the battleship assembly, space campaign, character development, giant construction, trade orders and other gameplay!

title: The Vengeance Of Lady Witch
description: "The Vengeance of Lady Witch" is an action-packed RPG game where players take on the role of Lady Witch, seeking revenge against those who wronged her. With a vast open world, intense combat, and a deep storyline, this game is a must-play for fans of RPGs and action games. Available on Steam.

title: Mossroot
description: Mossroot is a party-based tactical-RPG Roguelike. Climb a fortified mountain. Fight Monsters and villains! Power up your team's stats, make difficult decisions Recruit enemies to help fight against tyranny. Bring them to your Homebase, Build it to gain more power, or make runs harder for rewards!

title: Pyrami Head
description: We are trying to escape from a dark and extremely disturbing mysterious place. We are trying to rescue our character, who has lost his memory and is waiting to be sacrificed, without getting caught by the enemies around and open the hidden areas of the room by exploring the surroundings.

title: Demon Lord: Reincarnation
description: Assemble a party, explore the dungeon, fight your way through hordes of monsters, and defeat the Demon Lord in this brutal dungeon crawler. Are you up to the challenge?

title: Spaceman Memories
description: Spaceman Memories is a retro JRPG that takes place in a distant future but draws inspiration from ancient Japanese folktales. A story full of wonder and nostalgia as you take on the role of Ichiro 94, an astronaut who wakes up from hypersleep to go on a journey to find the remnants of his past.

title: Crazy Rabbits
description: Crazy Rabbits is a chaotic multiplayer FPS, you play as a rabbit with speed running abilities. you can play with up to 15 people.

title: Morrok
description: In this point & cklick adventure join young detective Rudolf Pasaret to solve the greatest mystery of the 19th century. Guide the detective along the brink of insanity through a world created by an evil madman as you unravel a mystery of black magic and false accusations to discover the truth.

title: Monch!
description: Monch your way to new abilities as you platform and puzzle your way through a colourful, handcrafted world. The Monchling is hungry for adventure!

title: Enigma Manor
description: Enigma Manor is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Navigate your way through the procedurally generated manor, fend off monsters, solve puzzles and find a way to escape.

title: Wolf in the City
description: A lone wolf whose children have been kidnapped from an animal shelter and is looking for his children in a Big city. He will need to find food and track to survive. As the wolf, run through the streets and interact with cars and people. Sleep and recharge, or talk to other animals. This is a ThirdPerson game about story and tracking.

title: The Sleep Experiment
description: Experience the horrors of one of the most infamous experiments that ever took place. As a test subject in a top-secret Soviet research facility, you must endure days without sleep while facing unimaginable terrors that lurk in the shadow.

title: Biomech Hell
description: A run and gun that mixes old-school mechanics from games like Contra, Gunstar Heroes and Metal Slug; with more modern features and a large dose of violence. A total arcade experience for all lovers of retro gaming!

title: Goosey Guess
description: Goosey Guess is a guess simulator with a goosey theme! Dozens or even hundreds of items will spawn in a 3D environment and you have to guess how many are in the container. Batteries, dice, marbles, push pins, and many other items will be generated and fall into all types of different containers.

title: Yolk Heroes: A Long Tamago
description: Yolk Heroes is the virtual pet game you've always wanted! RPG Mechanics, minigames, quests...who doesn't love quests? Your elf will explore, grow stronger, and embark on an adventure to deliver the world from evil! OR! You can just relax and enjoy your little friend.

title: Rose and Lotus: Petals of Memories
description: [Rose and Lotus:Petals of Memories] is based on Korean traditional fairy tales 'Janghwa, Hongryeon'.The main character, Rose, awake from the cold floor without her memory.Find the truth behind the dark mansion and get out of it with your sister Lotus.

title: Vae Victis
description: Vae Victis is a minimalistic turn-based strategy game that is easy to pick up but hard to master. Choose your faction, build your army, and crush your enemies to expand your empire! With clever tactics and strategic maneuvers, lead your army to victory in an epic battle of power and dominance.

title: I Believe in Capybara Supremacy!
description: We are the chosen one to take care of Capybara, a one-of-a-kind creature that lives on Earth and has the potential to destroy the world when it gets angry, in order to help it control its anger and prevent the destruction of the world!

title: Their Majesties' Pleasure
description: Pursue love and glory with unruly royals, seductive Fae, and rogue assassins in this epic text-based RPG romance set in a kingdom on the brink of war. As a member of the royal guard, it is your duty to protect the heirs to the throne, but the rebellious siblings lead you on a merry chase outside the palace. They open you up to a world that you never knew before: a secret network of assassins, corrupt city officials, and a cabaret brimming with songs, spirits, and sex. And when you are done carousing in the city, you can move into the dark of the magic-filled forest, where demigods and Fae throw jubilant, bacchanal revels, which include orgies for those so inclined

title: Hoop Land
description: Get ready for tip off at center court in the latest hoops title by Koality Game! Choose a league, select a team and lead your players to the Championship. Dribble the ball up court and cross-over your opponent for the step back three. Swish! Or run a fast break offense and throw the lob to your teammate for the alley-oop. Slam dunk! Either way, you can become the next dynasty in the hottest basketball simulation game on the market. Welcome to Hoop Land.

title: Antivine
description:
Antivine is like a delicate album and a peaceful composition. Describing a young boy seeking for the reason of his uniqueness, and step on his journey. With your wisdom can help him to pursue and reveal the truth.

Some say once you get order, branches will start to sprout out of the body and become a plant. Find the mountain God at the other side of the land, and you will find the cure.

Change the scenes with a simple click. One of the core of Antivine is to change viewpoints, and clear all the puzzles with it.

"Who am I? Why am I different?"
In this game, you can enjoy solving puzzles in a relaxing pace and together with a young girl meet on the journey. Put yourself in a teeming world and find the answer of life.

title: A Cairn Tale
description: A Cairn Tale is a 3rd person mountaineering adventure game in which you explore monumental and dreamlike environments through the seasons.

title: IT Clicker: Dinosaur in the Code World
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of the IT industry! In our game, "IT Clicker: Dinosaur in the Code World," anyone can try their hand at being an IT whiz. We'll show you just how easy and fun it is to make money in the world of IT.

title: 9 Lives
description: After living on a crisis striken city, you receive a letter inviting you to join a cat rescue at the Muur Islands. Grow medicinal plants, craft medicine, diagnose symptoms, establish relationships with the island's inhabitants, explore the island and untangle every mystery it has to offer.

title: Dragon Lair Depths
description: A board tactics game with a light roguelike twist. Bring heroes of different races, break into the dragon's lair full of monsters, improve heroes and use strategies, defeat evil dragons time and time again, and get dragon scales that prove your strength...

title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Necrons
description: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

title: Terrierble Logic
description: A game of logic, dogs, and questionable puns. Using the clues given, you'll arrange the elements and solve more than 75 puzzles that range from simple logic to fairly challenging. It is family-friendly and a fun way to engage with thinking in a logical way.

title: A Crazy Guy
description: With my hammer, my chainsaw and my boomstick, I'll take out all the old men and their mangy dogs... and some bizarre creatures.

title: Octo Curse
description: A pirate turned into octopus. Can you break the curse?

title: Forklift 2024: The Simulation
description: Get ready to take on the ultimate forklift simulation experience with Forklift 2024 - The Simulation! Operate your very own forklift and complete randomly generated orders to earn money and expand your warehouse. With a variety of goods to handle and increasing complexity as you progress, this game will keep you on your toes!

title: Khottabych
description: Russian point & click game, based on a 2006's film "Khottabych" ("Хоттабыч"), which based on Sergei Oblomov's (Klado) novel "Old Man Khottabych's Copper Jug".

title: Bubble Bobble Nostalgie
description:
A remake of the famous Japanese game about dragons releasing green bubbles, developed by Russian programmers and released by the notorious Alawar Entertainment studio. Yes, yes, the same one that created and released the well-known Farm Frenzy and the Treasures of Montezuma.

The gameplay is simple. We control a green dragon (and in the game mode for two - also blue), which shoots green bubbles at enemies, and as soon as the enemies hit them, they immediately find themselves in a trap, and we calmly pop these bubbles as a dragon. And from the enemies we get their leftovers in the form of various kinds of food: from fruits to a mug of beer, which also appear as a randomly appearing bonus. There are only 8 enemies - these are clockwork toys familiar to us from the original, and weirdos in a white cloak, and brown ghosts similar to octopuses, and flying monsters with a propeller, and jumpers, and fluffy monsters, and sorcerers, and spiders. If clockwork toys, propeller monsters and octopuses are not particularly dangerous, and they can be easily killed, then here are the rest to be wary of. You should especially be wary of types in white robes and sorcerers who, when they meet you, launch fireballs at you. Sometimes there are several of them at the levels. In some levels, it happens that the monsters are in a small room of platforms, the path to which either leads to a trap or does not exist at all. Then bubbles with lightning come to the rescue, with the help of which you can instantly kill enemies. And if there is open space at the same time, then you can use bubbles with water, crushing enemies when interacting with the player, and with fire, leaving behind traps that kill enemies in the form of a fire floor.

At levels, bubbles with letters appear from time to time, with which you can make a word and teleport to an empty room without enemies, where you will receive prizes in the form of bonuses and an increase in a unit of health.

title: Pro Soccer Cup 2002
description:
Pro Soccer Cup 2002 is a football game, released just before the 2002 World Cup in Korea and Japan. The game has all phases of the world cup and the 32 national teams are in the game, but football players have a fake names, and haven't the characteristics of their real-life counterparts.

The game can be played with friendly matches or a full world cup. There are 4 stadiums and matches have fast gameplay: there are no injuries, shooting goes very quickly, and tackling is easy. The ball can be passed in three ways: short, long and ahead of a player. If a player doesn't have the ball, he can make a tackle or a serious foul. Strategically the team's formation can be altered and players can be substituted.

The game is in full 3D and matches are conducted in varying weather conditions and different times of day. There are eight cameras viewpoints during matches and there is no commentary. Multiplayer is supported for two players on a single PC.

title: Door of Perception
description:
Doors of perception is game from castle game jam 2016. Enjoy!
Gameplay:

title: Grave Seasons
description: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

title: An Inner Walk
description: An Inner Walk is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You play as an unnamed character who explores the outside of their room, going through various familiar places representing memories from its past and present.

title: Brain Rot Excellence
description: Brain Rot Excellence is a Yume Nikki fan game mainly inspired by Broken Bottles and Space Funeral. You follow Brianna Ruth as she explores her mind while in a drug induced coma, inside her she meet Nocebo, a strangely self aware creature who latches unto her and aids her in combat. To be able to wake up from your coma you have to figure out what happened to you and hopefully regain control. The game is exploration based with a little bit of combat thrown in.

title: Syndoy
description: Syndoy is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame.

title: Haruka: Beyond the Stars
description: Haruka: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

title: 14 Days With You
description: Don't worry, he's always going to be with you... Spend time getting to know Ren, a mysterious individual who seems more than obsessed with you — and is willing to do anything he can to have you.

title: Katawa Crash
description: Spinoff of Katawa Shoujo in the vein of Toss the Turtle.

title: Nichibutsu Mahjong Collection
description: Strip mahjong game featuring FMV scenes and photographs of models.

title: Ganku Ganku
description: Search for the perfect fruit while evading your natural predators!

title: Murder Mystery: Who Killed Linda Neuman
description: Murder Mystery: Who Killed Linda Neuman is an exciting and entertaining game developed by iWin Games. At the luxurious Paradise Island Resort, the Grand Fashion Show is just about ready to get underway. However, things come to an abrupt halt when the show’s top model, Linda, is found murdered in her room. The hotel manager is concerned with his hotel’s reputation and calls on the help of Detective Clara. However, as Detective Clara gets deeper into her investigation of the mysterious death of the famous model, she uncovers clues that lead her into a chaotic whirlwind of secrets and affairs. Just when she thinks she has found the perpetrator, she learns something else that takes her back to the drawing board. The plot thickens with each clue she finds!

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Shadespire Edition
description: Warhammer Underworlds – Shadespire Edition is a digital adaptation of the explosive, high- stakes, turn-based strategy tabletop game from Games Workshop that pits mighty warbands from the Age of Sigmar universe against one another in an eternal player versus player batle for Glory. Choose a warband, build your decks and carve a path to victory using dice-and-card mechanics that offer boundless strategic depth.

title: Mystery Mansion
description: Escape from the haunted house.

title: Skautfold: Usurper
description: With Eldritch horrors having been unleashed by the outer-worldly Citadel, your job is to rid London of its terrors and defeat the Navigator!

title: Drill Deal: Oil Tycoon
description: Drill Deal is a fun oil business simulator. Start from a single tiny rig and expand it to a large complex of connected platforms. Optimize & grow your business. Look out for threats like weather, terrorists, fire, and others. Take care of your working crews.

title: Cassette Beasts: Deluxe Edition
description: This edition contains everything you need for the complete Cassette Beasts experience. Set out to explore the world of New Wirral with max expression, unique apparel, and accessories in the Cosplay Pack!

title: Kitten Island
description: In a land full of challenges, jumps, secret areas and meows. Play with a very special kitten. To win, break blocks, jump over other little animals, dodge dangerous spikes, and progress to the next level, all while traversing through diverse landscapes ranging from lush forests to icy glaciers and scorching deserts.

title: The Wonderful 101: Remastered - The Wonderful One: After School Hero - Part 2
description:
Get ready for a unique side-scrolling experience in the world of The Wonderful 101: Remastered! This free DLC lets you enjoy a brand new episode in which you experience Luka's story!

In Part 2 of this DLC, don't miss some brand new mode including a Caravan Mode and Online Rankings.

title: Bubble Bobble Nostalgie: Christmas Edition
description:
The developers of Bubble Bobble Nostalgia also released an add-on called Christmas Edition.

In fact, this is the same Bubble Bobble Nostalgia, only with the atmosphere of the New Year or Christmas holidays: the title music is the notorious Jingle Bells, the dragons are dressed up in the costume of Santa Claus or Santa Claus, and the passwords are replaced with the names of attributes of the New Year or the same Christmas. Well, they changed the background and platforms in some levels. And the rest is the same.

title: Rainbow hotel
description: Short game. You are in hotell attacked by rainbow animals. You have to find keys and run out!

title: Sphizofrenia: Concept of Horror
description: Sphizofrenia is a concept of horror.

title: Legends of Haired Pyra
description: Legends of haired Pyra is multiplayer game endless runner.

title: Spacident
description: Made for TK Game Jam.

title: Project Beksinski
description: Game inspired by images of Zbigniew Beksiński.

title: Steamfantasy: Unbelievable Korwin Story
description:
The game world is part of a destroyed planet that is similar to Earth with dimensions connected to it.
Your story begins in an alternate Hungarian Kingdom when King Korwin sends you to save his daughter and bring peace to the kingdom.

title: Hortal
description: You need to escape from caves. Use holes to teleport and have fun!

title: Boyfriend to Death 2: Fresh Blood
description: A sequel to Boyfriend to Death, focusing on new characters Vincent, Cain and Lawrence.

title: Cosmo Knight Zion
description: The project involves significant changes in the story to create an original plot, as well as improvements to the game engine, the addition of new elements and improvements to the controls, changes in the levels, characters and enemies, and modifications to the music. Although the project is still in its early stages of development, I hope to work on it until it becomes a completely new and complete game.

title: Dungeons of the Obelisk
description: A 2D, turn based, dungeon crawling, loot grinding adventure.

title: Aqua Ippan
description: Heavily inspired by arcade games from the 90s, Aqua Ippan is a ‘Shoot’em Up’/platformer game currently in development that can be played by one or two player(s). Despite being a modern game, it feels and plays like a true arcade classic, and pays homage to the Metal Slug series with its artstyle, detailed animations and jazz-fusion music.

title: Bum Fights
description:
Get ready to brawl like never before in Bum Fights! Jump into the ultimate online multiplayer top-down shooter set in a nostalgic medieval world, where you rise from rags to riches as a penniless warrior fighting for survival and glory.

Experience fast paced action and intense combat as you battle other players in the arena, or team up to take on hordes of the undead. Arm yourself with a variety of weapons, from rusty knives to throwing rocks, and fight until you're the last one standing.

But beware: the competition is fierce, and only the strongest and most skilled will emerge victorious. With customizable characters and diverse game modes, there's always a new challenge around the corner.

Gear up for battle and enter the arena to prove your worth as the Lord of the Bums!

title: Hana Awase: Mizuchi
description:
Volume 1 of Hana Awase.

A maiden's prayer shall make the flower bloom.

There is a card game called "Kasen", which is played with cards known as "Hanafuda". Only a handful of people, known as "Kaei", can call on and draw the power of the "flower". With most Kaei are men, the five students who possess the most power within the academy are referred to as the "Gokou" and are revered.

This is a story about a maiden who has dedicated herself to five male students aiming to become one of the Gokou, set in Kasen National Academy, which is a school that produces many individuals with rare talents.

title: Hana Awase: Himeutsugi
description:
Volume 2 of Hana Awase.

A maiden's prayer shall make the flower bloom.

There is a card game called "Kasen", which is played with cards known as "Hanafuda". Only a handful of people, known as "Kaei", can call on and draw the power of the "flower". With most Kaei are men, the five students who possess the most power within the academy are referred to as the "Gokou" and are revered.

This is a story about a maiden who has dedicated herself to five male students aiming to become one of the Gokou, set in Kasen National Academy, which is a school that produces many individuals with rare talents.

title: Hana Awase: Karakurenai/Utsutsu
description:
Volume 3 of Hana Awase.

A maiden's prayer shall make the flower bloom.

There is a card game called "Kasen", which is played with cards known as "Hanafuda". Only a handful of people, known as "Kaei", can call on and draw the power of the "flower". With most Kaei are men, the five students who possess the most power within the academy are referred to as the "Gokou" and are revered.

This is a story about a maiden who has dedicated herself to five male students aiming to become one of the Gokou, set in Kasen National Academy, which is a school that produces many individuals with rare talents.

title: Hana Awase: Iroha
description:
Volume 4 of Hana Awase.

A maiden's prayer shall make the flower bloom.

There is a card game called "Kasen", which is played with cards known as "Hanafuda". Only a handful of people, known as "Kaei", can call on and draw the power of the "flower". With most Kaei are men, the five students who possess the most power within the academy are referred to as the "Gokou" and are revered.

This is a story about a maiden who has dedicated herself to five male students aiming to become one of the Gokou, set in Kasen National Academy, which is a school that produces many individuals with rare talents.

title: Hana Awase Complete
description: Collection of all four volumes of Hana Awase for PC/Mac along with the series' soundtrack.

title: Hana Awase New Moon: Mizuchi
description: Port of Hana Awase: Mizuchi for the Switch, simultaneously released in Japanese, Chinese, and English.

title: Hana Awase New Moon: Iroha
description: Port of Hana Awase: Iroha for the Switch, simultaneously released in Japanese, Chinese, and English.

title: Hana Awase: New Moon
description: Spanning across time and realities, Hana Awase: New Moon is the story of a young woman drawn into the web of the game kasen, played with hanafuda cards. Through playing, she comes to meet five mysterious men, all of whom are elite players and all of whom guard secrets that hold the power to alter her world irreparably.

title: Sinking Iron
description:
A strong submarine earthquake caught the attention of an amateur diver and his apprentice.

They were close by when the incident happened and decided to investigate before officials arrived.

You are the apprentice. Good luck.

title: Austrian Avian Association
description: Austrian Avian Association is an episode-length total conversion for Doom II. You play as Katarina Berger, a Schnabelperchten doctor who has to save her home (and, potentially, the world) from a sudden invasion of monsters caused by humans tampering with dark powers.

title: Recreational Warfare
description: RecWar is an action game where the main goal is to destroy as many vehicles as possible. To do this you have several weapons and unlimited ammo at your disposal. You can play over a network, splitscreen against your friends or just kill computer opponents. RecWar also includes team game and Capture the Flag play modes. The flag isn't just any flag though...

title: Trick or Alice
description:
On the night of her birthday, Minase Arisa is inexplicably thrown into a Wonderland much like the one from Lewis Carroll's classic, a strange fairytale-like place that keeps repeating the same day over and over again. What's more, its inhabitants—each bearing an uncanny resemblance to someone whom Arisa knows in real life—insist that she is, in fact, their "Alice".

Will Arisa be able to get away? Or will she choose...

title: The Gold and Black Keys that Cannot Open
description:
Katagiri Kanade is a hikikomori who spent her days lazing off in her room. Her specialty is her broad imagination which often leads to various wild delusions. One night a weird cowboy guy appeared in her dream, saying that he’s her heart’s hero. Due to his encouragement, Kanade decided to try and go have a haircut the next day. It was then when she met a mysterious guy who cut her hair in the park, giving her courage to resume her school days.

Right after her haircut, Kanade was nanpa‘d by a guy who turned out to be her former classmate, Sudou Yukio. Kanade used to like him back then, and he was happy to meet her again. Kanade lives with her non blood-related brother, Sonomura Ikuto. Despite Ikuto’s warning, Kanade went looking for the mysterious guy who cut her hair the next day. She found him in the park, where he introduced himself as Hasui Tomoomi. He’s a professional hairdresser and owns a salon named Azalea nearby. Since Kanade was absent from school for so long, her homeroom teacher, Konno Chihiro, offered to help her with her studies.

Having these guys around her, what will happen to Kanade’s life from now on?

title: Death of the Augnob
description: An alien goes on a quest to defeat the Augnob.

title: Solasta: Lightbringers Edition
description:
The Solasta Lightbringers Edition contains:
- Crown of the Magister: The original level 1-12 campaign. From fledgling adventurers to saviours of Masgarth, this 40h+ campaign will take you through the Badlands in search of ancient artifacts to stand against a mysterious threat.
- Palace of Ice: A level 10-16 campaign, it is the continuation of Crown of the Magister and Solasta's last DLC. Venture north into the lands of the Snow Alliance to help your allies and end the Sorak menace once and for all! Also unlocks the Gnome and Tiefling ancestries.
- Lost Valley: A stand-alone level 1-12 campaign. Trapped by accident in an isolated valley where Manacalon's ancient traditions still rule, the party must find a way to escape by allying various factions jumping at each other's throat. Also unlocks an additional subclass for each class.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Update 3.1
description:
In this update you get:
- A new Legendary Hero
- Bretonnia are getting some love with plenty of changes and rebalances.
- The Great Drill of Hashut will strike in a new Chaos Dwarf endgame crisis for Immortal Empires, The Will of Hashut.
- Beef up the lower tiers of infantry with the fourth Regiments of Renown

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Shadows of Change
description: This DLC will add three Legendary Lords (1 for each race), a Legendary Hero and new units.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Thrones of Decay
description: This DLC will add three Legendary Lords (1 for each race), a Legendary Hero and new units.

title: Sandtrix+
description: Sandtrix+ is an expanded version of the freeware game Sandtrix. It extends the base game with new game modes, challenging color modes, and unlockable themes.

title: Firewatch: Audio Tour
description: This update adds a commentary mode in which the game’s protagonist goes on a hunt for new tapes that contain the developer’s recollections, anecdotes and more. It also adds a free-roam mode.

title: Lust Campus
description: Lust Campus is a multi-adventure graphic novel with an emphasis on eroticism and intimacy, with with a diverse cast of complex characters with whom you can connect and meet, and who evolve (or not) thanks to your decisions throughout the story. In LC you will find a game with a femenine gaze an empathy driven storytelling.

title: The Thing You Can't Defeat
description:
Experimental mod for Ultimate Doom. Doomguy has dementia. The Thing you can’t Defeat lets you replay the first episode of Ultimate Doom as it slowly morphs into a confusing and demented nightmare.

This WAD was HEAVILY inspired by the WAD “Doom but somethings not right” and the album “Everywhere at the end of time” by The Caretaker.

title: Young Street
description:
Before bipedal apes invented radio receivers, before we exchanged our gills for lungs, there was radio.
Man-made transmissions mutate and extend the electrosphere.

Remember the alien face of nature!

title: Real Time Assist Replay Time
description: "Real Time Assist Replay Time" is a slot machine simulator.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: Heists
description: Heists was a major content update exclusive to Grand Theft Auto Online. It featured a new 4-player cooperative experience for GTA Online, giving players the chance to team up to pull off a string of intense multi-part heists, raids and robberies. Online Heists spanned numerous missions featuring new gameplay, vehicles, weapons, and scenarios to test a team’s full set of skills.

title: Illegal Crime Game
description: Explore the city and commit crimes. Collect money and commit crimes. Pray to your Crime Deity and invade tombs.

title: Lambda
description:
This a gzdoom mod that contains all of the weapons and items from Half-Life and Half-Life: Opposing-Force, also includes some extra sutff from other mods to fill the item holes.

With a focus on fast-paced combat and visual fidelity, Lambda transforms Doom into a hybrid sci-fi shooter with classic mechanics and upgraded graphics.

title: Lambda-Strike
description: This mod was originally just a reskin of Doom, but now is a full port of all the arsenal of counter-strike 1.6 with some extra.

title: Taiwan 2001
description: Taiwan 2001 is a Japanese parody of the unlicensed SNES game Hong Kong 97. The game was released by Kuso Soft in 2001 and is based around the political status of Taiwan regarding if it is it's own country or a part of China.

title: Star Detective
description:
Star Detective follows a detective who gets a missing person case from a child that wish to a shooting star for help.

It's a simple game where you walk around and talk to people. The game is mostly story focus but you do get to meet some friendly faces as you help a child find their friend.

title: Assassin's Creed Mirage: Launch Edition
description:
Assassin’s Creed Mirage is a stealth-focused action-adventure game set in ninth-century Baghdad. It emphasizes parkour, infiltration, and targeted assassinations. The game follows a more compact structure than recent entries in the series. Players control Basim, a young thief drawn into a secretive order. The title blends historical settings with narrative elements tied to the franchise’s established lore.

The Launch Edition is a special physical release including the base game, a large map of 9th-century Baghdad, and a set of three collectable lithographs (art prints).

title: Grisaia: Chronos Rebellion
description: The newest installment in the Grisaia visual novel series. All of the girls from Mihama, past and present, must face off against a new evil terrorist organization in an all-out war.

title: Emerald Wasp
description:
Operation Rassvet was a model of surprise.

It started as an intelligence operation and ended up becoming one of the most mysterious disappearences to these days. None of the members were found. Forgotten by the world, the last survivor is hiding in the shadows...

title: Oddrietta
description: 3 days ago, 22 year old Henrietta was getting ready for work when she received a message from her mother: "Don't go out, the wind is changing people...". A mysterious wind appeared out of nowhere and if someone listens to it, they start to change: some get holes and pimples all over their body, some become grotesque abominations. Henrietta became deaf after a car accident 9 years ago, so she isn't affected by the wind... but she can't stay home forever. What's going on out there? What is that wind? Is Henrietta's mother okay?

title: Mungyodance
description: Mungyodance is the first game in the Mungyodance series. It is a rhythm game that features 167 songs, and has an overall simpler feel than the two succeeding games in the series.

title: Mungyodance 2
description: Mungyodance 2 is the second entry in the Mungyodance series. The game include almost every song from the first game, with an additional 295 new songs.

title: Mungyodance 3: The Third Rave
description: Mungyodance 3: The Third Rave is the final entry in the Mungyodance series. The game features over 780 songs, including some from previous games.

title: Mungyodance Final
description: Mungyodance Final is a cancelled forth entry in the Mungyodance series. The game was teased on Twitter by Emma Essex in 2013 and was later confirmed cancelled in a 2015 post on her Reddit.

title: Speed Demons
description:
Speed Demons is a racing video game released in 1999. The game was developed and published by Microïds.

The game has 6 vehicles with possible localised damage, with three possible points of view. The game can be played as single player, 2 player split-screen, or by up to 6 players on a network. There are 10 circuits in varying locations, such as American motorways, on the sides of a volcano during its eruption and snow-covered ski slopes.

title: Flif
description:
Baby angels save the world from drought! Bonky glidey flappy physics platforming! Explore clouds & sky ruins & collect raindrops!

Commissioned for Indiepocalypse #38.

title: Notes of Hearts
description: In a world of fantasy and magic, you are a rising strategician unraveling the mysterious magical events occurring all over the world. You are free to choose your gender as well as your species, which ranges from Human, Canine, Feline, Avian, Dragon and Fae. You will meet many characters, most of which anthropomorphic in your adventure who you may befriend or seek a deeper connection with. There are multiple romance options not bound by species or gender.

title: Black, White and Grey
description: Paige, a girl currently attending university in her hometown, discovers that someone has been following her. Strange noises come from around the house at night, and it seems that danger is near. Everyone's trying to keep their secrets, but circumstances force them to reveal more and more. Who will prevail in the end? It's all up to you.

title: Crap Game Compilation 2
description:
“Crappy games are better when they're all in one place.”
A compilation of flash games by JonBro originally on Newgrounds

title: The Riftbreaker: Into The Dark
description: Explore an entirely new area of Galatea 37 in this Story Campaign expansion for The Riftbreaker. Catalog new species. Craft new and unique weapons. Fight hordes of aliens, unlike anything you've seen before.

title: Drainscape
description: Drainscape is a vertical action adventure with roguelite elements, where you must survive your fall through a drain filled with obstacles and enemies with only an umbrella to save you.

title: The Lost & Forgotten
description:
There are cases of disappearances around him.

People will forget about someone, forget their name, and then their existence will be forgotten. That person will disappear. They are 'lost'.

Nikk, a sixth-grader, has a father who locked him up at home after school. He despised him. He thought that there were people that should just disappear.

And if there's someone that he doesn't want to disappear from the world, it's his dear friend, Rea.

title: Slime Roll
description:
Our game, developed for the Mini Jam, embraces the theme of Fusion and incorporates the required limitation of "Control the Environment." In this fast-paced and creative adventure, players will dive into a world where the fusion of objects and abilities takes center stage.

As the player explores various levels, they will encounter unique objects and elements that can be fused together to create powerful synergies. With the ability to control the environment, players can manipulate and combine these objects to overcome obstacles and navigate through challenging puzzles.

To navigate the game world, players will utilize the classic WASD controls for movement, providing a smooth and intuitive experience. Additionally, they will harness the power of fusion through the use of special abilities. Pressing the spacebar allows the character to perform a dynamic jump, while the Q key activates a heavy ability with tremendous impact. For explosive situations, players can unleash the fused power by pressing the E key.

Our game truly embodies the theme of Fusion by emphasizing the combination of objects and abilities to overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. With the limitation of "Control the Environment," players are encouraged to think creatively and strategically to manipulate their surroundings and forge their path to victory.

Join us in this thrilling adventure, where fusion and environmental control are the keys to success. Can you master the art of fusion and conquer the challenges that lie ahead? Get ready to experience a game that pushes the boundaries of creativity and control in the Mini Jam!

title: The Garden of Banan
description: Little Timmy has found himself lost at his kindergarten I mean preschool. You must find Little Timmy before he- well, dies I guess? Just find your kid man idk

title: Akahane Academy
description:
It's back to school after the break!! Your club leader is acting stranger than usual? The teacher is going crazy, and three new boys who are dying to meet you!!

Well, the teacher is always like that... But why is everyone being so weird today?!

These new boys seem to like you...
And by like, I mean it.

title: Spirits Mirror​:​ Digital Possessed
description:
A spirit reflects
The visions you see
Shifting divisions
Between you & me

title: Terrapy
description: Terrapy introduces the player to the complexity of caring for houseplants. Each plant requires its own unique accommodations and will react accordingly to the player’s selections. As is such when caring for each other, Terrapy illustrates the costs and benefits of personal choice and free will within a wholesome environment, integrating horticulture to nurture empathy and growth.

title: Yoshi's Island PC
description: Yoshi's Island PC is a fan made 2D platformer based on the Yoshi's Island series that was released on Mario Fan Games Galaxy by Emma Essex in the early 2000s and later rereleased in the Early 2000s FANGAME HELL collection.

title: Cyber Soldier
description: Fast-paced competitive online multiplayer and offline survival mode, guns and overpowered skills, you and getting cash!

title: Stray Doom
description: Stray's cat rips and tears through demonic hordes in brilliant upcoming Doom mod This mod lets you play as the cat from Stray in the original Doom, and you can shoot your way through the game as the cat. But not only that, but you will be playing in third-person.

title: Escape From Russia: Mobilization
description: Originally russian runner, in which you have to find yourself in the shoes of a poor piglet, running away from the military commissar with a agenda.

title: Tribute
description: A narrative-driven exploration game where your choices shape the outcome as you traverse an ancient temple and confront the fate of an Old God's eternal slumber.

title: TimeQuake
description: Time is your weapon in this online PVP first-person team shooter. Opposing factions bend time to take out opponents, complete objectives and dominate the battlefield.

title: ReplaceR
description: It's a 2D action shooting adventure game where you switch between multiple guns and use interchangeable gimmicks to try to break through the stages! What awaits you in a mysterious facility in a corner of the universe?

title: O Jardim Magico 3
description: The magic class helps to consolidate the knowledge acquired in School in a fun way. Facilitates learning and prepares the child for new challenges. Portuguese Language, Mathematics, Fun holidays, Junior Graphics, and Who knows, knows!, Recess.

title: Insert Title Here
description: This "game" hasn't got any story or plot, any characters, any enemies ... "Insert Title Here" is an interactive experiment in which you will decide what path to choose, how to react ... something innovative which is always nice to try. This experiment will play with you, "talk" with you and put you into a mix of various game genres.

title: Witch Trainer
description: Miss Granger has become a headache for Professor Snapes, and next to this one you will try to "put in waist" to this one, developing not only his personal growth but also affecting other characters such as Snapes, Harry or Ginny, although these are only mentioned.​

title: Muppets Sorting and Ordering
description: Sorting & Ordering is a Muppet Kids CD-Rom game produced by Brighter Child in 1997. This game is volume 6 in the Muppet Kids Reading and Thinking Series.

title: Become A History Explorer
description: My First Amazing History Explorer (aka Tidsmaskinen, Become a History Explorer) is a video game published in 1998 on Windows by DK Multimedia, Norstedts Rabén Multimedia. It's an educational game, set in a history and fantasy themes.

title: Become A science Explorer
description: Become A Science Explorer involves 8 different activities, 20 experiments to print off and try, brilliant graphics and 8 fun worksheets! You can also take the ultimate science test in the Bright Sparks Quiz!

title: Hugo: The Magic Oak
description:
Hugo: The Magic Oak or The Magic Oak is a 1998 video game developed and published by ITE Media for the PC as part of the "Play and Learn" series. It was titled Den Fortryllede Eg / Hugo: Leg Og Lær 1 in Denmark, Tajemný les (Mystic forest) in Czechia, Taikatammi in Finland, Die Zaubereiche in Germany, Zaczarowany dąb in Poland, and Кузя и его друзья: Волшебное дерево (Kuzya and friends: The magic tree) in Russia.

Originally released on 1 June 1998, the game was re-released on 21 April 2005 as Hugo Gold III in Germany. It was also re-released as part of the compilations Hugo 2 in 1 and Hugo - Sonderpaket 1 (with a beach wristwatch) together with Wild River in 1999 in Germany, Hugo: Birthday Party in 2000, and in the Best of Hugo series with Hugo Classic #1 (Hugo) in Denmark.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Yajilin
description: Draw lines through the centers of cells to make a loop, and paint cells black in this original Nikoli puzzle. It's immensely satisfying to see how the lines and black cells all come together to form a solution, and figuring out how to draw the loop isn't as easy as it might seem.

title: Sweet Dreams
description: Light hurt his eyes, use that to your advantage and keep him away. Learn the different points where the creature can enter to be prepared. Sound will give you clues to the creature's arrival. Keep your flashlight charged up. Every night the creature will try new ways to trap you.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate
description: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate is a DLC for The Elder Scrolls Online. It is the 29th DLC released for the game and continues the year-long Shadow Over Morrowind adventure along with Update 37. Its release date is March 13th, 2023 for PC and Mac, and March 28th, 2023 for Xbox and PlayStation.

title: I'll Invaligate your Aid
description: A short game where the antagonist is a lovely girl that doesn't want you to play.

title: Project: Playtime - Phase 2: Incineration
description: Phase 2 is finally here! The horrors continue with an all-new map along with a host of new terrifying monster skins, and intricate survivor skins. Phase 2 also expands on gameplay with new puzzles, a UI overhaul, and a slough of quality of life upgrades.

title: Letter To A Friend
description: Letter To A Friend is a short first-person experience by Christoph Frey about the unspeakable horror that creeps up on you at a nightly train station. Its visual references come from expressionistic silent movies and old analog recordings. The game was made in 48 hours during Asylum Jam 2015 and is a proof of concept regarding the visual aesthetics and atmosphere.

title: Vivitter for Nintendo Switch
description: Who's the Chicken?! Introducing a party game that measures your fear level! Online battles for up to 10 players! More than 30 mini-games to test your courage!

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged
description: The world’s raddest cars are back and taking the fun to the next level! Race over 130 vehicles with crazy new mechanics and even more vehicle types. Plus, build your tracks with stunning new environments and different game modes to have fun off and online!

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibugawa Ryousuke Jiken-bo vol.11 - Ane no Kabe
description: "Anesama" is there. What do the silent walls and folklore tell us?

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-bo vol.12 - Nakanai Irainjin
description: Their cries reach no one. In a distorted cage, they quietly await the hand of salvation.

title: Minecraft: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Experience a dramatic tale unfold with Minecraft's Dungeons & Dragons DLC. Explore iconic locations in the Forgotten Realms like Icewind Dale and Candlekeep, battling Beholders, Mimics, and more. Choose your class, unlock classic spells, and ace ability checks to escape sticky situations. Your story awaits!

title: Telenet Shooting Collection
description:
Welcome to Shooter's paradise.
Telenet Japan Wolf Team's greatest hits return!

title: Sneaky Monsters
description: Tower Defense with unusual mechanics, where the AI sends the most inconvenient monsters and you have to constantly sell and rebuild towers.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Season 4 - Critical Corruption
description: Welcome to Season 4 - Critical Corruption! Though we have gained great ground against the rampaging Lithophage in the past months, it remains a constant threat- and to make matters worse, reports of alarming new mutations are starting to come in. Let's get right into it!

title: Voxel Doom
description: A mod that replaces 2d characters and props from Doom with fully 3d voxel-based models. For the GZDoom source port.

title: National Videogame Museum
description: This WAD is a near 1:1 recreation of the National Videogame Museum located in Frisco, Texas!

title: Dimension of the Boomed
description: Dimension of the Boomed combines resources, monsters, and aesthetics from Quake with frenetic Doom gameplay to achieve its own unique style. Quake fans will recognise homages to some iconic set pieces, but the majority of the mapset is original content.
