description: Experience an alternative reality where ancient Egyptians have become a space travel civilization. Fly an Egyptian-themed space ship through an asteroid field, avoiding collisions with objects that bend the fabric of time-space. How far can you go in this endless runner game?

title: Another Chance
description: Another Chance is an isometric, story driven experience which pits you in the midst of an alien apocalypse. Split apart by your wife, your only objective is reuniting with her...or is it?

title: Xochi's Apothecary
description: A deceptively cozy narrative game about an alchemist that immigrates to a new country and opens an apothecary. Get to know your weird and wonderful community, brew the potions your customers need, and use your words to stir up a country on the brink of change.

title: Wyrd Gun
description: A roguelite looter shooter about breeding guns and leveling up to survive hoards of creatures on a strange planet!

title: Hearthkeeper
description: Hearthkeeper is a fantasy colony simulator, with rpg and platformer elements. Your characters will require food, water and shelter as the seasons change and the world turns. Plant crops, build structures, defend against raiders and beasts, research technologies and much more.

title: Marine Glory
description: Marine Glory is a single player sailing looting adventure. Find treasures, buy and upgrade new ships and explore multiple universes.

title: Dreaming Diorama
description: A unique casual puzzle game where you create a variety of dioramas. Explore and assemble dioramas in a 3D environment. Enjoy relaxing gameplay that allows you to create dioramas at your own pace with no time restraints.

title: Mr. Mookie and the Runaway Cookie
description: Help Mr. Mookie retrieve his giant cookie in this adorable puzzle-platformer! Glide through the clouds, explore alien lands, and solve complex puzzles to get the cookie and dip it in milk.

title: Hainya World
description: You are an adventurer, you need to explore this continent, make good use of the resources of this continent to arm yourself, explore this world full of monsters and unknown things and survive!

title: Falling Down
description: The main character must find all six pieces to repair the spaceship in order to continue the journey. Obtaining the six pieces requires navigating through challenging stories and making difficult decisions involving the people on this planet.

title: Chrono Crystal: Factory DLC
description: Chrono Crystal is a tower defense game. Spanning across 5 major regions with the Prince and facing numerous challenges, an unprecedented great war is about to break out. Build your towers, upgrade your heroes, and defend your crystal against waves of enemies—until the countdown timer runs out!

title: Live at Strummer's Pond
description: Come for a visit to Strummer's Pond with your friends! It's a cozy place full of tiny musical critters. Explore, ride a frog, pollinate flowers, and play some tunes along the way. ✨

title: Mortal Kombat: Defenders of The Realm
description: This is a Mortal Kombat fan game made with OpenBor.

title: Kaardik
description: Join the exciting world of Kaardik, a creature collection game. Embark on exciting adventures with your Kaardiks in the fascinating region of Kodumaa. Capture all the Kaardiks, battle with other trainers, and beat the king.

title: Burger Zombies
description: A top down free roaming shooter where you play as a burger delivery man who is completing his orders during the zombie apocalypse. Pick up and deliver orders while shooting and driving against a ever growing horde of zombies.

title: Machi: Above the Void
description: Is a captivating voxel-style indie puzzle game set in Japan style. Immerse yourself in its mesmerizing atmosphere, solve puzzles, and enjoy relaxing Asian-inspired music. Compete in multiplayer, climb leaderboards, and unlock achievements. A captivating journey of tranquillity and challenge awaits.

title: Silent Shores
description: Silent Shores is a first-person open world horror game where you play as a father searching for his missing son on an abandoned island.

title: Fall into Decay
description: A girl named Celica woke up in a strange mansion one day. She seemed to have forgotten something important... But her first goal was to find a way to escape from here.

title: Rise for the Fight
description: A Cartoon Multiplayer FPS Game, where you can upgrade your guns by dealing damage or gaining multikills.

title: Queen of Moths
description: It's a winter night. You are coming home by train. You have to change trains at a small train station in the middle of the forest.It's not the first time you've traveled this route. But now you feel like something is different. As if something was watching you.

title: Project Hunt
description: A casual-friendly hunting game that focuses on fun, punchy shooting rather than hardcore simulation. Track animals, line up the perfect shot, and inspect every hit on detailed animal models.

title: Blind Frontiers
description: Embark on an RPG-survival road trip adventure with Niuma, a unique and singular character on a quest to uncover The Eldorado. Navigate through a post-war world marked by limited resources. Explore cities, interact with locals, and manage resources while confronting your stigmas to survive.

title: Pipelinks
description: Welcome to Pipelinks, a 2D tile-based puzzle game where you'll use your problem-solving skills to connect a variety of pipe creatures and help them navigate challenging levels!

title: Riddle for your Life
description: Do you have what it takes to solve all riddles? Your life may depend on it. The stakes are high. Winning grants you a powerful reward, losing means certain death. Are you brave enough to play the odds?

title: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency
description: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency is a fun multiplayer horror game in which you and co-players have to investigate unique horror cases. Among finding victims and evidence of the horror event that has taken place, you will be faced with jumpscares and scary monsters along your investigation.

title: Invaders from the Third Dimension
description: A retro space game with 3D graphics and modern controls. Rotate your ship and shoot at any angle, instead of just sliding back and forth. Enjoy 3D graphics with lighting effects and realistic explosions.

title: TD Royale
description: TD Royale is a real-time multiplayer tower defense where you summon enemies for your opponents. Balance economy and offense without letting your own defenses fail in order to outwit your enemy and be the last summoner standing!

title: Galactic Grinder
description: Rider, skateboarder extraordinaire, is about to embark on a journey across the solar system after a catastrophic event sets him on a course to save us all.

title: Doppelganger: Nightmare Realm
description: This is a dark story about a little boy trying to survive in a parallel world of his doppelganger. You will have to experience adventures in places of life and death of your doppelganger, solve all the puzzles, and make your way from the cemetery to birth.

title: Trash of the Titans
description: It's turn-based fantasy combat with trash animals. Defend your trash from invading vermin, and use your trash to upgrade your team. Think your way out of ruin by using the shape of each level to your advantage. Be creative, and try to not die.

title: Jack Holmes: Master of Puppets
description: Survival Horror in first person where you must manage your ammunition well, explore varied scenarios and face nightmarish beings, while investigating the macabre experiments with children, the result of a mind unhinged by madness and family loss.

title: Wholesome: Heartdrawn
description: Wholesome: Heartdrawn is a Turn-Based RPG and adventure game about Lyra, who creates her world to imagine her memories to escape from some things. Explore real and imagined worlds, and go on adventures. Lead Lyra and help her handle everything.

title: Daedalus: You Have Been Chosen
description: Go on a scary adventure, whether you decide to face the dangerous path alone or team up with your friends. This intense game guarantees a mysterious experience every time you play. Get ready to solve tricky puzzles, avoid a terrifying monster, and fight your way out of the intricate maze.

title: Card Detective
description: "Card Detective" is a unique single-player card game that combines card gameplay, deduction, collection, and educational elements. The game features an engaging storyline and innovative gameplay.

title: Cybergrid Runner
description: This is a stealth puzzle game set in a cyber city. Help the hacker infiltrate the system by manipulating the intricate 5x5 tile system. Collect powerful implant upgrades and weapons. Brace yourself for endlessly thrilling playthroughs, as each session unveils procedurally generated labyrinth.

title: Will You Wheel?
description: Transform your rusty vehicle into a powerful race car by skillfully installing various parts. Engage in a variety of money-making activities such as woodcutting, nocturnal racing, or pizza delivery. Perhaps you're interested in managing a workshop for yourself? The possibilities are endless!

title: Mars Survivors
description: Ready to tackle the challenge? On Mars, confront countless mutated creatures and mechanical monsters. Choose survivors, weapons, and skills wisely for diverse battles. Employ precise shooting, agile dodging, and strategic use of props and skills to fend off enemy attacks.

title: A Deep Rest
description: A Deep Rest is a collection of short stories about men and their relationship with mental health and depression. Taking control of a different character in each story, you will experience life from their perspective. See the problems and issues they face and help them find ways to be alright again.

title: Stars, Stripes, and Subgames
description: Immerse yourself in a world of captivating and diverse subgames, inspired by the essence of America.

title: Angel Legion: Lil Lily - Green
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Haunted Memories: The Return
description: Haunted Memories: The Return is a psychological horror in which you assume the role of yourself. You decide which path you will take and what will happen in Green Park this time. But the question remains - will you ever be able to leave?

title: A Date with Death
description: Fight against and romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a chat simulator visual novel where you date the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through fully voiced video calls.

title: Drug Lord Tycoon
description: Start from nothing and rise to the top as you expand your criminal empire in Drug Lord Tycoon.

title: Unmanned: Midnight Nightmare
description: Welcome to Megan’s Mall, the place where dreams come true! It’s your first day on the job as a security guard, and it’s going to be an experience you’ll never forget.

title: Sender
description: The winds of the frozen wasteland are calling in this atmospheric horror game. Operate an aging vehicle to locate the missing driver of the previous expedition. Be careful not to stray from the path...

title: Survivter
description: Survivter is a roguelike first-person shooter where you no longer have to press a button to make your weapon fire, it shoots itself as long as there are enemies in the room. The gameplay consists of dodging enemies and upgrade character.

title: King Story: Prologue
description: A storm of darkness is taking over the world. Adventure in search of your quest escaping the demon darkness that chases you. Upgrade your items to progress through the maze like environment in this Metroidvania-like challenge. Can you find a Hermit's lost son in your quest to save the world?

title: Scroomage
description: Destroy property, kill companies, run fast, and punch opposing workers in this fast-paced first person shooter.

title: Dollar
description: This dollar is an excellent steam inventory item based on a real life currency item of the same name. Every hour you will receive a dollar, with a very small chance to receive the golden dollar. Good Luck!

title: Quintus and the Formidable Curse
description: ‘Quintus and the Formidable Curse’ is a Horror-Adventure game with a difference; the protagonists are a Man and Mouse duo!

title: Bucky's Grounds
description: Bucky's Grounds is a first-person Retro style mascot horror game, where you uncover the dark truth of a mysterious town within another dimension, visit the Khancoban playground while avoiding the sweet toothed rabbit who despises yellow light.

title: Append
description: Destroy friends or strangers in this online multiplayer bullet heaven/hell shooter. Collect powerups, combine weapons, build your defenses and obliterate the opposition. Hundreds of weapon combinations and multiple game modes.

title: Straftat
description: Straftat is a 1v1/2v2 online first person shooter with quick rounds in over 350 maps. Including all weapons, proximity chat and 4 players FFA.

title: Clash of Stars
description: MMO Real-time strategy star game.

title: Welcome to Mars 9
description: Welcome to Mars 9: The Tale of River is an old-school graphic adventure about a person adrift in space, rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you will be drawn into a world of comfort and pleasure, only to soon discover that the station hides a dark secret.

title: Breaking Friendships
description: A relaxing social game for two people. Use the knowledge about your friend to generate electricity for time-traveling residents.

title: Gate One
description: Survive with your team as long as possible and discover different worlds with different loot.

title: TTA 1
description: Tower Test Area is a classical tower defense game with puzzle elements. Build towers to defend yourself against the attacking enemies. Can you beat every level on hard? How far can you get inside Monster Power?

title: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
description: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In: The Hotel Stories, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

title: Raw Nerve
description: Raw Nerve is an easy-to-play, hard-to-master driving sandbox set in a psychedelic galaxy. Take a casual rip or sprint to the summit for a top time. It’s one truckin' awesome ride.

title: Frontera
description: Frontera is a fantasy city builder and colony sim where you start with a small camp at the edge of a dark forest. Build up your settlement and economy to attract more settlers. Form a military to clear the forest, and claim it for yourself!

title: Cryptid
description: An intentionally unbalanced Balatro mod.

title: This Grand Life 2
description: A money-focused life simulator. Create characters with allergies and addictions. Manage their lives through financial booms and busts. Advance their careers, start a small business, invest in real estate and stocks - or roleplay a penniless hobo.

title: Symphony of Souls
description: Save your beloved from the clutches of the God of the Dead! Symphony of Souls is a rhythm-based platformer about the Greek myth of Orpheus. Traverse the Underworld attempting to reach your goal to the beats of the music. Your performance also affects it, unlocking more elements the better you play!

title: Terminate: Study X
description: Become the machine, find out what happened in New Sapiens and eradicate the infected in a single player first-person shooter campaign of horror and gore.

title: Choice of Life: Wild Islands
description: Conquer the jungle and prove that in any situation you - the master of your destiny!

title: Dimhaven: The Lost Source
description: After several years, the team behind Quern - Undying Thoughts is back with new mysteries to unfold. Explore Dimhaven, solve mind-bending puzzles and uncover the truth behind the Ravenwood legacy in this first-person adventure.

title: Golf: Hole in One
description: Score in just one stroke in this singleplayer, minimalist golf puzzle game. You don't need friends or the internet, just play and relax with anytime with the game!

title: Exterminators of Saturn
description: A top down, twin stick shooter inspired by classic retro arcade games with loads of enemies, fast paced bullet hell combat, big boss battles and tons of weapon customizations.

title: Treasure Hunter: History of Monastery Gold
description: Treasure Hunter is a Metal Detecting Simulator, with lots of humorous quests and exciting storyline based on true event. With 250 thousand findings on the map and big open world.

title: A Shadow Cast on Water
description: Set in 1920s Arkham, you play as a private investigator trying to solve a mysterious case. Can you uncover the conspiracy that's befalling the city?

title: Novus Orbis
description: A combo-based deckbuilding roguelike through a space-time loop: collect cards, receive blessings, add pets to your party, and grow stronger. Chain together cards in the right order for max power, and act before the enemy does. Build synergistic decks, find many secrets, and make BIG numbers!

title: Predefined
description: Predefined is a 3D puzzle game where planning is key. Navigate a burrow through levels filled with puzzles and obstacles. Enjoy Twitch Integration for interactive gameplay and community collaboration.

title: Simply Cubic
description: Draw a route to where you want to the black cube to go. Take care to draw by anticipating what may happen after starting the route. Remember, your right to draw a route is limited. Make good use of these rights!

title: Kromlech
description: Embark on a journey in this dark fantasy action-adventure game to find out why the tapestry of the world is suddenly unraveling itself and even the gods themselves seem powerless to stop it. Sharpen your blade, gather your companions, and prepare to make the last stand as the world around you burns.

title: Desktop Mark
description: Desktop Mark is a simple minigame-centric idler revolving around the goofy character of Mark, a smiley that bounces all around your screen. Every so often, Mark hits the corner and prompts you to procrastinate & have some fun with Mark.

title: Cursed Bet
description: Cursed Bet is a horror game where you play from a body camera perspective. Tackle a cursed doll as you delve into the creepy story of the abandoned preschool you entered to record a videos for a bet.

title: Blinding Oversight
description: You play as Emma, who wakes up in an abandoned house without any prior memory of how she ended up there. Investigate your surroundings, uncover the mysteries of the house and connect memories from your past in this first person atmospheric horror game.

title: Settlemoon
description: After the moon vanished, the fantasy game world of Settlemoon lays abandoned in darkness. Re-light the skies, provide rest and resources for travelling adventurers, and piece together what happened to the world.

title: The Isolated Town
description: Shoot down enemies and avoid danger in an attempt to save your new friends on a grand adventure!

title: Veiled Edge
description: Veiled Edge is a dynamic cyberpunk action-adventure platformer featuring multi-genre gameplay and innovative hacking mechanics. Dive, hack, and adapt your abilities to uncover the secrets of Full-Dive technology in a thrilling journey through virtual worlds.

title: The Cannon Fighters
description: The Cannon Fighters is an action game with fully destructible environments. Experience loads of fun alone or with friends! Randomly generated levels in various environments await you for even greater entertainment. Gain experience and show that you belong among the best!

title: Chronautical
description: In this narrative-driven sci-fi mystery, investigate across space and time to uncover clues and unravel the secrets of a star system that has disappeared, and the man trying to find it.

title: Overhours
description: From building makeshift traps, to defending her new friends from danger and taking back precious time. Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a dystopian media agency that steals time. One employee, together with an unexpected ghostly partner, is trying to retrieve it all.

title: Aquarium Designer: Amazonia
description: In Aquarium Designer: Amazonia DLC, you could create new or redecorate existing aquariums with new exotic items straight from one of the longest rivers, Amazon! Admire fish native to this region and watch them get along with the others!

title: Limit Choice
description: In this game, a wide variety of unique cards will make their appearance, each wielding diverse skills to support your battles. With every confrontation against enemies and overcoming of difficult trials, your deck evolves, gaining ever-increasing power.

title: Venus One: Galactic Overlords
description: Outwit or perish in VOGO, a thrilling turn-based strategy game. In every move, you have a chance to surround more territory and destroy more structures than your opponent. But be careful, because every move can also be a trap. Outsmart your rival and claim victory in VOGO!

title: StairCase 55
description: An atmospheric psychological horror game that plunges you into an anomalous, paradoxical stairwell. Equipped only with a flashlight, navigate through the abyss of the procedurally generated staircase, haunted by an ever-adapting presence. Unravel the mystery of SCP-087.

title: The Mildew Children
description: Featuring a blend of 2D adventure and visual novel, The Mildew Children is a grim tale about a village inhabited only by children who follow savage pagan traditions. A young witch named Kyrphel, along with her sisters, are bound to perform a macabre Ritual in order to save their village.

title: Emergency Room Simulator
description: In "Emergency Room Simulator" you become a dedicated doctor in the emergency room, responsible for diagnosing, treating, and saving lives. This professional simulation offers an immersive experience of the challenges and rewards of working in a fast-paced medical environment.

title: The Cursed Oasis
description: A relaxing first-person exploration game. Trapped in a mysterious, uninhabited oasis, you must follow the clues and break the curse before it's too late!

title: RoundRunners Playground
description: Play tag-like gamemodes with a chance of random effects to happen. Roll, climb and bunnyhop to dodge fellow roundrunners as you’re trying not to get tagged. Face up against your friends or randoms in this easy-to-pick-up game. Make the map your playground.

title: Sneaky Seekers
description: Sneak into the shadows and, using your pickaxe, try to find the treasure hidden around the map, but beware: you're not alone, and your friends will do anything to get in your way! So be the smartest, and strike first.

title: Panel Rabbit
description: Flash! Puzzle Action！ Place the panels on the ground and Guide the rabbit safely to the goal!

title: Deep Blue Fantasy
description: Deep Blue Fantasy is a roguelike adventure game set in an underwater world. Collect weapons, recruit crew, hold the lucky dice in your hand, and embark on a journey into the unpredictable depths of the sea!

title: Neon Parkour 2
description: Control a blue cube and complete challenging trails and puzzles to reach the target! Red cubes that will destroy you the moment you touch them! Help the blue cube reach its destination in Neon Parkour, which has a minimal design. Jump, dash and swing to solve challenging trails!

title: Sakura in Paris
description: “Sakura in Paris” is a Romantic Comedy Visual Novel and Yuri Dating Sim. Play as Sakura Maeda as she travels to Paris, learns about her father and, if everything goes right, may fall in love with the woman of her dreams along the way.

title: Yume Memory
description: A relaxing Match Two Minigame featuring Anime Characters from the Works of Yume Creations.

title: Ramen Oil Pecking Simulator
description: Have you ever wanted to collect oil floating in a bowl of ramen by pulling it with chopsticks? This game will completely satisfy your desire to do so!

title: Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD
description: Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD is a roguelike tower defense game. You have one tower and a few skills that you must use wisely to fight off waves of ever-growing enemies. Choose from a variety of upgrades, and items to craft your unique and powerful builds.

title: Space Entity
description: Space Entity is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. A entity is within the space ship. Get the power back on and use the escape pods to live on.

title: Paragon Pioneers 2
description: Paragon Pioneers 2 is a city-building idle game in which you discover, conquer and then build on islands to fulfill the needs of your inhabitants. Even with limited time to play you can enjoy this deep simulation game and follow one of the countless ways to optimize your empire.

title: Monster Tiles TD
description: A unique roguelike tower defense game featuring epic battles between fierce (but cute!) monsters and medieval space pirates! Expand and defend your base by choosing where to place a new randomly generated path tile after each wave. Strategy and planning is key, but every game is different!

title: Zero Below the Sun
description: Classic survival horror reimagined with a retro look and modern feel, set in a top secret underground research facility in Antarctica.

title: Rescue Contest
description: The circus gained popularity with impressive acts, like turning pigs into barbecue, captivating and attracting large crowds. However, due to financial crisis, the circus had to close and the director decided to sell the animals.

title: Cursorblade
description: Cursorblade is an action arcade game where you play as a cursor that fights your way through waves of enemies. Combine weapons and items to be more powerful with your own unique builds. Slash, dodge, upgrade and repeat!

title: Forsaken Quartet
description: Humanity has gone nearly extinct. Only four humans remain—two men and two women, desperate to survive on a floating island. As they spend more time together, arguments on how to move forward threaten to drive the four of them apart.

title: A Bad Day for a Hangover
description: You awaken with the worst of hangovers in a nuclear bunker with supplies running low, the only chance of survival is to scavenge for tinned goods in the robot infested nuclear wasteland above before the town is nuked again

title: 52 / 0 = Infinity
description: This is a visual novel. The theme at the center of the story is what consciousness is. Your task in the game is to understand the essence of being. The main character is a successful, intelligent man who designs humanoid robots. He tries to understand if robots have consciousness.

title: Feeble Light
description: Blast off as a little star trying to rid the cosmos of angry celestial beings in Feeble Light, a 3-tone pixel art shoot’em up where minimalistic presentation makes way for precision controls and fluid animation!

title: Fear of Neighbours
description: Fear of Neighbours is a psychological horror game that puts you in the shoes of a resident in a quiet Finnish neighbourhood.

title: Azoove
description: Adventure with friends in this co-op card roguelike, bravely crossing the dangerous Azoove desert. Manage resources and communicate effectively to survive the journey and return the cursed book to the Library. Strategize and make it there in time to seal the evil fiend Ur'gan!

title: Survivor's guilt
description: A great earthquake with a magnitude of 9.2 occurred. The day when rescue arrives is unknown. Make full use of your smart phone and the supplies you have left, and continue to fight against the hunger and fear that is attacking you.

title: Kiss Before Midnight
description:
This dating simulation revolves around a group of nine people whose stories are all intertwined in the city of love, Paris. Paul has returned to his friends Amelie and Ricky after one year of studying in Berlin, and is thrilled to see his old crush Devine again, although he's less thrilled about her getting married to macho Vincent in a few days. Ricky is interested in Luca, the red-haired waitress at the clique's favorite café, while Amelie would like to get closer to her former professor Marcel Benoît. Amelie's fashion-conscious and manipulative twin sister Estelle and flower girl Marie will also play their part.

Taking control of these characters throughout 15 episodes, players influence the relationships between them, mainly by choosing what they say in conversations. Some characters occasionally have to be dressed for a specific event in a mini game, while a second, more frequent mini game allows characters to tip the mood or topic of a conversation in their favor by using cards representing certain gestures. In the end, the player's actions through all episodes will determine who hooks up with whom.

title: Chicken Brother
description: Exploring in the huge sinkhole, you can transform from a chicken to a muscle man, by jumping, gliding and climbing from the bottom of the sinkhole to the outside world.

title: Leaf Fragments
description: A war chess game that showcases the differences in the systems of different countries.

title: Angel Link
description: Angel Li is a Flash game featuring matching. Connect identical cards to eliminate them. The operation is easy. Elements of beautiful girls enhance the adventure in a different world.

title: Anti Japanese Heroes
description: This is a horizontal action game with 6 optional characters, including Farmer, Martial Monk, Qigong Master, Eighth Route, Secret Service, and King of Slingshot. Faced with countless invaders, can you kill all the enemies or end the game?

title: Circle Killer
description: play the role of "circle" to avoid incoming blocks with rhythmic music now have two different levels Fall Level: Accompanied by dynamic music you will move freely around the area, avoiding falling blocks Traversal Level: You will continue traversing a section of road with rhythmic music

title: Journey to the West Survivor
description: "Survivor of Journey to the West" is a journey to the West fairy theme of relaxed, happy, survival rogue, survivor like games. You can choose from 12 characters of varying abilities, and you can combine various gameplay and genres in over 200 massive skills and resonances

title: Love Yuri
description: Shu Yu, a popular writer, became sisters with Lu Xi, an online voice actress. But when Lu Xi accidentally discovers that her favorite yuri author is actually her sister Shu Yu, she becomes increasingly attracted to Shu Yu's personality and a forbidden romance gradually unfolds between them...

title: Anata ga Ookami Card Death!
description: Accuse and execute the owner of the werewolf card. It's a 5-minute round of a repeated death game in the werewolf genre.

title: Zeta Leporis RTS
description: A sci-fi real-time strategy game. An existential war among asteroids in classic RTS style. Build and defend, produce and upgrade, attack and annihilate!

title: Zombie Survival Game Online
description: In ZSGO, you and your fellow survivors wield the ingenuity, firepower, and courage to navigate a post-apocalyptic world crawling with the living dead. Treacherous landscapes, hidden resources, and untold stories waiting to be discovered! But remember, you are never safe – stay vigilant and keep your guard up, or risk being consumed by the horrors of ZSGO… Can you survive our experience? Craft your story today!

title: Trainz Plus: Yellowstone Mountain & Central Railroad
description: Set in the Yellowstone Mountains of Wyoming, this 55km long route offers a range of operations, including coal, iron ore, limestone, and steel. Complete with four sessions and a multiplayer session, there is plenty to explore on this route.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: Yellowstone Mountain & Central Railroad
description: Set in the Yellowstone Mountains of Wyoming, this 55km long route offers a range of operations, including coal, iron ore, limestone, and steel. Complete with four sessions and a multiplayer session, there is plenty to explore on this route.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Yellowstone Mountain & Central Railroad
description: Set in the Yellowstone Mountains of Wyoming, this 55km long route offers a range of operations, including coal, iron ore, limestone, and steel. Complete with four sessions and a multiplayer session, there is plenty to explore on this route.

title: Chrono Crystal: Hubert
description: Chrono Crystal is a tower defense game. Spanning across 5 major regions with the Prince and facing numerous challenges, an unprecedented great war is about to break out. Build your towers, upgrade your heroes, and defend your crystal against waves of enemies—until the countdown timer runs out!

title: Chrono Crystal: Archie
description: Chrono Crystal is a tower defense game. Spanning across 5 major regions with the Prince and facing numerous challenges, an unprecedented great war is about to break out. Build your towers, upgrade your heroes, and defend your crystal against waves of enemies—until the countdown timer runs out!

title: Autobahn Police Simulator 3: Off-Road DLC
description: Your shift in Autobahn Police Simulator 3 continues - with the new „Off-Road“ DLC!

title: Mortal Kombat Project
description: A Mortal Kombat fan game made on Mugen.

title: Escape from the Room with my Kouhai
description:
Escape from the Room with my Kōhai Game is an escape game based on the Don't Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro series. The game was made by the original author Nanashi in RPG Maker and released on Pixiv, just one year prior to the mangas official release date.
The game was also translated into English on July 21, 2018.

title: Semicolon Island
description: Semicolon Island is a multiplayer-focused sandbox building game, which aims to give its players large amounts of freedom to create anything their minds can come up with.

title: Solo Joe
description: A rock climbing rpg.

title: Phantom of Zana
description: Swing, dash, slide and slice your way through this retro style 2D side scrolling platformer! Blast, hack and slash your opponents or bounce off their heads! Power up Fantastic Fania to finally confront the Phantom of Zana!

title: Mage Kanade’s Futanari Dungeon Quest
description: Taking up a request to hunt demons, Mage Kanade arrives at a dungeon. However, she was turned into a futanari. In order to return safely from a dungeon full of milking traps, Kanade confronts the monsters…

title: Velberan In Miracle World
description: In this adventure, Velberan is in search of his dog Bolt. This game is a platformer inspired by the universe of Velberan.

title: Mood
description: This world has always been hostile to you. Human society disgusts you. MOOD - it is a dark visual novel where the player has to meet a cute girl and take a little walk with her. Nothing bad can happen, right?

title: Dobuki's Epic Journey
description: Embark on Dobuki's whimsical quest across three vibrant planets. Solve clever puzzles, battle quirky enemies, and save the galaxy from the clutches of Emperor Lik Wang in this charming blend of point-and-click adventure and RPG elements.

title: Aikagi Complete Box
description: Aikagi Complete Box is a bundle that includes Aikagi, Aikagi After Days, Aikagi 2 and Aikagi 3.

title: Minecraft: The Incredibles
description: Step into the boots of the Incredibles and dive mask first into a Supers playground! Suit up and play together as Mr. & Mrs. Incredible, Frozone, Violet & Dash to save Municiberg with their incredible powers. Explore the city, bring down the Omnidroid, battle The Underminer and stop Screenslaver's hypnotic schemes. Defeat them all to make Supers legal again!

title: My Little Sister's Special Place
description: Our hero used to go to Akiba a lot when he was younger. It wasn't to have fun, but for his little sister's sake. One day, his younger sister is gifted a Christmas trip, and they spend time together as if they're a couple. This is the delightful and touching love story of these two siblings.

title: Angry Birds Power Trouble
description: While the birds are sleeping, a pig wizard arrives and steals the bird's powers and their eggs too! While powerless, the flock must get their eggs and their powers back! Will they get their power's back, or will they be lost forever?

title: Arle's Travel Log
description: Released in Disc Station Vol 13, Arle's Travel Log is a text-adventure game where Arle is confronted by Satan on her way to magic school, who wants Carbuncle back. The three battling together accidentally cause them to be sent back in time, with Arle and Carbuncle looking for a way to return to the present. The gameplay consists of exploration similar to the Madou Monogatari series, along with elements of an adventure game. Arle can talk to characters she meets or can click on various items to progress the plot. Battles can also occur in-game, and are fought by using a click-and-point system. The game casts various Madou Monogatari and Disc Station characters as Japanese historical figures.

title: De Blob: Utrecht
description: A UFO is flying through space near Earth and Saturn, but it collides with an asteroid within the asteroid field. It crashes into the HQ of I.N.K.T. in Utrecht, but the occupant escapes the crash using a parachute. He is then surrounded by I.N.K.T. forces but tries to escape...

title: Rulue's Iron-Fist Spring Break
description:
Released in Vol 14, Rulue's Iron-Fist Spring Break is a visual novel starring Rulue. She is tasked to complete one of three objectives over her spring break: Find the five divine treasures, explore the "wonderful land," or gather ingredients for a recipe.

This game is mentioned, using the fan title of "Rulue's Spring Break of Fists", in Sega 3D Classics Collection's English-language manual for Puyo Puyo Tsu.

title: Puyoman-Eating Carbuncle
description: Released in Disc Station volume 14.

title: White-Hot Puyolympic!
description: White-Hot PuyoLympic is a sports game in which Arle and Witch battle in several varied events.

title: White-Hot! Puyolympic! in Bazaru
description: PuyoLympic in Basa~ru is an expansion of the Puyo Picking game featured in PuyoLympic.

title: Serilly's Happy Birthday
description: Released in Disc Station Vol 18, Serilly's Happy Birthday is a simulation game starring Serilly.

title: Madou Run
description: Released in Disc Station Vol 19, Madou Run is similar to the game of tag; players that obtain a bowl of curry have the ability to attack other players.

title: Groceries and JumpScares
description: Can you survive the horrors of retail? You are the newest "employee" under contract at the local Soke Co Groceries Store. Manage the amount of stock daily to try to satisfy the on slot of customers. Mark the price up on products to make more profit and buy more stock. All while quelling the hunger of the thing that lurks in the basement. Try to survive and remember the Soke Co Groceries motto. Try Not To Get Eaten!

title: Nikita: Speedy Pirates
description: Kart racer developed by Techland. Spin-off game featuring characters seen in Nikita: The Mystery of the Hidden Treasure.

title: Apricity
description: Apricity is a top-down shooter party game for 1-4 players. 11 character classes. Arcade-style gameplay with a text-adventure driven roguelike mode and a score attack endless mode.

title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
description: The PC-released version of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, a point and click adventure game unrelated to the 3D platformer released on console. SpongeBob and Patrick leave Bikini Bottom and journey to new and unexplored lands. Players join their struggle to defeat Plankton's diabolic scheme to take over the world...Plan Z! Plankton has stolen King Neptune's crown and assumed control of the town of Bikini Bottom, placing the blame squarely on Mr. Krabs. Together, SpongeBob and Patrick must journey to far away Shell City to recover the crown, return to Bikini Bottom and save the town and Mr. Krabs.

title: Fall Into Insanity
description: Fall Into Insanity is a First-Person Atmospheric Horror Game using the power of Unreal Engine 5. Your friends have gone missing under mysterious circumstances and it is up to you to find them. What you find, might just drive you to Insanity.

title: Eight Winds
description: A fast paced, highly technical 3D fighting game with an incredibly high skill ceiling and a large amount of freedom for self-expression

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Musu
description: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Musu takes place in the year 1996 during a short period of time on April 14th in Skinner's home within a residential neighborhood. The principal of Springfield Elementary School named Seymour Skinner, who lives on and owns his own home in the aforementioned peaceful neighbourhood, has invited Superintendent Chalmers to his home, to enjoy a home-cooked meal of his making. After Superintendent Chalmers arrives, something goes amiss, and things don't go according to plan. Will Seymour be able to salvage this meal as well as Chalmers's perception of him?

title: Comet Summoner Time Trial Version
description: Released in Disc Station Vol 22, Time Trial Version features additional levels.

title: Magic Battle Hasamuncho
description: Released in Disc Station Vol 22, Hasamuncho is a marble puzzle game. Players aim to capture the most marbles, with special powers being available to assist them.

title: Puyo Card
description: Released in Disc Station Vol 23, Puyo Card is a stacking card game. Players place cards onto the middle of the playfield; matching four of the same color will create a chain and damage the opponent.

title: Nawatobi suru Carbuncle
description: Released in Disc Station Volume 24.

title: Kaiten Puyoman Kuu Carbuncle
description: Released in Disc Station Volume 25.

title: Restaurant King
description: Restaurant King, released in Disc Station Vol 27 as Disc Station's final game, is a board game featuring Arle alongside several other Disc Station heroes.

title: Shuttlecock Carbuncle
description: Released in Disc Station in 1997.

title: The Stockpile
description: Preparing to move in with your new roommate, you have just a few last things before you can clear out the storage place you rented. While grabbing the last boxes, strange noises leave you wondering: is someone else with you?

title: Duke Burger
description: After saving mankind, Duke Nukem retired. He opened a little restaurant, Duke Burger. And now he is an honest businessman.

title: Refugee: The Second Hearing
description:
Asylum story...

You arrive naive and actually believing.

While they have number of awards from the LA city mayor private organization 'Program For Torture Victims' is no more than a group of Homeland Security employees, exchanging medical services for political opinions, making refugees lie in the court.

title: Beans or Bones
description: A fun 2-player online co-op pirate game for having a good time with your best buddy. Stranded on a cannibal island, your only chance of survival is to make the cannibals like veggie food. Go on quests, fly with birds, paddle in a barrel, and use your bubble shooter to fight sharks.

title: Fatpets
description:
Navigate adorable animals to their goals in Fatpets!
Solve engaging, physics-based puzzles with the strategic use of bubbles.
Easy to pick up, satisfying to master.

title: Hero Online
description: Hero Online is a fast-paced, free-to-play MMORPG from NetGame and MGame USA set in ancient China. It features colorful graphics and martial arts-style combat animations.

title: Wexew Mexem
description:
Wexew Mexem is a vertical scrolling shoot 'em up by Japanese developer Zakichi. It takes inspiration from games like Exed Exes and Xexex.

By activating "High Point Mode" when your energy is at full power, you can also destroy enemy bullets, turning enemies into bonus items.
If you press the mode activation button during "high point mode", you will return to normal mode at any time.

Your attack has a range, and if you move up, the range will be longer, and if you move down, the range will be shorter, but the power will be doubled.

title: Silver the Hedgehog: World's Collide
description: "Silver The Hedgehog: World's Collide" is a 2D fangame that revolves around the character, Silver the Hedgehog, inspired by the game "Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)". In this game you play as Silver the Hedgehog as you try to stop Eggman Nega from taking over the world by utilizing Silver's psychokinesis which you can control using your mouse or mouse pad. You must use Silver's psychokinetic powers to defeat enemies and move around platforms and other objects that will help you progress through the many different levels of the game.

title: Withering Way
description: Every thousand years the balance between order and chaos is lost, it is then that the gods choose one to return to the land of Wicklan and walk the Withering Way. You've been chosen to return to your body 68 years after your death to save the souls of those who condemned you to a fate they now face.

title: Wrong God
description: Wrong God is an action roguelike where you play as a demon summoned by mistake. Navigate randomly generated levels, face different enemies, and adapt to changing weapons every 5 seconds. Survive the catacombs and fix the cult's error.

title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Realm of Torment
description: Tricked by Winnie-the-Pooh, you must navigate a twisted maze filled with psychological tricks, demons, and sadistic challenges. Outsmart your tormentor, solve puzzles, and survive his pursuit. Reclaim your soul through multiple endings. Can you escape the clutches of this diabolical bear?

title: William and Sly
description: An open-world 3D platformer based on the popular William and Sly flash games. Explore a wild mountain landscape in search of mushrooms and untangle the magical machinations of a dark enchantress. Features fifteen new songs and over ten hours of gameplay!

title: Whispike Survivors: Sword of the Necromancer
description: Cultivate the strongest monster in this horde survivor farming game! Fight against waves of creatures to beef up your Whispike and use its seeds to create even stronger hybrids!

title: Water Defense
description: A strategy game that not only entertains, but also educates. Prevent pollution of natural resources with ACO products and score higher than others!

title: Voice: Legacy of Hale
description: Who will inherit the Hale family legacy?

title: Tri City Monsters
description: Tri City Monsters is a supernatural, monsterlovin' visual novel where you can romance and/or de-pants 3 demonic love interests. Navigate a dangerous urban jungle with their help and maybe you'll get a taste of what it means to be a monster.

title: Trauma Squad
description: Join the Trauma Squad and get rid of client's trauma deep inside! You will be the junior of the trauma care company. Meeting client's and talk with them, when you find out their trauma, you will get into their mind to release them from trauma. Take care and try not to be eaten by their trauma!

title: Turn By Turn Villain
description: Be the bad guy, do good: Play as a demon forced to walk the human world in this Turn-Based Action RPG! Engage your ex-minions in chaotic brawls! Choose your actions quickly from a classic menu but mind your Turn Points! Collect Light to dispel the darkness... your dark mess!

title: UWD: You Will Die!
description: You Will Die is a indie game survival shooter top-down with waves of zombies to kill.

title: Underdose
description: In a not-too-distant, retro-future world shaken by a shortage of medicine, a talented pharmacist is accused of murdering Patient Zero. He flees to the slums, where he tries to survive in isolation until he can recreate the formula for the drug that will save his life.

title: Tyrannis: Co-Prosperity
description: Tyrannis: Co-Prosperity is sequel to our first game Tyrannis, and it brings back the accessible turn-based asymmetric gameplay as you fight a massive megacorporation along the Pacific Rim. Battle the Kirihara Group's Security Division across 40 new maps and a brand new campaign mode!

title: Vaulted
description: Vaulted is a roguelike game that combines elements of top-down shooter, deckbuilder, RPG and immersive sim. Venture into randomly generated dungeons in search of resources and powerful equipment to ensure your settlement survives.

title: Vaporwave Pinball
description: Play LoFi digital pinball in a variety of cosy, chill locations. Explore a 90s operating system to find new worlds. Uncover hidden, corrupted files. For a couple of hours, escape the real world. Vaporwave Pinball is the ultimate "virtual holiday" destination.

title: Vilde
description: Vilde is a Norse myth-inspired roguelite FPS. Procedurally generated levels and RPG elements. Battle resurrected foes, earn boons, and permanently upgrade your character. Join 4-player co-op or play alone in a dark and epic world inspired by Norse mythology and Viking culture

title: Time Knight vs. Zombies
description: Help the knight close the time corridors and defeat the armies of extraterrestrial zombies to prevent them from taking control of the future in this fast-paced action and adventure game in a race against time !

title: Third World: The Bottom Dimension
description: Explore a fantastical world designed by visual artist Gabriel Massan & collaborators that draws on their experience of Brazil’s colonial legacy. This art-game is an experiment in non-linear storytelling and collaborative world-building that invites you to open your mind.

title: The Static
description:
we're not sure what the purpose of this is - if there needs to be a purpose. the image manifested itself and yearned for a husk, something to contain it and give it closure, but all we hear now is the static.

if there was an ending, we couldn't see its shape through the noise - but who is to tell if there ever was one.

title: The Endless Dream
description: Dive into an enigmatic world, solve captivating puzzles, and unravel the mysteries of an endless dream. Reconstruct a fragmented life as the line between reality and illusion blurs. Challenge your mind and uncover the hidden truth in a gripping adventure that will leave you amazed!

title: The Deadly Path
description: A building management, tower defense game set in an occult dungeon. Create your dungeon, defend against raides and build the idol in order to bring your dark lord into being and bring about the age of reckoning.

title: The Dark Tones: Loss
description: Sooner or later we all have to make a choice and live with it, are you ready to make your own in order to achieve the goal at any cost regardless of the consequences?

title: The Alpine Express
description: Experience the majestic Jungfrau summit in this short walking simulator.

title: Technophobia: Do Androids go to Heaven?
description: "Technophobia: DAgtH" is a Narrative FPS Adventure where you're tasked with rescuing FESAC Engineers kidnapped by terroristic androids in a dark forest, all while discussing the ethics of using androids and AI in our daily lives. Is AI truly better than humans?

title: Taste of Victory
description: An RTS that blends elements of MOBA and RPG, with a focus on action. Your soldiers will be the cornerstone of your economy. If you want to acquire resources to increase or improve your army, you'll have to conquer.

title: Tamer Vale
description: Tamer Vale is a turn based card battler, where a collective of Elven heroines, known as Tamers, journey forth beyond the safety of their hidden valley to find and confront the sources of corruption in the land, and bring balance to it using their special rituals!

title: Survival Sisters: 2048＋1
description: The popular 2048 puzzle Survival Sisters: 2048＋1 is now powered up and available as ""+1 (plus one)""! In a devastated world, the Sisters have returned from the depths of despair to cultivate the sustenance of life today......!

title: Survival Revelation: End of Days
description: Welcome to this multiplayer survival sandbox game! In this world, you will need to establish your own survival base from scratch, collect materials, make tools, build towns, manufacture weapons, explore unknown fields, and so on. You can team up with other players and survive together, as well as en

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Desert
description: Puzzles of desert!

title: Snotty's Sewer
description: Welcome to Mr Snotty's Sewer! Stealthy explore an abandoned sewer, collect items and activate the only escape in this small indie horror! Just don't get caught by Mr Snotty or any of his friends!

title: Spear Song
description: Add to the vishlist now! Spear Song is a turn-based tactic inspired by Slavic folklore, where turn-based tactics are combined with juicy and memorable graphics. Take the leadership of a small squad into your own hands and crush the most ferocious hordes of evil spirits and their mighty leaders!

title: Star Knight: Order of the Vortex
description: Star Knight: Order of the Vortex is a rogue-lite, shoot-em-up made to give you fun and interesting decisions and test you skill in action-packed, bullet-hell gameplay. Choose your crew, upgrade your ship, and explore the unknown depths of the Vortex.

title: Strongblade: Match 3 Puzzle and Match-3 Adventure
description: Strongblade is a match-3 puzzle game where you play as Sean the Mouse. Travel through a captivating world filled with puzzles, outsmart cunning villains, befriend charming animals, and build unique camps.

title: Sex Simulator: BDSM 2
description: An interactive sex simulation game with visual novel elements, featuring high definition graphics and videos, with realistic-looking characters set in a beautiful decor. You continue to play the role of an experienced Dom who initiates three curious women into the world of BDSM sex, in this sequel.

title: Sex Simulator: Futanari BDSM
description: An interactive sex simulation game featuring visual novel elements, high definition graphics and videos, and realistic-looking characters set in a beautiful decor. You play the role of an experienced Futanari Dominatrix who initiates three curious women into the world of BDSM sex.

title: Sex Story: Ruby and Hunter - Episode 2
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring HD graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Ruby joining Hunter at his new house for a night full of passion. Once there, he denies her advances until she agrees to be his sexual partner for an extended time.

title: Sex Survivals
description: Kill lots of rocking enemies and survive to the end of your porn workout! Porn Survivals is a casual game with an emphasis on humor and memes with elements of a simplistic RPG. Here, every decision you make can cause an avalanche of consequences for the hordes of enemies you have to fight!

title: Shirime 2: The Genesis of Butt-Eye
description: Get ready for a thrilling and terrifying adventure in 'Shirime 2: The Genesis of Butt-Eye'. Uncover the secrets behind the curse as you explore a mysterious inn. Engaging storyline, intense combat, third-person perspective, and stunning visuals await. Prepare for a spine-chilling experience!

title: Shadow Of The Devil
description: This game is an action, adventure, and horror game played from a first-person shooter (FPS) perspective. The main goal of the game is to immerse players in an exciting world and provide them with an engaging experience.

title: Shot Supreme
description: Sink baskets to score points, complete missions to buy upgrades, rinse and repeat. Shot Supreme is an arcade basketball game inspired by incremental games. Like a clicker, but you have to score baskets.

title: Sinful Catalyst CH1: Ethereal Camellia
description: Sinful Catalyst is a dark fantasy visual novel with a puzzle/action battle system. Follow Gyulia's journey on the Second Circle, battle nasty butlers, and fall at the hands of the first Mistress, Lilith.

title: Red Ops: The First Infection
description: Red Ops: The First Infection is an engaging ​BL/yaoi visual novel (18+) ​featuring hardships, world-ending events, zombies, love and intimacy. Follow our characters as they embrace their sexuality and explore their newfound romance.

title: Ripple in Dirac Sea
description: PvPvE moba-like game: 2 teams (1 god and 6 heroes per team) fight each other in a 2km*2km map with random starting points, random shops, and random monster bosses. 80% Action - heroes , 20% RTS - god .

title: Rionag: Survey Fleet
description: Rionag: Survey Fleet is a top-down starship builder and logistics game where it's your job to balance the needs of the crews with cutting-edge equipment on board. Unlock tech that adds new capabilities for your ships to go through hazardous environments, enabling you to explore new worlds.

title: Reptile Park VR
description: As a survivor of a tragic plane crash, you fight for survival on an island inhabited by prehistoric creatures. Explore, fight, survive and uncover the history of the tragic consequences of an experiment. Immerse yourself in a survival adventure like never before.

title: Route 13
description: Get ready for a spine-chilling horror experience in "Route 13"! Stranded on a deserted desert highway at night, players must find a way to refuel their car and escape the terrors lurking in the shadows. With an immersive heart-pumping gameplay, can you survive the horrors of Route 13?

title: Runeroots TD
description: A roguelike tower defense experience set in the Runeroots universe. Take on the alien invaders by upgrading your towers, unlocking unique perks, and building the perfect defense. Each run is a new challenge!

title: Sandy's Great Escape
description: Sandy's Great Escape is a pixel art crab puzzle game in which deaths create shells to help you navigate through different obstacles.

title: Vs. Imposter Alternated
description: Vs. Imposter Alternated is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' that is based on Among Us. The game is a fanmade variant of the Vs. Impostor mod. Each week is set in an alternate universe. Week 1 is based off if the cut character Blue was in the mod, and Week 2 is based on the Horse Wrangling mode from Among Us.

title: Scare: Fatal Picture
description: Scare: Fatal Picture is a survival horror game in which you must face a dangerous ghost tribe to save your sister.

title: Scarlet Lake
description: Delve into a retro survival horror where everything is not what it seems. You control Ben Murphy, a detective sent to investigate the strange on-goings in a small town, only to be caught in a nightmare surrounded by terrifying creatures. What dark mysteries will you uncover in Scarlet Lake?

title: Piece of..Horror
description: An indie horror game about a hypermarket security guard.

title: Panomap
description: Panomap is an interactive geography game for your Twitch chat! Explore new places around the world and observe your surroundings with your viewers. Everyone, including yourself, tries to guess your location by just typing it to your chat. Let the competition and bragging begin!

title: Pale Coins
description: Journey into the ruthless open world of Pale Coins, an old-school fantasy RPG. Face punishing bosses, goblin-infested dungeons, and discover legendary weapons as you customize your champion and fight across Grenmark for the fabled Champion's Coin.

title: PI.EXE Enhanced Edition
description: PI.EXE is a challenging action/platformer that takes place in the inside of an operative system's server! PI.EXE Enhanced Edition is an upgraded version of the game incluiding numeroues improvements:

title: Dungeonborne
description: Dungeonborne is an immersive first-person PvPvE dungeon crawler. Team up with trusted companions to hunt for treasure, explore dangerous dungeons, face terrifying monsters and other cunning adventurers alike, and escape before being consumed by darkness and greed.

title: Pirate Runner
description: Play the famous pirate BLACK BEARD in this new generation Endless Runner with stunning photo-realistic graphics! Blizzard, sandstorm or torrential rain, try to survive as long as possible!

title: PsyQik
description: PsyQik is a fast-paced psychedelic action game, featuring vibrant neon visuals and innovative interactive effects. Immerse yourself in an otherworldly adventure as you uncover the ultimate truth in a mesmerizing world that captivates your eyes and mind.

title: No Stone Unturned
description: Why did the chicken cross the road? Hunt for clues, interrogate suspects and solve cases! No Stone Unturned is a dark-comedy noir detective game featuring multiple endings and choices that truly matter!

title: Nevultra
description: Nevultra is an exciting shoot'em up that will take you back to the 8bit/16bit era. The protagonist, Nina, needs your help to reach her destination in deep space.

title: Oni Oneesan
description: Two Oni princesses are looking for a mate, one human looks to save his people by marrying into their kingdom. Before the Oni court approves however, he'll have to prove able to rein in their excesses, and maybe teach the two quarrelling sisters a thing or two about ruling.

title: Orgasm Simulator 2023
description: In Orgasm Simulator 2023, you'll step into the shoes of a man who embarks on a new chapter of his life, moving into a new apartment and finding a job, only to discover that the real transformations await him in the heart of his home.

title: Oslo: 2084
description: In OSLO:2084, hack your way through a dystopian world where AI rules supreme and democracy is a distant memory. As Embla, fight for freedom and change the course of history in this thrilling cyberpunk adventure.

title: My Mistress Lu Bu
description: You were born into the rough hands of the notorious group of bandits, the Yellow Turbans. After their downfall, you lead a small crew of bandits until you're defeated by the warlord Lu Bu. She spares you in exchange for your fealty, and thus begins your service to your mistress Lu Bu.​

title: Nebula's Descent
description: Colorful bite-sized roguelike twin-stick bullet-hell dungeon crawler! Explore a procedurally generated research lab, throw black holes at monsters, dodge lasers, and fight a final boss beyond comprehension!

title: My Name is Uncle Groucho You Win a Fat Cigar
description: In this bizarre graphically-augmented text-adventure originally released in 1983 from the mind of Mel Croucher, Uncle Groucho is your guide in a wacky alternative Hollywood where cigars are currency and you are as likely to travel in a space shuttle as in a covered wagon.

title: Ms. Holmes: The Case of the Dancing Men - Collector's Edition
description: When strange letters with dancing figures arrive just before an heiress mysteriously disappears, you know the similarities to your Uncle Sherlock’s old case are no mere coincidence. Can you crack the code and stop those behind the dancing men for good?

title: My Furry Succubus
description: You just found a mysterious old lamp in your uncle's garage. Nothing bad can happen if you rub it, right?...

title: Lucky Hero
description: "Lucky Hero" is a Roguelike symbol-building game. Your weapons and equipment have transformed into symbols, and by spinning the Wheel of Fortune, you will face various powerful enemies. This game offers a vast array of symbols and character skills for players to explore and combine.

title: Love n Life: Lucky Teacher
description: After the pandemic Covitch69, you lost your job as a space aviation expert and now become a teacher in a small town. Luckily, every cloud has a silver lining as you are stepping into a world where love blooms unexpectedly and leads you to captivating ladies with immersive romantic tales.

title: Love Love Candy
description: Choose your favorite girl and help her to complete a very popular phone game to unlock fashionable dresses for her avatar. As you guide and support them, they'll express their gratitude for you in many ways!

title: MagicShop2
description: An 18+ game that features a unique combat system mixed with adult activity that is never before seen in any other game.

title: MaidGardener
description: This is an action game where you control a gardener's maid and catch the Insectors flying around the stage in a cage. However, you need to be careful when catching them. It is important to avoid attacks and catch them well in cages. If you clear the stage, you can get an illustration (for adults).

title: Maze Girl
description: A long time ago, a beautiful princess was imprisoned by a demon in a maze. In this seemingly no exit maze, the princess could cast magic to change the space, so as to find a way out of one room after another, and finally regain her freedom.

title: Miasma
description: One fairly large and complex map. Difficulty should be more on the challenging side, harder encounters are mostly optional though.

title: Meeting Her
description: Meeting Her is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel. You play as Eric, an adult man who already has a life with friends until a new girl appears in his door. The game contains animated sex scenes with all the girls, But you can pick your path, what girl do you would like to be with? it is your choose.

title: Mind Control: Bloody Renaissance
description: Mind Control is a mystical meta horror game about the unjust and mysterious nature of this world. You must go through pain and suffering to learn the truth. Remember that you are responsible for those you control.

title: Mimi the Cat: New Friends
description: Help Mimi move, climb, or carry boxes to reach her bed and rest. Unlock adorable cats and choose to play with them in this challenging Sokoban-like game!

title: Minamochi Factory
description: Super cute and stylish inspection action puzzle!

title: Megabat
description: While in search of food, a fruit bat stumbles its way through the ventilation system of a secret facility finding unique fruit that give special abilities. While in search of more fruit the bat must avoid traps and enemies. Will the bat be able to satiate it's hunger and escape with its life?

title: Light of Atlantis
description: In this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania you dive into the ruins of Atlantis. As a small robot you control the water level in various rooms to solve puzzles and discover the mysteries of an ancient society.

title: Lidar Survival
description: LIDAR Survival is a first person, survival horror game. Where you have to survive through multiple levels to escape the enemies in the darkness. Try find your way to the exit before they find you..

title: Lisle Engle Heavy Distance
description: Heavy Distance is the ground breaking interactive single from Lisle Engle.

title: Lock & Key: A Hunter's Legacy
description: Become an unlikely hero by exploring, building new gadgets, jumping, and shooting to find the elusive keys to a mysterious tower that has emerged from the ground without warning and awakened a terrible power.

title: Impeached 2
description: Anyone can be President, so why not you? Become President of the United States in this text-based political satire strategy game, then push your morals and values upon hundreds of millions of people. Will you be a benevolent leader or a ruthless dictator?

title: Ikuzo
description: made to feel like a true sword fight, where the enemy and the player are on the same starting line, both sides use the same mechanics, no hard bullies, no high values, So it's a very simple action game, there's a combo system, there's a roguelike, there's a little bit of a growth system.

title: Inexplicable Geeks: RestoreTheMillerCut
description: The studio needs your help rewriting their next big superhero blockbuster for mass public consumption! What kind of movie will you make?

title: JR East Train Simulator: Senseki Line (Aobadori to Ishinomaki) 205-3100 series
description: The Senseki Line is a 49.0 km long line connecting Sendai City in the central part of Miyagi Prefecture and Ishinomaki City in the northeast, and is the only DC electrified line in the Tohoku region. Like the Saikyo Line, ATACS is used in some sections (Aobadori Station to Higashi Shiogama Station).

title: Just Date
description: Just Date is a simulator of a real date, and it's up to you to determine how successful it will be. Share stories and jokes, treat yourself to delicious dishes, and try to win the heart of the beautiful girl, Elizabeth.

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Myth of the Moors
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter and 3 Legendary Weapons: The Moorhound (Hunter), Maw of Darkness (Romero 77), Hell's Dewclaw (Caldwell Pax), Snarling Dawn (Flare Pistol).

title: How To Build Your Igloo
description: Skate your way in a grid-based arctic world and watch your new igloo grow as you help our friend Siku solve puzzles full of snow, creaks and ice cubes!

title: Hot Girls Delivery Club
description: A silent driver rescues girls from human trafficking. Can he and his operator Greta overcome the main enemy, and find themselves?

title: Hirocato: The Delivery Hero
description: Hirocato is a fast-paced side scroller loaded with hard-to-beat levels, great music, gorgeous pixel art and an emotional subtle story. Control Cato while running through an exciting city delivering food while discovering the hidden truths behind Cato's world downfall - Welcome to Hirocato.

title: Hentai Fantasy Chicks
description: Hentai Fantasy Chicks is a casual puzzle game. Listen to the relaxing music, move around the fragments of the image, and make the full picture. Explore and enjoy all different types of fantasy girls and relax.

title: Hakou Watcher
description: "Hakou Watcher" is a high-speed action rougelike game.

title: Grocery Grab
description: Active ragdoll speed running and multiplayer PVP couch party game

title: GoldenMiner
description: This is a puzzle game. In this game, gold coins can be obtained through "mining".

title: Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaira
description: Action RPG with survival elements. Manage resources and bond with NPCs to unlock crafting and gain allies who may become playable. Use them to solve puzzles and battle together. Survive the frozen wilds and uncover the truth behind your exile.

title: Flipshot
description: Casual brick breaker featuring beautiful landscapes.

title: Fitting In
description: Fitting-In is a single player puzzle game where you perform movement combos to jump over, through, and inside obstacles! There are walls, pause blocks, break blocks, and move blocks that all require creativity to overcome!

title: Fight for Eden: Heat
description: Fight For Eden is a fantasy action-RPG VR game where you will follow the adult story of a young orc enrolled to fight against the half elves' oppression. Make friends or lovers, fight enemies, explore lands, all in an adult setting.

title: Folly Of The Wizards
