description: Interact with two new characters and dive deeper into the mysteries of Kale Bay!

title: Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim 2 - DLC 2
description: A free DLC that adds some extra EXP.

title: Revenge of Noxi
description: Play as the ultimate ninja badass Noxi using magic, sword and shurikens to fight off an army of monsters and save your loved one. Bring Noxi to the top floor of her ruined home over dangerous terrain with athletic jumps, flips, sprints and slides

title: Missiles Away
description: Humanity faces its darkest hour as an alien force launches a relentless invasion. As a skilled pilot, you must take control of a powerful combat helicopter and engage in a fast-paced, high-octane first-person shooter experience.

title: Angel Legion: Oriental - Purple
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Layers of Fear: Deluxe Edition
description:
- The Layers of Fear (game)
- Original Soundtrack (digital)
- The Art of Layers of Fear

title: ASMR Slicing
description:
Choose your favorite cutting tool no matter if it's a playing card, flosser or just a simple kitchen knife. Just cut, cut, cut and experience those satisfying ASMR
sounds! Slice a variety of colorful objects made of kinetic sand in the shapes of food, toys, buildings, everyday objects and ordinary cubes or blocks!

Need to raise the difficulty level a bit? Turn on the challenge mode! Cut off the right weight, divide an object into a given number of parts, cut an item perfectly in half, or find things hidden inside!

title: Minecraft: Pac-Man
description: The legendary arcade classic PAC-MAN comes to Minecraft! WAKA-WAKA your way through a-mazeing 3D maze madness! Compete with friends for high scores on 10 challenging stages or build your own in the maze editor. Score big points to unlock new power-ups, like the Laser or TNT. Just make sure to watch out for Inky, Pinky, Blinky, Clyde and... CREEPY?!

title: Metallic Men
description: Explore the cosmos as a metallic man who wants to find lots of cool looking crystals.

title: Minecraft: How To Train Your Dragon
description: This is Berk, home of Vikings and dragons! Join Toothless, Hiccup, and the rest of the dragons and riders on heroic adventures in Minecraft. Compete in racing, map the world, and release captive dragons from invading trappers! Tame, collect, and train dragons from the vast reaches of the Barbaric Archipelago to become an expert dragon rider. Includes 24 popular skins!

title: FlatSoccer: Online Soccer
description:
FlatSoccer is an online multiplayer football game with several game modes, the main one being 3v3.

It has a large number of systems that allow the game to be competitive and the players to evolve.

title: Minecraft: Ben 10
description: Become the hero you were always destined to be! Transform into all 10 of Ben’s alien heroes, including Four Arms, Heatblast, and XLR8 in a BEN 10 Minecraft adventure. Defeat Ben’s toughest villains and save the day with your very own Omnitrix! It's Hero Time! Includes Story and Free Roam modes, plus 6 skins!

title: Starfield: Premium Edition
description:
Starfield is the first new universe in over 25 years from Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4. In this next generation role-playing game set amongst the stars, create any character you want and explore with unparalleled freedom as you embark on an epic journey to answer humanity’s greatest mystery.

Premium Edition includes:
- Starfield Base Game
- Shattered Space Story Expansion (upon release)
- Up to 5 days early access*
- Constellation Skin Pack: Equinox Laser Rifle, Spacesuit, Helmet and Boost Pack
- Access to Starfield Digital Artbook & Original Soundtrack

title: Starfield: Constellation Edition
description: In this next generation role-playing game set amongst the stars, create any character you want and explore with unparalleled freedom as you embark on an epic journey to answer humanity’s greatest mystery.

title: Knights of Braveland: Fantastic Beasts
description: The Fantastic Beasts Expansion augments Knights of Braveland with a number of fearsome new bosses. In addition, you will now be able to play as a new hero, the mighty Wizard, who can defeat fantastic beasts with hunter's gear.

title: Cry Babies: Magic Tears - The Big Game
description: Your favourite Cry Babies characters are ready to play! The Big Game is a friendly and fun adventure perfect for young players. Join Lady, Coney, Dreamy and friends in an all-new adventure as they take part in an exciting multi-stage tournament to win the fabled Golden Pacifier!

title: The Pear Game
description: This game is game might not be as it appears! hahahahaha!

title: Don't Let Him In
description: A Phycological Third Person Cinematic Experience - Some roads are better left untraveled.

title: Tarisland
description: Tarisland is a non-P2W MMORPG on PC and mobile that features raids, diverse classes and builds, and a vast world for exploration. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. In this immense, open-world playground, choose from various races, each with unique skills and abilities, and embark on an epic adventure full of mystery and dangers to overcome.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Part 1 - The Moon's Origin and Finality
description:
The Moon's Origin and Finality is part 1 of HoYoverse's Honkai Impact 3rd. It tells the stories of Kiana Kaslana, Raiden Mei, Bronya Zaychik, students at St. Freya High and normal Schicksal Valkyries, who through numerous trials, and with the help of their loved ones, protected the world from both the threat of the Honkai and those who sought to purge it no matter the cost.

The Moon's Origin and Finality spans 35 Main Story Chapters along with several bonus EX Chapters and the Elysian Realm Gamemode.

title: Truck Driver: The American Dream
description:
Truck Driver: The American Dream is a truck-driving simulation game that is setting out to mix storytelling.

Start from the bottom and work your way to the top in the name of getting your life together and chasing the American Dream.

title: Night Escape
description: Night Escape is a tense and strategic multiplayer game. Uncover the hidden assassin, solve puzzles, and escape the mysterious mansion before it's too late. Survive the night or become a victim. Embark on this deadly race for survival.

title: World of Grimm
description: A fast-paced 5-minute digital collectible card game in the Brothers Grimm universe.

title: Welcome to Freddy's
description: You, as the nightguard, must prevent someone from attempting to rob the building and prevent the animatronics from damaging valuable equipment in the night hours. For that, you have two specially designed doors at your sides. Prevent them from getting to your office by closing them, but watch out; don't run out of power, or Freddy and his merry band will get you.

title: Lego Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga Starkiller Update
description: For the uninitiated, Luke Starkiller is an early version of Luke Skywalker, as portrayed in concept artwork by Ralph McQuarrie, the designer and illustrator who helped to define the iconic look and style at the Star Wars universe.

title: Minecraft: Minions
description: Do YOU have what it takes to become a super-villain? You just might! Grab your Minions Adventure Map, and live out your evil dreams as you take on the Vicious 6 in an exciting Adventure Mode. Explore familiar places and cause maximum mischief with Illumination’s Gru and the Minions in Minecraft. Includes 29 franchise skins!

title: Minecraft: Walt Disney World Magic Kingdom Adventure
description: An authentic recreation of Walt Disney World Magic Kingdom! Experience beloved attractions, meet iconic Disney and Pixar characters, and celebrate the 50th anniversary of Walt Disney World with a spectacular fireworks show. With 25 skins included and special in-game merchandise, you can celebrate in style!

title: Minecraft: Ice Age
description: Ice Age freezes the overworld in this mammoth mash-up! Discover the lost world of dinosaurs and acorns a-plenty with the help of Baby Scrat. “It's time to get Buck Wild!”

title: Minecraft: Lightyear
description: Step into Buzz Lightyear’s shoes and journey to the far reaches of space in an action-filled adventure to save your friends and crew from Zurg’s evil plans. With the help of your trusty Star Command gadgets and Space Ranger vehicles, face the dangers on the alien planet, T’Kani Prime, and steer your spaceship to victory!

title: Pixel's Time Paradox
description:
When Pixel learns that author T. T. Hunter has killed himself, he’s devastated. Now he might never know how his favourite book series ends! So, he does what any inventor cat would do: he builds a time machine, to travel back to the novelist’s final hours, in hopes of preventing the tragic act.

But things are never that easy. In this latest addition to the Inspector Waffles universe—created in two weeks for Adventure Jam 2023—help Pixel, along with his flamingo pal JayJay, to solve time travel puzzles, avoid paradoxes, and save the day for literature fans everywhere!

title: Minecraft: SpongeBob SquarePants
description: Are you ready, kids? It’s time to join your favourite under-the-sea chums on an adventure in Minecraft! Visit Bikini Bottom and help make today the BEST DAY EVER for SpongeBob, Patrick, Sandy, and friends. Complete with 40 skins.

title: Minecraft: Batman
description:
Gotham City is in trouble but have no fear – Batman is here!
Fly through the night as the Caped Crusader and save the city from Harley Quinn, The Joker, The Penguin, and more dastardly Super-Villains from the DC universe. Explore the legendary Batcave, utilize the Bat-Gadgets in your Utility Belt, and complete puzzles to repair the sabotaged Nether Portal and save Alfred!

title: War Gun: Shooting Games Online
description: Join Armed Conflict - an epic war game! This is the place where your skill and tactical skills will determine the outcome of the battle. Fight with players from all over the world, diversify your arsenal with weapons and prove your superiority on the battlefield. Are you ready for Armed Conflict?

title: Nascar Heat 5: Next Gen Car Update
description: The 2022 Season Expansion DLC brings the excitement of the historic 2022 NASCAR Cup Series season to NASCAR Heat 5. The 2022 content will feature all three Next Gen vehicles, as well as the primary schemes for the entire team and driver roster from the season.

title: The Callisto Protocol: Final Transmission
description: Dig deeper into the horrifying secrets of The Callisto Protocol.

title: JungleRing2D
description: Jungle Ring is a fun and exciting game,that improves and trainning your reaction.The game is based on your concentration and reaction.How good is your reaction,you can test in this game?Would be you able to pass all levels?

title: Impossible Stunts
description: Prepare for an adrenaline-pumping experience in this racing game of Impossible Stunts!

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: Dodge, Plymouth, Chrysler Remastered
description: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - Dodge | Plymouth | Chrysler Remastered includes 8 licensed cars from 3 manufacturers!

title: Europa Universalis IV: China History Lessons
description: Learn more about Ming China, the early Qing dynasty and the surrounding nations in this package of lectures from Laszlo Montgomery, host of the popular History of China podcast.

title: Europa Universalis IV: Japan History Lessons
description: Learn more about the history of early modern Japan in this package of lectures from Isaac Meyer, host of the popular History of Japan podcast.

title: Gun to the Zone
description: Find powerful weapons, fight monsters and discover the secrets of the Zone. Each weapon is different.

title: Mysterious Place
description: Design: In this game, players will step into the world of a Mysterious Place. Navigate the enigmatic landscapes and make crucial decisions. With pixel graphics and high-quality animations, immerse yourself in a visually stunning and atmospheric experience. Available in Russian and English.

title: Sweetcore Brews
description: Sweetcore Brews is an otome about a tea-brewing witch called “Milly”, whose dream is to open her own magical tea shop in the city. She is currently an apprentice witch working at an existing magical tea shop where the shopkeeper is rarely around. So Milly manages the shop full-time, practicing daily her new magical teas on her own by using them as solutions for her customers’ lives. She meets two love interests – Zero and Kingsley, both are also magical humans who run their own unique businesses. This game is a slice of life romance where Milly deals with the funny mistakes she makes from her magical teas causing problems, and she falls in love with Zero or Kingsley over time.

title: Yakuza Complete Series
description:
A bundle including seven games from the Yakuza series:
- Yakuza 0
- Yakuza Kiwami
- Yakuza Kiwami 2
- Yakuza 3 Remastered
- Yakuza 4 Remastered
- Yakuza 5 Remastered
- Yakuza 6: The Song of Life

title: Southernmost Combine
description: Southernmost Combine is an alternate epilogue to Half Life 2 Episode 2, in which Gordon Freeman is sent back in time to the 1980´s to stop a Combine recon deployment happening in the southernmost land of the world. There are a few deviations in gameplay mechanics (more tactical and slow paced, no gravity gun, inventory) but it´s still Gordon fighting the combine and rebels helping him to achieve it. This is a small episode consisting of a variated set of scenaries with unique art made ex-profeso to bring Source to the look of the southamerican region in the 1980´s.

title: Duke Nukem 3D: Fallout Freeze
description:
Duke Nukem 3D: Fallout Freeze — is a mod that includes one level for Duke Nukem 3D Atomic Edition with custom art and code. It’s a Christmas themed mod whose main task is to bring a holiday atmosphere, but keep the vanilla style.

The level takes place in a captured by the aliens shopping mall “Queen's Mall”. Although the first part of the map is linear, the second part is designed for fully free exploration.

title: Target Party
description:
Welcome to Target Party, the first-person platform game that will make you feel the adrenaline of speed and the art of speedrunning! Face a fast-paced challenge as you dash through action-packed, thrilling levels with only one goal in mind: destroy all the targets before you reach the finish line, and do it at full speed!
Explore different strategies and routes, perfect your jumps and spins, and discover hidden shortcuts as you dive into the challenging world of Target Party. Master the mechanics and compete with players from around the world in online leaderboards to prove who is the true king of the party.
Join the party and discover why Target Party is the first-person platformer that will keep you glued to the screen, enjoying dizzying thrills with every jump, every shot and every second it takes to reach victory!

title: BathDoom
description:
A Doom II mod of a fashionable bathroom. GZDoom recommended to play.

It is 2149. You are in the middle of killing demons when you remember your house on Deimos still needs its bathroom remodeled. The task is perilous, as one wrong move will send the upper floor into the depths of Hell. Be prepared...for BATHDOOM.

title: Blood River Base
description: Welcome to the scenic mountain area known as Blood River Base! This WAD was made in under 64KB and will work in vanilla DOOM II. Traverse large canyons and destroy Hell's legions as the dangerous Blood River flows beneath.

title: Doom Hockey
description:
Doom Hockey is a GZDoom multiplayer mod that brings exciting ice rink action into Doom! Up to four players can play on the Red or Blue teams, all while various items appear on the rink to shoot at the puck (or the other team). Each match can be customized in game. Play with a 5 minute timer and see which team
gets more goals, or turn the timer off and play a Best of 5.

title: My Crimes
description: Get rid of the crimes. Grab all the evidence. Probably get arrested anyway because you have dogshit lawyers. Don't stop punching the boxes, it's your only way out.

title: Fun.Io
description: Battle for survival in FUN.IO! Choose your tank, face deadly bots, and reach the top of the leaderboard in a relentless arena. Customize your tank, unlock upgrades, and prove your skills in this roquelike action experience. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Amalgamy
description: Blend into the crowd, track down your friends and win the game.

title: Tero: Terror Hour
description: Your mother didn't let you watch TV at night... and even after her death, she still won't let you... Don't let her catch you watching that damn horror movie you just bought... Cover yourself with the blanket!

title: Sevyal
description: Sevyal is a single-player horror game set in an underground hospital. Something has gone wrong and as a government official, you must visit the location, repair the electricity, survive, establish communication with the military, and escape.

title: Age of Water
description:
Age of Water is a new MMO game set in a post-apocalyptic Earth completely covered in water.

The rooftops of high-rise buildings and tops of other man-made and natural objects turned into islands, on which the surviving people built new settlements. Your adventure begins near one of them.

title: Garden Dreams
description: Click around the garden to perform various jobs, like watering plants, picking produce and unleashing pesticides.

title: Silent Hope
description: Explore, fight, and produce items to grow stronger as seven distinct heroes in this silent world. Guided by the Princess, you'll delve into the Abyss and learn the mysteries of the King and his now-ruined kingdom. In a world without words, what hope is there for humanity?

title: Manic Mechanics
description:
It’s time to dust off your overalls and hitch on your toolbelt in Manic Mechanics - a chaotic couch co-op game where you and up to three fellow grease monkeys serve the car-obsessed residents of Octane Isle.

Your mission? Work your way through Octane Isle's five neighborhoods, challenging the Master Mechanics that rule each part of town. Repair as many cars, trucks, choppers, tractors, mini-subs (and even UFOs) as possible to prove your worth in this hectic race against the clock.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince
description:
Journey into a fantastical world on a quest for revenge in DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince.

Psaro is cursed and is unable to harm anything with monster blood. Now, he must become a Monster Wrangler to create an army for battle.

The hunt for high-ranked monsters takes Psaro through the ever-changing seasons of Nadiria and its unique environments, with rivers of bubbling lava, mysterious ancient ruins, and soaring towers of cake. Along the way, Psaro meets the kind-hearted elf, Rose, who joins his adventure to seek out ever-stronger monsters.

The key to Psaro's success lies with synthesis: the ability to combine two monsters and create a stronger offspring. Each new creation brings Psaro one step closer to his goal of becoming the Master of Monsterkind.

title: Penny's Big Breakaway
description: Join Penny & Yo-Yo in a kinetic 3D-platformer bursting with innovative gameplay! Showcase your catalog of tricks and chain impressive combos to deliver Penny & Yo-Yo's perfect breakout performance. Take the stage with this vibrant pair in Penny’s Big Breakaway.

title: Star Ocean: The Second Story R
description:
Two worlds, one fateful encounter.

In an endless sea of stars, at the edge of the universe, two people who live in different worlds go on a journey to save planet Expel.

Choose your path and witness an awakened destiny.

title: Fear Assessment+
description:
“Fear Assessment+” is here to give you the fear of you watching “Lost Episode Creepypastas” again, or the feeling of going through cardiac arrest.

I officially announce “Fear Assessment+” an alternate version of the fear assessment, with extended content, including: 3+ levels, an narrator, settings, longer levels, better and unique experience, and the scare-factor goes from 5 all the way to 10.

title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Party Dash
description: Give heed! Our academy's time-honored Spring Fan Fest will play to a very special event! Behold, the Slapdash Grand Prix! Teams will compete in four exhilarating events! Aim for ultimate glory in Hurtling Hurdles, Blazing Baskets, Dodgeball Demolitions, and Gourmet Gauntlet!

title: Flipper Soccer
description: Play a quick game of Flipper Soccer - the game that mixes football with pinball. Control the flippers to score goals against your opponent, who can be your friend or the computer.

title: Canadian Higurashi
description: Keiichi Maebara has just moved to the quiet little village of Hinamizawa in the winter of 2006 and quickly becomes inseparable friends with schoolmates Rena Ryuguu, Mion Sonozaki, Satoko Houjou, and Rika Furude. One of Keiichi's classmate start to act strange and ask him all sort of weird question. While trying to help her, he unearth the darkness that lurks over seemingly idyllic life they lead.

title: Swordbird Song: The Iron Owl Tower
description:
Follow the Bird Hero entering the lair of the Iron Owls in this short Action RPG game for Gameboy.

Bird Hero gets their journey interrupted when hit by a lightning bolt and falls on a remote island.

They learn the island is ruled by the Owl King, an evil ruler who enslaves the islanders, making them work in his tower.

Find your way into the Iron Owl Tower, defeat the Owl King and free the island from his evil!

title: As Long As It's Not Illegal: Act II
description: Join the senior class as they split off into groups to see what the city holds.

title: Sex Story: Ruby and Hunter - Episode 3
description: The story continues with Ruby's perspective, as she wakes up in Hunter's bed after their wild night to some expensive gifts. She plans a special thank-you to reward Hunter's gesture, but it takes a hell of a turn when she catches his naughty Maid playing with her pussy while she is spying on her.

title: Sex Simulator: Beach Resort
description: An interactive sex simulation game featuring visual novel elements, high definition images and videos, and realistic-looking characters set in a beautiful decor. You play as a guy who takes three different women on vacations to a luxury beach resort.

title: Lost Connections
description: If she leaves now you will never see her again. Would you have enough courage to take a step, or would you stay quiet and regret it? Experience this story about love and loss.

title: Phanotia: Interlude I-Aubzan Abbey
description: Princess Biana of the Fraensius Empire decided to send her trusted courtiers Celine and Allea, as well as Connecticut, as foreign aid to rescue the Vampir prostitutes who were secretly imprisoned in the Aubzan Abbey and played for the nobles, And try to find a larger dark network behind it.

title: Adorabilis
description: "Adorabilis" is a game where you control a white ghost to protect adorabilis from various threats while sending it home. You'll have to dodge enemies and trap, or using skills to get through difficulties on the way to home.

title: Mistified
description: Traverse an unknown land, purify the corruption, and salvage the souls of the lost by solving increasingly complex puzzles.

title: Danger Drop
description: Defy gravity, conquer challenges, and reach new heights in this thrilling platformer. Do you have what it takes? Can you overcome the trials, avoid deadly falls, and prove your platforming prowess?

title: Coraland: The Worst Rescuer
description: Coraland is a puzzle adventure game where we follow Joris, a good for nothing rescuer on her first adventure to save Pon-Pon island from imminent danger. The controls are simple and the puzzles have been designed to be accessible for all ages, without outside knowledge to solve them.

title: Circuit Superstars DLC: Top Gear - The Stig Challenge
description: Top Gear: The Stig Challenge brings a new kind of experience to Circuit Superstars. Inspired by classic moments of the legendary TV show, this expansion invites you to test your skills on a whole new level and laugh a lot while you're at it!

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days - Character Set 07: Chrono Shindou
description: Additional Card Set for Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days!

title: Crazy Brain
description: A fast paced strategic Block Breaking Pinball-type Score Attack style videogame.

title: Sweet Feets
description: Sweet Feets is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: New Lands 3: Paradise Island
description: Try being the owner of a whole island amid the south sea in new time management game. Gather tropical fruit and make refreshing ice cream. Develop your own resort. As you go farther into the new lands, your tasks will become ever more varied and difficult. Train your skills in the new time manager genre game!

title: Marauder of Dystopia: The Weakest Go To The Wall
description:
The people of the Omega Empire suffer under the oppressive rule of Emperor Duke—but a beautiful, dark-haired woman, sword in hand, has risen up to assassinate oppressors until the people are free!

Marauder of Dystopia: The Weakest Go To The Wall is a doujin RPG from ONEONE1 featuring animated battles and more.

title: Colorspace
description:
Colorspace is a fast paced singleplayer racing game where you have to destroy obstacles by changing to the right color. Set in a neon minimalist environement, you must clear the levels as fast as possible to restore the communication signal.
The best part is you don't have breaks!

title: Light Speed Ride Out
description: Light Speed Ride Out is a top-down space survivors arena shooter with roguelite elements. Upgrade your ship with a variety of items to create unique builds and survive the enemy hordes. Assemble the crew of your ship, make the right decisions and rescue people to get them to join your space colony.

title: Fallen Force
description: Rogue-lite arena shooter, where you kill monsters by knocking them out of arena. Shoot them, punch them, freeze them, burn them and much more in this unique take on a genre.

title: Quantum Derelict
description: Quantum Derelict is a rogue-lite survival horror game set in a chilling Lovecraftian inspired narrative. In the uncharted vastness of space, outwit the sinister cult of VUGSHERYOG and the lurking horrors as you strive to retain your sanity, find rescue, and survive against all odds.

title: Ourworld
description: Ourworld is a 1:1 global flight simulator. You'll battle awakened A.I.s, safeguarding our world. It features 3D city modeling, multiplayer online gaming. Deluxe version include all aircraft and features.

title: TS Marketplace: Sps 466 Wagon
description: Enter the world of track construction with the Sps 466 sleeper transport wagon from Join Together for Train Simulator.

title: Hotel Renovator: Gym Furniture Set
description: Are you ready to pump up your hotel? Well, you can flex your business biceps in the Gym Furniture Set. Complete your new objective to customize the hotel gym with plenty of options and attract fitfluencers from around the world.

title: Hell of Nightmares: Chapter 1
description: You have to escape Miss Roseville's school by solving puzzles

title: Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours
description: A 2D, turned-based, story driven action RPG.

title: Blazing 8s
description: Blazing 8s is an Activity that we've developed here at Discord. It is our Crazy Eights-inspired card game that you can play with your friends! The rules are simple — on your turn, discard a card from your hand with the same suit or number as the previous card. Playing special cards allows you to skip other players, reverse the direction of play, and even swap hands with other players. The first person to discard all their cards wins!

title: Bobble League
description: Bobble League is an Activity developed by Discord. Work with your friends to control your Bobbles on a tabletop setting in an attempt to score on the other team’s goal. With an emphasis on strategy and teamwork, you will experience a range of emotions in Bobble League as you watch your decisions play out in real-time against the opposing team. Use various Power Plays to improve your odds of scoring.

title: Guilty Me
description: In Guilty Me, take the role of Lucy on a scary nighttime journey home from the coffee shop. Face psychological terror, explore a dark environment, and uncover hidden secrets. Survive the chase and immerse yourself in a gripping walk simulator of suspense.

title: Checkers in the Park
description: Checkers in the Park is an Activity that we've developed here at Discord for playing checkers with your friends!

title: Chess in the Park
description: Chess in the Park is an Activity that we've developed here at Discord for playing chess with your friends!

title: Know What I Meme
description: Know What I Meme is a social party game of GIFs, memes, and good times! Select a text setup for the meme, browse to find the perfect GIF response, then everyone votes on which was their favorite. Earn points to prove just how funny you are. Up to 9 players can play but anyone can watch the fun!

title: I'm on Observation Duty 6
description: The most ambitious I'm on Observation Duty game yet with six unique levels. Gameplay is familiar to those who have played the previous games. The game is part of a series of popular "spot the difference" -type of horror games. In I'm on Observation Duty 6 the players job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies in the monitored rooms. You can swap between different camera-views. An anomaly means that for example something (e.g. a piece of furniture) has moved, an extra object has appeared or something has disappeared. There's also scary intruders. When you notice something is different in any of the monitored rooms you have to file a report by clicking on the anomaly or choosing the right location and type of the anomaly from a menu to fix it. Anoamalies appear at random so the player never knows what is going to hapen next. Too many active and unreported anomalies means game over. Goal is to survive long enough (from 00:00 to 06:00 in game time). You will need sharp eyes and good memory to survive the entire night. The game contains psychological horror that mainly comes from making the player paranoid about what has changed in the house. There are also some scary monsters that might appear.

title: Land-io
description:
In Land-io, players claim territory by moving around, making trails, and enclosing plots of land to gain them as their own.

The goal is to have the most land claimed when game time runs out, but watch out for other players! If someone runs into your trail, you'll lose all the land you've collected."

The player with the most land at the end of the 5 minutes wins the game.

title: Letter League
description: Letter League is an Activity that we've developed here at Discord. Letter League is a game where you and your friends take turns placing letters on a shared game board to create words in a crossword-style. Spelling words with high earning letters and placing letters on special spaces earn players more points, so get your dictionaries and thesauri ready!

title: Farcana
description:
Farcana is a third-person team ability shooter set in a mesmerizing Sci-Fi landscape. With its cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5 graphics, Farcana transports you to the awe-inspiring colonized Mars, where you will engage in heart-pounding 4x4 PvP combat matches across various game modes.

At its core, Farcana is a blend of gripping gameplay and eSports focus. Both players and spectators are bound to be drawn into its dynamic blend of action, strategy, and skill. Moreover, Farcana stands out with its innovative Bitcoin-backed prize system. Whether it's through cash boxes or tournament prizes, Farcana recognizes and rewards your dedication and prowess.

title: World of JumpStart
description:
Are your little learners ready to embark on an enchanting journey through the World of JumpStart? Invite them to create and customize their very own Jumpee, settle into a friendly neighborhood, complete exciting missions, raise magical pets and more in an interactive and adventure-filled world where knowledge is key and learning is fun.

Play now to get started with Frankie and the JumpStart friends!

title: Bakeru
description: A 3D action game starring taiko drum-wielding tanuki boy Bakeru, who assumes the form of a human, going on a journey to save Japan from the clutches of a festival army led by the notorious Oracle Saitaro.

title: Our Story in Spring
description:
Hana is a shy florist with a secret wish: to reinvent herself and experience more beyond life in the blossom-bathed village of Yamamori. There's just one small problem— hopelessly sheltered, she has never stepped foot outside the boundaries of the village before.

Meanwhile, those around Hana have flourished. Her best friend chased his dreams to the big city, and even her childhood bully returns to Yamamori a reformed man. Determined to be left behind no more, Hana steels her resolve, but it will take friendship, love, and more than a little courage to change on her own.

Drift across three tranquil springs in rural and urban Japan, and experience the tender tale of one young woman's budding desire to transform her future alongside the men who shaped her past.

title: The Elder Scrolls Renewal Morroblivion
description: Welcome to Morroblivion the godfather of The Elder Scrolls Renewal Projects! A community dedicated to recreating The Elder Scrolls III Morrowind GOTY into the more modern engine of Oblivion, complete with creatures, quests, voices and support for original Morrowind mods such as Tamriel Rebuilt.

title: Angelic Chaos Re-Boot!
description:
It began as a day just like any other.

A dull morning, an uneventful trip to school, an afternoon of tedious lectures...

And then I met her.

title: Sonic Frontiers: Sonic’s Birthday Bash
description: Celebrate Sonic’s birthday on the festively decorated Starfall Islands! Spin dash your way to the party with new challenges, moves, collectible Koco, and New Game+!

title: Love Spell: The Starlight Update
description:
Complete remaster of the original game in a new engine with overhauled graphics, new music, new content, and more!

After saving the life of a mysterious old woman, a young girl is gifted a magical spell book with the power to make anyone whose name she writes inside of it fall madly in love with her until the next full moon. "Love Spell" is a romantic-comedy otome game full of magic, laughs & cute penguins!

title: Yodoyabashi Oyasama Club
description:
The regular meeting of Kansai's famous "Yodoyabashi Ojousama Club" is about to begin! Fashionable and elegant ladies meeting together! Bursting with femininity, they will dye the mansion bright red!

Will you be able to make it to tea time... alive?

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Special Colors for Sol and Ky
description:
This early purchase reward unlocked color and effect swapped versions of Sol Badguy and Ky Kiske.

The pack was available for purchases on PlayStation and Steam from release till June 25th and on Xbox from release till April 13th. Physical versions received a single use code while supplies lasted.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Another Story
description:
This story expansion is exclusive to Season Pass 1.

Another Story provides the player a full look behind the curtain from another perspective featuring appearances from many characters who did not show up during the main story, including Ramlethal, May, and Baiken.

title: Mother Fucker Galaxy
description: its a shooting game about my ptsd and other mental illness but largely shooting.

description: Spanky! is THE booty-physics party game that brings cheeky movement mechanics to chaos-filled party modes. Twerk online with up to 7 friends and slap some jiggly tush!

title: Leap in Bootstrap
description: Modify the past, and make the different future!

title: Yudashi Peril: Floraison
description:
The year is 2013, and Homura Asano is trying to get by as a second year at the prestigious Ainami Academy. Up until the beginning of the second semester, she hasn't had much in the way of friends, hasn't participated in any clubs, and has never had a girlfriend. Most of all, she has a strong premonition that she will not live to see her third year. Is it possible to change the course of her life and avert this fate?

Throughout the course of the game, you will be able to raise Homura's stats by choosing different activities and make attempts to get closer to other girls at school in order to forge bonds through route events. While romance plays a significant part in her life and desires, not every route is romantic. Friendship plays just as valuable a role as dating in her story.

title: Kemono Friends: Neko to Wakai se yo
description: A cute action shooter game based on Kemono Friends.

title: Age of Time
description: Experimental networking game made to test the Torque Engine, the game focuses on small-server community dynamics in a classic fantasy RPG world. While mostly a personal project, the server continues to run today and players can partake in community driven features like crowd-sourced policing and fair-air bartering.

title: Prince Maker-Braveness
description:
Doujin game, similar to the famous Princess Maker series.

Raise a Prince into one of many different jobs. Different raising tactics lead to different endings.

title: Private: Pornmania
description: Compilation CD-ROM set from FL Studio creators Image-Line. Features "over 1,200MB of hard-core movies for DOS and Windows," in addition to erotic themed games such as Porntris, Memory, Maze, Solver, and 'In the Jungle' which combines gameplay from all these games.

title: SuiSui Sweet
description:
Our third-year protagonist Kosuke is surrounded by unique girls.
His bright and cheerful childhood friend Makoto.
The stoic council president Kyoka.
The cool girl Chiaki.
The flirtatious first year Miho.
And the crazy about adivination Yuubi.
Where will Kosuke's affection lead to...?

title: Book 5 Untold
description:
A free adult game based on "Legend of Korra". Game set on time after Korra opened spirit portal in republic city.

You play as Guru, who is supposed to train Korra to make her achieve Avatar State.

title: The Vamp
description:
A short story about a vampire who breaks into a man's house at night ...
You can play as Yumi (the vampire) or the man.
Your goal: obtain the best grade. But it's not really necessary. You can also get all possible notes, and all endings, for a total of 26 endings.

title: Clover Day's Plus
description:
Bottled-up emotions... An everlasting oath... Heartfelt desires... An enduring regret... And a childhood promise. Yuuto was abandoned by his parents and raised in an orphanage in Britain before a trading merchant by the name of Takakura Yoshiomi adopted him and brought him to Japan.

Clover Day's Plus is the Steam release of the remake of Clover Day's.

title: Spider Fox
description: Spider Fox is a game about a Mad Scientist who has combined all animals throughout the land. You play as a Spider Fox who must now save the animals and stop the Mad Scientist.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Battle Stage: Lap of the Kami
description: The additional battle stage "Lap of the Kami" becomes selectable in-game.

description: The additional battle stage "Tír na nÓg" becomes selectable in-game.

description: The game follows a cat asking about the developer's life.

description: A fan-made dystopian sci-fi visual novel with Clannad characters.

title: My Love for You is Evermore
description:
My Love for You is Evermore is a mobile otome game that lets you create your dream love story! Fall in love your way with one or more of these bachelors: Your work rival, your boss, the accounting executive, or your celebrity client!?

And now... your celeb client's mysterious manager who's always wearing a kitsuke mask joins the ranks! What could he be hiding?

As you enter your name, you enter your story! All conversation and images are oriented towards YOU, so you can fully immerse. And you'll immerse even further when you receive texts and hear your love interest's voice on video call segments throughout the story.

title: Snowkissed Romance
description: Fall in love in the cozy mountains of Northern Japan. Call, text, and make choices to snag the best ending!

title: Ozmafia!! 0 Reflexion
description: Upcoming game in the Ozmafia series. A demo released in 2017.

title: LIP! Lewd Idol Project Vol. 2: Hot Springs and Beach Episodes
description: The girls are back! Join Kairi, Ranko, and brand new member Yuki in these two new lewd adventures at the beach and hot springs. Hotter encounters, hotter conversations, hotter scenes and lots of girls’ love!

title: Wishbind
description: A 2D platformer collect-a-thon in which you'll have to help someone collect a special kind of leaves to help them fulfill their project, while meeting interesting characters, overcoming tough platforming challenges and discovering secrets all throughout the world.

title: Moth Planet
description: Moth Planet is a kinetic, energetic 2D platformer where you interview moths and explore an interconnected world in search of the truth!

title: Pet Luv Spa and Resort Tycoon
description:
To make money and reach the goal of each level you have to service the needs of the animals staying in your resort. Each animal will come to your resort with needs and an amount of money they are ready to spend. If the price of your rooms are equal or lower than what they are ready to afford the will rent a room in your resort. Animals will always try to rent the most expensive room available.

You service animals' needs by sending the animal to the proper stations where they will be serviced by your employees. If the animal is a V.I.P. (Very Important Pet) you'll have to service the pet's needs yourself. This is done through the minigames. Once all needs of an animal have been attended to the animal leaves your resort and pays you.

title: Danganronpa: Checkmate
description: Fangame made for the one month Fanganronpa challenge.

title: Bengarachou Hakubutsushi
description: Tomohisa has some memory of his childhood. When he was a kid, he was often playing at some place near his house. But his parents don't remember it. Tomohisa doesn't remember it clearly, either. One day, he finds a notebook. It is about history and things happened at a small town. It's just eccentric, so no one pays attention to it. But he knows who wrote it. It's his uncle, who has been missing for years. The notebook includes a town he spent his childhood. He soon gets interested in the town and decides to visit there. Days later, he arrives at the town, but there are a lot of strange things and customs in the town. He finds various curious goods there and gradually gets to know a secret of the town and his past....

title: Haunted Obachestra Vol. 2 Bianke
description: Haunted Obachestra Vol. 2 Bianke follows Erlucia, Treis, Dhyos, & Henas.

title: Adventure Reporter Ocean
description: Discovery Adventure Reporter Ocean is a side-scrolling platformer based in an ocean-like environment. The game disc used to be distributed inside Nesquik cereal boxes.

title: Adventure Reporter Jungle
description: Adventure Games 1 of 3 in each promo pack. Take up the challenge, take pictures, create a magazine. In an exciting computer game you will become a brave reporter. You will have to collect amazing facts and take pictures of rare animals and then make your own magazine!

title: Adventure Reporter Arctic
description: An old 2012 cereal game (promo game included on cereal boxes) lost in time. It's a game were you are a man whose job is to collect coins and take photos of wild animals during your journey on the wild lands of Antarctica.

title: Team Hot Wheels: Drift
description: Team Hot Wheels: Drift is an arcade racing game. The objective of the game is to score points in the race to unlock official Team Hot Wheels vehicles and car paint schemes. The points are earned for collecting pick-ups, smashing everything in the way, and winning the race. While racing a speed booster can be used. The player race against ghosts of the best times. The game features only one track, two camera views and allows to change the color of the driver and car parts. After scoring 100,000 points the player becomes a member of the Hot Wheels Team.

title: Team Hot Wheels: Baja
description: Team Hot Wheels: Baja is an arcade racing game. The objective of the game is to score points in the race to unlock official Team Hot Wheels vehicles and car paint schemes. The points are earned for collecting pick-ups, smashing everything in the way, and winning the race. While racing a speed booster can be used. The player race against ghosts of the best times. The points are earned for collecting pick-ups, smashing everything in the way, and winning the race. While racing a speed booster can be used. The player race against ghosts of the best times. description: A whole new loony dream world to explore!

description: “Sinister Games is a social deduction game with 8 players, 2 infiltrators, and a "Core" in an asylum. Use rewards to buy items from the vending machine for protection. Find the infiltrators, vote out the King to win. Infiltrators assassinate players, if all players are assassinated, they win.”

title: You're My Penguin
description: Help Jun, a self described "chronic over-thinker" make decisions at his new school with friends, conflicts, and romance in this Shounen-ai, anime style, coming of age story! This game offers a visual gallery with over 35 art to unlock, beautiful scenery, music, visual effects, and sound effects!

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Milano Malpensa
description: The Brughiera plains to the north-west of Milano rank as the cradle of Italian aircraft construction. Today, Milano-Malpensa is one of merely a few airports left in this historic region. Malpensa is the second largest airport in Italy and serves as a hub for Alitalia, the largest Italian airline.

title: World of Art: Learn with Jigsaw Puzzles - Pixel Art by Numbers
description: All Your favorite Paintings from "World of Art - learn with Jigsaw Puzzle" Collection! Choose Your favorite Pixel Art resolution, a number of colors in Your color palette and start painting!

title: Skippy's Diner
description: Skippy's Diner is a short, but fun horror game that features great pixel art and 2d style 90s arcade aesthetic. The movement is basic but gives a sense of fatigue and struggle when trying to escape from Skippy. Featuring great sounds along with a good 90s arcade feel on the music as well.

title: Tiny Visitors
description: Tiny Visitors is a 3D Platformer, based on physics, mixing escape-game, search & find and mini-games. You can play up to 4 players in local coop.

title: Trigger Fever
description: Engage in chaotic multiplayer battles in Trigger Fever, a top-down shooter party game. Crush foes solo or with friends, wielding 50+ unique weapons. Show off skills, tactically dominate, and embrace the crazy onslaught!

title: Treasure Mountain
description: Collect a treasure, slay the dragon

title: The Assailant's Arrival
description: Alternative Universe Game/Sci-Fi Game

title: Spirit Island: Horizons of Spirit Island
description: Horizons of Spirit Island adds 5 new Spirits and 3 new island boards for even more variety.

title: Street Thugz
description: Traditional arcade action fighting game, restoring the punchy impact of STREETS OF RAGE. Like SHADOW FORCE, you can control any enemy and BOSS in the game and compete for the title of Final Fight King.

title: Bladesong
description: Crafting/management game Bladesong is set on taking swordmaking mechanics to a new level, featuring unparalleled customization of the sword's every detail and deep analysis of the sword's physical properties. Take the role of a swordsmith in the city of Eren Keep, one of mankind’s last standing cities after the gods have banished themselves in an act of desperation. Run your forge, fulfill customer commissions and perfect your craft and tools. Find your way in a city governed by an idolized ruler with an iron grip and build a loyal team of those you deem trustworthy.

title: Metal Gear & Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake
description: The first and second title in the Metal Gear series that established the stealth action genre, as well as the basic mechanics of the series.

title: Chimera Island
description: Rediscover a lost island with mysterious creatures the world has long since forgotten. Now it is up to you to help restore this ruined world and bring about a new age of Chimera.

title: Space Funeral 2
description: Space Funeral 2, also known as Blood Blood, is a very brief fan-made sequel to Space Funeral and was released by DarkChibiShadow on October 13, 2012. It is regarded as the shortest game in the series. Space Funeral 2 is then followed by Earth Birth.

title: Daisho: Survival of a Samurai
description: Daisho: Survival of a Samurai is an Action RPG set in the Sengoku era of Japanese history. War is raging as Oda Nobunaga is determined to depose the weak shogun on his throne, engulfing the kingdom in flames and it is your fate to craft your legacy.

title: Temtem: Showdown
description: Jump right into Temtem competitive action in this free multiplayer battle simulator! Build your team in seconds and dash into ranked matches with players from all over the world for pure, no-frills Temtem battling action—no leveling or taming required!

title: Hide n' Explode
description: The explosive multiplayer game where seekers blow up hiders while they desperately try to blend in with decoys. Expect chaos, laughter, and thrilling gameplay! Don't forget to use the built in proximity voice chat!

title: Conscience
description: Jack Beckham is found dead, hanging in his apartment alone. Police rule it a suicide. His father, refusing to accept the conclusion, hires you to investigate. Delve into the clues left behind in his apartment to discover what really happened.

title: Forest of Lesbians
description: A fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel. Simple fast paced action/puzzle gameplay between story elements. Anime/pixelart/jrpg style.

title: Mencia: A Never Was Tale
description: Mencia: A Never Was Tale., is a styled rogue-like, 2D platform, in which you will have to face agains an invasion of cute aliens using the properties a magic sword will give you. Let's go!

title: Yohane the Parhelion: Blaze in the DeepBlue
description: Yohane the Parhelion: Blaze in the DeepBlue is an official spin-off of Love Live! Sunshine. Yohane's fantasy world sets the stage for a 2D metroidvania in "Yohane the Parhelion: Blaze in the Deepblue"!

title: Putin Must Die: Defend the White House
description: Vladimir has gone mad. He has created an army of Russian-speaking Putin clones to destroy America, and the White House is the final frontier. You must defend the White House against invading hordes of Vladimir clones, or become one of them.

title: Xaladia: Rise of the Space Pirates X2
description: Upgrade your weapons, control armaments, and annihilate space pirates! Cover the screen with a barrage of support weapons such as missiles, lasers, barriers, and bots! Captivate players with non-scrolling single-screen combat, flashy support attacks with armaments, and beautiful 3D graphics.

title: Oral Lessons With Chii-chan

title: Jumpah
description: Take the title for the fastest Jumpah alive, and in the process make your friends hate their lives! Parkour, Rage, anger, frustration, disappointment, despair, depression, and lots of colors! What more could you ask for?

description: These are dark and mysterious times. 200 not easy levels in the game "Mystery Solitaire. The Black Raven 5" is waiting for your mind.

description: This is a positional combat game that combines elements of Snake, Grid Avoidance, and Vampire-style combat. Players control the entire team of heroes by controlling the leader. The cute art style, beautiful music, and smooth rhythm combine to offer a pleasant experience.

description: The F-15E, developed in the mid 1980's, is a dual-role fighter designed to perform air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. An array of avionics and electronics systems give the F-15E the capability to fight at low or high altitude, day or night, and in all weather.

title: Draftycar
description: DRAFTYCAR is a fast-paced racing game simulating the art of professional stockcar drafting. Tweak the physics to your liking and immerse yourself in pursuit of victory. Strategically place your car to gain speed, disrupt your competition and navigate a high-speed drag race to the finish.

description: In this action-adventure RPG, explore a strange and futuristic island-city as Secret Police Captain Aeydrien Mason-Northwood. Become a Villain, Hero, or something in between as you deal with the island's various problems in any way you see fit.

You can win or lose, and there's even an arcade mode that's crazy-crazy. The game's simplistic setup makes it suitable for players of all skill levels and ages.

Except for the underground section between Tokyo Station and Etchujima Station, the entire line is characterized by running on elevated tracks along Tokyo Bay.

1+ minute box game

You wake up in the dark, checking your pocket you find a lighter. You are in a very strange place. You see many corridors that are filled with toilet cubicles, urinals and sinks. You begin to explore the area in the hope of finding a way out.

Toiletrooms are an endless gloomy maze of toilets. It is inhabited by strange creatures. It probably looks like a backrooms, but instead of being empty, it has toilet cubicles, sinks, urinals, and lots of pipes.

The game was made in two weeks. Inspired by the universe backrooms and samosbor.

title: Monster Racing League: Ignition Premium Pass
description: Ignition Season Pass!Get the Premium Pass and unleash an additional 80 unlockable items in Monster Racing League's Race Pass. Stand out with premium cosmetics and unlock powerful monsters faster!

title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany
description: Willkommen! It's time for you to return to the Cold War. With its bombastic amounts of new original content, the Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany Creator DLC for Arma 3 invites you to live and breathe the military conflict between the two Germanies in the 1980s. Ride into armored combat against a determined enemy that easily outnumbers you. Experience warfare from the perspective of infantry reinforced with APCs. Or breach the historic inner German border to force the enemy’s hand in battle. Which side of the wall will you fight for? Besides the West and East German armies, this DLC pack also includes Denmark as a smaller but viable military faction, whereas the Polish People's Army reinforces their East German comrades.

title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Western Sahara
description:
New and improved variants of existing vehicles in ArmA 3 itself are bundled with the DLC: namely, the Marshall IFV and Marid APC, both of which have been granted modular capabilities to expand their roles. Alongside this are enhancements to the Zamak truck which has gained (optional) anti-aircraft guns and ViVT-capable models. The Offroad pickup and the PO-30 Orca helicopter have also been outfitted with up-armour packages designed to increase their survivability.

Additionally, five new factions - some based on existing factions from the Armaverse, along with a slew of handheld firearms, a static gun turret, and new drones in the form of armed UAVs that can either be outfitted with improvised explosives or handheld small arms, are included in the DLC. Lastly, this is all accompanied by a wide selection of (both new and retextured) personal gear and vehicular assets that are camouflaged to suit the arid environment of Sefrou-Ramal.

title: Forza Motorsport: Premium Edition
description: Forza Motorsport Premium Edition includes the full game with up to 5 days early access, Race Day Car Pack, Car Pass (30 cars delivered to your game weekly, one per week), VIP Membership and Welcome Pack.

title: Baby Shark: Sing & Swim Party
description: Swim across the wide ocean with the Shark Family to enjoy the Fin-tastic Festival. Choose from five customizable characters and play either in the runner or rhythmic game mode. Sing and swim to fin-omenal songs and get rewarded with tons of musical cards to add to your album.

title: Runnordai
description:
Enter the foreboding world of Runnordai, an eerie and unsettling game set within the confines of a sprawling hospital. As you navigate the labyrinthine corridors, your sole objective is to check every locker and uncover a crucial code needed to escape. But beware, a sinister figure lurks in the shadows, emerging at random intervals with distorted laughter and a chilling presence that clouds your vision.

Time is of the essence in this macabre chase. Lingering too long in a certain area spells doom, but swift evasion can keep you one step ahead. Equipped with a phone, you monitor ventilation issues, while managing the battery levels of both your phone and computer. The PC serves as your lifeline to rectify the escalating ventilation problems, its power restored through a strategically placed lever within the map.

Immerse yourself in the chilling atmosphere of Runnordai, where each step could be your last. Unlock the secrets within the hospital's walls, confront your pursuer, and strive to escape this haunting nightmare. Are you ready to embrace the darkness and face the unknown?

title: Asterix & Obelix: Slap Them All! 2
description: Asterix & Obelix - Slap them all! 2 is a Beat'em Up with an original story. Explore different places such as forest ruins, a vast Roman camp and even Lutèce. This dynamic game invites you to come on an adventure — with a generous distribution of slaps!

title: NASCAR Arcade Rush
description: The NASCAR Beasts are Unleashed!

title: Soccer Kids
description: A game about soccer, made by people who suck at playing soccer. Guide your team of nerds to victory in this tight, tactical soccer game!

title: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 1 - Bonus Content
description: This add-on expands the Master Collection Vol. 1 with additional titles and media. It includes the NES/Famicom version of Metal Gear and Snake’s Revenge, alongside the Metal Gear Solid and Metal Gear Solid 2 Digital Graphic Novels and the Metal Gear Solid Digital Soundtrack. These extras are available when purchasing the complete bundle of Master Collection Vol. 1.

title: Project Fantasy
description:
In revealing this project, IOI stated, “We are building a new world, a new IP – an online fantasy RPG. A world and a game built from the core to entertain players and expand for many years to come.”

IOI added: “For many, this journey is also a deeply personal one that began long before we started making games for a living – and it started with the fantasy genre. From the ‘Fighting Fantasy’ books compelling you to choose your path, alone, against wizards, lizards, and thief kings. To the togetherness, camaraderie, agony, and delight found around the tabletop."

“For some it meant taking the role of a game master: Part storyteller, part AI opponent, part guide, part villain. For everyone around that table it meant creativity, imagination, building a world together, and a shared goal in creating a great game experience."

“This idea – that a diverse group of individuals with different skills and strengths can work together and become more than the sum of their parts – is what inspires us. It inspires the fantasy world we are building – and it inspires how we build it.”

title: Living Books: Arthur's Teacher Trouble
description: Arthur's Teacher Trouble is based on the 1986 Marc Brown book of the same title, and is the second Living Books PC CD-Rom Game and the first of the five Arthur Living Books games (counting D.W. the Picky Eater).

title: Living Books: The New Kid on the Block
description: The New Kid on the Block is the fourth Living Books game based on the 1984 storybook written by Jack Prelutsky, and was released in 1993. Instead of just one story, it was a collection of 17 poems. It is hosted by Jack Prelutsky as he voiced the cartoon counterpart of himself.

title: Living Books: Ruff's Bone
description:
Ruff's Bone is the sixth Living Books game (or fifth if you were to go by the PC release dates) released in 1994. Written by Eli Noyes and co-produced by Colossal Pictures, it is exclusively Living Books' second original story not being an adaption from any pre-existing titles (first if not counting Mark Schlitching's adaption of The Tortoise and the Hare).

The story is about a dog named Ruff, who fetches his bone that was thrown by his master.

title: Living Books: The Berenstain Bears Get in a Fight
description: The Berenstain Bears Get in a Fight is the first Berenstain Bears interactive Living Books PC game from 1995. It is based on the 1982 book written by Stan & Jan Berenstain and its adaptation of the 1985 TV series on CBS.

title: Living Books: The Berenstain Bears in the Dark
description: "The Berenstain Bears in the Dark" is an interactive educational game based on the book of the same name. It follows Brother Bear reading a scary story to Sister Bear, leading her to fear the dark. Papa Bear helps Sister Bear realize it's just her imagination, while Brother Bear eventually becomes afraid of the dark too. The game features two play modes, "Read To Me" and "Let Me Play," as well as bonus games like "Animal Match" and "Picture Jumble."

title: Living Books: Green Eggs and Ham
description: Green Eggs and Ham is the second Dr. Seuss Living Book Adaptation from Broderbund. The story features Sam-I-Am, who repeatedly asks the questions based on an object, e.g. “Would you Could you on a boat?”. This leads to his grumpy friend saying “I do not like Green Eggs an Ham”. The story gets more dramatic as it progresses. There are some activities featuring characters from the story like the Fox in a Box, and the Mouse in the House. The game features word recognition, vocabulary, reading comprehension and computer literacy. Every page is clickable for a few surprises. In Read to Me, the program automatically turns the pages leaving out the games as the story progresses.

title: Memories of a Spy
description: Collect intel, forge documents, blend in, hunt the mole. Immerse yourself in this first-person 1960s spy simulator. Work for CIA, MI6, SDECE, BND, or KGB. Defend your country or betray it, or choose to leave it all behind to live a normal life... as long as you can.

title: Lair of the Three-Headed Hydra
description:
A tragic tale of hubris and denial.

ENTER the lair. FACE the dangers. BATTLE the hydra???

title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure
description: A cozy life sim/adventure hybrid featuring Hello Kitty and Friends. Create a unique, Sanrio-style original avatar and befriend iconic Sanrio characters like Kuromi, Badtz-Maru, Cinnamoroll, Chococat, and Aggretsuko. Share gifts, complete quests, and take part in island activities to deepen your bonds. Spruce up cabins to attract new visitors from among Hello Kitty’s many friends. Create a stylish wardrobe all your own, solve mysterious puzzles, cook delectable recipes, collect friendly critters, and fish, and explore the island solo or with a friend to unearth the many secrets of a massive in-game world.

title: Sumomo Theatre
description:
This is an action game where you defeat enemies with kicks, jumps, and special moves.
Operation during the game uses a four-way controller + 3 button.
Equipped with pause and slow motion buttons.
You can choose between 2 difficulty levels to beat the 5 stages.
There is also a game mode where you can keep killing enemies endlessly.

title: Jephs Furry Adventures 7
description: An unique adult game which combines interesting logic puzzle with exciting animations of furry girls that you earn after successfully passed levels!

title: The Runaway Girl and Me
description:
My life has just started together with this runaway girl. She's naturally rather closed-off and suspicious of me at first, but as we communicate and spend more time together, she comes to open up to me.
Living costs money, so you'll need to work in order to save some money to fully enjoy your new cohabitation life.Complete goals to trigger events, and progress the story.
Along the way, you might find better ways of making money, too.
Have fun spending time with your new cohabitant.

title: Fetish Fetish Collection! DX
description: An exploration RPG consisting of fetish fetish collection! series + newly drawn characters + α!

title: Tripitaka: The Pilgrimage of Tripitaka
description: The final game by Softedge, and the spiritual successor to Cosmology of Kyoto, dealing with Chinese history rather than Japanese. Currently lost media, due to only being sold in museums hosting the 1999 Silk Road Journey To The West exhibition.

title: Prince or Villain
description: A slice of life BL about a patissier who loves to bake. Kai feels left out when Percy and Gavin grow closer with one another. One day, Lance appears into Kai's life with a plan to have him all to himself. Will Kai stay with Percy and Gavin, or will he choose Lance?

title: Rusty Robot Wants to Cry
description: Immerse yourself in the world of retro-games as a roller robot. From platformers and side-scrollers, to the legendary Arkanoid, Xonix, Digger and Snake. Jump across platforms and fight glitch bosses. Colorful graphics, effects galore, and chiptune music. Anyone but a robot would cry from nostalgia!

title: Sidecar Evolution 2024
description: The first ever true MMO sidecar racing game is here! Play with up to 39 friends!

title: Paws
description: In this unique top-down game from 1985, you are a mother cat whose twelve young kittens have wandered off into a labarinthine town prowled by fearsome dogs. Can you save them all?

title: Motorbike Evolution 2024
description: The first ever true MMO motorbike racing game is here! Play with up to 39 friends!

title: Miners Settlement
description: Explore enchanting landscapes with unique pixel art graphics. Join a guild for thrilling adventures and epic battles. Cooperate to conquer dungeons and dragons. Trade in the Open Market, master professions, and create your build. Forge friendships and shape your destiny in our immersive RPG world!

title: Formula Evolution 2024
description: The first ever true MMO formula racing game is here! Play with up to 39 friends!

title: Hentai Senpai: Cosmic Beauties
description: Hentai Senpai: Cosmic Beauties is a FREE swapping/rotating puzzle game featuring 9 sexy Cosmic Beauties!

title: IL-2 Sturmovik: Sky Nomads Campaign
description: Sky Nomads continues the story of the Soviet fighter pilot you may know from the Blazing Steppe campaign.

title: Imprecision
description: Imprecision is a first/third person, action game set in The Middle Ages. In Imprecision, you play as a lone archer, Örvar, who is training to take down The Black Knights of Bjørn and their kingdom. You are determined to defeat King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty and take back what is yours.

title: Worlds Align: Beginning - Collector's Edition
description: The game worlds are in danger, and some of your favorite characters have come together to ask an outsider for help. That's where you come in! Will you answer their call?

title: Train Sim World 3: Glossop Line - Manchester: Hadfield & Glossop Route
description: Climb aboard the Northern Class 323 “Hyper Networker” and embark on a journey in Northwest England. Magnificent Mancunian scenery comes to life along the quaint Glossop Line: Manchester - Hadfield & Glossop in Train Sim World 3!

title: The Traveller
description: Complete the mission for a secret organization and meet some hot girls and women!

title: Aether
description: Aether is a fangame of the classic indie hit, Yume Nikki. A prequel to Nihil, the game follows Hirumataiyo exploring her dreams. With her mindscape split in half, she must collect various Effects while her Shadow watches from deep within her subconscious.

title: Fantastic Dream
description: I dreamed of a girl. From then on, I saw her every day in my dreams. I don't know why it happened. I can only keep telling myself that it is all false, all illusion. But on the other hand, I fell in love with it.

title: AntiBots
description: AntiBots is an online PvP arena party game for 2-4 players where you and your friends must run, shoot and grapple to victory, all while anti-gravity switches on and off.

title: Math World VR
description: Math World VR combines fun games with simple math to exercise the brain! This STEM Accredited VR game consists of 12 fun mini-games for all ages to enjoy! Each mini game in Math World VR combines simple math that adds a fun challenge. Who said brain exercise can't be fun?

title: Bloomyth
description: Go on this journey, solve the puzzles and overcome the obstacles to discover the secret of the Bloomyth and save a life.

title: Room Map
description:
rooms in room

Room Map is a game where you explore progressively denser rooms inside an apartment that's inside another apartment.

title: R&Dy
description:
Little Alchemy meets Factorio in this genre-bending relaxing collectathon sandbox!

(Made for the Big Festive Game Jam 2022)

title: Starwulf: Seeker of Secret Space
description:
Venture into the cosmos in this unique, multi-genre space combat game. Take control of your own spaceship, shooting bricks to shatter asteroids and solve intricate puzzles. As you journey further from your home star system, the challenges grow, testing your reflexes, strategic thinking, and adaptability.

Uncover the secrets of the universe, upgrade your ship, and uncover the legendary spaceship to save your home planet. With its blend of arcade action, brain-teasing puzzles, and captivating narrative, this game offers an unforgettable space odyssey. Can you rise to the challenge and become the hero the universe needs?

title: Living Books: The Cat in the Hat
description: The Cat in the Hat is an educational game based on the Dr. Seuss book of the same name. It has the same plot of the original book. The Cat sees that Sally and her brother are bored on a rainy day. Eventually, they start having fun, but The Cat realizes he has made a big mess. The Cat uses a big vacuum to clean the whole mess up, and it ends happily ever after. The game lets you click on many things in the background, and has small mini-games during the story. The game also lets you go back to any page you want again.

title: Sludge Life: The Big Mud Sessions
description: Chop it up with BIG MUD and crew to get small glimpse of what went down prior to the events of SLUDGE LIFE 2.

title: Drinlan Yellow
description: A short adventure of five dreams, each different from the rest. Explore them to face your past and your nightmares. Accept the ritual and open your eyes.

title: Sakura Apprentice
description: Sakura Apprentice is a fantasy story set in the land of Elodia. The protagonist, Riven, is training in the capital to be a knight, under the tutelage of the stern and serious Alma. While training, however, he happens to catch the eye of Elodia’s most famous knight – the undefeated, impossibly beautiful Freyja.

title: The Lécuyer Cult
description:
You are a 21-year-old young man who receives an invitation to go to the Lécuyer mansion to find your missing friend. You head to the mansion where a cultured ceremony is taking place. You realize that you are about to experience a whole new world.
You walk through the corridors of the mansion that has been owned by the Lécuyers for several years now. You will learn the history of each character and decide whether you want to help them or not.
You will learn dark secrets and if you do it right, you will be able to enjoy the girls who are in the mansion.

title: Two Slices of Love
description:
One night you get a call, your hot girlfriend has just decided to move into your apartment.
That sounds great! But she's not coming alone, her younger sister is coming with her.
Now you have the chance to live with not just one beautiful girl, but two!
But not everything is going to be so simple.
Sister rivalry is growing day by day and you have no idea why.
Each of the girls keeps her own secrets.
As their advances become more aggressive and their desires more uncontrollable,
it's up to you to restore peace to your home, control your feelings and order pizza for dinner.​

title: The Secret Ingredient is...
description:
On his unyielding quest for employment, the MC picks up an odd job request at the townsboard from the local alchemist.

A straightforward, kinetic novel made with Ren'Py and a version of Skyrim SE, heavily modded for the creation of novels such as this one.
The game is not necessarily intended to take place in the world of The Elder Scrolls, so having played Skyrim is not required to understand the plot.
It features a few choices for dialogue variety but they do not alter the overall story, hence the kinetic novel tag.
It's primarily intended to be a one-shot story, with some light humor and romance elements.

title: Okashi Towers
description: Okashi Towers is a Halloween inspired Real Time Strategy game with Tower Defense elements. Gather candy resources to build tower units or go on offense and summon cute creatures to attack other player bases. Join with up to 8 players and choose one of the four factions that fits your play style best

title: Enigmas da Escuridão
description:
Game creates a society that fights the Obscures, people who work in the dark to create chaos in the cities of the world and you as a mystery hunter will unravel several enigmas to stop these evil events of the Obscures.

This first riddle and you're trapped in a dream that never ends and only you can crack this mystery!

title: March of the Drunken Sailors
description:
Defend the sea from the menace of these sailors, who wish for nothing more than to embark on another fishing trip. Unite the denizens of the sea to stop the coming menace before they can reach their vessel.

There are no health bars or damage numbers here, only mass. Instead of defeating an enemy through traditional means, you’ll need to push and pull your foes off the dock and into the sea to stop them from setting off to fish the sea once again.

title: Nibble: Pizza Delivery
description: Nibble: Pizza Delivery is an open-source pizza delivery game created in nine days for Game Jaaj 3.

title: Bug: Beetles Underground
description: Bug: Beetles Underground is an open-world adventure game created in nine days for Game Jaaj 6, where you live in the life cycle of beetles known as true dung beetles - walk, roll, climb, fly, do quests, race, and upgrade.

title: Etcetera
description: Etcetera is a Yume Nikki fangame. You are "Innard". You must return a lost pistol to "Etcetera". You need to find him.

title: Tides of Despair
description: After a shipwreck, you are one of the survivors. To Survive you will need to fight for your life.

title: The Pit Arcade
description: The Pit is a 2D pixel platformer with precise jumps, coin collecting and enemy encounters accompanied by a dark atmosphere and soundtrack. One or more missed moves can cost everything. Man up and defeat the evil!

title: Tetrageddon Games
description: Tetrageddon is what the internet does to people. Bring the internet to your desktop with stunning 8-bit graphics, monkeys, and a mild lack of self respect that games can be proud of today.

title: Secret Pie: Hidden Room
description: Secret Pie DLC Hidden Room~!

title: Prediction Game
description: It's a game to predict what it will say by looking at pictures and names.

title: Munchkin Digital: Unnatural Axe
description: Munchkin: Unnatural Axe shuffles up 112 new cards to help you kill monsters and take their stuff.

title: Granny Remake
description: "Granny Remake" is a scary horror game where you must escape from a sinister Granny. Test your wits, stealth, and survival skills in an intense, immersive experience. Navigate through a terrifying environment, feeling the suspense at every step.

title: Farming Simulator 22: Premium Expansion
description: Get a new map, perfect for the three new crops: carrots, parsnips, & red beet. Including 35+ specialized machines by series debutants Dewulf, Gorenc, Agrio & WIFO & more.

title: Family Adventure
description: This game in unique. It has beautiful texts. It has nice talks. You play 4 different characters which are family members. You enbark on a journey together as a family. Game has 41 quests. We are adding more.

title: 15 Minutes Dungeon
description: Can you beat the dungeon in 15 minutes? Roguelike + RTA.

title: Dungeon Defenders: Hermit Hero
description: The Hermit joins the heroes of Etheria! Harness the elements to take on the Old One's army!

title: Bounty Hunting Time
description: At a tavern It is where adventurers come together to form a team to hunt for the bounty of monsters that are dangerous to humans. This is an Action Roguelite game where you build a team and develop a character that people like to swarm with monsters that will flock to your team to crush …or not

title: Mecha Kucha Gacha Defence
description: Try your luck! Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense is a pixel gacha defense game. It is a game to smash enemies by summoning units through gacha. If you think you're running out of luck, get more units with more payments(free)!

title: Teeny Tiny Town
description:
Welcome to Teeny Tiny Town, where you can indulge your inner city planer and craft your very own bustling city! Merge, build, and watch your town flourish before your eyes.

In this captivating puzzle game, your objective is to combine three or more items on the board to construct new structures. Start with humble trees and transform them into majestic houses, and then merge those houses to create even grander residences! Unleash your creativity and witness your town grow exponentially.
As your city thrives, collect gold from your houses to unlock and acquire new items, expanding your options for development. Strategically manage your resources to maximize your town's potential.

title: Trade Mania 2
description:
Play a sequel of this amazing economic strategy game, combining the best features of economic board games with realistic settings in the world’s most fascinating great cities.
The new game has incorporated most of the suggestions received from players. It features more dynamic gameplay, sophisticated virtual competitors, and a great variety of strategic solutions.

title: Green Guy Goes Grappling 2
description: Green Guy Goes Grappling 2 is a super fast-paced platformer with a grappling hook released for desktop on June 7th, 2023.

title: Tasty Jigsaw: Happy Hour 3
description: What will you eat? We have fresh cakes and delicate ice cream, juicy burgers and hearty breakfasts, dinner parties and romantic dinners for you. No need to wash your hands before the game!

title: Home Designer Makeover Blast: Jason's Industrial Loft
