A new game mode, Arena, was introduced. It focused on combat between the two teams and brought five new maps to the game. Two other maps, Badwater Basin and Steel, were also included.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Scout Update
description:
The Scout Update was the fourth major content update for Team Fortress 2.

The update was mainly focused on the Scout. In addition to three new weapons, the class gained several unique voice responses to his new weapons and gameplay events, adding further immersion for players.

Three community-created maps (Egypt, Watchtower, and Junction) were established as official due to their outstanding quality.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Sniper vs. Spy Update
description:
The Sniper vs. Spy Update was the first two-class patch and the fifth major content pack released for Team Fortress 2.

Initially at the center of the update was the Sniper class, and the day by day progress went smoothly. An announcement on Day 4 revealed that the Spy would also benefit from the update. Each class was given three new weapons along with achievements.

title: Team Fortress 2: The First Ever Classless Update
description: The Classless Update, officially known as The First Ever Classless Update, was the first non-class specific major update. The content focus of the update differed from previous updates; instead of introducing new weapons or achievements, the Classless Update added new cosmetic items, game modes, and maps, while also delivering numerous bug fixes and minor tweaks to existing gameplay.

title: Undomestic
description: Uncover forgotten secrets on a secluded medieval island. Journey through a dynamic world influenced by time and weather. Build, battle, and unravel the enigma. Shape the destiny of this captivating adventure.

title: Little Keepers
description: What are friends for if not to defend each other from mutant plants that want to hurt you? Build your enemies, destroy your defenses and restore chaos in the garden! ... Wait, it was the other way around.

title: Tides of Dominion
description: Embark on a maritime adventure in Tides of Dominion, set amidst the rollicking waves of uncharted seas. Conquer islands, gather precious loot to upgrade your ship, and remember - in this game of nautical domination, it's either sink or swim!

title: Necrotic Haze
description: "Survive and escape an undead nightmare in this cooperative multiplayer adventure. Join forces with others, battle hordes of undead, and find the elusive way out. Teamwork is key in this thrilling fight for survival."

title: Ghost Mission
description: Inspired by stealth-action classics of the past, take control of an elite commando with the ability to turn invisible on a tense adventure where staying out of sight is the best way to stay alive, where the line between truth and fiction is always blurry, and where nothing is ever as it seems.

title: Team Fortress 2: Terrifying Team Fortress Haunted Hallowe'en Special
description: The Haunted Hallowe'en Special, officially known as the Terrifying Team Fortress Haunted Hallowe'en Special, was the first update in what would become annual Halloween events. The update was first revealed in a blog post, followed by an immediate release on October 29, 2009. Aside from fixing a few issues, the update introduced two new maps: Harvest and Harvest Event. The release of these maps was unique as it was the first time that the same map had been released in both a standard and an event variety. The patch also introduced two new hazards: the ghost of Zepheniah Mann, which was exclusive to Harvest Event, and the Pumpkin Bomb, which only appears on Halloween-themed maps. Two new cosmetics were also introduced, the Mildly Disturbing Halloween Mask and the Ghastly Gibus, as was a pack of five Halloween-themed achievements known as Scarechievements. Finally, the patch introduced the Halloween pumpkin; a special pickup item that only appears on Halloween-themed maps and randomly drops when a player is killed.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Hitori
description: "Hitori" is a puzzle in which you fill in any unnecessary numbers, making sure that the same number doesn't appear twice in the same line. Once you get the hang of it, you can feel the joy of figuring out the many various gimmicks thought up by the creator. This is a puzzle for real connoisseurs.

title: Team Fortress 2: War! Update
description:
The WAR! Update was a class update for the Demoman and the Soldier. It was the second multi-class patch, and was the sixth major content pack released.

The WAR! Update differed from previous updates by including two competitions, operating inside and outside the game. The first was announced at the start of the update; a kill tracker appeared in the HUD of anybody playing as a Demoman or Soldier, with the counter increasing each time they (as a Soldier) killed an enemy Demoman or they (as a Demoman) killed an enemy Soldier. The personal totals of each player were added to a mass tally, and with each day of the update a running total score for each side was displayed on the update page. The Soldier won with 6,406,065 total kills to the Demoman's 6,372,979, granting the Soldier the prize of an extra unlockable weapon, the Gunboats.

The second competition was the Propaganda Contest. Users were encouraged to design propaganda posters for the side of their choice, supporting either the BLU Soldier or RED Demoman. The posters were then submitted to Valve to be judged through the Propaganda Contest website. The three leading prizes were later revealed to be J.Axer's Dapper Topper, Amber's Rad As All Hell Hat, and Uncle Sam (for first, second, and third place respectively).

title: Team Fortress 2: 119th Update
description: The 119th Update was a major update released on April 29, 2010 Patch. The update was released in order to celebrate a notable milestone; the release of 119 Team Fortress 2 patches.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Mac Update
description:
The Mac Update was the first major update for Team Fortress 2 that included support for a platform other than Windows.

its main feature was providing the ability to play the game on macOS machines. The update also included a Training mode and its associated map Target, added help sections to the Loadout, Backpack and Crafting screens, and also completely overhauled the main menu. The patch also added the ability to play King of the Hill maps and Dustbowl in Offline Practice Mode against bots, and made a number of other minor changes. After the update went live, the Mac Update trailer was released as was a non-canon Apple-themed comic strip featuring the Soldier, Scout, Heavy, and Saxton Hale.

title: You Have 10 Seconds: 2023
description: A fast paced platformer where you’re spawned into a level and given 10 seconds to work out how to reach the exit without dying. 25 areas with unique level design mechanics to learn.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Engineer Update
description:
The Engineer Update was a major content update focusing on the Engineer.

Rather than announcing new content for the update regularly, new content was announced every time 25 Golden Wrenches were found. With 100 Wrenches to be found in total, there were 4 announcements prior to the final release of the update.

title: Team Fortress 2: Mann-Conomy Update
description: The Mann-Conomy Update was a major content patch for Team Fortress 2. In total, the update added 65 new items including community-contributed content from the Polycount Pack contest, new Cosmetics, weapons, Unusual effects, mini-games, tools, crates, and packs of cosmetics and weapons. The update also introduced the Mann Co. Store, Steam Wallet, and microtransaction system as well as item trading.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Second Annu-Hell Scream Fortress Hauntdead Halloween Special
description: The Second Annu-Hell Scream Fortress Hauntdead Halloween Special, then also commonly known as the Scream Fortress Update, Following the previous year's Haunted Halloween Special, the celebration established the annual Team Fortress 2 Halloween event.

title: Team Fortress 2: Australian Christmas
description:
The Australian Christmas 2011 update was a major content update for Team Fortress 2, released on December 15, 2011 Patch.

Part 1 of the major update consisted of two item sets for the Pyro and Engineer, as well as a 'double drop week' lasting from December 15 until December 21, where the rate of drops through the item drop system was increased. It also included a new map, Foundry, as well as an achievement cosmetic, the Full Head of Steam.

Part 2 added community-contributed items from the Steam Workshop, to only be obtained by unlocking a Nice Winter Crate with a Nice Winter Crate Key purchased from the Mann Co. Store. The Naughty Winter Crate contained a number of stock weapons with lights wrapped around them, including "Festive" as an added title, and required the separate Naughty Winter Crate Key to unlock.

On the night of the 21st, all players were awarded a Spirit of Giving and all premium players received one free Secret Saxton.

title: The Road to 56
description: Road to 56 is a DLC-sized addition to your Hearts of Iron experience that has been lovingly crafted by a team of dedicated fanatics. We've massively expanded the technology tree, extended the timeline to 1956, and developed some truly awesome alternate-history paths for nearly every country. Road to 56 is all about alternate history and giving you lots of options to make a new world. If you want to run a purely historical game, this is not the mod for you. New units, troop experience system, expanded difficulty modifiers, new releasable nations, more lovely laws, and a whole bunch of other things that will make you more popular at parties.

title: Millennium Dawn: A Modern Day Mod
description: Millennium Dawn is a multi-mod project set in 2000 and continues to the modern day and beyond. The mod boasts new and unique tech trees, focus trees, events, and decisions to immerse you in the intricacies of the modern era.

title: Cold War: The Iron Curtain
description:
Welcome to a new era of struggle, determination and conflict, as nations struggle to achieve independence and power. Superpowers rise from the ashes of old, with ideologies that shall determine the fate of the human race permanently. As the superpowers jockey militarily and economically for supremacy, many nations are freed from the yokes of colonial oppression, and finally the people of entire continents, have a say in determining their destiny.

War brews in East Asia yet again, and the African continent will no longer bear the immoral oppression of their people. Eastern Europe is encompassed by the Soviet sphere, and the West seeks to salvage its crumbling throne.

Will you spread your ideas across the globe peacefully, or will you tighten your bootstraps?

title: Thousand Week Reich
description: Thousand Week Reich is an alternate history mod that attempts to bring a sense of grounded, gritty realism to the age-old trope of an Axis 'victory' in the Second World War. Originally based on a series of maps by AP246/Proximexo, the TWR mod aims to explore a more grounded and ‘realistic’ version of the trope of a victorious Nazi Germany. Enter the world of TWR in 1952 and fight to hold onto the disintegrating remains of German ‘New Order’ or rise up to the task of defeating the oppressor and liberating Europe from Nazi tyranny.

title: Project F
description: "Project F" is a tactical FPS game that features 5-on-5 team battles over defensive targets on a auto-generated map. All maps are generated for each match and never to be encountered again.

title: Crazy Sprint
description: "Crazy Sprint" is a fast-paced endless running game where players take on the role of a character who constantly runs. They control the left and right directions and perform jumping actions to avoid traps and continuously collect coins. Test your reflexes and skills, and aim for the highest score!

title: Clock Tower: Rewind
description:
The Super Famicom classic, Clock Tower, is getting remastered for modern consoles.

This remaster is a collaboration effort between Capcom, Sunsoft, WayForward, and Limited Run. This remaster also marks the first time the original Clock Tower game will see an official release outside of Japan, which up until this point only had fan translations. The remastered version will utilize the Carbon Engine.

Clock Tower is a survival horror point-and-click adventure game developed and published by Human Entertainment for the Super Famicom in 1995. It is the first installment of the long-running Clock Tower series.

The story follows Jennifer Simpson as she learns the secrets of the Barrows Mansion and attempts to escape the game's antagonist, Scissorman.

Clock Tower originally released in 1995 and is not to be confused with the PlayStation 1 game Clock Tower released in 1996. The franchise only spawned four games, with the most recent release, Clock Tower 3, launching on the PlayStation 2.

title: Jurassic Park: Classic Games Collection
description:
The 8-and 16-bit era of Jurassic Park games returns!

This Carbon Engine release not only includes a lineup of classic titles but also adds new features, including save states for each game, new in-game maps, and various quality-of-life fixes that bring these games into the modern era of gaming.

The Jurassic Park Classic Games Collection includes Jurassic Park (NES, Game Boy, and SNES) and Jurassic Park Part 2: The Chaos Continues (Game Boy and SNES).

title: Tomba! Special Edition
description:
Our favourite pink-haired, high-jumping jungle boy is back!

Limited Run Games are working with creator Tokuro Fujiwara to bring the beloved platformer Tomba to modern consoles via the Carbon Engine, with a new soundtrack by the legendary FUJITA HARUMI.

title: School of Gods
description: All new gods must be trained and educated before they can be left to guide a new-born civilisation on one of the millions of inhabited planets in the galaxy. Journey to the world that has been developed to train new recruits in the intricacies and mysteries of successful civilisation development.

title: Abel
description: An uncanny liminal space themed walking-simulator.

title: Watcher of Realms
description: Explore the mystical continent of Tya and immerse yourself in a magical world with 100+ unique heroes! Build your camp, collect and manage heroes of diverse factions and races, unlock powerful faction lords, and challenge the Ancient Gods.

title: Sex in the Sky
description: Sex in the Sky - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: A Not Troll Game
description: A Not Troll Game, a pakour jump and run game where you are constantly being trolled. But, I warn you!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Hope Valley Line - Manchester - Sheffield
description: Travel to the heart of the Peak District in Train Simulator Classic and explore the picturesque Hope Valley Line from Just Trains.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Hatless Update
description:
The Hatless Update was a major content update for Team Fortress 2 and the update included changes originally tested in the Team Fortress 2 Beta such as the coaching and voting systems, Training Modes for the Demoman, Engineer, and Spy, Badlands' King of the Hill mode, and several item tweaks.

Other additions were the introduction of styles, dynamic model loading, and the association between servers and Steam IDs. Bots had their AI improved and duels were given the option of being class-specific. The painting and voice chat systems were also improved. A 'Sort by Rarity' option was added to the Backpack for sorting items.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Replay Update
description: The Replay Update was a major content update for Team Fortress 2 and the main feature of the Replay Update is the eponymous Replay tool, which allows a player to record their most recent life. The player can subsequently edit their replays to their heart's content and upload them to YouTube. In addition to the tool, a total of 13 new items were added to the game: A weapon, eleven cosmetic items, and an action item.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Über Update
description: The Über Update was a major content update for Team Fortress 2, It was heralded as "the biggest, most ambitious update in the history of Team Fortress 2." Similar to other major updates, like the Sniper vs. Spy Update and Engineer Update, the Über Update followed a four-day-long system of daily content previews, the last of which featured a new short, Meet the Medic.

title: Team Fortress 2: Manniversary Update
description: The Manniversary Update & Sale was a major update that included several new cosmetics, added a second miscellaneous slot (before hats and miscs. were Cosmetics), a new high-five taunt, and four loadout presets. All items bought via the Mann Co. Store before the update were made tradable, and all items bought after become tradable within two days of purchase. Players that logged on during the week of the update received a Manniversary Package.

title: Omaku
description: Omaku is a top down action adventure game, where you explore a huge interconnected world, without any hints or hand holding. Everything is cryptic and the game is quite challenging, so prepare to feel lost and frustrated. But if you persevere, you may find something beautiful in it.

title: Team Fortress 2: Pyromania Update
description: The Pyromania Update was a major content update for Team Fortress 2 and was released on June 27, 2012, coinciding with the release of the final Meet the Team short, Meet the Pyro.

title: Anatine
description: Anatine is a pixelated metroidvania game that contains organic musical elements. Play the flute to interact with the environment or unleash powerful magic! In the dangerous world of Avenis, battle against the Eidolons and confront powerful enemies to uncover the many secrets of this lost world.

title: Grow Light
description: A short game about a botanist banished to the moon for attempting to create sentient plant life. They move through the sections of their circular lunar base, talking to plants, drinking tea, reading old personal logs, and meditating on rejection and isolation.

title: Wogger
description: The complete story of woggers adventures is waiting for you! 12 levels lead you through woggers own world and strange creatures will appear. Sometimes it might be easy sometimes it can be very tuff to find a solution.

title: The Riftbreaker: Gold Edition
description: The Riftbreaker Gold Edition contains the core game and all available addons.

title: Corpse
description:
Explore and manage your resources in a short yet bizarre game

Wander through the streets of the town and search CORPSE fragments to lift the curse.

Check your inventory and you may find key information on how to escape this nightmare.

title: The Dunkening
description:
This is 30 minute long light horror (not that spooky in my opinion) that is not meant to be taken seriously, it's a joke game with some dumb jokes in it that hopefully will everyone enjoy it.

In game you can turn off all VHS effects and it has FoV slider from 30-120V, changing these settings may result in some graphical stuff but most likely won't.

title: Sex Story: Ruby and Hunter - Episode 4
description: An erotic Visual Novel featuring HD graphics, set in beautiful decor. The Sex Story continues with Ruby's perspective, as she decides to antagonize Hunter and test the limits of his possessiveness by fooling around with the pool boy right in front of him.

title: Sons of Saturn
description: Sons of Saturn is an adventure game focused on atmosphere and narrative, brought to life using photos of real life abandoned locations as assets. Experience both wonder and horror as you explore the underground city of Minerva, where the dead dream and memories cling to life.

title: Last Bloody Snack
description: Last Bloody Snack tells the story of a boy named Cody, who suffers from severe psychological disorders and has visions of a monster that will try to eliminate everything he hates. The game explores a strong theme, focusing on maternal responsibility.

title: InRun
description: Experience the magic of classic arcade racing with an innovative open-world multiplayer system and optional Virtual Reality support that, for the first time in a driving game, produces no motion sickness.

title: Lethal Application
description: Fly through the air in the extremely inefficient way of gun recoil. The burst mode activated by pressing two attack buttons at the same time is All health, 3x attack and significantly increase charge speed Instead, full life recovery. If you're going to die, use it and bet on the reversal!

title: Super Tank Attack
description: A super addictive arcade tank shooter from Tudou Games. Protect the enesphere, destroy the enemy.

title: Lethal Operation: Episode 1 - Healer Rugitta
description: キャラをじっくり育てながら広い世界を冒険する――。 そんなSTGがあってもいいじゃないか!! …というのがこのゲームのコンセプト。 ブレイクによって敵弾を消すことができ、 レベルと装備で強くなるので、STGが苦手な人でも凶悪弾幕ボスを間違いなく倒せるようになります!

title: Chicken Scratch
description: Chicken Scratch is a quirky multiplayer drawing game set in a bird office, where you pass on a telephone chain featuring unusual prompts, muddling doodles and wacky captions.

title: Cute Capybaras
description: Spend your time with profit and pleasure! Play the puzzle game with the cutest and friendliest animal in the entire world! Find difference on pictures with capybaras!

title: Into the Flames: Retro Fire Gear 1
description:
Fight fires like it's 1980!
This pack grants you access to retro US firefighting gear.

title: Garbage Truck Driving Simulator
description: Collect all the garbage in the city with the garbage truck and enjoy the car game.

title: Dinovaporate
description: Delay the impending doom of the dinosaurs! Destroy groups of blocks by clicking. When falling magma blocks reach bottom you lose health and a vertical row. Upgrade your block level to convert falling magma blocks to normal blocks.

title: Police Car SUV Simulator
description: Police Car SUV Simulator is a police car simulation with realistic graphics. Catch criminals, take them to the police station, and customize your vehicle with the rewards you earn.

title: Real Drift Multiplayer
description: Real Drift Multiplayer is a drifting game with realistic graphics and extensive customization options. Aim for the highest scores by competing with your opponents in single and online modes.

title: Raptoid
description: Raptoid is a gay scaly bdsm themed beat-em-up game and an homage to the classic video games of the 90s, featuring lots of kinky game mechanics, enemy grapples and a fighting system that was was developed with empowerment and fun in mind.

title: Idle Space Force: Retro Clicker
description: Idle Space Force:Retro Clicker A retro idle adventure that plays like a top down shooter! Join the Idle Space Force and take a journey through space to unique 8 bit worlds as you collect enough loot to make your way back home, upgrade your ship, and discover hidden treasure along the way!

title: Alien Invasion: RPG Idle Space
description: Do you like survival rpg adventure games or maybe role playing fun idle games? Our app Alien Invasion: RPG Idle Space is a cool mix of different genres. If you are bored at work or at home - just download our surviving alien game and enjoy amazing gameplay. Feel like an alien, discover evolution and destroy all humans!

title: Hexaduel
description: Test your number skills in this magical turn-based fighter! Cast hexes in the form of hexadecimal numbers, and block those of your opponent by converting them into decimal notation. Spar alone or with a friend, or brave the gauntlet for the ultimate hexadueling challenge.

title: Sex Simulator: Beach Resort Girls
description: A steamy sex simulation game featuring visual novel elements, high definition images and videos, and realistic-looking characters, all set in a beautiful decor. You play as a woman who has sex with three different women on her vacation at a luxury resort.

title: Magical Girl Dash
description: Magical Girl Dash is a retro arcade where you fight against the forces of evil in a runner style game. Protect the city and, most important of all, recover the stolen cakes from your favorite bakery!

title: White Flame Inna: Daughter of the Void
description: 2d hand drawn female protagonist metroidvania/soulslike game

title: Doomsday Jetlag
description: Arcade shooter at the end of the world! Play as fighter pilots fending off the aerial hordes of hell during total nuclear apocalypse, Doomsday Jetlag combines casual bullet-hell, shoot-em-up & rogue-lite elements to maximise the fun of playing through armageddon!

title: Nomifactory
description: Nomifactory (ファクトリーのみ) is a quest-driven expert pack focused on building large-scale factories, where you will put your automation skills to the test as you progress from punching trees to creative-in-survival, climbing the power tiers of GregTech: Community Edition (GTCE) and its extension, Shadows of Greg. No complicated magic systems, no forced combat or exploration: Only Factories!

title: Surface Runner
description: A narrative driven-platformer that puts the player in the shoes of an AI that is becoming more and more sentient.

title: Legends of the Eternal Flame
description: Embark on a perilous journey to rekindle the eternal flame and save the world that is falling into chaos.

title: Zombie Hunter: D-Day
description: The apocalypse is here. Zombies flood in from all sides. You have 80 days until the rescue team arrives. Your desperate struggle for survival begins now!

title: Alien War 2 DogFight
description: The best shooting game with various perspectives.

title: Zombie Arena Survival
description: Survive in an arena where more and more zombies appear and try to kill you. Kill as many zombies as possible before they kill you.

title: Nodes Escape
description: The game presents realistic game graphics through sound effects, narration and imagination. The level design is subtle and challenging, allowing players to challenge their intelligence and logic skills in solving puzzles.

title: Medved Hellraiser 2
description: Continuation of the carbon monoxide trash shooter. The player has to go through all the levels, burning enemies with a fire ax, and shooting them with a shotgun and grenade launcher musket.

title: Gaia Survivors
description: Control a variety of robots and destroy invaders from outer space in order to save the destroyed earth! "Gaia Survivors" is a 'Shoot 'Em Up' type sci-fi rogue-lite casual game with a retro-futuristic worldview.

title: PuzzleSquare
description: A Chinese traditional ink-style puzzle game.

title: MM
description: A narrative game about "a man's request for a life without regrets".

title: Mega Snake
description: Get bigger, but not all at once! You can also grow bigger. Aim for your goals, seize your opportunities, because time and failure can become your enemies.

title: Electation
description: In the game you need to pass the levels killing various creatures, some will run away from you, others on the contrary, will chase and attack you.

title: Neon Fantasy: Furries
description: Neon Fantasy: Furries is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Scratch Man
description: In this 2.5D obstacle dodging game Scratch Man is on a train home when he encounters his old enemy the Evil Squirrel, who has recently escaped from prison. After being knocked off the train it is up to you to dodge obstacles and catch up before it's too late.

title: Beast Dungeon
description:
A classic roguelike dungeon-crawler game with pixel graphics.

Fight your way through ten levels of a dungeon filled to the brim with aggressive monsters in order to take down the big, bad boss. The Lich Lord awaits you with powerful magic. Will you triumph, or will you become just another pile of ashes on the dungeon floor?

Gather equipment, spells, and skills to build your strength and defeat the ultimate challenge!

title: Fears to Fathom: Ironbark Lookout
description: Jack Nelson, a 24 year old fire lookout, transferred to a new outpost. As he settled into his new home, he couldn't shake the feeling that something was off, little did he know what was transpiring down in ironbark state park.

title: Restaurant Battle
description: Challenge yourself as a novice restaurateur in the face of existing competition. Open your establishment, decorate it according to your taste, manage staff and control purchases. Do everything to become the best, using honest and not very ways!

title: Primitive Society Simulator
description: In this game, you'll be the leader of an ancient tribe, guiding your people to explore the natural world, to hunt, and to farm. As culture and civilization prosper, you shall establish a tribal alliance, a community with a shared future of tribes.

title: Be-Yond: Kurodaishou ni Mirareteru
description:
When I woke up from the darkness, I learned that I was the legendary Devil of Darkness, that was said to have the power to destroy the universe.

The beautiful girls approach me one after another. My shout roars in space. When I pat a villain gently, he is discomposed into molecules... It seems that I have the power... But... am I really the Devil?

title: The Human Show
description: The Human Show is a spiritual successor to "The Outsiders" from the first DreadX Collection as a conflicting, collaborative asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience. Work together with other contestants to solve puzzles, avoid traps, and deal with a variety of otherworldly creatures each ‘“episode.” To keep the ratings up, the Game Master must not just torture contestants, but also collaborate with them while utilizing randomized trials and challenges every match. Plenty more are planned throughout Early Access to keep contestants expecting the unexpected.

title: The Telephone
description: The Telephone is a first-person psychological horror game that will transport you to a world governed by anxiety. You will have to explore the house in which you are locked and the mysterious town of Lonely Plain, searching for clues that can help Roberta regain her memory.

title: Kaiju Princess 2
description: Journey across the galaxy with a cute kaiju and her ravenous appetite as you collect ingredients to cook up the ultimate feast!

title: Time Breaker
description: Immerse yourself in the multidimensional universe of Desordre. Solve intricate puzzles, push the boundaries of 4-dimensional thinking. Get ready for a unique experience where reflection takes on a whole new dimension

title: Bloodecay
description: In the Land of Elworth, a plague called erosion emerged. It corrupts all life, brings pain and destruction ---- Becoming the knight idonia, who accepts the bloodthirsty brand, annihilat the plague claws, and destroy the ancient evil.

title: Flowfall
description: Unique puzzle/arcade game where you must fit the correct shapes into the correct gates as you fall.

title: BlazingAngel Mistletear
description: Become a transforming heroine and use various attacks and sweet combos to defeat enemies and monsters, and save your younger sister in this side-scrolling action game!

title: Doctor Cat
description: Reflect as you have fun with stories about a group of cats who after being cornered by the problems in there lives decide to go to Doctor Cat. Solve adorable jigsaws while uncovering the story of there patients

title: Makabaka
description: This is a third-person pronoun grass cutting game, a unique magic girl theme game, with the background set in a mysterious autumn forest. The player will play the role of a magical girl with a natural magical talent, facing the threat of ghoul appearing in the forest

title: Moorhuhn: Winter-Edition
description: The legendary chicken hunt returns with a snowy twist! Dive into 90 seconds of fast-paced fun, secrets, and laughs. Perfect for players of all ages! Enjoy

title: Johnny Trigger: Lunatic DLC
description:
Move into action and let your enemies taste the power of Showtime gun!
Customize your appearance with Lunatic skin and pick up a new unique weapon now!

This DLC unlocks the Lunatic skin and the unique weapon Showtime.
On the Nintendo Switch this pack also includes 3000 gems (to buy other currencies) and 75 additional puzzles to unlock more comic graphics.

title: Twinkle Star Knights
description: Twinkle Star Knights is Bishoujo RPG based on the Japanese visual novel Twinkle Crusaders developed by Lillian and released in September 2008. The project is supervised and planned by game artist Rei Kannagi from Creative Team Kuma-san.

title: Five Nights at Starry
description: Can you survive all five terrifying nights at STARRY? Five Nights at Starry is a horror fan game based on Five Nights at Freddy's and Bocchi the Rock!

title: Johnny Trigger: Butcher DLC
description:
Move into action and let your enemies taste the power of Vengeance gun!
Customize your appearance with Butcher skin and pick up a new unique weapon now!

This DLC unlocks the Butcher skin and the unique weapon Vengeance.
On the Nintendo Switch this pack also includes 15 keys to open locked doors in base and 50 hammers to unlock another upgrades in base

title: Laxius Party
description: 2005, the year Blades of Heaven was released on Windows. Made by Laxius Power and published by Laxius Power, this role-playing (rpg) game is available for free.

title: Johnny Trigger: Avenger DLC
description:
Move into action and let your enemies taste the power of Hurricane gun!
Customize your appearance with Avenger skin and pick up a new unique weapon now!

This DLC unlocks the Avenger skin and the unique weapon Hurricane.
On the Nintendo Switch this pack also includes 35000 money (to buy or draw weapons and skins in shops) and 1500 gems to buy other currencies.

title: Johnny Trigger: Hunter DLC
description:
Move into action and let your enemies taste the power of Triforce gun!
Customize your appearance with Hunter skin and pick up a new unique weapon now!

This DLC unlocks the Hunter skin and the unique weapon Triforce.
On the Nintendo Switch this pack also includes 25 keys to open locked doors in base and 75 puzzles to unlock more comic graphics.

title: GoldenLand
description: GoldenLand is a PvP strategy card game inspired by the classic GWENT

title: Extermination Day
description:
Extermination Day is a ZDoom map pack that uses many zdoom features, and allows the player to freely make use of jumping, crouching and even rocket jumping without worrying about breaking the game flow.
The maps are specially aimed at Zandronum's online cooperative play. All maps will have 8 player start locations so a lot of people can join without causing telefrags at the start, and all maps will have almost twice as much monsters in multiplayer. Some maps will also feature Deathmatch and maybe Invasion versions.

This wad will also feature a hidden ending, that can only be achieved by finishing the game on the Ultra-Violence skill or higher.

title: Waste Labs
description:
You are the last space marine at the Nuke Testing base on the Moon all of your friends are dead and you only have a pistol, so what are you gonna do about it?

Waste Labs is a megawad for Doom 1 with 3 episodes.

title: Alterlight
description: After the land has been plagued by a mysterious presence that has sucked all the color out of it, you must help Ash to unlock his powers and restore the color using the crystalline scepter, use your special character abilities to solve the unique puzzles laid ahead of you and be a hero.

title: Pause To Play
description: A puzzle game where the role of the pause menu is reversed!

title: Strange Investigations: Secrets Can be Deadly - Collector's Edition
description: Join Dane, the intrepid investigator, as she unravels the truth and grapples with what to believe in this haunting story from imagination to reality!

title: Underworld Adventures
description: Underworld Adventures is an excellent 2D adventure game, with RPG elements, in which you need to destroy an ancient evil and free your country from terrible monsters.

title: Fung
description: Nurture your mesmerizing slime mold and dive into the depths of a radiation-soaked realm, harnessing its energy. Whatever you do, do not stop feeding the Fung!

title: Heros and Monsters
description: Auto Battler, Clicker, Idle Game

title: Wizard World
description: World of Wizards: Fighting the Morvagore Demon of Hell offers rich graphics, captivating plot and exciting gameplay that provides hours of adventure and entertainment. Will players be able to defeat Morvagora and save the world from destruction? It depends on their skills, courage and determination!

title: Scopaesthesia
description: Join your friends or go it alone in this cooperative horror game. Collect pieces of evidence to uncover a mysterious disappearance, all while an unknown entity lurks in the shadows. Venture through a variety of environments, gathering what you can to progress and complete your objective...

title: Causal Effect
description: This is a text-based deduction game. Your choices will change the development of events, make up different timelines, and lead to different endings. Your primary task is to sort out the cause-and-effect relationships between events from textual descriptions.

title: As I Began to Dream
description: As I Began to Dream is an enchanting puzzle-platformer that merges a unique environment manipulation mechanic. Utilize this power to navigate dream worlds, solve puzzles, and aid Lily's escape from her dream realm.

title: Zombiolence
description: A rotten world, in which despair and extreme survival come together in order to end the largest plague of Zombies ever seen. Face them all, in order to save humanity from its end. Buy, improve and plan a strategy to kill each and every one of them. Do you have what it takes to get it?

title: Thriller Garden
description: Inspired by Vampire Survivor. you need to complete various tasks in the raging waves of monsters. During the mission process, you can choose appropriate enhancement options from 120+ unique non-numerical upgrade options to amplify the character's advantages or cover up the disadvantages.

title: Stoneman's Adventure
description: Enter an island full of puzzles and secrets as a stoneman and explore by harnessing the power to generate and manipulate stones. The gameplay is an unique combination of sokoban and one-line drawing.

title: Save Room: The Merchant
description: Immerse yourself in the Save Room, a place of safety and respite. Master inventory management while interacting with the enigmatic merchant. Buy, sell, and acquire crucial items to conquer every challenge. Not only will you need cash, but you'll need GUTS to finish this game!

title: I am Rabbit
description: 3D Flatformer Cute Adventure Rabbit Game Traverse captivating landscapes from forests to cities, seas, skies, and even the moon itself ! Enjoy charming low-polygon graphics ! Overcome challenging traps!

title: Battlepopes
description: Battlepopes is a multiplayer online 2D MOBA in a sidescrolling arena, featuring cooldown-based combat. Stuck in hell forever, as punishment for their wicked lives, ancient Popes and Antipopes fight in the eternal inferno. Come rot.

title: SeaFeud
description: SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game where players ride on a variety of fast fish. Swap fish mid-race to dynamically change your abilities, items, and stats. With eight different characters and three different courses to select from, players can have endless fun racing the seas.

title: A Normal Home in Ohio
description: A fabulous puzzle house escape game where you can experience Horror and Comedy together.

title: Screams from the Past
description: Uncover the dark past of an orphanage, gather clues and evidence, solve puzzles, and unveil the truth in a gripping suspense game. Your main mission is to unravel the mystery. Get ready for shocking revelations as you immerse yourself in the intriguing and chilling atmosphere.

title: Emergency Crew 3: Perfect Getaway - Collector's Edition
description: Our heroes are finally taking their well-deserved vacation to a chic tropical paradise! But alas, a major earthquake interrupts their vacation before it even starts and turns a secluded tourism destination into an isolated disaster area.

title: Exoprimal: Deluxe Edition
description: Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts - dinosaurs.​​

title: Days End: Becoming Blackbird
description: Becoming Blackbird is a story about how the player joined the blackbirds when has no where else to go to.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Even Immortality Ends
description:
Version 1.2 of Honkai: Star Rail, which included:
• New characters: Blade, Kafka and Luka
• New main story quest: Topclouded Towerthrust
• New areas: Alchemy Commission and Scalegorge Waterscape
• New companion missions for Kafka and Yukong
• New events, including Tales of the Fantastic,Underground Treasure Hunt and Where Are You, Mystery Trotter?
• …and more!

title: Sorry, We Have A Policy
description: A short and unhappy game about trying to get trans healthcare. The goal is to try to get to the front of the line without dying.

title: 20 Doors
description: 20 Doors is an exploration, action and puzzle solving adventure where strange events and environments make you question your sanity.

title: Hearthstone: Titans
description: Hearthstone: Titans is the 24th major expansion to Hearthstone, introducing powerful Titans, Legendary Keepers and upgradeable Forge cards. "Titans" introduces 145 new cards to Hearthstone, with the titular Titans being the most important ones.

title: Team Fortress 2: Mecha Update
description:
The Mecha Update was a major update for Team Fortress 2 released on December 20th, 2012.

The update was announced on December 19, 2012. It announced the addition of the final class in Mann vs. Machine, the Mecha-Engineer, as well as the map Bigrock. It further included the comic Shadow Boxers, and announced the addition of the Rescue Ranger, Loose Cannon, and the Vaccinator, new weapons for the Engineer, Demoman and Medic, respectively. Finally, the update announced the return of Nice and Naughty Winter Crates.

title: Team Fortress 2: Robotic Boogaloo
description: Robotic Boogaloo was a major content update for Team Fortress 2, released during the May 17, 2013 Patch. It was the first ever community-created update, with 57 different community-created cosmetics being added into the game. The 57 cosmetics added are robotic versions of ordinary TF2 cosmetics, spanning all classes. Along with this, 10 new robot-related Unusual effects, 4 new action items - the Battery Canteens, Pallet of Crates, Random RoboKey Gift and Pile of RoboKey Gifts - and one tool - the RoboCrate Key - were added to the game.

title: Hypercoven
description: RTS with focus on large and fast battles. Units are free, make the most of them

title: Attachment Not Found
description: Attachment Not Found is a horror game where your sister goes missing and you decide to explore her myspace page to find out why.

title: Don't Die Alone
description: After receiving an unremarkable spam message, an outcasted teen's friend count becomes the difference between life or death.

title: Wart's Turn-Based Revenge
description: What if Mario 2 was a turn-based strategy game? Well now you don't have to wonder. Give it a shot! Control Mario, Peach, Toad and the Green one. Find advantageous cover and attack the enemies! Stop on a plant to automatically toss it an an enemy for extra damage. Fight through 23 levels with 5 boss fights! Completing all levels takes 2-3 hours. 3 different level completion modes are available: Defeat All, Reach Area, and Defeat Boss. Saving is only supported in the downloadable version.

title: Johnny Trigger: Johnnybee DLC
description:
Move into action and let your enemies taste the power of Bulletstorm gun!
Customize your appearance with Johnnybee skin and pick up a new unique weapon now!

This DLC unlocks the Johnnybee skin and the unique weapon Bulletstorm.
On the Nintendo Switch this pack also includes 100 hammers to unlock other upgrades in base and 25 puzzles to unlock more comic graphics.

title: Don't Turn Your Back On The City
description: This is a short-ish map, maybe ten minutes? Very linear. Possibly a bit trite. Though difficulty settings are supported, I have a feeling UV may be a little underwhelming for seasoned players. I thought best to err on the side of generosity. I specifically restricted myself to only using Doom II textures, though I did use a track from the Ultimate Midi Pack ("Dread Factory" by MFG38).

title: Dust Devil
description: In the middle of street riots, you dodge motor officers, lasers, orbital beams and break cell mufflers on your hyper bike. The game is super fast and difficult: it has time limit and just a few checkpoints on your way to boss fights. With just one mouse button you control a swarm of bikers or a single agile rider. Your skills and tactics are that matters on each level.

title: Decadence
description: Decadence, a psychological horror game, is an immersive experience full of nerve-racking events that will make you question reality itself. As you look forward to your wedding anniversary with your wife, what is this unnerving presence that keeps chasing you around?

title: Johnny Trigger: Hotshot DLC
description:
Move into action and let your enemies taste the power of Sawed-off gun!
Customize your appearance with Hotshot skin and pick up a new unique weapon now!

This DLC unlocks the Hotshot skin and the unique weapon Sawed-off.
On the Nintendo Switch this pack also includes 2500 gems to buy other currencies and 25 keys to open locked doors in base.

title: Deppart Prototype
description:
Deppart is an indie first-person horror game with shooter elements.

Be very careful, enemies kill you with one hit.

title: Total Control
description: Total Control is a text based NSFW god complex game. In this game you will have supernatural powers combined with RPG elements that will give you Total Control over the world.

title: Suspended in Dusk
description: A set of four levels, which all push the limits of the good ol' vanilla Doom.

title: Ultimate Simplicity
description: Ultimate Simplicity is a megawad comprised of 3 episodes, including 30 maps. It is essentially an overhauled version of the original Simplicity, with vast improvements made overall. See the NOTES section for more detailed information.

title: Doom Raider: Crypt of the Vile
description: A single player level for ZDoom.

title: Ni'mRoD
description: This PC was from the beginning meant to be mainly DM maps for up to 32 players DeathMatch, as it progressed though it became mainly focused on SP and COOP. Some DM features are included but some maps are very poorly supported for this. Map01-04 should be the best though. There's some new monsters aswell as 7 all new weapons.

title: Caverns of Darkness
description:
The final rift was closed and the Hell War was over at last. The citizens of the Earth celebrated for the first time in almost six years. The forces of Hell had been beaten. Humanity had won. Now began the long process of burrying the dead and rebuilding, but the nations of Earth were united now, and they were willing to work together to usher in a golden age of peace.

However, all was not as well as it had seemed, for six months later, more Hellspawn began to appear and the air was once again heavy with cries of pain and screams of death. The war was not over yet, after all. You were stationed at the top secret military base when the source of the latest demonic invasion was pinpointed. Once again, the Marine Coprs was called upon to do battle with the damned. Your recon platoon was the first to go in.

The target location was a mining facility owned by the UAC. At least, officially, it was a mining facility, but upon investigation, it became clear that more had been going on here than mining. The place was abandoned, yet the machinery was in full operation. There simply were no people there. There seemed to be no Hellspawn, either. Once the area was secured, attention was turned to the mines. Half of the platoon went in to investigate and you were ordered with the other half to keep the area secure.

About thirty minutes later, the telemetry from the team in the mines was blocked by an energy surge, and suddenly, you and your buddies were surrounded by Hellspawn. They literally came out of nowhere, biting and snarling, and no matter how many you and the others blasted, more seemed to fill the gaps.

When ammo was running low, you and the other marines took cover. Somehow, you got separated from the others, and when all was quiet, you came out to see what had happened. Of the Hellspawn and your buddies, there was no sign, except for a trail of blood leading into the mines. With the sun setting red at your back, you stood looking at the mine entrace which under the fiery glare looked like the gaping maw of some Hellish beast waiting to devour you alive.

Screwing your courage to the sticking place, you draw your pistol, the only weapon you have left, and enter the Mine...

title: Mayan Mishap
description:
Five maps, loosely Mayan in setting, with an assortment of DeHacked changes to alter monster behavior and a few other things. Notably, some monsters and projectiles are faster than their vanilla counterparts. If you typically play maps on UV, I would definitely recommend HMP for your first playthrough to avoid any potential frustration. Similarly, if you usually play on HMP by default, dropping the difficulty down to HNTR would probably be a good idea. UV is certainly doable on a first playthrough though, if you fancy yourself a challenge.

MBF-compatible port is needed for play. (G)ZDoom recommended, but also designed to work in PrBoom+ at complevel 11.

title: Monster Hunter Ltd: Part I
description:
The world is full of monsters and you are working for the Monster Hunter Ltd company.
Your job is to bring back a stolen valuable painting. The trace leads you to an
industrial complex - there you start...

title: Monster Hunter Ltd: Part II
description:
After a deep sleep you wake up not immediately being aware
that the monsters came back during the night...

title: Forsaken Overlook
description:
This map is one of the many parts of the Secret Santa Imitation Project, led by Brian "Snakes" Knox. It was meant to imitate the style of Chris "lupinx-Kassman" Kassap, and is designed for Single Player, Co-op, and Deathmatch play.

A lonely medieval outpost overlooking a large sea sits on the edge of the world. In it lies a magical sword of power, waiting to be taken by a brave adventurer. But be warned - rumor has it that the sword was sealed away in order to keep an alleged curse placed on it at bay...

title: Putrefier
description: A single GZDoom map for Doom 2, not only raises the bar but megablasts it up to "how the hell is that even possible?" heights. Putrefier is set in an imposing UAC facility filled with shadows, beasties, and architecture straight out of an idTech 3 game. As you descend into the base, things get weirder, with creepy malfunctioning technology and demonic spaghetti crawling out of the walls in a sickeningly cool manner. There are no fanciful scripted cutscenes, but the thick atmosphere of the map suggests that the experience is part of a larger narrative than what's visible on the surface (a notion heavily reinforced by the set-up to a brilliantly-done boss battle).

title: Arcadia Demade
description:
Typically when you ship a big game you get some time off to relax, take a step back and enjoy life.

Of course, I had to do something very silly with some of this time. So I did a remake of a BioShock level for… wait for it… Doom 2.

Inspired partly by TIGSource’s amazing Bootleg Demakes Competition, I used a modern Doom level editor called SLADE to recreate Arcadia and the Farmer’s Market, the sections of BioShock on which I was the primary designer. It’s a monster of a level, crammed full of weird little BioShock-to-Doom transmutations and symbolism.

title: Hell Ground
description: Hell Ground is a seven-level mapset by Alexander S. (Eternal), released on November 15, 2009. It requires a Boom-compatible source port with support of hi-res textures, tall patches and OGG music; the author recommends an OpenGL-compatible port such as GLBoom or GZDoom. It is set in a variety of gloomy and surreal locales, and features moody music taken from American McGee's Alice.

title: Corrupted Cistern
description: Clear the ancient water caverns of the evil Hellspawn

title: Arrival
description:
9 + 1 (+ 1?) limit-removing levels for Doom II. Designed with stock Doom II resources in mind, utilizing the lovely skies provided by Mek's "box o' skies".

You may see a familiar space or two I implore you treat them as if they were new For the love from which these lands are derived Has been waiting patiently for you to arrive

May your heart's true will Be ultimately fulfilled For eternity

title: Infraworld: Coma Moonlight
description:
An experimental gothic-style map originally created as part of the Refracted Reality project. The central idea is a temple built on a huge piece of rock floating in an abyss with an abundance of vertical gameplay. Due to pursuit of the architectural complexity, in the spirit of Quake, map has performance problems.

The player's goal is to explore temple complex and find 3 runes. After installing them on the pedestals to open the exit and leave map. I'm sure sometimes players will find short cuts. Note that these are not bugs (although they were originally), since do not break the map progression.

title: Doki Doki Tutorial!
description: ‘Doki Doki Tutorial!’ is a mod that finally gives a proper tutorial for upcoming modders, expanding on the Modding Template and the subreddit’s modding tutorial.

title: Unhallowed
description:
This was meant to be a map of a much larger map pack, but I've decided to focus on another big project instead of focusing on making 1-hour long maps after the other, which was burning me out a little bit.

This is not my style of map usually, I just felt like doing something pretty Sunder-y for once to see if I can manage a grander scale of map without a hitch.

title: Arceon
description:
Arceon is a boom compatible mapset consisting of 6 medium length maps plus an epilogue map, mainly consisting of techbase themed maps, with different themes based on the light color of each map

Each of the maps was built with an emphasis on having layouts that encourage incidental combat from monsters and are easy to navigate, filled along with several combat setpieces.

title: Cydonia
description:
22 Plutonia maps created by @AD_79 and myself. Complevel 4/limit removing format.

Designed to try and emulate Casali mapping with old school compact, high impact maps.

title: Gods & Guardians
description:
So, I've decided to add proper beginning and boss fight maps to make a complete 6 map episode.

It's a tribute wad - stiles of different mappers were projected thru the prism of author's memories and
reflections. In the end you get 'Doom the way you did'.

-6 (+1 bonus) classic DooM2 maps, mostly adventurous, no slaughter (almost)
-stock textures only (except new sky and waterfall)
-new music (from "Rock It!".wad series)
-maps are mostly vanilla, some maps break save game limits
-new status bar by galileo31dos01

-bonus map includes a really bad joke.. Or does it not?

title: Three's a Crowd
description: A rogue-lite physics based match three!

title: Running Late 2
description: 16-ish Boom compatible levels. ZDoom based ports will have to level warp in order to access the secret levels, since Map14 sends you to the EndDoom screen. BOOM ports can access these maps regularly from Map15.

title: BGPA Missions Liberation
description: A (very) mini TC consisting of 5 maps comprising one mission

title: Escape from Castle Chezcrea
description: A linear, challenging level that shows off some some neat ideas I had.

title: Back to Basics
description:
After making a large map with slopes, scripts, all new resources and whatnot, I felt like making something very basic.

Also used this opportunity to get some maps that were gathering dust finished and released; a very old episode 2 project (although I have released e2m1 of that project before as e2m1er.wad), and a project for EDGE that got to 1½ levels (Rust). The maps were converted to use vanilla resources only (except for the sky).

E2M5-E2M9 however are brand new levels for this release. The wad is tested to be vanilla compatible, though during mapping it has mainly been tested with ZDoom for convenience's sake. Also found to work with Eternity. But as it is vanilla compatible, any port should work.

title: Thunderpeak
description:
These are my two maps "Thunderpeak powerplant" and "Termination" from the recently released Zpack community project!

Since there seem to be quite some interest in it, I decided to release those two maps as a standalone project.

title: Sine Die
description:
map01: mainly rusty metal, tech; map02: clean tech base, a bit hellish

Your mission: Seek three mystical skulls. Use their collective power to destroy the Source of Evil.

Notes: I recommend to play map02 from pistol start. No jumping.

title: Beluga
description: Tech-Base

title: Genesis of Descent
description: A large map for the original Doom that uses a huge amount of scripting and ZDoom features while attemptimg to retain classic and fast paced Doom action.

title: Phocas Island 2
description:
A different kind of experience, focused more on puzzles and individual encounters.
It is a remake of the first Phocas Island. I decided to do a remake because I felt
the first one was lacking in areas and was rushed towards the end. It features large
multi-path levels, with lots of scripting, not even one original monster (although some
are only slightly modified from the original).

title: ic2005
description: The likely final map in the ic200x series. A huge sprawling techbase with textures from a variety of sources.

title: Vae Victus 2
description: Vae Victus II is an all new level set for Doom 2 utilizing new graphics and music. The episode consists of 7 levels of varying themes and difficulty. The first Vae Victus was an attempt to honor the traditional gameplay of Alien Vendetta and other classic megawads; however, VV2 is a more balanced approach that provides challenging battles without the swarms of roaming enemies. The architecture is improved over last year's offering, and is more refined in it's concept and design. I am a classic doomer at heart, so I decided to keep this wad compatible with every source port that allows for limit removing. Co-op play is also supported, as are difficulty settings. In addition, every map can be beat from pistol starts.

title: Frozen Time
description:
You need an OpenGL port with support of ZDoom extended nodes, hi-res textures and tall patches.

GLBoom-Plus with gamma 1 is recommended.

title: UAC Invasion: The Supply Depot
description: The map is about a marine who must infiltrate a UAC Corporation large base because there are indications that dangerous secret experiments related to portals and Satanism are taking place. The protagonist is hidden in a truck of the UAC that goes to the complex getting to enter without major problems. But once inside the facilities he realizes that something terrible has happened there, it seems that he is not the only unexpected visitor...

title: Maskim Xul
description: A set of 3 Boom-compatible maps for Doom II (with a decidedly Lovecraftian theme to the second and third), with epilogue maps on MAP04 and MAP30.

title: Umbra of Fate
description:
Like my last mapset, Shadows of The Nightmare Realm, the premise is inspired by H.P. Lovecraft. The story takes place many years before Doom 1, and revolves around a man (NOT the Doomguy) who is on vacation and is out enjoying a day of hunting while his wife and infant son are at home. After a long and boring day, he starts walking back to his car, only to discover a ravine that wasn't there before. Feeling an unusually strong urge to find out what lurks beyond the ravine, he jumps down into it and heads out into the dark, foggy forest night. The rest of the story is told in the level itself through additional (skippable) text.

Umbra of Fate an experimental map, where I tried to push the type of gameplay that I personally enjoy to the limit rather than trying to include something for everyone. So expect an emphasis on dark, spooky areas; intense colored lighting; an emphasis on fights with a smaller number of tough enemies; a mix of Quake, Doom 64, and Doom 3 inspired map design; and interesting boss fights. It's also one giant level, conceptually split into four areas that are roughly equal to one level each.

title: Void And Rainbow
description: As once listening to Annihilator and playing one old game, I thought: what if I make mountains hovering in space that will shimmer with the colors of the rainbow? As a result, having threatened for one year and one month to some extent, I realized what I had planned. It was difficult for me alone to do everything, and so I called for help TheSkyBug, who made weapons, some monsters, and a bunch of different trifles, and also ZZYZX, who made a new lighting system. Big thanks to them. Also thanks to ChaingunnerX, DOOMGABR, Dagamon, VladGuardian and other people for help of various kinds - without you this wad would come out much later.

title: Legacy of Heroes
description: Legacy of Heroes is a Boom compatible episode for Doom 2 with 11 levels. The maps use the textures from Eternal Doom and the themes for the most are fantasy oriented. The maps also feature a more adventurous style and the level progression was made to make feel the episode like a continuous journey. Some levels are very long and all of them were desgned with pistol starts in mind.

title: Alpha Accident: Terra Nova
description: Alpha Accident: Terra Nova has not only new maps, textures and music but also new things. Also there are new monsters (boss included), and a new (barely) map hazard - voltage... Maps in this episode are quite large and more of an andventure sort than anything else, but there's enough monsters to shoot at.

title: Nihility: Infinite Teeth
description: A vanilla E2 replacement/PC for Ultimate Doom. It's called Nihility and I'll hopefully one day expand it into a full 36-level megawad. It's an old-school style wad with some new and replaced monsters and weapons, inspired by the Alphas/Beta but also old-school 90's partial conversions aka Strain. If you like DTWID, No End In Sight, Monti's favillesco and erkatane episodes, and Doom: The Lost Episode then you might enjoy this. If you don't like abstract, explorational and moody maps (and graytall) you should probably steer clear.

title: Team Fortress 2: Mann vs. Machine - Two Cities Update
description: The Two Cities Update was a major update for Team Fortress 2 that was announced on November 20, 2013 and released the following day.

title: Team Fortress 2: Love & War Update
description: The Love & War Update, known colloquially by the fanbase as the Bread Update, was a major update for Team Fortress 2 that was announced on June 17, 2014. It brought a total of 5 new weapons, 4 reskins, 44 cosmetic items, 11 item sets, 29 achievements, 6 startup themes, and 15 taunts.

title: Team Fortress 2: End of the Line Update
description: The End of the Line Update was a major community-created update. It brought one new multi-class weapon, 23 new cosmetics, a new Pyro taunt, as well as a collection of items for leaderboard tracking.

title: Combat Spec Ops
description: Combat Spec Ops is a team-based, tactical TPS (Third Person Shooter) based on close quarters combat and objective-oriented multiplayer gameplay. Bring back retro multiplayer gameplay where skill is rewarded, and teamwork matters!

title: Lipsync Killers
description: Lipsync Killers is a music RPG game for PC and mobile devices. Choose your drag, and do your best to perform on stage. Collect coins and diamonds to upgrade your attributes and get new skins with themed looks. Complete extra quests to get even more chances to acquire upgraded items and characters.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Gun Mettle Update
description:
The Gun Mettle Update was a major update that introduced weapon skins, 4 new maps, and 3 new taunts. It also introduced the ability to pick up weapons from the ground from fallen players, as well the Gun Mettle Campaign, a three-month event allowing players to complete skill-based contract challenges to unlock one-of-a-kind weapons and exclusive weapon cases. To participate in the Gun Mettle Campaign, players had to obtain the Gun Mettle Campaign Pass, which was available for purchase in the Mann Co. Store.

Additional content was further added in the August 27, 2015 Patch with the introduction of the Gun Mettle Cosmetic Case.

title: The Alfonzone
description: The Alfonzone contains 50 levels divided into 10 episodes with unique themes inspired by Alfonzos speedmidis.

title: Eternal Doom IV: Return from Oblivion
description: All maps are: (i) medieval-themed, and generally very large compared to typical DooM maps; (ii) non-linear and feature multiple paths; (iii) feature castle and fortress architecture, fights on an epic scale, and magnificent vistas. Maps 08-10 can be played in any order within the hub, and powerups & enemies are different in any given map depending on whether you play it first or play it after entering from another map. This provides additional replay value.

title: Dark Universe
description:
5 maps for GZdoom/Doom2.

Small to Medium sized maps. Maps can be completed rather quickly (just find the switch that opens the exit and then find the exit), with lots of secrets, switches, scripted events, and hidden areas full of the stuff you might need to survive the next map. HMP and UV difficulties available.

No jumping/crouching. Mouse-look encouraged.

title: Gynogenesis: The Next Day
description: Gynogenesis explores a remote government base in the arctic through the shoes of an aging animal TV show star. Explore the heart of darkness lurking beneath the ice.

title: Chungo's Gauntlet
description: Fight through 70+ stages of retro action and strange internet culture, as you make it through Chungo's Gauntlet. There'll be many traps, strange enemies and strong bosses waiting for you.

title: Children of the World
description: Children of the World is a 2D adventure indie game displayed in a 3D world with puzzles, platforms, music, and minigame elements based on the movie Boy and the World.

title: The Trade Prince
description: The Trade Prince is a logistical economic simulation game in which you build automated trade networks across multiple planets to produce increasingly complex goods.

title: Worldwide Battle Royale
description: Battle royale game with realistic world maps and characters.

title: Ecstasy / Light / Inertia
description: "Ecstasy / Light / Inertia" is a short immersive journey that redefines music engagement. Play as Luz, navigate through stunning landscapes, and unravel an intricately woven narrative. With original music, philosophic themes, and state-of-art HRTF audio, it's a free, story-centered music adventure.

title: Daycare Descent
description: Daycare Descent is a co-op shooter inspired by Left 4 Dead. Take control of our four trepid adventurers as they battle toys throughout the daycare in search of snacks. Tighten your diapers, grab your pacifiers, and fill up your water guns. Playtime's just begun!

title: Mugen Sweeper
description: Evolved minesweeper. Infinitely zoomable board. Portal gimmick.

title: Shroom & Doom
description: A top-down tower-defense game where you play as a little robot that has crash landed on an alien planet. Defend yourself against waves of bug-like enemies using towers made from the local mushrooms. Find a way to repair your ship and escape the planet!

title: Bloody Steel
description: 10 level's wad for boom.The action takes place in the modern world of alternative

title: Sigma-X
description: Sigma-X is a GZDoom episode consisting in 10 maps using the full power of the OTEX textures made by Ukiro that will recreate different themes ranging from the classic tech bases to hell and void themes.

title: Shadows of The Nightmare Realm
description:
The premise is Lovecraft-inspired, but not part of any of Lovecraft's universes. The story takes place not long after Doom 2, where Hell was defeated by the Doomguy. What no one knew was that there was a far greater and nigh inconceivable evil lurking beyond our realm: the Elder Gods. They saw how Hell had failed and felt it was now their time to succeed. They knew of the Doomguy's strength, and so decided to attack him in the one place he's vulnerable: in his nightmares. Thus, SoTNR takes place within the dreams of the Doomguy, each one manipulated by the Elder Gods.

The gameplay is pretty straightforward, with Doom-style exploration and combat. One difference is that your inventory is cleared and your health reset at the start of each map. After all, each one takes place in a separate dream :-P There are six total maps: three main levels, one secret level, one boss level, and a Quake-style start map.

title: Blood Samurai
description: After hundreds of years of civil war, the Blood Samurais of the Kanagi clan had secured victory at hand and the unification of the Eastern Empire was only a matter of time.

title: Only One Way Up
description: Reach new heights in a mysterious world above the clouds, full of secrets to explore. Ascend on your journey and get as high as possible in Only One Way Up! Step up into a realm way above the clouds..

title: Lost Forest
description: Experience the beauty of nature and embark on a serene adventure in Lost Forest. Uncover the mysteries, find solace, and immerse yourself in this enchanting world. Are you ready to get lost?

title: Ambush Tactics Advanced
description: A simple modern medieval tactics RPG.

title: L'Angolo Di Farenz: Avventure Vampiresche
description: "In "Avventure Vampiresche" Farenz faces morning obstacles in an epic race through Cremona at 5 o'clock in the morning! Dodge ducks, spitballs, runners, and more to close the rings in time! Get ready for a frantic and enjoyable experience!"

title: Fortnite: Season 1
description: Season 1 was the first iteration of player progression in Battle Royale. Players could buy 4 Items in the Item Shop after earning enough XP. It started on October 26th 2017 and concluded on December 13th 2017.

title: TNA vs. ROH
description: Clash between ROH and TNA in this WWF No Mercy mod

title: Oppidum
description: Face the challenges of Oppidum, a cooperative multiplayer adventure. Collaborate, craft, fight, and dive into a captivating story to uncover a powerful truth. A world hanging by a thread needs your help – will you answer the call?

title: Rocket Horizon
description: Rocket Horizon is a game where you control a rocket to dodge obstacles on different planets.

title: Bug Bite!
description: Bug Bite is an exhilarating game that puts players in the paws of a courageous squirrel on a mission to conquer a bug-infested forest. As the nimble squirrel dashes through lush environments, players must skillfully jump, slide, and use power-ups to defeat swarms of pesky bugs while collecting nuts for extra points. With vibrant visuals, challenging levels, and an infectious soundtrack, Bug Bite offers a captivating adventure for players of all ages. Get ready to embark on an epic squirrelly quest and prove your bug-bashing prowess in this action-packed, critter-crushing extravaganza!

title: Trishu-Drift
description: Trishu Drift aims to be the next generation of racing games, offering players a variety of exciting features and gameplay modes. The game provides options for both casual and realistic driving experiences to cater to different player preferences. With its selection of high-performance cars, players can engage in thrilling races and challenges on diverse tracks, each presenting its own unique obstacles. The game boasts impressive graphics and a physics engine that adds a sense of realism, allowing players to feel the speed and control of their vehicles. From vibrant city streets to scenic countryside roads, Trishu Drift offers visually stunning environments to explore. With its deep gameplay, including single player races, multiplayer competitions, and special events, players have ample opportunities to earn rewards, unlock new cars and tracks, and continually engage with the game. Overall, Trishu Drift stands out as a must-play title for racing game enthusiasts, combining stunning visuals, engaging gameplay, and thrilling races for an immersive experience like no other.

title: Droidmals: Lavanlier Town
description: A classic JRPG with a horror setting and collectible creatures. Delve into abandoned buildings, shady woods and secret laboratories to recover all the creatures before it's too late!

title: Wall protection
description: Protect the kingdom wall. Summon mighty warriors! Each type of warrior has its own characteristics, some attack from afar, some slow down, some heal.

title: Power & Revolution: 2023 Edition
description: The latest edition of the ultrarealistic world simulator where you play as the Head of State or as the opposition! New Additions: dive deeper into the war in the Ukraine with artillery, trenches, mines, troop morale, etc; detailed immigration management; the justice system; and children.

title: Blade Fury
description: The player is equiped with advanced movement mechanics in order to clear levels by avoiding obstacles, killing enemies and eventually obtaining a key which will be used to access the next level.

title: Shards of God
description: Shards of God is a retro hand-painted point and click murder mystery. It was originally started as part of AdvJam2023, and the full game was then finished within two months.

title: Fractals of Destiny
description: Fractals of Destiny is an Hybrid RPG with a epic story that is mixed by the best features from action RPGs and classic RPGs with blends them seamlessly. Feel the vibes in the world that mixed by magic and futuristic

title: Doki Doki Metal Club
description: Doki Doki Metal Club is a story of a high school club of metalheads. Instead of literature, this time it's music that the girls are passionate about. MC, a poser listening to metalcore, joins a club where every member has a different taste in metal. Yuri, a metal elitist, is a fan of "true metal" and all things kvlt. She introduces MC to the world of black metal.

title: Team Fortress 2: Invasion
description: The Invasion Community Update was a major community-created update and event added on October 6, 2015. Announced with a community-created Source Filmmaker video, it added four new maps, one of them a themed version of 2Fort, 16 new cosmetic items, 4 weapon reskins, 9 new Invasion-themed unusual effects, and a new taunt. Also included in the update was the Invasion Community Update Pass, which allowed players to directly support the team behind the update and also granted them access to special crate drops and to the Invasion Community Update Coin, which counted kills during the event.

title: Genshin Impact: A New Star Approaches
description:
Version 1.1 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Tartaglia, Zhongli, Diona and Xinyan
• New main story quests: Chapter 1, Act III - A New Star Approaches
• New story quests for Tartaglia and Zhongli
• New main event: Unreconciled Stars
• City Reputation System
• …and more!

title: Pickle-Pocalypse
description: PICKLE-POCALYPSE is a goofy 2D arcade shooter game about heroic cucumbers fighting for survival in a world of zombified pickles. Featuring a varied lineup of 5 weapons and frantic gameplay for 1-4 players. How long will you survive in the PICKLE-POCALYPSE?

title: Team Fortress 2: The Tough Break Update
description:
The Tough Break Update was a major update added in the 2015 Smissmas season that spanned from December 17, 2015 to April 11, 2016.

The update introduced 4 new weapon collections, 15 community-created new cosmetics, 4 community-created new maps, and 3 new taunts. It also added the Tough Break Campaign, a three-month contract campaign which allows players to complete 26 skill-based challenges to unlock one-of-a-kind weapons and exclusive weapon and cosmetic cases. To participate in the Tough Break Campaign, players had to obtain the Tough Break Campaign Pass, which was available for purchase in the Mann Co. Store. Players were invited to fulfill contracts ostensibly handed out by Miss Pauling via postcards on her state-mandated vacation.

Additional content was further added in the December 22, 2015 Patch, such as the Festivizer.

title: Genshin Impact: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon
description:
Version 1.2 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Albedo and Ganyu
• New area: Dragonspine
• New story quests for Albedo and Ganyu
• New main event: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon
• …and more!

title: Team Fortress 2: Meet Your Match
description: The Meet Your Match Update was a major update that saw the official release of Competitive Mode matchmaking and PASS Time, introduced Casual Mode matchmaking, four new maps, eight new cosmetic Items, an all class weapon, four new taunts, two achievements, and two startup themes.

title: Genshin Impact: All That Glitters
description:
Version 1.3 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Xiao and Hu Tao
• New story quests for Xiao and Hu Tao
• New world quest: "Bough Keeper: Dainsleif"
• New main event: Lantern Rite
• …and more!

title: Team Fortress 2: Jungle Inferno
description: The Jungle Inferno Update was a major update for Team Fortress 2 that spanned throughout 4 days, starting on October 16th, 2017 and finally releasing on October 20th, 2017 after a 1-day delay. It introduced 5 new weapons, 5 new community-made maps, 1 new Valve-made map, 7 new taunts, 1 new kill taunt, 49 new cosmetics (though 4 all-class items are currently unreleased), and many rebalances for existing weapons as well as the Pyro class. It also introduced an overhaul to the contract system with the ConTracker, and introduced War Paint in place of weapon skins.

title: Genshin Impact: Invitation of Windblume
description:
Version 1.4 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New character: Rosaria
• New main story quests: Chapter I, Act IV - We Will Be Reunited
• New quest category: Hangout Events for Barbara, Bennett, Chongyun and Noelle
• New main event: Invitation of Windblume
• …and more!

title: Dedz0ne
description: Dedz0ne is a Yume Nikki/Splatoon fangame based on Dedf1sh's backstory. It was created as a submission for Dream Diary Jam 7. Game contains visuals that may hint at Octo Expansion spoilers.

title: Fever
description:
Max is a teenager, who got sick of fever.
He's having weird dreams because of that.
Find the 11 effects and leave your room.

A Yume Nikki fangame developed for Dream Diary Jam 7.

title: KittyKart
description: Experience the game that will have everyone talking! Introducing KittyKart: web3's funnest, baddest, racing battle royale! KittyKart combines the nostalgia of old go-kart racing games with two emerging genres: the first person shooter and play-to-earn.
