Not only will players have to race to win, but they will have to fight to survive.

title: White Desert
description:
She's the girl of his dreams.

White Desert tells the story of Monoe's childhood friend Monoru and explores the deep bond they share together. This tale is not about making choices, but rather about creating an atmosphere and living in the moment.

title: Genshin Impact: Beneath the Light of Jadeite
description:
Version 1.5 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Eula and Yanfei
• New story quests for Zhongli and Eula
• New hangout events: Noelle (Act II) and Diona
• New main event: Energy Amplifier Initiation
• New housing system: Serenitea Pot
• …and more!

title: Killer Baby
description: Killer Baby is a shooter set in space. Killer Baby is the only survivor of a colony ship and has to battle aliens. Baby is located in the middle of the screen and has to defeat all enemies, coming from all sides. You can earn resources by destroying space stations. Power up's improve your weapons and refill oxygen and ammo.

title: Genshin Impact: Midsummer Island Adventure
description:
Version 1.6 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Kaedehara Kazuha
• New main story quest: Chapter II, Prologue - "Autumn Winds, Scarlet Leaves"
• New character outfits for Jean and Barbara
• New limited-time area: Golden Apple Archipelago
• New main event: Midsummer Island Adventure
• …and more!

title: Superior: Vengeance
description: Superior: Vengeance is a roguelite co-op shooter where all the superheroes have turned into evil abominations. Every session you’ll start out unpowered and outgunned, as you hunt the evil superheroes, steal their powers to take on even tougher challenges.

title: Mooshie's Kitchen
description:
Welcome to Mooshie’s Kitchen! Established and operating since April 20th, 1969.

Mooshie’s Kitchen is a short, first-person mascot horror game where you play as Todd, a chef at Mooshie’s Kitchen who is finishing up his day at the establishment.

Mooshie’s Kitchen has brought joy to all walks of life since April 20th, 1969! What could go wrong?

title: Ned: Iron Outlaw
description: Ned is a doom-like 2D metroidvania platformer, based on Ned Kelly – Australia’s most infamous outlaw. Run and gun through endless swarms of enemies, wielding standard shooters alongside some truly original (and crazy) weapons; explore a twisted take on true events starring real life Aussie legends; And decide the fate of the tangled bush, with playing style determining Ned’s choice between folk-legend or corrupted beast.

title: Dream's Deep
description: Explore someone's dream worlds. There are 3 Effects to collect.

title: Forza Horizon 5: Summer Party
description: It's summertime in Mexico and you don't wanna miss this party! The Summer Party update brings longer night cycles, the new Icons of Speed story and new summer props to bring the chill over to EventLab.

title: Toga
description: Dai is a little boy who unwittingly enters another world after investigating a suspicious door. At first glance, it looks like a stranger's house...

title: Furry BDSM
description: Furry BDSM - is a classic 2D game in the memory genre which is about you find the same pictures and enjoy different images of furry beautiful ladies.

title: Base Ganymede: Complete
description: A 3 episode vanilla megawad for Doom 1 containing a total of 27 maps. Set on one of Jupiter's moons called Ganymede, this wad should provide a challenge for a wide variety of skill levels ranging from the humble newbie to veteran speedrunner. Each episode has it's own progression rather than the usual base -> hellbase -> hell.

title: Khorus
description: Khorus is a 9-level wad, in which you should battle against evil in woods and deserts, caves and vaults, the ancient abandoned temples and catacombs of the forgotten civilisation (that has some related roots with the ancient Egypt's one), and all it - while listening to Russian folk music, or later motives close to them (with a possible small exception). You will learn, why nobody likes cyberdemon's voice, also you will take part in the search of our hero's missing red cow, and feel the Mastermind's wrath, who couldn't expect that despite numerous and difficult traps, prepared for you, nevertheless, you'll break into his den to make the court of Doom come true.

title: Wasteland of East
description: A Chinese style wasteland pixel style role-playing game. The combat mode is turn based combat chess. Can collect resources to manufacture weapons and props. Play the role of an expatriate comrade performing a mission on the abandoned soil of Huaxia.

title: Idle Worlds

title: Orz
description: You are at point 0. Therefore, you need to go to point 1.

title: Date Z

description: Presto! Magic becomes real for big hearted latchkey kid Hannah, a witch-in-training under the tutelage of her pet cat, as she learns that genuine witchcraft is not the kind of hocus pocus that she's seen on TV!

There's something I wanted to make for that one person.

Shitataru Nikki is an exploration of the thoughts and mind of the most deplorable and sickening human being possible. You play as Keko, a criminal hiding from the law, as he holes himself up in a dingy hotel room and waits for the heat to die down.

It was developed for the 2023 Dream Diary Jam

description: Dungeons and Demons is an 8-map limit-removing episode for Doom II from various members of Doomer Boards. In the words of adventuresmith @xvertigox, this month's project lead, Dungeons and Demons "is an one shot DND campaign played one slow Sunday afternoon on a dingy UAC base. Can you find the Daikantana Staff and make it out with your life? Will you try to take on the BBEG too early and end up having to re-roll your character? Grab your die and lets find out."

title: Occult Secrets of the Third Reich on Mars
description: Occult Secrets of the Third Reich on Mars is the 21st limit-removing project from the inglorious bastards themselves: the Doomer Boards Krew. Featuring nine maps of outrageous soon-to-be-banned-in-Germany action, not to mention possibly the most sector swastikas ever assembled in a single WAD file, OSotTRoM is a timely reminder that the only good Nazi demon is a dead Nazi demon. On Mars.

title: Biotech is Godzilla
description:
Forests of concrete and steel, breathing and flowing forever under the wide eye of the sun, now ruled the works of man. His own eyes watch as hummingbirds swarm their branches and feed from whirring flowers. Long since had a creature like him been to this place, and standing in the midst of this weird marriage of nature and machine, he felt himself an intruder. What happened here, to create this new earth? And what became of those responsible for this ironclad garden of earthly delights?

Before he can finish the thought, the marine's spell is broken by a thundering roar.

Seems not all of man's gifts were of good intention...

Biotech is Godzilla is the 22nd limit-removing project from the nature-loving, tree-hugging hippies in the Doomer Boards Kommune. Led by glenzinho, it features eight maps of intense scenic action pretty enough to paint a picture that will have you itching to get out your gardening overalls after it's all said and done.

title: Evil Egypt
description: Evil Egypt is a limit-removing Doom 2 episode from various members of Doomer Boards. This time, DBP goes back to basics with project lead 40oz taking you to a rather familiar locale. Just don't mind the new paint job.

title: Spaceballs: The Sequel: The Search For More DBP Maps
description: Spaceballs: The Sequel: The Search For More DBP Maps is a Doom II limit-removing project from the world famous doomerboardskrew, masterminded by director vertigo aka @xvertigox. Grab your popcorn and helmets and play it soon!

title: Dead But Dreaming
description: Large Knave-textured level.

title: The City of Damned Children
description: Loosely inspired by a cult French film, project lead @Big Ol Billy takes us into a crudely photo-digitized alternate Doom universe, standing on the sturdy shoulders of @Doomkid's "bootleg" Doom64-in-vanilla resources. This Doom 2 limit-removing set features 11 regular maps, plus an additional progression-stopping credit map. You'll also get new monsters, a chance to brush up on your French, and more MIDI accordion than you even knew you were ready for!

title: 10 Day Vacation
description: 10 Day Vacation is a Doom 2 limit-removing episode from various members of Doomer Boards. In this installment, project lead Joe-Ilya has finally found the perfect solution for summertime fun during a raging pandemic: playing Doom at home, of course!

title: Fear and Loathing
description:
Welcome to Mars, Marine. Due to a plague of photosensitivity caused by cheap gas station cheese and retinal parasites, we've had to enforce a strict low-light policy for the sake of our staff. That won't be a problem, right? You shouldn't expect to see much action up here anyway...

Fear and Loathing is a limit-removing Doom 2 mapset from various members of Doomer Boards. Conductor Scrangus McBrickdad (aka @Jaxxoon R), the lead behind the tranquil Lillywhite Lilith, brings the exact opposite with a spooky combination of ambient sounds, darkness*, vicious monsters and perhaps most horrifying of all: Doom 3. There's also some extra eye candy for GZDoom users, which is perfect for the Halloween season.

title: Morbid Autumn
description: Morbid Autumn is a Doom 2 limit removing episode made by various members of Doomer Boards. This month's project lead is 40oz.

title: The Magnificent Five
description:
This time around the story goes that while you were out hunting game in the prairie an old nemesis of yours "Black Hand Burt" murdered your wife & daughter, and robbed you of your fortune. Now you're on a path of Revenge! Your goal is to kill Burt & all of his men for what they did.

The Magnificent FIVE is a limit-removing Doom 2 mapset lead by your favorite space shark & containing contributions from FIVE members of Doomer Boards, containing FIVE maps, with only FIVE weapons to choose from.

title: Santa's Outback Bender
description:
It’s almost Christmas Eve, but no one’s seen Santa since he left to go party with demons in Australia! Those dudes are such bad influences... hell, they've practically got the whole country on lockdown. You hate being a buzzkill, but if someone doesn't find Santa and sober the old bastard up, no one's getting any prezzies!

Santa's Outback Bender is a Doom 2 limit-removing project from various members of Doomer Boards, led by resident down under Doomer glenzinho. It's the 3rd annual Doomer Boards Project Christmas extravaganza, and this year instead of the traditional cooler climes of the northern Winter, we're heading south to enjoy a Summer Christmas Down Under style. That means there's no snow and plenty of sun, surf, sand, and slaying!

title: The Merry Christmassy Doom Project
description: The Merry Christmassy Doom Project is a short limit removing episode for Doom 2 designed by various members of Doomer Boards with a Christmas theme. Massive props to @Jaxxoon R and @Big Ol Billy for salvaging this project and saving DBP Christmas in the process! Happy holidays Doomers!

title: Mindblood Genesis
description: Are you ready? Are you enough of a badass to blast through the relentless slaughter of pure carnage and come back just in time for dinner?! On this quest, more than just your mind will be blown away when you enter the realm of Mindblood Genesis.

title: Legend of the Hidden Tech
description:
The hottest meso-american-sci-fi game show in the ultraverse just got a new contestant! But this ain't no Price is Right. If you want to win the big prizes, you'll have to fight your way through ancient ruins, mysterious tombs, not-so-tranquil lakes, and demonic arenas. Don't worry, though. Whether you live or die, it's all for a good cause: entertainment!

Legend of the Hidden Tech is a 9-map episode for limit-removing ports made by members of Doomer Boards. The set features 7 regular maps, 1 monsterless progression-stopper, and a very special bonus map from @SuperCupcakeTactics. Props to overlord @Big Ol Billy for leading this!

title: Earth Ends
description: Earth Ends is a 6-map episode for limit-removing ports made by members of Doomer Boards. Thanks joe-ilya for being the lead on this one!

title: Lilywhite Lilith
description:
Tangled vines wind through crumbling limestone, serving as still markers under a misty sky. The stark tranquility belies something fell and horrible... for how long have you clutched the cold grip of your rifle? Lead forward by your own bloodlust and fervor; that lilywhite lilith.

Lilywhite Lilith is a 10-map episode for limit-removing ports made by members of Doomer Boards. The set features 9 regular maps, and 1 monsterless progression-stopper. @Jaxxoon R is the overlord to bow to :)

title: Into The Storm
description: Why not cool the Sigil heat with a little gothic thunderstorm? Into The Storm is a limit-removing episode made by various members of Doomer Boards. Project lead @SuperCupcakeTactics promises it'll leave you black and blue... in a good way!

title: Fuck Global Warming... This is Hell
description: Fuck Global Warming... This is Hell is a limit removing episode by various members of Doomer Boards, led by Joe-Ilya. It features eight maps of earth on hell and the introduction of a couple new and so-old-they-are-new members. Welcome (back) marines!

title: Cyb's Freaky Colonoscopy
description: Cyb's Freaky Colonoscopy is a limit-removing medical documentary of the various doctors and nurses from Doomer Boards, led by Big Ol' Billy. With 11 levels of carnage, it's the biggest, baddest and grossest DBP adventure yet! Shoutout to the two members making their DBP debut: Hardcore_gamer and dmdr!

title: Umbral Platinum
description: Umbral Platinum is a limit-removing project brought to you by us the Doomer Boards dungeon masters.

title: A Doomer Boards Christmas Carol
description:
It's that time of year again. Snow is falling, carolers are caroling... and Cyberneezer Scrooge has frozen time to stop Santa from delivering everyone's Christmas presents!

Sounds like a job for Doomguy, right? Well, to be honest, you're just not feeling the Christmas spirit this year. Although... hmmm... you still haven't looked at the Christmas cards those Doomer Boards Krew folks sent you yet! Maybe that'll be just the thing to help you feel some Christmas cheer...

A Doomer Boards Christmas Carol is a limit-removing Doom 2 mapset from various members of Doomer Boards, containing 12 maps of jolly action and a heartwarming 13-map narative from @Big Ol Billy. Merry Christmas Doomers!

title: Snake Farm
description: A top-down action roguelike about buying snakes, fighting them, selling their oil, and buying more snakes. Upgrade your weapons, get stronger snakes to fight, and chase down a high score with only ten days to live.

title: Rekuiemu Nikki
description:
Find me, otherwise you will lose yourself.

Rekuiemu Nikki is a Yume Nikki fangame, about exploring mind of young Julie, who locked herself at home due to adverse circumstances.

It took quite a long time, and Julie even forgot about the incident, but in one of her many dreams she discovered a strange creature. Now she is forced to find out the truth, but what it will lead to depends on the player.

title: Openlid
description: A interpretation of Yume Nikki in 3D, developed for the Dream Diary Jam 7.

title: The Curious Case of Captain Cray
description:
After the disastrous wreckage of his ship Captain Cray finds himself and his crew upon a curious island of dreams, where his crewmates are found in deep slumber. There, he realizes he can miraculously enter their dreams by resting himself...

Will Captain Cray be able to rescue his crew? Or will they forever be succumbed to their nightmares?

title: Down the Eye of the Tiger
description: A burnt out Las Vegas cocktail waitress has grown to resent her life, her city, and her choices. In the wake of an incident at her job, she decides to dedicate some more time to "self care" (sleeping, adopting avoidant behaviors, ditching work), and finds her dreams blending with those of the magician's white tiger at the casino where she works.

title: Portal: Prelude RTX
description:
In partnership with NVIDIA and powered by RTX Remix, Portal: Prelude RTX is a remaster of the 2008 ModDB Mod of the Year Top 3 Winner, Portal: Prelude, with stunning full ray tracing and high-fidelity assets, the groundbreaking AI-accelerated performance of DLSS 3, and the lowest texture load times with RTX IO. Step into the boots of Abby, the newest testing associate in Aperture Science, as you solve nineteen mind-bending chambers putting your Portal skills to the ultimate test. Make use of momentum, perform narrow escapes through deadly particle fields, and learn to work with manipulated gravity while heartless but dedicated observers watch and berate your every move.

When you finally come face to face with the minds behind Aperture Science, witness the scientific hubris marking the downfall of the facility as the activation of GlaDOS sets the scene for the rest of the Portal series to follow.

title: Nightsong
description:
In Nightsong you play Linda Nightsong, a level 0 bard, with great fishing skills, and some magical knowledge. When a series of mysterious attacks strikes a riverside village, Linda and her friend Uzoma come to the rescue, and must save all the villagers before dark! To fend off the bewitched creatures, you must use the power of your magic tambourine to put the creatures to sleep and continue your quest.

This is a 30-minutes platform where you need to save all villagers before the time up. With several routes, you must carefully explore Anhuma village, using safe routes, avoiding traps, and avoiding creatures as much as possible, putting them to sleep.

title: Krampen
description: Krampen is a horror-adventure game in which you will immerse yourself in a winter forest and help a lost soul regain a piece of itself. Uncover all the secrets that go beyond the gaming experience and discover the truth about the main character!

title: Heist Force
description: Single-player 3rd-person action heist game. Infiltrate banks, outmaneuver enemies, execute high-stakes heists. Engage in intense shootouts, utilize diverse weapons, navigate dynamic environments. Can you become the ultimate Heist Force?

title: Specters of the Sun
description: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

title: Nonorelia
description: A logic puzzle game and sci-fi visual novel rolled into one. Solve nonograms to overcome obstacles as Noah Von Sterne struggles to save his colony and reunite his family, or unwind and sharpen your mind with our relaxing Picture, Random, and ASMR Modes.

title: Up the Hill Down to the Nevermind
description: Up the Hill Down to the Nevermind is a game about identity, girlhood, delusion, and memory. A lonely and depressed hikikomori grapples with their existence and transgender identity in a world where delusion begins to intertwine with reality. What once was good is now lost and all there is left is memory. But how reliable is your memory?

title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Daemonhunters: Execution Force
description:
Unleash the Emperor’s judgement as a new threat casts a shadow over the galaxy. Execution Force introduces the elite Officio Assassinorum, a secretive, deadly force capable of eliminating high-value targets with surgical precision. Utilise their unparalleled stealth and lethal arsenal to turn the tide of battle as you face a new danger in the form of the Tentarus Hive.

Alongside this, take the fight to the forces of Nurgle as you unleash your strike force into the heart of enemy cruisers in brand-new Boarding Action missions, disabling them and claiming the spoils of victory.

title: Project: Shiba
description:
As the world's first half-human hybrid, you know that you're not something that's supposed to exist. Yet, here you are. An outcast in a world that's not your own.
Stuck in a feud between yourself and your encroaching distorted view of the world.
To you, things have always been black and white.
You've accepted your worth on this planet, and have accepted whatever torment the next day may bring.
You've accepted that you belong in captivity, locked away from the world, and have always been nothing more than some science project.
However, one day, in a spur-of-the-moment impulse...
..your entire life will change.

title: Entrenched
description: Entrenched is a Mulitplayer FPS World War 1 inspired arena shooter where you play in many warzones.

title: Gyakuten Higurashi Saiban: Curry Naru Gyakuten
description: A fan game of Higurashi with Ace Attorney gameplay.

title: Ember: Reignition
description: Ember: ReIgnition is a local multiplayer competitive fighting game in which you and your friends play as a lost knight and his spectral adversary, engaging in combat to determine the final survivor.

title: Prostitute Simulator 2
description: Welcome to the second entry of the best prostitute simulator. In this game you will be able to satisfy your hottest desires. Work as a prostitute, get clients and enjoy amazing anime and realistic porn scenes with stylized 3D models.

title: San Xing Dui
description: This is a click , Roguelike game inspired by China's Sanxingdui culture. Players can use the left mouse button to attack and the right mouse button to upgrade to unlock the entire Sanxingdui;

title: Star Conflict: Edges of risk - Stage two: Deluxe edition
description: This pack includesAccess to additional rewards in the event “Edges of risk. Stage two”.Upon receipt, the following 15 levels are immediately unlocked and all rewards of the unlocked levels are available30 days of premium license.The ability to unlock three additional levels in the next Battle pass “Ancient instinct”

title: Star Conflict: Edges of risk - Stage two
description: This pack includesAccess to additional rewards in the event “Edges of risk. Stage two”.Upon receipt, the next level is immediately unlocked and all rewards of the unlocked levels are available7 days of premium license.

title: Odyssey Moon
description: Discover Odyssey Moon, the charming ARCADE game filled with shooting, upgrades, and adorable characters. Explore the moon in space, enhance your character with unique combinations, and immerse yourself in this cute adventure. Get ready to fall in love!

title: Snackroach
description: Assist your distant cousin, Snackroach, on a perilous mission! Guide the courageous little critter towards the coveted food gate while minimizing your taps. Navigate past foes, hurdles, and treacherous rockfalls!

title: Rodney's Funscreen 2 Extreme
description: Rodney's Funscreen 2 Extreme: Dinky's Revenge is a semi-sequel / upgrade to Rodney's Funscreen that was released in Japan by Interlink for the PC and Mac platforms in 1997.

title: Undead Wilderness
description: Undead Wilderness: Survive the unforgiving jungle, unravel its mysteries, and escape the relentless horde of bloodthirsty zombies. Scavenge, manage resources, and fight for your life in a heart-pounding race against the growing undead threat.

title: Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place
description: Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep... but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

title: Mue
description:
A Horror game where you play Alicia, wandering through a creepy mansion filled with human-like statues... Who did this, and why ?

Face your fears in Mue.

title: 3 Heures D'Agonie
description: 3 heures d'agonie (English: 3 Hours of Agony) is a 32-level megawad for limit-removing source ports, created by members of the French Doom community. Each map in the WAD was made within a three hour time limit, though the concept differs from traditional speedmapping events in that there was no singular mapping period, allowing participants to create multiple levels. Additionally, several maps exceeded the time limit, with one map taking as long as nine hours to build.

title: The Given
description:
The Given is a single-level PWAD for Doom II, created in 2017 by Darryl Steffen (dobu gabu maru). It was named as the inaugural winner of the Machaward at the 2017 Cacowards, and was one of three maps that earned Steffen the title of "Mapper of the Year," the others being Saturnine Chapel and Devil's Den. It uses the music track, "The Village that Time Forgot," composed by Tristan Clark.

The map requires a limit-removing source port with an increased SEGS limit to play, such as PrBoom+ or GZDoom. Due to the map consisting of one gigantic area with a high level of detail, players may suffer performance issues. A second WAD file (TheGivenLD) is included, and is an alternate version with reduced detail so as to improve performance.

With an emphasis on atmosphere and exploration, the map contains no monsters or hazards; instead the player must navigate a series of puzzles scattered across the map in order to access an island at the map's centre. Inside the WAD is a plain text lump named PROLOGUE. It contains over 2500 words of lore that provides the context for the WAD.

title: 8-Bit RPG Creator
description: 8-Bit RPG Creator is a game developed and published by Five Nights at Freddy's creator Scott Cawthon. With this game, you can create your own Role Playing Games.

title: Yeah! You Want "Those Games", Right? So Here You Go! Now, Let's See You Clear Them!
description: Cute and comical stickman characters have arrived for you to enjoy "those games" you've seen and wanted to play before. Play a variety of minigames fully, thoroughly, and enjoyably to your heart's content!

title: Future Weapon
description: Future Weapon 2D is a top down space shooter where you can relive the couch co-op glory days with up to 8 players across 2 screens. Grab a gun, grab a spaceship, upgrade everything, mine rocks, explore, and recruit the local townsfolk to conquer this demo.

title: Viking Hiking
description: Viking Hiking is a cheerful 3D Platformer. Join Bøf on his adventure to reach Valhalla. Jump, dash and use the horn as you explore a lush but challenging island! Viking Hiking is a FREE game made by second year students from Breda University.

title: Surrealidade: Dadaist Remix
description: Surrealidade: Dadaist Remix is an update for Surrealidade: Definitive Edition, which adds brand-new content after 20 years, with a Dadaist New Game+ that unlocks an unprecedented game mode created after 20 years, a retro mini-game, a short film, new extra content, and a huge amount of content made available as additional material.

title: The Fall of Porcupine: Last Days of Summer
description: New jobs can be tense – especially when you’re about to become a doctor! Join Finley on an original narrative adventure as you take your first steps in a fresh and exciting world. Together, experience the “Last Days of Summer” before a change of seasons stirs up the sleepy town of Porcupine.

title: Doki Doki Pink Eyes
description: in Pink Eyes, we are again at the club, but this time we bring Natsuki to life in this fun and warm love story.

title: The 10x10 Project
description: The 10x10 Project is a modest set of ten BOOM-compatible maps made as mapping exercises in which I restricted myself to using ten stock textures and ten stock FLATs in each (with some universal textures such as switches, doors, DOORTRAK, lights, etc.). Pistol starts are intended but I won't put a gun to your head. Starts out at Plutonia difficulty then starts worshipping Killer5 and Insane Gazebo later on (but still easier than their stuff). In addition there is a secret map that will probably be unpopular.

title: Sepia
description:
Sepia is a 34-map megawad (which started as a NaNoWadMo project) with maps ranging from lighter brown shade to darker brown shade. The mapset is mainly targeting DSDA-Doom (Woof should also handle it, but it wasn't tested), but GZDoom should work for the most part as well (use it at your own risk still, there might be more issues than i found).

The mapset is divided into 4 episodes with themes variying from the trench warfare of the WW1 to abstract solid-colored places in the void. Difficulty varies as well, with the wad starting fairly tame, but getting progressively harder both in movement department (episode 3 being heavy on the plaftoming side) and in combat department (episode 4 being heavy on the slaughter side).

title: Machete
description: MACHETE is a 32 level Boom compatible megawad made during NaNoWadMo 2022.

title: Hydrosphere
description: It contains 6 very short maps that follow a theme inside a Hydroelectric plant. Gameplay is fairly easy and mostly consists of a power trip style.

title: Goetia 1
description:
Goetia (Medieval Latin; anglicised as goety) is a practice that includes the conjuration of demons

Doomguy, in an effort to take out more demons, engages in arcane demon rituals to reach the demon's realm.

title: Fallen Leaves
description: This wad features 7 small to medium sized maps with mainly an autumn theme, with the last two maps being snow themed. This wad utilizes, and was largely inspired by, DiR's beautiful Opal Palette.

title: Emerald Ambush
description: Emerald Ambush is a single, small map for Doom II. It has been tested in PrBoom+, GZDoom, and Doom Retro. Set in an overgrown facility, this map was made mainly to get me back in the habit of mapping after a fairly lengthy break. It is similar in style to my Sucker Punch mapsets, but the green detailing is not intended to imply an easy difficulty (it shouldn't be too rough, though).

title: Dubai
description: tech-base with a varied theming, mid-sized, generally nonlinear, less puzzle-like

title: Candlemass
description: 1 medium-sized map for Boom-compatible source ports with a monochrome theme, with a second map to stop the player from progressing into the stock maps.

title: Bloodstain
description:
Bloodstain is a full 32-map megawad for Doom2 made by Pavel Tvrzník, Czech Doom mapper known in the Doom community as Pipicz.

Bloodstain's map format is limit-removing Doom2. Recommend playing
with complevel 2, although it can certainly be played on other comp-
levels too.

title: Bloodspeed
description: This project started on Doom Power as a compilation of maps from speedmapping and gradually turned into something more. Some maps were seriously reworked, others were created from scratch and went a long way of development, or were transferred from other projects. The overall style of the project is very heterogeneous, and is a mixture of highly detailed and lengthy work, adjacent to the short and minimalist, practically unchanged speed mapping. The maps are divided into three thematic episodes describing the beginning of the invasion on earth, the journey into the realm of demons, and return to the our world that is already covered with ice.

title: Mutabor
description: One large and complex vanilla compatible map. Difficulty-wise this should be a bit less demanding than some of my previous works. Map 2 and 3 are just bonus stuff

title: Sucker Punch
description: Sucker Punch features 9 small single-player maps for Doom II, tested in PrBoom+, ZDoom, GZDoom and Doom Retro. The WAD is made up from three mini-episodes of three maps each which escalate from easy (with green details) to harder (yellow) to hardest (red). The maps should take no longer than two or three minutes each to play and are designed for pistol starts. Difficulty settings are implemented.

title: Attack on IO
description:
Attack on IO is a 7 map wad with themes of tech bases, castles and bloody unholy landscapes. It has you stationed on the moon of IO and has you being dragged through hell and back.

This wad features custom textures by Ukiro (Otex) and music by Jason "Jay" Reichard and Jimmy Paddock.

All levels have been designed with pistol start in mind, although you can also play continuously.

title: The Rebirth
description: Total Conversation for Doom2, replaces all of the 32 Maps

title: Phobos: Relive The Nightmare
description:
This is a nine-level WAD file with new graphics, music, and sound FX. The levels are very detailed, and are designed to mimic the "style" of the original shareware Doom.

This is an attempt at bringing back the "classic", realistic look of the Doom 1 levels. The story is the same as Doom 1 - Knee Deep in the Dead. You must fight your way through the Phobos moon base to the anomaly that monsters are pouring through. Check out the additional notes at the end of this file for more level info.

title: Good Morning Phobos
description: The Mapset is an updated version of the old game it replaces few soundtracks with different ones from popular megawads, also replaced 3 maps with another 3 new maps, the mapset has a mish mash between old school design and new school design visually, but it has something for everyone, fun and challangeing maps, no slaughterfest maps though..

title: Comatose
description: After going through a traumatic experience, Laura finds herself trapped within a looping nightmare inside her comatose brain. Fight monsters as you process your trauma and look for the door that will lead you back into the real world.

title: Dirt Track Racing Pinball
description: Dirt Track Racing Pinball is an arcade pinball game based on Dirt Track Racing series. Gameplay is similar to other Wildfire Studios pinball titles and features two tables based on Dirt Track Racing and Dirt Track Racing: Sprint Cars games

title: The Sudoku Challenge!
description: Play the Japanese numbers game that's driving everyone mad. We guarantee that once you've tried one Sudoku puzzle, you'll be hooked! The goal of Sudoku is deceptively simple, but it is a challenging game of logic and reasoning. The only requirements are brains and concentration. Try the number puzzle that has stormed its way into major newspapers, magazines, and websites across the United States, the United Kingdom and the world.

title: Jump Tracks
description: Action! Danger! Coins! What more could you want from a game?! Jump Tracks is a game all about timing and reflexes. Zoom off the tracks, clear each level, and try not to die along the way in this tiny and twitchy arcade tapper. It's harder than it looks! Good luck!

title: Only Climb: Better Together
description: Tired of sitting on the ground? Take a sky-high journey with your friends in Only Climb: Better Together! Touch the clouds with your own hands and find out what's behind them, but remember, there are no easy paths…

title: Onka
description: Explore the mansion and escape in this 3D horror game. Solve the riddles and escape from the ghosts that roam the mansion!

title: We Carry the Fire
description: We Carry the Fire is a fantasy-adventure visual novel about an apocalyptic curse, a magical forest, losing everything, and finding a reason to keep going.

title: Speard
description: Speard is a fast paced platformer. Beat levels as fast as you can. Traverse your way through vast worlds with only a Spear and a Rocket Jump.

title: The Gravity Trickster
description: Defy gravity and traverse tricky 3D platforms and mind-bending challenges as you navigate your robot to the end of each level, collecting keys, coins, cosmic cubes and more as you go!

title: Pumpkin Panic
description:
Explore this little farm in the middle of the forest, plant crops, take care of the plants, go fishing, or whatever you prefer, but have a good time!

But be careful, they say that strange things are happening in the area...

title: Eggwolf: Office Eggscape
description: The fiscal earnings report is due tomorrow, and it's already late. Get the job done, complete tasks from your coworkers, and avoid the killer Eggwolf. Estimated 20-30 minutes of playtime.

title: Bluey: The Videogame
description:
Join the fun with Bluey and her family in Bluey: The Videogame! Play a brand-new story set across 4 interactive adventures. For the first time ever, explore iconic locations such as the Heeler House, Playgrounds, Creek and a bonus beach location. Play your favourite games from the TV show, including Keepy Uppy, Chattermax Chase, and more!

The fun doesn't stop there! This game won't be trifficult, just a lot of fun. Experience the joy and wonder of Bluey's world, with local multiplayer you can play with friends and family in story mode and free play! Explore and collect items for your sticker book, unlock outfits and uncover the many secrets and hidden references throughout each location. Recreate iconic scenes or create your very own Bluey inspired adventures and games in Bluey: The Videogame.

title: Ruby: Huntress of Vale
description: Ruby: Huntress of Vale is an alternate universe fan project centered around a 2D action beat-em-up game. This project is based on the web series RWBY originally by Monty Oum & Rooster Teeth.

title: Engineer's Last Stand
description:
You've been left alone to delay the inevitable death by the alien horde with your turret building skills. Place turrets and dodge the monsters to survive as long as you can in this satisfying action game.

Created in FTE QuakeWorld engine in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 50.

title: Mortal Kombat: Outworld Assassins
description:
Mortal Kombat Outworld Assassins is a fan made game based on Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero game, but with a lot of fan made plot stuff.

In this game you play as Sub-Zero, Scorpion or Noob Saibot, and it's a prequel story, that tells the origin of those 3 characters before the tournament. And like i said above, the story is fan made, and thus everything that you see here is made up.

The gameplay is basically in beat'em up style, where you running around different locations, beating up bad guys and fighting with bosses. But, there is some extra stuff to it, like you can use some super moves and special moves, and also you can do a fatalities on bosses and enemies when they are low on health. But you can check that out in "How to play" option in the game itself.

title: Build-A-Delivery
description: You take the role of a delivery driver in a small desert village, moving packages from one villager to another and getting paid for it. Unfortunately the company car is quite bare bones and it's your job to install parts to it and figure out how to carry packages in it, essentially building your own delivery car.

title: Streets of Rage 2X
description: Remake of the famous Beat 'Em Up series. The remaster features improved artificial intelligence, high resolution and frame rate, new abilities, the ability to block, aerial combo attacks, and much more. Of the innovations, the developers note a cooperative mode for up to 4 people.

title: Escape From Lighthouse
description: Escape from Lighthouse of the vast universe. You are in a space prison called "Lighthouse" of space. A human experiment will be conducted. Escape from Lighthouse as you progress through a growing variety of experiments

title: Ludo Park
description: Ludo Park is a serious business simulation focused on management and entrepreneurship, in which the player controls a stand-in at a local amusement park for one month, creating his own character and business identity.

title: Hello Girl
description: Have you ever felt like a rabbit with a telephone? Hello Girl is a thrilling kinetic visual novel about connection and disconnection, set during a time of great uncertainty.

title: Ottomax
description: Ottomax is a game that emulates the entrepreneurship atmosphere, where the player gets to know and practice his entrepreneurial abilities by interacting with the story and deciding on the daily routine of the protagonist trying to make the company successful.

title: Ilha do Empreendedor
description: Ilha do Empreendedor is an educational business simulator focused on the five steps to opening new companies: opportunity analysis, planning, gathering resources, investment, and opening. Three players play against each other trying to be the most successful business manager in a board game play style.

title: Sign of Torment
description:
Sign of Torment is unique in comparison to mainstream wads, so it might be something that was never done before.

It utilizes features not commonly used in Boom maps, like silent teleports, friction, or jumppads.
The wad follows usage of red, white and black colors through episodes. To put simply the main theme color in Episode 1 is red, in Episode 2 is white,
and in Episode 3 is black. ﻿

title: Need for Speed: Pro Street - Pepega Edition
description:
The Ultimate Meme Mod is BACK!
The second installment of the Pepega Mod is finally here, taking you straight into the renewed legal street racing scene of ProStreet!
Black Box’s underappreciated gem from 2007 has been given a complete overhaul featuring an entirely new story with live action cutscenes, over 80 new cars from various regions and eras, new gameplay mechanics and much more!

title: Chainworm Kommando
description: Just a set of highly detailed small to medium large maps, mostly inspired by shooter classics of the 90s.

title: Elysium's Curse
description:
This is my new wad, containing 6 maps. It uses Otex textures by @ukiro. It also features custom tree sprites (by @elend and @Negatronica) which really puts the icing on the cake as far as looks go. Also, that nice blue sky is by @Mechadon taken from "boxoskies-v3". MIDI's are by @AD_79, which I felt fit the theme very well.

Gameplay is mostly strategic with occasional mild slaughter elements. Maps are generally short, tough and fast-paced.

Difficulty-wise, I've tried my best to cater for most players... I wouldn't say UV is ultra hard but it can be rage-inducing without the right care. HMP is much more oriented for fun, although still challenging in parts. HNTR is a walk in the park.

Pistol starts are possible, but I personally think continuous play is a lot of fun for this wad!

title: Tetanus
description: Tetanus is a vanilla compatible episode for Doom 2, centered around clean, easily readable level design, with visuals inspired by "orange-box" designs from various source engine games, as well as Super Mario Odyssey's "Steam Gardens." Tetanus also features an almost entirely bespoke soundtrack with midis by AD_79, and ZeMystic, among others.

title: TV1998
description: 22 maps for Doom2 I made back in 1998.

title: Mexican High School Simulator
description:
Mexican School Simulator is an anime style school simulator based on the schools of Mexico, the artistic design of the school is based on a real institution, it combines Sandbox, adventure, platformer, mystery, terror and RPG gameplay.

At the beginning of the game you will have your own house, your car and the opportunity to study in this prestigious school.Enter the life of a Mexican student, walk the halls of this school interact with the various students, drive a car, perform various academic activities and have fun.

Explore each classroom of the school, get ready to go back to class also explore a small part of the city of Tepic Nayarit, take a walk around here, and enjoy the graphics that have been optimized for smartphones. And don't forget to investigate the mysteries of this school.

title: Path to the Devil
description: A replayable rouge like deck building game in an RPG environment. Travel down a path across an island to face the devil. Build a strong deck on the way by taking out the devil's mercenary army and completing various non combatant encounters.

title: Mystery Box: The Journey
description: Welcome to the 4th chapter of the popular 'Mystery Box' puzzle game series! 10 new boxes full of enigmas to crack are waiting for you on this journey through lost worlds.

title: Bird Ball
description: You scream out and all your friends rush to their computers to fire up the next big thing in online multiplayer video game entertainment. Play with friends or alone and spawn in some friendly bird compatriots to play with or against. The aim is to score goals and have fun in the sandbox.

title: Only Down
description: Test your reflexes and precision by guiding a ball down a series of suspended steps. The goal is simple: reach the end of the level without falling or losing control. Each level introduces new challenges, with increasingly complex steps, narrower paths, obstacles, and routes that require perfect timing and skill.

title: JustWatchMyCat
description: It's a cat puzzle game that solves using the direction of gravity.

title: Chamber of Hex
description: A 15-minute puzzle adventure game on a 9x12 sheet of paper. Explore rooms, figure out the secret codes and escape the chamber!

title: Legend Creatures 2
description: Legend Creatures 2, sequel to the acclaimed strategy franchise created by the same solo dev, is a fun treat combining roguelike and auto battler gameplay. Recruit and evolve fantastical creatures with divine weapons to defeat the demon lord in the vast map. Modding support coming later!

title: Atominous
description:
Inspect every inch of a contaminated household.
Quarantine hazardous materials.
Encounter residents.
Put yourself in danger.
Be a professional.

title: End of Edge
description: End of Edge is a hardcore wuxia action game

title: Keepers
description: Keepers is a space-themed clicker game. You are an employee of a center tasked with saving a planet - a typical light-year.

title: Danny Phantom: Ghost Frenzy
description:
Help Danny Phantom stop Vlad Plasmius, his arch-enemy, and his evil plan. Halt the ghost invasion with Danny's full Fenton Ghost-Hunting arsenal!

Very similar game mechanics to the developer Wildfire Studio's other game Tumblebugs (2005).

title: KnightMan
description: Knight Man is a 2d Pixel-art retro style platformer. Play As Knightman, a heroic warrior who has taken it upon himself to save the 5 realms from the clutches of evil. Traverse through 20 hand-crafted levels across 5 unique zones, each populated by a variety of enemies and hazards.

title: Gnome Enchanted Jigsaw Puzzles
description: "Gnome Enchanted Jigsaw Puzzles" bring the whimsical world of gnomes to life! Discover the magic as you assemble pieces featuring vibrant, enchanting gnome realms. Ideal for both kids and adults, these puzzles offer a unique blend of challenge and charm. Perfect for a cozy evening indoors!

title: Jungo
description:
Help Chase the Cheetah rescue his jungle friends in this unique and colorful puzzler.

The villainous vulture Vargas has unleashed a shadowy spell and trapped all the animals in bright bubbles. Using cat-like reflexes and a keen eye for color, arrange the colored bubbles into matching groups to free the captive creatures.

title: Irang: The Last Hope
description: In Joseon, a kingdom honoring the Four Deities, chaos reigns. Nobles have unleashed sealed evils in a power grab, causing calamities. Join Irang and Haru on a journey to liberate the Deities and reclaim Joseon's last hope.

title: EWorlds
description: After an accident, your ship crashes on an unknown island, a convergence point between worlds. Explore impossible landscapes, overcome traps and puzzles, recover the lost Loops, and see if you can find the legendary Golden Loop in this 3D platforming narrative adventure.

title: Sprucerio
description: You went to the forest for a tree. You have a sled on which you transport the tree. A kettle with hot tea (so hot that it doesn't cool down to the end). Lantern and ax. Having cut down a tree, night has come, you return home through a dark forest.

title: Wheat Harvest Paradox
description: A psx style game where you harvest with a harvester. However, you do not live in an ordinary world, you live in a very gloomy and old giant city. Where all the inhabitants of this city are stuck in a time loop. Every day the direction of time changes. It can go both forward and in the opposite direction.

title: Treasure Island 2
description: Set your sails to the Caribbean! Step into the swashbuckling boots of an adventurer and escape to an exotic deserted island to loot pirates' buried treasure. Use your time wisely and match three or more treasures into lines - horizontal, vertical or diagonal. Do it right and the crazy pirate skeletons will do a jig just for you!

title: Why?
description: A bizarre and oddly captivating journey of patience, self-reflection, destruction, and meditation. Embrace the challenge, endure bare-knuckle blows, and seek the mystical light in this ethereal clicker game.

title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Gold
description: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Gold is a compilation for PC that includes RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 and its Soaked! expansion pack. It was developed by Frontier Developments and published by Atari.

title: New Years Eve Slaughter 2022
description: This wad contains 5 short slaughter-ish maps (plus 1 bookend map) that are all fairly difficult.

title: Pocket Slaughter
description:
The wad is divided into 5-map episodes, each with a different visual theme. There is some semblance of a difficulty curve, both within each episode and for the megawad in general. Certainly map 30 is a bit harder than map 1.

All difficulty settings are supported. UV is the primary difficulty for those who want a challenge, and HNTR was designed to be a more casual experience. HMP is somewhere in between and may not be as well balanced as the other two.

Pistol starts are enforced through MBF21 death exits. There are no secrets besides the exits on maps 15/31.

title: Moonblood
description: Moonblood is a 32-level megawad for Doom 2. It's split into 6 episodes and features small/medium-sized levels, vanilla mechanics, and a custom soundtrack. Its main inspirations were Scythe 1, Jenesis, Mano Laikas, and the DTWID series.

title: Exomoon
description: Exomoon (aka Moonblood X) is a megawad for Doom 2. The levels are a somewhat mix of the original Moonblood with some early BTSX levels twist on them, focusing in a mix of the ruins/temple theme with some exotic natural landscapes. Scythe and Mano Laikas also have a strong influence on this. It has been tested on zdoom 2.8 and prboom 2.5.1.3.

title: 180 Minutes Pour Vivre
description:
180 Minutes Pour Vivre is a collection of 32 new Doom II maps put together by the French Doom Community & friends.
Loosely following the recipe of the 3 Heures d'Agonie speedmapping series, this mapset makes use of a few extra assets to introduce a fresh, unusual, and definitely eerie setting.

title: Mapping at Warpspeed
description: Mapping at Warpspeed is a 32 map megawad created as the ninth edition of the Pineapple Under the Sea speedmapping series. Each map was made with a 10 hour time limit and with the rule of crossing UFOs over each level ﻿to provide a semblance of continuity﻿﻿.

title: Uprising
description: Grab your bat, lock your shields and light up that molotov: it’s time to take to the streets! Uprising is a brutal modern day riot simulator, where you fight either as police or protestors in a frenzied multiplayer melee/shooter mash-up.

title: Marswar
description:
You are a Martian terraformer stuck in a small station in the middle of nowhere.

Since the beginning of the terraforming project, the United Organizations of Earth have been threatening to take over. Recent events have prompted an invasion from Earth, only something went wrong with their new "space-warp" capable ships... that were built by some company with the initials "MS".

title: Anomaly Report
description: Anomaly Report is a horror game where you monitor live surveillance feeds, identifying anomalies like moving furniture or supernatural entities. Spotting an anomaly requires filing a report detailing its type and location. With observation and memory, you must survive, and uncover hidden secrets.

title: Lost Crystals
description: Unearth the hidden gems waiting to be discovered in the foggy valley. Immerse yourself in the calm and let the magic of Lost Crystals wash over you. Are you ready to embark on a tranquil adventure like no other?

title: Crystal Math
description: An infinite math runner with varying speeds and difficulty to test your skills.

title: Autumn Hike
description: Prepare to be captivated by the magic of nature as you embark on an unforgettable autumn journey. Are you ready to experience the beauty and serenity of the autumn forest in Autumn Hike? Lace up your boots and step into the adventure today!

title: Deceive Inc.: Neon Nights
description: Agent Hans gets a rude awakening when the ex-henchman who cut off his arm comes out of retirement! With his days of villainy behind him, new agent Sasori aims to bring Deceive Inc. into the future of corporate espionage.

title: Sizif
description: Sizif is a 3D endless runner where you simply control a ball and avoid obstacles to generate score for the longest time possible and climb the leaderboard. During a game you can unlock bonuses to either make your run easier or generate more score.

title: Crossroad of Worlds: Cursed Letters - Collector's Edition
description: Step out into the light! What do you do when someone intentionally steers you astray? Detectives of the Worlds' Edge agency are ever watchful. You have another task to accomplish - find out who could benefit from the stolen stars not returning to their rightful owners?

title: Yeerk Pool
description:
Yeerk Pool is an Animorphs arcade-style game, offered on the official Animorphs website.

Your challenge is to help Jake find his way through the maze to the Yeerk Pool. You can control Jake's movements with the arrow keys on your keyboard, or with the J-I-K-L keys.

As you find the colored keys, use them to free the gorillas from their matching-colored cages. Once you've released a gorilla, you can use its morph (by hitting the space bar) to help Jake chase off the controllers...but remember, you can only stay in the gorilla morph a limited time.

If you encounter any animals along the way, be sure to stop and collect them for extra points.

You have three chances to help Jake collect all the keys and release all the animals, which then allows Jake entry to the Yeerk Pool area, where you must help him find the Kandrona ray machine that feeds the Yeerks and destroy it. Warning: don't forget to stay away from any roaming Yeerk slugs and use Jake's gorilla morph (by hitting the space bar) to cross the Yeerk Pool.

At the end of the game, your points will be tallied, and you can proceed to the next level. Your game ends when you either run out of time or after you've exhausted all three Jakes. Play again to beat your score!

title: Hamboy: AutoChess Survivor
description: Hamboy is a rogue-like arena shooting game where you fight against aliens by strategically combining 12 attributes and 10 types of weapons to create synergies. As the waves increase, you'll realize that you shouldn't spend gold recklessly.

title: Hector The Cat: Treasure Hunter
description: Hector the Cat: Treasure Hunter is a rogue-lite action-adventure. Explore and battle your way through procedurally generated levels to gather as many Treasure you Can and become the Best Treasure Hunter.

title: Speedrunnerz
description: In this game, you will embark on various trails, each starting in a secure location. As you progress through the portals at the end of each trail, be prepared for increasing levels of difficulty. You are one of the best speedrunners out there!

title: Gutasaga
description: Gutasaga - 2D Strategy RPG pre-viking era game. Immerse yourself in the 550 - 600 AD saga. Be the Viking who opened trade routes with Constantinople. Encounter over 40 nations with unique cultures on your journey. Succeed in trading 205 historically recreated goods. Or try raids and piracy.

title: Capitals Quizzer: Countries Mode
description: Every capital of every country, with national flags.

title: Christmas Magic
description: Christmas Magic is a game where you fly on Santa’s sleigh above the streets in six different countries and drop Christmas presents for boys and girls on their chimneys in time while trying to avoid the scary Gargula from stealing the presents and ruining the night.

title: Throw Me To My Planet
description: A lost square trying to find his planet in a huge space. It's all about a square who wants to go to a planet and face consequences.

title: Genshin Impact: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings
description:
Second major expansion of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Tighnari, Collei and Dori
• New element: Dendro
• New region, Sumeru, with the Dharma Forest area
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Acts I & II
• New story quest for Tighnari
• New main event: Graven Innocence
• …and more!

title: Airframe Ultra
description:
Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing.

From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali Zego zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory… three feet above or six feet below.

title: Genshin Impact: King Deshret and the Three Magi
description:
Version 3.1 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Cyno, Nilou and Candace
• New areas: Hypostyle Desert, Land of Lower Setekh and Land of Upper Setekh
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Acts III & IV
• New story quests for Cyno and Nilou
• New main event: Of Ballads and Brews
• …and more!

title: Funny Park
description: Escape from HugoBoB using the Raygun on the toy factory! If you can!

title: Genshin Impact: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
description:
Version 3.2 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Nahida and Layla
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Act V - Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
• New story quests for Nahida
• New main event: Fabulous Fungus Frenzy
• …and more!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EGLL Airport
description: A major international airport in London, England. Heathrow Airport is used by over 80 airlines flying to 185 destinations in 84 countries. The airport is the primary hub of British Airways and is a base for Virgin Atlantic. It has four passenger terminals and a cargo terminal.

title: Aikokuryuu no Memoria
description: A Japanese, indie RPG.

title: Solar Systems For Kids
description: A family friendly casual game that teaches children about celestial bodies. Learn about the Sun, Earth, Jupiter, and the other celestial bodies that make up our Solar System. You or your child will also be able to create your own Solar System in a sleek and in-depth fashion!

title: One Deck Galaxy
description: Roll your dice and cleverly use them to build up your civilization from its humble homeworld, growing to create a Federation spanning countless star systems.

title: Magic Kaleidoscope
description: The Magic Kaleidoscope is an amazing anti-stress coloring game where you can become the creator of your own magical textures and animations.

title: Capitals Quizzer: Landmarks Mode
description: Learn the location of famous landmarks around the world!

title: Capitals Quizzer: Regions Mode
description: Learn local regions and their capital cities.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Castles and Palaces 5
description: Magnificent architecture and valiant warriors! Put the puzzles together and enjoy the atmosphere of the royal domain.

title: Genshin Impact: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void
description:
Version 3.3 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Wanderer and Faruzan
• New gameplay system: Genius Inokation TCG
• New main story quests: Interlude Chapter, Act III - Inversion of Genesis
• New story quests for Wanderer
• New main event: Akitsu Kimodameshi
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: The Exquisite Night Chimes
description:
Version 3.4 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Alhaitham and Yaoyao
• New area: Desert of Hadramaveth
• New outfits for Lisa and Kamisato Ayaka
• New story quest for Alhaitham
• New main event: The Exquisite Night Chimes
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: Windblume's Breath
description:
Version 3.5 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Dehya and Mika
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Act VI - Caribert
• New story quest for Dehya
• New hangout events for Faruzan
• New main event: Windblume's Breath
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: A Parade of Providence
description:
Version 3.6 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Baizhu and Kaveh
• New areas: Gavireh Lajavard and Realm of Farakhkert
• New hangout events for Layla
• New story quests for Baizhu and Nahida
• New main event: A Parade of Providence
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: Duel! The Summoners' Summit!
description:
Version 3.7 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New character: Kirara
• New major update for Genius Invokation TCG
• New hangout events for Kaveh
• New story quest for Yoimiya
• New main event: Duel! The Summoners' Summit!
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: Secret Summer Paradise
description:
Version 3.8 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New outfits for Kaeya and Klee
• New limited-time area: Veluriyam Mirage
• New hangout events for Kaeya
• New main event: Secret Summer Paradise
• …and more!

title: Paint by Pixel 3
description: Unleash your creativity and paint your way pixel by pixel!

title: Away Times
description: It's a vampire survive-like game where you survive running away from monsters. If you can survive for 30 minutes, you can win. When a crashed gray man lands on a strange planet, you are very curious about where this is. But first you have to survive hostile creatures.

title: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight
description:
A game about fear of the unknown.

A year ago, the Moon was sent violently flying off course by a catastrophic explosion, depriving Earth of its steady stream of resources. Less importantly, the two maintenance workers on there when the explosion occurred have been stranded ever since.

It's not so bad, honestly. The Heart provides for everything, a practically infinite source that gives them water, food, and powers their satellite as they wait with ever dwindling hopes for rescue. Really, it's boring, but there's no reason to stress out so long as-

The Heart has stopped.

title: Vicious Star: Kill All
description: "Vicious Star" is an engaging turn-based strategy game, thrusting you into the role of a village guardian fighting intense battles. Within the game, you'll assemble your team, mixing and matching various characters and runes, and deploying unique skills to obliterate the monsters menacing your home.

title: Daymare Town 1
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: We're All Dead Here
description: These maps are all playable from pistol start and have non linear gameplay.

title: No Sleep for the Dead
description: A Doom 1 episode replacement and the spiritual successor to 1997's Dawn of the Dead. This episode features 9 brand new original and consistently themed levels in classic good ol' Doom style. In addition, you receive one bonus level which runs on E2M1.

title: Imaginary Girl: Sequel
description: The future art will be drawn by two people... Platonic love? Drawing? Adventure game? A continuation of the "Prequel".

title: We Need To Talk
description: Try to avoid the conversation! Use every move you got and every answer you can find to delay these - you assume - terrible news!

title: Astra: Knights of Veda
description:
Astra: Knights of Veda is a visually stunning, story-rich, 2D RPG. A dark plague besets the world of Planis, perptrated through a dark ritual performed by the Mad King. You, and the other Knights of Veda, are the only ones who can bring normality back to the world.

Journey through this dark medieval fantasy world. Fatal challenges await in all corners of the world. Endless undead and beasts charge at you in the Nightmare, and difficult bosses wait in their Sealed Prisons. Stand alone and fight these monstrosities, and get rewards to make your Knights of Veda stronger.

As the Master of the Book, it is up to you to utilize the Knights of Veda in the best way possible to confront challenging but well designed bosses and monsters. Each Knight of Veda wields various skills and weapons, so make use of them as best as possible.
You'll be able to journey with up to 4 Knights of Veda in your party, or play co-op mode and explore the challenges ahead together.

title: Obscure Chronicle of Dynasty
description: This is a "fictional, but plausible" strategy role-playing game with a plot which can be regarded as a history of the Three Kingdoms in a different realm. Thus, those who have received little or no attention in the original history may blossom in this very different time and space.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: DreamSnaps Update
description: Summer is finally here – and so is new content for Disney Dreamlight Valley! Expect plenty of sweet surprises out of our DreamSnaps Feature Update, from a new Villager to new ways to earn Moonstones and other prizes. Vanellope, from Wreck-it Ralph, joins the Valley in this update.

title: Your Wings My Wings
description: A visual novel about a girl who chooses to love and be loved instead of being haunted.

title: Pokhozhdeniya bravogo soldata Shveyka
Fruitbus
description: Fruitbus is a cute culinary adventure, set in an open world where taste is everything. Upgrade your trusty truck and visit a whole world of new destinations together.

title: Frogdate
description: Help your best neighborfriend Scarlet and her new friend with issues with matters of LOVE and ROMANCE..!!!

title: CatWorld
description: CatWorld is a 3D world exploration application. It's scary and lonely out there. Good luck, and may all your dreams come true.

title: Mystery Cat
description: Mystery Cat is a linear visual novel about a cat lost in a subterranean utopia

title: Rusting Souls
description: Rusting Souls is a visual novel made in 4 days by Youli, Clémancipé and KuroYuki for the VN Cup. It's a short experience where two women, X and Y, confront the limits of their own body, in a dull atmosphere of a destroyed world.

title: Hazels
description: A gay lesbian visual novel.

title: Wormgrubber
description: A loser vampire girl who would end the world over a pointless crush.

title: I'd Look Better With Angel Wings
description: A shut-in finds themselves presented with the opportunity to transcend their humanity.

title: The Spiral Egg Challenge
description:
The Spiral Egg Challenge! A so special egg has appeared, and The ArcadeTV channel got their grubby lil hands on it...

Join the clumsy and hot-headed Tobble, as they try to cook their way out of a messy situation!!

title: Invasion UAC
description: Invasion UAC is a megawad by David Bernardi (Xsnake), meant for ZDoom-based source ports. Containing 32 very large, difficult levels, aimed primarily at cooperative gameplay, but also supporting single player, Invasion UAC is set mainly in a series of UAC locales overrun by the forces of Hell, which also include some new monsters through DeHackEd. The WAD is notable for featuring infinite ammo, eliminating the need to scour for supplies and focusing purely on the combat for most of the map. Invasion UAC was originally released in 2005, as three-level wad, and new levels would be added to the project gradually, until a full 32 were reached in version 5, released in 2009. The latest version, iu-part5-zd109c.wad, dates to 2012.

title: Sayori Shoots Up The Literature Club
description: “Sayori Shoots Up The Literature Club” is a controversial mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that drastically transforms the atmosphere of the original game. Instead of the subtle psychological terror of DDLC, this mod takes a more shocking and extreme approach, presenting a narrative where Sayori, one of the main characters, takes an unexpected and violent turn against the literature club.

title: Platform Game Maker
description:
Platform Game Maker is exciting tool to make your dream Platformer Game!
You can choose from many many pre-made blocks, sprites and other 2D assets and place them in your levels, and then add several different type of monsters to play and test your own levels.
Choose different backgrounds and ornamental sprites to populate and visually enhance your levels.
There are several main characters to choose from, each can be the hero of your levels
You can also add many health pick-ups, different obstacles as well.
Place check-points if your levels are too difficult to complete in one run.
Don’t forget to put your end-level award at the end of your levels!

title: Tailor Tales: Neil Plus
description: Tailor Tales: Neil Plus adds a longer epilogue for Neil. This epilogue is filled with explicit adult content and features the final (10th) CG. You also unlock the ability to skip gold and dress requirements for each chapter.

title: Akasha Dreams
description: A lonely girl finds perfection in the SOULNET, but the potential held by real life keeps her on the verge.

title: End of Verse 23,194,973,137
description: Follow Vouxeine, an immortal being whose sole purpose in life is poetry, as they consider an imminent debt weighing down upon them. Look a little into the nature of immortal beings, confront imminent ideological death, and experience girls' love..?!

title: A thousand words that I could tell you
description: After finding a mysterious necklace that allows her to travel back in time, a girl decides to use it to fix her troubled past.

title: 59 Fucks the Machine
description:
The story contains a transfem protagonist, wiregore, uncaring gods, and some weird sexy stuff. 14k words, estimated read time 1-2 hours. Hope you enjoy.

an irritable woman named Fifty-Nine makes a journey across the sun-scorned canyons of her world and into the caves below... What is she looking for in those depths, and why is she so hard-pressed to find it?

title: The Strange Case of Mei Lysel Andi
description: My old friend asked me to meet at her place, but it seems she's gonna be late and has invited me to read this unlabeled book that's just left on the table

title: Famous Crash
description: In a world, where women are gay for clout. One streamer breaks the rules.

title: Salamander Capital
description:
Mud and metal and the smell of rotting in humidity. A visual novel by Lichen Euchella.
A submission for Visual Novel Cup 2, 07/2023.

title: Tailor Tales: Caine Plus
description: Tailor Tales: Caine Plus adds a longer epilogue for Caine. This epilogue is filled with explicit adult content and features the final (10th) CG. You also unlock the ability to skip gold and dress requirements for each chapter.

title: Tailor Tales: James Plus
description: Tailor Tales: James Plus adds a longer epilogue for James. This epilogue is filled with explicit adult content and features the final (10th) CG. You also unlock the ability to skip gold and dress requirements for each chapter.

title: Re-Volt OpenGL
description:
RVGL is a modern, cross-platform re-write of Re-Volt with thousands of custom creations (from skins and cars to whole new tracks) to choose from to make the game your own. Online Races in the community are held regularly.

Re-Volt is an R/C car racing game from Acclaim, originally released in 1999. It features great gameplay, several game modes and realistic physics, coupled with bright and colorful visuals that still hold up to this day.

It's a game aimed not only towards people who just want to play a funky arcade racing game, but also for people who seek a more competitive challenge. It's meant for all ages and occasions: play by yourself, in a local network with friends, or even online with players from all around the World!

title: Halo 2 Uncut
description: Using evidence found within Halo 2's tags, map scripts, and other external media, Halo 2: Uncut aims to accurately restore as much cut content into the game as possible. Features pre-release elements such as cut weapons, cut weapon and vehicle functionalities, restored cut encounters and map scripts, and features Director's Cut-style cutscenes.

title: Between: Stardust Trail
description:
Made for Otome Jam 2023.

Clickety-clack... Clickety-clack…

Along the sound of the train track, Estelle, the MC, wakes up. After realizing that the information on her ticket was missing, Estelle had no choice but to work as a train attendant?! Will she be able to get off the train eventually?

title: Assignment Due: Project Blue
description:
Made for Otome Jam 2023.

A week-long online project being partnered with the quiet boy in your class that spirals into something different. Career dreams and the color blue, you wouldn’t have guessed an online class you were forced to take for your second year of college would lead you right to anything. Let alone to someone.

title: Chirk
description: A visual novel about lovers in a city where they cremate the roadkill.

title: Hinamizawa Branch School Basketball Tournament
description: A fanmade basketball game featuring the core cast of the Higurashi series.

title: Doki Doki Vacation: Kirameku Kisetsu no Naka de
description: Dokidoki Vacation tells the story of a Japanese teenager called Junichi. High school is over, the summer vacation has begun. But due to the young man's uneasy relationship with his family and other circumstances, he cannot afford the vacation he was hoping for. So Junichi decides to find a job. He starts working in a book store, and soon realizes that feelings develop between him and Megumi, a girl who works in the same place. But what about the classmate Junichi was in love with before?..

title: RehAIbilitation
description: A visual novel about a lolita who travels to an isolated place in hopes of fixing herself, leaving behind something dear to her. She meets a peculiar nurse.

title: Squid Girl World Ep.0
description:
After crash landing on a planet covered in mushrooms, Aseroe meets a squid girl named Sepia..

This is the first visual novel in Squid Girl World.

title: Pagodia
description: Pagodia is a vanilla compatible episode for Doom 2 featuring varied, japan-inspired settings. The wad is split into 3 distinct themes: Village, Techno-shrine, and Cyberpunk City. Difficulties are implemented. Mouselook, jumping, and crouching should be disabled if you're playing on a port with those features.

title: Moonlit District
description: Moonlit District is a Vanilla-Compatible episode for Doom 2 featuring textures from Perdition's gate. The WAD was a speed-map project made over the course of 4 days. It was tested in Chocolate Doom, Crispy Doom, and DSDA-Doom (complevel 2). Difficulties are implemented. Mouselook, jumping, and crouching should be disabled if you're playing on a port with those features.

title: Skibidi Battle: Toilets Attack
description: Unveil the universe of Skibidi Toilet, an addictive and engaging third person shooter video game inspired by the viral meme sensation.

title: Spiky Way: Forest
description: Spiky Way: Forest is an arcade game, where you need to go through different obstracles. Navigate through a dense forest, avoid spikes, and unlock cute creatures as you test your skills in this addictive adventure.

title: Nanashi Shoujo wa 100-satsu Hoshii!
description: This game is a collection of Touhou secondary mini-games in which the book-reading yokai works.

title: Aeryth
description:
Aeryth is an visual novel adventure game about finding her heart.

Aeryth takes place in a deserted world thought to be lifeless. In this world Aeryth a girl known for her useless dreams lives in temple with a priest Po who always seems to be deep in their studies. Today like any other she has a dream one that will lead her to a strange girl, and her own heart.

title: Doki Doki Fallen Angel
description: In an alternate universe where Monika is not self-aware, our protagonist finds himself growing closer to Yuri. Soon however, he discovers what this girl is hiding from the outside world. The other girls problems start to appear as well, as they progress within the overarching narrative of Yuri and our protagonist's relationship. Fallen Angel is a story that is meant to tug and pull on many different emotions. It'll allow you to help Yuri overcome her self harm, anxiety, and insecurities. The story will swing from wholesome and heartfelt, to soul crushing sadness. With new artworks and music to help you lose yourself in the story and help create an experience you won't soon forget.Do you have what it takes to save... a Fallen Angel?

title: Nothing Somewhere
description:
A story about art, what goes into being a human, and not feeling like a part of that. The lines that divide and define what "being" means are no longer existent, but were they ever there to begin with?

A non-binary visual novel talking about what it means to be neither here nor there- in more merits than one.

title: Planetary Attraction
description: A blossoming love between two wayward planets. Can it endure the constraints of the universe? A cute and short linear click-thru visual novel.

title: Theater Unrest
description: Indie horror game, inspired by creepypasta "The Theater".

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 is a remake of the original Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, bundled in the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1+2 collection.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - Blast to the Past!
description: The team behind Blast to the Past! is taking the vanilla game and reshaping it to become something great, something that fans were hoping for. Blast to the Past! is a mod that restores all cut content back to Security Breach and takes a step further by adding new content and new gameplay features and bits of story to help rekindle the spark that is Security Breach! Have a Faz-errific day and keep a look out for teasers and the future release!

title: Boxbrawl Delivery
description:
Welcome to Boxbrawl Delivery! Run n’ jump, grab n’ go, and haul n’ brawl with the best delivery service in the business!

Take the role of Carter, deliveryman for Zaplift, aiming to satisfy the town and score a good tip! With plenty of pests running amok (and with your co-worker Carrie watching over the inventory), it’s up to you to ensure your customers get their goods in one piece! Can you deliver on your promises, or will your customers’ ratings say otherwise?

title: My Supermarket
description: Manage your own supermarket, attend multiple types of customers and make the most profit you can. Order products, refill shelves, play with your friends in co-op mode, go after thieves, order some staff and grow your empire as much as you can.

title: Der Pferderennstall
description: Der Pferderennstall is a real-time strategy game where you will manage a racing horses' farm by making the constructions, buying horses, hiring workers to take care of them, and observing their growth until they are prepared to race your opponents.

title: Homo Ludus
description: Translated from rapid sub-supersonic squeaks clicks and whistles

title: Heelbain
description: Heelbain is a 9-map UDMF WAD focused on dread. The story is simple: you're on an expedition with your wife and friends in the deserts of Nevada. During the night, your camp is attacked is by hellish creatures, and everyone except you is killed. You escape into a local cliff side, hiding until dawn. You venture into what looks like civilization to seek help, but soon, you find yourself heelbain.

title: Fluxis
description: A free, community-driven, and open-source vertical scrolling rhythm game.

title: Precious Theatre: Pilot
