description: The first installment of Precious Theatre ~an experimental magical girl yuri slice of life visual novel

title: Daymare Town 2
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: Daymare Town 3
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: Daymare Town 4
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: Project B-Fer
description: A short puzzle/escape room game where you can choose between engaging with the puzzles, or breaking through them.

title: Missing: Itsuka Kitto
description: On the White Day February 14th Yuuki Masahiro received a bar of chocolate in the post. The next year he also gains a bar of chocolate and a message only saying "Missing". From that moment events starts to whirl around him.

title: M Hard
description: You're a normal college student. Your mother needs a heart transplant. Your father's mechanics shop can't pull in nearly enough money to pay for the surgery. Just then, this rich sadistic woman shows up and makes you an offer. She'll get the best doctors and pay for the operation, IF you become her slave.

title: Zest to Fantasy
description: The story behind Zest is that you, Zefaa, woke up at a desert after you have been knocked unconscious. You realized that you have lost all of your memory except you first name. Since there are no one around the desert, you decide to find a place to rest and begin the search of your own identity. From here on, you will choose one of the four paths and begin your quest for your past.

title: Rabid Helix
description: In this game, you are the medic of a corporate security team in some sci-fi setting sent to investigate a long-abandoned research installation owned by the company's predecessor. Similar to the lieutenant of the Colonial Marines in Aliens, you sit behind a bank of monitors and observe your teammates' status as they investigate the interior of this compound. And like Aliens, something nasty is waiting for them inside.

title: Dynasty Warriors Online Z
description:
On July 18, 2013, a massive update was released in the Japanese version of Dynasty Warriors Online, changing the name of 真・三國無双 Online to 真・三國無双 Online Z.

This update adds the new feature of "Weapon Swapping" similar to Dynasty Warriors 7. Characters and soldiers have been remodeled with their Dynasty Warriors 7 appearances. The intro of the game has been changed, featuring the same three characters from the first in a revised state.

title: Daymare Cat: 10-year Anniversary
description:
Daymare Cat is a gorgeously sketched exploratory platformer that feels like a simple adventure game.

Things that are new in this Anniversary Edition:

– The game is in glorious 60 fps and plays in full screen.
– Most noticeably the game has new background texture. This might be a bit controversial take, but in my opinion this improves the vibe.
– Interactive items have a color. Yes. A color.
– Cat now runs like a ballerina, not a raptor. Thank god.
– Platforming is a bit easier thanks to hitbox tweaking but also by redrawing platforms in few places, for reference check the main gate.
– I added a new pathway for you in case you have a fear of being eaten alive by a cosmic horror monster and really don’t want to do this part. So now you can go around it.
– No changes were done to the music, since it’s already perfection.

title: Berry Brother
description: A metroidvania with a unique perspective mechanic. Find your missing clothes and confront your tiny brother...

title: Five Nights At Bidens
description: You are the new security guard at the white house. It is your job to make sure nobody gets in or out of the building. I do have to warn you: the presidents do tend to get a bit 'quirky' at night..

title: Grasshoping
description: Grasshoping is a 3D platformer in which you incarnate a grasshopper in search of a new home after humanity has polluted his valley.

title: Stronghold: Definitive Edition
description: Greetings sire! Your stronghold awaits you. Build a castle economy, besiege unforgettable villains and return to the 'castle sim' that started it all. Experience this classic RTS with upgraded visuals, modernised gameplay, Steam multiplayer and a new campaign.

title: One Night as Freddy
description:
One Night as Freddy intends to give a faithful and fun twist on the Five Nights type of gameplay by instead giving you control of an Animatronics from the original game instead of the usual POV of a Nightguard.

The game lets you see through the eyes of popular animatronic Freddy Fazbear as he roams the games pizzeria attempting to enter a nightguards office.

title: Skull Island: Rise of Kong
description: Embark on a 3rd person action-adventure quest to avenge the death of your parents at the hands of the ultimate alpha predator: Gaw. Conquer waves of primal beasts and defeat the minions of your arch-nemesis on your way to becoming the rightful King of Skull Island. Traverse the mysterious island and uncover lore and all the secrets the island has to offer as you encounter swamps, waterfalls, jungle, and skullite-filled caves that give the island’s flora and fauna its power.

title: Iseran: Isekai Rantou
description: 最大４人でみんなでバトルパーティー！！！ 異世界乱闘、ちぢめて「いせらん」！！！ ありとあらゆる異世界から集いし者たちは、今日もバトる！！！ 様々な世界の者たちが迷い込んでくる謎の世界、「マザワルド」！ここでは、色んな競技で熱く激しいバトルが繰り広げられるのは日常茶飯事だ！ 勝利を目指せ！！！Let’s！いせらん！！！

title: Le Avventure di Blue: Lacrima di Cristallo
description: Discover the story of the best-loved characters from 'The Adventures of Blue'. Experience the adventure as the young thief Krystal and the beautiful Princess. Explore the game world and complete various missions while saving the Glacid Kingdom.

title: Showgunners: Security Breach
description:
Showgunners first DLC - Security Breach - is out now!

Five new tactical combat arenas, a new map, a new elite enemy, and new unique weapons and abilities are included in this exciting new chapter. Oh, and it's free. And new.

We'll see you in the arena!

title: Sānguó: 223
description: This is a RTS war game about the Three Kingdoms around AD 223 consisting characters such as Zhuge Liang, and Cao Pi and Sun Quan. The game has a series of magical events, to tell the story of that era.

title: Save My Sister
description: After a young girl is kidnapped by a human trafficking gang, an ex army officer with PTSD has to fight to rescue her. A Third Person shooter with film-noir/neo-noir style

title: Seoirye
description: "Seoirye" is a 2D platformer game that tells the story of Grandma Seo Irye, who embarks on a journey to the underworld to find her missing grandson. Help Grandma successfully locate her grandson and return safely!

title: WestHalla
description: A squad-based strategy RPG set in an alternate old west. Build your crew and manage their skills and equipment as you fight your way through bandits and beasts alike in a procedurally-generated valley to reach the promised land of WestHalla.

title: Uptown Outbreak
description: Use your driving and battling skills to defeat the virus and restore the game to its former glory.

title: Trade City
description: Trade City is a simple city building game that you build your own city by building/developing new buildings.Grow your city with production and trade, and conquer other cities on the map without fighting.

title: The Sinking of the Dream Chaser
description: Servant robot Led reboots in the stern of the ship Dream Chaser, only to find he's broken and malfunctioning. His memory drives have been corrupted. He has no idea what's going on. And he needs your help to find out what happened to himself, the ship, and to his master.

title: Super Fighting Jam
description: What is Super Fighting Jam? This work is a free 2D fighting game created by an author who does not know programming at all, reflecting his own values and tastes.

title: Spire Horizon
description: Discover a thrilling world of adventure in Spire Horizon, an RPG open world game, where you embody a skeleton protagonist, explore a visually stunning world, engage in battles against formidable enemies, and traveling in search of a beloved wife.

title: Traxion
description: Traxion is a cave flyer featuring beautiful pixel art, great music, and sophisticated in-game physics.

title: The Deadlands
description: The Deadlands, is a haunting journey of vengeance. Conquer undead horrors, face formidable bosses, and harness their souls to save your son from an evil necromancer. Pixel art meets gothic aesthetic in this intense, captivating metroidvania.

title: Fungal Colony Simulator
description: You are but a humble Mushroom farmer. You feel the need to farm mushrooms.

title: Gutter: The Reject
description: Play the role of a failed experiment in this hazardous new mini-campaign.

title: I Commissioned Some Unicorns
description: I paid more artists to hide unicorns and wands in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Mushy Score
description: Outmaneuver endless waves of enemies for high score!

title: Operation Octo
description: Dr. Odin, a hyper-intelligent octopus, is on a conquest against sunken skeletons. High-tech turrets are at his aid: Pistol Shrimp! Navy Seal! Death Ray! Deploy 'em, guard 'em, and collect more of 'em! Travel across unique biomes and put the dead to rest.

title: Pick-a-Pocket
description: Stealth your way through Victorian-Era streets and Pickpocket your way to the top. Stay Vigilant as other thieves will be out and about, ready to steal your rewards or as easy marks to increase your stash. Avoid Bobbies, vanish from the light and disappear with your ill-gotten goods by day break.

title: Russian Train Trip 3
description: A first-person adventure game with a deep plot. You have to get from Tyumen to Novosibirsk on a passenger train. You can look out the window and watch the changing nature, weather and architecture. You can see forests, fields, mountains, cities and villages.

title: Folcroft Monastery
description: You've been hired by an outfit known as SMS Group to retrieve an artifact lost somewhere inside the abandoned Folcroft Monastery. Locals say the place is haunted by restless spirits, but the pay was too good to pass up. You asked little questions. Find the artifact requested and get out alive.

title: Fantasy Amusement Park
description: Gameplay introduction This is a casual elimination + Visual Novel game, players need to fight against different bosses, and seal different levels in the amusement park location, escape from the amusement park

title: Beyond Inseparable
description: The only one that matters to you in life has been taken. Enraged, you storm the hellish dungeons of Castle Ire to rescue and reunite. Hack and slash your way out of this nightmare together or perish with many who didn't.

title: Bilattice
description: Bilattice is a massive puzzle game featuring over 300 hand-crafted levels and tons of unique mechanics. The mechanics interact with each other in endlessly interesting ways to produce hours of mind-bending content. The sheer number of clever gimmicks offered by this game is hard not to appreciate.

title: Bubble Blasters
description: Race against time and shoot giant bubble gums back to the vending machine in this sci-fi game!

title: Civic Story
description: When a sudden election rocks the country, whose side are you on? In Civic Story, you'll encounter colourful characters and situations that show how the upcoming election affects you, your colleagues, and the nation in this satirical and insightful 8-chapter Visual Novel about our world today.

title: Dino World
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into a world where the heavens themselves tremble under the majestic wings of mythical beasts.

title: Clan monsters
description: Clan monsters is a game in which you have to use your dexterity and reliable weapons to destroy monsters that appear from portals. Different types of weapons will be given you for completing levels. Fire, monster a lot of levels with different platforms! There is easy controls system.

title: Asteroidc
description: You're in control of a spaceship and your mission is to destroy as many asteroids as you can. Compete for the highest place on the Leaderboard.

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Angel's Gear
description:
A unique combat system - unconventional movement that rewards precise aiming and mastery over strategy, patience, and quick thinking.
KO enemies with melee attacks, stomp them for ammunition, use that newfound ammo to shred through enemies with a variety of interesting bullet types.

title: Backrooms Doors
description: Backrooms Doors - This is an atmospheric first-person horror game. Explore spaces that can't exist in the real world and find your way out before the entities find you.

title: Super Buff HD
description: Super Buff HD is a fast-paced skate-surf-FPS. Dash, bounce, grind, blast, shred, shoot, and soar through a fever dream world of unhinged weirdness. Defeat all the buff dudes. Get a high score. Be a winner. Home for dinner.

title: Sunlight Scream
description: The hero moves to a new city because of life circumstances. Upon entering university he makes new friends, he is horrified to discover that one of them is a murderer... And your decisions alone will determine the outcome of this story!

title: Halo Infinite: Season 5 - Reckoning
description:
An all-new Battle Pass featuring Flood-inspired rewards, new maps, a new mode, and a sophisticated AI Toolkit for Forge.

Coming later in Season 5, Firefight: King of the Hill offers a refreshing twist on the beloved co-op wave-survival mode.

Season 5 - Reckoning also brings with it multi-core helmets, Match XP in Custom Games, a new Mark VI reward for reaching Hero Rank, and more.

title: Where is 2010?
description: Help Santa find the New Year, it seems that kid got lost somewhere again!

title: Hotfix93
description:
Hotfix93 is a short and linear Boom-Compatable singleplayer map (bookended with even shorter, non-combat maps) set inside of Doomguy's PC!

Have you ever wondered what the inside of a computer looks like? Nobody truly knows. However, Doomguy is going to find out. After installing a DEMONIC VIRUS onto his UAC-DOS personal computer, Doomguy is left with no choice but go in there himself to clear them out.

title: Escape from Slime City
description:
Escape from Slime City is a short and linear Boom-Compatable singleplayer map set in the titular urban environment of SLIME CITY.

Fight hell's legions as you weave through urban streets and buildings while keeping your feet out of the toxic slime overtaking the city! Can you survive as you make your way back to your car parked on the other side of town? Can you find all of the Doomguy dolls scattered throughout the city?

title: Daymare Invaders
description: If you’re biting your nails waiting for Daymare Town 4, you can spend some time defending the town from invaders. Invaders from…. umm… from the mistfog. Or fogmist. Fogmist sounds better. So, the fogmist invaders are attacking daymare town and you have to protect it. Go!

title: Daymare Kite
description: Avoid the birds for as long as possible

title: 1 Million Zombies
description: 1 Million Zombies is a post-apocalyptic action game where the player takes on a world overrun by hordes of the undead. The objective of the game is to survive as long as possible by driving a series of vehicles and eliminating as many zombies as possible.

title: Slugfest
description: 10 levels for DOOMII! These are high quality levels, not just a bunch of boxy rooms with mismatched and unaligned textures. The levels include new sounds, new graphics, and all - new music!

title: Torment
description: Torment is a Doom II episode replacement mod of six levels including original music, created by Shamus Young in 1995.

title: Noonna the Rock
description: 'Noonna the Rock' is a special visual novel game that deals with the special material of death metal and the romance between the heroine 'Noonna' and the Protagonist.

title: Cooking Pix
description: CookingPix is an online cooking card game for 1-5 players.You can enjoy simple yet deep strategy building and bargaining.You can play many times in a short time, so even people who don't have time can enjoy it easily!

title: Mandew vs. The Forever Rain+
description: After 13 years, one of the first Suits & Sandals games is back with a fresh coat of paint! Help Mandew uncover the source of the mysterious never-ending downpour threatening his home in this 2D platforming adventure.

title: Prodigious Avian
description: Prodigious Avian is a casual game, where you play as Quercus thy magnanimous and attempt to evade the malignant clutches of the Robber Baron, who threatens to engulf you and all of Cymru. Flap your wings little birdie and do not allow the talons of an insidious wretch to besmirch your fair visage.

title: The Frozen Garden
description: The Frozen Garden is a third-person horror game inspired by classic survival horror that will immerse you in an intriguing and unsettling world.

title: Elysium Trials
description: Skill-based Fantasy Shooter on rails with an Epic touch, how you defeat enemies matter! Shoot, unleash powerful lightning magic, and Dragons, beware of dragons as you battle through 8 unique enemies all with unique attacks in vastly different worlds with an epic fantasy rock/metal soundtrack.

title: Police Car Escape Simulator
description: Are you ready for the multi-directional chase of the cops? Experience an adrenaline-filled police game with Police Car Escape Simulator. Escape, crash and beat the cops in fast vehicles!

title: Volatility
description: You are a PnL number on a Bloomberg-style terminal. Nothing more. Deep in debt to the creditor whose money you now trade, you read the filings, build the thesis, and work the whole desk — equities, options, futures, bonds, FX, swaps — to trade your way out. Or you don't.

title: Bounce & Roll
description: Control and guide the ball through a series of obstacles, testing your skills and abilities in a 3D environment, either solo or with a friend.

title: Wall World: Deep Threat
description: Welcome to Deep Threat, a Wall World story expansion! With it you'll get to explore a remote section of the Wall which holds traces of a distant past. But you will have to fight for answers, and not only with the new types of Zyrex: other inhabitants of the Wall are also not too keen on parting with their secrets.

title: Alfredo's Sneaky Meal
description: Alfredo's Sneak Meal is a stealth platform arcade game where, armed only with a frying pan, you have to help Alfredo get his meal in a building full of zombies and bats.

title: Dimensionals
description: Dimensionals is an RPG that combines fast paced, action packed tactics with deep rogue-like replayability. Collect powerful heroes and fight epic bosses. Every run is unique, so equip your heroes carefully to pull off insane combos. Dimensionals is a total reimagining of the rogue-like genre!

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Black Cat
description: Go on an adventure with Inspector Dupin! Monsieur Mark Davies has reported his wife, Sara, missing and now it’s up to you to track her down and solve the mystery! Follow a mysterious black cat, who seems to be purposely helping you, and discover helpful clues in Dark Tales: Edgar Allen Poe’s The Black Cat. Use your Hidden Object talents to tackle the case, and discover the evil culprit behind Sara’s disappearance.

title: Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel
description: Journey across Italy as best-selling novelist Dana Knightstone in Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel! During a lecture in a university in Tuscany, you are startled by the ghost of a 19th century girl named Eva. Decades ago, she died of a mysterious illness while her lover Giovanni left to find a cure. Why did he never return? Unravel the mystery of his disappearance as you explore beautiful landscapes in this incredible Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

title: Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel - Collector's Edition
description:
Journey across Italy as best-selling novelist Dana Knightstone in Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel! During a lecture in a university in Tuscany, you are startled by the ghost of a 19th century girl named Eva. Decades ago, she died of a mysterious illness while her lover Giovanni left to find a cure. Why did he never return? Unravel the mystery of his disappearance as you explore beautiful landscapes in this incredible Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

The Collector’s Edition includes:

Bonus gameplay
Integrated Strategy Guide
Stunning Soundtrack

title: Path of Exile: Crucible
description:
In Path of Exile: Crucible, you'll learn about the ancient titans who once shaped the primordial surface of Wraeclast. If you're powerful enough, you will earn the ability to forge their power onto your weapons.

Our April expansion introduces the Crucible challenge league, nine new Vaal Skills, Atlas Gateways, over ten new Unique Items and improvements to Breach, Abyss, Passive Tree Masteries, the Saboteur, the Pathfinder, Ruthless and much more!

title: Gainax Renzoku Satsujin Jiken: Ero
description: Main character is a new editor who participates in Gainax new game planning meeting in the mountains. However, as soon as team gathers, storm breaks out cutting way back. Meanwhile, Gainax staff members start to get killed one after another. Can protagonist find a criminal and develop special relations with staff girls under these circumstances?

title: DOOM 87: The Lost World
description: "DOOM 87: The Lost World" is an upcoming vanilla-compatible DOOM II megawad. The first few maps are fairly easy, but the difficulty increases significantly by the start of the Hell episode on MAP12. Currently, a 21-map beta release is available and features some epic vanilla DOOMING action! Get ready for an exciting new adventure as Doomguy locates a secret hellspawn base on Earth known as "The Lost World."

title: Blights Wrath
description:
Hack and Slash RPG in the world of Zeontis.

Level up and improve your combat finesse with magic, melee arts and ranged skills.
Improve your armory with thousands of items and fight your way through the hordes of demons and undead to save Zeontis.

title: Indigo Park
description:
Indigo Park is an immersive first-person exploration game that takes you on a thrilling journey through the eerie remnants of an abandoned amusement park. As the protagonist, you will step into the shoes of an adventurous soul eager to uncover the mysteries hidden within this once vibrant and lively attraction.

Official description (from Steam): Explore the abandoned childhood wonder of Indigo Park! Guided by Rambley the Raccoon, help restore power to the destroyed amusement park while you run from the reason it shut down.

title: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
description: Play as a mighty blood wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures with a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

title: Lilith + Eve
description: Garden of Eden-inspired story about Adam who chases after angels, Eve who can't find her place in Elysium, and a lesser demon of the lilitu species — Lilith.

title: Please Don't Hate Christmas
description: You haven't celebrated Christmas for years. This year, you decided to return to your hometown—Snowflake Island, with your childhood friend, Albert. Albert treats you so well that you choose to stay forever. However, you forgot something in the past, and it's still not solved...

title: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life
description: A strange incident turns the life of an ordinary young man upside down when, having fallen asleep on a regular train commute, he wakes up in another country... in a body of a Japanese student! An unforgettable summer adventure awaits, promising many fateful meetings and momentous occasions.

title: Sex Rhythm: Onsen
description: Sex Rhythm: Onsen is a rhythm game where you getting affection from girls. 3 colleagues came to your hotel, a distant hotel, for a vacation, considering how tired they are in your hands, how they will spend this vacation. Good or bad.

title: Florida Love Stories
description: “Florida Love Stories is a romantic comedy point-and-click adventure and yuri dating sim. Play as investigative journalist Veronica Hernandez as she explores the town of Boca Castor, meets beautiful women and maybe even falls in love along the way.

title: Quickclaw
description: Quickclaw is a 2d action/platform fully handmade with sprite animations. Take on the role of Dynamo City's newest vigilante Quickclaw in her fight against organized crime with an original storyline and many new characters in order to give the experience to play into an animated series from the 90s!

title: Neural Nexus
description: Neural Link Corporation developed a powerful AI that unexpectedly went rogue. As an employee, you must destroy the servers storing the AI's network model to mitigate the damage and uncover the reasons behind the AI's loss of control.

title: Healer
description: Heal your party as you defeat the leaders of the demon lord army. Find your unique playstyle by combining upgrades. As you die, you will learn the patterns and mechanics. Maybe one day you won't have to come back to life to save the world!

title: The Oni Taiji: Mezase! Nidaime Momotarou
description: The Oni Taiji: Mezase! Nidaime Momotarou is a board mini games game based on the traditional tale of Momotaro.

title: Nautical Dispute
description: Retro nostalgic big voyage game, dream back to the road of great voyage! Exploration, management, trade, piracy and war are constant topics. With wisdom and luck, gradually build a powerful fleet. Set sail, take the Golden Silk Road again, and reproduce the great voyage!

title: Rat Catcher
description: Embark on a perilous journey as a fearless rat catcher in this nostalgic 90's-inspired dungeon crawler horror game. Explore dark and treacherous dungeons, facing off against horrifying monsters and collecting an array of eerie rats. Can you survive the darkness and emerge as the ultimate hero?

title: DCS World: UH-1H The Huey Last Show Campaign by SorelRo
description: The Huey Last Show is a story-based campaign that will test your skills as a helicopter pilot, in 15 missions you will be facing various challenges and various missions while confronting the forces of the Soviet Union.

title: Seduce Her Harem
description: Play as Vera, the young Shadow Empress in this choice-driven Dating Sim Visual Novel. Meet, seduce, and... play with the five mythical men of this reverse harem! Come in now, don't be shy...

title: Soulbind: Tales of the Underworld
description: It's up to you to become the Endless, a mysterious skeleton, and embark on a perilous journey. Collect monster body parts to enhance your character and use a variety of abilities. Explore sinister locations, fight mythical creatures and uncover the secrets of the Underworld.

title: Lumiterra: Embers of the Legacy
description: Lumiterra is a multiplayer, open-world survival crafting game where you can battle, farm with your friends, or explore mysterious creatures in a vast world!

title: The Dwarf
description: Fight against darkness and take Thaldoh's vengeance. And then accompany the hero Thaldoh's struggle and let grace fulfill itself. Discover mystery and revenge in a fantastical world with a new Role-playing game.

title: Restaurant at the End of Time
description: You find yourselves at the end of time, but your determination to run a successful restaurant remains unwavering.

title: Sex Simulator: Yoga Class
description: A steamy sex simulation game featuring visual novel elements, high definition images and videos, and realistic-looking characters set in a beautiful decor. You play the role of an instructor who shows his clients the sexual benefits of practicing yoga.

title: Clonizer
description: Hex-based tactics meets roguelike deckbuilding! Play cards, manage clones, explore unique planets and outsmart aliens. Craft a powerful deck through your expedition and Clonize the universe to become employee of the month of CLONPO!

title: Andarin Weppes
description: A first person puzzle experience of someone with advancing dementia...

title: Keep Killing
description: This is an alternative game where you only need to live to fight, fight to live

title: FarmTech
description: FarmTech is a pixel-art roguelike farming simulator with tower defense/action elements. Embark on a special mission in a world conquered by aliens. Plant, harvest, loot and gain money in the mornings. Defend your farm against waves of enemies in the night.

title: Sword & Spatula
description: A cooperative game for two players where the players take on the role of a skilled cook and a fearless warrior. Together, you must defend against waves of enemies while preparing delicious meals to keep yourself satiated. Two players, one mission: Survive together!

title: Nightmare Manor
description: Welcome to Nightmare Manor - a terrifying horror game that will take you to an old manor steeped in dark history. In this game, you will feel the cold breath of the past, finding yourself in a place where sinister entities live.

title: Operator: Drones
description: "Operator: Drones" is a drone arcade/simulator that puts you behind the remote terminal of your equipment. Fly high - hit low.

title: So Much Stuff 3: Odds & Ends
description: Discover So Much Stuff!

title: Terror in the Kitchen
description: This is a first person atmospheric horror game. The style of the game is influenced by old graphics trend (PSX games etc). You play as a part timer in a restaurant. You wash dishes, take out trash, pump the toilets and organize the table tops.

title: Realm of the Dead
description: This is a low-polygon 3D game with top-down and first-person perspectives. Control any character, switch perspectives, collect items, and rescue teammates. Use AI or the formation system to operate characters. Face hordes of zombies and respond based on your choices.

title: Cyber Assault
description: Welcome to the world of Cyber Assault, an exhilarating top-down shooter in the Japanese style, set in a mysterious Japanese mountain monastery.

title: Grandpa's House
description: A Short Indie Still and fast-paced Horror Game. Hide your games from Grandpa and survive 7 rounds!

title: Elshe no Shounen
description: A short story about a boy who has been held captive by his "older sister" Elshe ever since he remembers.

title: Cats on Duty
description: Cats on Duty is a purr-fect blend of RTS, tower defense and match-3 mechanics. Manage two game fields at once, arm and upgrade your cat towers to defeat hordes of formidable foes. Enjoy the meow-nificent battle!

title: Silted Prayer
description: A hundred years ago, the chaotic world was suddenly pacified by the sword saint Nedidora, gradually moving towards peace. However, the crisis of the curse of all things was also uncovered... On the dark world tree, what kind of things will Karulu, as a lord, encounter...

title: Ultra Foodmess 2
description: Pack your bags and grab your passport! You and your friends are going on a tasty trip around the world filled with chaos and laughter! Your favorite food characters are back in an even more epic and fun competition (now with a DASH action!)

title: Samurai Kento
description: Play as Kento, an Elder Samurai, and face the evil Yokai in this 2D pixelated mini action RPG set in Feudal Japan based scenarios!

title: Creepy Tale: Some Other Place
description: Creepy Tale is a mysterious quest rich in riddles and eerie atmosphere. An autumn morning promised a quiet fishing trip, but events took our hero to "some other place." Find the way home, uncover loads of secrets, and save everyone that you can.

title: Light City District
description: A Game And Watch-like game with a cinema noire story, set in an openworld game in real time.

title: FlipTiles: Warp Lines
description: A sci-fi arcade game. Flip tiles to change path ship move on.

title: Egg War Puzzle
description: "Egg War Puzzle" is a mixed-mode fighting puzzle action game in which battles unfold in an otherworldly reincarnation.

title: Fingernail Floss
description: A short spooky-fun visual novel where you are a special guest for a special test! Is death a game to you? Do you like color schemes that involve the color black?

title: Draken's Shrine
description: A metroidvania action platformer set in an epic fantasy world where a barbarian woman raised in the wild, pushed by her mother stories about her father decides to look for his final resting place.

title: Orbital Drop Shipping
description: An orbital mashup of physics, puzzles, and business simulation! Navigate packages through a galaxy using gravity and tools like slingshots, mass drivers, and cannons. Create your own levels & share them with the world via Steam Workshop. The ultimate space delivery challenge awaits!

title: Split Personality Doctor
description: A doctor who suddenly gains the ability to shrink his body enters the patient’s body to treat them.

title: Kosmo Azs
description: In 2033 in Russia, Vitaly is looking for a job to provide for his family. He is given a good chance to prove his ability to work and get an average paid job. Can he cope?

title: Versus Vampire
description: Take part in the eternal battle between Vampires and Humans. Choose your camp and fight in this new online multiplayer action game.

title: Death the Guitar
description: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".

title: Let Them Come: Onslaught
description: Survive the relentless offensive of the alien horde in Let Them Come: Onslaught, a sci-fi survival roguelite. The pursuit of the perfect build and an ever-expanding arsenal of abilities are the keys to your success.

title: Pine Harbor
description: Pine Harbor was a small fishing town on the shores of the North Atlantic Ocean, surrounded by cliffs and dense pine forests, shrouded in thick fog. But everything changed as a result of a technological disaster. Explore the town, help its residents, and delve into the depths of the dark forests.

title: Circle of Orion
description: A mother and son are transported from the 21st Century to the mystical world of Orionis. Meet fantastical characters, battle powerful monsters, explore a dense overworld, and discover the truth behind this mysterious world in an adventure akin to RPG classics.

title: Portal Fantasy
description:
Portal Fantasy is a creature-collecting adventure RPG. Journey through an epic storyline, collecting creatures, avoiding traps, and solving thrilling quests in this RPG with a unique take on a beloved genre.

Collect unique creatures and gather ingredients to fuse and enhance your team. Discover hundreds of combinations, which can augment your creatures, teach them new skills, and even change their appearances.

Unlock Wilderness areas to battle and collect Porbles from 6 different elements with over 50 skills and 60 passive abilities. Conquer Baddies, fuse potent ingredients, and transform your Porbles into ultimate powerhouses. The battle is on!

Journey through beautiful pixelated worlds, navigating perils, solving quests, and meeting with countless quirky characters. A captivating story, tons of side content, and a charming soundtrack await you on your adventures.

Prove your mettle by tackling traps, puzzles, and obstacles. The Wilderness is a dangerous place, as you jump and maneuver across moving platforms, voids, spikes, saws, turrets, teleporters, and more.

title: Time To Wake Up
description:
You are the victim of a nightmare in an "abandoned" hotel. Your task is to survive and leave the nightmare. Difficulties will await you.

-Granny and her Daughter hear everything.

-Try to avoid traps.

-Slendrina in the scary cellar will interfere with your play, turn away as soon as possible to avoid the consequences.

title: That Gun Crafter Cat
description: This game gives you a roguelike bullet hell experience where you play as a cat whose eggs were stolen by the birds. Do your best to retrieve the eggs by Picking up parts to Customize your own gun, and Shoot down the birds.

title: Dungeon Survivors
description: Dungeon Survivors is a top-down fantasy roguelite where you can use your class abilities to fight off a horde of fantasy monsters. Choose from a variety of abilities and items to create unique builds and survive with 1-4 players.

title: Balloons
description: Balloons is a single-player 2D racing game with roguelite elements. You can play as different emotive head balloons, breathe to gain lift, and enjoy fun and challenging tracks. The game has random map generation, different skill combinations. Win by reaching the finish line first.

title: Ar3na
description: Ar3na is a top-down battle arena game that blends fast-paced action with strategic gameplay. Engage in heart-pounding battles against epic foes as you fight for supremacy in a variety of dynamic arenas. Use your wit, reflexes, and cunning tactics to outmaneuver your opponents and emerge victorious.

title: Deckstrander
description: A survival + deck building + story generated simulator. Build shelter, craft weapon & tools, hunt food, tame animal, fight creature, slavery, and story generation with character traits.

title: Forehead Chip
description: FOREHEAD CHIP is a cyberpunk narrative platformer where you play as Chip, a recruit in the IMPLANT CORPS. Capture as many HOLDOUTS as you can to get on the scoreboard, explore a divided city, uncover secret twists, and most importantly, win the FOREHEAD CHIP!

title: The Casino Empire
description: "The Casino Empire" is an exciting game that puts you in charge of building your own Las Vegas-style casino empire.

title: Ion Shift
description: In this hardcore 2D platformer game, players take control of a small and agile creature navigating a vast and menacing space ship. The objective is simple: survive against all odds. The ship is crawling with hostile soldiers, deadly turrets, and laser drones that are constantly on the lookout.

title: Dollar King
description: Cute & cool cat politicians battle in this deck-building game! Play unlimited against players worldwide in this online two-player game! Win by collecting more votes than your opponent using a variety of cards!

title: Runes of Aereal
description: In this fast paced rogue-like deckbuilder you can roam the islands of the Aereal archipeligo in search of the 9 runes that grant immortality.

title: Quantum: Recharged
description: Dodge and encircle your enemies in this neon-drenched revival of the one-of-a-kind arcade classic!

title: Float: Champions
description: Float: Champions is an intense skill based platformer where players race to become the king of the hill. Knock down those who oppose you by launching anvils or dishing out slaps as you fight to stay at the top.

title: Stacklands: Cursed Worlds
description: Cursed Worlds is the first DLC for Stacklands. Travel to three different worlds where the villagers are haunted by tricky curses. Build up their village, then use new cards and card packs to lift the curse! 130+ new cards, 50+ new Quests and 15 new card packs!

title: Sapphic Space
description: A women-loving-women choices-matter adult visual novel in a sci-fi setting! Experience lesbian love with an android on a spaceship. Play as Miss Puter, the ship computer, and influence the story towards romance with diverse lady characters and multiple endings.

title: Pandemommyum! Hot Single Moms in My Area
description: Your tomboy neighbour will stop at nothing until she proves you're good enough to get a harem. Even if girl #2 is your boss! A ridiculous +18 comedy visual novel that just might win you over!

title: Harem in Another World
description: Save the world. Get the girls!

title: Girls Rest
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Sleeve Shock
description: You've just come back from a job, you don't remember what went wrong but all your crew mates are weirdly horny and angry at you, how will you survive their "frustrations" vented upon you?

title: Detective Patch
description: Detective Patch is an adorable 2D turn-based RPG where you solve mysteries and interrogate enemies. Battle menacing foes, meet quirky characters, and solve the mystery of the stolen ruby.

title: Defenders of Cardom
description: Defenders of Cardom is a traditional tower defense game blended with deck-builder roguelite elements. Build your deck, play your cards right, and hone your strategy to defend against waves of enemies!

title: MiniLife: Tournament
description: Build your village under a hail of gunpowder barrels and bombs. Collect resources and defend against enemy sieges. Destroy enemy fortifications with combat llamas and mega mechs. MiniLife: Tournament is a cooperative game where only teamwork leads to victory!

title: GhostCatcher
description: Ghost Catcher is a cooperative horror game that can be played by at least 1 and up to 8 players. You need to perform mysterious rituals in a haunted house, confront spirits, identify their true nature, and ultimately capture them.

title: Alice in Dinerland
description: Embark on a whimsical and treacherous journey through a twisted version of Wonderland in "Alive in Dinerland," a gripping survival game inspired by the beloved tale of Alice in Wonderland.

title: Mtn Chaos
description: Conquer treacherous mountain terrain in Mtn Chaos! Drive powerful off-road vehicles, jump ramps, dodge obstacles, and customize your ride. Experience intense racing and thrilling challenges in this adrenaline-fueled off-road adventure!

title: Coffee, Plis
description: A young man gets to fill in for his colleagues at a large cafeteria franchise as his first job, but things spiral out of control when he discovers chaos, also known as rush hour.

title: Faunamorph
description: Mutant foes await: Transform into different animals and recombine your own DNA to unlock new abilities in Faunamorph. Uncover the mysteries of your origin in this action-packed 2D metroidvania about genetics and mutations.

title: Farm Manager World
description: Dive into the agricultural life with Farm Manager World! Manage your own farm across vibrant global locations, cultivate exotic crops, and build your agribusiness empire. Welcome to sustainable farming at its finest.

title: Protect the Planet
description: This is a simple typing game. In the game, the alien from the UFO is very evil, he will shoot many missiles to attack the planet. You need to type and type, to destroy the missiles, to protect the planet.

title: Musical Vibes
description: Discover a new dance game playable with the camera of your smartphone connected to your PC! Dance, hands free, to great music and learn new cool moves!

title: The Wine Hunt: Aim Fidelity
description: The Wine Hunt: Aim Fidelity is a quirky AI-driven blend of memory and aim training with a touch of dodgeball. Prove your spatial memory, precision, and dodging skills. Master diverse scenarios, and strive for high scores on the leaderboard!

title: Tattoos and Tulips
description: Follow Chrys as he declares to swear off dating in favor of focusing on himself and hanging out with friends. That is until a very sweet, and very hot tattoo artist named Shay enters the picture. Has Chrys' bad luck gone away?

title: Exodus: Sunflower on the Horizon
description: You're given a chance to find out what really makes the earth turn... But will you like what you see? Exodus is the ultimate sci-fi RPG experience about love, friendship, and deadly monsters.

title: Pesticide Not Required
description: Mow down countless crops and corrupt critters while crafting game-breaking builds! Pesticide Not Required is a bullet heaven, horde survival roguelite with farming elements that offers a myriad of stats and special character traits to create wildly diverse run possibilities.

title: Superbot Arena
description: Design your own Superbot and fight alongside or against others in this VR battle arena! Make your own motion gestures to activate a variety of abilities and effects to aid you in destroying your opponents. Includes AI bots and different game modes like "smash off" and endless play.

title: Dungeon of the Forgotten King
description:
Dungeon of the Forgotten King is a single-player turn-based roguelite RPG that combines pixel art with 3D graphics.

You awaken in a mysterious dungeon with no memory of how you arrived. A magical camp serves as your safe haven, where you can level up, heal, change classes, and obtain equipment before venturing deeper into the dungeon.

Combat is the core of the game. Defeat enemies to earn Gold and Loot, but each consecutive battle increases both the rewards and the difficulty. Spend your resources wisely, as death is permanent.

Even after death, your progress continues through Soul Gems, a permanent progression system that unlocks upgrades for future runs.

Face powerful Dungeon Bosses to gain unique run-long bonuses and eventually challenge the Dungeon Master to escape. Along the way, discover random events, play camp mini-games for extra rewards, and battle a wide variety of enemies in a constantly evolving dungeon.

title: Last Signal
description: Plan the perfect infiltration. Route a stealth robot past patrols and cameras, hack terminals, operate machinery, and manipulate the environment to create your path. Then execute your plan and watch it play out. Every decision matters.

title: Faceminer
description: Faceminer is the dystopian narrative-driven A.I. management sim where you build a biometric data processing empire from scratch. Classify dubiously sourced data, upgrade mining infrastructure, and scale up your A.I. surveillance empire to obscene ends in this hardcore thriller clicker set in 1999.

title: Lobber
description: LOBBER is a top down hack and slash where you can hack, slash, and chop your way to victory! Cut off skeleton's heads and catch their skulls to perform powerful moves!

title: Locator: The Search for Abigail Lidari
description: A Geoguessr-inspired detective game set on an alien planet. Pinpoint the exact locations of photos to track down missing archeologist Abigail Lidari. Cross-reference journal entries, decipher cryptic symbols, and uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization. Find her... before it’s too late.

title: Golful
description: Run, jump, and putt yourself around the map in this golf-themed puzzle platformer. Collect items, test your knowledge, and think critically to solve various physics-based puzzles.

title: Moonlight Mayhem
description: Moonlight Mayhem is a 4-15 player multiplayer horror game where the goal is to eliminate werewolves for humans or vice versa. To do this, you can team up with players, but make sure they are on your side or they could decide to backstab you.

title: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator
description: Are you ready to immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of car parking management? Step into the shoes of a visionary entrepreneur and become the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon! Take Charge and embark on a thrilling journey of strategy, expansion, and success.

title: The Witch's Cookbook
description: Concoct magical potions with or without the help of your community's chat. You'll experiment with different ingredients to create powerful spells, but beware - your viewers can add their own twists resulting in hilarious and unpredictable outcomes. Get ready for a chaotic and exciting experience!

title: Slug Gear
description: Slug Gear is an action-packed Metroidvania within a universe of insect-human hybrids. Collect unique trinkets, fight powerful bosses and discover the lost lore of the world!

title: The Math Problem Killer
description: The Math Problem Killer is a crime-themed, math-based, dungeon crawler. The player assumes the role of a Serial Killer Task Force Special Agent that must traverse dungeons by solving complicated math word problems created by a serial killer, in order to rescue a hostage.

title: Strange Seed
description: Evolve your creature using parts from mammals, birds, insects, and even dinosaurs! From your humble beginnings as a shape-shifting slime, build up your genetic potential and adapt your way through the islands of New Haven.

title: When the Light Dies
description: When the Light Dies is a survival game with roguelite elements set in a desolate, frozen wilderness. Step into a murky world of shadow and obscurity as a lone survivor fighting to keep the darkness and the horrors that lurk within at bay.

title: Llamalandia
description: In Llamalandia you play as a cute Llama that got lost in the mountains, prepare yourself to explore a new world that you have never seen before, while you embark on a magical journey across the Bolivian altiplano, facing many challenges in order to find your family and save the rest of your species.

title: 2x4 Nails
description: You are FBI Field Photographer Thomas Greene, fighting and documenting the crimes of a German serial killer known to the press as "Der Kannibale".

title: Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature
description: Get ready for another card battling adventure on Kamigami! Easy to play, hard to master, collect brand new cards, face over 80 opponents, build your strategies and restore peace to the gods!

title: Flying Toyz
description: Fast, competitive sport game where all the map objects are interactable. In Flying Toyz you fight using gadgets to outplay the opponents while playing in an alive room, full of environmental hazards, from which you should stay away!

title: Falling Limbs
description: Falling Limbs is a 2 to 4 player online and local platform fighter game. Customize your samurai, wield a variety of weaponry and vanquish every rival

title: New Yankee: Mary's Dark Side
description: The bond between John and Mary is unbreakable. They embark on adventures together, and always support each other. But their lives take an unexpected turn when Mary's memory is lost. Join John in an epic quest to restore Mary's memories now!

title: Auto Sale Life
description: Build an automotive empire. Buy, sell, and customize cars to create your own brands and showrooms. Become a shrewd entrepreneur in this immersive car trading and customization game.

title: Cat's Cosmic Atlas
description: Gaze upon the stars and other celestial bodies. Cat’s Cosmic Atlas takes you through the Southern and Northern skies. Experience the most beautiful sights and learn a thing or two about the vast Universe that surrounds us.

title: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef
description: An action roguelike co-op dungeon crawler set in a lovecraftian universe.

title: Draw
description: Welcome to the world of Draw, a 2D sidescroller and visual novel! Armed with nothing but a pencil, play as "Stickman" as you explore a brand-new world. Solve puzzles by drawing into the game, meet new friends while dodging scribble monsters, and make memories that’ll never be erased!

title: Crown Gambit
description: Choose the next sovereign in this dark fantasy game, featuring card battles and visual novel-like dialogues with multiple endings. Play your cards well, use your skills with care, and move carefully in these turn-based battles, where the weak rely on luck and the Heroes on their talent.

title: Astrotester
description: An action adventure game. Complete story tasks at various locations-levels. Fight against the dominant forces of the Stream and hostile creatures. Learn more about the world of the Star Network.

title: Golembert
description: Golembert is a beautifully illustrated story game about a Gardener Golem that takes care of the plants and spirits on his own small island. Manage the needs of your plants within a circular economy, grow fresh veggies, barter them with your friends and be ready for an adventure! Are there other Levighosts out there like Helio? How is the Great War related to your garden? And what about the cutthroat Trade Co. that makes life difficult for Frieda? Meet lovable characters, decorate your garden and make the world a better place through your choices!

title: Graveyard Gunslingers
description: Shoot down furious hordes of zombies until morning arrives. During the day explore, gather resources, and upgrade your gear to prepare for the next night. Create a unique build combining your favorite gunslinger characters, weapons, and abilities. Survive!

title: Zehlar
description: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

title: Swimming Dynasty
description: Take your mark... Go! Create up to 5 characters, upgrade your swimmers, recruit swimmers to improve your team and climb to the top division. Build your team from scratch and compete for the championship! Start your dynasty now!

title: Chiki-Chiki
description: Chiki-Chiki is a multiplayer racing game staged in the colorful reefs of Batabada. This frenzic gameplay based on physics will make you want to challenge all of your friends & family through a smashing versus experience. Make sure you samba hard.

title: Pro Philosopher 2: Governments & Grievances
description: Dive headfirst into everyone's favorite topic: politics! Engage famous philosophers of all stripes, challenge their ideas, and change the world— or just tell everyone they smell terrible. NONSENSE!

title: Slippy the Frog
description: Much like Slippy himself, this game is jam packed with mini games, cuteness, and gallons of juice.

title: Far Out: Selene
description: Step into the role of lab technician Zack Paterson and uncover the mystery of Selene's expedition. With no maps or guidance to rely on, your wits become the sole compass guiding the path. Prepare yourself for an exciting adventure, as multiple endings await your decisions!

title: Time Drive: Racing Destiny
description: Hentai of Multiverse – there are a lot of girls waiting for you in this universe who are ready to go to great lengths, if of course you have a good memory and you can find the same cards for them!

title: Tiny Europe
description: Do you like to "paint the map", but tired of the complexity? We present to your attention the most stupid and primitive strategy in the world!

title: Princess Paladin
description: Clobber the Castle Crashers! Princess Paladin is a 2D action game where you fight to remove uninvited houseguests. Follow Princess Nala as she uses all the magic at her disposal (and a giant club) to empty out her castle and regain her peace and quiet.

title: Version Three: Invisible Raid
description: Authentic Customizable Mech Action Game. Customize the combat mech "V3" and run through the battlefield!

title: Gore Doctor
description: Gore Doctor is an immersive horror game set to unleash spine-chilling thrills on PC. You find yourself in the institute of a tormented doctor who, driven by desperation after losing his wife, descends into madness and becomes convinced that death is the only respite.

title: Chicken Police: Into the Hive!
description: A wild tale of loss, friendship, conspiracy, and... chickens?! Two rooster detectives are about to venture into the insect underworld to uncover a worldwide conspiracy, while also battling their inherent demons in this animal noir adventure satire.

title: DanDan
description: It's simple, but it needs some ingenuity! ? An action game where bullets keep bouncing! If you attack to defeat an enemy, the bullets you fire will continue to bounce off, so you will continue to avoid your own attacks. Proceed through the stages by adjusting the timing and position of your attacks.

title: Misgiven
description: Misgiven is a 2D sci-fi adventure about the lump in your throat and how difficult it can be to say certain things. Stranded in a city of masks and toxic fog, find people you can trust and, via a tangible dialog system, experience how scary and awkward, but also how fulfilling, communication can be.

title: Dreaming Chicken
description: Explore and climb high and wide in the mysterious adventure of a chicken who wants to fly and fulfill his dreams.

title: Vox Populi: Spain 2023
description: Play as an existing or fully customized political figure, and campaign for the Spanish general election of 2023! In "Vox Populi: Spain 2023", you and the characters around you will have to promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

title: A True Story
description: A True Story is a turn-based strategy RPG based on "A True Story" (a sci-fi story from the 2nd century) by Lucian of Samosata.

title: Elite Rogue
description: Exciting, ever-changing 3rd person roguelike. Defeat monsters, collect powerful loot, and continuously strengthen yourself. Experience indefinite exploration or face the ultimate challenge of the final boss. How far will you push your limits?

title: Homebound Haerold
description: On one really bad day of his own vicious cycle. On his way home, Little Haerold's car breaks down in the bad part of town. And then he breaks down, in the violent way. Now Haerold is Homebound and Postal.

title: Pyroworks
description: Pyroworks is a free-to-play online multiplayer game containing fireworks from real-life companies from all over the globe. You can choose to make your own show, cause destruction and chaos or simulate new years. Don't miss out on playing with your friends - the most fun part.

title: Wagon
description: Wagon is a 1-bit card game where you make tough decisions to try and survive winter on the Oregon Trail.

title: Wordward Draw
description: Explore 4 letter words.

title: Inside Job
description: A reverse tower defense

title: Planet of War: The Legend of Fu
description: Save the world the way you want to: Most main and side quests as well as the game itself have several endings depending on your choices. A tactical combat system with over 100 different character and equipment skills. Over 20 hours of gameplay and over 20 original soundtracks.

title: Monochrome Heights
description: Monochrome Heights is a fast paced, challenging 2D platformer inspired by games like Super Mario Bros. and Megaman. It features crisp pixel art, a unique color swapping mechanic, and lots of robots.

title: Etrom: 20th Anniversary Edition
description: A point & click action RPG set in a dark future. Unravel the mysteries of a mystical artifact and your own identity as a fugitive. Explore sprawling cities, engage in epic battles, and navigate parallel dimensions in this immersive techno-fantasy adventure.

title: The Forest of Conx
description: The Forest of Conx: A spooky noir styled survival horror tower defense game

title: WitchHand
description: You're a witch, leading your coven into new, unfriendly lands. Use the cards you find to build and expand your civilization. Befriend the local covens or use their bones to fuel your spells. Gather your familiars, the witching hour is nigh.

title: Secret Shuffle
description: Social deduction games meets dance parties?! Secret Shuffle is a party game for 4 or more players with phones & headphones. Guess which player doesn’t hear any music but instead pretends to, or find the others dancing to the same music!

title: Rebirth of Arcadia
description: Rebirth of Arcadia is a turn-based tactics game with roguelike elements and contemplative story. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, wield and modify the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

title: London Cab
description: Imagine yourself as a 19th-century London carriage driver. You must be vigilant, as danger lurks at every corner. Darkness and challenging times make surviving in this world even until the next day difficult. You must be brave and make wise decisions to endure in this gloomy world full of perils.

title: ChronoDojo
description: ChronoDojo is a cute, cooperative tower defense beat 'em up game in which humble heroes travel time to bash, build and save the world!

title: Quarta Amethyst
description:
As Quarta Amethyst, the strongest knight in the Quarta Order, battling Olicts is your responsibility. When you discover that they've set up a den in a forest near a settlement, it's time for you to take action.

What's behind the Olicts' increasing activity? What are their plans? Most importantly, can you put a stop to them without falling for their fiendish traps?

title: Legends of Duels
description: Legends of Duels is a turn-based multiplayer TCG where champions with unique abilities engage in strategic duels. Build your deck and challenge the world!

title: Deaths Toll
description: Journey across the world with a deadly beast always right on your tail! Go alone or with a buddy as you search for supplies, compete in dance-offs, meet a bunch of weirdos, and fight off hordes of monsters in a randomly generated quest for survival!

title: Unreachable
description: An urgent message from home, a choice with an impossible price tag. In a 20-minute high-stakes dialogue, you must dismantle a "perfect" engineer's facade. Faced with $100,000 and a family tragedy, will you help him preserve his costly "American Dream," or force him to face the half-packed suitcase?

title: Hunchback's Dungeon
description: Destroy hordes of enemies in this top-down roguelike arena shooter. In Hunchback's Dungeon, you play as a deformed, magic-wielding human who can control up to 4 different spells. Unlock new characters, collect unique items, equip powerful spells, and survive until the end.

title: Automate Defend Repeat
description: Automate, Defend, Repeat: a cosmic game of factory management and tower defense strategy. Build a planet-dominating factory, defend it from disgruntled elementals, and upgrade until the locals hand over the keys to their world. Once you've claimed one planet, launch off to colonize the next!

title: Hellwatch
description: Join a squad of 4 suicidal to protect the celestial artifact from demon invasion in online cooperative roguelite. Reveal yourself in a munchkin way: support your team or drain their power. Struggle your way to better gear and beware debuffs from death. Kill, die, defeat, repeat!

title: The Secret Ties of Strandcliff
description: A detective game where you fiddle information to your advantage. As an owner of a small bar, listen to visitors of your establishment, overhear their gossiping, collect information and then use to manipulate their thoughts and actions.

title: Jelly & Toast
description: Jelly & Toast is a local co-op game where you control Jelly and Toast on an exciting quest for stolen magical ingredients. Throw your friends or boxes, beware of enemy cooks or kitchen hazards, and explore a world full of culinary challenges!

title: Edward's Journey
description: Set out on an epic journey to find your missing sister in a beautifully unique hand-crafted world full of secrets, puzzles, and danger.

title: Roving Rovers
description: Roving Rovers is a lunar rover simulation representative of the Australian Rover Challenge of 2023. It replicates the challenges that teams in the challenge will perform!

title: Silent Rain
description: Silent Rain is an online co-op, horror game, designed for 1 to 4 players. Team up with friends or brave the terror alone in this immersive horror experience. Explore and unravel mysteries by solving intricate puzzles, all while evading the grasp of a mysterious doctor.

title: Cats Game

title: Dino Path Trail
description: Dino Path Trail is a journey across a Wild West full of dangers in a world where dinosaurs have never gone extinct. Set up your camp and bring it along thanks to your classic western wagon towed by dinosaurs. Explore canyons, mountains and swamps and survive the harsh environment and predators.

title: Survivor: Castaway Island
description: Do you have what it takes to outplay your mates and become the sole Survivor? Explore a deserted island where you can only rely on instinct and strategy to outlast competition and survive on the island.

title: Bite Size Terrors: Reverse Blue
description: The Bright Blue Sky... Is Hiding Something.

title: SokoChess Black
description: SokoChess Black is a puzzle game about pushing and capturing Chess pieces while overcoming various obstacles. Enjoy 70 different handcrafted levels with a unique twist on the Chess formula.

title: Artifice
description: Adventure across two worlds, fight cyborg managers, learn magic, and save the world from a sentient AI in this turn-based RPG inspired by the classics of the genre.

title: Nightshift Survival
description: Survive Till Dawn. Nightshift Survival is a rogue-lite action game where the objective is to survive the night. Are you able to survive in this park?

title: Eventide Matter
description:
A 2D space mining adventure. Captured by a space anomaly, you find yourself stranded in another universe! Fortunately, your ship is equipped for mining and crafting.

Harvest exotic resources, manufacture components, and construct a massive inter-dimensional portal - your only hope of getting back home.

title: Together in Between
description: Together in Between is a first-person adventure-puzzle game. You have been imprisoned in a magic book with your partner, in the same place but in different dimensions. Will you be able to overcome the Wizard King's puzzles, and see your partner again?

title: End of Legends
description: Unleash your Darklord in this captivating card game. Dive into roguelike adventure, cast powerful spells, and evolve cards. Explore upgradeable cards, summon formidable minions, and unleash devastating spells. conquer all. let the light prevail in this dark fantasy realm.

title: Death Ration: Back to 19XX
description: In Death Ration, You can confront the aliens to save the world, uncover the truth behind the spread of nanomachines and invasion, dedicate your remaining time to work for the community of refugees, transport supplies to camps using trucks, decorate your own house with furniture, the choice is yours.

title: Crash Course Builder
description: Can you make it to the finish line? Crash your kart through impossible obstacle courses that will leave you wanting just… one… more… go! 2ez? Pfft! Build your own course to share with other crash test dummies!

title: Dungeon Evolution: Nemesis
description: Face the ever-evolving Nemesis, utilizing your character's skills and attributes to overcome challenges. Explore the mysterious dungeon, encounter thrilling events, and make strategic decisions. Are you ready to embark on an endless adventure in "Dungeon Evolution: Nemesis"?

title: NeoCars
description: Original and immersive cyberpunk driving game. Use your drifts to make your lines deadly for your opponents. Solo, local cooperative and online multiplayer modes. Play on a team with players of the same or different colors. Immersive soundtrack. Unique and stimulating gaming experience.

title: Who Did It?
description: Who Did It? Is a detective puzzle-game. Your job is to read the given case files to find out who the murderer is! Do you have what it takes to master all cases and close them all for good?

title: Team Five
description:
Five animals. Five exits. Five Minutes.

Demolish your friends online in a race against the clock. Boost your weapons to the max, annihilate the map so even its mother won't recognize it, and get the hell out!

title: Lost in Darkness
description: Lost in Darkness is a 3D top-down horror action game set in the snowy Atlas Mountains of Morocco. Deep in the Moroccan countryside, you are a Royal Gendarmerie motorcyclist who finds himself stranded alone in the woods while investigating the disappearance of a patrol car.

title: Mage and Monsters II
description: Recruit a hero to lead your army, and use spells while they fight for you. Mage & Monsters 2 is an active auto battler, where you choose to either enhance the strength of your hero, reinforce the might of your army, or increase the power of your spells.

title: Stronghold Conquest
description: In this thrilling Tower Defense - type game, you will become the main defender of your kingdom. Build powerful guns and strategically deploy them on the battlefield to fend off waves of incoming enemies. Your goal is to protect your territory and destroy all threats using various types of guns.

title: Botanical Warden
description: Botanical Warden is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder in which plants are used to fight strategic challenging turn-based combat. Evolve your plants with artificial selection and hybridization to create endless possibilities in your quest to defeat other tribes and conquer a barren island.

title: Era One
description: Era One is an innovative space game that combines elements of real-time strategy, base building, space survival, and tactical battles. Players can create and customize their bases from scratch, construct various types of structures and warships, manage fleets, and engage in tactical space battles.

title: Parkour Labs
description: Are you good at parkour video games? Are you number 1 in surfing mode? This is your game, welcome to Parkour Labs, an experience that will test your skills.

title: Single Malt Apocalypse
description: Not everything is fine in the small mining town of Cinderbrook. Your task is to find out what on earth is happening in the shadows of the town! Solve the mystery in this old-school adventure game with RPG influences!

title: We Need to Cook
description: We need to cook! You are a drug-designing genius, living a bland existence in a middle-class neighborhood in Utah. You decide you want more out of life, so you buy a beat-up RV, drive it into the desert, and cook drugs. Make immense profits!

title: Webventure
description: You and your friend will have work together to overcome challenges using your webs and creativity, helping each other and unraveling the mysteries of the forest.

title: Relic Guardian
description: "Relic Guardian" is a fantasy-style strategy tower defense game. As the builder on the battlefield, summon a variety of defense towers and spells with reliable hero companions to complete this epic and guarding adventure!

title: Neo Junk City
description: Dive into Neo Junk City, a cyberpunk adventure where you’re an android detective unraveling your own murky past. Navigate neon streets, engage with unique characters, and race through the rain-soaked city. Uncover secrets in this twist on point-and-click gameplay.

title: Sujimon Quest
description: A village is under attack by fearsome monsters known as Sujimon, prompting one brave woman to team up with a yakuza to bring them down!

title: Ancient Polis
description: Travel back 2600 years to ancient Greece. Build and manage your city (polis) and experience and shape the life of the ancient Greeks on your own terms.

title: Aquascapers
description: Bring Nature Home! Experience Aquascapers, a single-player and co-op aquascaping simulation that invites you and friends to discover and gather various ornamental resources for your aquascaping projects. Enhance your business and dominate the market!

title: Asfalia: Panic at the Mansion
description: A spooky shadow is on the loose within Asfalia. Join Charlie and flamboyant sidekick Lilly in their search of four adorable missing puppies. Meet amazing characters, solve fun puzzles, and collect beautiful stickers along the way! Chase the shadows away in a captivating story-driven game suitable for all ages.

title: Moen
description: Climb the mountain while you make friends. A multiplayer 3D platformer playground where you do whatever you feel like. You can climb the mountain, do activities around the Island or just chill out and meet new friends.

title: Rune Coliseum: Chained Warrior
description: A prologue to a RuneColiseum: deck-building roguelike game with unique semi-real-time combat system. Take your first steps in the Coliseum as a Chained Warrior. Find your fighting style and become the ultimate champion in this thrilling death tournament.

title: D96: Kansei
description: An arcade online racing game in an open world that will allow you to experience the atmosphere of night roads, as well as participate in drift competitions with your friends. Tune up your car, get behind the wheel and race along the narrow, winding tracks of the drift valley!

title: Rush: Run Up Super High
description: Join this intense MMO 3D precision platformer! Leap, parkour, and climb massive, uncharted locations and compete against 199 others in a race to the top. With a perfect character control system, all you need is focus and patience to smash records and reach unprecedented heights!

title: Bumper Arena
description: Buckle up! Bumper Arena is a party game in which you drive a bumper car through a series of arenas featuring different mini-games. Bump and bounce your opponents off the walls, earn the most points during the round and try to win the game!

title: Retris
description: A fresh take on the the falling block puzzle genre. Embrace imperfection with glitches and broken pieces to overcome this new challenge. Chase high scores or learn new techniques in a puzzle mode with over 50 handcrafted puzzles.

title: Bunny Guys!
description: Welcome to Bunny Guys! Climb, explore and have fun or be frustrated? Fight your way to the top with full of obstacles that want to stop you from reaching the top.

title: Nok
description: Get ready to NOK household items out of camps, aquariums and trains! Fling objects and make a huge mess in this weird, prize-awarded, physics-based 3D hidden object game to find items hinted by absurd dad jokes with satisfying “Aha!” moments that make you feel very, very smart.

title: Snapback
description: Snapback is a Speed-Runner Puzzle Platformer set in a robot dystopia where you are recruited to rebel against the evil GovCorp overlords, break the rules, and join the resistance!

title: Top Gnome
description: A top down shooter where the only way to move and fight is with the recoil of your blunderbuss. Whirl through waves of garden-destroying pests to defend Bert's garden, strive to reach higher and higher scores and become the Top Gnome!

title: Bone Born
description: Bone Born is Topdown, defense, casual and Co-op online game. make your skeleton with your friends and family to defend the infinity waves of demon enemies.

title: Micro Games: Volume 1
description: Retro 2D collection of 4 micro games

title: Tactics Greed
description: Aim for the top of the arena by using unique tactics combining units, magic, and formations! Casual action real-time strategy game that can be played with one hand!

title: February of Cards
description: This is a card game where you place 28 cards arranged like a calendar and compete with your opponent by taking the coins placed there and combining them with bonuses obtained by taking them continuously. Choose a player from among 26 alphabet characters and aim for the strongest.

title: Outrunner: Neon Nights
description: Outrunner: Neon Nights merges arcade racing with snake-style mechanics. Race, jump, and defy gravity as you outsmart your opponents. Whether you prefer intense one-on-one duels or chaotic multiplayer mayhem, you can join the neon-lit arenas online with up to 8 players.

title: Spooky Crew: Mask of the Mysterium
description: Join the Spooky Crew and uncover the secret of the Mask of the Mysterium in this point and click adventure game. An encounter with a masked figure leads the crew to investigate the secrets of a local museum.

title: The Mobius Machine
description: Discover a vast alien world. Fight the ferocious local fauna and killer machines. Reveal its secrets and find a way to escape. The Mobius Machine is a side-scroller action platformer with dynamic combat and heavy emphasis on exploration.

title: Heartwood Online
description: Heartwood Online is a cross-platform free-to-play MMO. Explore a vast world filled with adventure where you choose your own path. Immerse yourself in crafting, trade, PvP & PvE battles, guilds, politics, and a thriving player economy.

title: Little Monster
description: Little Monster is a hand painted side scroller beat ‘em up where you play as Stormy, a monster under the bed who protects us from our nightmares. Protect the dream! Explore the realms! Rescue your friends!

title: Curse of Blood
description: Curse of Blood is a brand new 32-level megawad for Doom 2. It's made by Mattias Johansson (waverider) and Michael Jan Krizik (valkiriforce).

title: Bloody Hills
description: Bloody Hills is an intense and heart-pounding survival horror game set in the depths of a secluded forest camp. As night falls, you find yourself trapped in a twisted game of cat and mouse with a relentless killer known as The Hiker. Armed with only your wits and limited resources, you must fight to survive until dawn while evading the sadistic clutches of this merciless predator.

title: The Adventures of Panzer 2
description: Set approximately 1 year after the events of the first game, Panzer returns to his role as Raid Leader of the Zergadins. The old team has been "recruited", an all-new state-of-the-art headquarters built, and a world of adventure awaits!

title: Crocogame
description: Crocogame is a fast-paced roguelite game with intense moment-to-moment combat and flexible character customization. Use your resources efficiently to take on increasingly difficult threats. Great challenges also bring great rewards!

title: Shred the Undead
description: Shredthe Undead, is a 4 player musical co-op hack-and-slash games. Instead of warriors, elves and wizards, you will be slaying zombies with guitars, drum sticks and piano keys. Travel from LA to Hell in 28 levels.

title: Guardians
description: Guardians, an extraordinary action role-playing game that transports you to a captivating universe teeming with danger, discovery, and heroism. Immerse yourself in a sprawling, post-apocalyptic world where chaos-infected creatures roam, and the fate of civilization rests on your shoulders.

title: Retrowave World
description: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, chrome robot women, speeding 80s supercars... Welcome to Retrowave World!

title: Lazarus A.D. 2222
description: The final part of the Sons of Welder game series, set in a dystopian universe, which uniquely combines games from the Magnus series. A game that you can experience on two levels. Hand-drawn motion comics. A metaphorical journey into oneself. A mystical experience with a touch of good humor.

title: Black Box Lss: The Shining Immortal
description: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art AVG that blends thrilling crime, romantic comedy, and the pursuit of love. This game depicts the story of a new employee pursuing his female boss. If you're a fan of love, yandere, and don't mind a touch of thrill and crime, you will greatly enjoy this game.

title: A Dog of Flanders
description: A Dog of Flanders is an adventure game based on the novel of the same name by the British author Ouida.

title: Cybertrash Statyx
