Dungeon Synths features an ogg soundtrack of music from classic RPGs, particularly Legend of Dragoon and Dark Cloud 2, newly arranged for (virtual) vintage synthesizers and drum machines.

title: The DBK Holiday Special
description: The DBK Holiday Special is a 15-map Christmas adventure from the December Bastards Krew, which takes the holiday season into the darkest reaches of outer space. Fans of Alien Bastards! and Spaceballs: The Seque﻿l should be particularly interested in this one! ;)

title: Shrine of the Silver CyberPrimate
description: Shrine of the Silver CyberPrimate is a 6+? map techno-mesoamerican adventure from the Diabolical Broadcasting Korporation, serving as a semi-spiritual successor to DBP09: Legends of the Hidden Tech. The project targets ZDoom 2.8.1 but has also been tested with recent GZDoom versions, especially 4.10.0. As with previous DBKs, the goal here is to use well-established ZDoom features to suggest a hypothetical '90s game engine made up of bits of Doom, Build, Quake, and Hexen. Since our goal is not to push the bleeding edge of modern source ports, effort has been made to keep the set playable on lower-spec machines.

title: Team Fortress 2 Classic: Fight or Flight
description:
The Fight or Flight update, was the second major update for Team Fortress 2 Classic.

True to its namesake, it focused on content related to mobility, as well as several weapons and maps. Its flagship feature is the Jump Pad, an Engineer building that allows taking to the skies. The Anti-Aircraft Cannon was designed for Heavy to swat enemies out of the air, while the Twin Barrel affords Pyro greater mobility. The Brick gives Scout a hard-hitting projectile, while the Heavy gains Chekhov's Punch and the Pyro gains the Harvester - both weapons that store critical hits for later. Finally, L'escampette gives the Spy an alternate watch, allowing for easier escapes.

The update also introduces the Arena map Floodgate, the Four-Team King of the Hill map Frigid, the Payload map Jinn, the Four-Team Medieval Mode map Krepost, and the new Territorial Domination game mode with the map Caper.

title: Invasion...: Level 1 - Contamination
description:
This is level 1 of a 9 level storyline episode.

You thought it was all over after you finished the grand tour in hell after Episode 3 -- Inferno.

Well, Mars Base has sent in an urgent distress call and this time you are called again for one final encounter against the... INVASION!

title: Invasion...: Level 2 -The Upper Decks
description:
This is level 1 of a 4 level storyline episode.

[It's too much work to make 9, so we decided to compress the story a bit!]

title: Skepland
description: An attempt to create difficult, non-linear maps in the plutonia visual style, without going the slaughterfest route.

title: Zaero
description: Zaero: Episode 1 is a three-level PWAD for Doom II, released in June 2005 by Steven Searle. Built for the ZDoom source port, Zaero is heavily inspired by Quake II and features a similar aesthetic, with the gameplay enhancements being reinforced by the addition of several custom enemies through DECORATE. Planned to be the first entry with more maps to come, no sequel ever materialized.

title: Rylayeh
description: Ten levels based on the Lost City of R'Lyeh.

title: Judgment
description: Judgment is an action-adventure game played from a third-person perspective. The game is a legal thriller set in the Yakuza world of Kamurocho and follows private detective Takayuki Yagami as he investigates a serial murder case. It stars Japanese actor Takuya Kimura and employs a fighting system similar to that of Yakuza 0 where players can change into different styles, namely crane-style which is more focused on fighting groups and tiger-style which is more focused on fighting individuals. Additionally, the game features an investigation mode where the player must find traces of the criminal.

title: Nensha
description:
Nensha is a mostly run-and-gun style loop through a grimy, demonic techbase, made in boom format (complevel 9). I've never been big on making techbases, but I had fun exploring some ideas with this one. Fingers crossed that it's bug-free and some kind of entertaining!

In terms of difficulty, I tried to aim for that Plutonia/Scythe/Valiant range (with varying degrees of success). It's not a complete pushover, but not overly punishing.

Hurt Me Plenty was what the map was built for (""intended experience""). It has some kick to it here and there, but most players shouldn't feel too out of their element. Ultra-Violence is just HMP with a few extra cheeky monsters/encounters, intended to catch the player off guard a bit more.
HNTR is now Hunted! Taking inspiration from Mutabor's "Onslaught!", this is an alternate version of the map for anyone who prefers their Doom extra spicy. Gets into slaughter territory, and I probably wouldn't recommend it as a first impression.

title: Caffeine Injection!
description:
Caffeine Injection is 5 maps long episode for Doom II done between 2020-2022. It's made from various projects I couldn't finish in time or left when I changed my mind. I didn't want to waste those levels, so I compiled them in one small ep.
Pistol start is the intended experience.

title: Azazel's Second Descent
description: Azazel's Second Descent is a full, 32 map megawad. This is a one-man megawad and all maps were made by me. I would categorize the maps as slaughter-lite, meaning it is not full-on slaughter but you might face a horde or two, especially the farther into the wad you go. The WAD is broken down into six 5-map episodes. There are 4 new monster types and 2 bosses added.

title: The Box of a Thousand Demons
description: The Box of a Thousand Demons is a brand new 32-map Boom megawad, targeting DSDA-Doom as a port and using OTEX as its main texture pack. It focuses on variety over visual consistency, and explicitly caters to all manners of niche and aberrant gameplay - within you will find lite and fat slaughter, key hunts, puzzles, platforming, pacifist maps, Tyson maps, NoMo maps, ammo starvation maps, the whole nine yards. A little something for everyone. Atmosphere was my main concern, with streamlined gameplay a distant second.

title: Twelve Easy Pieces
description: "Twelve Easy Pieces" (formerly known as "Constraining Order") is a set of twelve (or was it thirteen?...) Boom format maps that sets out to do exactly what it says on the tin - provide you some fun in an easy, stress-free environment. No evil archvile closets here (although my memory might fail me, it's been a while since I cleaned out those closets); no nasty obstacles to your carefree circlestrafing (watch your step though, I'm not insured); and certainly no revenants (skinny guy in red pants told me, how could he be wrong?). Take a stroll through techbases, temples, aquatic environments and out-there voids, always knowing that even on UV you'll never face anything worse than a slightly spicy HMP Plutonia. Small maps with low monster counts, a restrained texture choice, and occasionally a dash of my personal foibles - puzzles and platforming. Nothing you can't overcome, believe me

title: Declared New Apocalypse
description:
The player will travel through prisons, rifts, mazes, fortresses, forests, graveyards, sewers, factories, labs, the Hell, haunted libraries, all to chase down (or be chased down) by new stronger demons and bosses, but with the help of new powerful weapons at his disposal.

The wad presents 3 new Episodes, with 14 new levels, 12 + 2 secret, a Hub (reachable by beating the final level or just by entering the "Reliquary" episode), from where you can play all of the levels pistol starting (actually "fist starting"), go to a "testing area", change the skill level and reach the secret 15th level, a wave based arena.

title: The Man in the Park 2
description: It's been so long. You've tried to forget, however tonight you must walk through the park again. Now there are two men in the park. Will you help one, or both? Who will you trust?

title: Project Americas
description: Project Americas is a game that shows life in a criminal area as it is. You play as an ordinary fighter who has grand ambitions and strives for more. Make your way to the top of the criminal world, make your orders, create your gang, and keep the whole city at bay.

title: Catch Up
description: Welcome to the enchanting world of "Catch Up"! Get ready to embark on an exciting precision platforming adventure like you've never seen before! Join an epic journey with a brave cat where skill and precision will be your best allies.

title: Well, me neither
description: Originally designed for a community project, Well, me Neither is a short Doom 2 adventure through a possibly flesh-infested neighbourhood. It didn't quite fill the project's rubric, but I still feel it scrapes by just enough to deserve a second lease on life.

title: Reconstruction/Decomposition
description: A silver spaceship with custom textures. Loosely based on Termination by mrthejoshmon. The second map in the wad is just a small "outro" level.

title: Dark Tide
description: A sprawling coastal castle swarming with Hellspawn

title: The Old Bean Factory
description: The map is pretty linear and has a bunch of tangents and secrets and is stuffed with low-tier enemies and pickups for all you murder-headed-secret-hunting-bonus-fiends out there.

title: Death Again
description: Death Again is a single player horror fps. Journey through a nightmarish realm that lies between dimensions in search for salvation.

title: Mujina: Maze Game VR
description: Mujina is a Maze Exploration game where the player has to activate 4 objective points and reach the end portal. Beware of the monsters and the numerous traps awaiting you! If everyone dies, it will result in a failure! Group up with your friends to complete the 3 type of mazes!

title: The Magenta Spire
description: The Magenta Spire is a partial conversion mapset taking place in parallel to the events of Doom 1; albeit on a much more remote planet. Much too far for any hope of "backup" arriving from Earth. A lone UAC communications technician must find a way to survive the onslaught of demonic forces invading the remote research complex. A shuttle off of this rock, a big gun, or maybe a bomb shelter to hide and weather the storm. The walls of every installation are coming down and the monsters seem to have brought their own reality with them.

title: The Isle Survival
description: The Isle Survival is a vast open world survival / crafting game. Loot resources, craft items, build camps and explore the environment. Protect yourself from hazards and wildlife. Find ways to survive in hostile living conditions.

title: Ring Stars
description: Ring Stars is a physics-based 3D fighting game with local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

title: Color Splash: Dogs
description: Color Splash: Dogs is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable dogs and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful dog paintings.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted Plus
description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted + is a mod for FNAF Help Wanted, that aims to bring back cut features from the original Help Wanted, and add in completely new levels and characters!

title: Kusok
description: Kusok (Kurashiki's Kuso Map) is a two-level minisode made for Boom-compatible source ports.

title: Trolls Remix Rescue
description: Play as Poppy, Branch and more of your favorite DreamWorks Trolls as you explore, smash, dance and battle your way towards rescuing the Troll Kingdom from a melodic mastermind who’s trying to alter the Trolls’ musical harmony!

title: Sargasso
description: Sargasso is an 11-map space adventure episode for DooM II which requires a Boom-compatible port to play. You play as Wolf - the leader of a mercenary team which resides in a space station hideout known as Sargasso - until one day aliens capture a loaded cargo ship and wreak havoc on any who oppose. It's up to you now - grab your high-tech weaponry and show them who rules this side of the galaxy!

title: Eternally Yours
description: Eternally Yours is an 11-map episode that should work for vanilla Doom. I would say the levels work better playing from pistol start to avoid having too much for the next level, but that's your decision. Anyway, I hope you enjoy playing them as much as I did making them

title: Hai Shuuraku Tansaku
description:
The protagonist embarks on a journey to an abandoned village upon a friend's request...
Investigate what happened in the abandoned village in this first-person horror game.

title: Hai Byouin Tansaku
description:
The protagonist heads to an abandoned hospital at the request of a friend...
A first-person horror game about finding out what happened in an abandoned hospital.

title: Bloody Heck
description: An 8 map WAD with level design inspired by mouldy's Going Down

title: The Other Me
description: The Other Me is a first-person psychological horror game delving into the realms of horror that prowl the recesses of one's psyche. Pursue the dread ruminations amidst the maelstrom of the Asylum. This game offers both mind-bending horror elements and realistic environments.

title: Space Vikings
description: Pillage and plunder across the galaxy as part of a crew of Space Vikings in this sci-fi roguelite bullet hell dungeon crawler. Find exotic weapons, upgrade them with powerful augments, explore mysterious alien planets, and unleash viking vengeance on their inhabitants.

title: Bullets & Brains
description: Bullets and Brains is an adrenaline-pumping arcade top-down 3D shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by brain-hungry hordes of zombies. Prepare yourself for an intense battle against the never-ending onslaught of the undead.

title: Hyperlight Survivor
description: A Competitive Bullet Hell with roguelite mechanics. Fight against endless hordes of enemies in ever-changing arenas, unlock new spaceships and upgrade them with devastating weapons and Power-Ups. Beat your highscore and reach new ranks to become the ultimate Champion!

title: An Arcade Full of Cats
description: Journey through gaming history's time and space, while searching for adorable feline companions in 'An Arcade Full of Cats,' the ultimate pet'em up hidden object game.

title: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones
description: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones is a fighting game featuring digitized stereotyped character trying to win the presidency of Mexico.

title: Lessaria: Fantasy Kingdom Sim
description: Lessaria is a unique strategy game that combines city building with indirect hero control. Build and manage a thriving kingdom while issuing commands and quests to guide your heroes in their adventures. Explore, conquer, and shape the destiny of your realm in this epic fantasy world.

title: Rhino Runner
description: Runner Game where Rhino needs find balloons in different maps and avoid deathly traps.

title: Wobble Warriors
description: Wobble Warriors is a 1-4 player ragdoll fighting couch co-op game. In this dungeon crawler, you and your friends play as some wobbly dragons on a mission to conquer the goblins who stole your gold. Jump, dash, ground pound, and bonk your way to victory by clearing each room.

title: Black Journey to the West
description: Black Journey to the West "is a vampire like survivor game that integrates Roguelike elements. Choose a character from a scripture gathering team, build character treasures and skills, challenge the blackened All Sky God Buddha, and shatter the darkness that envelops the Divine World.

title: Fittest Fire
description: In a ruined world, overrun by evil robots, a disabled cyborg named Blaze rests. Send a spark of energy from your world to Blaze’s to wake him up. Help Blaze take revenge against the robots in this fast paced 2D platformer where you workout to level up.

title: Nature Escapes 4
description: Nature Escapes is back with another delightful assortment of enjoyable hidden object scenes!

title: Sunstone War
description: Harness Aztec bracelets, defend your village! Unique tower defense with epic freedom & diverse enemies. Unleash the Sunstone power now!

title: Astral Rot
description: Astral Rot is a fixed camera, survival horror sci-fi game by the co-creators of Tormented Souls. You play as Adler, a space mining engineer, that will have to face impossible choices in order to save his brother and anyone in the asteroid that hasn't been infected by the Stardust Disease.

title: With My Past
description: "How should I face my past in my ever-changing life? "Listen to her inner voice and solve these challenging puzzles to help her face her past self.

title: Dark Galaxy
description: Dark Galaxy is an action based rogue-like top-down shooter. You pilot a space drone to oppose the insectoid like species called Minaripods and get stronger by travelling to different star systems. Can you free our galaxy from the invaders?

title: Bestial Reception
description: In the game "Bestial Reception" the strongest survives, grab a weapon and start running towards the enemy. Shoot and destroy everyone who happens to be near you. Get new more powerful weapons with the help of earned gold.

title: Dead Underworld
description: Embark on a dangerous odyssey through the Dead Underworld. Unleash potent weapons and unearth artifacts to conquer this unforgiving dungeon diving roguelike. Ally with others, forging bonds or exploiting friendships, or gain power among factions to survive in this desolated realm.

title: Warbyte: Operation Falcon
description: An old-modern school fps, where you can play tactically, or engage in crazy fast-paced combat. Host your own rooms easily, and enjoy a fair game, where victory is determined by your skill.

title: Half Sword
description: Half Sword is a physics-based medieval combat simulator featuring historically accurate XV-century arms and armor. We are not afraid to show the brutal nature of medieval combat with in-depth blood and gore features.

title: Bot Crisis
description: A funny 3D online game where you must identify real players from a group of bots. Don't forget to act as a bot yourself!

title: Love in the Dark
description: In this multiplayer horror game, a loving couple receives an invitation from a wealthy man for an event. Despite my concerns, she insists on going. To protect her, I decide to secretly join and keep her safe.

title: Preserve
description: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

title: Hoptix
description: Hoptix is a movement playground game where style and speed come easy! Play as Rocket, a cyborg rabbit who is as cute as they are radical. Explore, race, and stunt on rollercoasters and skateparks in idyllic spaces. Share footage of your movement style with your friends.

title: Mindbug Online
description: Summon hybrid creatures and send them to battle against your opponent. But be careful: your opponent may use one of their Mindbugs to take control of it. Outwit your opponent in a fascinating tactical duel in which having the best cards and playing them at the wrong time can be deadly for yourself.

title: Roboom
description: Ascend into the Robocon Universe! Roboom is an arena shooter roguelite where you blast through hordes of unique enemies and bosses. Are you ready to face the challenges of the Robocon War and rise to become the best in the Multiverse?

title: Alvara
description:
Forge your destiny!
Every choice shapes the adventure in this turn-based narrative RPG. Forge strong relationships, influence the story and recruit allies whose power depends on their affections. Craft, potion, explore, dominate. Alvara: Choices and alliances chart your course!

title: 666 Second Rule
description: 666 Second Rule is an action game where you take a role of a tormented parent battling relentless insects. Utilize dark powers to fend off their disturbing attempts to crawl into the baby's head. Embrace the darkness within and prepare for an intense and gritty showdown.

title: Bridge Crossing
description: In a troubled period of war, help the shepherd to cross the bridge in search of the lost sheep.

title: Keyboard Maestro Voyage
description: "Keyboard Maestro Voyage" is a music game using a MIDI keyboard, simulating real performances. Play in sync with flowing notes in this classic-style game. Start quickly by simply choosing a song and sheet music.

title: Landraisers
description: Explore the seas, loot islands, and slay bosses - all in the name of creating your own dream island!

title: Cosmo Rider
description: Conquer the universe and defend humanity in space on your upgradable Rider ship. Fight unknown creatures and entities in this rogue-lite top-down action game. Ride the Cosmos!

title: Mighty Slap
description: Mighty Slap is a Player vs Player Turn Based slapping game. Time your slap with a time based bonus multiplier to land a powerful slap to your opponent. First player to knock out the opponent wins.

title: Revenge of Chickens
description: Play as a rooster that wants to get revenge from humans and try to rescue chickens!

title: The Divine Speaker: A Bounty Hunter's First Christmas
description: A Chistmas themed afterstory to The Divine Speaker featuring Leos and Raen! Search for the elusive Mister Bells, spend the Winter Solstice together, and win at rock-paper-scissors against your favorite ex-assassin turned bounty hunter!

title: Merge Adventure: Magic Dragons
description: Merge dragons and magic to solve hard puzzles by playing merge games.

title: Geode Climb
description: Control the Geode Climbers born in the underground and aim for the surface in this jumping action game. You can only jump. Control the direction and strength to climb up.

title: Hero Trial
description: Hero Trial is a low poly style, topdown, light rogue game. Players play the role of medieval warriors, defeat monsters and survive！

title: Last Spartan: Glory Over Madness
description:
In this deck-building roguelike, you'll customize and build your own dice set to use in turn-based battles as you explore a dark, randomly generated world, full of new enemies and encounters on every run. Experience a story-driven campaign! Fight for your Sanity and defeat the Lovecraftian horrors.

Last Spartan sees you playing as the titular Last Spartan as you battle through a story-driven randomly generated campaign where keeping a grip on your waning sanity becomes increasingly difficult as you do battle with more and more enemies that draw inspiration from Greek mythology and the Lovecraft mythos.

It's a roguelike with deck-building elements. The unique part here is that your deck is actually a set of customisable dices, with each face acting as a slot for a different ability. There are over 700+ dice faces to discover, allowing you to develop and learn numerous synergies to suit your preferred playstyle, especially when god selection comes into play.

Aside from the dice, you will be accompanied on each run by an ally Greek god. There are over 10 of them currently, although they won't all be unlocked immediately, and each provides distinct active and passive abilities. With them, you can develop different strategies for dealing with the many foes you encounter.

According to the developer, for the first ten hours, you will face new enemies on every run, with over 100 regular enemies and 20-plus mini-bosses to discover and fight in turn-based combat. This should keep the game feeling fresh and surprising for far longer than other entries in the genre.

The same applies to encounters with over 200 NPCs to meet and choices surrounding them to make. Depending on your interaction, they might provide you with a reward, blessings, or even curses that will remain constant until the end of that particular run.

Some of those NPCs will make their way to your city. It's here where you respawn after dying and spend resources you've gathered throughout each run to upgrade the various buildings in a bid to rebuild Sparta. This is the more permanent side of the Last Spartan game and will eventually provide you with perks that increase your chance of completing a run and progressing the overarching story.

The indie game Last Spartan is set to come out in early access on PC/Mac/Linux via Steam in February-March 2024 and full release coming to all Platforms and major storefronts by April 2024 ( Coming to PC/Mac/Linux first and then to all major consoles like Xbox & Playstation & Nintendo Switch & IOS soon after PC and console release )

title: Pan's Survivor Chess
description: This is a auto-battler & vampire-suvivor like game.

title: Botsu
description: Fight your friends in hilarious sandbox sports: Boxball, Sumo Survival, and Stockpile. Wrestle your way to victory online or split-screen in unique matches. Unlock outrageous outfits and pull off awesome moves to flex your skills!

title: Legends of Savvarah: Children of the Sun
description: A fantasy interactive story (visual novel) where the mysteries of ancient gods, enigmas of bygone eras, magic, and the complex relationships between various beings are intricately woven together.

title: Forest of Strays
description: Forest of Strays is a hardcore platformer with many dangers scattered across the stages. Try and retry to complete every level while collecting every leaf along the way, fighting enemies, evading traps and getting trough very precise jumps! Will the lost girl find her cat and return back home?

title: Cosmic Roads
description: Do you think you can complete the roads mysteriously built in outer space? It is time to put your driving skills to the test in this difficult game that requires skills, patience and perseverance. Put on the mantle of a cosmic rider and complete the beautiful roads in outer space.

title: Revenguard
description: Evil creatures took your dog! They have taken over the kingdom and are threatening all the inhabitants. Can you pass the obstacles, uncover all the secrets and save them?

title: RoadPipe
description: Rotate, Connect, Help the car reach its destination! Explore the minimalistic stage with various gimmicks.

title: Fight! Olyn Island
description: Explore the mysterious Olyn Island! Play against other players and use cute animal heroes towards victory!

title: Lost: Antinomy
description: With just a swipe to the left or right, you can make all kinds of decisions. So, please embark on your own unique adventure tale through the continent of Astra!

title: Blessed Burden
description: The most-aesthetically charged action horror first-person platformer. You play as the last priest who goes unarmed into the devil's abode to save the world.

title: Dojo Masters
description: Dojo Masters is a 2-button martial arts indie fighting game. Battle against your friends or head online to challenge warriors from around the world!

title: Bomber Party
description: Experience an explosive and nerve-wracking adventure! Eliminate other players, strategically use bombs, collect power-ups, and survive to earn trophies. The first player to reach the required number of trophies wins the game. Are you ready to triumph as the last survivor? Let's go!

title: Karnal
description: Outnumbered, outgunned, and alone, your only objective is to find your wife. Traverse horrific facilities, city streets, and apartment buildings while fighting various kinds of enemies in this old-school shooter.

title: Plunged
description: Plunged is a casual, first-person single-player 3D-Platformer where you use your plunger and rope to climb to the top.

title: Drum Roll
description: Have you ever wanted to roll an oil drum? Roll the drum as far as you want with Drum Roll!

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: China
description: Have you ever dreamed of driving classic Chinese cars? The ones that are filled with passion and fascination? Or perhaps it's a newfound desire for you? Whatever the reason, now is the perfect time to start your Chinese adventure!

title: Warlords Battlecry: The Protectors of Etheria
description: A terrible threat long foretold rises to finish a war waged in prehistory, throwing Etheria into chaos. Will you save or lose your kindred? In this successor-in-the-making to the RPG/RTS Warlords Battlecry, interact with the world and discover myriad new tactics to dominate the battlefield.

title: Frame of Mind: A Game of Thoughts
description: Frame of Mind is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you discover a character trough thoughts and mementos they find while moving out of their parents home. It's an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.

title: Candles
description: Candles is a short first-person horror game developed by TheUnbeholden. Set in a remote and shadowy home, players must navigate through unsettling interiors while managing limited interactions that shape their path forward. The game emphasizes atmosphere, using dynamic lighting, eerie sound design, and a compact, claustrophobic environment to build tension. Its minimalist mechanics focus attention on exploration and environmental storytelling, creating a suspenseful and immersive experience.

title: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
description: From the world of "Lost Eidolons" comes an all-new turn-based strategy RPG. Stranded on a mysterious island with scattered memories, your only means of survival is to fight. Recruit allies, undertake a perilous journey, and battle to reclaim what you've lost... no matter how many deaths it takes.

title: Pixel Gun 3D: PC Edition
description: Pixel Gun 3D is a near complete PC port of a legendary multiplayer FPS with blocky and colorful graphics. Fight in multiple game modes, unlock dozens of maps and collect more than 1500 unique guns

title: Spy Cats
description: A 2D platforming adventure where you play as a cat on a mission to find hidden secrets as part of the Spy Cats Agency. Use gadgets to sneak through each mission, retrieve the artifact, and make a successful escape.

title: Five Days of Hell
description: A survival game in which you have to explore a desert canyon, face anomalies and various monsters.

title: The Farming Frontier
description: The Farming Frontier is a tranquil wilderness RPG, that delivers a farming simulation. Within this realm, you can cultivate crops, cut wood, catch fish, mine, and build amid wild landscapes. Reclaim your village, and confront adversaries in this tranquil wilderness RPG.

title: Q2 Humanity
description: he smash hit game “Q REMASTERED”, which became extremely popular amongst users in Japan in early 2023, is now coming back! "Q2 HUMANITY" is finally available as Early Access! In "Q2" the sequel to "Q1" you can play as a character yourself. You can fly, jump, run, draw, grab, throw, and so on.

title: Geko: In Search of the Big Fly
description: Geko is a friendly gecko with a delightful goal: catching the big fly to ensure a delicious meal! To help him on this thrilling adventure, you'll jump, climb platforms, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies that appear along the way.

title: Dungeon Heroes
description: An action-packed local co-op multiplayer dungeon crawler with a 3D cel-shaded art style.

title: Long Way
description: Long Way is an immersive arcade driving simulator with diverse vehicles and customization. Driving different type of vehicles with trailers, various landscapes, and weather conditions. Impressive graphics, dynamic time, and challenges enhance immersion. Multiplayer support for up to 8 friends.

title: Tactical Zone
description: Welcome to the Tactical Zone world! This thrilling third-person shooter will give you adrenaline and unforgettable moments of battle on the battlefield. Enter the battlefield and take on the challenge of team play, where your cohesion and tactical skills will be the key to victory.

title: Medice To Arms
description: Medice To Arms is a PvP 2D battle game where you strategically arrange organs to harness power and avoid attacks from your opponent.

title: The Legend of Ogorets 1: Wrat
description: An immersive, barebones-style interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Not for heroes.

title: The Legend of Ogorets 2: Tsundere
description: An interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Do not read in the dark.

title: Wrong Landing
description: Wrong Landing is survival open world story horror game where you shipwracked on a deserted island and try to survive.

title: Labyrinthum
description: Labyrinthum is an exciting maze game that offers a unique gaming experience combining puzzles, riddles, and general knowledge challenges.

title: Distant Worlds 2: Factions - Quameno and Gizureans
description: The Galaxy Expands. The second Distant Worlds 2 expansion brings two new playable factions – the introverted puzzle-solving Quameno and the numberless and ruthless Gizureans.

title: Spirit X Strike
description:
An Action Adventure Game that lets you craft unique COMBOs and explore endless ways to style on your enemies with a high-speed combat system. Test your skills in fun chaotic one-vs-group battles, intense, strategic duels, and exhilarating post-apocalyptic adventure that will set your blood boiling.

Experience a fresh take on this action adventure of "Spirit X Strike," featuring three intertwined combat systems: Instant Counter, Super Strike, and Spirit Mimicry. Players can swiftly switch between defense and attack, and experience an adrenaline-pumping combat.

title: CaS-Puz: Camera Surface Puzzle
description: Your perspective changes the world. In this hardcore platformer, the existence of walls depends on the angle of your camera. A seemingly impassable level will transform once you look from a different angle, and every careless jump and camera movement can turn into a flight into the void.

title: Gears of Dragoon: Fragments of a New Era
description: Join a young explorer delving into the labyrinth beneath Carnas, a city pulsating with magic yet whispering of a mechanical past. As echoes of a bygone era stir, the ancient gears of fate rumble awake.

title: Mystical Riddles: Ship From Beyond - Collector's Edition
description: All hands on deck! A strange, oily fog has enveloped the waterfront of the port town of Quietcape, where local fishermen go, never to return again... Can you solve this mystery?

title: Line Link
description: Line Link is a logical puzzle game, perfect for relaxing or while your computer is loading another game.

title: DeadBlitz
description: A fast paced first-person action shooter set in a futuristic city overrun by zombies and robots. Feel the flow as you freely grapple and blast your way through a procedurally generated sci-fi city. Get satisfying kill streaks and challenge yourself by besting your best.

title: Cats Hidden in Georgia
description: Find and discover 100 cute cats hidden across Georgia in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: Elis in Winterland
description: In Winterland, everyone is in a winter slumber, but summer has arrived. Can Elis, the only one to wake up, save Winterland?

title: Mini Continental Saga
description: Mini Continental Saga is a biotope strategy history card game letting you freely stir small worlds! Human, elf, slime? Or lead your fishman to create your favorite fictional world! One play takes 5 to 30 minutes. Weave a tale that you've seen somewhere before, but doesn't exist anywhere else!!!!

title: Urbo: Dream One
description: Urbo: Dream One is a meditative puzzle game where you build houses around the mysterious Tower. Let your mind wander through visions of an enchanted city on an island in the middle of the crystal clear waters of a vibrant lake.

title: Hospital
description: This game is an action horror game that can be cleared by collecting cursed boxes in the hospital while escaping from ghosts. Various strange phenomena occur in the hospital. Collect cursed boxes and escape from the ghosts that roam the hospital.

title: Rocketman
description: As Ranger Ross, also known as the Rocketman, you are tasked to reclaim the corporate colonies of Sommerkrit. In this ultimate top-down shooter battle utilize your arsenal of weapons, summon your clucks, and support your allies to break through the enemy lines.

title: Silly Frog
description: Embark on an enchanting journey with Silly Frog. Overcome obstacles in a beautiful swan's introspective realm to win her heart and understand her better.

title: Akui: The Insane Cultists
description: A fist person horror adventure in a dark parallel world peppered with monsters and puzzles.

title: Fallen Prince
description: Fallen Prince is an atmospheric combat-focused metroidvania with retro elements. Explore a bleak undead zone, hone your skills and rid the kingdom from your brother's vile sorcery.

title: Twistingo: Turtle Bay - Collector's Edition
description: Play a variety of puzzles and games, including clever blends of hidden objects, bingo, and marble-popping. Are you up to the challenge?

title: The Sacrificial Girl of the Fantasy 3: Kingdoms 2
The Hookmarine
description: What would happen if during an expedition the submarine's engines stopped working and you only had your grappling hook to move and do your work?

title: Up to the Unknown
description: Step into a delightful 2D pixel platformer adventure! Explore a mysterious world with a dark world, an invisible cave zone, and so much more. Use simple controls to get past those scary traps. Enjoy charming pixel art and an enchanting soundtrack. Get ready for an unforgettable journey!

title: Psychotic Bathtub
description: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown dad. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

title: Claws & Chaos
description: Claws & Chaos is an auto-chess-style battler featuring charming creatures in dire circumstances. Build your team and hone your skills while battling across both story and competitive PvP modes. Will you earn your place on the Ark?

title: Artificia Armata
description: A classic tower defense game placed in a dystopic era where humanity is threatened by the machines that they built to protect themselves.

title: NecroAttack!
description: The army of the undead is attacking!!! The fate of the kingdom is at stake! Faced with the tide of undead, the young princess decided to step forward and lead the people to confront the enemy, explore unknown places... perhaps even uncover the mystery behind the disaster?

title: Rich Teddy Adventure
description: Get ready for an epic adventure in a magical world filled with wonder and danger. You play as a Teddy Bear who has been summoned to this realm to save it from an impending doom. To do so, you must travel through a series of portals that lead to different parts of this mystical world.

title: We Escaped a Twisted Game
description: Two players. One escape. Trapped in a haunted manor, you’ll need to talk, trust, and work together to make it out alive.

title: Forest Spirit
description: Tired of office life, you go to live in nature. In this new life, you have to build, craft, farm, fight and interact with the locals.

title: Holua's Arcades
description: Get ready to dive back into the pure joy of gaming. Prepare yourself for four thrilling games inspired by the arcade genre's all-time favorites. From challenging platformers, to epic space battles and classic beat'em up action. It's like having four arcade machines at your fingertips!

title: Quantum Cortex
description: Quantum Cortex is a fast-paced, physics-based metroidvania. Tear through a dark, atmospheric environment at lightning speeds and battle terrifying creatures. Discover the eldritch mystery behind civilization’s fall, and rise up against the transhumanist dystopia that took its place.

title: Antipsychotic
description: This non-linear, immersive docu-music album aims to help destigmatize mental illness by allowing the user to journey through the mind of an individual with bipolar disorder.

title: The Cable Guy
description: Your job is to connect all the users from different projects to their servers in the procedurally generated network. In an ever changing office environment you'll have a lot of nifty tools to help you save your job and keep everyone from losing their cool. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Episode 666
description: Delve into the spine-chilling world of "Spirits Uncovered" where you will accompany the fearless YouTube Ghost Hunting sensation, Scott Warren. Scott is excited that after years of building his YouTube following, he has finally hit Episode 666!

title: Drongo's Festive Adventures
description: Hop the seasons. Collect pickups, conquer themed levels inspired by Christmas, Halloween, Zen Garden, and Easter, and enjoy breathtaking graphics with ray tracing. Unlock each level as you progress, compete on leaderboards, and experience the joy of platforming in this immersive holiday-themed game!

title: The Last Exodus
description: Turn-based tactical strategy with massive capital ships, frigates, gunships and fighter squads. Gather resources, research technologies, design and expand your fleet. Destroy your enemies. Single player and multi player mode, hot seat mod also available.

title: Summerhouse
description: A tiny building game about beautiful lived-in houses. No rules or restrictions, just pure creativity.

title: Succubus RoomMate
description: Enter a fascinating and seductive world with "Succubus RoomMate". In this addictive cookie clicker game, you can buy cute power-up imps and immerse yourself in a story inside the protagonist's room. Unlock scenes with your very own succubus and enjoy intense dialogues in pure anime style.

title: Marionette Eden Breakers
description: Defeat monsters approaching the heriones! 「Marionette Eden Breakers」 features cute heroines in a Hack-and-Slash action game. Defeat lots of monsters and have some lewd "communications" with the heroines...

title: Dead Wells: The Devil Fragment
description: Hack, Slash, Parry and Dodge your foes in this Souls-like Action RPG. Explore the countryside in search of The Devil Fragment while fighting enemies with a multi game inspired combat system where you can launch foes into the air and then juggle them to build your combo meter for multiple buffs.

title: Road to Top G
description: Survive waves of zombies, collect perks, unlock boss door, and face Andrew Tate in an intense showdown. Can you conquer the Top G?

title: Praise Dead
description: Praise Dead is a roguelike auto-battler where you create minions from the parts of dead villagers and monsters. Collect relics that power up your zombies. And defend the town from the nightly demonic incursions that threaten to slay us all.

title: Match Gem 99
description: MatchGem 99 is a unique large-scale 3-match puzzle battle royale game where 99 players compete in real-time. Master the use of special blocks and gauge attacks to outlast your opponents and be the last one standing!

title: Epic Auto Towers
description: Epic Auto Towers is a turn-based strategy game combining elements of autobattler, deckbuilder and roguelike. Purchase uncommon and rare Towers and build the strongest combo to withstand the monster assault! Discover unusual new Tower combinations as you come back for more.

title: AtmaSphere 2
description: Embark on a frosty medieval journey! Guide your ball through snowy platforms, conquer obstacles, hidden challenges, and collect pickups. With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, brace yourself for a chilling adventure! Roll to victory in this winter realm!

title: Void Chaser
description: Void Chaser is a 2D arcade game where you're set on an endless run with void spaces to jump over, asteroids to avoid and more!

title: Hidden Champion
description: Hidden Champion is a turn-based economic strategy and management game. You'll take over the internationalization department of a previously only locally successful company and now you'll have to lead it to global success.

title: Tiny Chaos
description: Fast-paced Action Rogue-like. Fight Hordes of Monsters and Bosses. Survive, Level Up, Upgrade Attributes and Skills.

title: Journey Beyond the Edge of the World
description: An atmospheric first-person adventure game set on a storm-torn fishing ship. Solve puzzles to unfold a mysterious and surreal story – told in a unique way through narrated ambient music. An audiovisual experience with pixelated graphics and immersive spatial audio that works on regular headphones.

title: Killon
description: Killon is a vertical scrolling shooter that features exhilarating combat and a special cannon waiting to be unleashed. Fly a Star ship across a universe in chaos and restore the future today.

title: Cactus
description: Be the cactus, become the legend! Fight to save your planet in this fast-paced single player FPS. Shoot explosive needles from your spiky body to wipe enemy hordes with timed detonations, explore the desert, solve puzzles, find artifacts, unlock special skills and battle against the sun.

title: Chromosome Evil 2
description: Dive deep into this Lovecraft-inspired RTS survival for a second time. Assemble your strike team and manage your convoy. It's up to you to survive the onslaught of nightmares that are surely coming your way. Will you find the source of the darkness?

title: Poor Man's Adventure: Narco Sub Simulator
description: Join a small community of rejects, try to survive in hospitable world of peak capitalism. As a modern pirate you will scavenge wrecks of rich peoples' yachts for resources, grow weed and manage automated factories.

title: Cashier Simulator
description: Grocery Store Manager

title: Des Racines et des Graines
description: A garden game where you will explore a calm and peaceful island. You will gather some seeds from the vegetation and re-plant them close to each other to get hybrids. Day after day, you will cross-breed the plants to create some new ones, to finally find and restore the ultimate tree: Yggdrasil.

title: Cosmic Cleaner
description: Soar among the stars in Cosmic Cleanup! You have been tasked with helping with a large-scale intergalactic cleanup! Joined by your friendly companion PIP you will work tirelessly to do your part in cleaning up our solar system! Join the effort today!

title: Rome Frontiers
description: A realistic rome builder simulator will allow you build the most important architectural works of ancient Rome. Are you ready to face the challenges as a builder of ancient Rome?

title: Chores of Corruption
description: Chores of Corruption is a top-down arena shooter with roguelike elements where you defeat waves of enemies. Choose between different characters and from a variety of items and traits to create unique builds to survive the ever growing corruption.

title: Azorius
description: Explore the world, get resources, go through dungeons, solve puzzles, fight monsters, use magic, craft items, build a settlement and recruit residents!

title: PartySaur: Dino Mayhem
description: PartySaur: Dino Mayhem is a casual 1 - 4 player local multiplayer action game where players battle each other in a variety of mini-games set in a prehistoric environment. Defeat your rivals and become the PartySaur champion.

title: Gates of the Mind
description: Gates of the Mind - is a 2D Hardcore platformer. Game should search you in reaction and ingenuity in boss fights and locations.Each Boss fight and Location have a phases where you must be accurate in your actions and contains non-linear solutions for opening gates of mind.

title: Ramas' Call: Twisted Timing
description: Point and Click adventure in a medieval fantasy ambience. Imagine you are a random tabletop geek looking for new adventures and your friend makes a tiiny mistake with his time machine... Now add an adventurer, a noble and a detective and mix them all together in yourself. Must be fun, right?

title: Build a City Block
description: Build a City Block is an addictive blocks game where you need to fill city districts to reveal the landscape. Collect stars to raise unique landmarks. Increase your score and complete each levels.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Tools
description: Puzzles of tools!

title: The Lost Prince
description:
The Lost Prince is a story-based package game developed inspired by the fairy tale 'The Little Prince'. It is a visual novel-based complex genre in which the story begins with the assumption that the prince died from a snakebite.

It's an indie game developed by one person, so it's not enough, but please take care of it.

title: Rune Gate
description: Rune Gate is a deck-building roguelite where you design your own cards by slotting in runes of various elements. Gather your party, craft your runes, gear up and defend against hordes of enemies from the Rune Gate. How long can you survive?

title: Among the Zombies
description: Among the Zombies - you have to play as a survivor in a city filled with zombies.

title: The Eastern Drive
description: A fun and casual car driving game featuring Asian cars.

title: Kandyland
description: Kandyland is a single player horror game in which you must outwit beloved characters that once brought you joy, in order to escape the park.

title: Victory at Sea Atlantic
description: "Victory at Sea Atlantic" transports you to the cold, unforgiving waters of the Atlantic Theatre in WWII. With a vast array of ships, planes, and subs, engage in epic sea battles & secure your place in history. Victory At Sea Atlantic is the ultimate naval warfare experience.

title: Collecstar
description: Shoot for the stars! In this cute 2D platform arcade game, jump on clouds and collect as many stars as you can before you run out of lives.

title: League TD
description: "League TD" is a strategy tower defense game that combines unique defense towers and various upgradeable components to unleash different attack effects. Come and build your perfect defense line.

title: Formilion
description: Kill till you get through. Formilion is a top-down arcade blood shooter about a searching a person.

title: Asmodeus
description: Asmodeus is a management adventure game set in a 2.5D side-scrolling world. Collect resources and fight monsters, upgrade your village and defend it against outside threats. Thrive your village with a great commander mind and show your fighting skills during boss fights.

title: Redneck Joe vs The Swamp Zombies
description: In this exciting third-person shooter, play as brave Joe, a typical Redneck who must fight against hordes of zombies and scary monsters.

title: The Brittle Epoch
description: An immersive short story walking simulator. About an hour to complete for people who enjoy relaxed exploration while investing in a long term narrative project.

title: Piverantum
description: Piverdex has taken over the country thanks to a virus you created. As a researcher accused of an epidemic, he explores the entire country of Piverantum and creates the vaccine to save the country.

title: Cyber Sprint
description: Cyber Sprint is all about speedrunning mastery. Players must become adept at navigating the digital landscapes with unparalleled agility, employing a combination of sprinting, sliding, jumping, and wall-running to maintain momentum and shave off precious seconds.

title: Nope Nope Nope Nope Nurses
description: The thrilling final installment of Dark One!'s hit visual novel series! Hapless protagonist Yamada is once again at the mercy of the tender depredations of the world's worst staff of nurses... and this time, it's up close and personal with the ruthless Head Nurse who dominates all the rest!

title: Idle Weaponshop
description: In Idle Weaponshop, you are handed your very own weapon shop to manage. Design and sell weapons, build up your local community, hire employees, and send adventurers off into danger for fun and profit... all before prestiging to earn powerful bonuses, all so you can do it all over again.

title: SCP: Contamination
description: A bodycam footage game based on a member of D-class personnel who has awoken during a facility-wide contamination lockdown, you must escape the facility by navigating through the labs, basement areas & SCP classes that now roam free.

title: DefenseCraft
description: DefenseCraft brings revolutionary new mechanics to the tower defense genre, combining the traditional tower defense style with exploration, crafting and more! Sent to a far-off land called Sector 4, in search of a lost group of explorers, we find that the land is not as docile as it seems.

title: Wiki's Wild Ride
description: A birthright denied. An alliance forged. A plan hatched. The Jerks have locked away your dinners deep in the depths of the basement! Now you must ride your trusty steed through the house and reclaim what's rightfully yours!

title: Cyborg3003
description: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest with cyborgs, monsters, and aliens.

title: Meat and Metal
description: You are the operator of a combat turret defending the border beyond which lies the last human city!

title: Extreme Bus Driver Simulator
description: Are you ready to become an experienced bus driver? Experience the thrill of transporting passengers in a realistic city with Extreme Bus Driver Simulator! Get passengers to their destination on time and safely, earn rewards and customize your bus.

title: Wyred
description: You play as a little robot looking after a lonely outpost on a distant planet. In each puzzle, your goal is to find a way to the other (or one of several) connectors while laying down a wire as you go. But be careful; you cannot cross over the wire you have laid, lest you break it!

title: Plebs
description: Plebs is a casual real time strategy game about controlling ancient Nations to victory through strategic town building, creating mighty and diverse armies, and intelligent resource management.

title: Pim: The Forgotten
description: In this wonderful and colorful world, play as Pim, a fearful red panda able to wield the elements. Solve puzzles, support great heroes and discover the origin of the world in this Action and Adventure 3D game!

title: Ellan: The Lost Soul
description: Ellan is a beautiful first-person adventure game about the journey beyond life, Traveling with a light companion in dream-like worlds, and uncovering the meaning of eternal by overcoming the illusion of choice to light the path to Moksha.

title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
description: Join Sahara B. Shabazz as she honours that Korean man's sacrifice by winning this martial arts tournament with the Taekwondo that flows in her veins.

title: Infinite Realms
description: Discover a blend of 4X Strategy, Deckbuilding, and Roguelite! Find cards and customize them with runes, summon creatures, cast spells, terraform the world and push back Morrigan's Corruption!

title: Risky Sanctuary
description: Create, customize, and manage a vibrant sex club filled with adorable anthropomorphic characters. Watch the party unfold, while you install adult devices, navigate finances, protect your reputation, and manage a team of dedicated employees.

title: Ardent Passions
description: Ardent Passions is an adult visual novel where Heroman uncovers his girlfriend and her friends' vigilante secrets on a camping trip. With the fate of these relationships at stake, the game unfolds through decisions that determine if these vigilantes become allies or enemies.

title: Fights in Tight Spaces: Weapon of Choice
description: Weapon of Choice is the first major content drop for Fights in Tight Spaces, and gives the player access to a new gun-fu inspired deck with 30+ new cards, new levels, music tracks, and a set of deadly new enemies.

title: Suisenka
description: Main character comes from a powerful family and thus has everything he wants. His colorless life gains new palette after meeting a girl who introduces him to the world of sensual pleasures. But one day mansion inhabitants rebel against such life and try to find their own happiness.

title: Invention 4
description: Save the world from an impending threat in a dynamic 3D shooter with quest and puzzle elements.

title: Call to Arms: Gates of Hell - Liberation
description: “Soldiers, Sailors, and Airmen of the Allied Expeditionary Force: you are about to embark upon the Great Crusade!” This DLC introduces the western front action in 1944, featuring the US faction, as well as German western front content.

title: Legendary Slide
description: In "Legendary Slide" you have to clear away the mahjong tiles by sliding them next to matching ones. Solve unique and mind bending puzzles and collect gems to restore ancient temple of Air. Continue your journey through the Legendary world! This is the Platinum Edition with unique extra content!

title: Star Legacy VR
description: Star Legacy VR is an immersive virtual reality shooting game that incorporates intriguing Roguelike elements into gameplay. Players assume the roles of interstellar guardians who venture across diverse planets and traverse through various time zones.

title: Stellar Initiative
description: Stellar Initiative is a roguelike tower defence game where you land on the planet and use your orbit ship to deliver buildings and support you with fire. Complete missions, install new upgrades, discover powerful artefacts and find the best strategy!

title: Sound Lock
description: "Sound Lock" is a multi-ending puzzle RPG game based on the perspective of a girl without a mouth. The story takes place in a world with hundreds of similar rooms, where the decorations are nostalgic. Explore rooms full of death traps and try to clear the fog to find the buried truth.

title: Vapor Tanks
description: Explore Cyberspace in Vapor Tanks, an arcade 3D shooter with a focus on satisfying gameplay, addictive replayability, and surrealist visuals. It features a 30 level long single player, and Online PVP up to 4 players.

title: Arinn
description: Arinn is a precision platform game with dungeons full of enemies and deadly traps. The only way out is to escape from the enemies and overcome all the challenges. Collect all the treasures and help Arinn pay off his debts.

title: 2BBee
description: Exciting adventures await you in the world of the most hardworking little creatures! You will have to survive in the world of bees, develop your hive and raise new generations for your life with the dangers that may await you on your way! Survival sandbox, but how long can you survive?

title: V Gate
description: V gate; It is an open world game that includes first and third person shooter, survival, exploration, crafting, horror, thriller, team, building, mystery, management concepts and drags you towards different worlds with explorations.

title: Boyscout: Patrick's Town
description: Boyscout is a top-down adventure in which you play as Patricio, a little boy who is learning to help his neighbors while his father is trying to grow his own business in a rural town. One day, an unusual event will change the lives of the locals forever.

title: Kill The K.O.T.H
description:
The people call and beckon forth a hunter upon their shores to ascend the hill and kill their king who is rotten to his core.

Kill The K.O.T.H is a first-person climbing game by Rubeki.

title: Princess Maker 2 Regeneration
description:
Princess Maker 2 Regeneration, an enhanced port of Princess Maker 2 Refine, will release on Switch, PS5, PS4, and PC on December 2023.

It will have English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese language support.

title: RubyDung
description:
RubyDung was an unreleased base-building strategy game prototype created by Markus “Notch” Persson. Developed prior to Minecraft, the project was inspired by Dwarf Fortress, but with a focus on accessibility.

The name "RubyDung" was a placeholder name for a "DUNGeon game in the RUBYlands", the "Rubylands" being a rough idea for a game world that Notch had.

During the later stages of RubyDung’s development, Persson discovered the indie multiplayer game Infiniminer, developed by Zachtronics. This inspired him to experiment with a fantasy-themed, first-person, block-based prototype, reusing and adapting portions of RubyDung’s code and assets.

That experimental prototype demonstrated strong performance and positive early reception, leading Persson to abandon RubyDung entirely and pursue the new project full-time. This work would eventually become Minecraft, with RubyDung serving as a direct technical and conceptual predecessor.

description: Take to the clouds in this singleplayer 3D precision platformer! Jump over obstacles and navigate moving platforms as you make your way through the sky.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Celestial Eyes Above Mortal Ruins
description:
Version 1.3 of Honkai: Star Rail, which included:
• New characters: Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, Fu Xuan and Lynx
• New main story quest: Obsequies Performed, A Long Road Ahead
• New area: Aurum Alley
• New companion missions for Dan Heng, Luka, March 7th and Lynx
• New main event: Aurum Alley's Hustle and Bustle
• New Simulated Universe mode: The Swarm Disaster
• New QoL changes: Trailblaze Power System Optimization and Phone Wallpaper
• …and more!

title: Vivid's Hot Slots
description:
The Future...

You've set your coordinates for the Hagar System. Word has it that after the sexual holocaust, Admiral James escaped the Garion Asylum to establish a world designed in his new image. A world dictated by sexual pleasure and exitement.

Lord Stevos has ordered you to locate Admiral James and negotiate his return to Earth. Be aware that James has created the ultimate sexual machine hot slots, which is run by his evil assistant Rothman. A machine so erotic, those sent before you have never returned.

Prepare yourself now and launch your probe into Vivid World and hot slots!

Featuring Janine, Ashlyn Gere, Nikki Dial, Lené, Heather Hunter and all your Vivid favorites.

Including spectacular 3-D graphics and original music, custom video footage, erotic game play, and much more!

title: Jackpot Jubilee
description:
Jackpot Jubilee is a single player slot machine game.

The shareware version of the game has a single, traditional, three reel fruit machine with a single pay-line whereas the full registered version has three differently themed machines and a reel hold option. The game screen shows the machine being played in the centre while to the right is the player's stack of coins, the player clicks on a coin to transfer it to the machine so that they can play. An unusual feature of this game is the way cash is paid out, if/when a player wins and collects their cash the coin stack on the right is updated immediately while the coins collected do a little dance across the bottom of the screen before eventually disappearing.

title: Shadow of the Ninja Reborn
description: After 34 years in the shadows, prepare to see this legendary action adventure in a new light! Looking and playing better than ever before, Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn is Tengo Project’s remake of a cult classic, that the fans have been waiting for.

title: The Chimba's Adventure
description: Chimbinha was living peacefully in his luxurious castle when he received the news that his new lead singer had been kidnapped by a hairy villain. Now, Chimbinha will go through a lot of trouble to get his singer back!

title: Infinite Tux
description: Infinite Tux is a 2D platformer that has levels procedurally generated every time it's played.

title: Caminho Estreito
description: Caminho Estreito is a Christian role-playing game where you will need to prove your biblical knowledge and show that your faith is unshakable.

title: Minecraft: Frostburn Update
description: Minecraft: Frostburn Update is an update for Minecraft that added some new features such as skeleton/zombie variants in snowy biomes and deserts respectively, polar bears, structure blocks for saving/loading structures in worlds, and an auto-jump feature.

title: CzechBox
description: Czech Community project with all 32 maps made by Czech or Slovak authors. The maps should be playable with pistol start and also in one run. It should be fully BooM compatible and jumping/crouching is not allowed since it could spoil the gameplay of many maps. Also Voodoo dolls are used in several maps, so please use ports that support this feature.

title: Team Rocket: Blasting Off at the Speed of Mapping
description: Team Rocket comprises AD_79, Dragonfly, Jimmy and MTrop, four experienced Doom mappers who together endured a 20-hour speedmapping livestream. Their efforts were supported by kind donators and guest mappers who tagged in to let the fatigued rocketeers recuperate. We bring you 34 maps, all made within less than a day, shaped by you, our viewers.

title: Team Rocket 2: Looks Like We're Blasting Off Again!
description: Team Rocket comprises AD_79, Dragonfly, Jimmy and MTrop, four experienced Doom mappers who together will be working round the clock to reach the goal of 32+ full levels for Doom 2, averaging 8 maps each. Through their combined efforts, and the encouragement of you, the viewer, they hope to run for around 24 hours (but most likely a bit less!).

title: Nuclear Chunks
description: Nuclear Chunks is a limit removing Plutonia WAD with 6 decently sized maps. There is also a Map08 containing what I had made of Map07 before I lost my way with the project (the actual Map07 in the wad is a simple "The End" bookmark style map). Each map has a distinct style from each other and was limited to using a 32 grid size for linedef and things placement, similar to my favourite Eternal mapset (though allowing myself rotation for a bit of flexibility. Map06 breaks the grid a bit and Map08 a lot). Testing is done using mostly Crispy with DelphiDoom using the voxel pack to help with thing placement.

title: 32 Inch Nails
description: 32 Inch Nails is a seven-map PWAD for Doom II and limit-removing ports created by Alexander S. (Eternal), released on September 28, 2008. It split off the Grid 32 community project and is built in a similar fashion, as the maps were created with a 32x32 grid in the map editor for all linedefs and vertexes, giving them a rather unique look, although this does not extend to thing placement.

title: Port Glacia
description: Originally a map for Jimmy's Joy Of Mapping 5, I ended up pulling it as it had gotten too large and ambitious, and its size & length would have really bogged down what was already a hefty community project. This allowed me the chance to polish the map up to a higher standard.

title: Fuel Devourer
description: Large fuel base full of monsters - go and kill them! Made for FDC#11.

title: Asylum of the Wretched
description: Asylum of the Wretched is a single-level PWAD for Doom II for limit removing source ports. It was designed by Ian Myers and uses the music track "". The PWAD is notable for its horror theme and atmosphere, accomplished through the use of new graphics and sounds and a DeHackEd patch.

title: Oniria
description: When the moon rises, the garden falls with it. The insects succumb to exhaustion, all except one...

title: Plasmaplant
description: Plasmaplant is a single level for ZDoom created by Sverre Kvernmo. It was the first map released by Kvernmo since the release of Eternal Doom seventeen years prior. The majority of the map focuses on a visual theme dominated by the colour blue, and heavy lighting contrast.

title: Drip Feed
description: A GSTONE fortress, a red glowing sky, silhouetted bodies writhe on spikes in the distance, fortelling your fate.

title: I.C.T.O.A.N.
description: I.C.T.O.A.N. is a single level map set in a demon-infested airship type thingy. If you're claustrophobic, don't try this level, as it's really cramped.

title: Hymn: A Heretic Community Project
description: Hymn is a Doomworld community project for Heretic. It is a 9 level episode that features custom textures. HYMN should be compatible with most modern Boom and ZDoom related ports, as well as Doomsday, but has an emphasis on 'vanilla' style mapping.

title: The Iron Forge
description:
The Iron Forge﻿ is a single map for Heretic, created by Xaser (architecture/layout) and me (thing placement). It plays in the E2M1 slot and requires ZDoom/GZDoom.

This map includes a variety of tweaks to Heretic's monsters and weapons to improve the pacing and balance of the game (especially to address that feeling you get when all the monsters are super weak but take forever to kill).

title: Brutal Complex
description: One summer day, a girl realizes the way to the dream world, a path of blood leading to a white space. What kind of world awaits beyond that? Brutal Complex has a cute, surreal, and aesthetic atmosphere.

title: Touhou Komakyou
description: Touhou Komakyou is a Famicom-style Touhou fangame by Saigomen's Boss (Yuureikurage).

title: Steel Titan
description: Take control of a powerful mech with over 40 unique weapons to fight your way through a confidential computer system and defeat the hackers inside.

title: FurryMUCK
description: One of the earliest examples of a game catered toward and made by members of the Furry fandom, 'FurryMUCK' is an online text-based roleplaying game which allows players to interact as their fursonas with others, as well as in various rooms and plazas.

title: Nancy Drew: Mystery of the Seven Keys
description: Get ready for a thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history in the latest installment of the award-winning Nancy Drew game series – Nancy Drew: Mystery of the Seven Keys! This all-new 3D game experience transports players to the heart of the historic city of Prague as they assume the role of famous detective Nancy Drew. Tasked with uncovering the truth behind the theft of a client’s heirloom necklace, players will navigate and sleuth through the beautiful city’s mysterious old-world environments. Encounter challenging puzzles, decode riddles, and discover clues entwined with medieval legends, alchemy, and lore. As the investigation deepens, Nancy uncovers a sinister web of cybercrime. Players must outwit devious suspects and use their detective skills to unravel a mystery threatening the city’s Bohemian heritage. Danger and intrigue at every turn add to the suspense as the criminals stop at nothing to prevent you from bringing the truth to light. Your investigative and critical thinking skills are crucial to solving the case and discovering the real mystery behind the legend of the seven keys!

title: Presentes de Natal
description:
Every year, on the date that commemorates the birth of Jesus, Santa Claus distributes presents to children to remind them of the greatest gift God has ever given us.

But this year, Santa has a little problem, and he'll need your help to fulfill his mission.

Embark on this fantastic adventure to save Christmas, full of challenges and excitement.

title: Darkness Road
description:
Darkness Road is an immersive survival horror and psychological horror game that will plunge players into a chilling and nightmarish experience. Set in the year 1996, within the foreboding town of Dar Al Hai located in the Arabian Gulf, this game offers a unique blend of suspenseful gameplay and captivating storytelling.

Playing from a third-person perspective, you assume the role of Hamdan, an ordinary 34-year-old resident of Dar Al Hai. Suddenly and inexplicably abducted, Hamdan finds himself trapped within a cursed place. With every ounce of his being, he strives to escape the clutches of this malevolent force, only to discover that his efforts seem to lead him deeper into the darkness.

title: Five Nights at Roblox 2 RePartyin
description: It’s been awhile ever since Roblox Chill Hangout was shutdown. Even after 2 shutdowns, Blox Entertainment still wants to continue making more places. With NPCs becoming smarter, Blox Entertainment want to move forward with this technology creating newer and better bots. Roblox Corp gives them one more chance. Roblox Party Area was born.

title: RobloxTale: Noob Fight
description: RobloxTale: Noob Fight is an Undertale fangame that puts the player in a custom boss battle against the Roblox noob.

title: Hentai Literature Club
description: Hentai Literature Club is an 18+ fanmade visual novel based on Doki Doki Literature Club.

title: Fort Solis: Terra Edition
description:
Fort Solis is a riveting story-driven thriller on the Red Planet.

The Terra Edition includes:
- Fort Solis the game
- Fort Solis Extras (Artbook & OST)

title: The Lost Glitches
description: The Lost Glitches is a Techno-Optimist set Trading Card Game with RPG progression. Head-to-head PvP battles require strategy, unique deck construction and clever wits to climb the ladder.

title: The Crackpet Show: Happy Tree Friends Edition
description: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot'em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear ‘em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!

title: Pirate Bloopers
description: Pirate Bloopers is an isometric action game in the style of "time survival" where you take a control of a ship in the dangerous waters of the Pirate Bay. The sea is calling!

title: Crime Zone
description:
Enter the Crime Zone. Move it, Move it. Catch the perps. You are drawn to a mysterious hotel. You are repeatedly drawn to this mysterious hotel. Protect And Serve. It's just another day in the Crime Zone.

Originally released August 2011 for Ludum Dare. Made in Adventure Game Studio.

title: Der Pfad des Pinguins
description:
You wake up in a snow-covered landscape and can't remember anything. You have to find out how you got to this place and survive. On your journey you meet penguins who confront you with a mysterious disease. Can you help the penguins?

This is a RPG Adventure Game!

title: Internet Cafe Creator
description: Internet Cafe Creator is a new type of gameplay in the internet cafe game series. Build, expand, buy computers, hire staff, fight off bandits - all this wait you in this great game!

title: RoboHunters
description: Top-down 3D action shooter. Fight against swarms of rogue AI machines and survive as long as you can!

title: Validus Mortis
description: Validus Mortis is a 2D platformer in fantasy style. To stop the evil wizards of taking control of the land. explore the stage with your hero knight and find items to progress forward. Slay monsters and gain experience and new spells.

title: The Queen's Quest
description: In this top-down adventure, you are a bee on a quest to find the legendary Flower of Life. Along the way, you'll befriend allies with powers who help you solve puzzles, battle fierce enemies and overcome epic challenges. Explore four unique worlds and unravel the hidden mysteries of this realm.

title: Never Ending Nightmare
description: Life has been tough for you after the tragic incident with your parents. Your way of coping has been through reliving all the good memories with them, but all the memories had a dark turn this time... will you be able to figure out why?

title: Arrow a Row
description: Arrow a row is a game in which you shoot arrows (of course) in a row! or maybe two rows! (maybe three?) Choose your power-ups and defeat the Boss.

title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk: Base & Jay
description: Two new writers, Base and Jay, are coming in from out of town to support the BRC crew.

title: Attenborough's Antarctic: An Exploration of Life in the Freezer
description:
This is a program of exploration and discovery with David Attenborough as your guide. Go wherever your fancy takes you, and experience the savageness, beauty and abundance of life in the coldest place on Earth.
Welcome to the South Pole and the surrounding area, one of the most extraordinary places on our planet. In this richly illustrated title, you can investigate the Antarctic terrain, its seasons and the animals that live there.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Trident of Power
description: The Trident of Power is a Zelda fangame developed by Pizus, under RPG Maker 2003. It offers a very complete experience with both battles and puzzles and a complete storyline taking place in both Hyrule and the neighboring country of Tylistem. The game is available in both Spanish and English

title: Notes of the Outskirts
description:
Close future. Rumors say megacorps are getting mad over a possible treasure. Bandits, mercenaries and opportunistic merchants are showing up, and of course you're too. Whatever it is, you're determined to find it and sell it to whoever will propose the best price. That's where the adventure begins.

Note of the outskirts is a classic party-based role playing game in the vein of titles such as the original Wasteland.

title: Discovering Endangered Wildlife
description: An interactive program endorsed by David Bellamy, designed to help children and parents learn about animals and wildlife in danger of becoming extinct.

title: Titan 2
description: Titan 2 is a ten-level Doom II episode mod, created by Jesper Krag Rasmussen (Ixnatifual) and released on January 21, 2009. Built for GZDoom, it is the sequel to 2004's Titan and follows the protagonist's attempts to escape Hell and return to the moonbase. It once again features several custom enemies as well as a new weapon, the minigun.

title: 15 Years a Doomer
description: 15 Years a Doomer was a mapping contest held from March 22 to March 29, 2021. The event was organized by James Paddock (Jimmy) to celebrate his 15th year anniversary in the Doom community.

title: The Walking Dead: Destinies
description: Begin your journey as Rick Grimes, waking alone in a hospital surrounded by the dead. Assemble allies and fight your way through the walker apocalypse across iconic locations from The Walking Dead, including Atlanta, the Greene family farm, the prison, and Woodbury. In crucial choice-driven moments, you’ll forever shape the destiny of your team of characters from the series. Heroes and villains, living and dead – it’s up to you to decide whether to stay the course of history or forge your own path through the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

title: Maou Shoujo Eri
description:
Created in Wolf RPG Editor by yako, this is a puzzle game where the player must navigate dungeons, evading enemies and traps in order to save a kidnapped girl from the Evil Lord. The objective is to reach the end of every map before a timer runs out. The player character can destroy any enemy just by body slamming it into oblivion at the cost of HP equal to the level of the enemy. It is also possible to restore 30 HP with the press of a button in exchange for 1 second on the timer.

The player must find the most optimal route in every map, managing health and trying to find all the secrets hidden in the game, while still reaching the exit point of the map on time.

title: CyberGroove
description: CyberGroove is one of the oldest known DDR clones released for PCs. In Taiwan, it was released as an "upgrade" to Dance 2000.

title: Arctic Outpost
description: The map was designed to be SP only, for GZDoom (works fine in 3.3.1) and so jumping, crouching and freelook is allowed, the arctic setting was originally inspired by 'The Thing', however it soon evolved into a more traditional doom map. This was a submission for the Vinesauce Mapping Contest II.

title: Spidersilk
