description: Four of the most capable warriors in the Kingdom of Abrujah are about to commence a journey that will change their lives forever, if they fail, the world is doomed!

title: Echoes of Numa
description: Jessabel is the guardian of the next Vessel, Allegra. Responsible for training her, she'll soon find out that there is more to Allegra than she could have ever imagined. This 1 Vessel has the power to change everything. It's Jessabel's duty to make sure Allegra does well. For the sake of humankind.

title: Cash Cow DX
description: Holy cow, it’s all about the moooney! Run, jump and slide in this udderly moo-velous adventure to reclaim your fortunes from those sneaky Pig Pockets. Tough as nails and no continues! Are you up for the challenge?

title: Blue Sky Aces
description: A retro inspired, stylized world war 1 flight simulator that puts you in control of some of the worlds first war planes. Zoom above the trenches as you engage the enemy in fierce close range dogfights, where any moment could be your last.

title: Blood Moon Horror
description: Blood Moon Horror is a 1-8 player co-op survival horror game. Survive the nightmare under the alien-infested moon, navigate the abandoned lunar base, evade extraterrestrial predators, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows.

title: Galaxy Commanders
description: Assemble and command your space fleet to victory

title: Drill to the Stars
description: In "Drill to the Stars," you build your OWN base! Guide enemies with walls into traps and eliminate them before they destroy your drill. Strategically adapt to the environment and place the towers cleverly for maximum attack speed in this roguelite tower defense game.

title: Hell Miner
description: Hell Miner is a casual indie game. Players play as a mining veteran, mistakenly into hell, encounter various demon girls, fight all the way to the bottom of hell, and finally become the king of hell.

title: Restless Lands
description: Embark on an epic quest to save Midgard in "Restless Lands". Uncover ancient secrets, battle mythical creatures, and restore the magical garden of blue roses in this enthralling 2D pixel art metroidvania adventure. Magic, mythology, and mystery await!

title: Cosmic Resistance
description: Gear up, gamers! Brace yourself for an epic sci-fi strategy casual game where Aliens have swept across the cosmos, leaving humanity's fate hanging by a thread. The weight of liberation falls on your shoulders. Are you ready, General, to step up and become humanity's last hope?

title: Raicing
description: Mastermind the race in Raicing! Craft, train, and compete with AI drivers. Conquer rivals in thrilling multiplayer battles. Customize cars for the ultimate victory!

title: Umbra: Veins of Vengeance
description: The world has become a desolate wasteland, where boundaries between reality and nightmare have blurred, and madness is all there is to experience. Amon Morgan, a nefarious beast who enjoys the thrill of the hunt, is back. Be ready to experience a constant state of dread.

title: Mizeria
description: Nuoli finds herself stranded in a mystical land between life and death. With the use of her magical bow, and a unique platforming system, help her escape back to the land of the living, in this old-school inspired 3D Metroidvania.

title: Unrestricted Pest Control
description: U.P.C. is a top-down shooter where you play as a fearless exterminator to solve a small bug problem at a nuclear research facility. With the rogue-lite elements, you must choose your path to the upper floors carefully, while trying to bug fixing in the facility.

title: Rainbow Cream Saga
description: Welcome to Rainbow Cream Saga, a kickass melee action survival game with some RPG vibes! You can craft weapons, build bases, capture mounts and much more! Come through on this epic adventure and test out your survival skills.

title: Origami Lovers
description: Origami Lovers is a casual to midcore Jump'n'Run/Platformer set in a cardboard and paper world. Overcome obstacles and challenges while collecting different abilites that will help you navigate through the level.

title: Lindwyrm
description: Lindwyrm combines hack‘n‘slay combat, platforming, puzzling and housing in the shell of a rogue-lite action RPG. Crawl into thrilling dungeons, slay epic bosses with your weapon of choice, enhance your hero, and rebuild a destroyed village in this co-op adventure.

title: Wished on guilt
description: Aristocrat Evan Alford receives a mysterious invitation to the fair and comes to a small village on the outskirts of the country. The village seems strange and painfully familiar, but Evan has never been here. In addition, other guests of the fair are not as simple as it seems.

title: Dissent on Mars
description: A sci-fi life sim where you create new societies unlike anything on Earth. Design your economy and government, build your colony, and experience your choices firsthand by living as a colonist. Will your society become a living utopia, or another dystopia?

title: Deep Maze
description: Experience the game from a top-down perspective that allows you to delve into the heart of the mountain range, measuring your progress against the speed. Now, let's see how far you can go. Let's find out!

title: Clash Cats
description: Stock up on epic hero powers to start the battle of the century today!Unlock your potential and new characters to battle competitors while exploring all the possibilities of this new and exciting action strategic tower defense game!

title: 304 Seconds
description: A short visual novel where you figure out Kuroya and Nicole's circumstances, and decide who gets to live, and who gets to die.

title: Super Spooky Subgame Spectacular
description: Plunge into a realm of spine-tingling delights, where ghoulish subgames beckon! Embrace frightful fun in the Super Spooky Subgame Spectacular!

title: The Crimson Pearl
description: The Blight has plagued The Kingdom for as long as one can remember. Ashanti and Scarlett believe they have found out a way to fight The Blight and defeat it once and for all. Their path to such solution will drastically change their lives!

title: Daughter of Crone
description: Take the role of a young witch named Eyfrid and master the ways of magic. Learn to cast spells, brew magical potions, and explore the mystical kingdom of Ervein. It is up to you to shape the destiny of Eyfrid, the Daughter of Crone.

title: Solivagant
description: You are a lone traveler, adrift in a realm beyond time and space. Navigate, decipher, and endure the enigmas of a world that defies understanding. Embark on a journey through the inexplicable in Solivagant. Heavily inspired by the Backrooms.

title: Mayhemers
description: Mayhemers is game where you can create chaos and mayhem in different type of places. Play solo or up to 4 people against AI or challenge with other players in 3v3 pvp game mode.

title: Jissou Land
description: Jissou Land is a simple clicker game that grow a cute little creature, 'Jissouseki'.

title: Hell Throne
description: A fast-paced action roguelite game with bullet hell elements, encounter based combat and high replayability. Make your way through monster infested realms as you pick and choose from a multitude of upgrades and abilities to create the meanest build possible!

title: Here We Exist
description: Here We Exist is a path that seeks for purpose and meaning, wander around a strange world where everything has a purpose, but nothing makes sense, talk with strange creatures, fullfil your destiny.

title: Dirt Bike Racer Simulator
description: Get realistic motorcycle experience on offroad terrains with Dirt Bike Racer Simulator! Complete quests, explore the open world, and enjoy the adrenaline-filled ride.

title: Lifelong
description: Lifelong is a first-person adventure game about the bureaucratic empire and the meaninglessness of certain jobs. You play as Marcel Dämlich, an employee of Scopesoft, a complex and labyrinthine company.

title: 2099 Gravity Havoc
description: Shoot at enemies in a WEIGHTLESS space station to save yourself from burning alive in the atmosphere!

title: Chickado
description: Chickado is an isometric rogue-lite game where you play as an armed chick who seeks revenge against the other animals on the farm by battling them.

title: Wisdom Watcher
description: Wisdom Watcher is a new VR shooter set in a clockpunk universe, find the right weapons to face the folkloric monsters inside the arenas and come out on top!

title: Ancient Viking
description: Ancient viking is a 2D platform game with RPG elements. Destroy enemies on the location and complete the set goal to go further along the storyline.

title: KoroNeko
description: Relaxing puzzle game, roll your way in a Kawaii world full of Charming characters, a calming journey ahead of you to save your siblings from Strawberry the witch.

title: HistoriCity: Florence
description: A historical, mission-based, stylized 3D citybuilder set in Renaissance Florence. Use the strength of your economy, the power of religion, and the beauty of classical art and architecture to rebuild a city decimated by the Black Plague and civil unrest.

title: Paper Perjury
description:
Investigating a simple robbery reveals a tapestry of mysteries!

Solve a series of cases as newly hired police clerk Justina Smith and find out the truth behind a string of suspicious crimes. Work with the energetic detective Ernest Hunt and dig for clues in the paper trail to discover the secrets that paperwork can hide.

title: Yujiro's Mansion
description: As a thief who does his job well, you stumble across a mansion. What you didn't know was that this mansion belonged to the "Strongest Creature In The World", Yujiro Hanma. Can you rob Yujiro's Mansion and get out alive?

title: Million Depth
description: Embark on an adventure, exploring a million subterranean floors of a fallen Earth. Trace the remnants of humanity that once dwelled below, all in search of "YOU". Utilize a crafting system that transforms your drawings into weapons to survive the challenging underground world.

title: Micro Manager: 90 Days Probation
description: Live your life on your term in this modern coming of age work simulator. With various activities. The Manager doesn't like Slackers so watch out for his disappointment stance as he deducts points from your performance score.

title: NSG: Missing Tales
description: In this new adventure, the group discovers that Tales has disappeared and it is up to them to find him and arrive in time for the Halloween party. Here, time is your biggest enemy, or perhaps an ally? Your choices will make you closer or further away from finding it.

title: The Simplest Game in the World
description: You can beat this game with any key on your keyboard. ANY key, I mean it.

title: Adventure Tanks
description: Engage in fierce battles against rival tanks in a variety of arenas. Strategize your moves, dodge enemy fire, and reach the ultimate goal!

title: Eidolon Awakened
description: Eidolon Awakened is a turn-based creature collector RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world overtaken by creatures known as Eidolons. Take your place among the Summoners, able to capture and control the Eidolon to determine the fate of mankind.

title: Pixel Colony
description: Build and manage your own colony. Citizens are primary resource. Protect your settlement and colonists from hostile environment and make a prosperous city.

title: Midnight Acres
description: Experience Midnight Acres — an indie farming sim by day, and intense FPS by night. Unwind and battle on, all in one game as you grow and nurture your farm, plan and upgrade turrets and defenses, and engage in combat with horrifying beasts.

title: 1001 Jigsaw Detective 4
description: An intriguing and mysterious adventure in the detective world! Collect cryptic clues, examine intricate crime scenes, examine photos of suspects and immerse yourself in the fascinating atmosphere of a private investigation.

title: Desktop Basketball 2
description: Invigorating basketball everyone can enjoy together! Prepare for the next evolution in dunking!

title: Warf
description: Unleash strategic survival in Warf, where you guide Warf through relentless hordes. Shape paths, deploy towers, and engage in thrilling combat. Defend against the horde and emerge as the ultimate survivor in this innovative fusion of survival action and tower defense.

title: Dungeon Inn
description: Dungeon Inn is a charming turn-based management strategy game where you secretly run an inn for two rival adventurer guilds near a bustling dungeon. Carefully plan adventurer routes, keep the rival guilds from crossing paths, and manage suspicion while growing your business. Outsmart your guests, keep your double-dealing under wraps, and get stinkin’ rich!

title: No Man's Sky: Echoes
description: Meet a secret society of robotic aliens in update 4.4, ECHOES! Furthering the narrative introduced in INTERCEPTOR, explore the mysteries of the Autophage, perform their rituals, learn their language, and assemble your own ceremonial staff. In deep space, confront huge outlaw dreadnoughts, sweep through their trenches and destroy vulnerable components in new tactical space combat – and much more!

title: Frog Bridge Scape
description: You guide our friend Frog across temporary bridges and collect batteries to reach the portal. The bridges are activated with your electric gun on the coils.

title: Edge of War
description: Edge of War delivers an isometric, turn-based CRPG where the world reacts to you. All side quests are main quests, as every decision matters and impacts the fate of the Northlands. Explore and complete missions, but keep your heroes on their toes: the wilds do not forgive.

title: Horn Sounds
description: Your task is to destroy all enemies on the map. Farms will provide you with provisions, with which you can hire new soldiers. Gather squads, hire new soldiers, capture farms... All this will help you win!

title: Blocklords
description: Blocklords is a player-driven grand strategy game by MetaKing Studios. Rule, conquer, and grow with your medieval Hero.

title: Zubash
description:
Zubash is a physics action game blending "cooperation x battle". Experience unique gameplay, strategies of betrayal, and physics-driven miraculous plays. It's a user-friendly game perfect for fun times with friends and family.
Note: Supports local multiplayer only.

title: Tommy Gun Witches
description: A whodunit with witches point and click adventure

title: Shadow of the Orient
description: Ready to do battle with evil and save the day? Shadow of the Orient is a 2d pixel art action adventure platformer game with fully customizable touch controls, fluid movement and smooth animations. Explore vast levels filled with secrets, quests and loot. Fight your way through hordes of samurai enemies and mythological creatures using your Dao sword or fight off enemies at a distance with ranged weapons.

title: Pizza Hero
description:
Welcome to Pizza Hero, the exciting new shoot 'em up roguelite that puts a delicious twist on the genre! In this game, you'll play as a brave pizza who must defend the world from an invasion of enemies.
As you battle your way through the game, you'll have the opportunity to choose from a variety of different toppings that will grant you special abilities. For example, selecting pepperoni will give you a grenade, allowing you to deal splash damage. Or, if you're feeling saucy, you can choose blue cheese to create a pungent parameter around your pizza, damaging any foes that come too close.

title: Witch Cram Sorceries
description: Play as Marietta, a new magic teacher, as she tries to guide and teach the new kids to become master of their magic.

title: Mini Star Survivor
description: Collect stars and use them wisely to become stronger. Use each character's personality to establish a growth strategy. And survive and escape for 5 or 10 days.

title: Triplets Trouble!!!
description: Triplets Trouble!!! is a visual novel slice of life about a father and his triplets in a period shortly after the pandemic. Each game played by the children became a mini-game, in a short narrative over seven days in the life of this family.

title: Falls and Jumps
description: Falls and Jumps is an endless 2D platform game about where you need to stay alive by jumping on platforms that appear for a short time and avoiding deadly traps. Your task is to hold out as long as possible.

title: Poly Backrooms
description: Welcome to Poly Backrooms, an unique multiplayer co-op horror game that combines the infamous backrooms creepypasta with a fun, low-poly aesthetic. With up to 4 players, you and your friends will navigate through the backrooms, solving intricate puzzles and avoiding dangerous entities.

title: Zombie Battlefield Survivors
description: Zombie Battlefield Survivors is a top-down view roguelike action shooter game. Fight against hordes of zombies, constantly upgrading attributes and collecting credits to enhance your character's abilities.

title: Horror Gallery
description: Immerse yourself in a sinister narrative as you piece together the story through hints in this eerie place. Every step you take inches you closer to the truth.Will you uncover the chilling truth?

title: Dungeon of Horror
description: Dungeon of Horror - a 2D-pixel dungeon labyrinth, where you play as a girl trying to find the way out and discover all the dark corners of this frightening place. Watch your steps, avoid traps, collect all loot and escape the dungeon!

title: The Flat
description: The Flat is an FPS Immersive Horror where you're just a small cog in the vast, dark machinery of Corpo Corporation. Navigate corporate chaos, fight for your life, master unique stealth mechanics, and immerse yourself in a brutalist horror setting. How much can you take before you snap?

title: Idle Stellar
description: Embark on an epic adventure through the cosmos in Idle Stellar. Gather, trade, craft, upgrade your spaceship and fight enemies. Whether you play actively or look for a relaxed idle experience, the journey ahead is rich in features and content!

title: Jrago The Demon Hunter
description: Jrago The Demon Hunter is a METROIDVANIA style 2D Platforming Action-Adventure Role Playing Game. The world is overcome in darkness, and you are a hunter named Jrago on a quest to slay the demons and bring back the light!

title: Free for All
description: What is most important to you? Money? Honor? Love? Or any other things? It's all good. Please enjoy this adventure according to your values.

title: Grozs Fantasy World
description: "Grozs Fantasy World"A side-scrolling action adventure game where players take on the role of adventurers traversing various fantasy-themed worlds.

title: Sufficiency
description: Sufficiency is a 3D first person room escape puzzle game with unique puzzle solve system and artstyle. Players have to figure out the usage of each item/facility on their own, and solve all the puzzles based on their understanding.

title: Idle Crypto Capitalist
description: Idle Crypto Capitalist! Buy the best cryptocurrencies on the market and earn more and more money with smart investment strategy. Now you can be a millionaire through crypto investment while idle!

title: Hot And Lovely: Uniform
description: Hot And Lovely: Uniform is a classic puzzle game. Players need to eliminate more than three blocks of the same type to complete the goal and pass the level. After completing all the levels, the game is successful!

title: Mik
description: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.

title: Strategic Command: World War I - Empires in Turmoil
description: Our Empires in Turmoil DLC adds six exciting new campaigns to Strategic Command World War I.

title: Little Kingdoms: Chapters 1-3
description: Little Kingdoms: Chapters 1-3 is a prologue to Little Kingdoms, a medieval real-time strategy game with stylistic low poly graphics and relaxing music. Your goal is to conquer the neighboring kingdoms and grow your empire.

title: Miniature Mayhem!
description: In Miniature Mayhem, mad scientist Victor's experiment goes awry with a rogue gamma ray. Chaos ensues as the Mayhem Miniatures are born. Wreak havoc and compete against friends in hazardous environments filled with power-ups and weapons!

title: Through Time the Girl Puzzle
description: "Gentleman puzzle, relying on puzzle skills and skills to keep moving into the hearts of various beautiful girls! "

title: Thanks, Light.
description: [Thanks, Light.] is a first-person 3D geometry puzzle game where you shine and absorb light to transform 2D and 3D states.Watch as one boy saves a world that has lost its light.

title: Unread Messages
description: Unread Messages is a retro-inspired cyberpunk puzzle game where you deliver texts by making connections between cell towers. Alongside your Ai companion, FASMA, solve confounding levels and uncover the secrets hidden within Simullect Inc's computers.

title: L-Room
description: Let's build the routes that connect the platforms. This is a first-person puzzle game where you have to understand the algorithm and select the correct nodes.Think carefully with a drone as a companion.

title: Technocide
description: Technocide is a vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with a heavy emphasis on player weapons and abilities. You must not let enemies past you and reach your mothership! You will need quick tactical thinking as you weigh your weapons' strengths and weaknesses against your enemies and their positioning.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Amusements
description: Puzzles of amusements!

title: Fatrifice 2
description: The demoness Shar, summoned by a group of girls who performed a fatrifice, wants to become even stronger! And how will she do that, you ask? That's a good question, by another fatrifice!

title: Knightess
description: Anastasia, Artemisia & Lozen, three mercenaries who roam the Kingdom' looking for work, are seen by the King as the possible solution to keep the peace, even if only temporally. Join the three of them, as they journey in what will become a path of discovery, friendship and betrayal.

title: Fun With the Fitzgeralds
description: Welcome to the Battle of the Fitzgerald's there can be only one King or Queen of the land, so join in on the funniest battle you will ever play. It's all just about the FUN.

title: Toufra
description: Toufra is a challenging speedrunning game. Your only companion is your trustworthy grapple to manipulate in air. Take on this challenge throughout multiple immersive levels set in dark enviroment.

title: Collectamon
description: Collectamon is a creature collecting game with an additional focus on upgrades. Upgrade your character, upgrade the area and place your caught monsters in your sanctuary. Catch all monsters in the game? Upgrade Everything? Try and get all achievements? It's up to you!

title: Deep Nest
description: Deep Nest is a fast-paced single player action shooter roguelite where you play a space marine fighting off an endless horde of alien monsters in an infested facility.

title: Veil of Clay
description: A woman magically appears in Clay's home and he is swept into an adventure that forces him to come to terms with his selfish behavior, or be a coward and not face his weaknesses. Clay comes to question the essence of love, companionship, and who he is going to be.

title: Cooking Crew
description: Join forces online with friends or go solo in this immersive restaurant simulator! Transform an empty restaurant into a bustling hotspot, upgrade your kitchen and serve a variety of delicious dishes. Can you handle the heat and satisfy every hungry customer?

title: Hot Candy Land
description: A 9 to 5 desk job is not really your thing? Go grab your smart phone, start filming and get ready to fulfil your destiny as the King of the Adult Industry in this crazy classic tycoon parody!

title: Memento Dawn
description: A colorful puzzle game that follows a lost child on a journey to search for her memories and helps her through the darkness by controlling light and shadow.

title: Legends of Elementia
description: Legends of Elementia: A magical open-world metroidvania game with elemental combos and map interactions! Switch between heroes, defeat enemies with unique powers, and restore Elementia's balance. Unleash powerful elemental combos and explore a dynamic world with interactive maps.

title: Toree Saturn
description: Toree Saturn is a speed based 3D Platformer featuring a round bird with sunglasses and a backpack!

title: Small Kingdoms
description: Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals as you build up cities and armies on the world map and command troops on the battlefield. Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with small procedurally generated world maps, and campaigns you can complete in a weekend

title: Specimen #08
description: The untitled eighth game in the Haunted PS1 C.H.A.I.N. takes place in an unknown, blood-soaked location. The only new detail given on the research log is an ultrasound image of an unknown figure.

title: Wolvesville
description: Wolvesville is a multiplayer game for up to 16 players. Each game has different teams such as villagers or werewolves all fighting to be the last team standing. Use special abilities to uncover the roles of other players and convince your fellow players to work with you.

title: Labyrinth of Rage
description: Enter the Labyrinth... at your own demise.

title: Shadows on the Walls
description: Shadows on the Walls is an immersive VR game of psychological horror, exploration and puzzles that takes place in the Crystal Palace Museum of London. Put yourself in the shoes of a security guard in charge of watching the new and mysterious exhibit of the museum known as the “Cursed Loot”.

title: Surviving Skeleton Island
description: Surviving Skeleton Island is a challenging survival RPG set in a vast 3D low poly island world of 12 unique biomes. Explore, hunt, craft, build, farm and fish to survive, while quests and clues unveil the secrets of the island, and your past. Forge your destiny and plot your escape!

title: Star Wars: Dark Forces Remaster
description:
Star Wars: Dark Forces Remaster uses Nightdive Studio’s proprietary KEX engine, support up to 4K resolution at 120FPS, feature modern gamepad support, remastered cutscenes, and add trophies and achievements to the original game experience.

Players assume the role of Kyle Katarn, a mercenary hired by the Rebel Alliance to discover and destroy the Galactic Empire’s Dark Trooper project, a clandestine military operation created to develop Force-sensitive stormtroopers and battle droids. Star Wars: Dark Forces features several memorable locations from the original trilogy, including the interior of a Star Destroyer and Jabba the Hutt’s desert yacht, as well as new locations unique to the game.

title: Swell
description: Link #9 of Haunted PS1'S C.H.A.I.N. initially resembles a PSX disc, but is revealed in the research log to be some form of potentially living creature. What follows is only explainable on those terms.

title: Wonder Wheel
description: This is a wad of 4 maps; they are vaguely nature-themed and about 10 minutes and 100 monsters long each. No gameplay changes. Balanced for pistol starts.

title: Beware of Falling Angels
description:
This is an Eternity Engine map with portals and some special effects.
The gameplay is classic: no new monsters or weapons, no jumping. Freelook is not needed or recommended.

title: Bifrost
description: Single map based on the idea of rainbow bridges.
Short, if a bit tricky, map with nothing but neon skyscrapers, transparent platforms and setpiece fights.

title: Enigma of Sector Sigma
description: 5-map wad. Pistol starts are the intended experience, but continuous playthroughs are supported too.

title: Bourgeois Megawad
description: Bourgeois Megawad, also known as Bourgeois Deathmatch, is a 30-map vanilla and Unity compatible megawad created in 2021 by Decay, Adam Post (Doomkid), and Razgriz. All of the maps are playable in singleplayer, co-op and deathmatch.

title: Ichinichi
description:
This is my second 32-map solo project (remember KINDa.wad?)!
The gameplay is completely vanilla, using limit-removing ports and contains only stock textures and music. The majority of maps are small to medium sized with differing themes and pace.

title: Crusader
description: Stand alone against the endless horde. In this medieval FPS roguelike, defend your princess against waves of whimsical monsters. Slay, earn coin and gems, upgrade your power with the mystery mushroom, and become a legendary Crusader. How long can you survive, brave knight?

title: Lost Civilization 2
description: 7 maps with ending scene and a secret map.The gameplay is mainly exploration with small fights here and there. More shooting in the end. You can solve some puzzles or not, those are mostly optional. Gameplay is easygoing. Nothing for Doom-veterans (easy). Has a little scarier moments to spice things up.

title: 12 pm Break
description: 12 pm Break drops players into a chaotic lunch-hour showdown known as “Toonie Tuesday.” You’re not just taking a break—you’re fighting through it. With fast-paced action across multiple maps, players battle through office-themed arenas, cafeteria shootouts, and surreal corporate environments. The game blends satire and stylized violence with a tongue-in-cheek tone.

title: Lunacy
description: Lunacy is a wild journey to the moon and back! Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping Series welcomes back our hero from Mapping at Warpspeed, Zorglo Blaskowicz IX, on another Skillsaw-inspired quest to defeat the enemy aliens encroaching on the cheese production facilities of Luna, and to ingest as much dairy as possible.

title: Hovercab Station
description: A bit of a spiritual successor to my 2022 wad, Herschel Spaceport. Blast your way through demons from Hell in a rundown city block. The action takes place up top on the streets, in a (hover!) train station, and in the water filtration system below.

title: Herschel Spaceport
description: Here's a short techbase map set in Herschel Crater, on Saturn's moon, Mimas. The UAC has set up a space colony overrun by demons. What could the UAC have hidden under the Miman soil to warrant such an invasion?

title: Tyrant
description: 5-map wad, Egyptian-themed. Pistol-starts are recommended, but not necessary.

title: Never
description: NEVER uses mostly vanilla assets to create an atmosphere that I think you'll find unique and oppressive (but in a fun way). There is some old-school DEHACKED nonsense to keep it fresh.

title: Doomkid's Mega!
description: A set of 8 classic style Doom II levels. There's some minor DeHackEd use and a few custom sprites, but nothing too crazy.

title: Jamal Jones: In Judgment of Evil
description: Jamal Jones Trilogy is a compilation of levels created during the Doomkid's 20 Years Mapping Contest held at the Doomworld Forums. This was a community project dedicated to Doomkid's 20th anniversary as a mapper.

title: Jamal Jones: One Man Jury!
description: Jamal Jones Trilogy is a compilation of levels created during the Doomkid's 20 Years Mapping Contest held at the Doomworld Forums. This was a community project dedicated to Doomkid's 20th anniversary as a mapper.

title: Jamal Jones: Hell's Executioner
description: "Jamal Jones: Hell's Executioner" is the third and final episode of the Jamal Jones Trilogy, a community-driven megawad for Doom II created during Doomkid’s 20 Years Mapping Contest. Featuring 20 maps plus 2 secret levels, this episode follows Jamal Jones as he battles through hellish landscapes to stop an alien scourge infecting humanity. The game includes custom monsters, upgraded weapons, and a gritty sci-fi backstory.

title: Organ of Eden
description: The tenth entry within Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N. is preceded by a report of a parasitic mind virus and a biostratigraphic diagram. A medical team surrounds the player as gore begins to pile around them.

title: Day 11
description: The 11th link in the Haunted PS1 C.H.A.I.N. is extremely anomalous and is known to cause psychosis and paranoia among the staff who play it or otherwise come in contact with it. They are typically then reported either missing or dead. There is no known way to handle this game safely.

title: Avert Your Eyes
description: Link #12 in the Haunted PS1 C.H.A.I.N. is footage from a hiking trip in west Germany. The video quality is abhorrent for what should be a modern phone and the device itself is caked in ashes.

title: Column Dodger
description: For the 13th link in Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N. is a simple dodging game. Nearby metal objects are purported to migrate by a couple inches if the game is left on for a certain duration.

title: Specimen #14
description: Yet another untitled entry in Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N., it follows an unknown protagonist hounded by mysterious, eyeball-like creatures.

title: Symphonia
description: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.

title: Specimen 15
description: Mysterious disembodied eyes chase you in this link of Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N..
Appropriately titled 16, this C.H.A.I.N. link may or may not be linked to an incident of occult Welsh origin.

title: Vale
description: Fight your way to dominion over the universe in this Shoot Em Up game based on the book! In Dune: Imperium, you'll step into the role of one of the leaders of the Great Houses of the Imperium in a struggle to control the planet Arrakis and the invaluable Spice it provides.

The game plays out in a series of ten rounds, each of which is defined by a new Conflict on the surface of the planet; some award critical resources, and some provide Victory Points that will propel you to dominance. But choose your battles wisely: spread your forces too thin, and you'll find your enemies growing too strong to oppose.

Each round, you'll draw a hand of five cards from your deck, which will get stronger over the course of the game as you acquire new cards. Each card can be played in one of two ways: To send an Agent out into the Imperium to gather resources, or to Reveal at the end of the round to purchase new powerful cards. You must maintain a careful balance to get the most of the resources available to you. How will you find your path?

As your game progresses, you'll vie for Influence with four factions of the Imperium: The Emperor, the economically powerful Spacing Guild, the mysterious Bene Gesserit, and the ferocious Fremen of the deep deserts. Earning Influence among the various groups helps you to earn the Victory Points you need...but will you compete with your rivals for their favor, or abandon alliances to pursue other opportunities?

Many strategies are at your disposal, and many paths to victory. The cards are dealt. The choice is yours. The Imperium awaits.

description: Choose your path in the Serpent's Wake, an all-new Heretic adventure with three variations of each map. Featuring the quest system: each skill level represents a different way of playing each map. Monsters, items, progression, geometry and more change from quest to quest.

title: 5till L1 Complex
description: 5till L1 Complex is single-level PWAD designed by Lainos for Doom II. It was released in 2012 and requires a limit removing source port. The mod uses a music track and intermission music from the anime series Angel Beats! while replacing the title music with silence.

title: Lord of the Cyberdemons
description: This starts where Future Unveiled left off, at the entryway to where four angry Cyberdemons are about to blow you away, and you must rely on more than rockets or any weapons to get out alive!

title: The Uprising
description:
Looks like you're coming out of retirement, son.

Another citadel was taken over by the forces of Hell, just when you thought you exterminated them all!

This time, it's not so easy. The minions are more dedicated than ever, to take over the world! They've teamed up in larger numbers, and in tougher groups. This will be the toughest battle you may ever have been in, provided you can last through this marathon of gunfire.

title: Metal.ik Vol. II
description:
Ik a soul liberated full of hatred penetrates the depths of Internet to Play a cassette, because music is the only human vestige that remains.

FPS Steampunk like a Quake + Hotline Miami

title: Amnesia Re-collection
description: A collection of all the iconic Amnesia games from Frictional Games.

title: Metal.ik Vol. III
description: Old school graphycs,Volume 3 is inspired by Tribes 2,Dom 3 and Hotline Miami

title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon - Premium Edition
description:
Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon - Premium Edition is exclusive to the Bandai Namco Store and comes with:

Full game
Garage - A garage where you can park your Armored Core, inspired by the one available in the game. Size: 32 cm
Armored Core Figurine - Size 19 cm
Steelbook - Original art steelbook case
Pin Badges - A set of 4 pin badges featuring in-game emblem patterns
Stickers - A set of 45 stickers to personalize your computer, mobile phone, etc.
Artbook - An exclusive 40-page hardcover artbook. Dive deep into the world of Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon with never-before-seen visuals.
Digital Soundtrack - The complete Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon original soundtrack

title: Blood Orange
description:
Searching the Amazon for the elusive razorback dolphin, Nora discovers more than she bargained for.

Created in one month for Thalassophobia game jam.

title: Squirrel Stapler
description:
Originally created as part of The Dread X Collection II, Squirrel Stapler is a horror hunting simulator that satirizes low budget edutainment games with pitch black humor and panic-inducing absurdist horror.

A lonely man living in a remote cabin wakes up one day and realizes his beloved--a dismembered corpse nailed to the cabin wall--has been made ugly and rotten by the flies that swarm her. He wishes she were beautiful, like the squirrels of the wood. And so he sets out to hunt the squirrels of the wood, so that he might staple them to her and make her beautiful again.

But that is easier said than done. A sinister presence lurks in the deep forest, and it has only one rule: "Thou shalt not staple squirrels!"

title: Scary Library
description: C.H.A.I.N. link #18 revolves around a librarian in her workplace during a torrential thunderstorm. The specimen can purportedly possess people.

title: Abraxas
description: 1999. Four childhood friends (Clarice, Afonso, Sabrina and Marcos) decide to get together in a country house to reminisce about the good old days. However, at nightfall, Clarice proposes a dangerous prank to the group... Something seems to have gone terribly wrong.
There is no information on the last entry of C.H.A.I.N..

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Blood Frontier
description: So, you want to ride with Padre and the Autarkis Gangrel of the Lost Souls coterie? You think you have what it takes to sleep rough over 1,200 miles of southern-Texas border with the Mexican Jaguar himself? To pistol-whip Sabbat incursions? To wrangle the cattle ranches and border crossings of the Circulatory System? To lasso drug mules carting vitae-laced meth? Big cojones, huh? Alright, saddle up. The border tribes can always use another quickdraw, if you pan out that is. Welcome to the Blood Frontier.

title: Killing Machine: Movement
description:
You are Kador, a heavily armed nano-augmented spell casting former agent of the Corset Timarchy. You navigate a psypunk future society of shifting alliances. Starting in the continent of Mass City.

An overly ambitious action platformer more than a decade in the making!

title: The Beginning of the End: Part 2
description: The follow up to The Beginning of the end. Lots of new stuff here. All these levels have an original feel to them. You will enjoy playing these wads! But be warned... they are tough!

title: Dragon Ball FighterZ: Android 21 - Lab Coat
description:
Android 21, an original character from DRAGON BALL FighterZ, now joins the fight in her appearance before transformation!

This content includes:
• Android 21 (Lab Coat) as a new playable character
• 5 alternative colors for her outfit
• Android 21 (Lab Coat) Lobby Avatar
• Android 21 (Lab Coat) Z Stamp

title: Fortnite: Chapter 4 - Season 4: Last Resort
description:
A season of Fortnite: Chapter 4

The fate of the Island's at stake in Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter 4 Season 4, and thievery's the last resort. Are you in?

title: Suzu ga Utau Hi
description: A small town along the sea. A slight tide smell in the air ... in such a town I met a girl. Girl's name is Suzu. That small incident changed the boring summer and turned it into an irreplaceable season that I won't be able to forget till the rest of my life...

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou: Question Arcs
description: Higurashi When They Cry Hou: Question Arcs is a bundle released exclusively on MangaGamer's website that includes the first four remastered chapters of the game.

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou: Answer Arcs
description: Higurashi When They Cry Hou: Answer Arcs is a bundle released exclusively on MangaGamer's website that includes the last four remastered chapters of the game.

title: Blood Flows Where My Shotgun Blows
description: 6 relatively short maps for Final Doom: The Plutonia Experiment

title: Rising Blood
description: This is a remake of one of Chris Hansen's really early levels. He always considered it as his first really good level and felt that it needed a revival.

title: Flay the Obscene: Compilation
description: A combination of the first 4 Flay the Obscene releases (1-3 and DM) in 1 package.

title: Flay the Obscene: Reversed
description: This map is a revamp of the original Flay the Obscene, which was released in 1999. As the title states, the 1st map has been reversed with you starting at the end.

title: Gamma Labs
description: An action packed episode 1 style map from the creator of CH Retro Episode.

title: High/Low 5
description: This map is the conclusion of my High/Low series. This map is full of trick, traps, ambushes and puzzles. There is also a good deal of variety in the layout, so expect to do a little base jumping and try to watch your step at all times.

title: The Mean Green
description: The levels are small-medium in size and plays more like Ult. Doom since only lower tier monsters and weaponry were used. They should offer a good 45 minutes of some classic, old school fun! The action is fast paced and the levels feature their usual style of interconnectivity and semi-realistic to abstract visuals.

title: The Mean Green 2
description:
The first 3 maps saw you fighting against Imps, Sergeants and Demons with only the Shotgun, Chaingun and the Rocket Launcher. This time they are cranked up to 11 and you're gonna get bigger guns. But also a whole lot of beefier meat to aim them at! You are the Mean Green and you are about to bully the crap out of this strange world!
The levels are medium sized and sets the player in an abstract semi realistic hellish tech setting.

title: High/Low 2
description: High/Low 2 is a Doom Episode 2 themed level. Like High/Low 1, which was an episode 1 kinda level it is only meant to resemble the style, not to copy it.

title: The Wailing Horde
description: This one large map is Chris Hansen's interpretation of an action filled and slightly different episode 2 level. It tried to stay true to the style of eps. 2, but cranked it up a bit.

title: Gore
description: GORE is a found footage horror experience set deep in the mountains of the Pacific Northwest with Lovecraftian inspiration. Explore the wilderness and uncover the origins of the fleshy entity.

title: Millennium Mini-Episode
description: A collection of DOOM Millennium maps originally from 1998-1999 in a four-map mini-episode.

title: The Darkened Outpost
description: Yet another demon-infested, abandoned base. Fight your way through these nukage-processing industrial environments and expect surprises.

title: Plutonium Sandpit
description: A very large single map for Doom2. You are para- dropped on an abandoned industrial sand planet to investigate why the base was deserted. Sensors indicate the presence of hellspawn. Find the cause why facilities have ceased production and destroy any hellspawn you face.

title: Brotherhood of Ruin: The Lost Temple
description: A Large single map for DOOM2, taking place in an ancient temple complex swarming with hellspawn. Occasional switchhunt might occur as the map isn't very linear. Be warned and pay attention to the surroundings of the map.

title: Night Freak
description: A retro style horror game with silent hill style camera, tank controls, vhs filters, and survival horror elements.

title: Sudoku Master
description: Endless number of sudoku puzzles to explore. Sudoku Master - Classic Sudoku has different sudoku puzzles and comes in four difficulty levels: easy, medium, hard sudoku and sudoku expert levels. Sudoku kingdom for all kinds of sudoku players!

title: Selene: Apoptosis - 18+ Adult Only Patch
description: This DLC is only for those who are of legal age and wish to see such content. By downloading this DLC you are confirming you are 18 years of age or older (or your regional equivalent).

title: SeasonPark
description: In this Game you follow the story of a man that is searching his wife and his kids. They all disappeared in an abondend indoor playground. This indoor playground is themed after the four seasons with its mascots named Sally Spring, Siggi Summer, Frederick Fall and Willy Winter. You need to break in this playground and explore it to find your children and wife ( with no keycards!!!). You get the help from your friendly winter stick. With that stick, you can create ice blocks on which you can jump on.

title: Franzen
description: Franzen is a turn-based RPG set in a dystopian-steampunk world. Explore themes of empathy and politics as Franz and Lefsa Dellia work to uncover the truth of "The Scream". Meet a cast of colorful characters and fight bizarre creatures in your journey through the world of Branzen!

title: Chrono Ressurection
description:
Chrono Resurrection is an unreleased fangame developed by Resurrection Games under Nathan Lazur's direction, based on the Super NES role-playing game Chrono Trigger. The project was initially called CT64 and was meant to be a complete remake of the original game for the Nintendo 64 with both 2D and 3D playing modes, but it was eventually reworked from scratch.

On September 6, 2004, the project was publicly closed after Resurrection Games received a cease-and-desist letter from Square Enix for trademark and copyright infringement.

title: PhobosDeimos Anomaly
description: PhobosDeimos Anomaly is a 2012 mod for Doom containing two six-level episodes, totaling twelve levels, created with maps submitted to Doom the Way id Did by the late Callum Guy Oliver (phobosdeimos1) and released posthumously.

title: Warped North
description: It was a small wonder when, after a mechanical malfunction, the transport ship moving you to an isolated research facility crashed, granting you your long-overdue freedom. But the new frigid land you've arrived in swarms with jabbering, malicious little creatures, and you can't help but sense you may have caught the attention of something sinister.

title: Passpartout: The One Man Band
description: Compose your own music and perform it in front of strangers on the street! Adhere to the feedback from your listeners and bewitch them with your catchy beats and melodies!

title: Bee Garden: The Lost Queen
description: Bee Garden: The Lost Queen is a time management game with cute characters and innovative dynamic visuals. Complete 40 story levels in 4 breath-taking environments with day and night missions and special rush levels! Try your skills in 4 special challenges and beat the high scores! Be the best and collect all of the 8 trophies.

title: 3D Dinosaur Hunter
description: This 2000 edition of Eyewitness Virtual Reality Dinosaur Hunter updates some of the information and makes some minor changes, like replacing Segnosaurus with Therizinosaurus. It also adds a second disc called 3D Dinoworld, in which you can freely explore six prehistoric environments and observe dinosaurs in their daily life.

title: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion
description:
Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion is a faithful restoration of the classic first-person shooter originally released in 2000 for the Nintendo 64, upgraded through Nightdive Studios’ proprietary KEX Engine for play on modern gaming devices with up to a 4K resolution at 120FPS.

It joins Nightdive Studios, Universal Games, and Digital Platforms’ popular Turok and Turok 2: Seeds of Evil remasters, capping off the trilogy. Turok 3 Shadow of Oblivion Remastered features upgraded gameplay, high-resolution textures, enhanced lighting and rendering, and support for console gamepads with platform-specific features.

Finish the hunt in this epic finale to the Turok Trilogy. Pick up immediately after the events of Turok 2: Seeds of Evil, with dual protagonists Joseph and Danielle Fireseed, of the Turok family tree, as they battle the titular antagonist Oblivion and its followers, the Flesh Eaters.

title: Cyberpunk 2077: 2.0 Update
description:
Cyberpunk 2077: Update 2.0 introduces a comprehensive, free overhaul of the game's core systems. Key changes include a redesigned cyberware system, where armor stats are now linked to equipped cyberware rather than clothing, allowing for greater customization and strategic trade-offs. The update also revamps the perk system, adding abilities such as bullet deflection, mid-air dashing, and new finishing moves, along with a new skill tree tied to the Relic chip in V’s body for enhanced abilities.

The update introduces a vehicular combat system, enabling players to engage enemies while driving, including shooting and hacking nearby vehicles. This addition is accompanied by changes to the game’s “wanted” system, with escalating responses from the NCPD, culminating in confrontations with the heavily armed MaxTac Psycho Squad.

Update 2.0 also adds over 100 new items, including weapons, clothing, cyberware, and vehicles, expanding the game’s customization and combat options.

title: Starfield: Shattered Space
description: This will be the first story expansion to Starfield. This DLC is bundled with Premium Edition (digital), Premium Edition Upgrade (digital), Premium Edition Upgrade (physical), and Constellation Edition of Starfield.

title: J-Jump Arena
description: A turn based, jumping elimination game where everything happens all at once! Learn to be precise with your jumps and weapon handling, as well as in the art of outsmarting your opponents! Multiplayer for up to 10 players and single player mode available.

title: DanMachi Battle Chronicle
description:
Experience the world of Danmachi in 3D with fully voiced dialogue! Relive the story of Danmachi in 3D together with your favorite characters brought to life via anime-style 3D graphics! You can also enjoy game-exclusive movies and scenes drawn at totally different angles from the anime!

Monsters await you in the Dungeon where you can make use of a variety of methods of attacking and evading in exhilarating battles with simple controls!
Perform your favorite deadly attacks, including Firebolt and Lil Rafaga, in spectacular fashion. Go adventuring with your favorite characters!

Take on other adventurers in Magic Stone Contests, free-for-all battles where everyone is an enemy! These are battle royales fought between 8 different players.
Gather more Magic Stones than anyone else to become number 1!

title: Hell's Eventide
description: Because of three different authors the theme and style differed greatly, but with a little refining the whole thing clicked. A hellish level with a few traps, tricks and unwanted welcomes...

title: Bytesize
description: 12 small maps, each limited to 100 linedefs.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou: Outbreak
description: A remade version of Outbreak that was initially included in the PC release of Hou, with improved graphics and full voice acting.

title: Warframe: The Seven Crimes of Kullervo
description:
Return to Duviri and delve into a sprawling new island dungeon where the tragic Warframe, Kullervo, awaits your redemption. This strange, floating prison obfuscates both Kullervo’s crimes as well as the mysterious (yet familiar) Warden who binds him under lock and key. Explore the prison’s cells to uncover the story of Kullervo’s misdeeds and wield the power of treachery through his trademark daggers and thirst for vengeance.

As a mainline update It contains an exhaustive list of quality of live changes to the game. The main new content is the 53rd Warframe, Kullervo, and his signature weapons along with the chance to encounter his story missions on a new island in Duviri.
Other Duviri changes include Captain Vor's appearance in Undercroft challenge missions for a chance at new arcanes, Kaithe customization with armor and ephemera, 2 new side missions with Paragrimm's Tomes and Lost Belongings objectives, the return of Kaithe races and 15 new decrees.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou: Hinamizawa Teiryuujo
description: A remade version of Outbreak that was initially included in the PC release of Hou, with improved graphics and full voice acting.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou: Kamikashimashi-hen
description: A remade version of Outbreak that was initially included in the PC release of Hou, with improved graphics and full voice acting.

title: The Discrete Era
description: An Action-Roguelike, multiplayer coop game.

title: Memory Fragment
description: Roid, the handyman of a small town, retrieves a photo album filled with memories from an old box in the shed. As he flips through the Polaroid photos, he takes a journey back in time to revisit the memories leading up to his journey of becoming a handyman.

title: Panda Choice Mahjong
description: The panda has made her choice! Follow her into the wonderful world of the most ancient game.

title: Fractal Glide
description: Experience the mesmerizing world of fractals as you glide through meticulously repeating landscapes. Immerse yourself in a tranquil journey, finding awe in the beauty of math. Embark on an adventure where the goal is exploration and the discovery of infinite art through the wonders of fractals.

title: Hard Hero
description: Heroes are doing many things to save the world. Fight with enemy, dirve vehicles and combine to robot. Player control the vehicles and combine each other during avoid enemy's attack. Player can feel how hard to saving world. Challenge to being hero.

title: I Made this Game in 3 Days
description: Embark on a buggy adventure in "I made this Game in 3 Days"! I'm not kidding when I say this roguelike masterpiece was birthed in just 72 hours. Dive headfirst into a realm of whimsical chaos, where every bug is a feature and every glitch is a delightful surprise.

title: Chimeras: Heavenfall Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: Astrid and Greta are the best of friends, but when she goes missing during the semester break at their magical school, Astrid needs your help as a detective to find her. As you dig deeper, you'll discover she's not the only student to vanish in these hallowed halls.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Daredevil Edition
description:
The Daredevil Edition of Guilty Gear -Strive- includes the base game, Season Pass 1, Season Pass 2, Season Pass 3, the Ultimate Edition Content Kit and the Guilty Gear 25th Anniversary: Special Additional Color Pack.

Season Pass 1 includes 5 characters, 2 stages, an exclusive story expansion and the Additional Character Color Pack which adds 5 color variations for all 20 characters announced with its release.

Season Pass 2 and 3 includes 4 characters, 2 stages and a Color Pack which unlocks 6 color variations for the 4 characters in the related pass. Season Pass 3 also has an exclusive Color Pack with 3 additional color variations for its characters that missed both 25th Anniversary Color Packs.

Ultimate Edition Contents Kit includes the Digital Soundtrack, Digital Artwork and the Ultimate Edition Special Colors which adds 1 color variant for all 20 characters available with Season Pass 1. A color variant in the Season Pass 2 and 3 Color Packs matches the Ultimate Edition color variation for their characters.

The Guilty Gear 25th Anniversary Special Additional Color Pack unlocks 2 color variations for the 24 characters available at the end of Season Pass 2.

title: Riders Republic: 360 Edition
description: With the Riders Republic 360 Edition, take your experience to the next level. Enjoy the skate and hoverboard for a unique freeriding experience across the Republic's vibrant open world. Build your legend with original sports (bike,* ski, snowboard, and wingsuit).

title: Riders Republic: Complete Edition
description: With the Riders Republic Complete Edition, face no restrictions and shred like there is no tomorrow! Enjoy the skateboard, BMX, and hoverboard for a unique urban riding experience through the Republic's vibrant open world. Build your legend with original sports (racing bike, mountain bike, ski, snowboard, and wingsuit).

title: Riders Republic: Skate Edition
description: Shred the Ridge like never before with Riders Republic Skate Edition. Hop on your board and ride across brand-new skate parks! The Skate Edition includes the base game and the Skate add-on.

title: Medieval Delivery
description: Because deliveries also existed in medieval times, this is a third-person simulation and adventure game where you'll have the task of making deliveries throughout the village according to the requests of its inhabitants, such as meat, flour, bread, and perhaps other things.

title: Meta Nanos: Rumble Race
description: Meta Nanos: Rumble Race is an exciting and action-packed game where your Nanos race against other Nanos for the top spots in the weekly leaderboards. Win awesome prices and show your opponents that your Nanos are just faster.

title: Warframe: Echoes of Duviri
description:
This update adds Wisp Prime along with her signature weapons Fulmin Prime and Gunsen Prime. These additions replace Nidus Prime, Strun Prime and Magnus Prime which have now been added to the Prime Vault.

Other additions include a new drifter melee weapon Argo & Viel, new Undercroft tiles with a Jackal assassination mission, 5 new Incarnon weapons, 4 new Warframe augment mods, 4 new Duviri decrees, and a Duviri dojo room that allows you to free roam on the Harbinger’s Pass and Courtier’s Bliss islands.

title: Warframe: Abyss of Dagath
description:
Abyss of Dagath adds the quest for the 54th Warframe, Dagath, in a new Naberus-inspired story from the Entrati Grandmother. Dagath’s appearance and kit bear some resemblance to a certain equine companion you may have met in Duviri — and comes with a brand-new blade and whip melee weapon.

This update has some big changes that aim to improve the broader gameplay experience, including a major overhaul of companions and a rework for the aquatic swashbuckler, Hydroid!
Other planned changes include Auto-melee, a focus acquisition rework and the removal of flawed mods and MK-1 Weapons.

More information about Dagath and the full update will be revealed in the September Devstream ahead of Abyss of Dagath's release this October!

title: Trip World DX
description:
Travel across four fantastic lands and Mount Dubious in Trip World DX! Our hero Yakopoo's adventure begins when the Maita flower, a symbol of world peace and happiness, is stolen, throwing Trip World into chaos!

Fly through the air, traverse over the land, and swim through the water, collecting special items to help you find the flower and restore Trip World.

Use Yakopoo's shapeshifting powers to save Trip World from darkness! Race across the ground as a ball. Grow a tail to hit enemies—or a flower to make your enemies friendly!

This new version collects the classic handheld adventure Trip World in its original form, as well as the brand new color version bringing all new life to the world of Yakopoo! Discover how the game was made and all new secrets in the museum mode including development documents and video interviews, or go listen to one of the greatest game soundtracks ever made in the music player!

title: Whitestone
description: On the 'Sunchaser's capstone voyage to the Arctic, it's smooth sailing until Jack's quarters are broken into and his friend goes missing. Unsure who to trust, Jack is forced to fight nightmares both mental and physical as he becomes the prime suspect for a terrible deed.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R - Leone Abbacchio
description:
Bucciarati's team is fully reunited in All-Star Battle R with the playable character addition of Leone Abbacchio and his detective stand, Moody Jazz. Make your opponents think twice and see double with Leone Abbacchio! Available Now!

Contents:
- Leone Abbacchio as a playable character
- Additional Leone Abbacchio JoJo Glossary, Model Viewer, Sound Test, and Art Viewer
- Additional Leone Abbacchio collection items at the in-game store

title: Masala Drive
description: Super high-occupancy over 1000%! How many passengers on the bus can you goal with? Many Masala sound BGM for driving.

title: Paper io 2
description:
Welcome to Paper.io 2, the ultimate conquest game from Voodoo! Conquer as much territory as possible and beat the competition with a smooth drawing experience!

Are you ready to become the champion of township and take over the game? With Paper.io 2, you can draw your way to victory and claim your space before your opponents beat you to it.

title: Paper io 2: Animals DLC
description:
Conquer new maps with your friends in animal skins!
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- 15 animal skins: cow, giraffe, hippo, duck, piggy, rhino, mouse, mammoth, rabbit, dog, snail, white whale, cobra, elephant, unicorn
- 6 hats: fur with ears, guitar, crocodile, police cap, crown, diadem
- 9 custom game maps in the form of a: duck, fish, cat, rabbit, whale, bird, butterfly, octopus, seahorse
- 10000 coins

Put on skins of cute animals, change the look of your territory and take over new custom maps!

title: Paper io 2: Mishmash DLC
description:
Conquer new maps with your friends in mishmash skins!
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- 13 diverse skins: bus, burger, donut, poop, toilet, ufo, robot, ninja, santa, crab, car, police car, airplane
- 5 hats: widget, "truck" cap, helmet with horns, apple with an arrow, witch hat
- 9 custom game maps in the form of a: car, boat, poop, sport bike, cruiser, scooter, headphones, teddy bear, crown
- 10000 coins

Put on funny mishmash skins, change the look of your territory and take over new custom maps!

title: Sonic Superstars: Digital Deluxe Edition featuring LEGO
description:
The SONIC SUPERSTARS Digital Deluxe Edition featuring LEGO contains SONIC SUPERSTARS and the Digital Deluxe Upgrade featuring LEGO, which includes:
-LEGO Fun Pack
-Sonic Rabbit Skin
-Mecha Sonic Skin for Battle Mode
-Bonus Main Menu Wallpapers​
-Digital Artbook & Mini Original Soundtrack

title: Hole io
description: Can you move the black hole to swallow the buildings into the hole like an attacking hole master? The clock is ticking, tik tok, tik tok, will you succeed to swallow?

title: Hole io: Animals DLC
description: Wear animal skins and visit new Farm map with your friends!

title: Hole io: Freaks DLC
description: Wear freaky skins and visit new SciFi map with your friends!

title: Hole io: Red Planet DLC
description: Wear crazy skins and visit new Mars map with your friends!

title: Warframe: Whispers in the Walls
description:
Coming to all platforms this winter, Whispers in the Walls will drop you into a hair-raising conflict rife with shocking revelations that will shake the Origin System to its very core.

In this new story-driven cinematic quest, you'll be caught in the middle of a deadly battle between Albrecht Entrati, one of the Origin System's most brilliant minds, and the unknowable Man in the Wall. The board is set and the pieces are moving. Can you put it all together in time, Tenno?

Naturally, you won’t be fighting unarmed, either. Hold fast against the dangers littered throughout Albrecht Entrati's secret laboratory with an all-new Secondary weapon class — the otherworldly Grimoire.

Whispers in the Walls will also introduce the Murmur, a brand-new faction created by the Man in the Wall, along with a reworked and expanded Necramech enemy faction. No matter how you do battle, the forces arrayed against you have never been more fearsome.

title: Warframe: 1999
description:
Warframe: 1999 is the time-bending follow-up due for release the following year and features a distinctive, licensed track by seminal industrial rock band Nine Inch Nails: “Into the Void.” In 2024, the Tenno will return to the past in order to understand their future, and reveal the motives behind Albrecht Entrati’s perplexing research. But everything is not as it seems…

The pieces of the puzzle are falling into place, Tenno. But it will be up to you to solve it.

title: Trapped In Here With Me
description: Trapped In Here With Me is a lightning fast arcade action game. Grind for the top score among your friends, or globally.

title: Rail Gunner
description:
Defend your train against the oncoming horde of AI controlled robots which run, fly, rocket and roll in pursuit.
Enemies are fully destructible and physically simulated (not animated) making for infinite variation in the carnage which you unleash.
Neural network control allows for a wide variety of enemies which attempt to maintain the chase even when their parts have been damaged and destroyed.
A variety of weapons and power-ups to unlock.
Game Center enabled with achievements to unlock and scores to share.

title: Knight Without Sword
description: A strategy and tactics game, you will play the role of an apprentice knight, use your wisdom to kill enemies without using any attack means, get gold coins, and reach the end point, in addition, don't forget to bring your chicken, it is your important partner !

title: Bocchi the Smash!
description: Bocchi the Smash! is a fan game of Bocchi the Rock! made by DCinside Bocchi the Rock Gallery.

title: Blue Sango
description: A 1997 Japan-exclusive point-and-click adventure for PC and Macintosh utilizing QuickTime VR. Originally thought lost media, it was fully archived in 2023.

title: Megami Ibunroku Persona Digital Collection
description: A collection of minigames during a festival set after the events of Megami Ibunroku Persona. The minigames include races, quizzes, fortune-telling, an art gallery, puzzles, karaoke, air hockey, a shuffle game, and a shooting gallery. With other features like a sound player, persona compendium, music videos with remixed songs, and dress-up.

title: Cygnus IV
description: 14 levels of hard-hitting Doom II action, with new graphics, sound and music, and some damned impressive scenery!

title: Flower in Us
description: Flower in Us is a short, story-driven mystery adventure that invites players to unravel hidden secrets.

title: Girls Frantic Clan
description: A visual novel where a teacher becomes trapped in a virtual game world and is forced to relive a deadly loop, returning to reality upon death while guiding his unpredictable students in battle to break the curse.

title: 9 to Die
description: Your offices main server has made all of the electronics blood thirsty and you have to go and reboot the server. You will have to go through walls and floors to get to it.

title: 3D Movie Maker
description: Microsoft's 3D Movie Maker allows you to create your own 3D movies. title: Emil Chronicle Online
description:
Emil Chronicle Online was a 3D Japanese fantasy MMORPG with anime-style graphics. Set in the land of Acronia, the game featured twelve classes spread among four races, each with a particular advantage (agility, magic, or strength). Along with a series of quests and battles, the game featured a few standout modes including its marionette system, where players could transform their characters into marionettes, which were Pokémon-like surrogates. Marionettes could live in the world even when players had logged out. There was also a standard pet system outside of this. Players could also turn their characters into weapons that other people could use, gaining both experience. PvP was in RvR format, and massive battles were scheduled regularly in advance for different level groups.

As of 2024, no servers for the game are online, with GungHo Online Entertainment announcing that the Japanese server would be shut down on August 31, 2017, citing the impossible task of keeping up with modern players’ demands.

Explore a dangerous, minimalist world, armed with simple two button controls: tap a button to change direction by 90 degrees, and hold down a button to unleash a cathartic dash forward. That’s all you need to solve environmental puzzles and labyrinthine levels. Around each corner is a new challenge that will test your two-button and problem-solving skills. A cerebral puzzler lies within the heart of this indie twist on Pong.

description: Turn-based RPG from the creator of Jimmy and the Pulsating Mass set on a brutal alien planet. Four unique main characters, four unforgettable stories, four inescapable calamities.

title: Shoot For Fun's Sake
description: A short solo shooter game where you shoot fixed sensors and sensor patrols without anything shooting back. Use tactical skills to destroy sensors without exceeding the detection limit.

title: Tiny Touring Cars
description: A fun arcade racing game in a low poly style. Choose from 3 cars and 9 tracks to race against your friends and the AI or try your hand at setting the fastest laps times on the Steam leaderboards.

title: Pixel Puzzles WW2 Jigsaw: Kriegsmarine
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Farm Garden Simulator
description: Farm Garden Simulator is a farm simulator game where you can grow a lot of crops and raise animals.

title: Alpine Lake
description: Kick back in the fresh mountain air and craft your ideal haven on the shores of Alpine Lake! Build, and decorate your inn to bring joy and prosperity to the community. Welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Farm, cook, and entertain them in your own unique way!

title: Pixel Puzzles WW2 Jigsaw: French Tanks
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Traitorous Trek
description: Welcome to Traitorous Trek ! Immerse yourself in a universe teeming with deception, betrayal, and nail-biting tension. As a member of an interstellar fleet, your mission is to unravel the hidden shadows lurking within, thwart the conspirators' plans, and safeguard the future of humanity.

title: On Life and Living
description: In "On Life and Living", beyond metroidvania-style exploration and challenging encounters, players will also experience an emotional story of love, grief, and consequences. You are in control, shaping the course of this journey towards regeneration.

title: Castle Empire
description: Unleash your strategic prowess

title: Ship Regulus
description: In the first year of the ephemeris, the warp engine was invented. Due to the initial engine being too large, it was installed on the space city Regulus. During engine testing, the jump signal attracted an alien fleet, and the Ship Regulus embarked on a flight path.

title: Car Mechanic: City Driving
description: Customize your own car and go on a serene ride through the city streets!

title: Eternal Vigil
description: Embark on an epic quest to defend the sacred crystal from relentless waves of monstrous invaders.Harness your unique combat skills, strategically deploy your powerful turrets and reach your full potential to push back the dark forces. Will you rise as the ultimate defender or succumb to the shadows?

title: Depthris
description: Depthris is a 3D puzzle game inspired by the classic BlockOut game for DOS. Move and rotate the pieces almost anywhere (except backwards) and aim for the highest score.

title: Humbug Tales: Keeper of the Swarm
description: Experience the world of bugs through the eyes of the humbug ant herder Eacus and his peculiar flock. Together you'll meet a quirky cast of tiny friends on a larger-than-life adventure. Explore lush wetlands and use your wits to outsmart predators and enemy humbugs. Your colony is depending on you!

title: Latmos Explorer
description: Discover the mysteries of Latmos with block coding. Learn about the cultural heritage and history of humanity while preparing for the future.

title: Block & Shot
description: Block & Shot will immerse you in the captivating world of logical puzzles, where you will have to control various weapons to overcome obstacles in your path and reach the main goal - the golden cartridge

title: Anvil of Tristheim
description: The first card-based blacksmith crafting game! Merge material cards into items - and turn your customers into dragon slayers or dragon food.

title: Ultramassive
description: Embark on a journey towards the center of the galaxy in Ultramassive, a roguelite deckbuilder! Craft a unique deck, fight hostile aliens, gamble your way out of stick situations and and find parts to upgrade your spaceship along the way.

title: Cosmos: Stella Returns
description: Cosmos: Stella Returns is a metroidvania that will bring you to the mysterious planet of Memoria. Shoot, jump, collect materials and new items in this action-platform with a vintage flavor!

title: The Left Behind
description: The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore an overgrown open world at day time and beware of enemies coming in at night. Salvage, hunt and build your way through this world to survive. How long will you survive?

title: Custom Mech Wars
description:
Take customization to the extreme with the Omega Customization System and battle with one-of-a-kind combat units in this all-new third-person shooter mecha game.

Not being restricted to bipedal builds, you can freely customize your mechs to include multiple heads, legs, and arms in whatever positions and angles you choose. Depending on the parts you use, the parameters will vary wildly, so you can build mechs with whatever abilities and fighting styles you wish!

Arm your custom mech to the teeth with every weapon imaginable and blast your way through oncoming enemies. Experience the heart-pounding mecha action that only your Omega Customized units can provide. Destroy enemy units, collect their parts, and customize your favorite mechs even more. Complete a variety of missions as you battle, customize, and then battle and customize some more!

This game supports online multiplayer. Up to four players can cooperate to complete story missions just like in single-player mode. Not only can you experience the rush of tackling missions with friends, but you can show off your favorite mechs you personally customized.

title: Garlic Builder
description: Garlic Builder is a unique building game. As the new builder of the Garlic Family, can you inherit your father's building hammer, take various orders, follow the blueprint, or use your imagination to fulfill the strange needs of your customers?

title: Cold Verdict 2
description: A direct sequel to 'Cold Verdict'. Another group of people wake up in a strange abandoned location, trying to find a way out and understand why they were put there. What is the killer's endgame in all this? A short interactive story with choices.

title: The Tale of Lumi
description: Master tight platforming sections, collect and upgrade Godly powerups, battle powerful enemies, solve intriguing puzzles and explore the riveting world of LUMI in this fast paced 2D action game

title: Shape Quiz
description: -Shape Quiz- is a knowledge game with guessing elements.

title: Soul of War: Legions
description: "SoulofWar" is a strategy deck-building game with twists. It features 8-player PvP battles where you strategically outplay your opponents. It introduces a fresh auto chess gameplay.

title: Let's Play! Oink Games: Kobayakawa
description: Simple...or is it? An easy to learn card game full of bluffing and bravery. The "Kobayakawa" card is the key to victory!

title: Parcel Packing Simulator
description: A Cozy parcel-packing game where you use your brains to Pack parcels in as small packages as possible! Pack random orders to train yourself and try to break high scores from the order list!

title: Bloody Heaven
description: In Bloody Heaven, players will challenge to use various of weapons with different features to beat enemy waves.

title: Nellie's Nonograms
description: A collection of nonograms made by friends and fans of the vtuber NellieAndGrits!

title: Backrooms: Run For Your Life!
description: This is a Backrooms game created by fans. In this game, the main experience is the "Level!" in Backroom(or "Run For Your Life").

title: Arcade Galaxy Builder
description: Welcome to Arcade Galaxy! Race with cube-animals on obstacle-filled tracks. Use skills like lightning strikes and super jumps to gain an edge. Customize your Cub's look and abilities for a unique racing. Create your own tracks with our advanced editor. Unleash your racing dreams in our galaxy!

title: Warzoom
description: Warzoom A Game Of Dynamic Strategy is a fantastic game that's easy to learn and loads of fun to play! It's a tit-for-tat with no two games ever alike. Non stop action from the beginning to the end. Prepare for battle!

title: Space Battle Royale
description: Calling all space pilots! Fight your way to the final showdown inside the mysterious Cube, unleashing havoc and leaving only the debris of the rival ships behind. Oh, did you find yourself left among the wreckage? Upgrade your attributes, modify your ship – and get back into the carnage!

title: Slime Volley
description: Step into the bouncy and exciting arcade game of Slime Volley! This isn't your typical volleyball game – it's an arcade sensation that takes the classic sport and gives it a bouncy, slimy twist. Prepare for a thrilling multiplayer showdown as you leap onto the court for some fast-paced action.

title: Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah
description: A fantasy interactive tale about the beast-man Hidu investigating murders in a port city.

title: Fomography
description: Fomography is a story-driven adventure photography game. Play as a boy exploring his entire lifetime to rediscover and chronicle his memories. What has been forgotten that only the photos can show? What hidden memories do even the photos refuse to share?

title: Pixel Puzzles WW2 Jigsaw: Italian Tanks
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Silent Paws: Hidden Valley
description: Embark on a tranquil journey through the mesmerizing landscapes of the Hidden Valley as you take on the role of a graceful fox in this enchanting walking simulator.
