description: Dominoes Colors It is a puzzle relaxing game where you need to mix colors when put each piece on board. The mix result is the next step to solve the puzzle. The piece with a chequered flag is the last piece, your last mix of colors needs to be equal of it.

title: Eldritch Exterminators
description: Face the Eldritch hordes. You are a possessed gun, feeding on the souls of the dead. Grow your power and challenge the Eldritch Gods for Dominion over the Void. Slay the Forgotten Ones and harness Unspeakables in this Bullet Heaven, and escape the ties that bind.

title: Fishman's Last Stand
description: Brace yourself for a fight ahead, as humans set their sights on your land. Their unwavering determination fuels their pursuit, and they'll stop at nothing to claim it. Stand your ground with unwavering resolve, knowing that your defense holds the key to safeguarding your territory

title: Killa
description: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

title: Test Lab Inc.
description: Customize your skills and rain hell upon the endless hordes of robots. Test Lab Inc. is a fast-paced game where you'll be constantly tweaking your abilities until you become the ultimate weapon of mass destruction and crush all the puny robots that dare cross your path.

title: The Elder Tales
description: Prepare for a challenging adventure in this oldschool 2D action-RPG. Experience the nostalgic charm of retro graphics combined with modern gameplay solutions. With low computer requirements, immerse yourself in an intriguing story and explore a world filled with endless activities.

title: The Fall of Elements
description: The Fall of Elements is an action-adventure game set in an ancient dungeon. You are chosen by the Elements to find an evil enemy. Solve puzzles, explore a vast dungeon, overcome obstacles in your way and fight forbidden magic.

title: The Hallway: Escape Room
description: “The Hallway - Escape Room” is a story-based single player puzzle adventure game that will take you on a mind-bending journey to uncover the mysteries of a long-forgotten civilization and their gods discovered during an expedition. Will you face them?

title: The Hangman
description: After weeks of relentless searching, the Detective finally uncovers a critical clue that leads to an isolated location, unveiling the fate of the Hangman's victims. Can you make a getaway with your findings before it's too late?

title: Tensei
description: Experience facing the mind along with the peaceful Zen landscape.

title: Sunset of Ate
description: An open world TPS science fiction game

title: Sun-Rise.exe
description: Adventure through bizarre and intricately made levels in this 2D platformer game.

title: Sunland Hike
description: Unveil the tranquility of nature in this captivating walking simulator. Immerse yourself in the picturesque landscapes of Sunland, where every step leads to a new discovery. Your ultimate goal? Find hidden gems scattered throughout the terrain, each more breathtaking than the last. ️

title: Stimmings
description: Stimmings is a rogue like and real time strategy experience where units must be coerced into performing activities to snowball your colony into a winning state.

title: Stick Slasher
description: Stick Slasher is an epic 2D fighting game where you combat relentless waves of adversaries armed with shields, swords, or guns. Confront a range of enemy types, secure the highest scores, and ascend to the title of the ultimate warrior!

title: Simple Snooker
description: This is a two-player Snooker game, that runs on computer desktop or virtual reality device.

title: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
description: You are the CEO of a private military company. Recruit capable mercenaries, purchase weapons, and develop your mercenaries according to their roles and characteristics. Observe how your mercenaries perform in combat and plan your tactics to ensure mission success.

title: Stab!
description: STAB! is a competitive 2–4 player card game where the only rule that matters is simple: trust no one. Build temporary alliances and betray them at the exact moment it hurts the most! In this game, loyalty is an illusion and survival depends on how well you can deceive everyone at the table.

title: StanÇact: Sexy Tenacious Girls
description: 『StanÇact』is a cute and sexy girl-on-girl Shoot'em up. Mai, a military officer, is on her way to quell a riot, but the rioters and the military have teamed up and are on the rampage and the head of the military was the ringleader.Witness one woman's struggle to complete her mission amidst the chaos!

title: Snaky Survivor
description: Navigate the stark world of Snaky Survivor, an arcade game that pits you against starvation and challenges your survival instincts. Guide a snake-like character as it gathers soul fragments to stave off hunger, weaving through hazardous obstacles in a race against time.

title: Sneaky Peeky
description: Time for being stealthy! Dive into the shadows of Sneaky Peeky and experience real multiplayer stealth action. Use the environment to conceal your presence and avoid getting caught. Find ways to disrupt enemy team. Discuss your strategy and be sneaky!

title: Son of Perun Kharkiv
description: Son of Perun: Kharkiv is a first-person shooter in the setting of Kharkiv of the future and retrowawe.

title: Sorrow Asylum 2
description: Sorrow Asylum 2 is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison, as well as a sequel to Sorrow Asylum.

title: Space Dogo
description: Space Dogo is a platform/adventure game. Moro is an old trained dog searching across the galaxy for her owner who has been kidnapped after some enemy attack to the Human Colony.

title: Spectator 2
description: Welcome to the world of Spectator 2 – the sequel to the gripping horror game Spectator! Brace yourself for new levels of atmospheric terror and captivating surveillance, you'll face even more chilling events and dangers as you carefully monitor cameras and report any suspicious occurrences.

title: Race Manager
description: Become a race manager

title: Rescue Team: Mineral of Miracles
description: The extraordinary discovery of a mineral named "Immortalite" has sent shockwaves across the globe. Now you are tasked with uncovering the secrets of this powerful mineral and ensuring it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

title: Sexy Ladies
description: Sexy Ladies is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Seybul Tech
description: Seybul Tech is a walking simulator. Navigate as an office employee, confronting peculiar encounters while in search of an exit from this enigmatic abyss.

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 5
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki at the office getting cornered by her asshole of a Boss, then seduced into a wild quickie while her husband is on the other side of a glass wall.

title: Sex Play: The Sauna
description: A quick and dirty game made especially for your pleasure. Contains visual novel elements and a sex simulation part. You play the role of a man who goes to the sauna and receives a special treatment.

title: SCP-479: Shadows of the Mind
description: You are a Class D personnel on an experimental mission for the Foundation to investigate SCP-479. The facility is linked to anomalies affecting the human psyche, gradually driving them insane. Please remember to take your pills.

title: Ronshade
description: "Ronshade" is a turn-based roguelike game. Players collect items and challenge the depths. The turn system displays action results, with intuitive and quick controls. Over 100 unique items greatly influence combat outcomes.

title: Scarred
description: Scarred is a first-person atmospheric horror puzzle game where you must uncover the truth about one of your schoolmates before it’s too late. Traverse a world of nightmares inspired by nostalgic Singaporean architecture as you fight to survive.

title: Dough: A Crime Strategy RPG
description: Money, power, women, status... in the Prohibition, the world of crime is prospering. A Strategy RPG game where you start from the bottom and try to conquer the whole city, it would've been so easy too if you didn't have to fight pesky policemen, greedy politicians and ruthless competition.

title: Playroom Invasion TD
description: Playroom Invasion TD invites you to an exciting tower defense adventure set in a nursery filled with toy characters and towers. Take part in fun and tactical battles against evil toys trying to take over your room which is full of towers with different features.

title: Penguru
description: Penguru is a hack and slash game where you play as an angry Penguen. Choose your weapon from various options. Shoot, blow, cut and rip your way through waves of enemise. Reload and rest at the belly of a whale. As long as you present a Guru Level of Shooting you are welcomed at Penguru universe.

title: Nounishpunk
description: Nounishpunk is an exhilarating, fast-paced third-person comedy action-adventure shooter set in an open world, boasting a captivating fantasy futurism art style.

title: No Logic
description: No Logic is a puzzle platform game where you have to disable your logic in order to complete this game!

title: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree
description: Discover a once-thriving ocean, now tainted by enigmatic dark forces. Your quest: decipher the mystery and rekindle the ocean's radiant light.

title: Monstronomy
description: Monstronomy is a dark take on the timeless monster collecting genre. As you explore a cute world filled with quirky monsters and odd NPCs, a deep and sinister story unfolds with the discovery of found-films and unsettling glitches. This game is not suitable for individuals who are easily disturbed.

title: Deleted
description: Take control of a powerful drone and prepare to face off against hordes of enemies standing in your way. Collect currency and upgrade your drone with new weapons and skills. Are you ready for the ultimate challenge?

title: DJ Clicker: World Tour
description: This is a DJ's journey into light and sound. With the power at your fingertips to realise your dream. You can become a star.

title: HotDog TD
description: This is an awesome Tower Defense game that you need to protect the world from Alien 's invasion.

title: Gold Rush Clicker
description: Dive into "Gold Rush Clicker," an idle clicker game where you start as a novice miner. Tap to mine gold, buy upgrades, and face strategic challenges. With procedurally generated levels, stunning graphics, and Steam achievements, it's an endless journey to become the ultimate mining tycoon!

title: Polymino
description: A fast-paced puzzle game for 1-4 players. Match blocks by color, build up combos and cause huge amounts of destruction!

title: Memory Patches
description: A visual short novel about a girl who wakes up in an empty apartment and tries to figure out what happened. In front of her are four boxes filled with different items from her past. Touching them, she recalls pieces of memories, but one of the items is cursed.

title: DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create
description: Fight your friends as a cyberpunk robot ninja mercenary in DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create, the remake of the original DeltaBlade 2700. It’s the same high energy, competitive local multiplayer brawler with fast paced sword combat and jetpacks you love, but with tons more features!

title: Mooselutions
description: Explore a puzzling forest full of cute (but pesky) moose who anger easily.

title: Floating Life Record
description: I found myself in a strange place filled with dangerous monsters, You must find a way to escape here and return to the real world, but before that, you need to collect materials, food, and weapons to ensure that you can survive here.

description: Smash monsters, collect brains, and so much more as you attempt to stop Dr. Lunatic's evil scheme. 1,200 levels and hundreds of hidden bonuses in Bouapha's greatest adventure! Now enhanced for Steam!

title: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
description: A dark fantasy JRPG. The imperial princess Chrysoberyl must fight the Bloody Emperor who has usurped the throne. However, her army is small and her allies are conniving. It is a bloody war where she will have to choose between peace and lives...

title: Pea Pod Power
description: Explore a colorful garden world in this unique 3D platformer! An evil alien fungus has invaded the planet and seized control of its crops... use your epic Pea Pod Powers to defeat the fungus and recover the sacred seeds before it’s too late!

title: Night Poetry
description: Night Poetry is a rogue-lite, story-driven, RPG game, where your choices matter! Survive in your own manner and witness the game's response to your actions, whether it's fighting your way out or coming up with something to bewilder your enemies, as you explore this mysterious world...

title: Fishing Echoes
description: Step into the cozy realms of Fishing Echoes, a game that beckons you to shorelines filled with rare fish and whispered legends. Ready yourself for the ultimate angling challenge as you embark on a journey to mastery.

title: Brownie's Adventure
description: A fantasy point and click adventure in traditional 1990s style. Dark humour, player choices that have impact on your outcome and hours of daft shenanigans.

title: Ghost Hand
description: Ghost Hand is a game focused on combat and exploration, which follows the story of its protagonist, Iria with a non-linear progression. Iria is a young wizard apprentice who lives on the moon. Iria is on the hunt for her father, a long-lost powerful mage, while encountering all sorts of enemies.

title: Cats Spotter
description: Welcome to "Cats Spotter"! This is a light-hearted and enjoyable casual game where your mission is to find all the hidden cats on a colorful and vibrant Meow Planet.

title: Gridlock Gladiators
description: A real-time fast paced fighting game with deck building. Create your own unique characters, fight to collect new abilities and armor, and perform flashy combos to smash your opponent out of the ring in grid based combat!

title: Culinary Survivors
description: Food has revolted! Never-ending hordes of ingredients are after you. Fend them off in this casual, action game with a variety of decision making rogue-lite elements that influence your character build against the food army.

title: Chinese Pope Door
description: This is a role-playing game where the player can fight freely with the enemies. You can run and jump freely, use sword and dart to attack the enemies, and special attack to give the enemies a heavy blow. If you like Super Mario's style of operation, you must try this game.

description: Welcome to Stories One: an exciting pre-alpha game blending FPS and MOBA genres. Embark on thrilling 5v5 battles in a 90's retro-futuristic city. Strategically build your deck, level up, and conquer your foes. Join the Stories One arena today!

Adapt to the ever-changing environment, collect power-ups and weapons, and rise to the top of the leaderboard in this thrilling aerial showdown.

title: Island Master
description: Build, manage, and thrive in Island Master! Procedural islands, resource control, citizen happiness. Become the ultimate Island Master in this top-down city builder.

title: Priscillas Dream
description: In this Top-Down RPG game, players find themselves stranded in a vast and unforgiving desert, facing challenges and obstacles at every turn. The game begins with the player character waking up in the middle of the desert, surrounded by a small group of survivors who are also struggling to survive.

title: Potions & Emotions
description: Potions and Emotions is a creative game where you play the conscience of the villain. Join Thalia—a fae with big ambitions—who intends to take over a town hidden in a magical forest. Whether her shoulder angel or devil, you get to guide her actions and witness the consequences of your choices.

title: Persevera
description: Intoxicated by the philosophy of absurdity of Albert Camus, you wake up malnourished in a torn medical scrub with a suitcase handcuffed to your left arm and thousand open questions. In your pursuit of truth and answers, you encounter various daring quests, technical riddles and hazardous chases.

title: Ashes of Arcanum
description: This is a simple engine created based on the TTRPG Ashes of Arcanum.

title: Inhibit
description: "Inhibit" is an exhilarating and highly challenging speed run platform game that will put your reflexes to the ultimate test. Each level is more demanding than the previous one, and the slightest mistake will determine the difference between victory and defeat.

title: Ghost Member
description: 【Ghost Member】is a single-player ghost investigation horror adventure game. You investigate ghosts in a house where a member of the occult research club who went missing was investigating. The story progresses by using multiple items to find traces left by the ghost and identify the type of ghost.

title: Mutation Madness
description: Mutation Madness invites you to a thrilling virus-blasting challenge! Armed with your disinfectant gun, defeat waves of mutating viruses and save Cell City from the Madvirus outbreak! Upgrade your gun and use powerful items, while unraveling information about the virus.

title: Charon's Crossing
description: A mythological arcade-style game where you navigate Charon through the rivers of the Underworld. Dodge obstacles, confront adversaries, and strategize with Hermes' power-ups. Delve into a pixel-art world inspired by ancient legends.

title: Golel
description: Golel, a first person roguelike Dungeon Crawler.Combat is focused on mobility and using the environment to your advantage.Dropping book shelves on an enemy, or kicking an enemy into a trap are all valid tactics.Deep skill/magic and combat gameplay, with many development paths.

title: Ghost Vanguard
description: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness!

description: Resourceful by day, fierce by night; young Ember must survive and redeem the nightmare forest.

description: At Winter's End is a cozy narrative dice-rolling RPG about 12-year-old Noel growing up in the forest of spirits. Explore the forest and complete quests while rolling dice to see how Noel responds to the challenges they face.

description: Mamma mia! Our cats are now in the great city of Rome! Let's find them! Start with a monochromatic illustration and reveal the final colored art. Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels! More than 970 hidden objects to find! Enjoy the extra bonus level, NERD ARENA!

title: Dreams of a Geisha
description: Journey through the wonderful world of Geisha. Help Ichisumi to reopen the temples and restore a world of beauty and passion.

title: Circular Logic Games
description: Chess, checkers, hexagon, other board games on round board, network or offline.

description: Noga is a single-player shooter/driver, RPG, where an alien invasion of Earth has just begun. As you try to save your friend from the hands of the aliens, you uncover the real reason that brought them to Earth.

description: Obesity Simulator boils down to "eating smart", you are at the mercy of your own choices ....... and maybe also the food flying straight at you. Eat to survive, but be wary of what and how much you eat.

description: Embark on an epic medieval adventure in this fast-paced endless runner. As a valiant knight, leap across perilous towers, skillfully shoot down enemies with your trusty bow, and protect your kingdom while racing against the relentless passage of time.

title: Electron Flux
description: A circuit-themed tower defense game: Build circuits that can survive the onslaught of electrical bugs. Discover new enemies, research new and upgraded towers, and protect increasingly complex circuit paths.

title: Beaten Path
description: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

title: Courier 79
description: Drive across towns and countries and become the elite courier, a courier who delivers cargo in perfect condition ranging from food all the way to contrabands. In this Rogue-like experience you will be forced to show your endurance, skill and speed in order to succeed.

description: Your main goal is to defend the castle, because the enemies will stop at nothing. Do not let them break through the defense, as their ambition is to capture your fortress and gain power over your kingdom.

description: How many secrets and dangers lie in the vast expanses of the oceans and seas! In just one look at the immense waves, a spark of a thirst for adventure, a desire for wealth and fame is hidden in the very soul of every Viking.

description: Dominant Witches is a visual interactive story for adults, where the player will study in a magical institution and will perform sexual fetishes with beautiful witches, attractive kitsune, cute vampires and pretty kitsune who live in a castle among the woods.

description: Dive into VR missions at Naturpark Lillebælt. Plant eelgrass, catch fish, clean trash, and learn about biodiversity. Restore the ocean's balance in this educational adventure!

title: Go for a Punch! Saki Sanobashi
description: Four students find themselves trapped in the restroom of an abandoned school; the door is locked, and there's no way out except to cling to hope or face death.

description: Ride between mammoths and saber-toothed tigers and survive in the Stone Age.

description: This game teaches patience, balance and precise movement. Your objective is to try to tilt the playing field up, down, left and right to guide the marble to the end of the maze without letting it fall into any of the holes. The closer you get to the finish, the higher your score becomes.

title: Elemental Escape
description: Bullet hell, but kill the bullets instead of dodging them!

title: Dysmantle: Pets & Dungeons
description: Befriend a pet, and together solve the numerous dungeons to discover the secret behind the island. There's a furry friend for everyone!

title: Long Story Short
description: Long Story Short is a funny and erotic adult game about a young man who finally decides to explore life beyond his computer screen. Follow him as he retells his experiences to a mysterious girl. Choose what kind of sexual person he will become. A new world of sexual debauchery awaits you.

title: OA Family
description: OA Family, a game with learning and relaxation. The main system of the game is to bring the popular English vocabulary game Hangman to do in a player-friendly format with a helper.

title: Laruaville 3
description: Summer, Winter, Spring and Autumn aren't functioning properly, so you have to use your Match3 skills to get it fixed. Build a town to recreate rain,snow,clouds and more.

title: Guidelicious
description: A short, interactive visual novel about waking up in a strange room with a mysterious man. But why are you here? Let Him be your Guide to the truth.

description: Now you can visit Ellis Island. You have to survive on the small bridges there. If you succeed in surviving until the final stage, you may face much more stronger walker. Guess who?

title: Ducks Can Drive: Penguins Can Too
description: After the ducks taught the penguins how to drive, they are now comfortable enough to face the ducks in racing! With this DLC you will be able to drive as a penguin on top of your standard duck choices. Who will win, Ducks or Penguins? Penguins Can Drive Too!

title: Dark Lovers: Extended Edition
description: Dark Lovers is a short pixel art teenage romantic mistery visual novel game about a highschool prom night in 1979 which contains multiple endings and secrets.

description: Are you ready to experience the thrill of cycling on snowy mountain peaks? Mountain Bicycle Rider Simulator invites you to an unforgettable adventure with realistic graphics. Now explore and pedal to the top!

description: Dive into software development, face an irksome boss, rake in cash, chug energy drinks, and remember—no rage quitting allowed! Welcome to the untamed world of corporate code crafting.

description: Help Mimi and her friends move, climb, or carry boxes to reach their beds and rest. Alone or in multiplayer, unlocking adorable new cats and being able to play with them in this challenging sokoban-like game!

description: Immerse yourself in a chilling, X-Files-inspired horror game where you monitor live surveillance cameras, spotting and addressing anomalies. description: Embark on a demonic fishing adventure in My Little Blood Cult! Combine skill with luck to master a unique fishing mechanic and collect demons, creatures, and more to fill out your oddities cabinet and become the most powerful cult.

description: Parkside is an FPS-Immersive Sim that chronicles the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering. Shoot, hack, and either save or sour the future of humanity in the dismally attractive and dystopian city of Abbotsford, California in the awful year of 2038. Will you serve the Divine Rod?

description: Return to Dave's school in this brand new version of Dave's Fun Algebra Class! Solve math problems, meet Dave's friends, and uncover the secrets of Dave's school.

Elements for beginners are also substantial. Let's grab the victory with flashy magic using the "Possibility Gauge"!

description: A place where wishes come true! You just need to protect the obsidian portal from zombies. Mine resources with your pickaxe, build traps, and put them to use — let them grind the zombies into a juicy green porridge! Funny meme endings!

title: Dadoo: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs
description: Dadoo: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is an online multiplayer snake and ladder game with superpowers and lots of mischief! Change the course of the game with various skill cards. Push your enemy to their demise. Really, don't be nice while playing this game.

description: Prepare for the climactic finale as Montenegro returns for one last mission. Use your stealth skills to rescue your beloved daughter, Merche, and unravel the trilogy's thrilling conclusion amidst intense action and suspenseful gameplay!

description: The protagonist, trapped in the succubus's dream, cannot wake up. The only way to escape is to navigate through the traps set within the dream and find the exit. If you fall into a trap, you must start over to escape. Escape from the dream and make your getaway.

description: Many revelations will be realized as Roxanne's year the the crew comes to an end in the finale of this episodic trilogy.

title: The Case of the Golden Idol: Complete Edition
description:
Additional content included:
- The Lemurian Vampire
- The Spider of Lanka
- Soundtrack

description: Race as a cop, take down criminals in this thrilling low-poly game. Fast action, challenging obstacles. Join the chase!

description: A chaotic educational game set in ancient Greece!Become the fictional philosopher Epistemonos and defeat the scholars who stand in your way!Drag blocks to merge them and defeat the enemies.Immerse yourself in a topsy-turvy story set in ancient Greece, with a focus on the Acropolis.

description:
Fall from a ledge, collect the coins below, then undo back to where you fell from, with the coins in your pocket! An old-school puzzle platformer in which you explore rooms, avoid perils and collect all coins to progress. Missed some coins? Fall, collect, undo! Falling into some spikes? Undo!!

Test your forward thinking and logical skills. Plan your falls carefully, as your undos are limited. If you're not paying attention, you'll find yourself unable to restore back to the top, with coins still needing collecting!

Enjoy the retro aesthetics with monochrome pixel art, playing the game on the state of the art handheld GrimBoy (TM) (wink). Reminisce about the good times with lovely pixel art backgrounds to put you right back into your childhood bedroom, the backyard, the park, grandma's living and many more.

description: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Frontiers Adaptation Project is a mod project that aims to adapt the Sonic Frontiers open-zone formula into Sonic Robo Blast 2.

description: It's the night of Halloween and three young girls are about to experience their spookiest night ever thanks to a magical friend way too willing to give them a thrilling night.

description: Generic Brazilian Favela Game with Generic Enemies 2003 is a "very buggy" game developed by Joeveno, where you're Sledge MoreNeo, and you're wandering around a Generic Brazilian Favela because you suddenly appeared there. Heavily inspired by Max Payne, the game has bullet time, an old-school third-person camera, classic 2000s lock aiming, Matrix-styled hand-to-hand combat, rail grinding, and more. It also has a motorcycle.

title: Nights: Moonlight Dreams...
description: Nights: Moonlight Dreams... is a fan game of Nights into Dreams, developed by Marco Medina.

description: Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Tetris is a fan game where, after causing a dimensional rift and giving rise to an evil double of himself, the Badniks hold an enigmatic "Mean Bean Tetris" contest. Only the original Dr. Robotnik, with his cunning and skills, will be able to prove that he is the real one.

description:
Sonic and his friends found out about the Cyberspace and its inhabitants, and Robotnik is using this world to create his empire, now everyone has to try to save the Cyberspace with the power of the Cyber Emeralds.

Project 32X is a fan game that attempts to revive the original Sonic Mars/Sonic 32X project.

description: You don't see many cars like this around! Especially when they whiz past you at full speed! Bye Focal II will take you to victory in the blink of an eye! So get ready to say “Bye Bye” to your opponents and “Hello” to the finish line!

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed: Mattel Dream Mobile
description: Its futuristic design is a piece of history: Mattel Dream Mobile was the first toy car created by Mattel. This stunning bubble-topped convertible looks ready to take off and fill the future of your opponents with broken dreams!

description: Put yourself in the shoes (or more likely beach sandals) of Vert Wheeler and hop in this fabulous masterpiece from Highway 35 World Race. Ride the wave of success with the legendary Deora II with Wave Rippers livery.

title: Entities
description: We combined fast-paced roguelike combat with a randomized procedural format to make the best third-person single player we could. Entidades is a survival game, which tells the story of a very mischievous boy, who lived in colonial Brazil, suffered from religious abuse and slavery at the time.

title: Destiny of Immortal
description: Fate of Creation "is a meat pigeon, cultivation of immortals, and storyline game. You accidentally obtained one of the most precious treasures of creation and embarked on the path of cultivating immortals.

title: Futanari Girlfriends
description: Futanari girlfriends is a classic puzzle game with addictive mechanics and beautiful sexy girls. Solve puzzles to bring scenes and unlock levels.

title: Gedonia 2
description: Gedonia 2 is an online coop RPG, which allows up to 4 players to freely explore living open world and build absolutely unique characters. An expanded and improved sequel for RPG Gedonia.

title: Haddie's Pizzeria
description: Extremely realistic cooking simulator. The player has to work in an apartment in modern design, solving different tasks such as cooking pizzas via real-life recipes, meanwhile rethinking life’s transience, the futility of pleasure, and the inevitability of death.

title: Cats Hidden in Maple Hollow
description: Find 100 cats hiding in the cozy autumnal town of Maple Hollow in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game.

title: Angelstruck
description: Angelstruck is a 2D roguelite shooter where you demolish the forces of Heaven as you attempt to reach the pearly gates. Overcharge your holy rifle, and min-max your way into insane game-breaking builds. Unlock permanent capabilities and powerful screen-destroying weapons that feed on kills.

title: Sect-Machina
description: Sect-Machina is a fluid, atmospheric bug-themed metroidvania rendered in a vibrant 2D pixelated style, crafted with meticulous attention to detail in its combat, characters, environments, sound, and story.

title: Project: Sword Art
description: Project: Sword Art is a visually stunning, engaging and addictive match-3 game that combines spectacular anime-style artwork, addictive gameplay and an exciting fantasy world. Embark on this magical adventure, defeat seductive girls and amass the largest collection in your gallery.

title: OverRoot
description: A Sci-fi Action Side Scroller, where you control Root, a sophisticated malware created to bypass the defences of malfunctioning computer systems. Use each ability at your disposal to erase everything in your path, in this experience focused on challenging and fast paced combat.

title: New Arc Line
description: Take a stand in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution and tip the uneasy balance between sorcery, elves, dwarves and mysterious monsters on one side and steampunk gadgets, zeppelins, and tesla guns on the other in this single-player, party-based, story-rich RPG.

title: Memoriapolis
description: Memoriapolis is a historical city builder where your city grows organically across 5 ages, from Antiquity to the Industrial Revolution. Manage resources, interact with factions, and shape your dynasty toward building a final Wonder with easy, normal, or hard difficulty levels.

title: LoneStar
description:
LoneStar is a strategic Roguelike spaceship combat game. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain bounty rewards and vacations. Find the treasures, customize your spaceship, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you!

title: The Hunter's Journals: Return to Wight Chapel
description: The Crawling Horror is dead, but its legacy of madness lives on!

title: Shipping Manager
description: Create and manage your own shipping empire. Control every aspect from route creation to marketing to staff handling and beat other managers to top the leaderboards.

title: X-Plane 12: FSDesigns - Alliance Municipal Airport
description: Welcome to Alliance! Alliance Municipal Airport, just about 3 miles southeast of the town of Alliance is statistically known as the least used airport in mainland USA. It offers scheduled passenger flights from, and to Denver with Denver Air Connection on the Fairchild Metroliner

title: X-Plane 12: FSDesigns - Jacksonville International Airport
description: Jacksonville International Airport is a civil and military airport that serves as the primary gateway to Northeast Florida, being one of the busiest in the state. The airport was built in the mid-1960s to replace Imeson Field as Jacksonville’s main airport.

title: X-Plane 12: FSDesigns - Pensacola International Airport
description: Pensacola International Airport is a public use airport 3 nautical miles northeast of the central business district of Pensacola in Escambia County, Florida, United States.

title: Sailing Era: Edge of the World
description: In Sailing Era's DLC, World's End, you will be setting sail on a new adventure from Northern Europe! Raise your sails, fill your cargo hold, and crush the Hanseatic League's monopoly to expand your own trade route!

title: Nurtopu
description: It is a rabbit game for collecting 2d diamonds. 2d hyper casual platform game.

title: Bowave
description: An addictive game in which the player takes on the role of an elite archer who is tasked with protecting the tower from the onslaught of enemies.

title: Lost Puzzle: City
description: Lost Puzzle: City is a 3D puzzle game in which you will have to place some items from the list where they belong. Look for clues in the environment, scrutinize every street and don't forget: it's not as easy as it seems at first sight!

title: Lost in Fantasy
description: Lost in fantasy - 2D platformer with RPG elements. You will go through different levels as you progress through the story of the game! Create your character, equip it with the necessary weapons and go to battle! Go to a wonderful world, explore it, and most importantly, beware of dangerous enemies!

title: Slum Musketeer
description: The game is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements. Go through many levels, find out what happened to the teacher. Overcome various traps, fight enemies with swords, and also destroy bosses! Find a way to bring it back!

title: Room Cleaning
description: Room cleaning - addictive game to help you relax. You are only hiring and offering a solution for cleaning dirt, stains and waste disposal and offer it in perfect order! use all available items that can be used in your task!

title: Task Control
description: Task control is a 2D platformer with action elements. You have to play as a special agent and destroy enemies on the level, moving around the locations. Your goal: Destroy the maximum number of enemies and complete the level. First aid kits and grenades will always come to your aid!

title: Possibly Endless Golf
description: Embark on a cozy golfing journey with Possibly Endless Golf. Enjoy this minimalist game in bite-sized chunks or endless rounds. No pressure, no scores, just you and the fairways. Perfect for a quick escape or a relaxing retreat. Your tranquil golfing experience awaits. Tee off today!

title: Skibidi Toilet Skibidi Boom
description: Get ready for a hilariously outrageous multiplayer FPS experience that combines the meme world of the Skibidi toilet with intense action-packed battles! In "Skibidi Toilet Skibidi Boom" you'll dive headfirst into a quirky universe where two bizarre factions clash for supremacy: the eccentric Cameraheads and the wacky Skibidi Toilets.

title: Just Fighting
description: Just Fighting is an exhilarating survival game that plunges players into a post-apocalyptic world infested with hordes of bloodthirsty zombies. Developed for adrenaline junkies and strategic thinkers, this game offers a unique and immersive experience like no other.

title: Tobi D+Vine
description: Shmup spinoff of D+Vine[Luv].

title: 4D:XD
description: 4D:XD is a top-down 2D bullet hell space shooter. Conquer the game with as few deaths as possible!

title: Karting Superstars
description: Karting Superstars is a charming racing game that captures the exciting and competitive world of karting. Inspired to condense the thrill and beauty of racing, we've dedicated our love, time, and craft into this new game that builds on the celebrated simcade taste of Circuit Superstars.

title: BrazSonic 20XX
description: BrazSonic 20XX is a reboot of the BrazSonic series set in 20XX's Brazil, where the congressman Dr. Corruptnik, who dreams of being President of the country, seeks the Corruption Emeralds to make it true. However, his ambition implies chaos and destruction to the lands and citizens. Then the hero BrazSonic will come into the scene to stop him!

title: The Hardest Game Ever
description: The Hardest Game Ever is a precision 2D platformer. As the name suggests, it's a very difficult game, so difficult that the developer has created a challenge to pay the first person to beat the game.

title: Ivaxion
description: Ivaxion is a turn based tactics RPG focused heavily on its strategic gameplay with no luck based elements.

title: F-Zero Pocket
description: Select one of the 30 most skillful drivers of all time and boost your way to the top in F-Zero Pocket, a racing fan game made as a tribute to both the GameBoy Color and the F-Zero series.

title: FNaF World: Outplay
description: FNaF World: Outplay is a Five Nights at Freddy's fan game about to recreate the FNaF World from an RPG format to a Sonic-like platformer format with fast-paced gameplay.

title: Bub's Big Blowout!
description:
Bub and his friends seem to have found themselves lost in a strange new world! Everything is so familiar, yet so different! Will you be able to help Bub and his friends find their way home?

Welcome to "Bub's Big Blowout!", A 3D reimagining of the Bubble Bobble arcade game! Here you can jump, blow bubbles, and burst baddies as bub or one of his 3 friends! Collect fruit, Extend Bubbles, and other collectibles for the best possible score!

title: Choujin Sentai Jetman
description:
Two years have passed since the Jetman triumphed over the evil Vyram faction and saved the Earth. Humanity has flourished again, but peace is fragile, however, one night that peace was destroyed. A remnant of Vyram, hidden in the darkest corners of the universe, has returned to Earth. Renegades and resentful, this group has developed powerful mechanical giants that are wreaking havoc on humanity. They have issued a chilling ultimatum: if the sun goes down, the giants will devastate the world and there will be no hope.​

Faced with this desperate situation, the Choujin Sentai Jetman are forced to meet again to face the greatest threat they have ever known.

title: Space Quest: Incinerations
description: Space Quest: Incineration is a 2012 fan-made sequel to the Space Quest series, created by Chris Ushko. It had been previously started in 1999 as a team project, cancelled, and then revived again as an almost completely different game. Information for both versions of the game are kept on this page.

title: Cave Story: The Desolate
description: Cave Story: The Desolate is a fangame based off of the Cave Story Beta.

title: Super Mario Bros. Star Scramble DX
description: Super Mario Bros. Star Scramble DX is a fan-made remake of the flash game Super Mario Bros. Star Scramble.

title: Sonic Encore
description: Sonic Encore is a fan game that re-imagines some of the classic levels from the Sonic 2D era into a more modern 3D environmental setting.

title: Acceleration of Suguri: Y-Edition
description: Acceleration of Suguri Y-Edition is a fan-made remake of Acceleration of SUGURI. The speed has been cranked up, gameplay and visuals have been polished, along with a more balanced cast and rollback netcode!

title: Supra Smash Bross Devolution
description: Supra Smash Bross Devolution is a satirical take on the Smash Bros. series, with hilariously terrible graphics yet surprisingly deep gameplay.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed: AcceleRacers Bassline
description: Make some noise for Bassline! Its huge rear speakers and subwoofers will spread the perfect soundtrack… for your tracks! And whoever tries to stop you, will have to face the music!

title: Chital's Mini Adventure
description: Small Indie Platformer that started a Game Jam entry in 2022, now polished a little and released! A Single-Level game where you must collect Jewels and defeat a Boss!

title: Girl Travels Forest of Dream
description: Let's start the journey with the girl who picks up machete and eats grilled fish! please remember. What is needed to save the world is 'recipes to try', 'border privet', and 'balanced diet'. Needless to say, the smell of cat paws and the warmth of loved ones!

title: Star Realms: High Alert - Heroes
description: The Star Realms: High Alert Heroes expansion contains 12 new multi-faction Heroes. This expansion also includes campaign chapter 25, which has 7 new missions!

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Starlet
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Starlet. Manufactured by United in 1955.

title: Golf Evolution Simulation
description: 30 Main stunt missions, 15 Parking missions, a fun test course map and a complete all-in-one game with all golf carts and modifiability. A different experience with a mix of Arcade and Simulation.

title: Schwarzerblitz: 8-Colors Star Guardians Collaboration Costumes - Chapter 1
description: Go, go, go, Star Guardians! This official collaboration between Schwarzerblitz and 8-Colors Star Guardians Plus brings a superheroic spin to your matches! Get 6 new cosplay costumes inspired by 8CSG and start fighting for Earth now! The DLC includes a stage and a new song for the jukebox/Free Match.

title: Elephant Rave 2
description: The rave goes on! 14 years after his first rave, the elephant has returned for monumental challenge: avoiding very, very deadly beams of light

title: Sakura School Love
description: The background of the game is an interesting story that happened in the small town of Sakura on the campus. You can also learn more knowledge and experience various daily activities, waiting for players to explore in the game.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed: AcceleRacers Hollowback
description: Metal Maniacs rejoice! Here is the legendary car of Tork Maddox, a muscle car super modified to resist everything! Hollowback is made of pure solidity and will leave a void behind! A must-have for all fans!

title: Wormhole: Battle for Planet Earth
description: Wormhole: Battle for Planet Earth - This is a fantastic third-person action game. In the game you are waiting for aliens, teleporters, dark matter and hurricane action.

title: Hyperdrive Inn
description: Dive into the mysteries of an infinite hotel. Unveil an ever-shifting adventure where every playthrough is unique. Immerse in fabric-crafted visuals, guided by an enchanting score inspired by Finnish folk music. Hyperdrive Inn is a point-and-click journey like no other.

title: Saga of Weil
description: Saga of Weil is an old school side scrolling adventure with some souls-like style combat

title: Duskborn
description: Duskborn is a 3rd-person rouge-like game. Descend into the Abyss as fast as possible, level up by defeating various enemies, collect and combine items to upgrade your player. Maneuver through the Abyss with your jetpack and grappling hook. The race against time is on.

title: Robospital
description: Become a doctor in Robospital and fix robots. Learn programming, write code, and test your code. With vibrant graphics, coding challenges, and a narrative, embark on an undercover mission. Dive into a game where coding meets adventure!

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991
description: This game is a global strategy, which is primarily focused on Ukraine after leaving the Soviet occupation. Here you will be given control of Ukraine with the opportunity to change history and intervene in the events of that time.

title: Screamdown
description: Scream through your mic at opponents to send them flying into the void in this PvP horror game.

title: A Lively Haunt
description: Are you bold enough to enter A Lively Haunt alone? Or must you join a friend to investigate this 2-player, old-school, text parser adventure game?

title: Magic Force
description: Magic Force is a 3D adventure game. You have to take on the role of a traveler who went in search of new adventures. Explore a mysterious continent that has been poisoned and help the locals find an antidote.

title: Karen's Fault
description: Join Karen in her uphill battle. But remember, there will be a lot of anger in this adventure...

title: Burger Shop 3
description: Make tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced sequel to the amazing food making games Burger Shop 1 & 2!

title: Woodland Isle
description: Explore the enchanting world of Woodland Isle, a captivating exploration game that invites you to embark on a tranquil journey through a lush, mysterious island. Uncover hidden locations, from ancient campsites to majestic trees and the remains of giants.

title: Becca
description: Becca is a short point-and-click, interactive story book.

title: One Night: Burlesque
description: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.

title: Vadi
description: Build your own kingdom in the dark valley where zombies rule and stay safe from zombies. It is up to you to survive in this valley.

title: Slime Alchemist
description: Turn-based tactics and roguelike deckbuilding with a twist! Forge your path across a procedural overworld, spend time as a resource to play cards, and build your deck from the techniques of vanquished foes. Hone your strategy and become the greatest slime of all!

title: Chained Together
description: From the depths of hell, climb chained to your friends through diverse worlds. Solo or co-op, try to reach the summit and discover what awaits you there...

title: Departed Away
description: Discover 'Departed Away,' a captivating visual novel where friendship intertwines with mystery. Uncover secrets, engage in verbal duels, and make choices that shape your story. Delve into emotional depth and intricate connections in this unique story.

title: Secret of the Vikings 2: The World Tree
description: Inexplicable disasters haunt the Vikings. Help Valkyrie Fenja and Raven Yorin rebuild the destroyed village and find out what is behind the mysterious events.

title: Deadpoint
description: "Deadpoint" is an engaging third-person survival game set in an apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Players take on the role of a resourceful scavenger, tasked with navigating the dangerous landscape and ensuring their survival amid the hordes of undead.

title: Louma
description: Louma is a Roguelike Dungeon Crawler. Fight through the procedural generated floors and save the World of Louma.

title: World War 1: Ruined - Part 2
description: Ruined Part 2 DLC: Free, Thrilling, and Here! Explore 3 new maps, experience an innovative game mode, and enjoy enhanced visuals/audio. Your journey continues with an epic storyline. Let's dive in! - RonStar Studios

title: FolcDark: Part I
description: FolcDark: Part I is the sequel to the prologue of a third-person dark fantasy action-adventure game, with a story and characters focused on Brazilian folklore.

title: Xaphan: Battle Simulator
description: Xaphan is a third person shooter mixed with sandbox battle simulator featuring zombies, huge insects, medieval knights, animals and monsters.

title: Exit the Backrooms
description: Embark on a journey through 8 meticulously crafted levels that blur the line between the mundane and the surreal. Each environment, designed to captivate the senses, pushes the boundaries of what you thought you knew.

title: Matchpoop
description: Step into a world overrun by mischievous poops! Rally allies, employ match-N mechanics to battle and flush them down the drain. Conquer poop overlords, reclaim the bathroom in this addicting game!

title: Semu
description: Space adventure can be scary, so that's why we at InkForge Studios have developed the most advanced Space Suit ever - the Semu suit. Standing for Survival Extra-vehicular Mobility Unit, it will keep you safe as you journey the cosmos. With survival guaranteed, what else is there to worry about?

title: The Johnny Papa
description: The Johnny Papa is a strategic multiplayer horror game with 3 main characters, 5 side characters and 1 murderer. Welcome to the village of Agris.

title: Gem
description: This is a 2D science fiction casual game, where players can gain increasingly fulfillment by collecting and exploring in the universe. The non-competitive game mode can also bring relaxation to users.

title: The Adventures of Bunny and Pig
description: Narrative game where Bunny heals an injured Pig and then together they fight against monsters. Psychological healing theme with a cute art style.

title: Unexpected Visitors
description: Step back in time to the 1950s and immerse yourself in a chilling tale shrouded in mystery in "Unexpected Visitors." Play as Barbara Clark, a housewife whose picturesque life takes a nightmarish turn when she returns home to find her children and babysitter mysteriously vanished.

title: Mahjick: The Realm Taker
description: "Mahjick - The Realm Taker" is a turn-based strategy game combining Roguelike and Mahjong Elements. Embark into this epic journey of taking the throne and to become the Keeper by defeating enemies for Enchantments and Skills, and Ronning your tiles for Attribute and Talent skills.

title: Ultradian
description: Ultradian is an intense JRPG adventure featuring turn-based combat, Survival Horror elements, and resource management. You must escape the war-torn town of Lgov within 24 hours before a devastating nuclear bomb is unleashed! But beware, falling asleep means certain death!

title: God's Forest
description: God's Forest is a Roguelite Bullet-Hell. Gather powerful items and weapons, battle the guardians of the dungeon, and maybe even make a few friends along the way!

title: Survival on a Deserted Island
description: The players of 'Survival on a deserted island' are immersed in a challenging and adventurous desert island. We need to constantly explore islands, find resources to manage our hunger, thirst, and physical strength, and build shelters to resist the threat of terrifying skeletons wandering around.

title: Paint Desk Simulator
description: Welcome to Paint Desk Simulator! In this game, you own a small paint-mixing company. As you rise through the ranks, you will start to be able to automate the paint mixing process. You need to strategize your days and always think ahead. Good luck, and all hail Radiant.

title: Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance
description: As Himiko Masaki continues the search for her mother, the resistance to change ever marches on when new rebellion groups challenge the city's obsession with Shinogi Chess, and the struggle for truth envelops Yoshino High School. Every move counts in Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance!

title: Little Monkey King's Big Quest
description: Welcome to "Little Monkey King's Big Quest"! Exciting adventures await you alongside the Little Monkey King.

title: Let Him Cook
description: Let Him Cook is a top-down action roguelite where you play as a food industry professional fighting in bullet hell's kitchen. When food fights back, you gotta cook. Jam to the music, hire assistants, and face against all kinds of live food puns!

title: Dungeon Create
description: Roused from sleep, I'm in a dusty cave, named the master of a dungeon!? I'm "forced" to manage it... Defend against daring adventurers!

title: Evil Snowmen 2
description: Evil Snowmen 2 - This is an improved port of the mobile game with a nice winter atmosphere and evil enemies snowmen. The game is not long, the average passage of the story will take about 30 minutes.

title: Island Hopper
description: Oh no! Your island got hit by a tornado. Can you rebuild your island and help out your friends? Enjoy randomly generated islands with different biomes to collect the resources you need to upgrade your gear and save your home. But don't leave the enemies out of your sight!

title: Blue Cradle: Signifie
description: A novel game with a fully voiced story about everyday or extraordinary stories.

title: Invert by SlushyRh
description: Embark on a precision platformer journey to the moon! You'll climb, fall, then cry and do it all again.

title: Unnamed Experiment
description: What could be more disorienting than finding yourself in a point-and-click puzzle game with no words at all? You wake up in a cell, surrounded by symbols and traces that make no sense. An atmospheric journey awaits. Immerse yourself in piecing clues together, but don't get lost in the surreal world.

title: Dadlympics
description: Engage in physics-based fun! Conquer hilarious dad-worthy challenges with friends in the DADLYMPICS. Are you ready to claim the title of ultimate dad?

title: Tax Evasion
description: An action filled roguelike, where you climb the floors of the IRS headquarters to reclaim what is rightfully yours... Your money. Take down your enemies. Buy items with their money. And climb the floors. Unlock new characters and abilities to approach this office building in many different ways.

title: Slime Experiments
description: A 2D top down puzzle game where you play as a slime that must go through various experiments after finding yourself captured by some sort of slime researcher.

title: Manor of Mysteries
description: Manor of Mysteries is a horror-puzzle multiplayer game. Explore a manor full of randomized rooms! Solve puzzles, survive monsters, escape traps. Work with your friends to solve this manor's mysteries! Can you survive 100 rooms? Or will you be another lost victim to the manor?

title: Stellario
description: In a large star field, the Spirit flies around and absorbs stars to build up mass and take on a different appearance. But you have to be careful on the journey - there are black holes scattered around the field, and also spaceships flying at unthinkable speeds.

title: Hover Shooting Defence
description: Aliens have invaded for Earth's resources. They dominated nature and made them attack mankind. Humanity on the verge of extinction has gathered the last of its strength and developed a superconducting hovertank that can stand against them. Now our counterattack begins.

title: Hajikise!
description:
Released in 2009, Hajikise! is a turn-based RPG for Windows PC.
It was developed and released by Hachimitsu Kumasan, a doujin game developer.

Hajikise! is a traditional Japanese RPG that uses two-dimensional top-down view.
Characters can be customized from a number of different classes and their skills.

title: Roaming Backrooms
description: This is a back room style game. There are many rooms in the game, like a maze, where players need to find a way out. Mainly focused on exploration, with some frightening elements. There may be monsters waiting for players around the corner, or chasing them. There is no bloody content.

title: Murder Miners X
description: The long-awaited sequel to the #1 rated Xbox Live Indie Game is not here yet, but it will be (Believe). Classic FPS gunplay with awesome parkour. Online, 4 player Splitscreen! Block-based destructible maps. Vehicles. Zombies. PVP Infection: Devour your victims, get new zombie powers!

title: Games Advent Calendar: 25 Days - 25 Surprises
description: In Games advent calendar, immerse yourself in that fantastic Christmas spirit, an exciting new game, every day for 25 days!

description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Rio. Manufactured by United in 1953.
