description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Beach Club. Manufactured by Bally in 1953.

title: BlooDooMoon Survivor
description: Welcome to this survival sandbox game! Your plane made a forced landing during the Bermuda storm. You will need to establish your own survival base from scratch, collect materials, make tools, build towns, manufacture weapons, explore unknown fields. Will you conquer the challenges?

title: Hilda and the Tower of Lust
description: The mightiest female warrior, Hilda, will face a tower teeming with monsters... Can she defeat the demon king without letting down the hero?

title: Desktop Pet
description: Desktop Pet is a life simulation game where you can take care of cute creatures while working or playing on your computer. Write documents, play games, watch videos, all together with your little companion.

title: Heartium
description: A fantasy SRPG.

title: Mr. Platformer
description: Run! Jump? Swim?! Mr. Platformer can do it all!

title: Mind Puzzle 2023
description: Mind Puzzle 2023: Dive into a world where physics reigns and every level offers endless possibilities. With just rectangles and circles at your disposal, discover your unique solution in this riveting casual game. Challenge the usual, embrace the extraordinary!

title: Monolith O Pesadelo
description: First person horror, Simple short game, look for keys, unlock passages. Be in an unknown location with a Dark atmosphere. In each phase there will be a different challenge, survive and advance while you try not to get caught. Avoid Scares.

title: Juicy Retro Style!: Bloodhound
description: Bring the Bloodhound world fully into the retro dimension ️ and enjoy juicy old-style gameplay!

title: Crimson Needle 3
description: Play as The Kid, and traverse a vast world of profoundly challenging platforming with a wide variety of atmospheres and visual styles.

title: WannaFest 22
description:
After the events of I Wanna Be The Guy, The Kid is invited to a game show hosted by an imposing figure! Fight your way through several game challenges to compete for a high score. Do you have what it takes to master these games and win the grand prize?

Developed by Cherry Treehouse for Fangame Marathon 2022's Blind Adventure event, WannaFest 22 is a fast-paced rollercoaster through hidden gaming gems of the past!

title: The Bowyage
description:
The Bowyage is a low fantasy platformer inspired by the NES Castlevania games, where you control Yew Bowman, a member of the low nobility and a longbowman, in his journey of conquests against his other two elder brothers.
Yew, lacking resources, figured that he needs to gain power to fend off against his two more powerful brothers, so with his trusty bow and arrow and his loyal army, he marches towards the path of conquest.

title: Sonic Test Labs
description:
Here at Hedgehog Testing Inc., we take the matter of rogue and spikey rodents very seriously. They're a threat and a menace to society!

So what have we decided to do? Take matters into our own hands by capturing these creatures and studying them to their fullest extent. All sponsored by G.U.N. of course!

title: Break Arts III
description: Freely customize your own robots to win high-speed matches! With the brand new Co-op Mode and Diorama Mode, this game is a fresh new addition to the series.

title: Fight Crab 2
description: Flip your opponents on their backs in this crustacean wrestling fighting game! Come up with your own strategies and use the deceivingly deep physics engine to your advantage. Challenge mighty foes in Career Mode, or pit your crab against others in online multiplayer.

title: Great Wall March
description: A turn-based fantasy JRPG.

title: Evil Girls Party!
description: Evil Girls Party is a dark fantasy dungeon-exploration RPG. In the world of Filtwiz, humans and demons are locked in relentless conflict— yet a new, threatening third force quietly rises: the Erosion, In the vast labyrinth, the feast of evil girls opens wide… the adventure begins!

title: Pokémon Mino
description: At the beginning of their journey, the trainer and sailor go to the Hishout Dungeon to see the very rare Pokémon, Graykid. When Team Digital arrives has a plan to steal the Pokémon, Graykid. Even though who's gonna stop Team Digital? Their good friends Damian and Skyla are the adventurous trainers in a whole wide world.

title: Rocher no Nagai Yoru
description: A turn-based fantasy JRPG.

title: Misty no Kira-kira Hanjouki
description: A turn-based fantasy JRPG.

title: Pokémon: Burning Lotus
description: The game takes place in a new region called Lotus, a region that is filled with Pokémon from every previous generation, including new species as well. You take control as either a male or female protagonist, and the region has eight gym leaders who are all returning leaders from previous games.

title: Sparkster PC
description: A reimagined version of the Genesis version of Sparkster that aims to create something new and exciting with its existing ideas and assets.

title: Megaman X in Sonic Blasting Adventure
description: A fan game that adds X and Zero from the Mega Man X series into Sonic Blasting Adventure.

title: Sonic Colors Demastered
description:
Sonic Colors Demastered is a 2D reimagining of Sonic Colors for the Nintendo Wii and Nintendo DS. The game features gameplay inspired by the Sonic Rush series and a fully original level design and soundtrack.

Join Sonic, Tails, and a colorful cast of aliens to put a stop to Eggman’s plans for interstellar domination! Use Sonic’s signature suite of abilities, including the boost, grind, and homing attack, to make your way through exhilarating, high-speed 2D platforming challenges!

title: Sonic Colors VN
description: Sonic Colors VN is a remake of Sonic Colors DS in a Visual Novel format using the Ren'Py game engine. This project bridges the gap between all versions of the tale, stringing their plot threads together.

title: Sonic 04
description: A loving tribute to the good old days when Sonic fangames were worse than the official onres.

title: Mekanikko
description: Mekanikko is an RPG that takes place in the world of modern steampunk. Explore the world of automatons, as weird things are always about to happen. Meet wacky characters with each of their own story tell. Solve cases with your sugar-freak partner, and find out the truth of this mechanical city.

title: Hot Job 94'
description: Hot Job 94 is a 3D action platformer inspired by the early 2000's GameCube games such as Sonic Adventure and Super Mario Sunshine. Control 5 different characters with unique attributes like speed, flight, shooting, and combat.

title: Funtography: A Gameboy Cameradventure
description: In Funtography, enjoy looking at 100+ Gameboy Camera pictures as you explore various urban vistas to solve the mystery of a missing video game prototype.

title: Sonic McOrigins Plus
description: An update to Sonic McOrigins that adds Shadow Hockey, Amy/Rouge Volleyball, and Shadow Basketball.

title: EdelSuche
description: EdelSuche is a Rockman-style-doujin-ish-action-platformer game where you play as Cecilia Wonderwand, a mage apprentice who finds herself in need to save the world from "The Rot".

title: Beep Bap The Beep Boop
description: Beep Bap The Beep Boop is a 3D platformer inspired by Spyro, Banjo and Zelda! Explore colorful worlds and talk to a variety of charming NPCs! Use your surroundings to aid in combat & use shields to block and parry enemy attacks!

title: Rocket League: Season 12
description:
Home to Rocket League’s opening day, Neo Tokyo’s megalithic tech scene and neon-soaked cityscape make for a landmark Arena setting. But fanged rumors lurk amongst the roots of these glittering towers. Notorious hacktivist Zero-Day has gained access to the city's digital infrastructure, and although their motives remain unclear, the city's underbelly buzzes with anticipation of what’s to come.

How will you survive this world of digital disruption? Override your Garage with the Porsche 911 Turbo, go incognito with Rocket Pass rewards, and play Soccer in Zero-Day’s corrupted vision of Neo Tokyo.

Season 12 begins on September 6, no password required!

title: One Tap
description: "One Tap" is a high-octane first-person shooter game that delivers an immersive and competitive gaming experience. It's all about the thrill of the game, the strategy, and the skill. The unique twist? You get to choose an in-game asset with special abilities that can turn the tide of the battle. The special characters in the game are digital assets or "NFT" stored using blockchain technology.

title: Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club
description: A visual novel focused on mental health and personal identity. Help your character fit into the new city you moved to and find new friends. As part of your journey, you will be able to listen to the people around you and learn to surf for the first time. Player choice affects how the narrative will progress, including special dialogue to discover for key scenes.

title: Amorphous
description: Amorphous is a 4v1 multiplayer experience where one player takes control of the elusive shape-shifting slime, seeking to consume and contaminate various locations across space and time. Meanwhile, the team of 4 relentless Cleaners unite and attempt to eradicate the ever-evolving threat.

title: Willow Guard
description: Willow Guard is a single player story-driven fantasy RPG that combines dungeon-crawling action gameplay with a choice-based interactive fiction.

title: Wisp Child
description: Join Mylo in this coming of age adventure as they explore magical woods, hone their alchemy skills, and repair their troubled relationship with Ademia. Unravel the secrets of wisps, and even learn to control them. Meet fun and quirky characters, and find your place in the village.

title: Wreckage
description: A classic car combat game set in a post-apocalyptic sunny south Florida. Fast-paced gameplay, a wide variety of vehicles and weapons to choose from, and killer stories for each and every driver.

title: Zbuki Zoo Strategic Comedy
description: Humorous strategy with unique set of characters: buff genius, precious kung fu lady, half-ton puppy, cool spitter and much more. Plus some non-standard structures to build and quirky maps to explore. You can find these only in Zbukiland.

title: Candy Crisis
description: Candy Crisis is an exciting combination of pure action and puzzle gaming! The game features twelve unique stages, complete with its own character and individual technique. Also, you can pair off against a friend, and even specify a handicap so that both players are evenly matched. And if you don't want to play against an opponent, Solitaire Crisis mode allows you to practice without having to compete against an opponent. A tutorial is included with the game as well, so even puzzle novices can become Candy Crisis champions in no time.

title: Vampire's Kiss
description: Unleash your lust and your thirst in a battle for the soul of London! Will passion lead you back to humanity, or will you embrace the night as a vampire?

title: Up Against Aliens
description: Navigate cosmic debris using time-bending tech in this 3D platformer. Solve puzzles and thwart the alien threat across shifting landscapes. Will you be Earth's unexpected savior when you go Up Against Aliens?

title: Tom the Postgirl
description: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

title: Too Shroom!
description: Slash your way through hoards of hellish shrooms, defending your once peaceful land, or attacking the infinite procedural enemy fortress! Choose upgrades that synergize with your build to survive as long as possible against the infinitely scaling waves of monsters attempting to overwhelm you!

title: Towerbolt
description: Towerbolt is a fast paced vertical platformer set in the year 239X. Race to the top of a cyberpunk Megatower while outrunning lethal security lasers on every floor!

title: They Come In Waves
description: Forge your path through unending zombie swarms! Craft inferno-spewing flamethrowers & explosive rocket launchers for ultimate undead domination. How long will you survive?

title: ThinkExplosive
description: ThinkExplosive is a first-person puzzle-platformer about bombs! Throw bombs to overcome obstacles - or launch yourself to new heights! Explore the corridors of an abandoned facility and discover new game mechanics.

title: The Weird Dream
description: The Wierd Dream is a hand-drawn anime style 2D horizontal action-adventure Metroidvania game. You play as a mysterious Rabbit in the middle of a destroyed city. Defeat residents who have been alienated and continue to improve yourself to finally unlock the ultimate secret behind.

title: The Last Braincell
description: Do you ever want to revisit the good old days of bouncing screen savers? Well not only can you do that you can also add whatever images you'd like to it, customize its background to whatever you'd want it to be, and even play around with them as you brain blast your last few brain cells!

title: The Rabbit Haul
description: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

title: The Last General
description: Lead your army through raging conflicts in this massive RTS modern war game. Execute tactics and conquer the resources you need to achieve your goals. Take the enemy territory, perform assassinations, lead insurrections, rescue your stranded troops and much more, in millions of different missions.

title: Telebbit
description: No future for mankind. Now, rabbits rule the world. A fast-paced platform game using teleporters.

title: The Amazing Crackpots Club!
description: The Amazing Crackpots Club! is a fast-paced, action-packed magic duel in a 2D arena, where wizards throw powerful spells trying to destroy the opponent’s pots, while using mobility and defensive abilities to protect their own pots from incoming attacks.

title: The Backrooms: Unbounded
description: The Backrooms: Unbounded is a Free single player first person body camera horror game based on the backrooms. You take the role of a police officer who noclips out of reality while on duty. Will you make it out alive?

title: The Attic
description: Visual Novel and Walking Simulator style game with multiple endings. A love letter to the classical horror stories about old haunted houses, basements and ofcourse attics. Psychological horror inspired by author's experience with OCD-like symptoms and intrusive thoughts.

title: The Garden of Silvergrass
description: The main character, Naho, meets a mysterious fox spirit named Semi in a silver grass field. Fall into her lovely charm. The closer you get to her, the more you will face her and your dark past. Can your choice create a new future?

title: Stormworks: Space
description: Stormworks: Space is the space mechanics and moon location expansion for Stormworks. This expansion includes the vacuum of space, the moon, and all new space-grade components and equipment.

title: Starship Troopers: Terran Command - Raising Hell
description: A series of 7 new missions tell the story of the struggle on planet Gehenna - an unforgiving hellscape engulfed in molten lava, volcanic eruptions, and hordes of Arachnids.

title: Square City Builder
description: Build the small pixel city of your dreams! From classic city-building games, Square City Builder offers various ways to customize your gameplay, from constructing houses, farms, or roads to facing random events. In this game, you're in control!

title: Shutdown.
description:
Play as a Doll on the operating table. You have mere minutes before you're disassembled and dead... But who is that, picking away at your rivets.?

☆1000 words, 1 sprite, 1 background, 1 song, 1 sound effect, 4 endings and a single shared fate.

title: Side by Size
description: Side by Size is a puzzle game where taking damage and healing changes the puzzle layout. Purposefully get hurt to open the way to the exit in 100 hand crafted puzzles!

title: Slime Masters
description: In Slime Masters, defend the town from menacing monsters as a valiant hero. Choose from 5+ unique characters, level up, acquire powers, and embark on quests. Unleash strategic combat and become the legendary Slime Master in this endless adventure of bravery and heroism.

title: Secrets of the Haunted Mansion
description: "Secrets of the Haunted Mansion" is an immersive interactive adventure game that transports players into the dark and mysterious world of an abandoned and haunted estate. Step into the shoes of an explorer, ready to unearth forgotten secrets and unravel intriguing puzzles.

title: Seer's Gambit
description: Seer's Gambit is a strategic, semi-auto battler that rewards smart positioning, player agency and building a team that plays to each character’s strength. Explore a perilous world to unlock new heroes for the perfect team composition or upgrade nodes for powerful group buffs.

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 3
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki going to the gym on a Saturday morning, attempting to seduce her new smoking hot trainer for a quickie, despite her husband’s reluctance.

title: Raioh
description: Raioh is a retro style shot and bomb style vertical scroll shmup.

title: Samawa Idle
description: Unleash the power of specialized towers to annihilate hordes of monsters in this idle game with roguelike elements. Collect gold, level up your towers, face powerful bosses, and refine your strategy with an evolving skill tree.

title: Royal Romances: Endless Winter - Collector's Edition
description:
Sometimes saving one life can change the fate of many. Can you melt the ice in people's hearts?
The Collector’s Edition includes:
An all-new story in the bonus chapter!
Replay your favorite mini-games and hidden-object scenes whenever you want!
Tons of achievements to unlock!
Keep an eye out for secret collectibles and morphing objects!

title: Realm of Dread
description: Take a step into the Realm of Dread's world of horror and suspense. Explore mysterious locations, fight for survival within the realm of supernatural entities and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows. This journey through darkness requires courage and intellect. Are you ready?

title: Project Otherside
description: Project Otherside is a horror exploration game. Where players will be transported to an otherworldly dimension where they must navigate through endless spaces while being pursued by nightmarish entities..

title: Wild Wild Eden
description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

title: Open Hunting XL
description: Open Hunting XL is a hunting simulator focused on creating a customizable experience. Hunt small game with engaging systems tailored to those animals. Go after deer with challenging realistic gameplay or go for a casual day out hunting after tweaking your experience to what you enjoy.

title: Operation Noogy
description: Dive into a rhythmic shooting range adventure where precision meets melody. Unlock diverse firearms, ascend the ranks, and groove to the beats in this captivating casual shooter. Challenge your aim, reward your skill, and immerse yourself in the ultimate aim-and-groove experience!

title: Ooze: The Great and Powerful
description: Ooze: The Great and Powerful - is a puzzle platformer without the ability to jump. In this adventure, you will learn the story of classic monsters who are trying to get along with each other by playing for the Ooze Cube guarding the dungeon.

title: My Legend of Immortal Cultivation
description: Immortal cultivation hanging game, with a rich system, experience the world of immortal cultivation

title: My Father's House
description: My Father's House is a first-person indie survival horror game. The father’s old mansion becomes a maze of nightmares when the secrets of the past are released. Survive, save resources, solve puzzles and stay in the shadows. Ingenuity and tactics are your only way to escape.

title: Milky Way Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Embark on a cosmic journey with "Milky Way Jigsaw Puzzles". Solve puzzles featuring stars, galaxies, and celestial wonders while unlocking Steam Achievements. Dive deep into the universe, learn astronomical facts, and connect with fellow puzzle enthusiasts. Your galactic adventure awaits!

title: Monument Village
description: Monument village is a turn-based pacific medieval city-builder. Optimize the placement of each building to grow your village while fulfilling mandatory resource requests. When you are ready, gather workers and materials and finally build the monument of your dream.

title: Modulor
description: A perma-death action rogue-like FPS, where you get gun modules, create crazy combinations and bulid a unique gun every run to shoot through procedurally generated dungeons and slay bosses.

title: Missile Dancer 2
description: Missile Dancer 2 is a new sprite scaler shmup that combines rail shooter and caravan STG.

title: MimiCries
description: Investigate the mysteries of a haunted mansion as you solve various challenging puzzles in this Victorian-inspired, narrative-driven escape room game. With only your wit and a lantern to light the way forward, will the choices you make seal your fate, or open the path to freedom?

title: Midnight at the Disco
description: Annihilate massive hordes of evil alien eyeball monsters as you struggle to survive a full day on the dance floor. Choose from a diverse set of character traits, weapons and upgrades to create unique builds on each run to blast the baddies into oblivion.

title: Metal Bringer
description: In this roguelike action-adventure, control humanoid "Labor" and giant "Arms" to uncover the mysteries of the world. Create fully-customizable robots, strengthen them, and take down hordes of enemies!

title: MannaRites Gold
description: Gold edition of the warmly received fantasy 2.5D hack-n-slash / RPG - MannaRites! Cut your way through enemy troops, explore open map, find and equip legendary weapons, armor and artifacts, level up your hero! Defend your lands from invaders!

title: Manhattan Dolls
description: "Manhattan Dolls" is a point-and-click adventure game with RPG and dating sim elements. Play as either a lesbian woman or as a straight man and romance your way around The Big Apple. Meet beautiful women and see what crazy adventures lie in store for you on this epic night about town!

title: Mature Comedy Visual Novel
description: Experience a world filled with awful people - and you're one of them! You embark on a journey to get your awful catgirl girlfriend some illicit materials, intense and prolonged misery immediately ensues.

title: Maid Cafe: Maid Girls Comics
description: New content in the form of comics to collect and read in game, new desserts and new in-game content are added with this DLC. Enjoy the fully uncensored comics within the game at any time as you play via the in-game phone.

title: Maid Cafe: Monstrous Beauties Comics
description: New content in the form of comics to collect and read in game, new desserts and new in-game content are added with this DLC. Enjoy the fully uncensored comics within the game at any time as you play via the in-game phone.

title: UnReaMod
description: Experience Lumina Leap: Leap to the beat of neon through dazzling levels.Master the jumps, shine on the leaderboards.Dive into the light action!

title: Locura
description: Locura is a first-person immersive horror game. It is a thrilling journey into the unknown. Prepare for moral ambiguity where the line between light and darkness blurs.

title: Little Dew Drop
description: Little Dew Drop is a small, relaxing and slow-paced 2D platformer. Enjoy the original soundtrack while travelling through six increasingly challenging levels.

title: Line Time
description: 《Line Time》is a puzzle game based on “controlling the timeline”.

title: Life Museum
description: A side-scrolling puzzle game in line style. You take on the role of an office worker who, after working day after day, decides to explore the city. Play with keyboard or Xbox controller.

title: Lawin Catch The Kim
description: Lawin Catch The Kim is a fun puzzle game~Chicken Kim never eats and runs wild outside every day. As Kim's good friend, you need to take them all back to the chicken coop and eat obediently! The game is always given 20 levels.Take all Kim home!

title: Kill a Million Rats
description: A roguelite bullet-heaven RTS, set in a forest invaded by an endless horde of Rats. As the Spirit of Vengeance, you must save the adorable, innocent animals. Explore a randomly generated world, harvest resources, rebuild the Hidden Village, recruit allies, and Kill a Million Rats!

title: IronWolf: Free Non-VR Edition
description: This is the Free Non-VR version of IronWolf VR. A co-op submarine game with a light touch on realism, making the submarine sim genre accessible to a wider audience.

title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 4: Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the enchanting depths of the mystical underwater realm of Atlantis Solitaire! Delve into numerous intricate underwater levels and build stunning aquatic landscapes. Tackle the latest Supersize, Challenge, and Match-2 levels as you unlock a multitude of new solitaire variations.

title: Jump Malcolm Jump
description: Embark on a jump-filled odyssey in "Jump Malcolm Jump," a 3D platformer that blends arcade excitement with daring dashes. Collect Energy Orbs across stunning worlds and dash past obstacles. Casual fun meets high-flying action!

title: Gloomy Village
description: Gloomy Village is an erotic adventure with elements of survival. You are in the role of a big-breasted treasure hunter and adventurer - Evelyn.

title: Flips¿de
description: Flips¿de is an RPG where Sam and her roommates are getting ready to move out of their apartment, but the night before they leave, a mysterious leak leads to a strange world with even stranger people. Can Sam navigate this world, fix the leak, and get her security deposit back?

title: Gobs and Gods
description: The tactical RPG going full Goblin mode! Hire a band of almost-heroic goblins to fight and die for you in tactical turn-based battles, accomplish silly quests for the weird inhabitants of this fantastic world, and truly become a god - at least by goblin standards.

title: Hero or Villain: Genesis - Supercharged!
description: Over 40 new powers! Five new side missions to patrol the streets, go skiing with your favorite characters or discover the legacy of vampire hunters!

title: Hoops World
description: Relax and shoot some hoops around the world!

title: Harem! Ranch Life
description: This is a relaxing farm RPG game where you can earn money by collecting and raising livestock! Interact with adorable villagers to increase your popularity in the village through chatting and giving gifts. Please enjoy a cozy farm life in this small village!

title: Heroes & Redemption
description: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell where you face hordes of enemies, annihilate them, learn new abilities and enhance your skills. Explore different regions, acquire new companions and embark on adventures again and again.

title: Grunenberg
description: "Grunenberg" is a single-player horror game that utilizes the visual and sound design of VHS tapes. The protagonist, Jimmy Solomon, comes to the abandoned area named Grunenberg to find his grandfather and captures everything he sees on the camera as his grandfather's request.

title: Enigmatic Worlds
description: Explore strange and abstract worlds filled with equally unusual but deadly beings of many types. Enigmatic Worlds is an FPS inspired by obscure retro-styled FPS games and Amiga games.

title: Duckball
description: Duckball is an action-packed battle royale game where up to 100 players compete to be the last duck standing. Play with friends online and collect wacky items to knock your opponents off the stage in an ever changing 3D environment. Do you have what it takes to be truly glorious?

title: Dualis
description: Dualis is a sci-fi horror thriller whose story takes you to an underground research complex. You will have to fight not only for your life, but also to understand if you really exist. What is consciousness and personality are the questions you will have to ask yourself.

title: DropingBalls
description: This is a simple casual game for avoiding falling balls. You can move the protagonist through AWSD to exercise your reaction and planning abilities while resting. It comes with a maximum survival time recording mechanism.

title: Fate of Aruna
description: A science fiction and high fantasy role playing game which takes place amid the ruins of a shattered planet.

title: Fate and Life: The Mystery of Vaulinhorn
description: Fate and Life: The Mystery of Vaulinhorn is a visual novel game set in an enigmatic city rife with mystery and lust. Navigate the intertwining paths of fate and desire, unearth the haunting secrets of Vaulinhorn, and revel in the thrill of its sensual encounters.

title: Farther Forest
description: Farther forest - is a 2D platform game with RPG elements. Kill different enemies with your weapons! Complete different tasks and deal with the monsters that stand in your way, and beware of deadly traps.

title: Estate Agent Simulator
description: Estate Agent Simulator lets you enter the exciting world of the real estate market. You can buy, decorate, advertise, rent or sell houses. You can buy vacant land and build houses. Environmental factors will affect the rental prices of houses.

title: Escape Escape
description: You awaken in a mysterious room and promptly clear items from the desk. The individual behind this watches in surprise on the monitor. "Hey! What are you doing? Let me play my game!" "Escape Escape" is an adventure where you explore, interact, and advance through maps and characters.

title: Eon Rush
description: Eon Rush - a real-time action RPG that combines the best of endgame PvE and PvP thrills, skipping the filler and getting straight into the fun. Players dive into a variety of trials, including taking down colossal monsters, competing in challenging gauntlets, and engaging in heart-pounding battles.

title: DMVR
description: I taught myself how to drive by making this game.

title: Draco and the Seven Scales
description: Take on the role of a pirate captain as he sets sail to save his greatest treasure of all. Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that hearkens back to an age of top-down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art. Melodic shanties will guide your way through this sprawling world full of dangerous enemies, items to collect, and a dark force that seeks to corrupt. Will you break free from a kraken's dooming bargain, or be another victim?

title: Carnival Survivors The Parade
description: A musical rogue-like adventure where you lead a band of adorable cats. Feel the rhythm-based abilities to unlock new band members, levels, and songs. Each member brings unique instruments and abilities, allowing you to overcome the hordes of enemies with the power of music!

title: Dark Age
description: Dark Age is a futuristic 3D action game with refined low poly design. Enjoy this frenetic Beat 'em up.

title: Descentia
description: We fused card games and open-world rpg together to make the best single player open world deckbuilder we could. Build your party with different races, craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, complete the quests and get ready for a breathtaking adventure

title: Crowned Control
description: A couch co-op multiplayer game, where the goal is to grab the crown and keep it on your head for as long as possible to win the game!

title: Crimson Crisis
description: Embrace the chaos… Battle aliens, shoot guns and, above all else, survive to work anotherday in Crimson Crisis, a sci-fi action-roguelite set in a post-apocalyptic universe.

title: Cozy Fishing
description: Cozy Fishing is a game where you can chill and fish to grow your aquarium fish collection in chilling environments and a relaxing atmosphere.

title: Cosmorists
description: Explore, and exploit your surroundings to advance! Unlock crafting recipes in a tech tree via research, and crafting science. Explore the surface, or deep in the caves, and protecting yourself against the elements in dangerous areas, or relaxing in safe areas!

title: Code, Solve, Revolt!
description: "Code, Solve, Revolt!" is a puzzle game where you solve factory tasks through intuitive drag-and-drop programming. Write code for your robot to clear each level, delve deeper into the factory, encounter new puzzle concepts and data-structure creatures, and uncover the truth.

title: Bounty Hunters
description: Fight in a top down 2d shooter adventure with resource gathering / bullet heaven/hell mechanics.

title: Blue Ridge Hunting
description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game where you and your friends investigate, document, and hunt cryptids in the Appalachian Mountains.

title: Broken Life
description: BROKEN LIFE is an atmospheric, fully voiced point-and-click adventure set in a war-torn world. Follow Leo, a former soldier, as he returns to his hometown to uncover the fate of his family, restore his home, and confront the dark secrets hidden within.

title: Brews & Bastards
description: Brews & Bastards is a chaotic co-op dungeon crawler for 1-4 players, overflowing with action-packed combat, magical brews and outlandish tavern games. Select from a group of distinct heroes and blast your way through hordes of drunken demons in search of the stolen Brew Stone.

title: Bright Side: Riddles & Puzzles
description: Who is lying? Who will survive? Which way is safe? Watch unusual stories and solve tricky riddles with your friends or solo!

title: Bunny's Pizza Tycoon
description: Open and customize an old restaurant! Inspired by the fnaf series, you play the role of a company owner during the day and a worker during the night. Buy Items during the day and maybe make a little bonus cash during the nights so you can make money the next day!

title: Bunny Bond
description: Bunny Bond is a steamy visual novel where you can chat, flirt, and fall in love with 6 handsome guys! Enjoy fun interactions with the group, send DMs to whoever catches your eye, and collect all of the sexy pictures they send to you!

title: Bump and Run Racing
description: Get ready to tear up the streets and smash your way to the finish line! Bump & Run Racing is an ode to classic arcade racers where crashing opponents is not only allowed, but encouraged.

title: Buhei
description: Dive into an action-packed Twin Stick Party Shooter! Grab your friends and engage in explosive multiplayer battles, whether you're playing right next to them on the couch or from a distance.

title: Coke Bugs
description: A hallucinatory bender of a late night road trip sketched in nervous lines of arcade action and exploration.

title: Chaos Crafters
description: Learn, craft and test spells on any element of the game! Solve puzzles or fight enemies alone or in co-op. Be careful, your friends are not immune to your magic and one wrong move could cause total chaos.

title: Cadde
description: Are you ready to let it rip in the streets of İstanbul? Cadde combines fun physics, realistic sound design and the atmospheric air of İstanbul.

title: C.I.E.B The Backrooms Project
description: Prepare. Explore. Survive. Extract. Profit. You will explore the infinite backrooms and bring back proof of your journey. In return I will allow you to browse a catalog so our scientist can increase your odds at survival. You will have to cover some expenses like body upkeep and so forth. Good Luck.

title: Age of Goblins
description: Conquer caves, farms and towers to expand your might and raise your tribe of goblins to the heights it deserves. Age of Goblins is a real-time strategy (RTS) game with simplified mechanics where your goal is to dominate the entire map and subdue your rival tribes.

title: Adventure Story
description: Play the role of the Adventure Guild President of the Magic World. Manage and utilize every resource at hand. Dig out legendary stories from various regions and spread your guild name throughout the entire empire. Finally, obtain powerful artifacts hidden around the world.

title: Blood, Fuel, Ammo & Speed
description: Blood, Fuel, Ammo & Speed is a Fast Paced Rogue-lite Action Fps Game. Pour Out Fuel and Ammo and Dance In Blood With Speed. KILL THE DEMONS.

title: Beyond Hanwell
description: Step into Hanwell and discover a world beyond it. Set in the deeper parts of London, explore Westminster and uncover the truth about the enigmatic stranger known as The Director. Fight with whatever you can find or use the environment to take out Anomolies.

title: Beasts of Steel
description: Beasts of Steel is a semi-realistic WWII game that combines FPS and Strategy where you can battle solo or online. Experience intense combat as an infantryman, tank crew, or take to the skies as a pilot. Unleash chaos and dominate the battlefield!

title: Bancroft Academy

title: Draculesti
description: Drăculești is a villain-focused reimagining of the classic novel Dracula that shines a light on the shadowy figures of Renfield, Dracula's Brides, and Dracula himself. Be enthralled by the residents of Castle Dracula, and thrill at a dark narrative with strong LGBTQI+ themes.

title: Snowdrop the Blade Master
description: It's a deck building roguelike game with a feature, where the card you played leave a shard that can be used as an extra assistance that will help you to reach your goal.

title: Little Loki & The Yggdrasil Maze
description: A hundred years ago, the defeated Demon Lord Loki has now been resurrected! Disregarding the dissuasion of his former subordinates, Loki is determined to reach the Yggdrasil. Faced with powerful enemies, will Loki be able to succeed in seeking revenge?

title: Tax-Force
description: Hunt down tax-evading mutant billionaires and reinvest in society in this narrative Action Rogue-lite meets Political Sim.

title: Lovanium: The Rising Suns
description: Find a way to escape Lovanium before it's too late. Extract resources, trade them, confront the wildest and most dangerous enemies, and fully harness the power of the suns. Are you up for it?

title: Horses
description: In Horses, you will take on the role of a summer worker taking a break from his college studies. You will be responsible for taking care of the farm and its animals for a fortnight. Each day, as you explore the farm, you'll encounter many "surprises," peeling back the layers of the farm's unsettling mysteries.

title: WiZmans World ReTry
description: This is a remaster of Jaleco’s RPG WiZmans World released in 2010 on Nintendo DS, now in HD with a 16:9 screen ratio.

title: Pettson o Findus i Snickarbon
description: Pettson o Findus i snickarbon is an edutainment game with a collection of mini-games situated in Pettson's workshop. Players will choose a guard for their treasure chest and then will be able to collect gold feathers for every completed activity within the game. Other things can also be collected if found like pieces of a map.

title: Address1
description: 2D style shoot'em up in which close combat is the primary attack method. With two large swords in her hands, cut her way through enemy bullets and enemy units in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: Bobble Bash
description: It is a tabletop point collection game, where players bash their way between obstacles to score and win. Think shuffleboard meets bumper cars. Apart of Discord's in-game activity collection.

title: Adventure Kitty: Drill Buster
description: Adventure Kitty: Drill Buster is an action-paced drill game that has you drilling across new terrains and collecting coins to break barriers.

title: Blob Command
description: Match blobs together, create chain reactions and don't run out of time!

title: Blob Command: New Attack
description: Experience more blob action with power-ups and two player co-op!

title: Bun 'N' Gun
description: Bun 'N' Gun is a fast action-based run-and-gun game where you command different weapon elements and jump through several action-packed stages full of enemies, traps, and powerups.

title: Cosmogelica
description: Blast off into space! Help Monica and her team explore the galaxy, fight off hordes of enemies, and clean up the mysterious cosmic gel in this retro-arcade inspired action shooter!

title: Crazy Kitchen
description: Hordes of Hungrys are coming in waves. Protect the Kitchen and its precious snacks at all costs!

title: Cube Crusaders
description: Mow down all who stand in the way of your Crusade. Become a benevolent conqueror, or a brutal oppressor to those you achieve victory over. Your actions decide the fate of the planet.

title: B.U.D.D.
description: B.U.D.D. is a cute sci-fi adventure platformer heavily inspired by games and anime from the late 80's.

title: Dogs of the Dark
description: Dogs of the Dark is a role-playing game that pulls inspiration from retro RPGs from the 90s and the quirky ones from the 2000s. It features a full 5+ chapter campaign filled with dumb jokes, strange characters, and retro pixel art graphics akin to 8-bit or 16-bit games.

title: Scruffy 3: A Day in the Life
Woody's Incredible Journey to the Escape from Eternal Terror
Dolan Reborn
description: In Dolan Reborn, random people are disappearing all over, and it's up to you to stop that. Take control of Dolan and go to various locations to pinpoint the person responsible for this. In this journey, you will encounter difficult obstacles, enemies, and bosses so do your best to get to the final act.

title: 'Round The Mind
description: 'Round The Mind is a hybrid-genre, fast-paced platformer where you, a young therapist kid who is accompanied by a big floating talking TV, help people feel better as a member from the 'Round The Mind organization.

title: Trimurti Online
description: Relive the classic gameplay of an old-school MMORPG. Select a class that suits your style and join your friends to explore the vast world of Trimurti Online. Enhance your equipment and maximize your skills to complete quests, confront monsters and bosses, conquer dungeons, and fight other players!

title: Donny Donut: Dokrats
description:
Donny, Donno and Donna were invited to the ceremony of collaboration with Candy-Land and an other continent, Food-City. Everything was going perfect until a strange wizard, named Brook, enters the President's Palace. He wants to conquer the world and shape it at his mind, with the power of the Dokrats Relics. These are ancient relics from an old civilization, the Dokrats. They are the ancestors of our heroes.
The relics contents an unlimited power that only a pure soul can handle at perfection. Your quest is to get all of the Dokrats Relics and stop Brook. Will you save the world before the revival of the Demon Golem ?

title: Arena Kingdoms
description: Arena Kingdoms is a community battle game where Discord servers play together, compete, and represent their server's HOUSE in weekly Arena Tournaments.

title: Zorropa y La Torre de las Sombras
description:
Zorropa is a young fox that has to leave his house due to some spiky plants growing all over the island, it is at this moment that your adventure begins.
Use your abilities to make your way into towers that behold the power of the sun, maybe with this power you can save the island, or start an adventure and save the world.

title: Candy Rangers
description: Go on a single player, On-Rails Shooter Adventure in Candy Rangers and match 4 colors with 4 rangers! Each ranger can take down enemies that match their color, and it's up to you to use each one accordingly! Can you match them all?

title: Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey 2: Veggocalypse
description: Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey 2: Veggocalypse is an Earthworm Jim and Jazz Jackrabbit 2-inspired shoot-em-up platformer with fluent & wacky animation, high-speed moveset, and lots of fruit-filled action!

title: Croaking Around
description:
Use your tongue to pull, sling and swing acrobatically to get around the hazardous underground.
The game focuses on simple platforming gameplay combined with spectacular aerial acrobatics and a cute cartoony artstyle.
It's pure fun for the whole family (it's singleplayer so you're going to have to take turns sorry).

title: Lumiva Legacy
description: Lumiva Legacy is a fast-paced action platformer about three young multivas, Alex "Bingo" Rivero, Salamon Avery, and Roy Cruz, on their journey to stop D-Tech from invading their home of Neuo Town. The trio will have to put their skills to the test to conquer many challenges, defeat countless foes, and explore exotic locations with their various abilities and the help of Elemental Charges!

title: Harrow
description: Harrow is a culmination of several nightmares. All of these nightmares were in an old 1995-1998 horror video game setting. It's also heavily inspired by the Silent Hill series, as that has been an influence for many of my nightmares. That's why the game is themed the way that it is. By entering this game, you are entering the embodiment of the nightmares, and because of this, you should proceed with caution.

title: Honey Bunny
description: Honey Bunny is a bartender at Lucky Rabbit's Foot Casino, the cutest casino in all of Starlight City! She's busy at work when the no-good gang, The Cool Cats, steals away the casino and the entire city's supply of cocktail cherries. Chase them down as Honey Bunny using your ears to headbutt enemies, grab items, and platform around the city as you recover as many cherries as possible!

title: Dirappen Restoration
description: The planet has been overrun! Play as the lone Dirappen Soldier Unit D6-4 in its epic quest to defeat the alien invaders and restore the planet of Darptha to the rightful rule of King Darpon.

title: Anjelo's Province
description: Anjelo's Province is a fan-made remake of Anjelo's Land.

title: Meander Land
description: Meander Land is a remake of Anjelo's Province with new original characters, a new story, and a ton of quality-of-life improvements.

title: The Sims 4: Poolside Splash Kit
description: Turn heads at the pool with bright and playful swimwear from The Sims 4 Poolside Splash Kit.

title: Tower of Dreams
description: Climb your way to the top of the tower in this vertical platforming roguelike! Bound off walls, discover fantastical items, and make use of Dream Knight's sword to bounce off of obstacles!

title: The Sims 4: Modern Luxe Kit
description: Treat yourself to luxurious modern furniture that says “I made it” with The Sims 4 Modern Luxe Kit.

title: Isonzo: First Wave
description: Enhance your Isonzo experience by requisitioning a variety of cosmetic Unit Pack DLCs with the Wave sets! First Wave includes all the core Isonzo Unit Pack DLCs: the Reserve Units, Veteran Units, Elite Units, and Alpine Units.

title: Train Simulator: Norfolk Southern SD70ACU
description: Now, you can climb aboard the powerful Norfolk Southern SD70ACU, as created by developer Travel by Train, to haul heavy tonnage in Train Simulator Classic!

title: Hotel Renovator: Disco Room & Furniture Set
description: Get ready to boogie down and transform your hotel into dazzling disco paradises with the Disco Room & Furniture Set for Hotel Renovator! Step into the glitzy world of disco with this sizzling hot DLC that adds a burst of retro energy to your hotel renovations.

title: BobsleighX
description: You will feel the thrill of speed in the BobsleighX.

title: DNF Duel: DLC 2 - Brawler
description: 'Brawler' can be used in DNF Duel.

title: Red Tie Runner
description: Red Tie Runner is a simple but challenging 2D platformer. Put on a red tie and step into stick-figure shoes to navigate through 30 levels so intense you might just forget about the impending heat death of the universe.

title: Travis' Coward Combustion
description:
In this fast-paced action platformer, you delve into Lost Angeles, a city plagued by supernatural parasites called "wisps". Aside from looking suspiciously cute and marketable, wisps can possess human hosts and give them supernatural abilities in exchange for the person's free will. When a wisp gets bored enough, it breaks the connection to find a new host, leaving the current one behind with severe injuries in the process.

In order to protect the city, a governmental organization was created: P.C.E., which exists to Protect, Contain and Exterminate this threat and keep Lost Angeles at peace.

But what happens when someone is unfortunate enough to be possessed by no mere wisp, but one megalomaniac enough to drag its host around in a rampage quest?

title: Susan Taxpayer
description: Susan Taxpayer is a free 2D platformer made in the SMBX2 engine, meant to imitate the likes of the later Wario Land games, with music by the Super Lesbian Animal RPG Composer, Beatrix Quinn! Follow Susan and her coworker Franky as she powers through the worst workday ever. Help her platform through a myriad of office-themed levels, from orientation videos to mailrooms to forests made of printer paper!

title: The Moshpit Tournament
description:
"The Moshpit" is a Horde Mode TPS Single Player game, where you gun down waves of enemy Cyphers that assault you from every side!

Waves ​have a fixed set of points to be won. The faster you complete the wave & squash your opponents, the MORE points you'll WIN!

title: Spasms of Stupidity
description: PC wargame-Roguelike, inspired from DragonForce(Saturn)

title: 100 Halloweens
description: Trapped in a mansion filled with 100 years of darkness... Fight or hide, stay alive and set things right.

title: Nextbots In The Backrooms
description: They only look ridiculous at first glance, but they're not! Run. Don't stop, don't try to hide, just run!

title: CryptoClash
description: Welcome to CryptoClash, the ultimate free-to-play multiplayer shooter that thrusts you into a cyberpunk world like no other. Are you ready to dominate the neon-soaked chaos and emerge as a legendary champion?

title: City Ambulance Car Driving
description: Take ill people to emergency hospital in this ambulance game. If you like to play simulation games, this ambulance game is for you.

title: GravytX The Gravytoid
description: Play as GravytX an alien who has the ability to control objects remotely and manipulate gravity. Travel the universe to save the peoples who are under the domination of the Vodouas (Malicious beings who want to conquer the universe) and bring peace to their Planets.

title: NBA 2K24: 25th Anniversary Edition
description: Grab your squad and experience the past, present, and future of hoops culture in NBA 2K24. Enjoy loads of pure, authentic action and limitless personalized MyPlayer options in MyCareer. Collect an impressive array of legends and build your perfect lineup in MyTEAM. Feel more responsive gameplay and polished visuals while playing with your favorite NBA and WNBA teams.

title: I Can Transform
description: In this game you will use your special costume which allows you to transform into mechanical objects (car, rocket, helicopter, magnet, motorcycle, ...) to avoid obstacles, collect vortex gems in levels and defeat the Assas (the bad guys who want to destroy the world).

title: Light and Shadows: Pocket Islands
description: Light and Shadows: Pocket Islands is a spin-off made for fun, inspired by the retro game of peak 8 where the levels are only simple and challenging while progressing​.

title: ScooMart
description: ScooMart is an indie horror game that plunges you into a meticulously crafted world filled with dread and suspense. As the protagonist, you stumble upon the gas station while on a dreaded road trip. What begins as a routine stop for gas quickly turns into a nightmare of supernatural proportions.

title: Jammo
description: This was an individual project to learn about game development. The game is a third person shooter with some platforming. As you progress through the levels, you will be able to access an array of guns and abilities to help through the game.

title: Hentai Vivian
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Scary Maze Game
description: You and up to 5 friends need to find the exit of a maze, beware of the monster that lurks in the shadows.

title: Escape from Toilets
description: Escape from Toilets is a coop horror game 1 to 4 players in a session. Go through strange rooms, escape from toilets that want to kill you and other dangers in the form of challenges and puzzles. Realistic graphics, easy controls and creepy atmosphere will immerse you in the game.

title: Play Minigames with Reiko
description: Build an unbreakable friendship with Reiko as you earn tickets and have fun with over 30 minigames in the exciting world of 'Play Minigames with Reiko'.

title: Dreamsweeper
description:
The floor isn’t lava, it’s Minesweeper!
A Dungeon Crawler x Minesweeper Roguelike and a lo-fi musical experience like no other game before.
Navigate worlds by solving Minesweeper rooms and fight your anxieties with the power of lo-fi music. This is the story of a girl who goes to sleep listening to music every night, and awakens in a dream world to face her nightmarish anxieties.

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - When Shadows Dance
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter, two Legendary Weapons, and one Legendary consumable: Hayalî (Legendary Hunter), Karagöz (Legendary Springfield 1866) , Hacivat (Legendary Scottfield Model 3 Swift) & Lamba (Legendary Alert Trip Mine)

title: Black Smith 4
description: You are a blacksmith in a small rural village. You steadfastly earn your living by hammering out products daily, but at night, you take your earnings and go to town to seek out innocent and cute girls. Continue improving your experience and skills, so that you can raise the price of your products.

title: College Sex Party
description: Welcome to the world of College Sex Party - an exciting visual novel that immerses you in an unforgettable and enticing student life!

title: Froggin' Around
description: A little frog in a little pond eatin' bugs, takin' naps, and just froggin' around.

title: Hot Lap Racing
description: Awaken Your Inner Champion! Hot Lap Racing is a simcade racing game where you will discover the history of motorsport from GT Cross to Formula 1 and race against your friends or compete against players online!

title: Degradation: Kyomu's Fury
description: Fight viruses, survive insane waves of rays and bullets, and find out more about the inhabitants of the Network in this mix of exploration and 3D bullet-hell/FPS game.

title: Paraido
description: Paraido is a unique and relaxing puzzle game. Complete levels by moving and rotating hexagonal-shapes into their correct positions.

title: Secrets of the Room 3: The Girl Group Back to the Night
description: Wake up to attach themselves to love beans, it is said that our group to collapse the house? Return to the night, but the sound source was stolen by hackers; Female group members black material scandal is constantly exposed; A thrilling bureau in the bureau, launched at this point......

title: Close to Flight
description: Grab your grappling hook and pack your bag and swing through the skies, filled with floating islands and colourful characters eagerly awaiting new adventures!

title: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
description: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

title: Yeon-oh and Seo
description: Success and failure, love and friendship, dream and reality. The story about our choices in the meantime. A real passionate romance interactive game.

title: The Boy and the Cathedral
description: Drawn to a mysterious cathedral, a boy sets out to unlock its secret.

title: Hana Exposure! A Blooming Flower
description: Hana Exposure! is an exhibitionism focused narrative RPG. Follow Hana as she works and spends time in River Town, where she will get into embarrassing situations, unintentionally become exposed, wear revealing outfits, and slowly awaken her exhibitionist side!

title: How to Lose One's Virginity
description: "How to Lose One's Virginity" is an adult visual novel that describes the process of self-discovery... and hot beauties. Playing the role of a loser, are you able to change your life and become someone women are very fond of and build your own harem?

title: Spirit of the Island: Adventureland
description: Rejoice, Adventurers: A brand new way to entertain your guests is coming up to the tropical world of Spirit of the Island. Please welcome: Adventureland! Are you ready to build your own tropical amusement park?

title: Myth or Reality: Mystery of the Lake - Collector's Edition
description: Follow the footsteps of the Loch Ness monster and reveal the secret of the legendary Loch Ness Lake! Better be careful to avoid being another appetizer for Nessie…

title: Rubinite
description: "Rubinite" is a dark fantasy boss rush action game that utilizes the unique mechanic "Focus" to pinpoint enemies' weaknesses and execute thrust attacks. Follow Ruby, a princess who has escaped from the Scarlet Kingdom, embarking on a journey of revenge to reclaim her kingdom.

title: Highway Getway
description: "Highway Getway" is a car parkour type game. The player controls a car to drive on the highway. There is a lot of game money on the road. The player can get the game money when he controls the car.

title: Aboriginal
description: Embark on an epic adventure in "Aboriginal," tapping into inherited powers and unraveling ancestral mysteries. Traverse India and the mystic Tiroti Islands, inspired by the real-life isolated Sentinel Island in the Indian Ocean, on a journey of self-discovery and redemption.

title: Endless RPG: Untold Tales
description: Craft a party of diverse characters, each with customizable skills and looks. Explore a living world with dynamic day-night cycles, changing seasons, and diverse biomes. Embark on an epic journey where you shape your destiny as the director of your unique story.

title: Unparalleled
description: This is a wonderful little game.

title: Sanguo's Ambition 4: Three Kingdoms
description: The world's first competitive SLG strategy game with real-time matchmaking for multiplayer battles. In 《Three Kingdoms Ambition 4》 you can experience the unique journey of starting as a small faction and growing into a powerful warlord during the turbulent Three Kingdoms era.

title: Chroma Wars
description: A retro, turn-based strategy game on a square-map where you engage in techno-fantasy warfare! Command magical armies, repel abyssal foes, and conquer the world in high-skill strategic battles.

title: Freaky Trip
description: Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself. In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere.

title: Eden's Guardian
description: Where shadow falls, it begins. Dive into Eden's Guardian, a challenging metroidvania experience with handmade pixel art set in a world with medieval and fantasy aesthetics devastated by conflict where the history of Gods and humans intertwine.

title: Alien
description: 'Alien' is a cartoon style 2D platform jumping type game. Players need to control their characters to avoid the enemy and finally reach the end to win.

title: School Girl Simulator
description: School Girl Simulator game has two players in a high-security school - a fragile and brash student against a strict and fierce teacher. The student's task is to find a way to pass the exams and not be caught, while the teacher has to catch her and punish her.

title: Survivors
description: Break through the siege and welcome the dawn of victory! Eight skills, twelve maps, three hundred talents, top-down survival Roguelike game! Through repeated battles, the character becomes stronger and more fearless, surrounded by monsters.

title: Liminal Border Part I
description: First game of a four-part visual novel series. Nerdy Itsuki Ninomae accidentally creates a “digital hypnotism movie.” Showing it to his neighbor causes him to learn her and a classmate’s dark secret, dragging him into the underbelly of society.

title: Trials of Randoom
description: Trials Of Randoom is a unique puzzle game with immense challenges and great mysteries. Each level is unique and your experience will be unforgettable as you solve the puzzles to advance through the different levels.

title: Malkin
description: Malkin is a 2D, hand-drawn, atmospheric RPG. A quest to find the blood of a murderer leads a witch into ever deeper mysteries. Expect intricate storylines with multiple endings and combat that poses a balanced challenge.

title: Silent Paws: Winter Quest
description: Embark on an enchanting journey with Silent Paws: Winter Quest, where the fate of a mystical world rests in your paws. As a cunning fox, you must venture forth into a breathtakingly immersive landscape teetering on the brink of eternal winter.

title: Necroslayer
description: Necroslayer is a dark fantasy styled, open world roguelite game. Play as one of several characters unlocked through the story, in first person action combat, with meta progression to improve stats and survivability each play through.

title: Jackpot 3
description: Jackpot 3 is a casual game. Before starting the game, you need to bet first. After the bet, the small ball will start to turn again. When the small ball stops on a certain number, that number is the winning number.

title: The Merlies
description: Meet the Merlies, a tiny birds community trying to find harmony in a world where the remains of an ancient civilisation are still visible. Build your village ingeniously, gather your birdies and explore this way-too-big world in this cute post-apocalyptic adventure ! Ready to spread your wings?

title: Relight The Dark
description: Relight The Dark is a short horror experience about a girl living with her abusive mother. After finding some dark secrets about her mother, the girl has to find a way to escape the house and get to safety.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 1: Archer's Paradox
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: Milu Milan
description: Milu Milan is a casual game of architectural maze exploration and puzzle solving.

title: Playtown
description: Playtown is a horror game set in a kid's abandoned indoor playground. Roam the abandoned kids play areas to uncover and find your daughter's necklace, while unraveling the mystery surrounding the once happy place. Remember, you are not alone - as danger can be lurking at every corner.

title: Live Hard, Die Hard
description: I can't live like this! But, I won't die like this either! Do you want a mix of hard battles and cutting-edge medical treatment?! Then Live Hard, Die Hard is the strategy game for you! Use violence and science to stop the invasion and get those pesky aliens off of our planet!

title: Crisol: Theater of Idols
description: What would you do if your blood were your only weapon? How much would you sacrifice your life? Experience the unholy island of Tormentosa in this twisted first-person adventure full of horror and action where only your blood can be used to defeat the impious creatures that roam therein.

title: Fishyphus
description: Traverse an impressionistic sea, listening for predator and prey. Cast a lure and feel their cues to reel them in. The reaper slowly tracks your movements, who you must outmaneuver to survive.

title: Mineral Madness
description: Mineral Madness is a fast-paced battle arena where you go head-to-head against rival moles as you race to collect the most minerals. Create mayhem as you blast your way through the fully destructible underground to become the number one mole miner!

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 2: Hunting Grounds
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 3: First Ones
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 4: Impossible Objects
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 5: Europa's Folly
description: Immerse yourself in the role of Camina Drummer, the Executive Officer aboard the Artemis, a scavenging ship hunting for a big score in the outer regions of the Belt. You must corral a crew rife with tense relationships and powerful personalities, and make tough decisions that will decide everyone’s fate.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Archangel Bonus Episode
description: A bonus DLC episode for The Expanse announced as part of its Deluxe Edition and set to be released after the 5 episode story is finished in September.

title: Kill The Topulus
description: Kill The Topulus is a simple first person shooter, shoot accurately to survive the attacks of giant rats and become a master of the Topulus by completing all the challenges in each level.

title: Another Reverie
description: A small game about moving on.

title: Lylia's Deadline
description: Lylia's Deadline is an action-platformer inspired by games such as Mega Man X, focusing on new mechanics and movements.

title: Mr. Triangle Mania 2
description: Mr. Triangle Mania 2 is a platformer-shooter game with a stupid and wacky meme filled plot.

title: HooperVania
description: Welcome to HooperVania, a free and non-profit French fan game celebrating Castlevania, the French videomaker Hooper, his community, and video games as a whole! Navigate through various stages using the famous Vampire Killer to defeat numerous enemies, and large bosses and ultimately vanquish Dracula himself!

title: The Chronos Event
description: The Chronos Event is a fast-paced third-person shooter that emphasizes the tactics of time travel and fast, aggressive play. Players rewind time, battling alongside their younger selves against overwhelming opposition.

title: Superior Relatives
description: Superior Relatives is a couch-based multiplayer fighting game. Choose from a variety of balls and battle it out with up to four players in online multiplayer. Enjoy a variety of maps and characters, as you battle it out to be the ultimate champion.

title: Foxes Need to Eat
description: Control an adorable fox in scenarios full of traps and obstacles.

title: Cosmic Cowabunnies
description: Play as "Sauce," the Grey Alien, on a critical mission to hide alien evidence from humanity. Abduct, rescue, mine, and unravel Earth's mysteries. Battle formidable foes and prove your skills on the intergalactic leaderboard. Prevent disclosure, or the truth is out!

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 6
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki accepting an invitation from her friend Sienna to go out drinking in a club, only to end up fucked in the restroom by the blonde's cocky boyfriend.

title: Golf With Your Friends: Peaceful Pines Course
description: Become one with nature with the new Peaceful Pines Pack.

title: EXE Clash
description: A platform fighting game featuring many spooky video game creepypastas.

title: Shuumatsu no Valkyrie Humanity's Last Hope
description: It is a game created for the SNV community to recreate the most epic battles in anime.

title: SMB RMX Land
description: One Day In Sarasaland, Mario (Or Whoever You Are Playing As) is running through the desert and Encounters Thicc Boi Who Is Wielding The Phantom Ruby. The Hero Gets Teleported Away To Another Part Of The Desert And Meets A Wiggler Named Harold And A Snorpler Named Gerald. The Two Siblings Are Trying To Stop Thicc Boi From Destroying The Fabric Of Reality. The Hero And The Two Worm Brothers Set Out Two Stop Thicc Boi Before It Is Too Late...

title: Super Smash Bros. CMC+
description: CMC+ (stands for Character Making Community) is the biggest official modpack to date, including many, many character and stage mods both released here and exclusive to the modpack itself, as well as a myriad of perks and features that the other builds currently doesn't allow for (an all new Assist system, the ability to assign stages to characters for them to appear in in Classic Mode, alongside many more!).

title: Transylmania Deluxe
description:
Vampy is back with a remake of the classic Flash game! Relive your childhood and revisit the castle!
Transylmania Deluxe is a remake of Transylmania, a game once available on Zeeks and Funschool.

title: Swolemochao 1 & 2: Gym of the Year Edition
description:
Ready to get swole? Swolemochao has a workout routine for you! But, it seems there's something odd about him, as if he's testing you more than training you. Find out the truth! Afterwards, find out what happened when Dr. Robotnik finds the fate of Swolemochao's mission. A depressed Player encounters Dr. Robotnik's newest scheme, the Mean Muscle Machine! Can you succeed with the perils that unfold?

Slapped together in a single package, Swolemochao 1 & 2: Gym of the Year Edition offers both games for you with remastered art and updated gameplay changes to improve upon the original 12 hour made first game, and extra bells and whistles for the not-made-in-12-hours sequel!

title: Luigi and the Quest for Nothing 2
description: After the events of Luigi and the Quest for Nothing, a mysterious figure snags the Nothing away from Luigi. I think he didn't like that. So off he went again to find this figure, along with his friend, the Green Toad. But little did both Luigi and this mysterious figure know of the importance of "The Nothing"... As you go through the worlds you will meet new unlikely allys, who will tell you about what exactly is happening in the world... or worlds... or universe?

title: Sonic Arena
description: Sonic Arena is a Fighting game that was finished after 17 years.

title: Monster World IV Regenesis
description: Monster World IV Regenesis is a fan-made role-playing game to celebrate the 35th anniversary of Wonder Boy. It features combat that expands on the original Monster World IV formula along with combat directly inspired by the popular ATB (Active Time Battle) system introduced in Final Fantasy IV, but with its own unique gimmicks.

title: Mario and Luigi: Superstar Simulator
description: Mario and Luigi: Superstar Simulator focuses on the battle elements of the Mario and Luigi series and enhances them with new enemies to fight and characters to play as. The playable characters range from the usual such as Mario, Luigi, and Bowser, but there are also some characters you wouldn't expect in this format such as Paper Mario, Sonic, or even Peppino from Pizza Tower. Each battle has something special and unique to bring to the table, like a new mechanic while dodging or a phase 2 that changes things up. There are some extra things to do as well, like playing minigames or going on bounty missions by collecting wanted posters in the overworld/HUB area.

title: Wario in Generic RPG: Chapter 2
description: Wario in Generic RPG follows Wario, as he is thrust into being the hero of an entire kingdom, trying to find pieces of an ancient artifact to save the kingdom from an unknown enemy. The game pokes fun at common RPG tropes, while also including a surprisingly deep story at its core. In the upcoming chapter 2, he meets an eccentric ringleader, who needs help reuniting his circus troupe to put on one, last show. Will you be the hero the kingdom needs?

title: Sonic LaserDisc
description: Sonic LaserDisc is a fangame that tributes to Sonic CD, focused on exploration and puzzles based on time travel.

title: Tails Adventure Remake
description: Tails Adventure Remake is a fan-made remake of the Game Gear game for modern platforms, adding 16:9 widescreen, high refresh rate support, improved physics, controls, and enemies' behavior.

title: Sonic Horizons
description: Sonic Horizons is an open-zone fangame inspired by Sonic Frontiers that aims to take the foundation of the open-zone formula that Frontiers established and expand on it in a different direction, focusing more on physics-based platforming/exploration, thinking outside the box, and generally forging your own path along the journey.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Gearhead
description: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Gearhead is the fourth episode of the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG series,

title: Battle Cross Fever
description: Prepare yourself for this brand-new age of fighting game with never-before-seen mechanics!

title: Sonic Treading Power
description: Sonic Treading Power is a fan game made for SAGE 2023.

title: Éclipse The Cat
description: ​Éclipse The Cat is a semi-linear platform game that focuses on the variety of situations. Over the course of fast-paced levels, the player will unlock power-ups (running, dashing, flying, etc.) that will help them defeat the game's many bosses.​

title: Super Mario Bros. Friends
description: Join Mario and the kids from Mushroom Heights to rescue his brother Luigi!!!

title: Freedom Planet: Shang Mu Architect
description: Freedom Planet: Shang Mu Architect is an unofficial stage builder fan game set after the events of the first Freedom Planet, featuring its own campaign mode to showcase the capabilities of the editor.

title: Rushdown Rivals
description: Drive back evil robotic versions of several NG characters as your own NG icon. Stylishly dance through them as Cassette Girl, shoot them with Hank's personal arsenal, unleash Girlfriend's inner demon, and so much more in this tough-as-nails action game

title: Wilfred the Hero, Part 1
description: Game created for RPG Maker 2003 by Brandon Abley and Teo Mathlein with the initial objective of making a console-style RPG unlike any other created with the engine. Features 100% user-created content and no RPG Maker 2003-default game systems.

title: MicroSstep
description: "MicroSStep" is an exhilarating 2D action roguelite where you control "Cross", a dual-wielding girl who becomes infinitely stronger, and defeats monsters. Create the strongest swordsman by combining the items and skills you get each time you level up or clear a stage.

title: Experiment
description: You don't know where you are but you know you need to get out. Figuring how, managing your resources, solving puzzles and fighting/avoiding enemies.

title: Kitsunetsuki Project
description: Multiplayer-focused arena third-person shooter (TPS) game in anime style

title: Snakes LTD
description: Casual Snakes Combat. Kill other snakes and grow as much as you can.

title: Beat 'Em All
description: Beat 'Em All is a very crazy, fast, and weird platformer in which you need to beat everyone in your way!

title: Esper Girls
description: Esper Girls is a 2D action platformer game inspired by the many Japanese retro, actiony, and arcadey types of games that populated consoles like the Sega Genesis and Playstation, and a little bit of GBA as well.

title: Tacti-Cat
description: Tacti-Cat is a fast paced, momentum based, platformer where you play as Ellie the cat and use fish guns to save the world from an evil wizard invasion!

title: Fuu3's Fuun Journey
description: Fuu3's Fuun Journey is a 2D platformer that stars the titular Fuu3 on an adventure he’s clearly not ready for, but he’s gonna do it. Someone has to! Joined with his friends Fuu6 and Fuu9, he must make his way through weird and unknown locations in order to stop the nefarious Minus3 and his dastardly team from finding and controlling the remaining paloomanium, an element thought to grant the user powers beyond reality. Will you have the upper hand? Or will you fail and suffer under the might of Minus3? Only one way to find out: BE THERE OR BE SQUARE!

title: Welcome to the Game 2+
description: Welcome to the Game 2+ is a mod for Welcome to the Game 2 that adds a ton of new websites, new enemies, new items, new modes, twitch integration and more.

title: Fix the Lab!
description: Lucas, a newly hired young scientist's assistant, accidentally turns the lab into chaos! Now he must retrieve the gears to fix the machines before his boss returns.

title: Nicolás the Sea Urchin
description:
One day, Nicolás was hungry, so he decides to make a seaweed burger, but something he didn't know is that the burger was the most perfect burger that was ever cooked.
Suddenly, Loquendumbo breaks into his house and steals the burger! Don't let that bastard easily get away with your burger, control Nicolás and travel through the inmense and amazing underwater world!

title: Galactic Blasters D2: Brilliant Supernova
description: Galactic Blasters D2 - Brilliant Supernova is the fifth entry in the horizontal space shooter game series Galactic Blasters.

title: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest
description: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest is a 2D platforming game that takes inspiration from classic platformers such as Sonic, and fighting games like Mortal Kombat.
