The game aims to be a combination of classic 2D platforming with 1v1 fighting whilst also exploring the large forest of Veredilia across various locales with a wide range of characters, technical movesets, and flashy combos. You can take control of one of 3 characters, each with their own special moves, combos, and super moves. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and kick, punch, and slash your way to victory, before it's too late. Do you have what it takes?

title: Geno 2 the Generals' Orders
description: Take out demonic generals that have taken over the planet! Destroy giga robots, save the cities, give the citizens their homes back, and stop the reign of terror from the 6 masterminds. Collect power orbs to unlock new areas and explore the open world of each location.

title: Terry's Treasure Trouble!
description:
Terry T. Cat is back, and he's going to hop-and-bop and cartwheel his way through the Feyside Islands in search of a mysterious lost treasure!
After finding a treasure map on the beach, our old cartoon cat Terry decides to go off to a land of adventure. However, a gang of pirates, led by the notorious Grand Beard, are also in pursuit of this legendary treasure, and will stop at nothing to get it.
Along the way, Terry will find Star Fairies willing to take a hit for him, ladders and bars to hang on to, bouncy springs, ridable vehicles, Mode 7 Special Stages, and minigames. Oh, and coins. Lots and lots of coins.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Shang Tsung
description:
Play as the powerful sorcerer Shang Tsung.

included as a pre-order bonus for the game and available 5 days early with the Premium or Kollector's Edition of the game.

title: Russian Roulette
description:
Russian Roulette is a 3D action game, and the first game published by Buka, formerly only a distributor in Russia.

A ring of planets, connected by galactic portals has become lost in space. The planets are devastated and the portals have been disassembled. It is up to you to you to find the missing parts of the portals so they can be reactivated.

You can exit and enter any vehicle you encounter at will, and many have turrets that can rotate independently. In some levels you will be accompanied by an NPC who will guide you to the next portal part.

title: Russian Roulette II: The Next Worlds
description:
Russian Roulette II: The Next Worlds is a 3D shooter and sequel to Russian Roulette.

In the game you have to, again, unite six planets through the activation of galactic portals. Each of the planets features a completely different theme, ranging from prehistoric, to medieval and futuristic.

You can move around the worlds freely, both on foot or using the various vehicles available to you, including tanks, jeeps, space ships, or even live dragons or giant grasshoppers.

title: Road Wars
description: Self billed as the "most realistic combat racing sim ever created", Road Wars is a driving and shooting game where twelve different characters race their armed and armored vehicles across a dozen assorted tracks. Although the emphasis is on racing and completing laps, cars are equipped with a variety of weapons to impede the progress of the other drivers including gatling guns, missiles, oil slicks, and land mines. Individual drivers also have personal advantages such as cheaper repairs or better traction. Players can compete in single races or three different league circuits of increasing difficulty. Each league season consists of eight races where drivers use their cash winnings for repairs and upgrades between the stages.

title: Click For Cash: Cashed Out
description:
it's time to click till you're filthy rich... again!

Welcome to Click For Cash: Cashed Out, the best idle clicker game about yellow buttons since the original Click For Cash! This sequel is filled to the brim with new features, customization, and polish. In this game you click a button for cash (real original, I know), purchase a variety of upgrades to get more money, and unlock achievements to become the richest person in the universe! at least in the game...

title: Moorhuhn: Die ersten 10 Jahre
description: Moorhuhn: Die ersten 10 Jahre is a Action game bundle developed by Software Pyramide and published by phenomedia publishing gmbh in 2009.

title: Porterminus
description:
Porterminus is a spooky RPG.

It follows the story of a girl named Julie, her boyfriend Donnie, and a mysterious cat.

Warning: Although the graphics are all pixel art, it has rather intense body horror, please keep that in mind before deciding to play.

title: KilaFlow
description: Play as the mascot of a blazing fast (for it's time) antivirus software to clear out corruptions and viruses from various devices around a town.

title: Manufactur'inc.
description: Lead your new company to success in this industry management game. Blueprint and optimize your production; make ethical choices to influence your worker conditions, ecological impact, automation level, and more. Will you create a simple manuFactory or a beneFactory?

title: Nuclear Cheetah
description:
Bounce, pounce, and slide your way through fast-paced levels as Chaz, the radioactive cheetah! This retro platformer inspired by the likes of Sonic the Hedgehog and Jazz Jackrabbit features a high skill ceiling, crispy pixel art, and a bangin’ MIDI-styled soundtrack.

Nuclear Cheetah combines time attack platforming with a collect-a-thon progression system. Play through and master challenging stages, earn power orbs to unlock new areas of the castle, and save the princess; all while uncovering the story of how a once mild-mannered cheetah transformed into a green gangsta who eats toxic waste for breakfast.

title: Refind Self: The Personality Test Game
description:
All players approach games in varied ways, making different choices.

No one ever plays in exactly the same way. Indeed, how a person plays can be an indicator of their personality...

And Refind Self is a game where you can learn all about that personality.

title: The Detective Reaper Invites
description:
Invitation from the Detective Grim Reaper is a roguelite deduction game.
As the detective grim reaper, your job is to solve randomly generated murder cases, find the culprit, and execute them.

title: Outer Outage
description:
UH OH!! A little alien named Blemie got his ship stolen by the EVIL robot Retri whilst on vacation to the Planet Cluster! What will he do now!? Well he's gotta find the Outages, creatures that possess insane electrical energy and can take out the high tech security measures Retri has set up.

So now... jump, dash, drop and LAUNCH through all of Planet Cluster for these Outages! Game contains 13 whole open sandbox collectathon stages, 8 bossfights (3 mini bosses too) and fast paced, adrenaline pumping collectathon gameplay! All tied together with a vibrant, mixed media art style and a 2.5D, surreal aesthetic.

title: Hugo Gold
description: Hugo Gold is a compilation video game developed and published by ITE Media in 1998. It is a collection of 12 minigames from the classic Hugo games, including a special version of Labyrinth from Skærmtrolden Hugo.

title: K.S.-n-Kickin
description:
K.S.-n-Kickin is a 3D action puzzle video game made by Artworld UK and Big Future Ltd. for Kinder Surprise, with music licensed from Telstar Records. It was released for Microsoft Windows. The game was a promotion by Ferrero to "strengthen their foothold in the younger age group market". The game features Kinder Surprise toys from the K00 series.

The game was not sold in stores, but was offered in exchange for Kinder Egg wrappers which were sent to Ferrero. The promotion was advertised via TV commercials. K.S.-n-Kickin has the same map layout and soundtrack as Gubble 2 (part of the Gubble video game series), but has different backgrounds, characters, and items.

title: Trudy's Time and Place House
description: Trudy's Time and Place House (aka Lisa: La maison du temps et de l'espace) is a video game published in 1995 on Windows by Edmark Corporation. It's an educational game, set in a math / logic and pre-school / toddler themes, and was also released on Windows 3.x.

title: Rise of a Hero
description: Clear the areas captured by terrorists in Syria from terrorists and rescue the hostages.

title: Pokémon Ancestral X
description: Ancestral X is a difficulty hack of Pokémon X, built primarily for Nuzlocking, and otherwise inspired by popular hacks from Drayano, Buffel, and NotSuicuu. This is intended to be a truly challenging experience, but you’ll also find features common to enhancement hacks throughout. All 721 Pokémon are available, the leveling curve has been revamped, quality of life improvements are in place, and trainer battles are custom built and significantly harder. Best of all, Ancestral X introduces a number of features never before seen in Gen 6 hacks, including the ORAS Megas, Mobile PC, Trainer Natures, and Custom AI!

title: Pokemon Black 2: DE
description: Pokemon Black 2: DE offers an authentic Unova experience with a region almost exclusively filled with double-battles, a "challenging-but-not-kaizo" difficulty level, balance changes to improve viability and variety, postgame and all-new content within the main adventure, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements!

title: Amalgamation
description: A short space gothic diorama featuring the lesser known astronomical body, the brown dwarf. An atmospheric visual novel-type game.

title: It's Real And It Kills
description: 9 old school vanilla maps featuring Castlevania music and Realm667 textures.

title: Intrusion
description: Doomguy invades a techbase full of demons. This is my first map that uses custom textures, and used Essel's amazing pack.

title: Ruined District
description: Ruined District is a short city map for RAMP 2023 back in June, now revised and playing/looking a bit better than its first version. Adding traps to some areas and making the map just a tad harder overall.

title: The Green Machine
description: he Green Machine is a 12-level PK3 for Doom II that requires the GZDoom source port to play. It was the second mapset created by speedrunner Andrea Rovenski (Cyberdemon531), and features such additions as decorate monsters, 3D floors and scripted events. Released in November 2014 as part of her continuing SecretDoom series, The Green Machine features medium to hard maps, with improved atmosphere and level design over her initial offering, Disrepair.

title: Hell's Memento
description: Hell's Memento is a 12-Map GZDoom wad that has heavy inspiration from classic wads like "Memento Mori", "TNT Evilution", "Requiem", etc. with GZDoom features such as 3D Floors, ACS Scripts, and Decorate Powerups/Monsters.

title: Disrepair 2
description: Disrepair 2 is an 11 map episode for GZDoom that expands upon the ideas and themes of my original Secretdoom episode "Disrepair" and transforms it into a new expansive world. This mapset features new monster types, new music, new textures, and of course new maps .

title: A War On Christmas
description: After reports of a mass slaughtering of good little children by a crazed man in a Santa suit, you track them down to one final stand-off. This is A War On Christmas...

title: Existential Dread
description: Existential Dread was a warmup project, to get back into making doom maps and vanilla in particular.

title: Autophagy
description: Autophagy.WAD is an old school megawad aiming for a mixture of Evilution, Scythe, Demonfear, and other classic experiences. Levels range from very easy to moderately challenging. This should be played in dsda-doom -complevel 2. 33 retro maps with fast and intense action!

title: Guilty: Ashlar
description: This is an easy to get started role-playing, adventure and exploration single player game that tells the exciting story of several criminals who experience adventures in a desolate and forbidden world.

title: Ep. Kazoku
description: A first-person Japanese horror game.

title: Chilla's Art: The Kidnap
description: The Kidnap is a Japanese horror game about a kidnapping incident.

title: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 2
description: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 2 contains additional content that allows you to use Personas from Persona 5 Royal.

title: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 1
description: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 1 contains additional content that allows you to use Personas from Persona 5 Royal.

title: Zeitghast
description: Run, dash, shoot, and slash your way through a mechanized prehistoric world in this fast paced platformer-shooter. Keep your eye on the clock while trying to stop an evil mad scientist from disrupting the timeline!

title: Vampires' Melody 2
description: Emerald seas! Blue skies! Sandy beaches! An island adventure in the ocean sounds like a trip to paradise. However, the place is a nightmare with no one to provide any blood for Raylan to feed on after he turned into a vampire by accident, especially since he has another hungry vampire at his side.

title: Warrior Next
description: Few against many... Fight with a handful of Spartans to save Greece. Destroy hordes of enemies until the fight with creatures sent by the Gods. Lots of action for everyone!

title: What The Gravity
description: Prepare for the electrifying space adventure as a delivery specialist in the legendary United Space Force (USF). Embark on a high-octane delivery run, navigating treacherous space battlefields, and defying all odds to ensure the success of your critical mission - before the beer gets warm.

title: Where's My Loot?
description: Where's My Loot? is a hidden object game in a fantasy world. The loot from your last adventure was lost. Search around and find all your precious items back.

title: Whispers of an Elven Captor
description: Whispers of an Elven Captor is an erotic visual novel. As a captive, you're questioned by elven Ayelith, eager to prove herself and protect her realm. Reluctance sparks an intimate exchange of questions, escalating to daring demands over time. From reserved to explicit, Ayelith's journey unfolds.

title: Wings of Seduction : Bust 'em out!
description: Clothing Damage + Survivor + Gear Mods >>> A woman is in danger! Do what must be done… Rip her clothes off! Oh, get your mind out of the gutter, it's the only way to save the world! Grab awesome weapons, sick skills and gear, and get ready for a unique, roguelike shoot-em-up each time you play!

title: Tank Battle Resist
description: In the face of a large number of fierce enemy steel torrents, the real warrior is not afraid of danger. Come on, let's defeat the enemy and protect our camp together.

title: The Blogger
description: The Blogger is a third-person horror game focused on story, exploration, and solving simple puzzles to progress through a terrifying atmosphere. Take control of our protagonist, a young photographer for a horror blog.

title: Telluria: Forebodings Gear Minigame
description: Help Annelise open the doors of the water mill (1st Age) or the library (3rd Age) solving visual and textual riddles.

title: The Castle Mystery
description: A first-person horror game where you step into the shoes of a historian who, on a solo mission, receives a tempting invitation to explore a long-abandoned castle. Drawn by the promise of a generous reward, you accept the offer without hesitation.

title: Swordeye
description: A hardcore MMO slasher with brutal directional combat. Explore massive, persistent PvPvE dungeons where every fight matters. Fight your way to the top, or die trying.

title: SickOw
description: This is an RPG game where you will follow our protagonist to fight and save lives!

title: Soulstone of Hope
description: Embark on a heroic journey in this captivating fantasy turn-based JRPG. Choose your path as a fearless Warrior, cunning Rogue, or powerful Mage, each with unique abilities. Form unbreakable bonds with your companions and uncover the secrets of the forgotten catacombs.

title: Soulgasm
description: Come in, come in! Immerse yourself in a dating sim adventure filled with romance and intrigue. Wander through the Palace's hidden chambers, unravel its mysteries, build lasting bonds, and woo the ladies! Let your choices guide your path as you enhance your Eromancy skills. Your love story awaits!

title: Son of the Dragon King
description: Son of the Dragon King, a beat 'em up action saga, with captivating storytelling at its core, RPG-like character growth, and intricate crafting. Your path—a blend of honor and redemption—will decide feudal Japan's fate. Can you emerge as the champion, facing down the elemental warlords?

title: Smokey's Rescue Team
description: Smokey's Rescue Team is a cat rescue/adoption simulator that allows you to interact and look after cats that have been abandoned in front of your home. You will need to take care of all the cats and make sure they are fed and happy until you can find them a new home.

title: Six Ears
description: This is an RPG game where you will follow our protagonist to fight and save lives!

title: Space Mining Company
description: Dive into the exciting adventure and conquer your own business in Space Mining Company - a world of limitless possibilities! Prepare to scour the solar system for precious ores and sell them for profit.

title: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles: Samurai Clans
description: Revolution is afoot in the land of the rising sun. The shogun’s power is fading fast, while rival warlords muster their troops as they plot their ascent to the throne.

title: Steel Roamer
description: Immerse yourself in Steel Roamer's chilling experience, trapped in an RV, pitted against unimaginable terrors lurking outside. Driving is your only goal.

title: Super Retro Rec League Racing
description: Race against the clock in Super Retro Rec League Racing! Perfect your lines, optimize every turn, time your pits, and push yourself to absolute mastery.

title: Super Paul World
description: Experience a great adventure in "Super Paul World" where you defeat many enemies while trying to retrieve the Cookie Nexus Core for Baker Tim. Earn experience points (EXP) to acquire various cosmetic items.

title: Sushi for Empress Setsuko
description: “Sushi for Empress Setsuko” is a cozy fishing game, yuri dating sim, and point & click adventure set in a fantastical Japan-inspired land. Follow Mizumi Nagashima as she travels around the Empire, seeing gorgeous views, catching delicious fish, and charming beautiful women.

title: The Backrooms Recorded
description: Navigate a nightmarish labyrinth, avoid eerie entities, and uncover dark secrets in this liminality based horror game. Explore realistic levels, unravel secrets, and figure out life or death puzzles. Will you escape the madness? Brought to you by a solo 13 year old dev.

title: Project DarkHeaZ
description: Progress through short levels to face enemies and final bosses to save your life. Win and you'll level up, fail and you'll level down. The whole galaxy depends on you!.

title: Popucom
description: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

title: Philna Fantasy
description: This is a pixel-art style action role-playing game with exciting storylines, different career choices, cute art style, lively battles, and rich character development.Let's go and start the adventure.

title: Petty's Adventure: Volcano
description: Petty's Adventure: Volcano is a colorful game with changing gravity in which you have collect crystals to complete a level.

title: Horrific Xanatorium
description: A world where Spilia, a virus that causes delusions and hallucinations, has become epidemic. A horror visual novel game set in a hospital where patients are isolated.

title: Mozzies
description: A colourful retro style matching game. Squash Mozzies and match splatter colours before time runs out.

title: Myriad Hotel
description: A silly hotel-management visual novel. Impress clients, earn money, and resolve issues for your staff to keep the hotel from going under.

title: Olive's Art-Venture
description: Olive's Art-Venture is a spell-slinging arena and mobbing game. Use the paper on the right side of the screen to draw shapes which then cast spells, damaging enemies and protecting you.

title: On a Cloudy Day
description: On a Cloudy Day is a short, autobiographical vignette game by Emperatriz Ung. It is an interactive memory that captures the loneliness experienced during the hospitalization intake process. Designed to narratively compliment & be played alongside with Carol Mertz's "I'll be here."

title: Swapdown
description:
Step into the pulsating world of Swapdown, where every second counts and your wits are tested to the limit! In this exhilarating "match three" extravaganza, players are given a thrilling 60 seconds to slide shapes in all directions - left, right, up, and down, with the goal of aligning the perfect trio of colors.

But that's not all! Feel the board has become too predictable? Hit the "Space Bar" and watch as Swapdown's dynamic arena reshuffles, throwing an array of fresh combinations your way. The clock is ticking, but if the pressure becomes too much, the trusty hint button awaits to give you that gentle nudge in the right direction.

Compete against friends or challenge yourself to beat your personal best. As the seconds dwindle, the pace intensifies, and the adrenaline soars. Only the sharpest eyes and quickest reflexes will emerge victorious with the highest score.

With vibrant visuals, an addictive soundtrack, and nail-biting gameplay, Swapdown guarantees a heart-racing experience from start to finish.

Are you geared up for a minute of mayhem? Dive into Swapdown, where the clock is your biggest rival, and glory awaits the swiftest swiper!

title: A Belief in a Perfect Today
description:
This is the story of a day that we wanted to be perfect. A bank holiday trip to Brighton with friends. A chance to see the ocean, to see a band, to see slot machines and eat doughnuts.

This is a story of a day that wasn't perfect. A day of fighting through hangovers, of trying to have a good time, of putting up with bad weather, of trying not to snap.

This is a story. It focuses on the cracks.

title: I'm Yearning for a Train Journey
description: I haven't taken this kind of journey for a long time

title: Loinkham TD
description: A tower defense game set in the village of Loinkham. Use towers and various interactable objects in the environment to protect your little oinkers and their assests! Each map offers something new to help you with your journey. Unlock new towers and maps as you play.

title: Fair and Square
description: Fair and Square is a fast-paced bullet hell platformer roguelike where everything revolves around squares. Survive relentless enemy waves, upgrade your skills in the shop, and face epic bosses. Customize your playstyle, adapt on the fly, and prove your mastery in this chaotic challenge!

title: Ghost Tag
description: It's the classic game of tag, but for ghosts! In this multiplayer party game, you can use spectral super powers like vanishing and possessing objects to gain an edge on your opponents and be the tag champion!

title: Keo and the Cosmic Crystals
description: Keo and the Cosmic Crystals is a 2D platform game with colorful and cute graphics, featuring high difficulty and precision challenges.

title: Arena 9th
description: Welcome to the AUTO-CARD Competition of The Ninth Universe. You can show your skills, enter a higher level of competition, and strive to win the glory of the universe championship.

title: A Night at the Watermill
description: You wake up in an old watermill in the middle of the night ... and can't remember anything. Examine the surroundings in this thrilling point&click adventure and find out what happened.

title: Demon Slayer Shion
description: When her fellow Demon Slayer, Ayano, disappears in the depths of an enormous dungeon, Shion and her friends take it upon themselves to find her.

title: Mannequin
description: Play as a clothing store worker who is just finishing up her shift and preparing to go home. However, as you make your way towards the exit, the power suddenly goes out, leaving you trapped inside the store.

title: Death Lease
description: You will die.

title: 4D Games
description: 4D Shapes, 4D Chess and 4D Mazes!? Take a deep dive into the world of Four Dimensions, with more control than ever before!

title: Die in the Dungeon: Origins
description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and discover the story behind Die in the Dungeon!

title: 3D Chess Online
description: 3D Chess Online combines the magical world of chess with a modern and three-dimensional experience! Determine your strategy and fight against your opponents worldwide in this simulator equipped with realistic graphics.

title: Halloween Naughty Girls
description: Halloween Naughty Girls is a collection of adult visual novels inspired by classic horror movies from the 80s and 90s.

title: Hidden Glade
description: Hidden Glade is a 2D simulation role-playing video game set in a fantastic world of mysteries and unexplored worlds. Go on a new adventure together with Tobi. Develop your new home, find answers to your questions and go to your goal.

title: Enemy Trench
description: Enemy Trench is a Roguelike set during the First World War. You play as a British soldier fighting your way through enemy lines hoping to survive. You must contend with an onslaught of enemy soldiers, deadly terrain, gas attacks and more. Do you have what it takes to survive in the Enemy Trench?

title: Kitten's Wardrobe
description: This is a relaxing casual game. Take a walk in Dessert Town, explore more areas, and meet new friends. The Kitten has the ability to turn the stuff in the painting into reality. Help it gather new clothing through drawing!

title: Last Lesson
description: It's your first night as the caretaker of a scary quest. The last visitors have gone home. You need to turn off the lights, check the equipment and not die of horror, because someone or something suddenly starts a nightmarish game. With you in the lead.

title: Eyewinder
description: Run, glide, and grapple across an open world filled with floating islands. Armed with an Eye that gives you the power to rewind and accelerate time, use it to solve puzzles, fight enemies, and rescue your dragon friends.

title: Butterfly again
description: In a world where not everyone has magic, the kingdom is suffering from an infestation known as "Insect Demon". But only those who can use magic can see the Insect Demon...

title: Minute
description: A 3D action platformer where you play as a wind-up toy in a Tinkerer's workshop set in the Victorian Age. As a small wind-up toy, you must rely on your wind-up key to embark on an arduous journey. Defeat enemies and uncover a dark secret within the rooms.

title: Helle's Undersea City Project: Bringing Air to The Garden
description: Grow and expand the land with air, aiming to rebuild the undersea city with a lone girl, Hele! A new type of undersea city-building simulation game!

title: Crystalish
description: Crystalish - A side-view game with a physical world where the player must destroy blocks in a certain amount while controlling the balance of the fish and not allowing it to fall off the screen.

title: English Is Hard_
description: An arcade style typing game that evokes the nostalgia of Missile Command. Defend your cows, shoot aliens, and go for the high score!

title: Cropisle TD
description: After an earthquake, you're sent to an island for rebuilding. Face nightly critter attacks, set up towers, and farm. Your mission is to seal the island or secure crops before defenses are breached. Now, grab your shovel and hammer, and enter the defensive battle!

title: Harmonic Depths
description: Embark on a relaxing journey in an underwater realm. Glide through captivating environments, embracing the tranquility of exploration and survival found in these Harmonic Depths.

title: Mansion of Memories
description: Investigate the old manor, compete for the inheritance, or dive into mysteries left by your late aunt along with her will. Your choices decide whether other inhabitants of the mansion become your foes or friends… or someone special.

title: Little Green Girl
description: One day the protagonist meets an alien girl and the story turns...

title: Brick on the Head
description: As a manager of an hospital near bankrupt, you find that a brick on the head will give you patients. Also play on Hospital Mode where you can build your own hospital, take care of patients, protect him with security guards...

title: Baby Climbing
description: baby climbing is a 3d third person game where you control a baby in a dream where you have to climb platforms in order to reach the end. climb the platforms and complete the mission without falling and overcoming the obstacles

title: Marshmallow Imouto Succubus
description: Tsukikawa Keisuke had a strange dream. That dream involved his younger sister but instead of her usual, innocent self, she had lust in her eyes. So he finds out that a succubus lurks within her! How will he choose between his innocent sister and the allure of a lustful succubus?!

title: Get Me Out, Please
description: Work together with friends to escape an abandoned school in this horror escape action game for up to four players, but beware: one of you will become a monster.

title: Cataclysm Survivors
description: Cataclysm Survivors is an action packed roguelike in the survivors genre. With countless weapons and upgrades, play through endless waves of zombies and become INFINITELY POWERFUL. Thousands of Weapon and Upgrade combinations and TONS of enemies to slaughter with multiple classes and maps.

title: HBD-RPG
description: Interactive Role-Playing Game (RPG)

title: Maze Monsters
description: Maze Monsters is a procedurally generated, roguelike dungeon platformer where vicious threats and dangerous foes make for an original and action-packed adventure every time.

title: Asteroids Star Fields
description: It is an awesome space war game. It is a very simple game. Move the spaceship and shoot the asteroids. Try to make the highest score. It is an easy and time killing game. You can play to rest and relax between the big games you play.

title: Filled to the Limit
description: ​A newspaper ad inspires a girl to become a test subject for a tube-feeding machine, and must reach her full capacity!

title: Card Collector And Card Girls
description: Control: Keyboard arrow keys, A button = Z, B button = X This game has no story. You just have to defeat enemies and acquire skill cards to learn skills or acquire items to challenge stronger enemies. Battle is turn-based, Use your skills appropriately. Please have fun with these beauties.

title: Fly With The Yellow Crane
description: Soaring in the daytime, where are you going? This game will give a possibility. The night is long, and the road is full of branches. Good and evil are difficult to balance. Beauty is disaster or blessing? Regrets long live in the world. I can only imagine the utopia in the fairyland.

title: Fortress Defense
description: 'Fortress Defense' is a cartoon style defense game. Players can summon archers and upgrade to different roles to block the enemy's attack.

title: Corn Kidz 64
description: The unauthorized, kid-friendly version of the classic Stephen King thriller (or maybe not, maybe it's just a game about one-horned goatbabies)

title: Jump Queen
description: Get to the top in the really challenging platformer Jump Queen! You don't need a hot girl, she's already here. You just need to move up because the fall price is too high. Jump, collect coins, look for secrets and get to the top.

title: Brain Quiz
description: Brain Quiz crazy general quiz game... Challenge your brain, and your culture

title: Aerodangle
description: Aerodangle is a chaotic mix of high-speed flying, parkour with a grappling hook and a stream of airplanes falling apart in the air.

title: Knights of Grayfang
description:
The land of Eldraad is in the midst of a war between the humans, born from the Twilight Deity, and the monsters, born from the Nightfall Deity, to control all nine temples. King Edwahl wields twilight's might, turning humans into vampires via a ritual. Yet, a sinister force awakens among monsters. Will nightfall or twilight triumph?
One of the main characters, Thoma, wields a unique Blood Gauge, replacing HP and MP. Using this gauge, characters can activate Bloodthirst, granting new skills and appearances. Equip bats found in dungeons for passive effects like protection from ailments and boosted attack power. Seize victory by claiming all nine temples. Unravel the mysteries and battle the monsters within to conquer them!

title: Jackpot 2
description: Jackpot 2 is a casual game. After starting the game, it has three wheels to turn. When the wheel stops, the icon stopped at the winning line matches the winning pattern, and the player will get the winning amount indicated by the winning pattern.

title: OMSI 2: Agora Bus Family Citybus Vol. 1
description: Plunge into the middle of the urban hustle and bustle with the Renault Agora DLC for OMSI 2. Explore the narrow streets, master the challenges of traffic and feel the adrenaline of rush hour - all with the comfort of your passengers in mind.

title: Assetto Corsa EVO
description: Assetto Corsa EVO is the sequel to 2014’s racing simulator Assetto Corsa, which featured a range of road, track, racing, historic and drift cars as well as laser-scanned tracks

title: Pokémon Myth
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Pokémon Myth, where you'll rise from a 15-year-old villager to a legendary Champion. Unravel the sinister plot of Team Corrupt, an enigmatic organization seeking to harness the power of Arceus and Mew, the region's legendary Pokémon. Discover the groundbreaking "Infusion Types," a new mechanic that empowers your Pokémon with type-specific DNA, boosting their attacks and adding a strategic layer to battles. Encounter intriguing factions like the research-driven Team Rose/Infusion Inc. and the formidable Team Astra, hailing from the Serene region. Explore two vast regions, plus Sinnoh and Unova, teeming with new Mega Evolutions, regional forms, and a plethora of Fakemon, including unique Star-Face shiny variants. With player-controlled gyms, custom mechanics, new moves, items, types, and even new Eeveelutions, Pokémon Myth offers a fresh and captivating Pokémon experience.

title: eFootball 2024
description:
eFootball 2024 is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami as part of their ongoing eFootball series. Released in September 2023, it is an update to eFootball 2023 rather than a completely new title, continuing the free-to-play model introduced with the previous instalments.

The game features updated team rosters, enhanced graphics, and refined gameplay mechanics.

title: Street Pursuit
description: Endless Runner PC Game

title: Mars4
description: The first Real-Life Mars simulator.

title: Angelic: Dark Symphony
description:
A Cinematic Tactical RPG set in a Dark Sci-Fi Universe.

Experience a cinematic sci-fi RPG through the shifting perspectives of a complex cast. Each hero reshapes turn-based combat, from brutal melee and gunplay to aerial battles and gravity-bending powers. Uncover a dark cosmic story where death may be the kinder ending.

title: Femboy Aim Trainer
description: Now you can train your aim with femboys. Enjoy and relax while shooting femboys!

title: Pangolin Cassowary
description: Pangolin Cassowary is a physics-based 3D platformer. Explore the city and find its secrets by kicking, rolling, and bouncing.

title: Pibby: Apocalypse
description: Pibby: Apocalypse is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' that is centered around Learning With Pibby: Apocalypse,

title: Plat Wacky Adventure Remastered
description: Play as Plat Wacky as he tries to save the world!

title: Possess Quest
description: Possess Quest is a puzzle platformer game where you play as any enemy you touch.

title: Decollate Decoration
description: This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost. The objective is to fulfill her desires by speaking to her beloved "him" causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.

title: Vacant Ark
description: Side-scrolling shoot-em-up in an atmospheric deep sea setting. Gameplay features 3 cyclable weapons and a close range "option" that changes enemy bullets into ammunition.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Sweep the Board!
description: Embark on an adventure through iconic settings from the anime Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba in this action-packed board game. Compete with friends as you brave the elements on your quest to become the strongest demon slayer!

title: Pyramid: Challenge of the Pharaoh's Dream
description: Pyramid: Challenge of the Pharaoh's Dream is a 1996 education adventure game for Windows and Macintosh developed by Knowledge Adventure and published by Edusoft SA, published in Sweden by Knowledge Adventure and Levande Böcker.

title: Turbo Leaper
description:
The multiverse is colliding!

Some dark force has awoken far away... Breaking apart the barriers between different universes has opened wild portals, leaking corrupting energy!

It is up to a rag-tag group to eventually put a stop to this.

title: Key Hunters DX
description: Key Hunters DX is an re-imagined version of Sonic & Knuckles: Key Hunters!

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Omni-Man
description: Omni-Man soars into the Mortal Kombat Universe joining the roster as a new Kombatant. This pack includes playable character Omni-Man, including all new move-sets inspired by the Invincible animated series.

title: Mr. Shootem Breaks Out!
description: Mr. Shootem Breaks Out! is an arcade-inspired puzzle-platform-shooter about destroying levels and levels of bricks by using a ball and pure firepower! Brought to you by a group of friends across almost a decade, it's a game unlike anything you've played before!

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Quan Chi
description:
Now a master of the Netherrealm's most vile sorcery, Quan Chi plots with Shang Tsung to conquer the realms. This pack includes playable character Quan Chi including all new move-sets.

Quan Chi is a returning character previously playable in Mortal Kombat X as part of the main roster.

title: Five Nights at Candy's DX
description:
No company is without a rival.

Freddy Fazbear's New Pizzeria has closed for good. And so, another restaurant is going to take its place in the world of entertainment.

What could go wrong?

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Peacemaker
description:
Christopher Smith, the Peacemaker, cherishes peace with all his heart. So much so, that he will kill anyone and everyone necessary to get it.

This pack includes playable character Peacemaker, based on DC's Suicide Squad, including all new movesets.

Peacemaker is a guest character based on John Cena's appearance as the character in The Suicide Squad movie and the Peacemaker television series.

title: Five Nights at Candy's 2 DX
description:
Rebuilt. Enhanced. Upgraded.
We brought joy to many, but that was long ago.
Broken. Fractured. Damaged.
In the end, we ended up where we came from.

title: Lloyd the Monkey: Remastered
description: Lloyd the Monkey: Remastered is a remastered version of the original game with various improvements, released originally for PC in the 2023 edition of Sonic Amateur Games Expo.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Ermac
description: Announced for the Mortal Kombat 1: Kombat Pack, Ermac is a returning character previously playable in Mortal Kombat X as part of the main roster.

title: Five Nights at Candy's 3 DX
description:
"I've always liked it when it rains...
the rain makes the silence go away,
it feels comfy and relaxing.
I don't like the silence
the silence means they're hiding
if they're hiding, they're coming closer
and if they come closer
they'll hurt me, for what I did- didn't do...
for what I couldn't do"

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Homelander
description:
Homelander, the ultimate patriot and leader of The Seven, descends upon Mortal Kombat. As a narcissistic sociopath with an insatiable need for validation, love and power, Homelander unfolds a new Era of tyranny in Mortal Kombat 1.

This pack includes playable character Homelander, from 'The Boys', including all new movesets.

Homelander is a guest character based on Antony Starr’s appearance as the character in the television series.

title: Cowboy 3030
description: Step into the Wild West future of Cowboy 3030, a third-person roguelite bullet hell where you dive into action-packed shootouts as different playable characters, each with unique abilities and playstyles, to take on notorious outlaws and criminals and rise to become top gun of 3030.

title: Lloyd the Monkey 3: Judgement Day
description: Two years have passed since Lloyd and Lura defeated Kronos and his Dark Gorillas, seemingly once and for all, and the duo have gone their seperate ways. However, the villain Scholz is ripping his way through countless lives in order to complete a decade-spanning plan to conquer the universe once and for all. The final battle is about to begin, and the blood shed at the end of it all will sow the seeds of a new beginning.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Takahashi Takeda
description:
Seeking to right the wrongs of his past, Takeda swears to rip up Earthrealm's underworld by the roots.

This pack includes playable character Takeda Takahashi, including all new move-sets.

title: O-Bot The Robot 2
description: Last year O-Bot has stopped an invasion on his planet and now everything was peaceful. Until some strange lavender gear in a pile of junk activated itself and shot out beams everywhere, causing every creature and living things to be revived and teleported to one planet named "Earth". So O-Bot decided to investigate and find every piece of lavender gear to stop this chaos.

title: Sal.
description: Sal. is a 2D arcade platformer that adds a twist, you have three floors to explore, destroy the Artlings, collect the Noskey, and find the secrets!

title: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham - Dark Knight
description: Experience the heart-pounding chase scene from the iconic film complete with cool vehicles and explosive action. Play as the legendary Dark Knight and Commissioner Gordon, as well as the Joker and his goons as they chase down Harvey Dent’s police escort. Bane and Catwoman from the third film are also playable.

title: Spacewing War 2
description: The galaxy-wide known cult Shine Tomorrow has taken over the Power Generators in the Center of the Galaxy, and you must stop them! In Spacewing War 2, jump into battle with many new unlockable weapon types and face enemies and obstacles from every corner of the Milkdromeda Galaxy.

title: Spekel Sparks
description: Take off through the groves of Blooming Genesis with the charming assistance of brother foxes' Spekel and Bekel, and their friends, who decide to take matters into their own hands to stop the unruly and vicious A.C.E. Corporation from fully diving the world into a biochemical warfare with their nuclear creations! Try out each character and see which playstyle best fits you? Team up with friends and infiltrate their bases together!

title: Trinity Heart
description: Bounce, whip, and blast your way through three challenging action stages!!! Enjoy bright scenery and goofy characters!!!

title: Uprush
description: Uprush is a platformer game originally developed for Mini Game Jam in 3 days.

title: Brawlers
description: One of the top Web3 fighting games, developed by Tyranno Studios! A rowdy collision of strategy and suplexes, designed by the Magic: The Gathering mastermind.

title: It Happened Here: Streaming Lives
description: Are you ready, detective? Step into a tale of mystery, intrigue, deceit, and murder!

title: Light-It Up
description:
It’s a dark world out there for a teeny little stickman like you, and it’s about time you light it up. Jump, flip and slide from one neon shape to another to make them glow. Collect stars as you play to raise your score.
Just when you start to feel like a stickman boss, things get complicated (or “sticky,” if you will) as you pass levels. Shapes start moving, rotating and even exploding, and lethal spikes become a constant threat to your poor little stickman life.
If you miss a jump or hit a spike… you fall into oblivion! Ready to light it up?

title: Drift Legends 2
description:
Experience the ultimate drift and driving sensation in Drift Legends 2, an incredibly realistic 3D car drifting and street racing game. Compete with other racers while playing drifting games or play your car driving games offline. Become the in-game drift king as Keiichi Tsuchiya in real racing! Make your best car drifts in this extremely engaging racing simulator!

Take control of highly-detailed legendary drift cars and conquer various tracks as you strive to break records, both yours and of other racers that play this drifting car game. Engage in both offline and online drift racing events, progressing from a novice to a professional drift driver. Test your skills in a multiplayer game mode, if you think you are tough enough to win the title of the Drift King. Challenge other drivers and ascend to the pinnacle of the cross-platform online leaderboard.

title: Poly Match
description: Challenge yourself inside a polysphere world! It is the best choice to spend your time. Playstyles and moves are rendered in-game with meticulous attention to detail. Simple and fun for all ages. Get a completely new experience and relax your mind with 3d puzzle!

title: Trim For Your Dream
description: Step into the shoes of LA's top cannabis trimmer returning to reclaim his glory. Navigate the vibrant world of trimming, chase dreams beyond the physical, and immerse yourself in an unforgettable journey with a chill dub soundtrack. Rediscover your roots in this unique 3D cannabis simulator.

title: Sanguivore: Twenty Below
description: Survive and strategize with friends in Sanguivore, a first-person escape-room style nightmare. Your mission: lead your team to safety through one of multiple escape routes, while evading bloodthirsty monsters hunting you. Work together to survive.

title: Spellslayer
description: Take on the role of a spellcasting slayer puzzle tactics roguelite. Use a combination of clever positioning, strategic thinking and pure casting power to vanquish your enemies and claim the ultimate power source!

title: Vivid World
description: A follow-up to the hit game Vivid Knight, Vivid World is a completely new party-building, roguelike strategy game! Our story takes place in the Netherworld, a land ruled by demons. Utilize and master our protagonist, Lemuria's new Jewel Magic to conquer strange dungeons.

title: Dash x Survivors
description: Defeat endless hordes of demonic robots in this hack n slash action roguelike. Use 100+ unique upgrades to create your own game-breaking build and claim victory.

title: Only Fortress
description: Become the hero of your own fortress! Defend, customize, and explore in this PvP & PvM strategy game. Unleash your skills, lead your troops, and dominate in the battles. Build, fight, and conquer on the open world cross-platform online game!

title: Rogue Samurai
description: Rogue Samurai is a roguelike action game where you must battle against waves of enemies. Fight, die, upgrade your skills and fight again until you beat all your enemies.

title: A Night With Angel
description: An interactive text narrative where charm, charisma, and seduction will be your key tools. Angel is an alluring and confident twink- each word, each glance, has deeper meanings as the two of you spend a fleeting night's tryst with eachother.

title: Botanical Chronicle
description: Discover a third-person adventure as a robot seeking the last traces of life! Technology morphed into nature! Explore, unravel secrets paths, and escape dark forces of this mysterious landscape. Rivers, rocks, bushes seamlessly merging into digital realm and try to stop you!

title: The Vorlec
description: Enter an adventure where you will have to make your way to the great metropolis, where hundreds of obstacles will stand in your way, you will have to be very careful because any obstacle can kill you...

title: Budget Backrooms
description: Free, open-source low-budget single-player Backrooms game using Unreal Engine 4.

title: Stronghold Siege
description: Command your army against a relentless demon horde in this intense real-time strategy game. Master strategy and resource management to conquer the enemy's stronghold while defending your own in the ultimate battle for survival.

title: Egypt Frontiers
description: In the game Egypt Frontiers, players explore ancient Egypt, constructing authentic pyramid and making strategic decisions. The game offers the opportunity to learn about real history or create their own vision of civilization in both strategy and first-person modes.

title: Village
description: A young boy has come to a distant village to visit his grandmother. Arriving at the final station, in some wilderness, we find newspaper clippings on the platform. This is where our tangled story begins.

title: Replik Survivors
description: This game is a time survival game with role-playing and roguelite elements. Through the choice of upgrades in battle to make the character stronger and stronger, defeat the oncoming enemies.

title: Blackjack Simulator 2024
description: Blackjack Simulator 2024 is a simple, fun, and realistic simulation of blackjack. Battle against the dealer every single round as you try to use the right strategy to win big!

title: Game Time Glizzys
description: Game Time Glizzy's is a casual cooking simulator where you must manage your money, sabotage your competitors, serve swarms of angry customers and pay back a mountain of debt to keep your concession stand alive.

title: Cookie Game
description: A casual arcade game concerning a bear named Bottle, the Cookie Game's goal is simple: to consume cookies. However, the missiles raining from the sky appear to be hindering this goal. Thus, you must make Bottle stronger by dodging these missiles and help her achieve her questionable dream.

title: Quiet on Set
description: Quiet on set! Action! Amidst a grand mansion, an elite movie production turns sinister with a sudden murder. Investigate, interview suspects, gather clues, and solve the murder. But beware, push too hard and you could be the next victim!

title: Xiangqi: The Chinese Chess
description: "Xiangqi—the Chinese chess "Is a strategic and challenging chess game, whether you are a beginner or an advanced player, you can find fun and learn in the game. You can search and download the game in the app store, and start enjoying wonderful chess matches!

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Menorca
description: The popular holiday island Menorca is now also available for X-Plane. The current aerial images come in a resolution of 50cm/pixel down to 25cm/pixel in the airport area.

title: My First Grade Fantasy Adventure
description: An early education game for kids with tons of mini-games and movies! Features draggable interactive objects, solving puzzles, & memory matches. All with visual and sound effects to support your child's learning. Enjoy this memorable adventure in one of the most comprehensive First Grade prep games!

title: Lofi Kitten
description: Step into the dreamy world of LoFi Kitten, where the soothing LoFi music meets the adorable charm of cats. Immerse yourself in a relaxing and heartwarming experience combining the challenges of puzzle games with the calming embrace of LoFi beats and melodies. Ready to let the music guide you?

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Succubus
description: Sumire was just like any other woman... until she was reincarnated as a succubus in a magical world! Now she must find her way back to her home world and survive the many challenges that await her in this fantasy realm!

title: Uberslaughter
description: Uberslaughter is an adrenaline-pumping retro Movement Shooter that pays homage to classic FPS. Embark on a gory inter-dimensional odyssey in order to neutralize high-priority targets. Butcher you way through hordes of enemies. Accumulate vast riches. Rescue a helpless kitten. And slaughter them all.

title: Elder's Grace: Unchained
description: Elder’s Grace, Unchained is a magical action RPG meets castle defense, building & raiding & battling game. Create customized treasure strongholds. Build teams to plunder others or battle until there’s only one.

title: Claire's Cruisin' Cafe: Fest Frenzy
description: Join Claire as she embarks on a journey of culinary discovery! It's the first day of the festival, and she needs your help to run her food truck successfully. You'll need to swiftly take orders, cook up delicious dishes, and serve them with a smile.

title: Spielbahn
description: Spielbahn is a small relaxing game that lets you unleash your creativity by designing and building your own tracks using various parts and decorations.

title: Monster 2
description: Although I had a good house, wealth, I had no girlfriend who could give me sexual comfort. But one night I felt very lucky when I found stray cat girls. After gaining their trust I had sexual pleasure with them. Grace and Lucy disliked it all at first but over time they both came closer to me.

title: Dice Crypt
description: Dive into Dice Crypt! A thrilling digital board game where you and your friends compete to conquer a mysterious dungeon. Roll the dice, face monsters, loot treasures, and outwit rivals. Will you conquer the crypt?

title: Hepo
description: The first volume produced by Gemini Hirono. The hero determined by playing rock, paper, scissors defeats the demon king. RPG format where you move around the map and defeat enemies It is a 2D STG. Score Attack allows you to move around the map automatically and play only 2D STG.

title: Guardians Of Gaia: Guardians 8
description: Guardians of Gaia: Guardians 8 is an introduction to the combat and game mechanics of Guardians of Gaia. Are you ready to take up the challenge?

title: Alborada
description: An idle forest game with a rich nature sound library. Discover, collect and customize your forest, set your ideal atmosphere to focus on your tasks or just relax and meditate with the sounds of nature.

title: Cyberpunk: Red-Light District
description: Cyberpunk Red-Light District is a game for adults set in the world of Cyberpunk.

title: 505 Game Collection
description: 505 Game Collection is a compilation game for PC by Cokem International. The game features sport games, puzzle games, action game, among others.

title: Bubble Hero 2
description: Bubble Hero 2 is a Windows game released in 1998. It is a sequel to the original Bubble Hero, and features new gameplay mechanics and improved graphics.

title: Still Hunt
description: During the '90s, South Korea was home to many PC games that elsewhere would have appeared on consoles. Still Hunt is such a case, a classical run 'n gun very much inspired by Treasure's Mega Drive games, particularly Gunstar Heroes.

title: Royal Romances: Endless Winter
description: Sometimes saving one life can change the fate of many. Can you melt the ice in people's hearts?

title: King of Fighters XV: Characters - Duo Lon
description: This character is also bundled together in the available KOF XV Fighter Pass DLC character set. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

title: Chapter Zero: The Angel Island Saga
description: The world is a chaotic, terrifying place, rife with all manner of monsters, warlords and hostile architecture. Even for the mighty Pachacamac clan, just the act of survival is a day to day struggle, and everybody seems to know that they can't keep it up forever. In pursuit of a safe home, a lone shaman named Ichima happens apon the Special Stage - and with it, a means of realizing their dreams of safety and peace...

title: Daris Venture
description: Daris Venture is a half-Saturn/Advance-style fan-made game that will tell you an alternate history of Mobius that ended not in the best way for the Robotnik Empire.

title: Lost Alone Ultimate: George's Nightmare
description:
Find 10 candles and place them on the ritual table before the demons find you.
Your heart won't be able to withstand this psychological experiment.

title: Mobius Red Zone
description:
Mobius Red Zone is a Sonic fan game in the same universe as the animated web series Sonic the HEDHUG. The events of 'Big Space Race' set the mysterious Red Comet on a collision course with Mobius where Sonic and Co live. Later, the events of 'Dr.Eg.D.S.' may have reloaded the planet, but not the rest of the world, and the Comet is still slowly moving towards the Mobius, finally arriving many years later, in the time of The New Circle.
No one expected this to happen, but upon arrival, the Red Comet released the cursed energy that suddenly changed the world to its corrupted, horrible version of itself - the so-called Red Zone where even the small pretty flower in the background can turn into a devastating mechanical monster with saws and lasers, and cannons, and even more saws.
Now our heroes embark on their own adventures to reveal the truth about the Red Zone and, maybe. even stop it from spreading across the whole Mobius... yet it still exists.

title: Sonic Skywind
description: A Sonic game introducing fast paced combat with limited open world areas involving story progress scenarios and side missions.

title: Sonic Spectre
description: A 2D Sonic the Hedgehog fangame made with Clickteam Fusion

title: Sonic USB Online
description:
Dive into a frantic race with Sonic, the legendary blue hedgehog! Defy the laws of physics through twisted worlds to save your animal friends captured by Doctor Robotnik. Get ready to jump, turn and cross all obstacles in this epic adventure to save the world and free the innocent creatures!
Are you ready to roar, push the limits and become the ultimate hero? It's time to show your super speed and kick Robotnik's butt.

title: Incursion: Halls of the Goblin King
description: Incursion: Halls of the Goblin King is a freeware roguelike game based on the Wizards of the Coast d20 system.

title: Super Mario Continuance
description: Super Mario Continuance follows Riba from RPG Maker horror game "(Mario) The Music Box" on a quest to bring the Mushroom Kingdom's beloved hero, Mario, back from the dead. To do this, Riba must help Len Alwenia Foska (the god of rebirth) destroy an enigmatic entity who is traveling through time and erasing Riba from existence.

title: American Truck Simulator: Arkansas
description: Located in the south-central region of the United States, the state is a nature wonderland with three national forests, many State Parks, nearly 9,000 miles of pristine streams and rivers like the Arkansas and Mississippi, as well as the ever-stretching Ozark and Quachita mountain ranges.

title: Lynn's Legacy
description: Follow Lynn the mercenary as she recollects the mysterious mission that nearly took her life. Travel through multiple overworld areas, (forest, towns, desert, mountains) and boldly step into uncharted dimensions in search of memory!

title: Cappi: Starbound Saga
description:
Go forth, it is you who will save the universes... from annihilation.

Cappi: Starbound Saga is a 2D platformer with gameplay styles inspired by the Kirby and Sonic series. With Cappi, use powerful abilities and maintain speed to be able to save the galaxy in record time.

title: AlllCall
description:
This is a mini shmups.
The boss appears when 8 large numbered enemies are defeated.
The stage is cleared when the boss is defeated.
On the way, press the X key when you have money (ALC).
You can buy weapons and restore HP.

title: Cassette Beasts: Pier of the Unknown
description:
Charge your oversized flashlights and steel your nerves for "Pier of the Unknown", a new DLC for Cassette Beasts! This DLC download includes:

A new storyline to seek and unravel
A spooky new location with three carnival-themed attractions to uncover and explore
TWELVE new monsters that can only be found and collected within Brightside Pier
Five new character costume options

This new addition to Cassette Beasts brings the total monsters to 141, meaning you can now unlock 19,881 fully imagined fusions!

title: False Dawn
description: False Dawn is set a number of years after the events of Quake 4, where you assume the role of the best of a new breed of soldier, the Stroggified Marine. You can go where no regular human can and have been called upon to save humanity from the threat of a mysterious new super weapon developed by the vicious Strogg!

title: Football Manager 2024
description: Progress never stops when you're pursuing footballing greatness. Gameplay upgrades empower you to develop a blueprint for success on and off the pitch. Pre-order for 10% off and Early Access*.

title: Combat Mission Fortress Italy: Rome to Victory
description: CMFI Rome to Victory Module Rome has been liberated! It's time to finish this war! Continue the march to the Alps as we introduce new TO&E that includes Indian, Brazilian, South African and Free French forces.

title: Combat Mission Fortress Italy: Gustav Line
description: CMFI Gustav Line Module depicts the desperate battle for the Italian mainland, revolving around Salerno, Anzio, and Monte Cassino, and culminating in the capture of Rome on June 4, 1944.

title: The Chant: The Gloom Below
description: Survive a mind-bending new chapter in The Chant: The Gloom Below DLC. Harness dark forms of Prismic Science with new ability upgrades and weapons against unpredictable enemy encounters. As each death leads you closer to escape, finding the right build is essential.

title: Friday Night Funkin': VS Boykisser
description: Friday Night Funkin': VS Boykisser is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' based on the Boykisser meme. The song features 1 week, with the song No More Boykisser based on the song No More Nuzzles from Undertale: Halloween Hack.

title: Finding Frankie
description: Finding Frankie invites you to participate in Frankie's terrifyingly twisted parkour game show. Stealthily navigate around horrifying characters, tackle obstacle courses, and swing and wall-jump through challenging parkour courses! This is a game show you wouldn't want to miss!

title: Dreams: Unlimited links
description: 《Dreams: Unlimited links》 is a third-person shooter competitive game that features a variety of unique heroes, exciting gameplay modes, and rich scene maps and battlegrounds. Players can venture alone or team up for thrilling multiplayer battles, challenging other teams.

title: Though the Heavens Fall
description: Though the Heavens Fall is a Christian game reminiscent of classic JRPG gameplay while presenting a perspective of the spiritual world using the Christian Mythos. One where God reigns supreme and though there is conflict in heavenly places, His will is imminent and unstoppable. The game while light-hearted and comedic in tone is backed by the reality that things in the spirit realm are real, our prayers have effect, and that no lesser principality will have its way forever.

title: Tank Mayhem
description: Tank Mayhem is an intense local multiplayer tank shooter with many unique power-ups and game modes. With a 3D environment and real-time lighting, this game aims to add a modern twist to classic 2D tank shooters. Have fun blasting your friends and trying out all of the exciting weapons.

title: Grey Heritage: Noble Duty
description: Grey Heritage: Noble Duty is an anime Tactical RPG. Follow Jaden, as he travels across the land and learns the truth about his country. Learn the origin of the war that leads to Grey Heritage: Faded Vision. Fight enemies in tactical combat and manage your army in this JRPG inspired journey!

title: Dark Odyssey
description: Dark Odyssey, an epic online rpg game that features idle playing, dungeon challenges, boss fights, character enhancing and customizations. Get ready to embark on a dark and thrilling journey, increase your power, team up with other players and save the world!

title: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
description: The Hyper‑Dungeon awaits! Explore an evershifting labyrinth where classic dungeon‑crawling meets exhilarating action. Challenge yourself in turn-based combat with a real‑time, arcade‑inspired twist and befriend an eccentric cast of dungeon dwellers on the quest for the legendary Sacred Groowl!

title: Cryowakers
description: Cryowakers is an exploration and survival game that takes place in a randomly-generated futuristic world. Play solo or with seven other players to explore, survive, build, and fight to uncover the truth behind the cryosleep experiments.

title: Sole Seeker
description: Land on unique planets to survive the horrors that await in this adventure survival RPG. Use the spoils to upgrade defensive buildings and explore the galaxy further. Can you survive the hunt all alone?

title: Isometria
description: Explore a procedurally generated isometric world solo or with friends. Build a base, explore caves, dungeons, tombs, deserts, and forests. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, mine rare elements, craft armor, potions, and more!

title: A Night On The Farm
description: Survive the night and uncover the mystery of The Farm, in an atmospheric horror adventure! Locate key items, uncover cryptic notes, gain access to [REDACTED], and make decisions that alter your story!

title: Project Adder
description: A run & gun zombie-killing rogue-lite with weighty responsive gameplay that’s different every run.

title: Rogue City: Casual Top Down Shooter
description: Fight the mafia on city streets and save your city in this cop action shooter game!

title: Polygons Tower Defense
description: Defend this colorful world with a brilliant strategy! Strengthen your battlefield and don't let enemies reach their destination. Make amazing combinations, and choose the most powerful elements wisely!

title: Eredia 2: The Great War
description: A dark fantasy JRPG, sequel to Eredia: Diary of Heroes. Eredia 2 is set in an open-world enemy continent as you are made to partake in a war you are least interested in, but it's the only place where you can find some 'answers'.

title: Rhythm Master
description: ‘Rhythm Master’ is a new concept rhythm game in which each stage proceeds in a battle format based on a story. Collect various characters and strategize using their unique abilities to fight against various enemies.

title: Mining Mechs
description: Unleash your inner miner as you commandeer a high-tech Mining Mech! Mine for valuable resources and upgrade your mech for even bigger hauls as you explore the underground. Mining Mechs is a small game that you can play alone or with up to 7 friends in online co-op and offers 4-8 hours of gameplay.

title: Horror Inside the Forest
description: Plunge into the captivating realm of "Horror Inside the Forest," an exhilarating game that tests your bravery. Explore a mysterious forest, confront supernatural forces, uncover secrets, survive the darkness, and escape its shadowy embrace in this immersive horror experience.

title: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator: So Many Ducks
description: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator - So Many Ducks brings 27 additional ducks to the pool! Each of them is a brand-new duck you have never met, with a unique personality and, in some cases, new interactions.

title: Valor & Victory: Pacific
description: The Pacific War was a theater of immense strategic importance, with nations vying for control over key territories and vital supply routes. Valor & Victory: Pacific 1942 - 1943 plunges you into this theater of war, where the forces of Japan and China join the fray.

title: Landlords & Tax Evasion
description: Embark on a feudal adventure in Landlords & Tax Evasion! Build your empire, dodge taxes, and conquer your way to prosperity.

title: Bit Tower
description: Bit Tower is an exciting Tower Defense game that will immerse you in an epic battle between adventurers and monsters! Hire adventurers, place them in the arena, face countless waves, and secure your spot on the leaderboard.

title: BastogneBreakout
description: Hex, Counter and Card simlation of the battles around Bastogne during the Battle of the Bulge in 1944. You play against yourself or play as Germans against Allied AI. Units are regiments, battalions and kampfgruppen. New Supply procedures make the Germans keep an eye out on the road network.

title: Mindfield
description: Experience the powerful VR short film, Mindfield, delving deep into the world of PTSD. Immerse yourself in this thought-provoking journey and witness the invisible scars of war in a whole new way.

title: Phrank's Photon Pharm
description: Phrank's Photon Pharm is a logic puzzle game set in the steampunk world of Underland. Explore the caverns of Underland, solve hundreds of puzzles, uncover who threatens Underland's denizens, Save the Pharm!

title: What Have You Done, Father?
description: An atrocious scandal threatens the Catholic Church when the lifeless body of a woman is discovered in the rectory of a young priest.

title: Moonbunny
description: Meet the guy who had a one-way ticket to heaven yet decided to take the express train to hell.

title: Sands of Skullcreek
description: Sands of Skullcreek is retro style FPS. Your travels have brought you to this town that has been overrun by a gang. You decide to swear in as a deputy and restore order to this once peaceful place.

title: Midnight Prowl
description: Midnight Prowl is a horror exploration game set in a Japanese town, where you will experience the horror that takes place there.

title: Sumo Tanks
description: Sumo Tanks is a tank arena fighter where players shoot and ram each other to be the last standing in the ring. Select your tank and claim the title of grand Sumo Tanks champion.

title: Fright Animatronics 2
description: Fright Animatronics 2 is a first-person horror game where your task is to work in a warehouse for a week. What can go wrong?

title: JunkTok: Paranormal Investigators Challenge
description: Another 3-player co-op horror slop. But it’s set in 2016, baby!

title: Medimon
description: "Medimon" is a health science-themed monster-taming RPG. Players capture, battle, and evolve creatures symbolizing health concepts, turning intricate biology into an interactive and captivating game experience. Dive in and make education an adventure!

title: Grave Digging Me
description: In this casual looter and crafting game, you join as a new grave digger. while expanding the town, graveyard and upgrading your tools.

title: Protecting the Base
description: This is a tower defense game, where you can experience the charm of war from the game summary, reasonably prevent turrets, upgrade your turrets, and win victory.

title: Survivors Last Stand
description: Survive waves of alien invaders. Upgrade your weapons and create insane builds. Addictive arcade roguelike action awaits you!

title: Robokid
description: You are the robot with mindset of a kid, but your robotic body allowing you to fight better than most humans. Your goal is to solve the mystery how aliens got into spaceship and, most importantly to discover "who You are for real?" A strange scientist will accompany you during the exploration

title: Last Stand
description: Future Agent Natasha finally found the recently awakened human hero, Morgen. This time, they must embark on a perilous journey back to the South Pole, seeking the origins of the impending world apocalypse. However, what awaits them there is a group of unknown enemies shrouded in mystery

title: The Scramble Vice
description: It is the year 2048. Tokyo Police Department’s notorious 9th Mobile Unit, “The Scramble Vice” is ready to fight high-tech robot crime! Clad in an armed exoskeleton suit, police officer Sakuragi Kei of the 9th unit stands to fight robot crimes within Neo Tokyo! Are you ready to scramble up Tokyo?

title: Golden Leaf Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Unfold the tapestry of the season, from golden forests to festive harvests. With breathtaking artwork and a heartwarming narrative, it's an ode to autumn's splendor in puzzle form.

title: Medieval Kingdom Wars: Prologue
description: Rewrite medieval history through bloody siege combat in a fusion of RTS and Grand Strategy genres. Rule, build, and serve your King as a minor lord in medieval Europe. Experience siege, field and naval combat with an unseen degree of brutality. Rogue-like progression, epic towns and battles await…

title: Mokete
description: Mokete is a turn-based roguelike game with cartoon graphics and an alien theme. You'll take control of a brave alien who uses abducted animals in thrilling battles on Earth to become the zone champion and face mythical beings.

title: ReversiBot
description: The roles of keyboard and mouse will be reversed

title: Espalion
description: Shooting doujin game.

title: Greener Grass Awaits
description: Greener Grass Awaits is a golfing horror game about a golfer breaking onto a golf course for an after hours game.

title: Genshin Impact: To the Stars Shining in the Depths
description:
Version 4.1 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Wriothesley and Neuvillette
• New areas: Liffey Region and Fontaine Research Institute
• New main story quests: Chapter IV, Acts III & IV
• New story quests for Wriothesley and Neuvillette
• New main event: Waterborne Poetry
• …and more!

title: Sex Simulator: Office Promotion
description: A sex simulation game with visual novel elements where you play the role of the boss who sleeps with his female employees.

title: Trash Goblin
description: A cosy and moreish fantasy shop sim where you uncover, clean, upcycle and sell a vast variety of trinkets - both invaluable and unlovable - to a diverse cast of fascinating customers across a colourful fantasy city. Think Potionomics meets PowerWash Simulator, with a unique protagonist!

title: Whisker Waters
description:
Whisker Waters is the ultimate RPG adventure that blends light fantasy and the art of fishing into a mesmerizing world. As a player, you'll create and play as your very own Cat character and embark on a whimsical fishing journey like never before.

Unlike any other game, Whisker Waters makes fishing the star of the show! Use cool fishing tools to explore and catch all kinds of unique fish. Each fish has its own tricks, making it exciting and rewarding!

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Fan Favorites
description:
POLKA WILL NEVER DIE!
… and neither will you, with help from the new heroes in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! This expansion adds two new character decks—Thomas Raith and Waldo Butters—and two new book decks—BLOOD RITES and DEAD BEAT.

title: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare
description:
A port of Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare is the fourth installment in the survival horror video game series Alone in the Dark. The player can choose which of the two protagonists to play as. Carnby’s side of the plot focuses mainly on fighting monsters through physical means, while Aline’s is more centered on puzzle-solving. The two occasionally meet, and the main plot areas intersect.

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Winter Schemes
description:
FEELING WINTER'S BITE?
Warm up with this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! Includes two alternative character decks — WINTER KNIGHT HARRY and WINTER LADY MOLLY — and two new book decks — COLD DAYS and SKIN GAME.

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Mouse & Variants
description: Bring Harry's faithful companion Mouse (with a dash of Mister) into the game with this character deck packet. Also includes 2 variant cards for Harry's deck and 3 variant cards for Susan's deck to add a little variety to your play.

title: Sonic Blaze
description: Sonic & Blaze is a 2D fangame inspired by the Sonic Rush series and the 3D Boost games.

title: Sonic Battle Rush
description:
Based on the original on the Gameboy Advance, Sonic and the gang are back to duke it out with each other once more! Only this time as a 2D traditional fighter!

Fight as Sonic the Hedgehog and Shadow the Hedgehog in the Sage demo and learn the ins and outs of their expanded moveset!

Old mechanics from the original are making a return here as well!

title: Sonic: Before the Sequel - Redux
description: Sonic: Before the Sequel - Redux is a fan-made remake of Sonic: Before the Sequel.

title: Untitled Paper Mario Fangame
description: A playful reimagining of Paper Mario (N64)

title: Sonic Requeset
description: Sonic Requeset is just your generic Sonic fan game.

title: Sonic QWERTY
description: What if "Sonic CD" happened in alternative universe?

title: Sonic In The Timeline Of Madness
description: Sonic In The Timeline Of Madness is a fangame about the battle between Sonic and his friends against Eggman's evil plot. With the help of seven chaos emeralds, Eggman decides to mess up time so that he can carry out his plan.

title: Sonic Overdrive
description: Sonic Overdrive is a Sonic fangame that is a personal take on Sonic 4 episodes 1 & 2.

title: Sonic Outbound
description: Sonic Outbound is a Sonic fan-game set one year after Sonic Mania's bad ending where Robotnik had the Phantom Ruby and Chaos Emeralds in possession. After the final battle in the core of the Titanic Monarch, Robotnik was stuck in Little Planet and started collecting the Time Stones and preparing his greatest plan yet.

title: Aimee's Cafe
description: Aimee's Cafe is a cozy point-and-click adventure game where you play as Aimee, a lazy café owner who suddenly has to solve the mystery of the missing sugar, all to save the Spring Wake Festival.

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Taste of Rome Set - Chapter 5
description: Build your pizza empire with these decorations!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Villa Vista Set - Chapter 5
description: Decorate your very own Roman holiday!

title: Fast Food Crisis
description: A culinary battleground where iconic fast foods face their greatest threat: an uprising of militant vegetables. you take charge as a sentient pizza slice or a defiant hamburger, and more against these green invaders.

title: Firefighter Connor
description: Firefighter Connor is a linear narrative visual novel that tells a story in a modern world where humans and furries coexist. The player will play the role of Luo Geng, who is 22 year-old, eligible for marriage registration, and somehow ends up with a marriage with a furry firefighter named Connor.

title: Crime Boss: Rockay City - Dragon's Gold Cup
description: Travis Baker (Michael Madsen), a distrustful and spiteful gangster, joins forces with his rival, Dollar Dragon (Danny Trejo) in the first Expansion Pack of Crime Boss: Rockay City. Steal the King's gold and establish your legacy as the next Crime Boss.

title: Fastest Cars Traffic Racer
