description: Fastest Cars Traffic Racer invites you to endless highways for speed and adventure! Prepare for a real racing experience with four different racing modes and eye-catching graphics.

title: Scruffy Rides Again
description: Scruffy Rides Again is a top-down shooter game with platformer elements mixed in.

title: Disc Station #15
description: Disc station compile featuring many videos.

title: Disc Station 16
description: Disc station compile with a few full exclusive games.

title: Gunvolt Records Cychronicle
description:
Gunvolt Records Cychronicle is a new rhythm music game starring the songstresses of the Azure Striker Gunvolt series, Lumen, Lola, and Luxia singing 15 different songs.
Follow the notes to the pounding beat and aim for a top score in this electrifying rhythm game!
The dual analog controls sync with the characters dancing in the 3D backgrounds for a fully immersive experience.

title: Pokémon Academy Life
description:
Pokémon Academy Life is a visual novel that takes you into an alternate Pokémon world that doesn't send 10-year-olds off to fend for themselves. Familiar characters from the core series games are placed in an academy setting, where you take on the role of a student.

The majority of your time will be spent in the Kobukan (koh-BU-kahn) region, located fairly equidistant from the six regions. As Red (or custom player name), you are the dynamic protagonist who will interact with a plethora of characters. The story will progress in different branches depending on who you choose to talk to, who you try to befriend, pursue as a romantic interest, who you choose to help, and much more throughout your three years at the academy.

title: Global Soldiers
description: Global Soldiers is a video game published in 2005 on Windows by Clemens Hofmann. It's an action game, set in a shooter and fps themes.

title: Galshell: Blood Red Skies
description: Strange shooting guro themed game.

title: Mega Alien Destroyer
description:
Mega Alien Destroyer it's an action packed shoot em up, with distinct zones and huge alien bosses and machines, inspired in the classic shooters of the 80's and 90's like Alien Soldier, Contra series, Thunder Force series, Mega Turrican, Gynoug, Eliminate Down, R-Type, Salamander and others.

The world is in danger from an imminent alien invasion and you have to pilot a ship and fight to save it. Can you do it?

Mega Alien Destroyer is a challenging game but the bosses have their patterns that you will learn, if you lose your life in the first levels you will start over from the beginning but don't worry, there are checkpoints in the following areas.

title: The Pixel Grotto
description: The Pixel Grotto is a video game published in 2011 on Windows by Apocalyptic Coders. It's an action game, set in a fantasy and dungeon crawler themes.

title: 2001 TetRize
description: In 2001, AxySoft publishes 2001 TetRize on Windows. This action and puzzle game is now abandonware and is set in a falling block puzzle theme.

title: Afritis
description: 2002, the year AfriTris was released on Windows. Made by gaimplay and published by gaimplay, this falling block puzzle game is available for free on this page.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Megami Ibunroku Persona - Iku no Tou-hen
description: Escape from the other dimensional space ruled by demons. Another story of the Persona users.

title: Path of Kung Fu
description: Path of Kung Fu is a Wuxia RPG that blends classic martial arts storytelling with open-world freedom. Master kung fu, navigate the Jianghu's bloody conflicts, and rise from a novice to a legendary hero. Subscribe to top-rated Workshop MODs to elevate your experience to the next level!

title: Zarie: The Story of Sin
description: What kind of conversation will you have with the Shinigami girl? How will you conclude your story? The choice is yours in this tale of sin and 'the girl'.

title: Amp
description: Dive into the synesthetic world of Amp, the neon rail shooter set in a polygonal rhythmic universe.

title: Bug Bash
description: Get ready to unleash your inner exterminator in Bug Bash! In this thrilling and interactive game, players wield a virtual flipflop to squash pesky bugs as they scuttle across the screen.

title: Stolen Memories
description: Welcome to the real world! Hot girls distract you from your studies, but despite this, you need to get into the most prestigious university of Russia! Love or money - what would you choose? Or maybe both?! "Stolen Memories" is a non-linear romance visual novel.

title: Storm's Harvest
description: Grab your gourds! Storm's Harvest brings the spooky, arcade fun to your home! Storm, the pumpkin-picking spirit, has until sunrise to collect his crops. Pick a high score, but don't get picked-off! The beasts are also out to claim their prize!

title: Super Anthony's Joltzsi
description: Manage falling tetrominoes with an innovative top down perspective and layering mechanic in this all new action puzzle game that combines elements of Tetris, 1010 and Sudoku in one!

title: Tether Brawl
description: An action-packed, top-down, 2-player game set in a sci-fi world with a hint of cuteness, players are connected by a tether and must fight against waves of killer robots. Will you work with your partner to survive or betray them for a higher score?

title: Three Blades Ranch
description: Three Blades Ranch is a ranching management simulator set in the wild west with a high fantasy twist. After a dragon destroys your ranch it's up to you to rebuild, resettle, and reclaim your homestead from the beast's fiery claws.

title: Voin
description: Fight hordes of enemies in fast-paced first-person hack-and-slash battles. Explore the world of dark fantasy filled with secrets and dangers, and master your skill of wielding primordial elements.

title: Purple Explorer
description: Welcome to the enchanting world of Purple Explorer, where cuteness and adventure collide! Join our plucky protagonist, the lovable Purple Explorer girl, as she embarks on a heartwarming 3D platforming journey through vibrant worlds filled with stars, coins, hearts, and charming surprises.

title: Pumpkinman
description: Pumpkinman is variation of classical arcade games in Halloween setting. Travel through world of mystery, full of creatures from tales and horror stories. Improve Your skills and face final adversity.

title: Plebs & Pillagers
description: Rebuild your kingdom in this village management game. Command your loyal villagers to help you on your quest, and to expand your realm while defending it from unknown threats.The king has returned!

title: Scare Girl 2
description: A game at a haunted house and you're trying to collect 10 radio to open an escape door from a killer.

title: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles: The Great Battle
description: The leaders of every nation have raced to apply new technologies to their armaments industries, equipping their militaries with terrifying weapons of doom and destruction. War, they say, is inevitable.

title: SCP: Event XK
description: Set in the universe of the SCP foundation, play as Doctor Logan Andersen as you fight to survive a catastrophic containment breach releasing dangerous entities and objects beyond scientific explanation.

title: Skibidi Toilets: Invasion
description: Welcome to Skibidi Invasion, a heart-pounding FPS zombie shooter where you must obliterate cyborg toilets and restore order to a world in chaos! Armed with an array of weapons, unleash your fury against the rebellious toilets across seven distinct locations, each offering its own challenges and opportunities for strategic mayhem.

title: Shunya
description:
Shunya is a survival horror game where you must escape a secret medical facility while uncovering the horrifying truth behind its human experiments. Trapped as Patient #17, you awaken with fragmented memories, pursued by the mysterious Janitor whose sole purpose is to erase every failed subject before they escape.

Search abandoned wards, laboratories, and restricted treatment rooms for key items needed to unlock your path forward while avoiding the Janitor's relentless patrols. Stay out of sight, listen carefully, and use the environment to survive as every patient file and hidden note reveals another piece of the facility's disturbing history.

Explore a claustrophobic research facility inspired by secret medical experiments, filled with abandoned equipment, unsettling patient records, and atmospheric environments designed to keep you constantly on edge. Every corridor hides a new danger, every room tells a forgotten story, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

Will you escape the facility... or become another terminated patient?

title: Land of Crystals
description: Embark on a journey of exploration in Land of Crystals! A captivating collectathon RPG through a whimsical world filled with healing crystals. Collect and cleanse your crystals to save the island from the attacking monsters and overcome your vulnerabilities!

title: Keali
description: The other guardian spirits have gone missing, and now the timid Keali must traverse down into the forest temple to find them. Using your tether and other movement abilities to traverse past the creeping vines and what was long ago imprisoned there.

title: Hentai Maze
description: Welcome to the exciting world of "Hentai Maze", a world of mazes and puzzles where you play as a ball and must complete 50 levels to win! From simple mazes to complex puzzles, each level offers a unique challenge and riddles.

title: Hellbound Ropes
description: 「HellboundRopes」 is a speedrun game with special ropes and various platforming techniques to quickly escape from various obstacles in the city. Try different modes to beat your time!

title: GunRun
description: Kill lots of things. Like. A LOT.

title: Narona Sports: Supernatural
description: Unleash your competitive spirit and cuteness overload with this local multiplayer sports game! With randomly generated fields and different physics for each ball, each match will be completely different. Choose an adorable character and get ready to enjoy with family and friends!

title: My new neighbor is a Futa
description: A visual novel about a young woman who was not very happy in her marriage, but her whole life changed when a new neighbor moved in next door

title: Molar: Underground
description: Dig in for handheld-inspired retro adventure as you become Molar with Mole a tenacious new character brought to life in this side-scrolling, 2-D, monochromatic indie game. Each new level presents growing challenges and memorable bosses you're sure to enjoy.

title: Miniatures
description: Miniatures is a cozy puzzle game where you start a journey in the world of a bookworm girl. In this journey, you're tasked with solving puzzles of miniature-style illustrations to create cities by fitting blocks, making paths by aligning roads & rivers and reanimating landmarks by matching pieces.

title: Mardori
description: Mardori is a spaceshooter game with aspects of ARPG's. Upgrade your ship with various materials from missions, craft your equipment with damage or defense mods., create new weapons using blueprints, unlock new missions with Stargate.

title: My Lovely Empress
description: My Lovely Empress is a empire management sim inspired by Asian mythology. As the Emperor of the Crimson Empire, you will build relations with neighboring rulers, balance internal factions, and ensure the prosperity of your people, all before you reap their souls to resurrect your beloved empress.

title: Little Penguin Chillventure
description: Welcome to "Little Penguin Chillventure" – an exciting journey into the world of adventures! In this game, you'll become a little penguin embarking on a thrilling running adventure.

title: Blood Knuckle: Rooftop of The Impossible Skyscraper
description: Use your giant fist to punch, puzzle and scale your way to the top of a tyrannical skyscraper run by an evil sorcerer to rescue your brother!

title: Battlegrounds: At Enemy Gates
description: BattleGrounds : At enemy gates is a quick to learn tag of war strategy game. Deploy tanks & planes in this strategy-focused war game. title: State of Decay 2: Curveball Update
description:
How do you meaningfully add to a game that’s been in players’ hands for five years? In the case of State of Decay 2, you throw a curveball. Although this is the 34th update for State of Decay 2, Curveball represents a significant overhaul. This new update, coming to players for free on September 18, is a landmark moment for the game – not just offering a swathe of new content for the game’s most dedicated players and newcomers alike, but marking a new era in State of Decay 2’s development through the work of Wushu Studios.

Wushu, from Liverpool, England, will continue providing support to State of Decay 2 as much of original studio Undead Labs transitions to work on the next entry in the series – but where you might expect that support to be incremental, Wushu is making a very big splash. Curveball is a major update, touching almost every element of the game, and designed to consistently offer brand new challenges, even to those who have been playing State of Decay 2 since release.

Available after the fifth in-game day, curveballs can change the world around your settlement in some very interesting ways. Housed in a new menu, curveballs will periodically appear – each with their own narrative attached – offering new objectives, rewards, enemy types and much more. Curveballs can be positive (like finding increased loot) or negative (like buffing regular zombies in multiple ways); they can be timed or objective based; they can affect enemies, your survivors, or other NPCs. Effectively, any element of the game you may have gotten comfortable with can, and often will, change.

description: My Little Karaoke: Singing is Magic is an unofficial My Little Pony karaoke game for Windows, Mac and Linux. The game features music from the Friendship is Magic series, alongside various fanmade songs from the community.

title: Metroid: Eternal
description:
A 2020 April Fools "update" to the critically acclaimed fangame 'AM2R: Return of Samus'.

After exterminating the Metroids, Metroid: Eternal follows Samus as she returns to SR-388 to eliminate the Septogg threat as well, on the Galactic Federation's orders. This title is played from an old-school arcade perspective, with quick reflexes, item collection and strategic reloading being the main focus of the game.

title: Around us: Zombie shooter
description: Around us: Zombie shooter is a multiplayer cooperative zombie shooting game. There are various kinds of zombies and bosses. A lot of weapons and upgrades are waiting for you to unlock via waves. Try to survive the highest wave that no one ever reaches!

title: Lunar Depot 38
description: Oh, no! Angels are pouring down from space, interfering with the creative process and also threatening to burst through this strange door... Better get out your fish gun and lend a hand!

title: Perchance to Dream
description:
You awake after dreaming of a mysterious voice...but where are you?
Let's find out!

title: T.N.Terminus
description: This tells a short story about a marine who got into the trouble at the TNT corporation base. It consists of three levels, the first of which is a short intro.

title: Super Freaks: The Demo
description: Super Freaks: The Demo is not actually a demo, it was initially the testing ground for gameplay and features meant for the long-awaited Super Freaks 4ever but it was submitted to SAGE 2016 and later included in the Classic Pack as it was complete enough.

title: Neurotypical
description: You wake up as a teenager named Neo in a strange place, apparently in someones mind, and they want your help?! Collect items, fight enemies, and try not to get yourself annihilated! But always remember, nothing in this game is as "typical" as it seems.

title: Strato-Scruffy
description: Long awaited since 2009, Strato-Scruffy has now been finished. It's a Fantasy Zone-style shmup game with fancy graphics and bosses for its time.

title: Project N3T
description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device that functions as a powerful magnet. Complete a few tests by moving metal objects and using the magnet as a grappling hook in this short single-player experience.

title: Multiverser
description: Multiverser is an action game with rouglike elements, in which you defeat hordes of enemies who precede clashes with bosses. After each skirmish you gain currency, which makes you develop your characters stronger. All this to save the multiverse and clean it from all sorts of monsters.

title: Meurtre Au Florian
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Meurtre Au Florian! This game features real actors bringing captivating characters to life. This innovative experience transports you into the mysterious world of an enigmatic murder.

title: Spellbound Shuffle
description: Tactical roguelike deckbuilding game in a funky post apocalyptic far west. Pick a hero, build your own deck and cleanse the world from the evil. On top of regular attacks and defenses, make good use of movement and positioning on the grid to stay alive !

title: Stand Your Ground
description: Defend attacks from enemies from all directions within a limited time. Only by making full use of the differences in each tower and choosing appropriate random rewards can you survive.

title: NeverRage
description: NeverRage is a third-person online role-playing game, with action & tab-targeting combat that combines theme-park and open-world experiences.

title: Bad Dreams: Free Dive
description: Bad Dreams is a Solo VR Horror game with immersive gameplay based on real gesture. A unique experience, where nightmares become reality.Fight, Run, Jump, Wipe your eyes, Cover your ears... while avoiding the game's traps and puzzles, you won't come out unscathed!

title: KimodameshiGolf
description: Kimodameshi Golf is a horror golf game based on golf!

title: Shards of the Past
description: A trading trip with a nearby village turns into an epic adventure when you discover a hidden truth about your world. You will meet new friends and foes, explore amazing places, and face a choice that will shape the future. Your actions and choices will determine the outcome of this story.

title: Foxcrate
description:
Made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 53 game jam, "Delivery"

You are the newest employee of Foxcrate, a delivery service. Make sure everyone receives their packages on time!

title: Bug Heroes: Tower Defense
description: Help the Bug Heroes defend their food stash from hordes of enemies! Control powerful heroes, build your defenses, level up your heroes and towers, equip upgrades, and more!

title: Unknown Dungeon
description: Explore randomly generated maze with lots of treasures, puzzles and monsters. Help people, do quests, explore the dungeon, obtain treasures, gain experience and find out the history of the world!

title: Two Climbers
description: Two Climbers embark on a journey to climb a mountain, TOGETHER! This game requires 2 players who own the game to play!

title: Idle Space Navy
description: A sci-fi idler. Upgrade your ships, get new items, and conquer the stars.

title: Final Exerion
description: Call on CELLs, change your weapon, and shoot however you want!

title: Kosmocean: The Endless Sea
description: Adventure and submarine exploration game. Control your Bathyscaphe with the help of a logbook. Through the game puzzles, bullet-hell sequences, and skill-based challenges, you will be plunged miles and miles into the depths where the ocean seems to have no end.

title: Cactus Simulator 2
description: Cactus Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a cactus.

title: Halloween Games for Toddlers and Kids
description: A lovingly designed Halloween puzzle learning game for small preschool children. It contains an animal memory find the pairs game that you can play against a cat as your opponent. For fearless children or you have your diaper ready!

title: Lucia and the Possessed World
description: The Latina fighting Satina in Hell! Blast your way through demons to save your famiily!

title: My Ex-future Family: Premium Edition
description:
This version contains two additional features:
1) Cheats — you may control changeable parameters of character and girls with legal tool. It helps to open all pathes and scenes.
2) Events — when you play MEFF you would have your favourite scenes. This feature helps you to repeat all sex events from the game per one click.
3) Walkthrough (in game folder)

title: Mafia Online
description:
Mafia Online Game by MafiaInLT is the first entertainment Mafia platform built for emotions, intuition, and the thrill of the bluff — playable by anyone, from first-timers to seasoned players.

Up to 10 players join a session and are secretly assigned roles: Mafia, Doctor, Sheriff, Lawyer, or Civilian. Every game plays out in real time — live video and audio for every participant, directly in the browser via WebRTC. Players vote, target, and interact by clicking on live video feeds. Faces, reactions, and hesitation are part of the game.

The platform is visually illustrated with crafted art and atmosphere designed to make each session feel like an event. The experience is built around entertainment, social connection, and the raw human dynamics of trust and deception.

title: Dark Conflict
description: Welcome to "Dark Conflict"! This is a game full of strategy and war elements, allowing you to play as a leader, constructing buildings, assembling armies, and developing resources to compete for the glory of victory.

title: Missing Stars
description: Missing Stars is a visual novel that aims to depict mental disorders and the people who live with them in a realistic, but sensitive and respectful light.

title: Enigma Quest
description: Explore an enigmatic museum, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover lost secrets in this immersive puzzle-adventure game.

title: Drive Up
description: Embark on a thrilling journey in 'Drive Up.' Scale the floating objects on a mysterious island in the ocean. There are no saves; one fall, and you're back to square one. How high can you climb?

title: Game Store Simulator
description: Buy and sell video games, upgrade your shop,load the cargo in your vehicle and take it to your store. Sell them to customers, make improvements and purchase new items to increase customer satisfaction and earn your place in the video game sales empire.

title: Kinky Fight Club 2
description: Join the Kinky Fight Club, where sex is a competitive sport! Set the rules, customize your appereance, abilities and skills and get ready for intense matches to wrestle and seduce your way to the top and become the champion!

title: Asterix & Obelix: Heroes
description: Original gameplay combining deck building and turn-based combat. 24 heroes from the comic series available for you in this original adventure. To foil Caesar's plans, upgrade your deck and make the right tactical decisions!

title: Shadow Rebirth
description: Shadow Rebirth is a classic top-down ninja game with an exciting story, dungeon exploration, monster and ninja fights.

title: Beatmons 2
description: Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! I don't want to die

title: Rake Remastered
description: Survive the pursuit of a monstrous predator in "Rake Remastered," a tribute to the 2015 original. Uncover mysteries armed with traps and cameras. Outsmart the Rake, survive the nightmare.

title: Kizuyami
description: Kizuyami is an atmospheric psychological horror game. You find yourself in a never-ending Japanese street that you cannot exit wherever you go. You stumble upon the same house over and over again, which calls for you in inexplicable ways. Will you be able to find your way out?

title: Garnouille Must Live!
description: Help Garnouille. In a magical world full of dangers, Garnouille, an intrepid frog, embarks on a quest to save his habitat from imminent destruction. To do this, Garnouille must navigate through levels riddled with deadly traps using his special “dash” ability.

title: MechWarrior 5: Clans
description: MechWarrior 5: Clans follows a Star of Clan Smoke Jaguar warriors during Operation Revival, a full-scale invasion of the Inner Sphere. Armed with an arsenal of cutting-edge BattleMechs, meticulously designed maps and missions deliver immersive and intricate tactical gameplay and combat experiences.

title: Back to Reality
description: Oh no, this poor boy is trapped in a mobile game ad. Unfortunately, he's also completely incompetent. So please help him not to die. And to earn a living. Sounds awesome, right? Right? Now who is actually trapped here? Him or you?!

title: Volatile Particle
description: Play as a particle with the power to manipulate your electronic charge. Leverage the laws of physics to complete levels, collect gems and set records.

title: Rockets, Planes, Soldiers
description: A relaxing rock-paper-scissors mechanic, turn-based strategy on a hex-grid.

title: The Order of the Snake Scale
description: Inspired by Lovecraft, a psychological survival horror game set in a dystopian, alternative universe. Discover the mystery of the woman's death and learn the dark secrets of the Happy Rock. Are you ready? Demo available in February 2024.

title: Neon Marble Rust
description: Play as one of 3 Houses: Neon, Marble, or Rust! Each faction is completely unique: buildings, units, even resources are unique to each House. A two-state rollback system ensures smooth online gameplay, while a mix of challenging mechanics and automation allow you to play (and win) how you want!

title: Warlords Battle Simulator
description: Test yourself as a commander in a tactical game where you will have to choose the right units to defeat the enemy forces. Test combinations of different units in over 100 fun levels as you fight disciplined Undead, fast Barbarians and strong Orcs.

title: The Sun Shines Over Us
description: An award-winning visual novel that dives into the lives and minds of high school students. While focusing on the stories of victims of bullying, The Sun Shines Over Us also explores the social, mental and emotional issues facing modern teenagers.

title: Boundless Paths
description: A tower-defense roguelike with an emphasis on exploration - reveal monster paths, bonus resources, and sites to place towers. Tackle unique quests and unlock new options across endless procedurally generated maps!

title: The Lost Ashford Ring
description: "The Lost Ashford Ring," a captivating hidden object adventure set in the enchanting world of Victorian England. In this immersive game, you step into the shoes of a brilliant detective, hired to unravel a mesmerizing mystery that will test your keen eye and sharp wit.

title: Cryoterror
description: A space horror game with retro-like pixelation and dithering effects, where you explore a desolate spacecraft and its mysteries.

title: The Local
description: A fast-paced parkour game set in the Australian outback. Rail grind around the long abandoned country to complete orders or compete in timed courses. Master the movement mechanics and conquer the leaderboards.

title: Lonely Turret 2
description: Build up your defense turret with unique attachments to survive waves of enemies and bosses. With 5 unique levels each with their own endless mode and over 50 attachments to try out and upgrade, the fun never ends.

title: Ataraxie
description: Ataraxie, in the pure style of retro games, ties itself with the SNES Gaming era and embrace difficulty, for it wishes to give experienced gamers/players the test they are really looking for!

title: Monotonia
description: In Monotonia, you take on the role of a worker with a simple mission: press a button to dodge resistances and generate as much energy as possible, without succumbing to resource scarcity, exhaustion, or insanity. How far will you be able to go?

title: My Douchey Boss Has a Gentle Twin Brother?!
description: Kyle's new boss, Vincent, is mischievous and eccentric. One day, Kyle bumps into his boss after work and is surprised when his superior acts kind. Later, he finds out he'd actually met his boss' twin brother, Vernon. The brothers are estranged, but what happens when they fall for the same person?

title: Geist
description: The Empire has enlisted you in the Geist Squad. Complete missions based on WWII in order to fulfill the Empire. Each one will be harder than the last in this WWII FPS. You the Player will have to fight through the enemies of the Empire. You will face heavily armed soldiers based on events in WWII.

title: Move The Chains: Season 1
description: Move The Chains is a choice-driven adult visual novel that puts you into the shoes of a hot-button athlete who finds himself being given a second chance after spending a year behind bars. The road to redemption is a long one, but it's packed with girls, love, drama, and of course, sex.

title: Caesar's Revenge
description: Caesar’s Revenge is a single-player retro FPS set in classical antiquity. Bring retribution to the greedy senator’s that betrayed you. Become the fall of Rome.

title: SpaceDRG
description: SpaceDRG is a high-octane, motion sickness inducing action game featuring cute pixel art graphics. Fight against the letters D, R & G in a space themed 1980s retro arcade environment.

title: Squeaky Squad
description: The Squeaky Squad struck again! Fight an army of rodents in this roguelite platformer.

title: Tank War Shooting Simulator
description: Experience the excitement of tank wars with the Tank War Shooting Simulator! Feel like a tank driver with realistic graphics and various game modes.

title: Mandela Syndrome
description: A horror puzzle game about keeping the world from being forgotten, one box at a time. Control multiple switchboards, solve puzzle minigames and survive the horrors of this strange Association.

title: Orbital Defense Force
description: Orbital Defense Force (O.D.F) is a multiplayer shoot 'em up co-op rogue-like game. play as mercenaries working for the O.D.F., accepting contracts to defend planets from invaders and earn precious scrap that can be used to upgrade their ship to take on more difficult contracts.

title: Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War
description: A narrative rhythm game that takes you back to 1920. See, hear and feel the Battle of Warsaw from a novel perspective - a war telegraphist, the crucial bond between soldiers and commanders.

title: Slimedrop Laboratory
description: It’s war under your microscope: bacteria will devour your Slime cells if you don't help! In this casual strategy game grow your cell sample, guide them to stay out of bacteria’s reach, boost your cells power, and watch them use unique abilities for survival.

title: Subenishiki
description: This is a shooting action game in the style of Metroidvania. It is not a very complex maze, and the emphasis is on shooting combat. There are several types of weapons that can be used, and maintaining firepower is an important key to the strategy.

title: P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L.
description: P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L. It is a multiplayer TPS game with fantastic and colorful graphics, developed by a small team. Fight across multiple game modes and ever-growing maps. Take to the Field, Fight and Survive!

title: Bubu Kong Goes Bananas
description: "Bubu Kong Goes Bananas" is a modern solo adventure, blending classic Arcade game nostalgia with dynamic environments and epic boss battles for a thrilling banana-collecting experience.

title: The King In Yellow: Escape Room
description: You have been sent to investigate a spaceship whose members have inexplicably disappeared and there is a strange symbol everywhere. In this escape room you will have to solve puzzles as you get closer to the truth behind the mystery.

title: My Furry Protogen 2
description: After every night comes a new dawn, full of hope and light. As the adventure of our heroes continues, let's see what lies ahead!

title: Days of Haze
description: Days of Haze is a puzzle filled climate simulated action RPG where your actions affect the weather and temperature. Coated in the exakt NES palette. it's insides reveal a deep survival lite action RPG

title: Mukke
description: Mukke City is about to take its musical turn! Help the new music scene by getting your self-created music on the radio, rocking the local music venues and hanging out with your newfound friends! MUKKE lets you make your own way between laid-back everyday life and gripping intrigue!

title: Spy Racing
description: A "driving" game of sorts. You can move left and right, and a bit forward and back. Don't collide with other cars, and collect as many disks as you can.

title: I Commissioned Some Cats 3
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Restless Voronezh
description: Restless Voronezh - A game in the Top Down Shooter genre, where the player controls a hero and, using various available means, deals with his enemies in cramped rooms of a huge building, clearing floor after floor.

title: Telescape
description: Telescape is a horror / puzzle game consisting of multiple sagas that each have a different goal and add extra mechanics. Find items, solve puzzles and change the direction of gravity while teleporting a monster to a random location as your only means of defense.

title: The Arrogant Kaiju Princess and The Detective Servant
description: Living as a slave to the Monster Princess in a colorful cohabitation lifestyle! An enriching and exciting time management love development game.

title: Running Fox
description: A sweet little indie game where you need to run with the little fox through a whole level of ups and downs. To complete the game, you need to collect all of the 100 gems. You may need to keep your eyes open to even find the hardest hideouts. Can you do so?

title: Only Wish
description: Dive into Only Wish, where doors reveal secrets, chairs become treasures, and cars drive you into a vertical world of endless wonder!

title: Rust Rails
description: Rust Rails is a 2D roguelike platformer. You have to travel by train through randomly generated locations, collect resources, craft equipment, and fight enemies. On your journey you will be helped by a mysterious robot and other inhabitants of this world.

title: Pixel Puzzles World War II Jigsaws: Battle of Hürtgen Forest
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Tentacle Prawn: (Actually) A Cthulhu Dating Sim - The Myth & Legend of Marauder Shields
description: New story content! Two new Magnusball co-captains!

title: Slow Rise
description: A small adventure.The road ahead is difficult, moving and jumping.Carefully reach the finish line.Once you make a mistake, go back to the starting point.

title: Trapped in a Cage
description: Trapped in a Cage is a text adventure game developed by Disposable Club, where players will witness various events beyond human rationality that occur in an anti utopian prison. This is a small incision in a turbulent world, and also a brief moment of endless human nature.

title: Hundred
description: Let's set up our items and defeat monsters!!! Sorry, that's all there is!!!

title: Civilization Simulator
description: "Civilization Simulator": A casual simulation game that lets you control the fate of civilizations. Every click will impact the course of civilization. Whether it's prosperous trade or unexpected disasters, each turn presents a brand new challenge!

title: Island Clash
description: Island Clash is an adrenaline-pumping, fast-paced first-person shooter game! Unlock brand new weapons every time you eliminate enemies, with no ammunition limits, delivering a completely different shooting experience! Are you ready to take on the hail of bullets?

title: Cube Battlefield: 2048
description: A rogue-like top-down shooting game with infinitely generated levels. Grow a army of cubes with different abilities to break down enemies into smaller units. Make your cube army more powerful each time you are reborn.

title: The Scourge
description: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

title: The Nights on Arcade
description: In The Nights on Arcade, Axel searches for his sister in the spooky Arcade World. Face your fears and reveal dark secrets in this nightmare.

title: Three Goblin Wobblin'
description: Goblins are prohibited from entering a local tavern, but luckily, they hatched a cunning plan. Move and balance the three goblins to help them quench their thirst and end goblin discrimination in this cute casual wobbling simulator.

title: Leap to the Top+
description: You are a frog, leaping automatically every second to the top. But can you beat all 7 of the grueling levels along with defeating powerful foes to learn how to Leap to the Top? Can you get the best times for true mastery along with collecting all of the hidden collectables in each stage?

title: Cum & Climb
description: The higher you climb, the more undressed your companion will be! Choose one of the two and start to Cum and Climb! The most realistic animations and 3D models are waiting for you!

title: Infernae
description: Fear is not a shield. Only those who face it will survive this adrenaline-pumping bullet hell boss rush.

title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
description:
Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord is a full 3D remake of the first game in the legendary Wizardry series of RPGs. It is built directly on top of the original 1981 game's code. Although it looks all new, underneath the hood is the authentic game. You can even view the original Apple II interface as you play.

While the well-known difficulty of the enemies has not been altered, quality-of-life improvements have been added in every area. Party management, navigation, spellcasting, and combat have all been significantly enhanced.

title: Quantum Tripper: Math
description:
Purchasing this DLC enables the Math map to be fully playable.
When computational advancements render human sapience obsolete.

title: Your Train 2
description: You can operate trains more and more with your own train schedule! Train routes all over Japan and Taiwan, with a total of more than 50 routes!

title: All one click
description: Prove yourself against thousands of enemies in seemingly endless waves. Upgrade your skills from fighting with an ordinary bow up to casting powerful magic spells. "All one click" is an Action-RPG that reduces player input to the most existing part of every RPG: the level-up.

title: Bozalleth's Curse
description: Nightmares that wake you up in cold sweat. The world of dreams hides secrets and your sins. The game 'Bozalleth's Curse' tells you the story of Mary, who had an unfortunate accident eight years ago.

title: Fusing Noracam
description: Climb the mysterious tower to get the legendary treasure said to be at the top. The controls are simple, but if you make even one mistake, you will fall. You can also connect to the internet and climb with someone.

title: Pantheon: Card Game of Hentai - Part 1
description: Throw yourself into a fascinating adventure on the beach where you will meet mysterious goddesses! Defeat your opponents to win their favor and discover the secrets of their magical world.

title: Bombabomb!
description: Bombabomb! is a by old pre-installed games inspired game, where you light the bombs with matching neighbors to detonate them. The game is only complete when all the bombs have been detonated! When you say you can remove all the bombs easily, walk the talk!

title: The Windows Are Gone
description: Haunted by grief and guilt after a tragic accident, you start seeing a house in your dreams. No matter what you do, you can't get its image out of your mind. You feel it calling for you, so you answer it.

title: House 2
description:
As a terrible storm approaches, two young girls spend a fateful night watching TV and playing games…

House 2 is the sequel to the hit indie horror game, House. In House 2, you play as Tabby & Melody, finally free from their cursed home, in the next chapter of the House saga.

title: Wildlands Resurgence
description: section for a game where players need to survive from both other players and wildlife, mine resources, craft items and structures, and even form tribes:

title: Noah's Descent into Madness
description: Noah's Descent into Madness is a short horror-themed adventure and puzzle game. Make your way through a dark forest of unknown horrors while trying your best to escape the nightmare you've found yourself in.

title: Alice in the Nightmare Land
description: This is an escape adventure game. Within a building full of traps and mechanisms, your goal is to find the exit. Players will play as Alice, navigating through sealed rooms using click-based interactions to find items and solve the mechanisms to advance to the next stage.

title: Cyber Tower
description: Cyber Tower is a 3D cyberpunk Tower Defense game. Defend the city against virus-infected autonomous vehicles across 40 missions. Strategically place towers to eliminate enemies efficiently.

title: Blitz Guard
description: Embark on an indie souls-like game! Master the unique Parry Gauge system, where successful parries fill the meter, but beware: a failed parry or taking damage will deplete it. Show your skill and strategy to unleash powerful abilities in epic battles!

title: Tatari: The Arrival
description: Take the role of a detective from Tokyo who tries to solve the mysterious case of the disappearance of a young camper. You will try to follow the trail of evidence to guide you through an enigmatic and paranormal case connected with a Japanese urban legend. Can you help until the end?

You have recently died in an accident, and you just want to go to paradise. But when you're sent to the depths of Hell, you can only do one thing: travel through the Nine Circles and state your case of innocence to Satan.

Everyone has been kind to you so far. Too kind, maybe. Especially the Keeper of Heresy, the Sixth Circle. In the confines of his space while an ash storm rages outside, the two of you pry each other open. But he might break you first.

title: Kenophobia
description: A Psychological Horror Backrooms Found Footage Game

title: Widow in the Endless Labyrinth
description: The story begins with a missing superhero and Widow the supervillain is the only suspect in this case. Does she have something to do with the missing superhero or is she trying to hide something? This game is an action-roguelike game with randomly generated mazes.

title: Navigavia: Kirka's Island
description: Embark on an epic journey in Navigavia: Kirka's Island, a thrilling third-person action-adventure game. Unleash your inner hero against terrifying creatures.

title: Chill Seekers
description: Slide your penguins to safety in this relaxing puzzle game.

title: Lethal Beach
description: This is an RPG game where you will follow our protagonist to fight and save lives!

title: Soul's Spectrum: Awakening
description: You wake up in a mysterious dungeon, full of dangerous traps and unlucky inhabitants. Brain cracking puzzles await you while a dark story will slowly unfold in this supernatural place!

title: White Hat
description: White Hat is a bullet hell roguelite where you upgrade the game, not yourself, to progressively increase the difficulty. Earn points on runs that you can use to add more waves or research gameplay modifiers. Upgrades make the game harder, but increase your score multiplier.

title: Elfboarders
description: Battle against your friends as you race down the mountain slope in this multiplayer battle-racing brawler! Play with friends online, through LAN, or try to beat the computers solo. Four player maximum.

title: .Curator
description: In a world imagined by acclaimed SF writer Richard K. Morgan, you are The .Curator. Use C.R.I.S.S.I. to glimpse the future — and rewrite it! In this episode-based detective adventure, choose your path, decide who lives or dies, and turn enemies into stepping stones toward saving the world.

title: Rough Souls
description: A game with a new game style: Rough-Like

title: Cozy Hike
description: Dive into the serenity of Cozy Hike and discover the secrets nature has kept hidden for generations. Start your adventure today and let the wilderness whisper its stories to you.

title: No Numbers
description: Put two and two together in this minimalist, hex-based puzzle game that will rekindle your love for numbers. Solve thoughtfully crafted levels that invite you to engage your mind and explore the unique gameplay at your own pace.

title: Fire Water Green
description: This is a 30-second survival shooting game. You shoot with the mouse for direction and move your ship with WASD. There are 3 attributes: fire, water and green, and 3-way deadlock.

title: HeroBot!
description: "HeroBot!" Is a 2d platformer inspired by Kirby and MegaMan. You play as HeroBot a robot that can grab and absorb your enemies and use their powers against them. You can also absorb two powers and mix them together for a stronger power. Absorb and mix powers to adapt to any situation!

title: Sud-Oh-Ku: Furry Playtime
description: "Sud-Oh-Ku Furry Playtime" blends erotic fantasies and Sudoku puzzles, immersing players in a captivating world of super horny furries. Solve puzzles, engage in seductive conversations and experience stimulating sexual intimacy with a colourful cast of furries in this enchanting indie game.

title: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy
description: Build your diner. Grow exotic ingredients and create a menu for your intergalactic guests. Send expeditions to outer worlds in search of loot. Form alliances and rivalries with powerful factions and shape the fate of the galaxy. Welcome to the Diner at the End of the Galaxy.

title: Multi Turret Academy
description: Multi Turret Academy is a top-down tank shooter game where you serve as the commander of various WWII tanks to participate in tank battles.

title: Oh Satan, I Gotta Hide
description: A Prophunt game made by Students at a school Named "Asane Folkehogskole" in norway Hide around our school or look for the monster's that have become Props

title: Silver Moonlight
description: After many consecutive victories, the fierce Orc warriors began to attack the capital of the kingdom of Lusnistan. The fall of the kingdom of Lusnistan is now only a matter of time.

title: Railway Fugitive
description: Railway Escape is a railway shooting light ROGUE game. The player plays a rebel warrior who escapes the pursuit of AI life enemies, fleeing along the railway line. Players need to upgrade different abilities and defeat all enemies in front of them.

title: Asurajang
description: Asurajang is a new Battle Royale experience that mixes in melee combat that packs a punch and trendy anime style graphics. Pick your favorite character and engage in strategic combat to become the last team standing in Asurajang.

title: Shape Hunter
description: Shape Hunter is a 2D roguelike action game in which players defeat an infinite number of monsters.

title: Time to Strike
description: Time to Strike is busted build bullet hell roguelike. Create overpowered builds and break the game by collecting powerful weapons, modifying them with whacky mods and discovering crazy synergies!

title: Perfect Ninja Painter
description: Perfect Ninja Painter is a colorful arcade puzzle game that's so much fun, it's hard to stop. Paint the walls through 50 levels and try to get all stars!

title: Break the Loop
description: Break the Loop is a turn-based Rogue-like RPG. Compose your team and create a timeline by selecting the events you'll go through. Each decision will bring you one step closer to the ultimate threat, but will you have accumulated enough power to stop the apocalypse?

title: La Frana
description: This is a very simple antigame. I made it to represent a situation very common in real life but absolutely impossible in videogames.

title: Mega Man Permafrost
description: ...features 5 polished stages, 4 smaller secret stages, original art and assets, a completely original soundtrack, and more!

title: Lugh World
description: A living world awaits new explorers. Capture creatures called Lughs, evolve your team, and face epic challenges in real-time combat. In Lugh World, your adventure is shaped by the choices you make, the Lughs you encounter, and the challenges you decide to overcome in an evolving world.

title: Hikkikomori Quest
description:
Hikkikomori Quest is an RPG where the player controls a reclusive individual who has not left his house for a year. When he eventually runs out of food, he seeks help at the website 4chan but they only mock him, so he decides to finally venture outside and buy food.

With the help of a sarcastic tutorial owl he has to search for a 9 eleven shop. Once inside however, he is incapable of purchasing the food and his mind transforms the shop into a dungeon where he has to fight cans of soft drinks and hot dogs. The game consists of four main dungeons with a final boss and alternate endings based on some decisions in the game.

The character's basic attack is screaming, but after gaining experience he can learn new talents. While walking around he is dragged into random battles where he can also choose to run away. The statistics are based on energy and stamina. Saving is done by writing a livejournal blog entry and he shop online at Amazon. There are also some vending machines to buy drinks that replenish stamina. Other statistics are confidence, willpower and mindpower, he can wear weapons in his left and right hand (initially a fist of dork), a hat, a shirt and other accessories.

The game is very difficult. Some of the graphics are done by Paul Robertson, famous for the animated film Pirate Baby's Cabana Battle Street Fight 2006.

title: Tawamu i-call
description: Tawamu i-call is a short game with a romantic friendship element that is mainly conversational released by kanekodou.

title: Carrion: Greatest Time of Year
description: In honor of the December holidays developers Phogia Game Studio released a special holiday update for the monster game Carrion called the Greatest Time of the Year. This update is free for players and features a brand new level for players to complete in-game. This DLC level tasks players with taking the monster through a base that has been decorated for the holidays.

title: WizardryWars
description:
The game is simple: You play as Wizards who have magical powers. Using your powers, you must kill all the other wizards and be the last wizard standing.

It is as simple as that
This was made for 2 hour challenge by the talented devs at Stux Group.

title: Dawnshard
description:
Dawnshard is a multiplayer fantasy card game for pc and mobile devices. Focused on eSport and competition.

Dawnshard is the first digital card game that integrates procedural generation in deck building, with the intention of removing the meta-game.

Playing Dawnshard feels like exploring a Jungle. In the Jungle, you have the tools you have.

You can’t just look up what the best strategies are. You'll have to adapt during each game to your opponent's strategies!

title: Beltion: Beyond Ritual
description: Beltion: Beyond Ritual is a fantasy action RPG with steampunk elements. The game is set in the diverse world of Sarmontazara and includes a large variety of weapons and types of armor for players to utilize on their quest to summon the enigmatic power of Beltion.

title: Marito Arcade 2
description: Marito Arcade 2 is a pure arcade game based on the Marito Baracus universe.

title: Slith
description: A five-map episode for Doom II with Thy Flesh Consumed-inspired visuals and Plutonia-like gameplay.

title: Majukes Tower Defense
description:
You are the Supreme Mage who controls a powerful magic tower. This tower attracts many monsters and monsters who dream of destroying it.

Your task as the Supreme Mage is to protect the tower and prevent it from being destroyed.

title: Revolgear II: Second Brightness
description: A freeware horizontal shooter developed by Bikkuri Software. It is an upgraded version of Revolgear II ver. 1.00 originally released in September 2012.

title: Sex Play: Naughty Doctor
description: A quick and dirty game made for your pleasure. Contains visual novel elements and a sex simulation part. You play the role of a doctor who cures his patient's sexual problems.

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 7
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki and her husband meeting her boss for a live cuckolding experience. Will Adam enjoy being dominated by the guy who fucks his wife? Follow their Sex Story and find out!

title: Fragment's Note 2+
description: This is the story of the future.

description: Gather up to 6 friends, and compete to join the Council! Customize your mage and team up or challenge each other in easy-to-learn mini-games that will have you all laughing and cheering together. Not enough controllers? Connect your phone and play! Create memories in this whimsical party game!

description: Sclera is a Lovecraftian turn-based strategy roguelike set in a dying, near-futuristic world. Through menu-style combat, text exploration and skill-check events, maintain your sanity and manage resources as you gather a dark essence needed to survive the inescapable eldritch horror now hunting you.

description: Reborn on an island paradise filled with fantastical monster-people, live your brand new day-to-day life making friends and indulging in erotic intimacy!

description: Investigate an experimental Farm and stop the Global Vegetable Crisis!

description: Nothing brings people together as well as a common grief or crime! Can you bravely confront a criminal puppeteer with no legal defense?

description: Foggy Rainfall Escapade is a 2D indie platformer, invites you into an enchanting adventure. Follow a young adventurer's journey through mesmerizing visuals and soothing melodies. In a world of serene beauty and calm foggy rain, he embarks on a quest to find his way back home.

title: Deidthraw
description: Deidthraw is a first person endless shooter with rogue-lite elements set in a fantasy style 1940's era Scotland. Fight, Upgrade, Build defences and Survive against the hordes in Deidthraw. How long will you make it?

title: Legend of the Sword: Hongwu Age
Mind War

title: Embers: Return to Dragonland
description: Save your legacy from the goblins by embodying legendary dragons in this cooperative twin-stick shooter action.

title: Vogvhathos
description: As an elf in a panicked flight from home, you discover a more dangerous secret; a human claiming to be a dragon.

title: Ticket to Ride
description: The cross-country train-adventure game is on its way! It's a fresh take on the iconic board game in stunning 3D. Play with friends, family and players of all ages around the world. Drive your enterprise from coast to coast and strategise as lines collide and direct routes grow!

description: Fragment: A Story in Growing is a stream-of-consciousness life simulator game. title: Rebels: Under the Spell of Magic - Chapter 4
description: A Visual Novel game about adventure, fantasy, magic and friendship. This is a continuation of Chapter 3. There are only a few choices that can be made, and some paths to choose from. The decisions do not have an impact on the ending, instead they provide slightly different content.

title: Oxytone
description: Relax and listen to the hypnotizing world of Oxytone, slow paced puzzle game where you rotate hexagonal tiles with paths. Each tile can be used up to six times, creating tangled paths.

description: You play as Lennox, a psychic who ends up in prison for a good deed gone bad. A detective and a psychologist offer him freedom in exchange for help using his abilities. But what starts as yet another good deed quickly devolves into true psychological horror.

title: Animalism
description: It's time to become an actor in social deduction games! Become animals assigned roles and cooperate or compete for collective or individual goals. But watch out for the animals next to you, each with a different purpose. They can be allies, bystanders and even traitors!

description: The only way to solve the trolley dilemma is to delay the inevitable fate forever by trapping the trolley in a loop in a series of tiny puzzles.

title: Airport Renovator Simulator

title: Gas Station Simulator: Tidal Wave DLC
description: In a tropical island paradise owned by the god-like active volcano, Chunchumanchu, players embark on a unique adventure inspired by Robinson Crusoe. Starting near the coast, they discover an abandoned Gas Station.

title: Defense Cards
description: Defense Card is a very creative barrage shooting game. It combines the gameplay of barrage shooting and card use. It also has a random in-game growth mechanism, making it an addictive and fast-paced bullet hell game. curtain shooter

title: Max Capacity
description: Be the Boss....How quick can you get rich and expand your empire? Do you create everything on your own or buy on the market? Before you get to that point, what will you make? Should you go for a finished product or build material used by others to create product?

title: Stress testing
description: This is a challenging horizontal game that showcases a resilient spirit of challenge！

title: Mech Academy
description: It is the year 2075 and you are the pilot of a Guardian Mech. Gigantic war machines built to defend Earth from the Noxa, a ruthless alien race intent on conquering your planet. As a result of a mysterious experiment, you have been catapulted two centuries forward in time...

title: Cuckold Chair Simulator 2023
description: Welcome to the captivating world of Cuckold Chair Simulator 2023! This unique game combines an intriguing storyline with the engaging gameplay of Idle and Clicker genres.

title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
description: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered.

title: Fallout 3: Remaster
description: A remaster of Fallout 3 announced on July 17, 2026.

title: Dishonored 3
description: Dishonored 3 is the upcoming third entry in the Dishonored series. The title was leaked in court documents relating to the FTC v. Microsoft case.

Explore the dark and mysterious factory, where you will face terrifying creatures and deadly traps. Complete scary missions and unlock characters like Freedy Skibidi, Toilet and Huggy Wuggy. Can you survive the nightmare and escape the factory?

title: Shadow King
description: The Shadow King has invaded the castle belonging to the Knights of Valor and they need your help to get it back! Explore the massive castle in this metroidvania and help the fallen knights back to their former glory! Upgrade your moves and weapons along the way as you fight minions, defeat bosses, find secrets, and unravel what has happened.

title: Folder Dungeon
description: Dungeon crawler roguelike inside computer folder!

title: No Sleep for Sole
description: No Sleep for Sole is a surreal survival horror game about mental illness and abuse. You play as a young boy named Sole who stays awake at night to protect himself from the monsters he sees around his home.

title: Swipepi
description: Minimalist and unique puzzle game

title: Venatrix
description: Venatrix is a unique hybrid of action-packed and stealth-based horror game.

title: Aero Dancing I
description: The third game in the AeroWings series, Aero Dancing i, was only released in Japan, for the Dreamcast and Windows. The "i" stands for Internet, as it was the first title of the series with an online mode. It was also the first in the series to offer air-to-ground missions.

title: Five Nights on the Toilet: Number 2
description:
A comedy parody of the Five Nights at Freddy's indie horror series, and the sequel to Five Nights on the Toilet.

Survive five nights upon a toilet in an abandoned Freddy Fazbear's location, and investigate what events brought the story to where it is now.

Features first person sit and survive horror gameplay, with many levels, secrets, and challenges.

title: Five Nights on the Toilet
description:
A comedy parody of the Five Nights at Freddy's indie horror series.

Survive five nights upon a toilet in a Freddy Fazbear's location, and find clues as to what's really happening that week.

Features first person sit and survive horror gameplay, with many levels, secrets, and challenges.

title: The Legend of Beowulf
description:
The Legend of Beowulf is an action adventure game that has been developed primarily for younger audiences.

The plot loosely follows the famous poem telling the adventures of the titular Scandinavian warrior. The player is provided a more accessible adaptation of this work, focusing on selected events portrayed in a fairy tale style. The action of the game takes place in the 6th century AD, and the protagonist's main objective is locating and defeating the beast called Grendel. In the next phase of the game, after the official coronation of Beowulf as King of Denmark, the goal is to face the mother of the defeated monster.

While playing as Beowulf, the player explores a variety of lands and eliminates comical opponents, solves simple puzzles, and plays mini-games.

title: Trail Out: Steel Wheels
description: Create chaos on multi-wheeled vehicles with extra features!

title: Detective Zhuge
description: "Detective Zhuge" is a detective puzzle game. Players through the "two-in-one" play, in the game's story level to promote the story, explore the level to find clues to the case, and finally in the trial level, through all the clues obtained, the suspect is finally brought to justice.

title: Take A Leak
description: Human testing is back in fashion! Solve the puzzles laid out by Toilet Labs in this piss-filled experience. Our state of the art latrine testing facilities ensure you will feel more relief on solving a puzzle than ever before.

title: Ultimus
description: Introducing Ultimus: A Vision of First-Person Shooters, circa 1965.

title: The Protean Forest
description: The game "The Protean Forest" combines Rogue-Like card game and turn based mechanisms. Defeat demons by deploying and moving unit cards in the area and using skill cards at appropriate times. Uncovering the secret of The Protean Forest

title: The Paper Trials: Chapter 2
description: A first-person horror maze game. Hiding & Standing still is Death. Run or you are dead. Trapped in a realm of nightmarish mazes with your only hope of survival is to find all of the pages to the mysterious book and escape!

title: The Infirmity
description: The Infirmity is the third-person zombie shooter game that includes the stories of different characters living during the zombie epidemic.

title: With Eyes Closed: Season 1
description: With Eyes Closed - Season 1 is a thriller in the adult visual novel genre. It concentrates on storytelling, realistic characters, and letting players control the development of the story. The game also features plenty of hot scenes that are interwoven into the storyline.

title: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles: Ancient Empires
description: Long-lost civilizations are rumoured to live on in the deepest, darkest rainforests. Many intrepid explorers have attempted expeditions into these uncharted lands, but none have yet lived to tell the tale.

title: Survivors of the Mare Vitalis
description: Survivors of the Mare Vitalis is a Rogue-Lite action game, which you can discover unique planets and it's biomes while thousands of animals and uncategorized life forms coming after to kill you!! Earn Credits while destroy them, upgrade yourself and destroy the Ecosystem of each planet!!

title: Temple of Aeryn
description: In the mystical world of Temple of Aeryn, an enchanting adventure awaits you, filled with magic and mythical creatures. Tragedy strikes when a brutal assault on your village reduces your spell book to ashes, leaving you vulnerable to the encroaching darkness.

title: Plant Gallery: A Short Botanic Experience
description: This is a short game about a gallery with plants. As a player you can walk through the gallery and view the frames. In order to complete the game, you will need to find keys, open chests and connect the right name tags to the right paintings. Duration of the game is aproximately 15-30 minutes.

title: Clue: Murder By Death
description: A narrative adventure set in 1930s England. Immerse yourself in an adventure where knowing who, how and why will depend on your skills as a detective.

title: Mikene's Aspects

title: Rolling Toolman 2 Deathly Traps
description: New rolling toolman game. Try to reach finish fast and avoid deathly traps

Explore the town, Fight zombies, Find the last survivors, and Discover who is behind the mysterious factory explosion that caused it all, all while following the story from 2 different points of view.

title: Kaizo Block

title: Illuminate Frame
description: "Illuminate Frame" is a mouse-click-only simple puzzle game where you strategically place various tiles on the board to conduct electricity from power tiles to terminal tiles, aiming for high scores.

title: HordeFighter 2D
description: Challenge yourself to see how long you can last against endless waves of enemies, and discover hidden areas by completing tasks. Use the souls of your slayed enemies to unlock permanent upgrades to help you survive longer each run.

description: Come and defeat the evil gods! Create your personal outfit, overcome the siege of numerous monsters and leaders, and usher in a new victory! Gods Wars is a pixel ARPG Rogue like Game. You can obtain epic artifacts, upgrade epic skills, choose your epic pet, face the powerful evil gods!

title: Friends Play Pool
description: Invite your friends to play pool. Optimised for Steam Deck

title: Coneru: Dimension Girl
description: Embark on a 2D action date with the dimension-girl, Coneru! This time, your date plan is to fend off the mysterious alien group "Hateful Fruit Company" invading Shinjuku City!

You must navigate through five maps, facing a variety of enemies, including shotgunners, snipers, melee fighters, kamikazes, and more.

title: Flightmare
description: Indie horror game that will take your adrenaline to another level.

title: Eseala
description: As Eseala, you navigate misty cliffs and forgotten pockets of time, uncovering knowledge of the past, present and future.

title: Emzombed
description: Emzombed - You must kill all of the Zombies and solve the mystery of the island.

title: Disco Samurai
description: Disco Samurai is a unique rhythm combat game in a cyberpunk setting. Challenge your skills by smoothly combining attacks, parries, dashes and other abilities to the beat of the electronic music. Crank up the volume and seize the rhythm of the electrifying soundscape of synthwave and rock!

title: Deep Space Directive
description: Build. Expand. Upgrade. Defend. Combine TD and RTS mechanics to defend your growing economy.

description: Swing your liana, plant and throw seeds in Auxin! Local and online multiplayer fun featuring intenses versus matches in 4 modes, for up to 4 players. Swing into action!

description: Ambusher is a tower defense game. Set your traps. Build your towers. Prepare your defense and survive until sunrise.
