description: Prepare for your first day of work as a delivery man, ride your bike, make deliveries, meet new people. Enjoy a delivery-filled story driven adventure in the not-too-distant future and discover the true nature of city's existence.

title: Apex Heroines
description: Hack&Slash – Beat'em all! Six heroines, five types of weapons and adrenaline-pumping levels create an adrenaline rush you can't resist. Easy to learn and hard to master. 4K/120Hz & SteamDeck-ready. Everyone can enjoy the game!

title: Bloxtacle Course
description: Bloxtacle Course is a block breaker game where you are given nearly full control over the ball itself.

title: Cat Life Simulator
description: Cat Life Simulator is a realistic simulation game that allows you to see the world through the eyes of a cat. Explore the world, interact with the environment, and create your own cat's story. Your adventure begins in a domestic setting, but over time, you will discover many other places.

title: Bob the Elementalist
description: The magical power of the elements is our last hope for survival! Master the four elements in this indie puzzle platforming challenge.

title: Bob's Mansion
description: Bob's Mansion is a First-Person, Survival Horror, Adventure game where you use your skills to Run, Hide, Fight and Survive the darkness within your family home.

title: OMSI 2: Hohenkirchen
description: Welcome to the Hohenkirchen expansion for OMSI 2 - Experience the diversity of Thuringia with this add-on in an OMSI map that has been deliberately optimised for a fluid gaming experience!

title: Friday Night Funkin': Skibidi Invasion
description: Friday Night Funkin': Skibidi Invasion is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' based on the Skibidi Toilet series.

title: LEGO Technic Bionicle Nestlé
description:
In 2001, LEGO System A/S publishes LEGO Technic Bionicle Nestlé on Windows. This action game is now abandonware and is set in a licensed title, platform and promotional themes.

It's a side-scrolling platform game where the player can play as any of the six colored original Bionicle.

title: Magic: The Gathering 7th Edition Starter
description:
Introductory game to help new players learn how to play Magic the Gathering.
This game was developed by Coresoft Inc. and published by Wizards of the Coast.

It was included in the 2-Player Duel Sets of the 7th Edition Core Set of Magic the Gathering in 2001.

title: SAS: Zombie Assault
description: The world is being taken over by bloodthirsty zombies. Be brave, hide behind the barricades and face them.

title: A Vampire Romance: Paris Stories
description:
A young art student moves to Paris and falls in love with a young and enigmatic man. When her new love suddenly disappears, she must travel the city, solve a mystery, and discover her lover's secrets in this thrilling adventure!

Investigate the Seine river banks, the Pére Lachaise Cementery and more as you uncover clues and determine your destiny.

title: Nova
description:
Nova is essentially an RPG with horizontal Level Scaling, which means that any advantages players get over other players are temporary, with skill and game-knowledge being the primary determining factors in player success.

When a player logs into the game, they are presented with 5 points of interest: The Courtyard, the Kingdom, the Desert, the Forest, and the Dungeon. These locations' unique objectives and loot combined with their varying aesthetics and purposes give them each a unique personality.

There are 5 classes in Nova: Fire, Frost, Shadow, Nature, and Storm. Because of the bifurcated class structure and the unique synergies of the elements, there are essentially 10 fun and interesting classes. Each element entails 7 unique abilities that can be cast at any time with the only limitation being mana costs. This leads to 10 very different elemental combinations, all with access to unique Talents and Augments.

title: AFL Live: Premiership Edition
description: Released for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 2 and Xbox on 29 April 2004. The game is based on the 2004 AFL season with team rosters based on that year. It was developed by IR Gurus and was the final AFL game to be published by Acclaim Entertainment, before their bankruptcy on 1 September 2004.

title: Balvenie's Birthday Party
description: Balvenie's subjects are preparing a party for her birthday, you must help her getting ready for it.

title: Tomb Raider: Legend Demake - Chapter One
description:
Tomb Raider: Legend Demake is a fan-made reimagining of Tomb Raider: Legend using the classic Tomb Raider engine. Originally released in 2006 and developed by Crystal Dynamics, Tomb Raider: Legend has been adapted here by Delca using an enhanced version of the Tomb Raider IV engine (TRNG). The gameplay and environments have been reinterpreted to reflect the style and design typical of Core Design's work in the late 1990s, often referred to as the "classic" era.

Chapter One features four levels: Croft Manor, Bolivia, Peru, and Japan. A follow-up containing the second half of the game is currently in development.

The story centers on Lara’s search for her mother and the mythical sword Excalibur, with some narrative elements reworked and simplified for this version.

Cutscenes are voiced in French, with English subtitles provided.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Ranseiki
description: The ninth title in the Nobunaga no Yabou series, this game returned to province-taking battles, and a system of varying powers was introduced.

title: Soft Kitten Experience
description: Created by Sylvie & Aria, featuring music by Frédéric Chopin and 煉獄庭園 (Rengoku Teien) The difficulty is extremely high. Controls: Figure it out yourself!

title: Claustrophobic Nights
description: Claustrophobic Nights is a complete reimagining of a VR game called Crawlspace 2 in the style of FNaF Help Wanted with multiplayer included. In the game, you crawl through tight spaces and solve various puzzles whilst evading animatronics in order to beat the night.

title: Hot Dog Reporter
description:
Hot Dog Reporter is a (very early access) game about a hot dog in a hurry.

It's a fast paced platformer with a speedrun mode that will eventually turn into a metroidvania with a mystery to solve and charmingly weird characters to meet (and a speedrun mode). Once the linear levels are iterated on enough to finalize Hot Dog Reporter's mechanics, gameplay will begin to spill onto the sprawling, interconnected city streets of New Yorkshire City.

title: Laughing to Die
description: Nannan returned to her hometown to attend her grandmother's funeral.

title: Seal Online: Eternal Destiny
description: An anime-style MMO based on the original Seal Online game. The features six classes with two sub-classes available for each.

title: Oripathy
description: A series of short/medium-length speedmaps made throughout the course of one month and a half.

title: Netto de Para
description: A port of Nekopara: Nekosogi Paradise that removes sexual content. Released in Japan for Dreamcast and in Korea for PC.

title: Where the Two Flowers Meet
description: An indie psychological horror visual novel about the meaning of everything that has been lost, along with the memories of our time together.

title: Enemy Star
description: Enemy Star is a Lander-style game, where the player is a bomb defusal pilot, blasting away through heavily defended underground caverns, past wind tunnels, fire walls and subterranean lakes. There are 27 missions across 5 different worlds.

title: Fantastic Haven
description: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.

title: Biggles On Mars
description: Grandson of the famous pilot, Biggles makes his living defending the planet of Mars with his rickety plane. Can he overcome a menacing scheme and also finally move into a new line of work?

title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Conqueror of Jiangdong
description: Conqueror of Jiangdong is the second DLC for Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty. It follows Sun Ce and his forces as they begin their campaign to conquer Jiangdong after the death of Sun Jian. The DLC adds new battlefields, weapons, equipment, demons, a new Divine Beast, a higher difficulty level, and additional endgame content.

title: Exoprimal: Season 2
description: Season 2 includes a new Survival Pass and runs from October 18th, 2023 to January 17th, 2024.

title: Rabbitmaiden Softbook
description: Rabbitmaiden Softbook is a companion visual novel to the mainline rabbitmaiden softworks vns (e.g. heartlovepowertemple)

title: Skull Scavenger
description:
Skull Scavenger is an unforgiving twin-stick Extraction Looter Shooter where you are a soul trying to get out of hell.

Procedurally generated maps ensure you never escape from the same level twice!

title: Yohane the Parhelion: Numazu in the Mirage
description: Yohane the Parhelion: Numazu in the Mirage is a deck-building roguelite set in the world of Yohane the Parhelion.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

title: Half-Life 2: MMod - Half-Life 2: Update
description: This mod is to run Half-Life 2: Update (itself a mod for the original Half-Life 2) under MMod.

title: Plumbers Don't Wear Ties: Definitive Edition - Collector's Edition
description: Plumbers Don't Wear Ties: Definitive Edition - Collector's Edition includes a physical copy of the game (on USB or Disc, PC release contains a bonus Steam key), a strategy guide, an 18"x24" reversible poster, a wearable replica tie, an "Plumber on a Bike" decal, a sticker sheet, 4x6 framed picture of the protagonist Jane and an 7" vinyl that contains the soundtrack of the game.

title: Syndicate of Souls
description: A tactical MOBA with a classic old-school feel and a few innovative twists. In "Syndicate of Souls", battle unfolds across three distinct maps. "Roadway To Ruin" is a 1v1 snowy bridge, providing tense duels. "Deserted Stronghold", a 3v3 map, places players amid swampy ruins, emphasizing team tactics. Lastly, "Dreamfall Grove", a 5v5 battleground, immerses players in a mystical forest with vibrant fauna, promoting expansive team strategies. Each map reflects the game`s emphasis on tactical gameplay, strategic positioning, and environmental interaction.

title: Mimizu Panzer
description: Snake like tank game.

title: Tales of the Shire
description: Welcome home, Hobbit! Live the cosy life of a Hobbit in the wonderfully serene landscape of the Shire. Discover, decorate, & share in this idyllic corner of Middle-earth. Join friendly Hobbits & familiar faces awaiting your arrival in Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings Game.

title: Leisurely Brick
description: This is a leisurely brick game, the control of this game is to use the mouse to control the reflector to move for the reflection ball to attack the bricks, this game belongs to a casual game, the store in the game has a lot of strengthening content to improve the game experience

title: Megalothymia: Mokusei Zettai Bouei-ken - Heaven's Fall
description: This is a space fleet shooting game that can be easily enjoyed with FPS-like controls.

title: Chaos Metaverse
description: free, there will dance, will send skills of beauty and hero butler, there is a character special effects system, there is a dressing system, skin system, and MMO-style shooting, lobby chat, friends system, equipment system, props system, leaderboard system, view the results

title: IL-2 Sturmovik: Hell Hawks Over the Bulge Campaign
description: History books called them the "Hell Hawks", the USAAF called them as the 365th Fighter Group, the Germans called them a terror.

title: IL-2 Sturmovik: Lisunov Li-2 Collector Plane
description: Li-2 was a Soviet C-47 sibling armed to the teeth.

title: IL-2 Sturmovik: Ten Days of Autumn Campaign
description: This campaign shows the actions of 3./JG 52 it the end of October 1941.

title: Cardfight!!: Additional Card Set Vol.6 [D-BT09] - Dragontree Invasion
description: Unlock cards from [D-BT09]: Dragontree Invasion.The booster pack will be added to the in-game shop, and included cards will be available for crafting.

title: Bulanci: Hero Factory
description: The Hero Factory, where you can choose the right pattern and colour for your Bulanci. You can highlight the nature of your killer pillow with sunglasses, an eyepatch, a baseball cap, or leather gloves, to name but a few.

title: Vae Victis: Khan
description: Conquest and seduction, sexual dominance and fiefdom management; Forging an empire is a brutal business where you must balance the needs of your budding Khaganate with your own desires. In this revenge story meets an empire simulator, the risks are high but the bounties are heavenly...

title: The Seven Realms: Realm 3 - High Lathión
description: The Seven Realms is a fantasy, story-driven, adult visual novel where your choices will shape the fate of the Realms and the people around you. Will you be a Fair or a Strong Ruler? Will fate be enough for you, or will you want more? The choices are yours to make.

title: The Foretold: Exordium
description: Embark on an ancient Egyptian odyssey in this prequel to the gothic horror card game, The Foretold: Westmark Legacy. Build your deck, collect relics, and wield items to conquer creatures and bosses lurking in Egypt's shadows.

title: Vox Populi: Poland 2023
description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for the Polish parliamentary election of 2023! In "Vox Populi: Poland 2023", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

title: Wanted Shadows
description: Decimate thousands of demons on All Hallows' Eve to protect your infernal home. Wanted Shadows is a bullet heaven roguelite where the difference between overpowering and being overpowered lies in your skill and wit.

title: Tale of the Shadow World
description: Walking through the forest, the girl found an interesting book, after reading which her world turned upside down for a while. And maybe forever. The shadow flowers gently whispered to her, luring her further into the darkness. Will she be able to bear the moral of this tale?

title: Temple Knight Saga: Oath of the Knight's Sword
description: The story of the Three Temple Knights, dispatched on a secret mission, and takes place .Along the way, Sir Virginio accepted a request from a certain lady. But what truly awaits him. JRPG Quality. Translated with help from native English speaker, and not machine translation.

title: Surveillance
description: Surveillance is a psychological horror in which you have to prevent high paranormal activity In different places around the world. Identify suspicious changes in environment and take immediate action!

title: Sushi Battle Rambunctiously
description: "Sushi Battle Rambunctiously" is a comical physics-based action battle royale party game where appetizing sushi, created by combining various types of 'shari' and 'tane', engages in fierce combat alongside zombified sushi to survive until the end.

title: Sex With Toys
description: Sex With Toys is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Scars of Mars
description: Scars of Mars is a new real-time RPG. During combat and exploration, time flows, so you must make split-second decisions, execute precise commands swiftly, and vanquish enemies within a limited time. It's a thrilling experience that captures the unique tension and satisfaction of the gameplay.

title: Space Race
description: Embark on a thrilling cosmic journey with Space Race! Pilot your ship in this vertical top-down racing game, where you'll race, battle enemies, and collect power-ups in vibrant arcade landscapes. Master the art of firing, jumping, and dodging obstacles. Will you dominate the stars?

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Club Crazy
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Party down with these Night Club themed tables!

title: Nixie
description: Nixie is a 2D story-driven exploration game about a robot's search for a missing human lost in an android space colony. Slash, fling, and glide your way through an eclectic world, while enjoying colorful 16-bit pixel art and an infectious soundtrack!

title: Paradise's Secrets
description: After accepting the invitation from the Paradise company following the events we've experienced, nothing on our journey may turn out as we expect. You must be very careful to uncover all the mystery and reveal the truth. Learn everything and expose the true face of the Paradise company

title: One Button Run
description: Press the button to reach your destination!

title: Office Overtime
description: That soulless office job you hate? It hates you too, playing video games during work hours was your fault. Catch up on overdue work before morning. Coffee is your best friend.

title: Dungeon Croaker
description: Dungeon Croaker is a frog themed turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler. Navigate randomly generated dungeon floors, find and synergize relic effects, fight enemies with unique abilities, avoid dangerous environmental hazards, and defeat powerful dungeon bosses.

title: Project;Hypatios
description: Project;Hypatios is an FPS game inspired by Portal where Aldrich was cursed with a time-loop ability and must escape from Mobius Corps' Hypatios Lab by shooting his way through the chambers.

title: Radio Silent
description: You're a marine that just latched onto a ship that went radio silent for 10 years after entering a wormhole in space. Battle hoards of aliens, upgrade your arsenal, and collect audio logs to discover the chilling history of the ship you've boarded.

title: Hidden Western Frontier Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Hidden Prototype Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Hidden Boxes
description: In Hidden Boxes, players are divided into two different teams: seekers and props. Seekers try to find props before time runs out.

title: History of Space
description: History of Space is an immersive and educational game that allows players to explore a virtual space history museum, delving into the captivating history of space exploration.

title: Maraka
description: Maraka is an action dungeon-crawler that features physics based combat. Delve into a procedurally generated cave system on an alien planet. Harness the power of magnets and the environment to wield as your weapon: defeat opponents by physically manipulating objects and the enemy itself.

title: Lum's Game
description: Live an idyllic life growing a garden with your family, and taking care of their strange pet! Life is perfect, except for these strange dreams you keep having...

title: Lost Recall
description: Puzzle game with the addition of skill-based elements. Move, push the objects, solve puzzles, and uncover new mechanics. Use unique abilities of the robots, which will allow you to unlock the next levels.

title: Little Splash
description: Little Splash is a 2D precision platformer inspired by the classics you love. Here you play as an agile protagonist who will splash paint all over your path, are you ready to make the cleanest run possible?

title: Leap Hero
description: The princess has been captured! Step into the armored boots of a frog and use your tongue as a grappling hook to beat challenging levels. Encounter quirky characters and dive into this thrilling rescue mission.

title: Late Night Cleaning Simulator
description: Take on the task of cleaning different businesses, but avoid breaking too many items in the buildings otherwise your boss will not be happy.

title: Mow That Lawn
description: Action-packed sidescrolling gardening-shooter, with colorful comicbook-style graffics and gameplay inspired by the arcade-machines of the early 80's. Mow that lawn, jump over the holes and don't let piles of dirt, animals, drones-with-water-balloons or mischievous friends, get in your way.

title: Moose Miners
description: Take control of a mining operation run by moose. They mine and sell the gems. You need to decide where to spend the profits. Hire more miners and upgrade their gear. Buy new rails and minecarts to get deeper into the mine. The deeper you get the more valuable gems you will find.

title: Model Railway Millionaire
description: Model railway builder with economy simulation. Edit the terrain, build the track, and place all the highly detailed objects to create exciting model railway layouts! Deliver food and row materials to the cities to earn money and expand your world! Be a model railway millionaire!

title: Drinkrime
description: Jin, a talking liquor bottle with supernatural powers, has given you a mission. Face DRINKRIME's cast of unique characters and force them to confess their crimes. Interrogate them together and make those wrongdoers come to terms with their guilt!

title: Disaster Golf
description: Disaster Golf is a new, fast-paced take on golf that requires you to react on the fly. Experiment with many combinations of natural disasters to navigate the golf ball through wild and diverse courses as fast as you can!

title: Heaven Attack!
description: Gabriel comes to wake up Michael sleeping in his room in heaven. It's my turn to look around today. Let's start before Metatron gets angry.

title: Cosmic Panic
description: Arcade style party game for one to four players. Top the highscore charts in a variety of game types in top-down, platforming, and 3D third person perspectives. Play with friends local couch-party style or online with steam remote play.

title: Challenge Tour
description: This is a casual little game!

title: Coreless
description: Coreless is a roguelike action game blending deep RPG customization elements, set in a sci-fi world. Craft your unique playstyle through a rich system of avatars, protocols, augmenters, and traits, as you tackle challenging bosses in this action-packed adventure.

title: Defendor
description: Defendor is a throwback to the fast paced arcade games of the 80s.A retro style, arcade shooter where you upgrade your base to increase the capabilities of your ship, unlock new weapons, ships and cause more mayhem.Defend your base until everyone makes it into the escape ship.

title: Deceived by the Host
description: A slice of life RPG. Hiroshi Kawada’s third year as a college student is as hectic as it can be. He’s trying to secure a job for the sake of his beloved girlfriend, Nanami Miyasaka. Experience romance and drama in a modern Japanese setting.

title: Deathwatchers
description: Deathwatchers is a 4 player online co-op 'spot the difference' style, psychological horror. Use the equipment at your disposal to locate & log as many events as possible. Build your ritual and try to cleanse the locations of any demonic threats. An incorrect ritual and you may never leave.

title: Cryptfall
description: In this 1-4 Player Co-Op game, gather resources, fight fierce enemies, and craft essential tools in a dynamic island adventure. Race against time to survive as an ancient evil awakens in just 10 days!"

title: Anticitizen: Red
description: Use bullet time, a variety of movement mechanics and an improvised arsenal to outwit and outgun biker gangs and corporate police in an American-occupied cyberpunk Australia. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, delve into the lore of the new American empire, and stay for the larrikin charm.

title: And the Hero Was Never Seen Again
description: After defeating the Demon King, the Hero Astel is affected by a magic that turns him into a woman, and resets her powers. Now she must retrain her powers when the "true demons" begin to appear once more.

title: Absolute Color Perception
description: Absolute color sense is a very test of color sense eye game. Among the many colors, can you tell which one is different?

title: Buriedbornes 2
description: "The oldest and most abhorrent Prophecy has become reality. This is endless and merciless warfare for Buriedbornes, army can revive forever." The long-awaited sequel to the easy-to-play turn-based dungeon RPG series is finally here!

title: Buddy and Friends on Halloween
description: Halloween's here, and Buddy the cat and pals are set for 'tricks or treats' in the neighbourhood. But as they venture into the unknown, will compassion and kindness triumph over fear? Join these kittens in a heartwarming Halloween tale in this beautifully illustrated jigsaw puzzle game.

title: Brewing Haus
description: Brew your legacy and explore an inviting world as you create and expand your business. Embark on a serene beer brewing journey in this relaxing simulation game. Discover new recipes, expand, and master the art of brewing.

title: Balling Up
description: Immerse yourself in a colorful journey through universes that does not forgive any mistakes. Jump well in the ball parkour game, where falling can cost you everything!

title: Carball 360
description: A game of carball where the last team to touch the ball scores the goal. An AI named Vicky is there to fill the void when friends are unavailable. Light, simple, competitive.

title: Byle
description: Fight through a corrupted city, battling over 50 unique enemies and powerful bosses. Arm yourself with an arsenal of weapons and uncover mysterious power-ups as you strive to liberate the city from the clutches of the mind-altering BYLE.

title: Call Sign is Magic Liner
description: Call Sign is Magic Liner is an old school Shmup with a new twist. You can strategically draw lines and defeat your enemies.

title: Resident Evil 2: Kendo's Cut - Uncut
description: Sequel to the mod to the original Kendo's Cut, this time following Claire as she deals with the ramifications of Robert Kendo surviving the zombie attack on his gun store.

title: Warriors of Freedom
description: Old schooled turn based tactics game. Pick your hero, gather up your army and fight for your freedom. You have to decide carefully as you have finite amount of everything. Prove your value.

title: Wind Ryder
description: A comedy, romantic dating sim, masquerading as an adventure RPG.

title: Youlogic
description: Indie logic puzzle game

title: Zonescape
description: You wake up in one of the prison cells. By chance, you end up with a key in your pocket that you can use to open your door. Escape from the most secure prison in the world!

title: Way to the Light
description: You are a real digger, having descended down a vertical shaft of a mine, you find yourself in an abandoned tunnel system.

title: Usurper
description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your King is your strongest weapon. Play cards from your deck to drop units onto the battlefield and checkmate your opponent. Build your Deck, Upgrade your Ruler, and Claim the Throne!

title: Visco Collection
description: With the Visco Collection, you'll have the chance to relive the glory days of arcade gaming with these seven fantastic titles. Whether you're a fan of shooters, fighters, sports, or racing games, there's something here for everyone.

title: Twilight Array
description: A narrative-driven sci-fi exploration game that sees a couple being torn apart by invisible forces whilst trying to salvage an abandoned spaceship and uncover its mysteries.

title: Town of Sins
description: Battle card game with a unique battle system. Seduce every girl in the city and turn her into a fighting whore. Train your cards with new strikes. Fight with other players. Go through adventures and events to collect the most beautiful and strongest bitches.

title: Tomboy: Love in Hot Forge
description: Tomboy: Love in Hot Forge is a medieval VN about guy who was left on the street without money. Bridgid is a blacksmith girl who invited you to spend the night at her house. Find out what difficulties you will face and how your relationship will develop.

title: The Stormy Islands
description: Survive mother nature, prepare for the different seasons protecting yourself from cold, heat, hunger and thirst. Beware of Tornadoes, Storms, Tsunamis and predatory animals, on a variety of islands where each one will have to adapt to its limited resources.

title: Puppet Master: Full Moon Toys - Totem & Mephisto Skins
description: After years of experiments, Andre Toulon has created puppets that want to play with you! Play the game in style with skins inspired by the hot 90s action figure toy line. Includes skins for Totem Sutekh and Mephisto!

title: Robot
description: This is a role-playing adventure puzzle game, a wonderful and unfamiliar world that requires thinking in order to continue moving forward, exploring the wonders of this game, overcoming various difficulties, and experiencing magical experiences.

title: Rusty Rabbit
description: Millennia after humanity abandoned the planet, rabbits claimed their place... Stamp, a cute bunny with an old soul, pilots his trusty mech "Junkster" through the giant ruins of a frozen world in this 2.5D action belt scroller.

title: Escapen't
description: YOU CANNOT ESCAPE - I made sure of that. Solve puzzles, gather clues, don’t crawl into ventilation shafts, and realize how trapped you are in this comedy-horror escape room, my magnum opus.

title: Earl vs. the Mutants
description: Play as Earl, a mutant exterminator, in this top-down driving rogue-lite. Navigate a post-apocalyptic wasteland, mowing down hordes of mutants while fulfilling your mission to save humanity.

title: Drift.Wav
description: Drift.Wav is a casual drifting game with a synthwave inspired aesthetic. This game is not meant to replicate / simulate actual drift mechanics, but more serve as a fun & relaxing game where you can slide in a synthwave inspired world. See if you can drift your way to the top of the leaderboard!

title: Diceomancer
description: Diceomancer is a roguelike deck-building game. Despite aspiring to live a peaceful life, fate forced you to embark on an adventure. Make the most of your deck and dice in a world filled with swords, magic, and guns, all to restore the tranquility you once knew!

title: Dice Assassin
description: Dice Assassin is a challenging game where you defeat enemies on the board according to the dice numbers. Choose attacks using cards, position yourself strategically to overcome enemies on the board, and devise tactics using action cards.

title: Debtors' Club
description: Be the tax collector of a shady city hall in this narrative-driven resource management game. Talk to debtors, manage a team, make difficult choices, and challenge the city's moral decay. It's their money, but it's your job.

title: Conflict of Lords
description: Conflict of Lords is an Roguelite Anti-TD game. You will act as the Lord of Foe in Game Development Council, who decided to go his separate way due to a conflict. Invade the newly released game Village Guardian. Summon the Predators to destroy villages. Try your best to overthrow the Overlord!

title: Conqueror of Time
description: Conqueror Of Time is a traditional dungeon crawl rogue game with a time travel theme. Choose a character from different time periods and fight your way through dungeons using various items from different times and spaces. Use time travel abilities to fight alongside your past or future self.

title: The Last Martian
description: The only survivor. The Last Martian. Unite 10 civilizations against an invincible enemy. Fight for the right to life of the last people in the universe, during 20 hours of storyline. Author's Uroboros Universum. A game unlike any other.

title: The Lab Thing
description: The lab thing is a first-person survival horror game. Explore a mysterious secret lab and play as the only human left alive. Gather all the scientist's notes about the monster, upgrade backpack items, record information and try to escape before you join the body collection of the lab thing!

title: Tasty Jigsaw: Happy Hour 4
description: Incredibly appetising dishes for every taste! From juicy and colourful fruits to flavourful grilled steaks. And for dessert we will offer sweet culinary masterpieces and, of course, unusual soft drinks and tart coffee without limit!

title: That Damn Goat
description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where the world, and your character, is constantly changing. Battle to keep control of the crown all while That Damn Goat does everything in its (omnipotent) power to get in the way.

title: The Big Lez Video Game
description: Choose between battle royale, deathmatch, infected and free roam mode and play with your friends as some of the main Big Lez Show characters! Use each characters specific special ability to assist you during combat and create your preferred weapon loadout to play optimally. Beware of the Choomahs!

title: Tactics Below
description: Tactics Below is a turn-based strategy roguelike where you assemble a party of 4 characters and conquer challenging waves of diverse enemies. Unlock new skills, upgrade your characters and create distinct synergies each time you play.

title: Storage Hustle
description: Storage Hustle is a Simulation RPG where you go into storage auctions to buy different mysterious storages. Discover and sell many items, join Yard Sales and haggle your way for profit!

title: Spider Mall!
description: A night of urban exploration goes wrong for Explorer X as he finds himself trapped in an abandoned shopping mall facing off against security guards and a giant hungry spider. You make the choices in this live action bodycam FMV game. Escape the mall or die trying!

title: Space Shooter 24
description: Join the war in the depths of space with Space Shooter 24! Customizable ships, realistic graphics, and breathtaking action await you. Take action now to save the galaxy.

title: Small Aircraft
description: This is a classic flying shooting game with exquisite and simple graphics.

title: Story Time
description: Turn based Strategy game focused on multiplayer. Choose 9 characters, battle your friends, build levels, share them.the player with the most characters after 20 turns wins.

title: Pure Badminton
description: Pure Badminton is the most realistic Badminton simulation game. Experience the sensations of badminton, in a fast, technical and strategical game.

title: Pro Basketball Manager 2024
description: Welcome to Pro Basketball Manager 2024 - the best basketball management experience, offering unparalleled depth and authenticity across 160+ elite basketball competitions. Show the world you're the ultimate basketball manager!

title: Past Memos
description: "The game Past Memos is a game set in three different time periods, containing puzzles and mysteries. It aims to blend its features with a narrative to provide players with a beautiful experience. You must unravel the mystery in different time periods to shed light on the future."

title: Paper Bride 5 Two Lifetimes
description: "Paper Bride 5 Two Lifetimes" is the 5th work in the "Paper Bride' series. Our cast from Zangling Village return to the stage to welcome players back to the world of paper bride...

title: No Vacancy Tonight
description: Imagine waking up trapped in an abandoned motel. When you manage to get out of the room, a phone rings in the distance... In this point & click adventure game in 3D, you will have to use your wit to solve puzzles and find out what happened.

title: Kem Alpha 1
description: You get a call to go to your friend's house, but then things start to take a horrible turn....

title: Letifer
description: Take on the demonic threat as Letifer in an action-packed mix of twin-stick shooter, roguelite, and survivors-like gameplay. Gun through brutal Rituals, shape your build with powerful upgrades, and return to base for lasting upgrades to your character and gear.

title: Lily in Puzzle World
description: Explore a sketchbook world in a casual mix of platforming and brainteasing puzzles!

title: Luna's Tale
description: Help Luna in collecting coins, defeating enemies, overcoming hurdles and exploring huge worlds in saving her forest from the evil forces in this classic 3d platformer.

title: Megaquarium: Deep Freeze
description: Unite the deep ocean's abyssal species and polar favourites such as Adélie Penguins and Seals in this two-for-one expansion! Deep Freeze combines complex new care requirements, new decorative options and a 5 level campaign into Megaquarium's most ambitious expansion yet!

title: Millennia
description: Create your own nation in Millennia, a historical turn-based 4X game that challenges your strategic prowess across 10,000 years of history, from the dawn of humanity to our possible futures.

title: Mr. Semmel
description: Mister Semmel is a 2D platformer in which precision and speed are required. Can you manage to pass each level within the given time? Can you beat your own records?

title: Multiplayer Drone Simulator
description: Take part in breathtaking drone simulation in a realistic city with Multiplayer Drone Simulator! Enjoy the freedom in free mode, test your skills in levels, and drive drones with players worldwide.

title: Nightlife Tycoon
description: Nightlife Tycoon is a bar management game, where you have to build your dream bar and make it thrive. Hire staff, take care of customers, organize incredible events and become the king of nightlife!

title: NeonPowerUp!
description: Save a city overrun by robots. Save a dystopian futuristic city overrun by mad robots

title: Neon Fantasy: Cats
description: Neon Fantasy: Cats is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Fall Valley
description: Step into the breathtaking world of Fall Valley, where the vibrant hues of autumn await your discovery. Immerse yourself in a serene, orange-colored wonderland as you embark on a soul-soothing journey through this stunning valley.

title: Filly Astray
description: A platforming adventure game with a new take on combos, dare you adventure into the world of Filly Astray and face the monsters and mayhem within?!

title: Forza Motorsport: Car Pass

title: Abandon: The Town
description:
A Source 2013 mod with a focus on gunplay over puzzles or story. Weapons feel better, enemies are a lot tougher, and the player can no longer quick save to try and cheese their way through situations. Play this if you're looking for a mod that actually makes some changes to the game rather than just a pack of maps set in the Half Life universe, but be sure to expect a challenge!

The mod is basically 100% focused on combat and is in some ways more of a proof of concept than a full game. So in other words there isn't really a story to speak of and it ends a bit abruptly. That being said more content is in development and everything I'm developing in this will be put to use in future work so look forward to that.

I'm currently very open to any assistance from experienced developers. I have very specific goals in mind so if you're looking for a project that isn't going to wander into the unrealistic territory that kills a lot of mods, this is it.

title: Spellbound Survivors
description: Welcome to the mesmerizing world of Spellbound Survivors, a single-player action-roguelike game! Embark on an epic adventure, conquer maps, acquire mighty powers, and gear up for an ultimate showdown with the formidable Overlord Wizard. Your destiny unfolds in this captivating journey!

title: Spark Mk1
description: Spark MK1 is a fast paced non-stop action game that will challenge your reflexes.

title: Sonny The Mad Man: Casual Arcade Shooter
description: Welcome to Sonny The Mad Man! Are you ready for adventure and epic fights?

title: So Much Stuff 4: Bits & Bobs
description: Uncover an abundance of new stuff in this exciting sequel!

title: SCP: Centura Tycoon
description: Rebuild the SCP Foundation, contain anomalies, and face the Chaos Insurgency. Your choices shape humanity's fate. Can you secure, contain, and protect?

title: Set Off Fireworks Together
description: Set off fireworks together, here you can experience a different feeling, you can create as much as you like in the game, combine fireworks, and pursue the taste of childhood!

title: Sky Conquest
description: In short, Sky Conquest is a fun platform game to play with friends, with cute graphics and competitive gameplay. Download it for free right now on Steam and get ready to jump in and have some fun!

title: Shelter in the Doomsday
description: This game is a 2D platform game mainly focused on defense and adventure, with some storyline tasks, as well as collection and construction.

title: Recordbooks
description: 'Recordbooks' is a Photorealistic bodycam first-person tactical shooter . You will play as a secret agency agent whose duty is to solve Complex and Mysterious cases of your duty area .You will need your detective and tactical skill to solve these complex cases. Get ready to show your skill.

title: Red Barrels Go Boom
description: The world is overrun with zombies! They are fast and they are immune to bullets! The only way to kill them is EXPLODING BARRELS!

title: Rogue Mech
description: Pilot your trusty Phoenix in this isometric, post-apocalyptic mecha survival game with base building elements. Trade, plant, hack, dig, talk and fight your way through the wastelands. If you survive, you might be able to restore a little green to this ash-ridden world.

title: My Recycling Center
description: Operate, configure and expand your own recycling center in this first-person simulator! Work fast and sort the trash. Use the compactors to destroy the bulky waste. Earn satisfaction and cash to buy new containers and unlock new trash types.

title: Motel Manager Simulator
description: Restore an old motel alongside a shop and a gas station. Design, furnish, decorate and rent rooms. provide products for customers and fuel for cars. Hire employees to help you and be the boss of your own empire.

title: Memory Rewind
description: Explore the thrilling detective visual novel adventure with your assistant Olivina. Find your way through the bizarre case that pulling you into unique investigation gameplay and meet the colorful cast of memorable characters that can help you or endanger you

title: JR EAST Train Simulator: Shin-etsu Line (Naoetsu to Niigata) E129-0 series
description: Currently, the Shin-etsu Line operating as JR EAST has three sections: between Takasaki Station and Yokokawa Station, between Shinonoi Station and Nagano Station, and between Naoetsu Station and Niigata Station. This DLC includes the section between Naoetsu Station and Niigata Station.

title: Le Corps-Glitch: Multitudes
description: In Le corps-glitch (multitudes), multiple becomings occur. It is a virtual reality experience that highlights potential and future bodies to merge with the Other, change skin, slowly morph into a hybrid being that connects with plant, animal and technological species.

title: Leave Panda Away
description: In China, there is a peaceful and beautiful country inhabited by pandas of various races. They are usually gentle and friendly, but when faced with threats, they will demonstrate strong combat effectiveness.

title: Legend of the Archer
description: Legend of the archer - the game will tell you the story of a legendary archer who finds himself in the midst of a war between two clans.

title: Legends of Savvarah: Flowers and Scorpions
description: You are Nikaria. An agent of a mysterious god, sent to another country. Does the end justify the means? Is the will of the god above the law? Is the death of a non-believer insignificant? The decision is yours alone.

title: Martha's Dolls
description: Dive into the adventures in " Merphy Town " where Martha's Dolls lives, solve the mystery, prepare yourself for a great horror experience !

title: Lovey Dovey
description: As the #1 toilet fan, you visit an abandoned toilet factory in search of the legendary golden toilets. However, you're ambushed by the factory's friendly mascot, Lovey Dovey. You're at an extreme disadvantage since the only thing you brought is a rocket launcher. Collect all 69 toilets then escape!

title: Lens Of Horror
description: Descend into the psyche of an elder known for his red hat. Is his world an illusion or a horrifying reality? Each shadow holds untold secrets, with a line blurring reality and delusion. Seek the truth, but it unveils itself only at the end. Are you brave enough to look through the Lens of Horror?

title: Luna's Adventure: The Overlord
description: A special friend to rescue. A final boss accessible from the start. A whole world to explore until you can defeat him. Risk your life to save the person most important to you in this fantasy adventure RPG in 3D and real-time combat.

title: Poon Puzzle
description: Poon Puzzle is a relaxing anime puzzle with cute horny girls. Solve puzzles, and enjoy high-quality animated artworks!

title: Project Chimera
description: We will save humanity by our knowledge. We need to just immerse in this environment.

title: Prin-C01
description: An endless runner where you can control your speed. Run, trot and jump as you collect bones while avoiding speed blockers, pits and enemies. Or use your wits and turns those blockers against enemies. Play across multiple levels to beat the best score.

title: Pixi Poxi Autorunner Lab
description: Pixi Poxi is a challenging autorunner rage puzzle platform game that will test the limits of your gaming skills. You will accompany a test subject on their quest to escape to freedom fighting through several levels with a variety of difficulties, traps and barriers!

title: Philistine
description: Join Priam as he navigates a world that wants him dead. Help him make decisions as he’s met with trials and tribulations that never cease to antagonize him. While he has his own character, you may be surprised with how heroic, or villainous, he may be based upon the decisions you’ve made.

title: Operation Terra
description: Lead mankind to its new Earth in this science fiction First Person Shooter/Role Playing Game. Grab your gear and fight through hordes of hideous robots, droids and machines. Loot credits and power ups. Complete missions to unlock permanent bonuses. With procedurally generated levels and maps.

title: Nothing Left: Give Up
description: Legend has it that in the far east, there is a golden tree that produces golden fruits, and there are constantly explorers embarking on this arduous and challenging journey in search of the legendary golden tree. Explorers please be careful of the rough sea, once stepped into will never be recovered

title: Glam Pursuit
description: Enter the dazzling world of Glam Pursuit in Sunshine City. Master the unique acting system, shape your actor, and navigate the highs and lows of fame. Watch your scenes steal the limelight on the silver screen. Your path to stardom begins here!

title: Freja
description: Freja is a first-person psychological horror game with a unique approach. You take the role of a woman with PTSD and selective amnesia and must help her remember her past traumatic experiences through exploration and arcade games.

title: Ghost In The Mirror: Episode 1 - Here Be Dragons
description: Ghost In The Mirror is an anthology of graphic adventures. A series of ghost stories characterized by a lot of storytelling, puzzles, and wild humor. A collection of modern adventure games that still capture the spirit of the '90s games.

title: Graviteam Tactics: Stalemate on Donets
description: Izyum-Barvenkovo offensive operation of the Red Army was carried out from 17 to 27 July, 1943 by forces of South-Western Front in order to encircle and destroy the German group defending Donbass, as well to prevent the transfer of enemy troops to the Kursk region.

title: Highway Cleaners
description: The world is overrun, and your survival depends on your skills behind the wheel. Are you ready to take on the apocalypse and become the ultimate Highway Cleaner? Get behind the wheel, gear up, and let the mayhem begin!

title: Hearts of Cold: Redemption
description: Hearts of Cold is a story driven, futuristic, open world, first person-third person Shooter, set in a wide range of varied environments with fast paced, intensive action interspersed with moments of calm and adventure.

title: Hinge
description: Hinge is a psychological horror game inspired by Lovecraft and Bioshock. Explore atmospheric locations, search for clues, survive the nightmare, and discover who you are and why you're here.

title: Hitler is my crash
description: Hitler is my Crash is an absurd adventure in which you will plunge into the world of black humor and satire. You have to take on the role of a girl who is in love with Hitler and does not want to share him, and go on an absurd journey with Hitler, who is captured by saboteurs.

title: I Love Finding Wild Friends
description: Discover lovable wild animals in this thrilling hidden object game!

title: Fakeway
description: Dig, fight, collect, and explore. If you like Terraria very much, you can try this game. It will also give you a different experience.

title: Escape The Charon
description: Escape the Charon is a sci-fi adventure meant to be played in one sitting. An ancient alien artifact has been brought to the space station Charon - soon after, the Charon goes dark. James West must search for clues and solve the mystery to discover what went wrong.

title: Educational Suite
description: "Explore a world of fun and learning! Educational Suite offers engaging mini-games to help kids develop essential skills. Join the adventure now!"

title: Dystopika
description: Dystopika is a chill cyberpunk city-builder of dystopian dreams (or nightmares). No goals, no stress, no objectives. Just your imagination.

title: Drunkoff V.
description: "Drunkoff V." is a narrative game with elements of horror, telling the dramatic story of the main character. You will have to come face to face with skeletons in the closet along with him. The events unfold in the post-Soviet era.

title: Drop Doll
description: "Drop Doll" is a casual puzzle game. In this game, players earn points by combining balls of the same type.

title: Dragon's Ruler
description: This is a single-player, turn-based strategy war game set in a fantasy world. With over 130 different units, strategize to maintain a balance between governance and military strength as you aim for territorial expansion!

title: Dungeon 3D
description: The ultimate 3D Virtual Tabletop, Dungeon 3D is light-weight, incredibly easy to use, and extremely robust. It has everything you could possibly need to run full sessions, create gorgeous 3D maps, access character sheets, initiative, dice rolling, animated and customizable avatars, and so much more!

title: Explosive Madness
description: Explosive Madness is an exciting game about physics and destruction. You have to destroy various structures using tools and explosives! In the game you will find many exciting and exciting levels of varying difficulty.

title: Forebloomed: Evergreen Edition
description: An action rogue-like about garden plants fighting back against the hungry pests that threaten their home. Spend the day blasting through hedges to find loot, but take care to make it back before dark! Gather synergistic items, confront formidable bosses, and play as several unique characters!

title: Flex Disc Golf
description: Play countless disc golf courses throughout the world, find lost discs or buy new ones, and learn new throws and styles! Experience realistic gameplay while being surrounded by highly detailed nature.

title: Firebowl
description: FireBowl is an Arcade Multiplayer game inspired by the classics. It is set in High Fantasy world with all the classic characters such as Halflings, Wizards or... Toilets? Join the party and discover the number one sport of the Middle Ages.

title: Field of Honour
description: Field of Honour is a single-player game that combines elements of first-person shooter and strategy, set in the Napoleonic Wars. You can take command of massive battles or engage as a single soldier to defeat the enemy in various game modes.

title: Caribbean Legend
description: An open-world RPG set in the Golden Age of Caribbean piracy. Embark on a 200-hour-long adventure, plunder cities and ships, explore the unknown, discover treasures, forge friendships, earn bounties on your head, and charm the ladies on your path to ultimate freedom!

title: Card Crafter Genesis
description: Card Crafter Genesis- Create your own card games with custom cards, decks, and rulesets! Then play them against other players online! Each card can be given custom backs, fronts, descriptions, and effects!

title: Cardboard Fish
description: Dive into the captivating world of Cardboard Fish! Experience gripping gameplay as Nozzle, the heroic fish, in a physics-based adventure filled with skill challenges and mind-bending puzzles for thrilling progress and achievement.

title: Card Battle Simulator
description: Dive into the world of customizable card games! Whether you're a player seeking new challenges or an aspiring creator, this is for you.

title: Dark City: Kyiv - Collector's Edition
description: Gather your courage for a journey into a mysterious world beyond our view in this hidden-object mystery!

title: Corvos Dynasty
description: Build your heroes, loot the kingdom, and discover rare treasures. Corvos Dynasty is an RPG inspired by old-school classics. Will you be the legendary hero who saves the princess or the conquerer who burns the monarchy to the ground?

title: Concubine
description: A sensual, hack dark fantasy ARPG. Fully customize an adorable concubine and up to three female companions with deep cosmetix details. Be the private assassin of the Sultan and earn sexy outfits, powerful weapons & mystic skills. Design & customize your harem base at the Grand Palace.

title: College Sex: Episode 1
description: A visual novel series about the sex life of two college girls. In this episode, they just arrived at their dorm.

title: Chick-Chick
description: You play as chickens who have to survive on unstable platforms in various universes of the chicken coop, will you be able to keep the balance and hold on, compete with friends and beat the record!

title: Daydream Mosaics 4: Shades of Blue
description: Join the Twin World saga's latest chapter as you dive into the mesmerizing underwater kingdom of the Azure World. Solve nonograms to restore submerged sanctuaries, and explore the tranquil beauty of the deep blue. Enjoy added challenges with hidden object, spot-the-difference, and jigsaw mini-games.

title: Daydreamy
description: Explore the imaginary worlds of Nela in Daydreamy, the indie first-person narrative adventure that takes you back to those years when everything was possible. Discover how she lost her imagination and let yours soar. Are you ready to embark on a unique adventure?

title: Decopins2
description: "Decopins 2" is a sequel to "Decopins" a Decopin-type tower defense shooting game. Use traditional Japanese finger flick -Decopin- to repel the approaching donuts. Collect EXP and money to level up your Decopins. Depending on your level, you will also be able to use magic. This time, it's tougher...

title: Cartel Tycoon: Anniversary Edition
description:
About Cartel Tycoon - Anniversary Edition includes:
- Cartel Tycoon
- Cartel Tycoon - Lieutenant Pack - Guerillas DLC
- Cartel Tycoon - Lieutenant Pack - La Familia DLC
- Cartel Tycoon: San Rafaela DLC
- Artbook
- Soundtrack vol.I
- Soundtrack vol.II

title: Project Adam: AI Attack
description:
2222 AD,
Humanity will suffer destruction due to highly developed AI.

Adam, a special forces agent who survives, wakes up in a laboratory...
That place was the robots' giant space battleship 'Eden'.

Act like AI as much as possible,
Escape Eden from the eyes of AI!

title: CounterAttack: Uprising
description: CO-OP SHMUP / STG (Shoot em' up), 4 player local and 8 player online. Customize your ship with over 500 attachments while you blast through 32 levels.

title: Boykisser Mayhem
description: After being sucked inside of the internet, Boyfriend has to face another dead meme again, it's Boykisser! They shall both get into a rap fight to see who is the ultimate Boykisser!

title: Helion
description: Are you ready to embark on an intergalactic journey like never before? Step into the thrilling world of "Helion," where tactical teamwork, role-based strategy, and stunning stylized graphics collide in an epic sci-fi adventure. Get ready to experience the future of team-based third-person shooters!

title: Luntik Learns Numbers
description: Curious Luntik invites girls and boys to fun counting lessons! Together with Luntik, other characters from the cartoon “Moon Guest” will find themselves at the epicenter of incredible events: the grasshopper Kuzya, the worm Korney Korneich and two hooligans - the caterpillars Pupsen and Vupsen. Favorite characters will challenge your child to complete a series of fun tasks to demonstrate their knowledge of numbers. If the baby fails to pass the test, he will have another, simpler one.

title: Luntik Knows the World
description:
Luntik invites the kids for a walk through a bright fairy-tale world!

Together with the inquisitive lunar guest and his friends, little players will visit meadows and fields, forests and lakes, learn the names of many animals, plants, birds and fish, learn to determine which category this or that object belongs to, and visit Kapa and Shera will get acquainted with the features of some professions.

For each topic, you need to complete several interesting tasks, and if the child fails, the heroes will offer him a simpler test. At the end of the baby's adventures, a surprise awaits you - a new series of cartoons about the adventures of the lunar guest, as well as a certificate as a World Knowledge Specialist.

title: Luntik Learns Letters
description: Our favorite character, as well as the favorite of many modern children, Luntik, invites all young children to go with him on an exciting journey, during which he will conduct very unusual reading lessons. If your child thinks that memorizing letters is a rather boring activity, then this game will definitely change his opinion by turning learning into an exciting game. General Sher, Little Bee, Kuzya and Mila will help Luntik teach your children to read.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Jolted Awake From a Winter Dream
description:
Version 1.4 of Honkai: Star Rail, featuring:
• New characters: Jingliu, Topaz & Numby and Guinaifen
• New main story quest
• New areas: Old Weapon Testing Ground and Pillars of Creation
• New companion missions
• New main event: Aetherium Wars
• …and more!

title: Monster Hearts R
description: Strange shooting game for PC.

title: The Legend of Legacy: HD Remastered
description:
RPG fans rejoice as the classic adventure, The Legend of Legacy is remastered in HD!

The unique stories of 7 heroes spring to life as you explore the mystical land of Avalon and face unknown dangers along the way. Classic RPG gameplay has never felt more engaging with features such as battle formations, combat roles, and forging contracts to channel the power of elementals. An adventure unlike any other awaits you!

title: Phobos Massacre
description: A replacement for Episode 1 of DOOM, in E1 style. This wad is an attempt to capture the atmosphere of "Knee Deep in the Dead" and to evoke nostalgia in players who enjoyed the original DOOM levels.

title: Vordakk's Keep
description: This wad is a replacement for Map 01 of DOOM2, and is my attempt at a Plutonia-style level. Expect a very challenging adventure with some nasty battles and rather unfair ambushes, all in the spirit of The Plutonia Experiment.

title: Ultimate Knight Windom XP
description:
Ultimate Knight Windom XP is a 2008 3D arena combat game featuring mecha inspired by various Windows and Linux operating systems originally developed by Y. Kamada for Microsoft Windows.

Windom XP supports singleplayer, local PVP, online PVP, and LAN PVP.

title: Strato-Spear
description: Strato-Spear is an 3d character action/hack and slash game, with freeform combos and movement. It is inspired by games like Devil May Cry and Super Smash Bros.

title: Nyan Nyan Tower
description: Doujin stage ascending game.

title: Tsumera
description: Taiwanese PC Pinball game.

title: Tenebrum
description: A heretic megawad containing total 35 levels, including secret levels. Intended to be played as a campaign. Also contains around 30 new monsters and 8 bosses.

title: Sinful Discharge
description: An episode for Heretic

title: Templum Dormiens Dei
description: A single level for Heretic, which requires ZDoom 2.8.1 or later. This map is meant to follow the events of Dark Deity's Bastion, and serve as an ending to the storyline which began with that level.

title: Shadowcaster
description: A 21st century Heretic episode covering many styles of level, both traditional and unusual as well.

title: Reclamation
description: An ancient sanctuary has been corrupted by the minions of evil; reclaim the church and make the bastards pay.

title: Torture
description: A small map inspired by the style of the levels in the alpha

title: Thief: The Trail of the Arch-Heretic
description: A moody, ambient WAD intended to put some of the feeling of "Thief: the Dark Project" into Heretic. It's a reworking of my own njthief WAD for Doom2.

title: Where Serpents Ever Dwell
description:
After the lifeless bodies of D'sparils body guards crumble and fall to the ground, for the first time in ages you feel a sense a sense of relief... as you enter the portal that finally takes you... home?

This is a challenging map for Heretic, and your gonna need to keep moving as well as taking full advantage of artifacts if you want to survive.

title: The Sewers of D'Sparil
description:
"Even underwater cities like D'Sparil's Dome need sewers"

A collection of speed maps made in 100 minutes.

title: The Crypts
description: This large map is a remake of E1M7 (The Crypts).

title: Foot Clinic
description:
Step into the shoes of a doctor and podiatrist as you indulge in the foot clinic experience. Scrub, scrape, pluck, and pull all kinds of feet.

Perform foot treatments for conditions like calluses, corns and ingrown toenails. Each patient presents a new problem, so you'll never get bored of your work!

title: The History of Fruit
description:
This is a 9 level Heretic wad designed for single/cooperative play.
In an epic turn of events, the Overlords of Fruit have rallied their unequaled forces of ferocity and badness and meanness and have struck back. It's up to the heretics to fight them back to the last bastion in The History of Fruit!

title: Water Castle
description: This map is the sequel to Water City, and as such picks up where that map left off.

title: The Fiery Crater
description: After you entered the core of the volcano in Fiery Descent, you found yourself in the middle of a smoldering crater on the other side. This map picks up where that one left off, as you journey deeper into it, discovering an ancient fortress built into the side of the lava mountain.

title: The Fiery Descent
description: A short map, set inside a great volcano.

title: Defense of Nations
description: A base defense shooter in the vein of flash game classics like "Elona Shooter" and "Defend Your Castle" but with a satirical, political-sim twist. Shoot hordes of monsters, negotiate your operating budget, and navigate international rivalries, all for The Good of Humanity️!

title: Paddock Note '95
description: The game simulates building up a career for horse racing. As the manager, the player can choose the winning horse, the rider and how many meters racetrack, which is done by navigating multiple menus. In the Strand Yard office, the player has access to plenty of information for the available horses and riders before making decisions. Further learning can be done at the Horse Museum.

title: Mahou City
description: 3D Action Battle City like game.

title: Crowd City
description:
Control the biggest crowd of the city!
Gather a maximum of people, invade the streets and crush your opponents!

title: Portals of Phereon
description: Portals of Phereon is a turn-based tactical role-playing roguelike monster-girl creature-collector by erotic artist Syvaron. Select from one of three distinct protagonists, each with unique skill trees and specialties, and embark on expeditions through the Portals of Phereon to accrue enough strength to tackle the final mission before time runs out.

title: Naruto x Boruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm Connections - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Main Game
• Season Pass
• Naruto Uzumaki (The Great Ninja War: End)
• Kakashi Hatake (Maskless)
• Costume & Accessory Pack

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Base Game
• Character Pass
• Character Mission Pass
• New Champions Uniform Set
• V Jump Accessories
• Shutetsu Uniform
• Tsubasa's Challenge Ball + Meiwa FC
• All-Japan Junior Youth Uniform
• Open Sky Uniform Set
• Hawk Uniform Set
• 2 goal performances

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI: Leader Pass
description: Return to rule with the Civilization VI: Leader Pass. Lead your people to greatness with 12 leaders brand new to Civilization VI and 6 new takes on classic Civilization leaders.

title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Yamato's Grand Tour Logbook & Soul Map 1
description: Yamato takes Oden's logbook as his personal bible. Set out with him on his own grand tour across various stages!

title: The 20 Heretics Challenge
description: 20 monster challenge from Doom but Heretic. Only 20 monsters per map. Period. Max 1 boss monster of any type

title: Heretic Upstart Mapping Project
description: The Heretic Upstart Mapping project was made to get people into mapping for heretic. It includes many maps by people who had never mapped for heretic before, and some older maps that authors had never published.

title: Heretic Upstart Mapping Project Mini
description: HUMP mini (short for Heretic Upstart Mapping Project mini) is a 2018 Heretic mappack, an offshoot of Heretic Upstart Mapping Project from the previous year. It was led by HexenMapper, but unlike the preceding effort which was meant for GZDoom, HUMP mini is instead built with vanilla compatibility in mind.

title: Sosuria
description:
Sosuria is a map made for SOSU's birthday.

Sosuria is a proud, peaceful village on the island of Khshayarsha, full of life and hospitality. That is, until one day an evil sorcerer ransacked the land with his army, taking most of the goods and resources for himself and turning the island into an uninhabitable volcanic landscape. Legend has it that a mythical being of wonder dwells in Sosuria's largest and most prominent building, the Temple of the Ancients. It is said that this creature has the ability to turn back time and undo the evil that was dealt to the village. There is only one way to find out if this is true...

title: Wrath of the Titans
description: A complete 9-level episode featuring some new textures and classic Heretic style with attention to Raven's mapping conventions. The set plays on the episode 2 slot. It includes 8 revised editions of ETTiNGRiNDER's prior released ﻿maps to update the visuals and gameplay, plus 1 never before released one (E2M2)

title: Blood, Fire, Death
description: You Akroxs, the archimagus of fire and ice. Long time ago you have called great demons, masters of fire for yourself in a service, in exchange for the soul. But when payment time has come, you have not wished to give the most valuable that is at you. And you have gone to their house to win them and not to be more dependent on them. Whether you will to win them? Or you will for ever doom the soul to a fiery torment?

title: Burial Ground
description: Burial Ground is a heavily gameplay-driven custom story that's built to emulate the feeling of playing Amnesia: The Bunker for the first time, with an emphasis on high randomness, replayability, and gameplay that rewards exploration and playstyle.

title: Dark Mountain
description: A graveyard is being harvested of corpses to create undead warriors. Fight your way into the caverns beneath the mountain to destroy the evil inhabitants.

title: Desert Crypt
description: While traveling through a desert region, you are ambushed and knocked unconscious by a group of golems. You wake up to find yourself inside a sarcophagus. You push the lid of off the coffin and climb out. You hear the sounds of stone debris being piled up outside the entrance to the tomb. They are sealing you in. At your feet you notice your crossbow. Whoever has put you in here has tossed your weapon on the tomb floor to be sealed in with you. You force the door open and begin fighting your way out of the crypt...

title: The Forgotten Portals
description: You're making your way through an icy region and are nearly crushed when some ice caverns collapse. Eventually you make your way out only to find yourself trapped in a long deserted temple complex. The gates are enchanted and cannot be opened. You decipher an inscription that tells you that you must pass through three portals to remove the barriers that will allow you to leave.

title: Recant
description: Recant is a fairly large level created by Dr. Sleep

title: Shadowy Forest
description: Battle your way through a forest at night.

title: The Subterranean River
description: A river running through an underground city. Fight your way through the docks, the throne room, the flooded temple, a cathedral, the crypts and much more in this massive level.

title: The Master's Domain
description: A full replacement, (9) levels for Episode 1.

title: Ye Olde Smudge
description: Ye Olde Smudge is a 1995 Heretic mapset by Christen Klie consisting of three levels.

title: The Indespensible T_DUNNxx.WAD Series : For Heretic
description: The Indespensible T_DUNNxx.WAD Series - For Heretic is a single-level PWAD for Heretic designed by Travers Dunne and Alister Dunne and released in 1997.

title: Dark Mountain II
description: Sequel to "Dark Mountain" (darkmtn.wad). This is a very large level with more detail in many places than the original Heretic engine can handle.

title: Heretic Speedmapping 1
description: A set of 4 Heretic speedmaps made during an 8 hour session that occured on 1/19/2018.

title: Heretic Speedmapping 2
description: A set of 4 Heretic speedmaps made during an 8 hour session that occured on 2/23/2018

title: Lucifer's Spell
description: New map for Heretic replacing E1M1. Its fairly large and straight forward in progression.

title: Candy choppers
description: The first released Heretic level for Paul Corfiatis, replaces E2M1 and is very small

title: Lost and Forgotten
description: After D'Sparil's defeat, Corvus thought he would be trapped forever. Not long after the decisive battle, Corvus was teleported to an unknown, snow covered region. He gathered what remained of his willpower and began his trek. Lost and Forgotten is a two map release for Heretic's E1M1 and E1M2.

title: Hoshigari Empusa!
description:
A dating simulator on PC and PS2.

You can choose any of the eight main characters as the protagonist and go after the characters of the opposite sex.

title: Go to Sleep
description: What began as a fun dream has turned into a waking nightmare. Now trapped in your room, you are stalked by a relentless demon. You must keep it at bay. Your only way through this nightmare? Close your eyes... and go to sleep.

title: Sweet Season
description: An adult visual novel released in 2002.

title: My Dear Brother Jeff
description:
My Dear Brother Jeff is a Horror experience based on a certain point of view of the story/Creepypasta named Jeff the Killer.

Immerse yourself as Liu, the brother of Jeff, the psychotic killer, face the tragedy of an entire family and discovers the terrible truth that hides behind this horrifiying event...

title: Yukigatari
description: A adult visual novel released in 2001.

title: Yukigatari Renewal
description:
The protagonist's little sister appears as a new character.
Scenarios have been remade since the Dreamcast release, and new event CGs and endings added.
This version also adds voices for the male characters which original only female characters were.

title: Timespinner 2: Unwoven Dream
description: Travel to the Tower in the Sea to avert the apocalypse, in this exploration action-platformer. Join Auria, a retired war hero, as she adventures through a beautiful and dangerous world to save her family and the fabric of reality itself!

title: 2048 3D
description: Control cubes and enjoy 2048 game in real 3D world! Be careful not to drop the cube outside the box!

title: Command & Conquer: Generals Evolution
description: A Red Alert 3 total conversion aiming to bring C&C Generals Zero Hour onto the new engine as well as to expand upon it.

title: Blasphemous Experiments
description: Blasphemous experiments is a complete first episode replacement for Heretic, using the Blasphemer texture pack.

title: The Village of Archensheen
description: A bite sized Heretic level with the restrictions of no more than 100 enemies, 100 sectors, and 1000 linedefs.

title: The Remote Outpost
description: Sarge Baldy's first released Heretic map, to be used as E2M1 of the FreeHeretic project. The overall theme is therefore vaguely similar to the original.

title: Quoth The Raven
description: Quoth the Raven is the 28th installment of the Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping series, created by BluePineapple72. The event ran during June of 2023, in which maps were created in a time limit of 8 hours or less. Mappers were to create Heretic maps using a custom texture pack and calling back to several of the design tropes from the original Heretic. It contains 3 episodes, with forced secret exits, for a total of 27 maps.

title: How to Disappear Completely
description: 3rd part of the river of fire series. this time it all takes place in a underground cave

title: Heart of Fire
description: This is the sequel of The River of Fire. This level is detailed and you start where you left on The River of Fire.

title: The River Of Fire
description: Find the way back to the surface.

title: Anthology of the Killer
description:
A paid compilation of the "Of The Killer" comedy-horror games. The compilation contains a loader for the games, bonus content, and controller support.

Join BB as she makes rent and zines in a world of drinky birds, secret rooms, dream resorts, bort dolls, waterparks, immersive theater, beachfront t-shirt stores, police men, art freeports and unorthodox medical treatment. Nobody gets out of here alive!!
